tei:div.tei:p: bka shād dran bkabastan pa yar rgyasakyisabartsams/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
sdo nga

'go brjod/sgrung deb ring ba 〈thag ring gi sbra nag 〉ces pa ni kho bos lo shas ring 'bad pa byas pa'i rtsom rig gi 'bras bu zhig yin/ de yang 1991lo'i dbyar kha'i nyin zhig than cin dpe skrun 'grems spel khang nas sne len gnang ba ltar shin tu rgyas pa'i gsol tshigs la rol ba'i skabs/ de snga bod du lo mang phyag las gnang myong ba'i bod skyod pa rgan gras gnyis phebs 'dugaphyi nyin khong gnyis nas nga tshor ched mngags gra rgyas pa'i gsol ston zhig bshams byung / khong gnyis ka de snga bod kyi gsar 'gyur dpe skrun dang /dril bsgrags tshan pa'i bya ba'i 'gan khur myong bas/ bod kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal la do snang chen po gnang gi 'dug khong gnyis nas kho bor chang gzhas shig gtong rgyu'i skul slong gnang / kho bos chang gzhas tshad ldan zhig gtong mi shes kyang 'dzem zol med par khram glu zhig btang / de rjes than cin wang khra'o ar khang chen mor log rjes rang nyid nas khram pa'i lo rgyus mtshon pa'i sgrung gtam zhig 'bri rgyu'i kun slong glo bur ba zhig rnyed kyang le lo dang /rdzogs mtha' med pa'i srid 'dzin las ka'i rnyog 'dzing gi nang du sgrung gtam de'i spyi khog cig klad pa'i nang 'khor gyin yod mod/ dngos su shog bu'i steng da dung tshig grub gcig kyang 'god ma thub par yun ring lus/1

1995lor bya ba'i don du kho bo mdo smad du bskyod pa'i ring chab cha grong rdal du nyin nyi shu rtsa lnga bsdad pa'i ring / rgyun ring klad pa'i nang 'khor bzhin pa'i sgrung gtam de dngos su shog bu'i steng du 'god pa'i 'go brtsams te kha byang du 〈khrag gi zegs ma mkha' la 'phyo ba'i gangs ri dmar po 〉zhes btags nas ha lam dbugs thengs gcig gis shog grangs sum bcu lhag bris/ de dgong krung dbyang brnyan 'phrin khang nas bod rang skyong ljongs dbu brnyes nas bgrang bya sum cu lon pa'i rten 'brel dgong tshogs thad ston byed rgyu yin pas brnyan 'phrin la mgo 'khor nas le tshan ma rdzogs bar bltas rjes yang shog grangs bcu la nye ba zhig bris te bod rang skyong ljongs dbu brnyes nas bgrang bya sum cu lon pa'i nyin der kho bo'i sgrung deb ring ba de yang nyin der dngos su ‘‘dbu brnyes ’’song /phyis su rgya grong zi ling mkhar du sdod pa'i ring dang / bod du log rjes rang nyid la dbang ba'i khom pa yod tshad bed spyad de lo gcig dang phyed ka'i nang cha tshang bris zin pa dang / phyi lo bzo bcos bskyar bshu byas te 〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉nas mu 'god byed rgyu gtan 'khel nas sku zhabs don rdor lags nas 'gan 'dzin rtsom sgrig gnang ste mu 'god gnang ba red/de rjes deb rkyang zhig 'don rgyu'i 'dun pa drag po skyed pa dang / klog pa po mi nyung ba zhig gis kyang deb rkyang zhig blta klog byed rgyu'i re sgug byas nas 'dug kyang / ma dngul dbul ba'i rkyen gyis re zhig khong rnams kyi 'dod blo bskong ma thub par lus/ de rjes kho bo'i grogs kyi dwangs ma sku zhabs bkra shis dpal ldan mchog brgyud kun phan thebs rtsa tshogs pa nas bod yig rtsom deb dpe skrun byed phyir rogs dngul thob pa dang pe cin mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas rgyab skyor dang dpe skrun gnang bas da lam sgrung deb de dngos su rgya che'i klog pa po'i spyan sngar bshams pa'i go skabs de shar bas 2

ma rtsa'i mthun rkyen skrun mkhan kun phan thebs rtsa tshogs pa dang / de bzhin pe cin mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi rtsom sgrig pa rnams la snying dbus nas bka' drin che zhu ba yin/'dir ched du zhu dgos pa zhig la/ sgrung deb ring po der do snang gnang mkhan grogs 'ga' shas kyi bsam 'char ltar da res 〈thag ring gi sbra nag 〉ces ming bsgyur nas deb gcig gi nang stod smad gnyis su khag dbye ba las nang don thad 'gyur ldog med/ sgrung deb de ni kho bo'i lo ngo mang po'i ring 'bad pa byas pa'i rtsom rig bya ba'i snying bcud lta bu zhig yin khul yin yang kho bo rang nyid shes bya'i chu tshad dman zhing lag len gyi myong ba dbul bas na ma dag 'khrul ba'i cha mi nyung ba yod srid pas rgya che'i klog pa po dang zhib 'jug pa rnams nas dgongs 'char lhug stsol yod pa zhu/ rtsom pa pos/2004lo'i zla 12pa'i ches 20nyin tse cin lu'u zhun rtsom rig slob gling gi rang shag tu shan mar bris so/3
ring sbyo

lo du ma 'das pa'i sngon rol gyi dgun dus kyi nyin zhig dbang chen gyis rang gi bu dgra 'dul khrid de kha byang la gtad de 'gro bzhin 'dugagrang rlung hur hur du g.yo zhing skabs re rlung gis ded pa'i gangs phye dang nam mkha'i sprin nag 'dres te gnam sa kha 'byar pa ltar mun pa rub nas re zhig rang sar langs nas sdod pa las shar lho nub byang gi kha phyogs kyang mi shes par gyur/ yang skabs re rlung chen cung zad 'jags nas 'brog pa dbul phongs kyi slog hrul lta bu'i sprin gseb las 'phros pa'i nyi 'od sa gzhi'i steng du lhan pa thar thor brgyab pa ltar ser thig 'ga' mngon bzhin 'dugade ring ni yul dang bral nas nyin bcu drug red/ gnam gshis kyi 'gyur ldog dang grang ngar ga tshod che yang pha bu gnyis kyis mdun phyogs su bskyod pa las phyir bshol gom gang yang byed kyi med/song song nas dka' ngal gyis ma bzod pa'i tshe pha bong gi steng du tsog nas cung zad ngal gso ba dang yang dbugs ring re 'then te slar yang mdun nas mdun du bskyod/da gzod dbang chen gyi smin ma dang sma ra'i steng du kha rlangs kyi dkar bad mthug po zhig chags nas 'dug kho'i wa zhwa'i sgrog lung rlung gis lhab lhab tu bskyod bzhin pa ni mdun skyod la skul lcag gtong ba dang 'dra/ kho'i rgyab tu khur ba'i bo'u khra ring gnam lcags zhes pa de'i ru rtse ru btags pa'i ru dar dmar po de ni skyi g.ya' ba'i dkar mdog gi 'jig rten de'i steng du gson nyams kyi zil shugs lhag par che ba'i tshon mdog cig red/ dbang chen gyis skabs re 'dren byed kem kem du g.yo bzhin mig 'ben nges med kyis thag ring gi phyogs su rgyang mig gcod pa dang / skabs re mgo bo btegs te gnam la blta gin 'dug da thengs kha phyir bskor nas rang gi bu la blta dus bu'i ngo gdong 'khyags sbos thebs nas dmar nag 3

tu gyur zhing mig gnyis kyang dmar por gyur 'dug 'on kyang bus am gtsigs bsdams nas gom pa re re bzhin mdun nas mdun du spo ba las thabs zad 'u thug gi rnam 'gyur ston gyi med pas dbang chen la sems shugs je cher sbyin/mya ngam gyi gangs thang de'i steng du grung sha dod shos ni rngon khyi lnga po de red/ rngon khyi lnga pos rgyug ma 'dur gyis sngon du 'gro ba min na phan tshun 'ded res 'thab res kyi rtsed mo ci yang rtsed kyi 'dug pas kho tsho ni 'jig rten 'di'i steng du rang dbang dang spro snang gis ma dor ba 'dra/da gzod gnam yang cung zad dwangs pas dbang chen gyis pha bong che yang mi che g.yag ro tsam/ chung yang mi chung g.yag ro tsam zhig 'dug pa de'i steng gi gangs gsog mthug po de phu dung gis 'phyags tsam byas nas der bsdad de sna tha sen mo gang blugs te ngal gsos/bu dgra 'dul yang pha'i 'khris su bsdad nas rum las gung zi dhigacig blangs te khram glu'i dbyangs rta la drangs te btang /dbang chen gyis gang yang ma bshad par rang gi snying ltar gces pa'i bu pang du bzung nas drod khug thabs byas/ 'jig rten gyi pha mas rang gi bu phrag la gces nas de ltar byed pa las don du bu dgra 'dul ni pho lo lnga gsum ༄cob lngar slebs nas yod/ dbang chen gyis rum las spags gong gcig blangs te bu'i lag nang du bzhag rjes sna tha sen mo gang de shugs kyis yar 'then pas sna tha mang drags pas yin nam yang na 'then shugs che drags pas yin mi shes par ri lung yongs su brag ca 'khor ba'i hab sbrid chen po zhig brgyab pa dang dus mtshungs lus kyi tsha drod kyang 'phar/ kha chu/ sna chu//kye gung zi/ smyug leb kyis bzos pa'i dmangs khrod khas 'bud rol cha zhig

mig chu sngo nag mchin pa'i mdog tu gyur ba'i ngo gdong las shar mar 'dzar byung bas dbang chen gyis goms gshis chags pa ltar mthe bong dang ldag mdzub kyis phyis tsam byas rjes yang sna tha sen mo gang blugs nas gang yang ma bshad par bu'i sna khung du u tshugs kyis blugs pas bus de sngon sna tha 'then myong med stabs 'tshes te bstud mar hab sbrid chen po gsum brgyab pa dang da gzod lus phung gi tsha drod 'phar nas tsha sob sob tu gyur/ 'on kyang kha chu/sna chu/ mig chu 'dzar te mnyam du 'dres kyang phyis tsam ma byas par spags gong dang mnyam du bzas/dbang chen gyis yang sna tha sen mo gang blugs te brang khar bzung nas bu'i ngo gdong la bltas nas bsdad/rngonakhyi lnga pos kho gnyis kyi mdun du mchu brang 'og tu bcug nas sgor mor nyal zhing 'khun sgra yang yang grags pa'i tshul la bltas na grang reg gis gnod 'tshe med par gnyid skyid po khug pa 'dra/ dbang chen gyis bu'i rgyab tu khur ba'i sgye mo de tshur blangs te kha phyes nas lug sha sog pa gcig bton te gtsang mar bzas rjes rus pa'i steng du rdzas kyi nag thig mthe bong gi sgor rgya tsam zhig bris te gom pa brgya'i sar 'ben du btsugs nas rang gi rgyab tu khur ba'i bo'u khra ring gnam lcags de mar blangs te phu dung gis nyams 'gyur ldan pa'i sgo nas thengs 'ga' phyis rjes cung myong rol byed pa'i tshul la bltas na/ltas ngan des khyed kyang 'o rgyal chen po bzos song zhes brjod bzhin pa dang mtshungs la dpung rogs khyod 'dra ba zhig yod pas nga dpa' 'khum mi srid ces brjod pa dang yang mtshungs/ de nas khos ru sa la brdab nas sbi sdi'i du ba sngo lhog lhog tu 'phyur bzhin gzes khung las 'ben la gzes dus sog rus de mthong thub tsam las med mod gzes nas cung ma 'gor bar ‘‘twa’’zhes me mda'i skad grags pa dang dus mtshungs skyi g.ya' ba'i mu med gangs mtsho'i 5

dbus su rdzas dri mngar sang sang zhig sna lam du 'thul ba dang / ri lung yongs su brag ca 'khor bas khams sangs pa'i snang ba sbyin byung la/ rngon khyi lnga po'ang gnyid las sad de rna ba krong krong gis phyogs bzhir blta bzhin 'dug khos sa las yar langs te mchu zur g.yas g.yon las yid mgu ba'i 'dzum mdangs kyi gnyer ris shig bsdus te bu la/ ‘‘sog 'ben de tshur khyer shog ngas gcig blta ’’zer/dgra 'dul lam seng song nas ‘‘mig brus zhag mig brus zhag ’’ces skad rgyag bzhin sog rus kyi 'ben de kho rang gi pha la sprad/ dbang chen gyis sog rus kyi 'ben de lag tu blangs nas mchu zur g.yas g.yon las da res las kyang mang ba'i 'dzum mdangs kyi gnyer ris bsdus te mgo bo lcog bzhin du ‘‘lha mda'/ lha mda'/ dgra lha 'khor zhag ’’ces bshad rjes/ sog rus kyi 'ben de da res kyi sar btsugs nas me mdar rdzas mde'u blugs nas gang yang ma bshad par me mda' bu dgra 'dul gyi lag tu bzhagabus me mda'i ru sa la brdab nas gzes/ da res ni khos me mda' rgyag thengs gsum pa red/ sems nang dngangs skrag cung zad skyed kyang rang sems rnal du phab cing dbugs brang khog tu sgom nas gzes khung gi so kha sog rus steng gi nag thig la gzes te me mda'i skam pa gnan grabs byed dus dbugs sgom drags pas rang dbang med par ‘‘bing ’’zhes stug dri shor nas me mda'i mchu yang 'dar 'khrug 'khrug byas/rgad pos bu'i rkub la rdog rgyag bzhus te ‘‘kho re/ ngas khyod me mda' 'phongs zhes pa las stug dri thongs zer med/ rang gi rkub kyang bdag po mi thebs na/ pho khyo ga'i gral la sdod rin e yod ’’ces skad gdangs cung dma' ru btang nas ‘‘pho rab la mkho rgyu mda' rab/ mda' rab la mkho rgyu rdzas/ rkub bdag po byos la me mda' rgyob ’’ces skad cha'i mjug rdzogs pa 6

dang yang rkub la rdog rgyag gcig bzhus te 'khris su langs te rang gi bus me mda' 'phang rgyur sgug nas bsdad/bus dbugs ring gcig 'then rjes dbugs brang khog tu sgom nas gzab nan gyis 'ben la gzes te ‘‘twa’’zhes me mda' 'phangs pa dang dbugs ring shur sgra grags pa zhig 'then nas yar langs/dbang chen gyis lam seng gom zheng chen po'i sgo nas 'ben gyi 'khris su song nas blta tsam byas te ‘‘tog tsam ma gtogs khyod kyis kyang mig brus zhagabu 'di red/ bu 'di red/’’ces mthe bong ker te bsngags brjod byed kyin tshur yong nas pha bong gi steng du bsdad de yang sna tha sen mo gang blugs te ‘‘mda' rtsal skyen po 'dug khyod kyis kyang sor gang gis ma gtogs mig brus zhag da ltas ngan de tsho 'tshol bar yong yang mo 'debs mi thub ’’duzer/ nyi ma 'di tsam song yang da dung gnam gyi mtha' ru slebs rgyu mi 'dug pas kho'i sems su ya mtshan skyed de/ dgra 'dul gyis mgrin pa btegs te rang gi pha la bltas nas ‘‘a pha/ nga gnyis nyi ma 'di tsam song yang da dung gnam gyi mtha' ru slebs rgyu med pa ci red ’rices dris/dbang chen gyis ‘‘um/ gnam sngon po'i mtha' ru 'gro dgos na rta phos nyin lam bco brgyad dgos/’’‘‘gnam gyi mtha' ngo mar slebs na ci 'dra zhig yod dam/’’‘‘gnam gyi mtha' ngo mar slebs na mtha'i rgya mtsho chen po yod/ de phan chad 'gro sa med par gnam gyis bkag nas yod/’’‘‘'o na gnam zhes pa 'di sa yi kha gcod red dam/’’rī rjomi sngar rga mdas sog rus la mo 'debs srol yod/ 'on kyang sog rus la i khung dang chag skyon yod tshe mo 'dabs thub ra/ 7

‘‘red ’’ces dbang chen gyis tshig thag chod pos de ltar bshad zhor du snang med kyis mgo yar btegs nas gnam la blta tsam byas pas lhab lhub tu lhung ba'i gangs kyi 'dab ma gcig mig nang du lhung byung bas ‘‘sprang gnam ’’zhes dmod tshig cig bor nas mig lag pas phur tsam byas/ sen mo'i steng gi sna tha ma lus gtsang mar 'then/dgung sngon gyi sprin nag lang long du 'phyur zhing rlung shugs cung zad chang du phyin nas yang bu yug 'tshab byung / da lta gangs 'bab shugs da res riri pa /bye/shā rigi mi 1)nge/las kyang ba 'dug kyang grang ngar da —sa las cung chung ba 'dugadabang chen gyis sog rus de rdo pha bong stenge gi gangs gsog gi steng du btsugs nas ‘‘ltas ngan de tsho 'tshol bar yong yang mo 'debs thub kyi ma red ’’zer nas bo'u rgyab tu khur nas song /sog rus de da gzod gangs khrod kyi pha bong de'i steng du dmigs gsal gyi lam rtags ltar ha cang mngon gsal dod po 'dugadabang chen gyis kha phyir bskor nas blta dus bu yug gi khrod du rgyang thag gom pa sum brgya tsam phan chad gang yang mthong gi mi 'dugadabang chen gyis rgyab tu khur ba'i bo'u yi steng du da dung bu'i rgyab tu khur ba'i sgye mo de yang khur nas gom zheng chen pos mdun du 'gro gi yod/ me mda'i ru dar dang wa zhwa'i sgrog lung lhab lhub tu g.yo bzhin kha ba bu yug gi grang ngar ji ltar che yang gnya' mi khum par mgrin pa gzengs su btegs te glu blangs par/sde khra lus nga la ma sdang a/sde khra lus nga la sdang zer na/bo'u khra ring gi mjal kha rjes la yod/ 8 sde khra lus nga la ma sdang a/

sde khra lus nga la sdang zer na/rta 'do ba'i khyu 'ded rjes la yod/khos btang ba'i glu de'i tshig dang gdangs la bltas kyang phyir sde ba'i nang du mi log rgyu'i sems thag bcad zin pa 'dra/bu dgra 'dul gyis glu'i nang don gsal po shes/ 'on kyang sems khral che shos ni skyi g.ya' ba'i gangs mtsho 'di de ring sa ma rub gong bgrod thub min de red/ gal srid bgrod ma thub na do dgong gson thub bam phyis su ji ltar 'tsho gnas byed/ kho rang lo chung chung min stabs don mang po zhig blo ngor 'char/ kho rang gi pha dbang chen ni mi 'jon thang can thabs rtsal drug gi kho lag rdzogs pa zhig yin pas thabs shes nges can zhig blo ngor bkod sgrig byas tshar yod nges red snyam nas khos kyang glu blangs par/ri mgo mtho la grang ngar che/rdzi bo 'gro ba'i sa cha min/chu mo rnyog la 'dam snyigs can/ja chu len pa'i chu mgo min/mgo dpon mtho la bka' khrims btsan/ nyam chung sdod pa'i sa cha min/bus blangs pa'i glu de thos pas dbang chen gyi snying khong rus pa'i gting gi 'khon 'gras kyang re zhig yal te rang gi gces pa'i bu mchan 'og tu bzung nas 'khyags sbos thebs pa'i ngo gdong byil byil 'ga' byas nas ‘‘skyes pa pho lus blangs pa la/ dpa' dang blo stobs ldan dgos shing / dpa' dang blo stobs ldan pa la/ thabs dang jus chen 'dzoms pa dgos ’’zer/de nas dbang chen gyis rgyab kyi me mda' mar phabs nas goms gshis chags pa ltar nyams 'gyur ldan pa'i sgo nas phu dung gis yar mar thengs 9

'ga'aphyis rjes rdzas mdel blugs te ‘‘twa’’zhes nam mkha' la gtad de me mda' gcig 'phangs pa ni kho rang gnyis grang ngar che zhing mu mtha' med pa'i gangs mtsho'i steng nas phyogs nges med du 'gro ba la blo stobs sbyin pa 'dra la zhe 'khon gyi sems nad bsangs pa'ang 'dra/de dang dus mtshungs ‘‘kwa kwa ’’zhes pho rog nag chung bzhi me mda'i skad kyis 'drog nas phyogs ga nas yong ba cha mi 'tshal bar gshog zung brkyangs nas phyogs gzhan zhig tu 'phur song /dbang chen gyis gshog zung gi rtsal la brten nas myur bar 'phur ba'i pho rog bzhi po der bltas nas bu la ‘‘pho rog 'phur ba'i phyogs su song na sa nag cig thug nges red/ da ni nyi ma yang phyi dror slebs zin nges yin ’’zhes bshad bzhin mgo bo btegs te nyi mar blta dus nyi ma lta zhog nam mkha'i sprin nag lang long du 'phyur ba'i bu yug gis mkha' lam du gsal thig tsam yang mthong rgyu mi 'dug khos dbugs ring zhig btang nas ‘‘da nged gnyis mgyogs tsam ma song na gangs khrod du shi rgyu red/ do dgong nges par du gangs thang 'di bgrod de sa nag cig tu slebs thabs byed dgos ’’zhes bshad/dgra 'dul gyis ring du gshegs pa'i pho rog bzhi po'i rjes su bltas te mi'i lus la yang 'dab chags lta bu'i gshog pa gnyis yod na ci ma rung /des na dka' ngal chen po 'di yong gi ma red la sa mtha'i rgyal khams 'grim nas mig khra chung gis ltad mo ci yang mthong rgyu red snyams nas sems bsam pa mi 'khrug dgu 'khrug 'khrug pa dang yid stong bsam mi shar dgu shar shar/dbang chen gyis bu dgra 'dul gyi phrag steng du lag pa rdeg tsam byas nas ‘‘bu/ khyod ci zhig la bsam blo gtong gi yod ’’zer/dgazod kho stong bsam gyi rgya las grol te ‘‘a pha/ rkang gnyis mi la 10

yang bya dang byi'u 'dra ba'i gshog pa gnyis re yod na dga' ba la ang /des na sa mtha'i rgyal khams 'grim na'ang dka' rgyu ci yod ’’ces bshad/dbang chen gyis mgo bo 'phred du g.yug bzhin du ‘‘kho re/ skye ba mi lus blangs te don go mi gcod par/ dud 'gro glen lkugs kyi lus la yid smon skye dgos don ci yod/ ma a ma'i khog las don te lte thag gcod dus/bu red dam bu mo red ces 'dri dus/ bu red ces pa go dus gnyen nye ba'i sems la gangs rir nyi ma'i 'od 'phro ba ltar dga' lhang lhang dang / sdang dgra bo'i sems su rdza rir grib nag phog pa ltar skyo snang byed kyi yod pa red/da skye ba pho lus blangs/ pags tshag pus mo'i yan la gnyer/ mgo skyes skra lo nag po la dpa' bo mtshon pa'i skra gzhug btags na'ang / da dung dud 'gro glen lkugs kyi lus la sems chags na skyes pho'i gral la sdod rin ci yod/'gro/ mgyogs tsam 'gro ’’zhes bu dgra 'dul gyi lag g.yon ma las bzung ste khrid de song /da gzod gangs 'bab mtshams chad/ ri thang yongs dngul gyi khu bas byug pa bzhin skya thing thing du gyur zhing rlung 'tshub kyis bslangs pa'i gangs phye nam mkhar 'phyur ba ni gnam sa steng 'og brjes te bu yug gi mun pa rub pa dang gnyis su med/ gangs phye dgung du 'phyur ba'i mtha' med gangs mtsho'i khrod du pha bu gnyis kyis 'gro skyod byed pa'i gzugs brnyan ni 'gul skyod kyi dbang rtsa ma nyams pa'i 'bu nag gnyis 'bu srin rig pa'i gnas la rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang phyug gi mdun gyi zhib 'jug dkar sder gyi steng du 'phag 'tshag rgyag pa dang yang dag mtshungs/rngon khyi lnga po ni 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal dang yang dag bral ba'i rang dbang can zhe gcig red/ kho tsho'i gom lag yang la phan tshun 'thab res rtsed res byed kyin 'dug11

grang ngar ji ltar bzod dka' yang pha bu gnyis kyis gnya' mi 'khum par mdun nas mdun du skyod/ ngo gdong 'khyags sbos thebs nas mchin pa'i mdog ltar gyur ba dang / sma ra dang smin ma'i steng du sngar bas mthug pa'i dkar bad sor gang tsam chags pa'i tshul ni gnam bdag ye shu'i chos lugs kyi lha 'khrungs dus chen skabs kyi lha 'khrungs bgres song gi rgyan gyis spras pa'i ngo gdong dang gnyis su med/ skabs re gnam sngon por ka ba btsugs pa lta bu'i gangs phye'i rlung 'tshub kyis pha bu gnyis mgal me skor ba ltar bskor nas sa ru brdab kyang am gtsigs bsdams nas sa las langs te mu mthud mdun du skyod pa las rang sar langs te ngal mi gso ba ni mtsho bod mtho sgang du 'tsho ba'i bod rigs mi dmangs la lhan du skyes pa'i bla na med pa'i blo stobs rang red/dgun dus rtswa thang gi gnam gshis ni sgyu ma mkhan gyi sprul pa ltar 'gyur sla ba zhig red/ da lta rlung 'jags nas mdun skyod kyi gom rlabs la 'gog rkyen chung du phyin pas pha bu gnyis kyi rkang par ljid che ba'i lcags sgrog cig gtor ba lta bu'i tshor snang byung ste rgyug ma 'dur gyis ha lam chu tshod phyed ka'i nang rgyang grags gsum lhag tsam gyi lam thag bcad kyang sa nag sbar mo tsam yang ma thug 'on kyang de khul gyi gangs gsog cung srab pa 'dug pas kho gnyis kyi sems su da res dang mi 'dra bar bde lhod cig byung / rngon khyi lnga pos mjug ma a long ltar bkug nas sa la snom bzhin pa ni sder chags khyi la yod pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i sna shes kyis dri gang zhig tshor ba 'dra/da lta nub kyi gnam mtha' nas 'od mdangs bral ba'i nyi ma'i zhal khyim skyo po zhig mthong byung / nyi ma nub ri dang bar thag ha cang nye bas sa rub rgyur ha lam chu tshod gcig tsam las mi 'dugapha bu gnyis kyis ngo gdong gi dkar bad mthug po de sbar mos gtsang 12

mar phyis rjes grang ngar gyi mkha' rlung yid tshims pa re brngub rjes pha dbang chen gyis mgrin pa gzengs su btegs te glu blangs par/bu khram pa nga la mgo sba (sbra )med/dgung a sngon khram pa'i mgo sba (sbra )yin/bu khram pa nga la dpung rogs med/bo'u khra ring khram pa'i dpung rogs red/bu khram pa nga la glo rta med/rkyang gwa ma khram pa'i glo rta red/bu khram pa nga la 'gro rogs med/mde'u sngon mo khram pa'i 'gro rogs red/glu mjug rdzogs pa dang phas bu'i ngo gdong la bltas/ bus kyang pha'i mgo nas mjug bar zhib blta 'ga' byed dgos byung / rgyu mtshan ni kho'i phas de ring khram glu thengs gnyis btang byung / de sngon khos phas khram glu gtong ba go myong med pas red/ sngon chad kyi 'tsho ba'i nang bu dgra 'dul lta ci/ pha dbang chen yang mda' gri mdung gsum la blo bcol te rta 'do ba'i mgo 'phang shin tu mtho zhing / lag mtshon cha'i rno dbal rab tu che ba'i ming chen khram pa'i las la zhugs myong med/ zhugs pa'i dgos pa'ang ma mchis par rta nor lug gsum ri thang khengs pa'i phyugs bdag btsan grags can zhig min yang / lhas ra khra mo stong par lus myong med/ g.yu byur mu tig byur bur bltams pa'i mdzod kyi bdag po zhig min yang / zas snod stong par lus myong med/ ja chang 'o ma rgyun chad med pa'i mi chen dpon po'i khyim tshang zhig min yang / rgya ja yu dmar la tshwa mar chad myong med/ 'on kyang 'byung 'gyur gyi las bskal ni ngo ma dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyis kyang dpog dka' ba zhig red/ tha na gson thub bam mi thub kyang ngo ma shod 13

dka' ba zhig red/ sngon chad dang 'byung 'gyur gyi las bskal yid la shar dus dbang chen gyi sems su 'khon 'gras kyi zhe sdang me ltar 'bar nas rang dbang med par khu tshur lcags gong ltar dam por bsgril nas mas mchu so yis dam du bcangs/de nas kho gnyis sa 'bur zhig gi steng du bsdad de ngal gso brgyab/dgra 'dul gyi mgo pha'i pang du bzhag nas cung ma 'gor bar ngal dub kyi rkyen gyis gnyid shor/dbang chen gyis ga ler rum las sna ru blangs te sna tha sen mo gang blugs te bu'i ngo gdong la blta dus/ ngo mdog mchin pa dang mtshungs shing mig dang 'gram pa 'khyags sbos thebs pa dang / mchu to gas te khrag kyang bzhur gyin 'dug pas sems gting nas bzod dka' ba'i sdug bsngal chen po skyes/khos sna tha sen mo gang 'then rjes tsub la mkhregs shing dreg pas nag por gyur ba'i lag pas bu'i ngo gdong la byil byil zhig byas pas bus mig gdang tsam byas te yang gnyid khug kho'i rkang pa gnyis gangs gsog gi nang du brkyang 'dug pas 'di ltar yun ring gnyid khug na rkang pa gnyis lham gyi nang du 'byar nas grang ngar gyis phyid kyi red snyam nas ‘‘bu/ bu/ da gnyid nas ma sdod/ rkang pa phyid kyi red/ gnyid nas ma sdod/ longs shog ’’ces shod kyin 'gram par byil byil byas/dgra 'dul gyis ga ler mig gdang nas ‘‘um’’zhes lag pas mig phur gyin mgo yar btegs nas pha la bltas te ‘‘de ring sa nag cig thug rgyu a yod/’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘'di'i rgyud gangs cung srab pa 'dug pas da dung mdun du song na phal cher sa nag thug gi red ’’zer/dgra 'dul gyis mdun du nyal ba'i sngon khyi gcig gi mgo la byil byil 14

'ga' byas/dbang chen gyis sna ru bton te rkang pa'i steng du lan 'ga' brdab nas ‘‘sna tha e 'then ’’zer/‘‘mi 'then/’’‘‘sna tha 'then nas hab sbrid brgyab na lus kyi tsha drod 'phel yong ’zer bzhin mthe bong gi sen mo'i steng du cung zad gcig brdab nas dgra 'dul gyi sna khung la gtugadagra 'dul gyis mig btsums te shugs kyis 'then pas ‘‘ha chi ri’zhes hab sbrid brgyab pas mig dang sna khung las mchi ma 'dzar bzhin ‘‘da dad dung tog tsam zhig ster dang ’’zer bzhin kho rang gi mthe bong pha'i phyogs su bsrings/dbang chen gyis bu'i mthe bong gi sen mo'i steng du cung zad cig blugs rjes kho rang gi sen mo'i steng du'ang cung zad cig blugs/dgra 'dul gyis yang mig btsums te shugs kyis yar 'then pa dang mgrin pa gzengs su gtod cing kha gnam la gdang nas ‘‘ha ha ha chi/ ha chi/ ha chi/ ha chi ’’zhes bstud mar hab sbrid brgyab pas lus kyi tsha drod je cher 'phel/ denas khos kha chu/ sna chu dang mig chu gtsang mar phyis nas ‘‘a pha/da 'gro ’’zer/de'i tshe kho gnyis kyis gangs 'khyags kyis zin pa'i lham phud de gtsang mar brdab rjes ‘‘me shul chu las grang / chu shul me las dro ’’zer bzhin rkang pa gangs kyis gtsang mar bkrus te lham gyon pa dang / sked rags dam par bsdam nas song bas da res las yang zhing lhod pa/ rkang pa'ang tsha drod 'phel/15

ngo ma 'brog pa'i kha dper ‘‘lham sgrog dam na sgrog yin/ sked rags dam na rta yin ’’zhes pa rang red/ 'khyug tsam zhig gis sa thag ring po bcad de sa ma rub gong ri 'dabs kyi na thang zhig tu slebs/ der gshong sa rnams gangs gsog cung mthug kyang / sgang 'bur tshang ma stobs chen 'byung po'i lce yis ldag pa ltar gangs sen mo'i sgor rgya tsam med par nag rkyang red 'dug pas/ re zhig gson thub pa 'dug snyam pa'i dga' tshor skyed pa dang / rkang pa'i 'degs 'jog kyang sngar bas yang zhing lus yongs kyi 'gul skyod bde lcag dod du phyin/rngon khyi lnga po mchongs bzhin rgyug bzhin sngon du song nas mthar gshong sa zhig tu mi snang bar gyur song /pha bu gnyis kyis myur rtab kyis khyi lnga po'i rjes su rgyug nas song bas gting ring zhing 'khor rgya che ba'i gcong rong khyad mtshar can zhig 'dugagacong rong de'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad rdza dang brag las grub pa'i ri bo gcan gzan gyi mche ba dang 'dra bas bskor nas 'dug pa de dag gi rtse mo ni dmag dpon chen pos dngul dkar gyi rmog gyon pa ltar gangs dkar gyi cod pan bcings nas 'dug gcong rong gi gting du gangs kyi ming tsam yang med par/ na rtswa wa dmar gyi sgal gzhung dang 'dra ba'i dbus su rngon khyi lnga pos chu ldag bzhin 'dug pha bu gnyis kyis rdza ldebs nas thur du rgyug nas sa ma rub tsam la gcong rong gi mthil du slebs/'chi la nye ba'i skabs der pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis lung bstan pa'i sbas yul lta bu'i gcong rong gting ring de 'dra zhig tu slebs pa'i dga' tshor yin nam/ yang na yab mes kyi dgongs pa rdzogs sa/ chung bu rgyud 'tshar longs byed sa/ rang gi yul sde khra mo dang kha bral te nyin zhag du ma'i ring gi 16

zhe 'khon dang semes sdug bkres ltogs dang ngal dub kyi khur po khur te ma shi tsam byung nas da lta gcong rong der slebs nas sdug bsngal yod tshad rgyab tu bskyur ba yin mi shes par sgra dbyangs mtho dman mi mtshungs pa'i gad mo'i sgra de gcong rong gi nang du phyogs bzhir brag ca 'khor byung /der cung zad gan rkyal du nyal nas ngal gsos rjes/ gso rlung yid tshims pa re rngub ste yar langs nas mdun phyogs su song / der gtam rgyud du gsal ba'i 'chi med lha yi btung bya lta bu'i chu mig dwangs shing gtsang ba zhig 'dug pa de'i chu gzhug 'khyags rom gyi sbub tu tub tub kyi sgra grags bzhin rgyug pa dang / chu 'go'i mtha' ru 'khyags pa srab po zhig las med par 'phyur bzhin 'dug pas sa cha de ni ngo ma khyad du 'phags pa zhig red/gcong rong de gting shin tu ring bas ngo ma khron pa'i gting du slebs pa ltar gnam sngo lhob lteb cig las mi mngon zhing rlung spu tsam yang med ces brjod na ha lam ma 'grig pa med pas sa sbug cig tu 'dzul ba ltar grang reg gi 'tshe ba med par dro skyid ldan pa zhig red/dbang chen gyi sems su bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' drin gyis nged pha bu gnyis ma shi tsam 'dir slebs/ sa cha 'di ni o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis lung du bstan pa'i sbas lung zhig min rgyu mi 'dug da res ma shi tsam 'dir slebs nas gson thub pas phyis 'byung sngar yag sngar dar yong nges red bsam pa'i dga' tshor skyes/de nas kho gnyis kyis chu mig gi chu mdzub mos mchod pa phul te ‘‘mchod/mchod/ mchod/ rgyab ri kha 'dzin can/ srung ma myur mgyogs can/lha dge bsnyen gyi zhal la mchod ’’ces gyer dbyangs sgrogs rjes khur po phabs te zhag sdod kyi gra sgrig byas/khyi lnga pos kyang da skabs 'dir zhag sdod byed rgyu yin par shes te tshang ma 17

khur po'i 'gram du a long ltar 'khyil nas nyal/bu dgra 'dul gyis kho tsho dang bar thag mi ring ba'i sa na spu gra gser mdog bkra ba'i wa mo gcig rgyug ma 'dur gyis 'gro ba mthong nas ‘‘a pha/a pha/ ltos dang wa mo gcig 'dug ’’ces skad dma' bos bshad/de 'phral dbang chen gyis de phyogs su lta tsam byas nas bo'ur rdzas mdel blugs te blo rtse gcig sgrim gyis gzes te brgyab pas 'di phyogs nas ‘‘twa’’zhes me mda'i skad grags pa dang / phar phyogs nas wa mo de gzugs po gzhu dbyibs ltar bkug ste gnam du mchong pa dang de mar sa ru lhung nas 'jig rten phyi ma'i gzigs mor gshegs/dbang chen gyis ‘‘khyod song nas wa ro de khyer shog ngas lci ba sgrug nas nged gnyis ja bskol te dgong ja 'thung ’’zer nas bu dgra 'dul wa ro de len par btang / kho rang gis slog pa'i thu gsham yar brdzes nas lci ba bsgrugadabang chen gyis lci ba thu ba gsum bsgrug nas rdo phog gsum gyi thab rdo btsugs pa'i nang du lci ba sgor sgor du brtsigs pa'i dbus su lci ba zhib zhib bzos te spungs/ de nas glo la btags pa'i me lcags blangs nas me rdo bzo dbyibs yag pa gcig bdams nas me lcags brdabs te blangs pa'i me son chung chung de lci ba zhib zhib spungs pa'i nang du bzhag pa dang kha sbub tu nyal nas phu btab pas dben pa'i gcong rong gi mthil nas gson shugs ldan pa'i me spungs shig sbar nas gyen 'phur g.yu 'brug lta bu'i du zhag dgung du 'phyur/dbang chen gyis me phung gi steng du rdza ma chung chung khengs pa gcig btsugs nas ja sbar mo gang blugs/ rgyang nas blta dus rdza ma chung chung de me phung gi steng du babs pa'i pho rog nag chung zhig dang 'dra/ dbang chen gyis 18

thab nang du lci ba rdog re gnyis blugs nas me 'gram du tsog bur bsdad de me phung la myong rol byed pa dang mtshungs/bu dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘brang la brgyab 'dug ltos dang /’’zhes skad rgyag bzhin wa ro phrag par khur nas 'dug wa ro de shin tu che bas mjug ma sa ru drud nas 'dugadabang chen gyis ‘‘da yag po byung song / khyi la yang khyi lto byung song /da khyod me 'gram du bsdad nas me sros ’’zer nas bu'i lag nas wa ro de tshur blangs te me mda'i kha wa ro'i mde'u khung la gtad de ‘‘rngon pa sha zan gyis sha za/ gze mo khrag 'thung gis khrag 'thung ’’dhices bshad rjes me mda'i kha ru ༵ byetrī /mde'u khung gi khrag byug byug byas rjes/ wa lpags bshus te wa ro khyi khyi lnga pos hab thob rgyag bzhin wa sha ma lus par bzas rjes kha ldag lce ldag byed kyin kho gnyis kyi 'khris su tsog nas bsdad/khyi lnga pos da dung sha za rgyu yong re byas te tsog kyang sha tig gcig kyang ster mkhan med pas mthar rngul chu'i zil pas brlan par gyur ba'i nag snum gyi sna brang 'og tu bcug cing ‘‘si/ si/’’zhes 'khun sgra sgrog bzhin gnyid khug pa'i tshul la bltas na dgun dus gangs khrod kyi grang reg gi 'tshe ba gang yang med pa 'dra/ skabs re me phung gi nang nas me yis tshig pa'i rdo chag pa'i sgra grags dus rna ba g.yug tsam re byed pa las gzhan 'gul tsam yang byed kyi min 'dugade nas cung ma 'gor bar sa rbad de rub/ mgo bo dgye nas blta dus ()mirngonapasharwasagyis1 za/ gze sngokhrag 'thung gis khrak+ta'athungazhusasdodeni rngot+yāpasaridwagasarjekyiljaza yang sdig 'askyong bas mda' na dasas kya 43ldi ṭ+wāṃthung snrakhasnyi na sdil gyas ltegs ga ༷mar bsat+yā sa skyo zlosna byu / kūshā yo dzo/ ma chad rgyun du za rgyu nga ba' na ma na da du ltar smras mda' mchu ru dwags 19

phyogs bzhi'i g.yang gzar mu khyud kyi dbyibs ni sgang gshong mi snyom pa sog le'i kha'am yang na chu rdzing gi gnyer ris dang 'dra/ sprin lhob tsam yang med pa'i lha yi rdzing ring ni gcong rong de'i steng du bkab pa'i tshags ma'i kheb gcod dang 'dra/ me spungs de 'ur 'ur du 'bar ba dang me lce dgung du 'phyur nas sa srod mtshams kyi mtshams sprin dang dbyer med kyi me mdangs pha bu gnyis kyi ngo gdong la yang yang 'phros/‘‘da gzugs po dros song ’’zer bzhin dgra 'dul gyis lham phud nas me 'khris su bzhag ste bskams/dbang chen gyis bu'i rkang pa'i steng gi 'khyags sbos la tshwa chu byugs te phur phur gtong bzhin/ ‘‘skyon mi 'dug skyon mi 'dug skye ba pho lus blangs par mda' gri mdung gsum gyi kha gtad langs thub le dgos/ rkang pa 'khyags sbos cung zad thebs par ha las rgyu ci yod ’rizer/bu dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘a pha/ nga gnyis sang nyin gang du 'gro ’’zhes dris/‘‘sang nyin sang nyin gang du 'gro min sang nyin lta rgyu red/’ri‘‘lung pa 'di'i phyi ru 'gro sa a yod/’’‘‘lung pa'i chu gang du rgyug pa'i phyogs der 'gro sa yod thag chod red/’’‘‘lung pa chung chung 'di dro ba la ang ’’‘‘dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' drin gyis nga gnyis do dgong 'dir slebs pa red/’’‘‘'di nas song na yul ga 'dra zhig la slebs kyi yod dam/’’‘‘ngas mi shes/’’‘‘bu/ da ja 'khol ran 'dug do dgong ja rgyags tshad 'thung nas gnyid skyid po nyol ang ’’zhes bu'i mgor byil byil 'ga' byas rjes ‘‘thab ’’nang du lci rdog 'ga' blugs/20

‘‘ja khol song / ja khol song /’’rdza ma'i nang gi ja khol te rlangs pa skya 'phyur 'phyur byas/ dbang chen gyis phu dung gis 'jus te ja thab las phabs rjes ja phud gnam la gtor te rang yul gyi yul lha gzhi bdag la mchod par byas shing gsol ba smon lam btab/de nas kho rang gnyis kyi phor pa blangs te rtsam pa dang mar phyur blugs nas ja btung / nam nyin mtshan mang po ja tsha po lta ci/ chu drod 'jam hub gang yang 'thung rgyu ma byung bas da res ja tsha po hub gang btung ba tsam gyis kyang sems nyid sos pa'i snang ba byung nas mig gnyis kyang gsal du song /dbang chen gyis ja'i kha ru lding ba'i mar khu la phu 'deb bzhin hub chen pos gang btung nas ‘‘a da ’’zhes kha gnam la gdang nas ‘‘nga'i mi tshe'i nang ja zhim po 'di 'dra de ring ma gtogs 'thung myong med/ de ring gi ja las gar ba'ang 'thung myong med/ lung pa 'di'i ming la ja gar rong zhes 'dogs rgyu yin dwa ’zer/dgra 'dul gyis bstud mar ja phor pa bzhi lnga btung rjes kha la 'gos pa'i rtsam ral dang ja ro lag pas 'phyi bzhin ‘‘de 'dra'i zhim pa la ang ’’zer/mtshan mo gcan gzan gyi 'tshe ba mi yong ched/ nyal khar kho gnyis kyis nye 'khor nas lci ba mang po sgrug ste phyogs bzhi me phung mang pos bskor te nyal bas me yi tsha drod kyis grang reg gi gnod pa ma byung bar pha bu gnyis mgo sngas la bzhag pa dang gnyid lam gyi zhing khams su gshegs/nyin ma mang po'i ring ngal dub kyis mnar bas phyi nyin gnyid sad dus nyi ma yang nyin dgung zin grabs 'dug nyi 'od kyis gzugs po tsha drod lham mer 'dug pas kho gnyis langs ma 'dod par gan rkyal du nyal nas bsdad/ rngon khyi lnga po la la tsog nas bsdad/ la la gzugs po a long ltar gug 21

nas nyal/ la la sa ru dzi snom byed bzhin phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed kyin 'dugadabang chen gyis grim ril zhig byas nas ‘‘da longs/ da nged gnyis zhogs ja bkol do ’’zer/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘a pha/ tog tsam nyal sdod ’zer nas langs 'dod ma byas/dbang chen gyis ‘‘'o na khyod tog tsam nyol/ ngas ja bskol yong ’mizer/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘tog tsam nyal nas ngas ja bskol yong / pha khyod rang nyal nas sdod rimizer/‘‘'o na ngas sna tha sen mo gang 'then ’zhes dbang chen mal las tsog ste sna ru tshur blangs te kha phye nas mig ya btsums te de'i nang blta tsam byas nas ‘‘o/ sna tha mang po 'dug ga ’’zhes chig lab rgyag bzhin mthe bong g.yon ma'i sen mo'i steng du tog tsam zhig blugs te 'then bzhin bsdad/ kho'i pus mo gnyis gong ba'i nang nas dmar rong nger phyir mngon pa'i steng du'ang sna tha 'gos nas 'dugadagra 'dul cung zad nyal rjes ‘‘a ru ya ’mizhes bya rmyang zhig byas rjes mal las tsog ste phyogs bzhir bltas pa na bsam yul las 'das pa'i ngo mtshar gyi ltad mo mig gi dga' ston du mngon pa ste gcong rong gi sbug gi rdza 'dabs na 'brong khyu gcig bag phebs ngang gnas 'dug pas khos de phyogs su mdzub mo btsugs te ‘‘a pha/ a pha/ khyod kyis ltos dang / 'brong ma red pas ’’zer/dbang chen gyis 'dren byed kem kem du g.yo bzhin de phyogs su bltas pas na rdza 'dabs kyi nag rog rog de dag ni ngo ma 'brong red 'dug pas ‘‘a/ngo ma 'brong red/ khyod kyis rtsis dang 'brong ga tshod 'dug da de ring sha zhim po zhig za rgyu yin pa 'dra ’’zhes bshad/22

‘‘gcig gnyis/ gsum/ ’mizhes rtsis pas tag tag 'brong bcu gsum 'dug pas ‘‘'brong bcu gsum 'dug ’rices bshad/de nas kho gnyis gnyis ka nyal 'dod med par mal las langs te zhogs ja bskol/ gyen 'phur g.yu 'brug lta bu'i du ba sngon po dgung sngon du 'phyur ba ni skye bo'i bsam yul las 'das pa'i gcong rong gting ring de'i nang du lhag pa'i pha bu gnyis shi gson gyi dbye mtshams chod par mtshon/ tshe srog gi stobs shugs ldan pa'i du ba'i g.yu 'brug de mkha' dbyings kyi sprin rim du zugabu dgra 'dul gyis dwangs gtsang chu mig de las chu rdza ma gang blangs nas rdo phog gsum gyi thab steng du bzhag phas ja sbar mo gang blangs te blugs rjes gtsod kyi gnya' lpags las bzos pa'i ja khug nag ril de'i nang blta yag byas pas ha lam ja 'debs thengs bcu lhag tsam las mi 'dug pas dpral gnyer dam du bsdus nas ‘‘um’’zhes mgo bo 'phred du g.yugadagra 'dul gyis ‘‘a pha/ rjes ma nged gnyis 'brug mo'i thor ja dhibatung na ’’zhes thab nang du lci ba 'debs zhor du mgrin pa pha'i phyogs su gtad de bshad/pha dbang chen gyis bu'i ngo gdong la gzab nan gyis blta bzhin ‘‘tag tag red/ 'on kyang 'brug mo'i thor ja mang po btung na khrag kha 'phar gyi red/’rices 'dzum chung zhig mngon te shod bzhin bu'i mgo la byil byil byas/bus ‘‘'o na/ de ring nas bzung ngas ja mi 'thung / nga chu btung na 'grig pa 'dug ma gzhi nas phru gu ja 'thung mkhan ci yod ’rizer/de nas kho gnyis ma gros gcig mthun gyis 'brong khyu'i phyogs su bltas/dhi 'brug mo'i thor ja/ gro ma'i kha lo dang 'dra ba'i byang thang gi ri ja zhig23

'brong khyu de da res kyi sa de rang du gnas 'dugakho gnyis zhogs zas bzas rjes da dung ja rdza ma gang bskol te btung rjes pha dbang chen gyis ‘‘da nged gnyis 'brong gsod par 'gro/ de ring 'brong sha zhim po zhig za/ da dung 'brong 'bri skam gcig yod na de bas zhim pa yod/’’ces bshad rjes bo'u yi nang du rdzas mdel blugs te ru bkar nas bzhag rjes sked gri dang kho rang gnyis ka'i glo gri brdar/ khos rdo leb 'jam po zhig gi steng du mchil ma btab/ de'i steng du go thal sbar mo gang blugs nas nyams 'gyur ldan pa'i ngang yun ring brdar rjes gri sor mthe bong gis gnan tsam byas nas rno thon min bltas te ‘‘spu gri dang khyad par mi 'dug’’zer nas phu dung gi steng du gtsang mar phyis rjes gri shubs su bcugade nas kho gnyis 'brong khyu'i phyogs su song /de snga kho gnyis kyis 'brong mthong myong ba tsam las 'brong gsod myong med/ lhag par du bu dgra 'dul gyi ngos nas bshad na de snga 'brong rgyang nas mthong ba tsam las nye po mthong myong med/ kho gnyis kyis grog shur zhig gi nang nas 'jab ste 'brong dang bar thag gom pa lnga brgya tsam gyi sar slebs te ga ler grog shur gyi kha nas blta dus 'brong rnams la la nyal nas 'dug la la langs nas phar 'gro tshur 'ong byed pa las rtswa za mkhan mi 'dug pas byang thang gi gtam dper ltogs na nyin rtswa mi za le/ gre ser 'brong gi gshis ka/skom na nyin chu mi 'thung le/ kha dkar rkyang gi gshis ka ’’zhes pa de cis mi bden snyams/bu dgra 'dul gyis de ring ma gtogs 'brong nye po de 'dra mthong myong med pas 'brong ni spyir gzugs dbyibs g.yag dang 'dra yang gzugs phung g.yag las ldab gsum tsam gyis che ba/ rtsid pa bkrag mdangs che ba/'bur du don pa'i mig gnyis nas ches gtum drag gi 'od mdangs 'tsher gyi 24

'dug pas kho hang sang nas khog 'dar yang yang shor yang rang sems gnon gang thub byas/de nas grog shur gyi nang du mar bsdad rjes pha dbang chen gyis skad gsang dma' po'i sgo nas ‘‘bu/ skrag gi 'dug gam ’’zhes dris/‘‘mi 'dug nga skrag gi mi 'dug ’’ ces mgo bo 'phred du g.yugadon du kho'i sems su ya mtshan pa'i 'jigs skrag ha cang chen po skyes/ spyir 'brong ni gcan gzan min pas 'jigs skrag skye dgos don med kyang 'brong gi gzugs phung che bas yin nam yang na rgyu mtshan gzhan zhig yin mi shes par 'brong 'di dag gis dus de ring nged pha bu gnyis gsal nyi ma'i 'od mi mthong ba 'jig rten phyi ma'i lam du gtong gi med dam snyam nas skad dma' pos ‘‘a pha/ 'brong nga gnyis kyi phyogs su rgyug na ’’dbang chen gyis bu'i sems nang 'jigs skrag skyed pa shes te ‘‘bu/skyon med/ dang po khob sdug dhide gsod dgos ’’zer nas ga ler grog shur de'i kha nas bltas te ‘‘ngas de ring khob sdug de khob gang gis langs rgyu med par bzo nges yin/ khyod kyis ltad mo ltos ang / gal srid mde'u gcig gis gsod ma thub na khob sdug de nga gnyis kyi steng du rgyug yong gi red/'brong tshur rgyug byung na nges par du g.yas g.yon phyogs gang rung du 'phred kyis bros dgos pa las 'brong gi mdun nas thad kar bros mi rung / de ltar byas na 'brong gis rdung nas gsod kyi red ’’ces nan bshad byas/‘‘ya ya ’’zhes bus mgo bo lcog tsam byas/‘‘sems 'tshab ma byed/ nges par du 'phred du bros ang /’’‘‘shes song / me mda' brgyab rjes 'di ru gab na 'grig gi ma red (nye khob sdug 'brong rgan la zer/25

dam/ ’‘‘khob gang gis gsod ma thub na rmig pas brdzis te sha phye bzo gi red/'brong rmas ma las ngar ba'i sems can med ’’ces yang bskyar nan bshad byas/de nas bu dgra 'dul gyis pha'i sked gri lag tu bzung / phas me mda' yi sbi sdir me sbar nas mgo bo grog shur gyi kha las don te me mda' gzes/skabs der rlung grang shur shur zhig mdun phyogs nas brgyab yong gi 'dug pas 'brong gis sbi sdi'i rdzas dri ma tshor bas sngar bzhin bag phebs ngang gnas 'dug da res kyi khob sdug de'i gzhogs g.yon phyogs kho gnyis kyi phyogs su gtad de langs nas 'dug dbang chen gyis bu'i ngo gdong la bltas te mgo bo lcog tsam byas pa ni da res kyi skad cha de dag yang bskyar nan bskul byed pa red/de'i skabs bu dgra 'dul gyi sems su rang yul gyi rgyab ri dran te snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba smon lam btab/dbang chen gyis khob sdug de'i snying gi thad du gzes te me mda'i skam pa ga ler gnan/ ‘‘twa mi’zhes me mda'i kha grags pa dang 'brong de'i dpung pa g.yon mar phog ste khog stod kyi g.yon phyogs sa ru 'gyel grabs byas rjes slar yar langs te na zug bzod mi thub pa ltar mgo bo smad de g.yug bzhin sna gnyer gnyer 'ga' byas rjes rnga ma dgung du 'phyar zhing lce dmar po 'dom pa gang bsnar nas me mda'i skad grags 'ong sa'i phyogs su bltas te rang nyid la gnod par byed mkhan gyi dgra bo de 'tshol bzhin 'dugadabang chen gyis slar yang me mdar rdzas mde'u blugs te sbi sdi'i sne mor phu 'ga' brgyab pa dang sa steng du brdar tsam byas pas du ba sngo lhog tu 'phyur bzhin 'dug pas khos me mda'i ru gad pa'i steng du btsugs te da thengs me 26

mda' khob gang gis langs rgyu med pa bzo dgos snyam nas ga ler mgo yar gad pa'i steng nas don pa dang 'brong rmas ma des mthong ste smyo ba ltar kho gnyis kyi phyogs su rgyug byung /byang rigs kyi rngon pa'i lo rgyus thog 'brong rgod rmas ma'i rno ngar gyi rwa co dang / shugs drag che ba'i rmig pa/ tsub la tsha drod che ba'i lce yi 'og tu rkyen lam du song ba'i rngon pa bgrangs kyis mi langs/ da lta pha bu gnyis 'chi gson chags 'jig la thug pa'i dus der kho gnyis gcig gis me mda' khyer/gcig gis gri khyer te rlung nag 'tshub ma zhig dang 'dra bar mdun phyogs su rgyug 'ong ba'i 'brong rgod de'i mdun nas 'phred bcad de byang phyogs su bros/'brong rgod de'i mgyogs tshad ni rlung ltar myur ba ste de'i mchongs thengs rer mi'i gom pa bco lnga tsam yod stabs 'brong rgod des bu dgra 'dul gyi rjes zin te rwa g.yug gcig gis bu dgra 'dul gyi sked rags rwa rtser bzung nas rkang pa sa la 'drud kyin rang nyid la rgyal kha thob pa'i tshul ltar phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas/pha dbang chen sems 'tshab langs te da res rang gi snying ltar gces pa'i bu'i srog shor song snyam nas mig gi mchi zhag gis 'dren byed kyi mthong lam bkagade mar am gtsigs bsdam nas me mda' yar btegs te 'brong la rgyag par brtsams kyang lag zung 'jag skya rlung gis skyod pa ltar 'dar bas stabs mi legs par 'brong gsod rgyu phar zhog bu bsad na mi 'os bsam nas me mda'i skam pa gnan ma nus/skabs der bu dgra 'dul ni 'brong rgod de'i rwa rtse las dpyang ste rkang pa gnyis 'brong gi 'gram pa g.yon ma'i 'khris las thur du dpyang nas bya dka' byed gtad du gyur nas ‘‘a pha nga nga shi ran song ’’27

zhes ngu ngag gis 'o dod 'bod kyin 'dug 'on kyang kho'i lag nang gi skyed gri de lhan skyes kyi dngos po ji bzhin da dung lag nang du bzung nas 'dug‘‘bu nga'i bu 'brong de'i mig la mig la gri tshugs ’rizhes 'bod pa las 'brong dang nye bar bcar ma nus/'brong rgod rmas ma ngar ma des bu rwa rtser bzung bas mi tshad pha yang 'cham la 'bebs dgos snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyis mig 'bur tshugs kyis dbang chen gyi phyogs su bltas te lag pa g.yon ma 'theng bzhin dbang chen gyi phyogs su yong gi 'dugatshul de mthong bas dbang chen khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar nas nyi ma de ring 'brong rgod 'di gsod ma thub na nga'i snying gi bu chung 'di'i srog shor song snyam nas de mar sar nyal te me mda'i ru sa la btsugs te gzes/da gzod kho gnyis dbar gyi bar thag da gin las kyang nye ba yod pas bus phar bltas pa na rang gi phas rang gi phyogs su me mda' gzes te sbi sdi'i me stag dmar 'tshub ber 'phyur zhing me mda'i kha nag rog ger rang gi phyogs su gtad yod pas dngangs skrag chen po bskyed de ‘‘a pha me me mda' ma rgyag nga gsod kyi red ’rices ngu 'bod byas/dbang chen gyis kyang de phyogs su gzes pa tsam las don du 'brong rgod de rang sar mi langs par lag pa 'theng gin kho'i phyogs su yong gi yod pas rang gi bu'i bde 'jags la bsam nas me mda'i skam pa gnan ma nus par snyingakhong rus pa'i gting nas bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs kyin bsdad/ji ltar sgug kyang 'brong rgod de se gol tog yun tsam yang mi sdod par skabs re lce ring po bsnar te phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed pa dang skabs re rkang lag sa la 'drud kyin kho'i phyogs su yong ba ni khyod kyi bu nga'i lag 'og tu tshud 28

zin pas khyod kyis da dung me mda' rgyag nus sam zhes kho la rgyal pham gyi 'gran rtsod byed pa dang mtshungs/'brong gi gam du bcar thub na me mda' rgyag rgyur 'gog rkyen med kyang 'brong rgod ngar ma des rang nyid gsod rgyu gtan 'khel/ 'gyang sa nas me mda' brgyab na 'brong gsod thub rgyu phar bzhag rang gi bu la yang nyen kha yod pas ‘‘bu dgra 'dul 'brong gi gnya' la gri rgyob ’’ces bos/‘‘a pha me mda' ma rgyag’’‘‘'brong gi rtsib gseng la gri rgyob/’’‘‘a a pha nga gsod pā me mda' ma rgyag’’‘‘gri rgyob 'brong la gri rgyob/’’‘‘a pha nga'i rgyu ma chad nyen 'dug aru ’’phan tshun bar thag 'gyang po med kyang sems 'tshab dang dngangs skrag gi dbang gis gcig gi skad cha gcig gis mi thos/de'i tshe dbang chen gyi bsam par 'brong gi khog smad la me mda' brgyab na des 'phag 'tshag brgyab nas bu sha thor rus thor du gtong rgyu red/ 'on kyang 'brong gi snying gi thad la gzes te brgyab na bu gsod nyen 'dug 'di ltar sgug drags na bu'i sked pa chad pa'i nyen kha yod pas da 'di 'o snyam pa'i thabs shig ma rnyed/ rang nyid pha bu gnyis khyim khra mo mi lag tu shor nas rang yul rgyab tu bskyur/ gzhan yul pang du blangs te dka' ba mang po spyad nas 'dir slebs kyang / da gzod snying ltar gces pa'i bu 'di yang 'brong gi rwa rtser 'khon pa ni nga'i skye ba sngon mar las ngan ci zhig byas pa'i rnam smin yin nam snyam nas sems nang mi bsam dgu bsam bsam/de nas dbang chen yar langs te ‘‘bu 'brong la gri rgyob/ gri rgyob/’’ces skad shugs chen pos lan mang bos pa bus thos te lag g.yon mas 29

'brong rwa'i rtse mo nas 'jus nas 'brong gi mig g.yas par gri btsugs pa na 'brong de na zug ma bzod par 'phag 'tshag shugs chen brgyab pas rwa rtse'i steng gi dgra 'dul phar g.yug tshur g.yug gis 'brong mgo'i steng du mun pa rub rub dang nyi ma shar shar brdab kyang da gzod kho yang snying stobs che ru song ste 'brong gi mig gnyis ka 'dru thub na tshe srog thar pa'i lam zhig yod snyam nas lag g.yon mas 'jus pa'i rwa rtse lhod du ma btang bar dam por 'jus nas thur du dpyang ba'i gzugs po'i ljid tshad yang du gtong gang thub kyis go skabs shig rnyed pa dang de 'phral 'brong rgod kyi mig g.yon mar gri gcig btsugs/ 'brong rgod de na zug ma bzod par sa mchongs gnam mchongs byas pas tog tsam ma gtogs kho'i rgyu ma yang chad la khad byas/dbang chen gyis tshul de dag mthong bas zhe sdang gis am gtsigs bsdam nas mas mchu nas khrag dmar don pa dang / da thengs bu'i rgyu ma bcad med dam sked tshigs bcag med dam snyam pa'i dngangs skrag je cher je cher skyed de me mda'i skam pa gnan grabs gnan grabs thengs mang byas kyang 'brong de 'phag 'tshag rgyag bzhin yod pas me mda' rgyag ma nus/'brong rgod de'i mig 'bras gnyis ka mig kong gi phyi ru don te thur du dpyang pa dang khrag dmar 'phyur 'phyur du don gyi yod pas da gzod kho ji ltar gtum drag che yang 'jig rten mthong ba'i mig med pas rang nyid kyi tshe srog thar song snyam nas nus shugs yod dgu bton te gzugs po g.yas phyogs su bskor nas rwa cer 'khon pa'i sked rags kyi steng du gri zhig g.yug pas de mar sa ru lhung pa dang ‘‘a pha da ri’zhes ngu 'bod dang bcas rgyug ste pha yi brang la 'khyud/re zhig kho rang gnyis ka kha nas skad cha tshig gcig kyang ma thon par gcig gis gcig la 'khyud de ngu bzhin rang sar gnas/30

yun ring song rjes pha dbang chen gyis bu'i ngo gdong la byil byil byed bzhin ‘‘khyod kyi gzugs por skyon byas ma byung ngam ’’zhes dris te mgo nas mjug bar yang yang bltas/‘‘nga skyon mi 'dug a pha/ khyod kyis ltos dang ’’zhes bu dgra 'dul gyi ngo gdong las 'dzum zhig shar/da gzod kho gnyis sems lhing 'jags byung nas 'brong rgod de da dung gsod ma thub par gson po yin pa yid la dran te bltas pas na 'brong rgod de mig 'bras gnyis ka med par dmus long du gyur stabs phyogs nges med kyis skor ba bskor gin bsdad 'dug‘‘a pha/ ngas kho'i mig gnyis ka drus zin pas da khos gang yang mthong gi ma red ’’ces dgra 'dul gyis spobs sems chen pos bshad/‘‘red red/ khyod kyis gri btsugs te mig 'bras gnyis ka bton pa ngas mthong byung / pho khyo ga de ring nga'i bu 'di pho khyo ga rang red/ lte thag bcad pa la bcad rin 'dug ’mices bsngags brjod byas/ ‘‘khob sdug de'i sdug mig gnyis ka 'dru ma thub na nga de'i rwa rtse las thar sa ma red ’’ces bshad/ ‘‘de rang red/ a phas me mda' ga tshod gzes kyang skam pa gnan nus kyi min 'dug da 'grig song pho rab ’’ces bshad rjes dbang chen gyis me mda' yar blangs te ‘‘da kho da dung gyong po e 'dug ngas blta dgos ’’zer nas gom zheng chen pos 'brong rgod dmus long de'i gam du bcar/ 'brong de'i mig gis gang yang mi mthong yang ri dwags la yod pa'i dmigs gsal gyi sna shes kyis gam du mi zhig yod pa'i tshor snang byung nas zhe sdang gi lce bsnar zhing rwa g.yug rgyami bzhin smyo ba ltar skor ba rgyag gin phar rgyug tshur rgyug byed kyi 'dug31

dbang chen gyis rdo phug ron tsam zhig sgrug nas rwa cor gzes te brgyab pas rwa co las me stag khra ltem lhom shar ba dang 'brong rgod de sngar bas ngar bar gyur nas gang byung 'phag 'tshag brgyab pas kong dong zhig gi nang du lag sug gnyis shor te rang dbang med par mgo rting log ste re zhig sug bzhi thag pas dam por bkyig pa ltar rang tshugs su langs mi thub par 'phag 'tshag rgyagagin rwa co gnyis kyis brkos pa'i gad pa'i sa nag gnam la gtor kyin 'dugadagra 'dul da res bsam yul las 'das pa'i bar chad de'i dbang gis 'brong dang thag nyer bcar mi nus par 'gyang sa nas bltas te ‘‘a pha da me mda' rgyob/ da gsod cig ’’ces skad rgyag bzhin 'dugadabang chen gyis yang rdo mi mgo tsam zhig sgrug ste kong dong gi nang du da dung langs ma thub par 'phag 'tshag rgyag bzhin pa'i 'brong de'i mgo la brgyab pas 'brong de na zug ma bzod par 'phag 'tshag shugs chen po thengs kha shas brgyab pas a log thebs te da gzod yar langs thub tsam byung nas gzugs po'i tshugs ka mi brtan par 'dar 'khrug 'khrug gis phyogs nges med kyis skor ba bskor bzhin rnga ma dgung la 'phyar/dbang chen de mar phar tsam bros te me mda'i sbi sdi'i sne mor me lcags kyis me sgron te 'brong dang nye bar bcar nas snying khar gzes te ‘‘twa ’rizhes me mda'i skad grags pa dang dus mnyam 'brong rgod de ri nyil ba ltar sa ru 'gyel byung bas tog tsam ma gtogs kho rang yang de'i 'og tu gnan/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘a pha/ 'brong shi 'dug gam ’’zhes da dung rang sar langs pa las gam du bcar ma nus/‘‘shi 'dug ngas snying la brgyab pa yin/ shog shog ’’ ces dgra 'dul gyi phyogs su lag g.yug brgyab pas dgra 'dul gzhi nas ga ler tshur 32

yong yang sems nang du da dung 'brong de ma shi bar rgyal ba las sangs nas srog nyen la thug pa'i chags 'jig slong mi yong ngam snyam/dbang chen gyis me mda'i ru 'brong ro'i steng gang sar btsugs kyang 'phag 'tshag rgyag gi mi 'dug pas da ni 'jig rten phyi ma'i lam du brdzangs zin no bsam nas me mda'i mchu 'brong rgod kyi snying kha'i rma khar gtad de/‘‘rngon pa sha zan gyis sha za/ gze mo khrag 'thung gis khrag 'thung ’’zhes ri lung brag ca 'khor ba'i skad brgyab/bu dgra 'dul yang dga' drags nas ‘‘lha rgyal lo/ lha rgyal lo ri’zhes dga' 'bod byed kyin dga' mchong brgyab nas sked rags med pa'i slog pa lhob gyon byas pa de lhab lhab tu g.yugadagra 'dul gyis dum bur btub pa'i sked rags yar bsgrugs nas mdud pas mthud de sked rags dam par bcings/dbang chen gyis bu'i lag tu yod pa'i sked gri tshur blangs te 'brong gi rnga ma bcad te rwa co'i rtser bskon nas/dur dur dur/bu rta gnyis kyi dmu gab/dgra 'brong gnyis kyi mgo la khob/meces byang rigs rngon pas ri dwags bsad rjes nges par dmod pa'i dmod tshig de dag bor rjes yang me mda'i kha mde'u khung la gtad de/rgyu ma'i byi'u tshang gi mda' lon/dusteskabyāldadonabasodasbri'i sernyis ༷sa de bsad nas rangadang3 nga gā bzhon rta gnyirnyimimathojub sbodapatre sdosna /gab — zhwa dgra dang 'a nga ga—sa — mgo la bkab nas rang gisam nga zhing gzhan —sa rang ma3ṭ+wāṃ ba'

dpung pa'i nyag nyag gi sha lon/dhizhes yang yang bshad rjes de ring snga dro brdar ba'i sked gri dang glo gri lag tu bzung nas/brdar lo/ brdar lo/ brdar lo/rdza rag dkar 'dra ba'i g.yas zur/gangs nu ma 'dra ba'i g.yon zur/'drogs 'dod can gyi rgya ri sgyid sangs /brdar lo/ brdar lo/②zhes rdo leb gcig la mchil ma btabs nas mtshon byed rang bzhin gyis gri brdar nas 'brong bsha' 'go brtsams/rngon khyi lnga po mjug ma a long ltar 'khyil te yang sha dod po'i sgo nas nye 'khor du phar rgyug tshur rgyug gis khrag dri bro ba tsam gyis yid tshim pa'i rnam 'gyur ci yang bstan/'brong khyu de da gin gyi sa nas 'drog ste lung pa'i mdo na rang gi rigs kyi 'gro 'dren spun zla gcig gi srog dgra lag tu shor bar yid gdung ba'i mya ngan zhu ba ltar rtswa mi za bar langs nas 'dugade nas bu dgra 'dul song nas kho gnyis kyi mkho byed rnams khur 'ong / rnyi t+t+waṃ bye ༵/ga ste rdo phog gsum gyi thab steng du rdza ma btsugs nas sha btso rgyu'i dbang chen gyis 'brong bshas ma tshar gong brang sha blangs te che chung lag so rjo phaspra cher rngon pa dwad )sabargyab pa'ispyada' des ri dwags gang de'i sgro ma gsaskya pañcha nang khrol bcad de sprupyad+ngha sdot+na zlo/ zhag dang / bgrad zud lag sug ga dpung pa bcag thub pa shaṃg sa pa' sman ga 'dra yang da dung tho byedamongadangasta 'draba'irdzuridabyenuspyadūnga'adran+ni'igarwas ri'i 'dabasaroladā gdus1ngarngonāpa s+t+ra rnotwe ṭ+wāṃ chisdildi lda rnyikā r+shanā swātrīsna snad/ga rgya 'am za rkang pa nga pa rgyad pa sang sang byas pa' 'azang ka bshu da

pa tsam btubs te rdza ma'i nang du blugs/ bu dgra 'dul gyis me gtong chu len zin rjes phu dung g.yas pa phud de pha dang mnyam du 'brong bsha' bar song /mi gnyis kyis 'brong gcig bsha' rgyu ni ha cang dka' ngal che ba'i las ka zhig red/ 'brong gi rkang lag la thag pa btags nas dgra 'dul gyis phyogs gcig tu nus shugs gang yod kyis 'then/ dbang chen gyis bshus zin pa'i ko ba'i mtha' nas phyogs gzhan zhig tu 'then nas sha dang ko ba'i bar rdo zur gsum gcig gis rgyag bzhin dus yun chu tshod gnyis tsam 'bad 'thab byas kyang 'brong ko da dung phyed ka'ang bshus ma tshar bas kho gnyis lus kyi stobs shugs yongs zad de rngul chu khrum khrum du bzhur nas nganabugs hal bzhin langs te ngal gsos/de dus thab nang gi me 'ur 'ur du 'bar gyi 'dug la rdza ma de'i kha nas rlangs pa skya 'phyur 'phyur byed kyin 'dug pas dgra 'dul song nas bltas pas sha rdog tshi lu ser po byas pa mang po lhog lhog tu 'khol ba'i sha khu'i nang 'gre ldog rgyag bzhin 'dugadabang chen gyis lag pas dpral ba'i steng gi rngul chu phyis tsam byas nas ‘‘sha tshos grabs 'dug gam ’’zhes dris/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘ha lam tshos yod pa 'dra ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘da dung tog tsam zhogari’zer/dgra 'dul gyis thab nang du lci ba rdog kha shas blugs nas yang 'brong ko bshu bar song / da lta gri yang rno zad 'dug pas 'brong ko bshu rgyu sngar bas dka' ngal che bar gyur bas kho gnyis sa ru bsdad de ngal gso zhor du mi re'i lag tu rdo leb re bzung nas mchil ma btabs te gri brdar brdar byas nas mthar 'brong ko phyed ka bshu thub tsam byung /35

kho gnyis las mtshams bzhag nas ‘‘da sha za ’’zer nas thab kyi 'gram du song nas dbang chen gyis lag tu gri thogs te sha khu'i rlangs pa snom tsam byas nas ‘‘de 'dra'i zhim pa la ’’zhes bshad de thab 'gram du bsdad nas phu dung gis 'jus te rdza ma thab las phab nas sha rdog gcig gri rtses blangs te bu la sbyin/ de nas yang sha rdog gcig blangs te kho rang gi lag tu bzung nas gri kham chen po gcig bcad de bzas/ 'brong sha de dag phyi tshos kyang nang da dung tshos med pas khrum khrum du bzhur ba'i sha khu dmar pos kho gnyis kyi lag pa dmar po byu ru'i sdong po ltar gyur/mi res sha rdog gsum bzhi re bzas rjes yid yongs su tshim par gyur nas dbugs ring re btang nas phor pa'i nang du sha khu blugs te btung /dbang chen gyis rang gi kha la 'gos pa'i zhag phyis tsam byas nas rum nas sna ru blangs te rkang 'gor thengs gsum brdab rjes lag pa g.yon ma'i mthe bong gi steng du 'gos pa'i sha khu dang zhag slog pa'i steng gtsang mar phyis rjes sna tha sen mo gang blugs nas sha khu phor pa gang btung ba dang gri rtses so gseng du 'tshang ba'i sha len bzhin bsdad/dgra 'dul gyis sha khu 'thung bzhin mig gis 'brong de'i phyogs su bltas nas bsdad/dbang chen gyis gri mar bzhag nas lag g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang ldag mdzub slog pa'i steng phyis trem byas nas sna tha cung zad cig bzung nas 'then rjes da gin gyi 'jigs skrag de yid la dran nas ‘‘bu khyod da gin skrag e byung ’’zhes dris/bus ci yang mi smra bar mgo bo lcog lcog byas/‘‘khyod kyi gzugs po la rmas skyon ci yang med pa ngo ma red dam ’’zhes yid ma ches par bu'i sked rags bkrol te mgo nas mjug bar yang yang 36

bltas pas sked rags 'brong rwar 'khon te gzugs po'i ljid tshad kyis thur du 'then drags pa'i stabs kyis rked par dmar thig cig 'dug pa las rmas skyon gang yang mi 'dug pas dbang chen gyis ‘‘tsha gi mi 'dug gam ’’zhes sked par phur phur byas/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘tsha gi mi 'dug ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘da res ni bsam brjod kyi yul las 'das pa'i bar chad cig red/ bar chad de'i nang stabs mi legs pa'i rkyen ngan ma byung bas phyis 'byung nged gnyis bsam don tshang ma 'grub kyi red/ lha bla ma'i bka' drin gyis ma gtogs de ring nga'i bu'i srog shor song ’’zhes skad gzhug 'dar gyin bu rang gi brang khar dam por bzung /de nas ja khol song bas kho gnyis ja yid tshims par btung rjes yang 'brong bsha' bar song nas yun ring 'bad 'thab byas rjes 'brong bsha' thub tsam byung nas nang khrol glo mchin dang rgyu ma rngon khyi lnga por sbyin/ 'brong sha yongs 'khyags pa'i steng du spungs/ de'i mtha' skor nas rdo yi ra ba brtsigs pa ni pha bu gnyis gcong rong de'i nang du gnas sdod kyi 'go thog mar tshugs pa'i mtshon tshul tsam zhig go/nyi ma yang nub ri'i phag tu yib cing rgyu skar gyi tshogs kyang rim gyis mang du song / pha bu gnyis nyin gang ring 'khyags ltogs kyi mnar gcod ma myong yang / bu 'brong gi rwa rtser 'khon pa'i sems kyi 'jigs skrag dang 'brong bsha' ba'i lus kyi ngal dub che bas 'brong ko gdan du byas nas gnyid lam gyi zhing khams su gshegs/bu dgra 'dul la bsam yul las 'das pa'i nyen kha chen po de 'dra 'phrad kyang stes dbang gis rmas skyon gang yang ma byung bar srog thar bas nyin shas de'i ring kho gnyis la sngar byung ma myong ba'i dga' tshor gyis nyin ltar za 37

ma za ra na skabs 'khyags pa'i steng du bzhag pa'i 'brong sha las za tshod re bcad de zas za ba dang / snga dro mal chas kyi nang nas khog stod don te me gtong ba dang ja bskol nas zas za gi yod/mal las langs rjes kyi don dag dang po ni 'brong khyu gang du bsdad yod blta rgyu dang de nas lci ba thu ba sha khas bsgrug rgyu de red/nyin zhig pha dbang chen gyis 'brong ko'i steng gi rtsid pa yongs breg ste skud pa yog bzhin glo gri de dgra 'dul gyi lag tu bzhag nas ‘‘khyod kyis de'i rnga ma'i steng gi rtsid pa breg dang ’’zer/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘a pha/ rtsid skud yog nas ci byed pa yin ’ zhes dris/‘‘snga phyi ma gtogs nga gnyis lung pa 'di las don te rang 'go thon thabs byed dgos/ nged gnyis la sbra zhig med na ga la rung ’’zhes gzab nan gyis lan btab/dgra 'dul gyis 'brong gi rnga ma'i steng gi rtsid pa breg bzhin mgo lcog 3gleg byas/dbang chen gyis mu mthad bshad par ‘‘nga gnyis lung pa 'di'i nang rang ༄༄mi (1)mar/bsdad na za rgyu sha las rtsam pa dang dkar chu da pas sdod thabs med ’’zer/‘‘lung pa 'di'i phyi la don sa yod dam ’’zhes bu dgra 'dul gyis lung pa'i phyogs bzhir mig 'grim zhig byas/‘‘don sa yod nges red/ de ltar min na 'brong mang po 'di dag gang nas yong ba red/ chu rgyug pa'i phyogs nas don sa yod pa gtan 'khel red ’’ces dbang chen gyis kyang lung pa'i phu nas mda' bar mig 'grim zhig byas/byebye dkar chu/ zho dang 'o ma sogs la zer/

dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘a pha/ nged gnyis lung pa'i phyi ru don thub na'ang nged gnyis la zog zer ba ra ma gcig kyang med pas ji ltar 'tsho thub ’’ces dris pa na/dbang chen gyis smin ma bsdus te mno bsam gtong ba las lan 'debs rgyu ma rnyed/phyi nyin kho gnyis nyin dgung ma zin tsam la mal las langs te rgyun ldan gyi dus tshod las yol ba'i zhogs zas bzas rjes lung pa'i chu rgyud 'ded de lung pa'i mda' ru don sa yod med blta bar song /hang sang 'os pa zhig la lung pa de ni ha cang btsan pa'i lcags ri ltar phyogs bzhi nas sa 'dzin gyi phreng bas bskor zhing mda' ru phyogs gnyis brag ri dkar po las grub pa'i 'phrang 'gag gu dog po gcig 'dug lung pa'i nang nas rgyug pa'i chu mo de 'phrang 'gag der slebs rjes dgun gyi grang ngar gyis 'khyags pa'i phung gsog thebs te g.yas g.yon gyi brag ri dkar po dang mtho dman gyi khyad par cher med pa'i 'khyags rir gyur nas yod pas gshog gnyis kyi bya las gzhan su yin yang 'gro ba'i lam bu mi 'dugakho gnyis re zhig hang sang nas mgo bo btegs te 'khyags ri dkar po der bltas nas sdod pa las thabs gzhan ma byung / g.yas g.yon gyi brag ri de gnyis ni ral gris phyed bshag btang ba ltar shin tu gzar bas gnam la 'dzegs pa'i skas 'dzegs yod na ma gtogs dpa' rtsal drug gi kho lag rdzogs pa'i skye bo stobs ldan ga 'dra zhig yin yang mgo bo sgur nas sdod rgyu las mi 'dug dpyid kyi drod rlung ldang nas 'khyags pa'i phung gsog de ma lus 'joms rjes ma gtogs btson rar tshud pa ltar gnas 'dir sdod rgyu las ma mchis snyam nas dbugs ring shor/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘a pha/ da lta zla ba ga tshod red ’’ces dris/39

dbang chen gyis ‘‘zla ba bcu gcig red/ zla ba bzhi pa ma shar bar lung pa 'di rang du sdod rgyu las thabs gzhan mi 'dug ’’ces mgo bo 'phred du g.yug ste ‘‘lung pa 'di 'dra ya mtshan can gyi sa cha zhig red ’’ces bshad/da res lung pa de'i phyir don sa yod nges gtan red snyam nas kho gnyis skad cha sna tshogs shod kyin phyin yang bsam yul las 'das pa'i 'khyags pa'i phung gsog chen po des 'gog rkyen gyi dbang gis bsam pa'i 'char sgo sna tshogasakhya 'phur rjes med du gyur ba'i tshul gyis 'khyags ri de ma bzhur bar 'di rang du sdod rgyu las med snyam nas gcig sngon gcig rjes kyis mgo bo gzhu ltar gug nas rang gnas su logader slebs pa dang dbang chen gyis rtsam khug nang gi rtsam par blta dus ji ltar za mkhas spyod mkhas kyis gron chung byas kyang mi gnyis la nyin bcu tsam las ldeng ba mi 'dug sha kho na bzas te 'tsho sdod byed dgos gyur na ltogs shir 'gro mi srid kyang nyi ma 'khyol dka' bo yin pas ‘‘lung pa skyid po 'di 'dra ba la phyir don pa'i sgo tsam yang med par ngo ma ya mtshan red ’’ces dbang chen gyis chig lab brgyab nas dbugs ring shur sgra grags pa zhig btang /lung pa der don sa zhig yod nges snyam yang bsam yul las 'das pa'i 'gog rkyen de 'phrad pas kho gnyis gnyis ka yid mug par gyur te kha mtshar skad cha shod pa'i spobs pa bral te ha lam don rkyen zhig gi dbang gis phan tshun kha rtsod shor te pha rol po'i mdun du rang nyid la bden pa yod khul gyis mgo mi sgur ba ltar gnyis ka gan rkyal du nyal nas skad cha gang yang ma bshad/nyi ma ma bzhud tsam la yar langs te 'o na phyogs gzhan zhig nas don sa zhig med dam snyam nas phyogs bzhir mig rgyang bcad kyang gcig las gcig mtho ba'i rdza ri dang brag ri'i mu khyud kyis bskor ba las phyir don rung ba'i 'phrang lam tsam yang mthong rgyu mi 'dug40

de nas kho gnyis song nas 'brong sha spungs pa'i khrod nas 'brong mgo de tshur blangs te ya mgo ma mgo gnyis bshag ste 'brong lce de btsos te mnyam du bzas rjes smag rum mun pas phyogs kun bcom zhing skar phreng gi gur khang phubs/dbang chen gyis bu'i mgor byil byil byed bzhin du ‘‘dpyid ka ma shar bar sdod rgyu red/ da nyal lo ’’zhes kho gnyis 'brong ko'i steng du gnyis gshib byas te nyal nas bo'u khra ring gi ru sa la btsugs te dbang chen gyi 'khris su bzhaganub der gangs chung chung zhig babs te gcong rong de ba so'i gzhong pa dkar gtsang zhig ltar snang /rngon khyi lnga po kho gnyis kyi g.yas g.yon du sna mjug ma'i 'og tu bcug nas a long ltar 'khyil te nyal nas 'dugaphyi nyin dbang chen gnyid las sad kyang lang ma sgyid par mgo bo rum las bton te nyal nas rang gi bu la blta dus dgra 'dul ni gangs kyi phung bo nar mo zhig ltar da dung gnyid khug nas sdur pa 'then gyin 'dugadus yun cung tsam song rjes dbang chen mu mthud nyal ma 'dod par sna tha 'then dgos snyam nas bya rmyang zhig byas rjes mal las tsog te phar blta tshur blta byed dus 'brong khyu de lung pa'i phu ru nag rog ger 'dug pa gangs kyi steng du lhag par gsal/ de nas sngas kyi 'gram du bzhag pa'i sna ru btsal skabs smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa zhig la bo'u khra ring mthong yul du mi 'dug pas ci yin nam snyam nas phar blta tshur blta lan 'ga' byas kyang bya 'phur rjes med du gyur bas sa ru 'dzul lam gnam du 'phur snyam pa'i hang sang nas re zhig kha gdangs nas sdod pa las ma 'das/bu dgra 'dul ni da dung gnyid sad mi 'dug pas mdang nub nga rang 41

gnyid khug rjes khos rtsed mo rtsed nas sbas pa yin pa'i re ba bskyed de ‘‘bu bu yar longs/ yar longs/ khyod kyis me mda' gang du sbas pa yin ’’zhes dris/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘ga re/ me mda' ’’zhes skad cha dab dib cig bshad rjes da dung gnyid ma sad par grim ril zhig brgyab nas nyal te rkang pa phyir brkyang pas rkang pa gangs dang reg pas grang gis ma bzod par myur mo yar bskum nas yang grim ril zhig brgyab ste kha phar phyogs nas nyal/‘‘kho re/ bu/ me mda' mthong rgyu mi 'dug khyod kyis gang du nyar ba yin ’’zhes 'bod kyin dpung pa las bzung nas dkrug dkrug btang /dgra 'dul hob ste mal las tsog nas ‘‘ga re/ me 'da' mi 'dug ad ’mices mig phur gyin mdang nub me mda' 'jog sa'i phyogs su blta dus me mda'i ru gnyis sa la btsugs pa'i shul i khung chung chung gnyis bya dka' byed gtad du gyur ba'i skye bo nyam thag cig gi 'dren byed ltar tshur bltas nas 'dug pas yang bskyar ‘6me mda' mi 'dug ad ’’ces dris/ngo gdong gi rnam 'gyur la bltas na dgra 'dul gyis rtsed mo rtses te sbas pa min pas dbang chen sngar bas brel 'tshub langs nas ‘‘mi 'dug ngo ma mthong rgyu mi 'dug khyod kyis ltos dang mdang nub 'dir bzhag yod ’rices i khung chung chung de gnyis kyi steng du mdzub mo re btsugs te mig ce rer dgra 'dul la bltas nas bsdad/‘‘lung pa 'di'i nang mi gzhan yod pa yin nam/’ri‘‘khyad mtshar/’’‘‘ya mtshan/’’de mar kho gnyis sems 'tshab sngar bas che bar skyed de mal las langs te lham gyon zhing rtab rtab por sked rags bcings nas g.yas g.yon la blta 42

myul byed skabs bu dgra 'dul gyis sug rjes khyad mtshar po 'ga' mthong nas ‘‘'di ci'i rjes red/ a pha ltos dang ’’zer/dbang chen gyis gzugs po gzhu ltar gug nas brtag pas de ni dred mong gi rjes red 'dug sug rjes de thad kar lung pa'i mdo phyogs su zug 'dug ‘‘sa 'di la dred mong yod pa yin nam ’’zhes bshad zhor du thab rdo yar blangs te sked gri dang glo gri lan 'ga' brdar rjes mdang dgong za 'phror lhag pa'i 'brong lce rdog tsam de dum bu gnyis su bgos te gcig dgra 'dul la sprad/ gcig kho rang gi kha nang du blugs te ldad kyin du ‘‘'gro ’’zhes rdza ma dang lam rgyags phyed thig cig khur te dred mong gi sug rjes 'ded de phyin/nyin mang po kha ba bu yug gi khrod du 'chi gson la thug pa'i dka' ba spyad de ma shi tsam la lung pa 'dir slebs kyang / bu 'brong gi rwa rtser 'khon te cung tsam ma gtogs bu'i srog shor/ da gzod yang gar yong cha ma 'tshal ba'i dred mong gcig gis nga'i bo'u khra ring yang brkus/ hun/ 'di 'dra sdug gcig thog gnyis brtsegs 'di ngas tshe sngon ma las ngan ci zhig byas pa'i bu lon yin nam snyam nas gom mtshams bzhag ste lung pa'i mda' yi brag ri dkar po'i dkan gzar der bltas te ‘‘dred mong de brag phug tu nyal yod nges red/ de ring gzab gzab ma byas na nga gnyis dred mong gis za rgyu red ’’zer nas ske gri shubs las bton te yang bskyar rdo leb cig gi steng du lan mang brdar/dred mong gi sug rjes de ma dor bar song bas mthar sug rjes de lung pa'i mda' yi g.yas phyogs kyi brag ri dkar po der zug 'dug pas dred mong de ga dus brag khung ga 'dra zhig las phyir don yong gi yod snyam pa'i 'jigs skrag chen po byung yang / bya ba bzang ngan ci byung yang bo'u khra ring de tshur thob thabs ma byas na ga la 'grig snyam nas pha bu gnyis sems chung gi sgo nas 43

sug rjes de ded de brag ri dkar po de 'dzegs/ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la brag ri de'i steng zheng tshad pho 'dom gnyis tsam las med pa'i 'phrang lam dog po zhig kyag kyog sbrul nag sa ru 'khyug pa ltar 'dug brag 'phrang gu dog po de ni ha cang rnyed dka' ba'i bgrod lam nyag cig red/ kho gnyis brag 'phrang rgyud de song song bas mthar ri rtser slebs/ nyin mang po gcong rong du bsdad pas da lta ri rtse nas lung pa'i phar phyogs su blta dus phyogs bzhi mtha' yas shing sa 'dzin gyi phreng ba rab tu mang ba/ nam mkha' rgya che zhing mu mtha' med pa ngo ma 'jig rten gzhan zhig tu slebs pa ltar snang /yang kha tshur phyogs te gcong rong la blta dus gcong rong ni gting shin tu ring ba phyogs bzhi rdza ri'i mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i sa cha ya mtshan can zhig red 'dug pas nga gnyis dmus long mya ngam gyi thang du 'khyam pa ltar nyin mang po phyogs nges med kyis bskyod nas sa cha 'di 'dra zhig tu slebs pa de yang bzang ngan gang gi cho 'phrul zhig yin pa 'dra snyam/de nas dred mong gi sug rjes 'ded de ri las babs pas mthar ri gsham der spang a long me long 'dra ba'i spang ljongs khams gtsang zhig gi steng du bo'u khra ring nyam chag gang yang med par bzhag nas 'dug de mtshams nas dred mong gi sug rjes de yang nam mkha' la 'phur ba'am sa ru 'dzul ba ltar mthong med du gyur/ dbang chen gyis bo'u khra ring lag tu blangs nas dad pa'i spu long rab tu rgyas te ‘‘de spyir btang gi dred mong zhig ga la yin/de ni rang re'i yul gyi rgyab ri kha 'dzin can dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo'i srung ma myur mgyogs can gyi rnam sprul red/ lha dge bsnyen ni bzhon pa dred rag dkar can zhig yod/ rgyab ri kha 'dzin can/ srung ma myur mgyogs can/btsan po brdung ba'i tho ba/ nyam chung skyong ba'i pha ma/ sngar yang yod de deng yang 'dug ’’ces lag zung gi snyim pa brang khar sbyar/44

bu dgra 'dul gyis rang gi mig 'khrul ba min nam snyam ste bo'u de lag tu blangs nas 'go nas mjug bar bltas pas de ni ngo ma rang gi khyim gyi bo'u khra ring de rang red 'dug pas srung ma myur mgyogs can der dad pa chen po skyed de rang yul g.yang phyug dang ma g.yang mo dran pa'i mig chu lhung lhung du shor/dbang chen gyis bu'i mgor byil byil byas te ‘‘da ma ngu / pho dpa' bo zer ba de mda' gri mdung gsum gyi gdong len thub pa dgos/ ring min nga gnyis yul g.yang phyug la slebs nas btsan rgod kha sho kho'i snying dmar len thub kyi red ’’ces brjod/kho gnyis spang ljongs de'i steng du ngal gsos te yud tsam bsdad rjes dbang chen gyis me mdar rdzas mdel blugs shing me lcags dang bcas bu dgra 'dul gi lag tu bzhag ste/‘‘khyod song nas gcig sod shog ’’zer/‘‘ci gsod dgos red ’rices dris/‘‘ci sod na'ang 'grig’’ dgra 'dul gyis me mda' rgyab tu khur te phyogs nges med kyis ri dwags shig 'tshol bar song / rngon khyi lnga po yang lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i zhabs phyi ltar kho'i rjes su 'brang /song song bas ri bong gcig kyang ma thug de nas la nyag chung chung zhig 'dug pa de rgyud nas 'gro skabs ri spyang sngon mo gcig kho'i g.yon phyogs nas tshur yong byung bas kho dga' thag chod de/bso bso bso/dgra rang yul la yod tshad mi yul la khug grogs mi yul la yod tshad 45

rang yul la khug dhices gyer bzhin rngon khyi lnga po la la'i gnya' las bzung /la la'i mjug ma rkang pas brdzis te spyang ki'i phyogs su rgyug ma bcugango gdong las dga' ba'i 'dzum mdangs shig shar te spyang ki 'gro ba'i phyogs su yud tsam bltas rjes la nyag gi steng du gtor gzugs kyi la rdzas chen po zhig 'dug pa de'i steng du rdo phug ron gyi che chung tsam re zung g.yug rjes rgyab tu khur ba'i bo'u mar phabs te lag g.yas pas bzung nas tshur yong ba'i lam bu de ltag log brgyab/la nyag las babs te yud tsam song rjes pha bong chen po zhig gi steng du ri bong gcig tsog nas 'dug khos de mar me mda'i ru sa la btsugs te gzes/ rlung phyogs nas sbi sdi'i du ba'i dri ma sna lam du 'thul byung / me mda'i gzes khung las ri bong de nas rdog gcig gi che chung tsam las mi mngon yang de mar dbugs sgom nas me mda'i skam pa gnan pa na bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la rdo pha bong de'i 'og nas mgo skyes kyi ral pa phrag par glod cing ngo gdong sol ba las nag pa'i mi gcig gis sked gri dgung du skor bzhin ‘‘kho re/ mgo sgur ram ro 'jog gi yin ’’zhes skad rgyag bzhin kho'i phyogs su tshur rgyug byung bas da gzod bo'ur rdzas mdel blugs te phar rgol byed pa'i dus tshod med stabs glo gri shubs las 'byin te ‘‘khyod kyi sdug srog rta rnga phra mo la phangs pa med na nga'i srog la'ang phangs rgyu med/ gsal nyi zla gnyis kyi 'og tu sdod 'dod med pa yin na shog ’’ces ngar skad rgyag bzhin phar rgol gyi sta gon byas/ngomadog sol ba las nag pa'i mi des the tshom spu tsam med par ‘‘ki/hi/ hi/’’zhes kho'i phyogs su tshur rgyug byung /dhi 'brog mi'i ngag rgyun du spyang ki tshur yong dang lam thug brgyab na rlung rta dar zer/46

mi med kyi sa stong 'dir don dag khab rtse tsam gyi klan ka rtsod myong med pa'i mi 'di ci yin nam/ 'di 'dre yin nam mi yin/ gang ltar ci yin yang wa rnga ma shar re bros pa las/ stag 'dzoms drug rgyas nas thi na dga' zhes pa'i dpe ltar dbugs kyi rgyu ba ma chad bar 'dzing rgyu las ma 'das snyam nas khos kyang tsham tshom rta rnga til 'bru tsam med par ‘‘ki/ hi/ hi/ri’zhesas mdun du rgyugaphan tshun bar thag gom pa nyi shu tsam gyi sar slebs rjes ngo gdong 'jigs su rung ba'i mi des ‘‘hwa/ hwa/ hwa/’’zhes gad mo dargod kyin gom mtshams bzhag ste sa ru 'gyel nas ‘‘bu rgod po gcig red zhag’rices r+ya/the bong ker/da byed dus mi de ni gzhan su yang min par rang gi pha dbang chen red 'dug pas ‘‘a pha khyed kyis ci byed pa yin ’’zhes ha las hang sang nas mig gnyis kyang sngar bas che bar gyur/ ‘‘hwa/ hwa/ ngas khyod khyod rang la dpa' che chung tshod lta byas pa yin/ hwa/ hwa/ a ru ’’zhes gad mo dgod drags pas grod pa'i na zug ma bzod par lag pas phur gyin ‘‘khyod ngo ma pho rtags 'byar pa'i 'byar rin 'dug hwa/ hwa/ khyod kyis nga ci zhig red bsam byung ’’zhes shod kyin ngo gdong la byug pa'i rdzas nag phu dung gis phyis/‘‘nga la de ring pho rtsed rtse 'dod can gyi mi zhig 'phrad 'dug pas khos nga bsad kyang ngas kho rmas ma bzo dgos bsam byung ’’zhes bshad/‘‘um/ skyes pho rab zer ba de 'dra dgos ri’zer/dgra 'dul gyis phar blta tshur blta byed bzhin ‘‘a pha da res ri bong de ga par 'dug ’’ces dris/‘‘ri bong de khyod kyis me mda' brgyab nas bsad song ’’zer nas rum 47

las thang khug gcig bton te kho la bstan/‘‘'di ci red/’’‘‘'di khyod kyis bsad pa'i ri bong de red/’’‘‘ga re/ a pha khyod kyis ci zer ba yin/ 'di ri bong red ad/ri’‘‘red/ khyod kyi me mda' tsha po 'dug’’‘‘'di 'di 'di thang khug red pa/’’‘‘'di khyod kyis bsad pa'i ri bong de red/’’‘‘ri bong red zer nas thang khug bstan pa ci yin/’’‘‘da gin ngas thang khug 'di pha bong gi steng du bzhag nas ri bong yin khul gyis khyod kyi me mda'i tsha kha tshod lta byas pa yin/ ri bong de khyod kyis bsad song / de 'dra ya nga ba la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ ’’zhes ku re rtsed kyin thang khug steng gi mdel khung la mdzub mo btsugs/‘‘o de 'dra yin pa red/ ngas ri bong red bsam byung /’’dbang cherno gyis bo'u de tshur blangs nas yud tsam myong rol byas rjes rdzos rwa bton te rdzas cung tsam blugs rjes zha mdel sngo ril gcig rkang pa'i lham la brdar tsam byas rjes bo'u yi nang du blugs nas dmigs 'ben nges med kyis gzes tsam byas/de'i skabs rngon khyi lnga po dus gcig la 'phang pa'i mda' mo lnga ltar spang ljongs de'i phyogs su shor song bas ci zhig mthong ba yin snyam nas blta dus sbre dhidamar ser gcig mjug ma rlung gis g.yo bzhin bros nas 'gro gi 'dugadabang chen gyis ‘‘ltos ang rngon khyi lnga po kha skyengs pa zhig bzo ’’zer te de mar sar nyal zhing ru sa la btsugs te gzes/me mda'i kha de sbre dmar ser de rgyug pa'i phyogs su gtad/ rngon khyi lnga () wa'i rigs shig yin zhing / gzugs dbyibs wa dang 'dra la pags pa'i gra kha wa las tsub pa yod/48

po'i nang gi mgyogs shos mda' mo nag rkang zhes pa gcig yod pa des sbre de'i rjes zin te rnga mar rmug pa dang ‘‘twa ’’zhes 'di phyogs nas me mda'i kha grags pa dang dus mnyam sbre de gnam du thengs gcig mchong pa dang slar sa ru lhung ste 'jig rten phyi ma'i gzigs mor gshegs so/pha dbang chen gyi me mda' tsha po der dgra 'dul hang sang nas re zhig kha nas skad cha'ang ma thon par mig ce rer pha la bltas nas bsdad/ dbang chen gyis ‘‘ga 'dra 'dug me mda' rgyag zer dus de 'dra rgyag dgos ’’zer/‘‘a pha/ gal srid me mda' sbre la ma phog par khyi mo mda' mo nag rkang bsad na ’’zhes dris/‘‘ngas da bar me mda' 'di rang lus dang ma bral ba byas te dbang du 'dul yod pas ma gtogs ngas rgyag ga la phod ’’ces bshad/ don du kho rang gis rang gi me mda'i tsha kha tshod lta zhig byed dgos bsam ste bya 'phur ba ltar rgyug 'gro ba'i sbre der gzes kyang gsod thub pa'i gdeng tshod med/'on kyang so khung las khyi mo mda' mo nag rkang gis sbre de'i mjug mar rmug pa mthong bas 'dar sig shor te me mda'i skam pa 'gul nas bsad pa las bsam bzhin du bsad pa ma yin yang rang gi bu la dpa' dang blo stobs shig sbyin ched de ltar bshad/dgra 'dul gyi sems su rang gi pha dang mnyam du gnas pa'i tshe rang srog shor song snyam pa'i 'jigs skug skyed dgos don mi 'dug dgra nam mkha'i bya yin yang 'phur dbang mi 'dug snyam pa'i dga' tshor spobs pa skyed/khyi lnga po la las da dung sbre ro der rmug bzhin pa dang la la de'i gam du langs nas 'dugade nas kho gnyis kyis da res bsad pa'i sbre de'i gam du song nas blta dus hang sang 'os pa zhig la me mda'i mde'u sbre yi ltag par phog nas dpral 49

pa'i dkyil las don te bsad 'dug dgra 'dul sngar bas hang sang bar gyur nas ‘‘a ma ma/ a pha khyod kyi me mda' tsha ba la ’’zer/dbang chen gyis gang yang ma bshad par sbre yi dpral pa'i mde'u khung las da dung dal mor bzhur 'ong ba'i khrag gar po de me mda'i mchu la byug tsam byas nas ngo gdong las 'dzum mdangs shig ston/da lta tsha zer can gyi nyi ma yang nub ri'i rtse mo dang bar thag shin tu nye zhing / ri chen gyi grib ma ri gsham gyi thang steng du phog pa dang dus mtshungs kho gnyis kyi gzhogs g.yon phyogs su grib ma nag po ring po re thon nas kho gnyis kyi gzugs po'i 'gul skyod la lad zlos byed pa bzhin mnyam du 'gro bzhin 'dug go/de nas kho gnyis dwangs gtsang gi chu mig yod pa'i brag ri zhig gi gsham du slebs dus nyi ma nub ri'i phag tu yib cing nub phyogs kyi gnam sa'i 'dres mtshams nas dgong mo'i dmar ser mtshams sprin gyis re zhig 'jig rten yongs dmar ser ldog 'od kyis khyab nas yid mug pa'i tshor snang zhig bster/bu dgra 'dul dgong mo'i grang lhags kyis ma bzod par mjing pa slog pa'i gong ba'i nang du bskum nas 'dugad ni brag 'phrang dog po de lta ci/ spyir btang gi lam bu bde po zhig yin yang 'gro dka' bas dbang chen gyis me mda' dang khur po der phabs nas ‘‘do dgong 'dir zhag sdod byed/ sang nyin phar log 'gro ’’zer/dbang chen gyis rdo phog gsum btsugs nas ja bskol/ dgra 'dul gyis sbre ro de mdun du bzhag nas sbre lpags bshus rjes sha dum bu kha shas bgos nas rngon khyi lnga por sbyin/rdo phog gsum gyi steng du babs pa'i pho rog nag chung lta bu'i rdza ma de'i kha nas rlangs pa 'phyur gyin ja thang gar po zhig dmar lhog lhog tu 'khol bas 50

dbang chen gyis rdza ma thab las phabs rjes ja phud dang po yul gyi rgyab ri dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mor phul nas/mchod/ mchod/ mchod/dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo'i zhal la mchod/phar 'gro bskyabs kyi skyel ma/tshur yong bskyabs kyi bsu ma/grogs mi yul la yod tshad rang yul/dgra rang yul la yod tshad mi yul/mchod/ mchod/ mchod/ces phor pa'i nang gi ja gnam la gtor/phyi nyin bu dgra 'dul gnyid las sad dus nyi ma shar tsam red 'dugadabang chen da dung rngur pa 'brug sgra ldir ba ltar 'then bzhin gnyid lam gyi zhing khams su myul bzhin 'dug pas/ dgra 'dul gyis ga ler mal las langs te lci ba thu ba gang btus te rdo phog gsum gyi thab nang du byi'u yi tshang ltar brtsigs pa'i lci ba sgor mo'i dbus su lci ba zhib zhib sbar mo gang spungs/de nas rang gi glo la btags pa'i me lcags brdab ste me stag gis zin pa'i pa rdog gcig lce ba zhib zhib de'i steng du bzhag de nas yang de'i steng du lce ba zhib zhib sbar mo gang blugs nas phu 'debs kyin du ba je cher je cher song nas dgung sngon du 'phyur/re zhig song rjes dbang chen yang gnyid las sad de bya rmyang zhig byas nas mal chas las tsog ste shar phyogs su blta skabs/ shar phyogs kyi la nyag de'i phar phyogs nas kyang 'di phyogs kho gnyis kyis btang ba'i me yi du bar 'gran rtsod byed pa ltar du ba'i g.yu 'brug ring po zhig dgung sngon du 'phyung yong gi 'dug pas dbang chen gyis lag g.yas pas nyi 'od 'geb kyin ‘‘la 51
