'di'i phar phyogs su'ang mi khyim zhig yod pa 'dra ’’zer bzhin mig zim zim byed kyin yun ring bltas/ khoganyis kyis zhogs ja btung rjes dbang chen gyis ‘‘da lta nyi ma snga po red/ nged gnyis song nas mi tshang de ga 'dra 'dug lta bar 'gro ’’zer nas mkho byed yongs rdo yi 'og tu sbas te du ba 'phyur 'ong sa'i phyogs su song /kho gnyis ci gros mol gros kyi skad cha sna tshogs lab bzhin song bas yun ring po ma 'gor bar ri rtser slebs te bltas pa na rgyang ring gi ri tshogs kyi rlabs 'phreng bar med du gnas shing 'byams klas kyi rtswa thang chen por skabs re skyi g.ya' ba'i rlung 'khor 'tshub nas thal rdul gyi ka ba nam mkhar zugari gsham gyi spang ljongs nar mo zhig gi steng du lug khyu gcig bag phebs su gnas pa'i 'khris su sbra chen po zhig phub nas 'dug ma gzhi sbra de ni ha cang spyir btang gi sbra chung chung zhig yin yang / yun ring sbra mthong myong med stabs sbra de ha cang chen po yod pa'i 'phrul snang shar/kho gnyis la nyag der bsdad de phyogs gzhan du zhib blta byas kyang gzhan gyi mi tshang gcig kyang mthong rgyu mi 'dugadabang chen gyis sna tha sen mo gang blugs nas 'then bzhin du ‘‘byang stong mi med lung du mi tshang gcig yod don ci yin nam ’’zer/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘'di tshang la lug las nor med pa yin nam ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘o/ go thos la stod rgyud kyi 'brog pas lug la do po 'gel srol yod red zer ba go myong / ha lam stod rgyud kyi tshwa len mkhan yin gyi red ’mices bshad rjes ldag mdzub dang mthe bong gis sna tha cung zad cig bzung nas sna khung g.yas par gtad de ‘‘sir sgra ’’dang bcas yar 'then rjes glo gsang zhig byas nas mkhur mgo g.yas g.yon las lhung 'ong ba'i mig chu phyis tsam byas nas ‘‘ngas 'gro nas blta 'ong / khyod 'dir nga sgug nas 52

sdod ’’zer/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘a pha/ der song nas ci phan// ma 'gro/ yang stabs mi legs pa'i gnas tshul 'dra thug yong ’’zhes sems khral skyed de rang gi pha'i phu dung las bzung nas 'gro ru ma bcugadabang chen gyis ‘‘skyon yod pa ma red/ me mda' dang sked gri khyod kyis nyar nas sdod ’’ces sked gri blangs te sar bzhag de nas yang rum las rdzas rwa dang mdel khug kyang blags te sar bzhag nas ‘‘ngas g.yag 'tshol bar kha g.yar te song na gang byed kyi ma red/ stabs legs na khyim tshang 'di nged gnyis kyi grong rogs su 'gyur yang chog ’’ces bshad de bud song /dgra 'dul gyis rang gi pha la rkyen ngan pa 'phrad dogs kyis me mdar rdzas mdel blugs te pha la mig gis skyel ma byas/sbra de'i nye 'khor du mi gcig kyang mthong rgyu mi 'dug dbang chen sbra dang thag nye bar slebs rjes ‘‘wa ye/ wa ye ’’zhes lan gnyis bos/de mtshams nas bud med dar ma lo sum cu lhag tsam byas pa mgo skyes kyi lan bu sil mas lus kyi stod khebs pa zhig sgor don nas bla 'khyam pa ltar ci yang mi shod par langs nas 'duga.a tsi/ byang stong gi sa cha 'di na ngo ma mi khyim med pa red mi 'dug snyam nas phar blta tshur blta byas kyang bud med de las gzhan gyi mi ni mthong rgyu mi 'dug rna ba gtad de nyan yang sbra'i nang yang skad sgra lab sgra thos rgyu mi 'dug mo hreng gi kher rkyang khyim dud cig 'dir gnas sdod byed don ci yin nam snyam nas gom pa gang mdun du spos pa dang bud med des phyir bshol gom gang byas/dbang chen gyis lag zung pus mo'i steng du bzhag nas ha cang ngal dub 53

kyi rnam 'gyur ston bzhin du ‘‘a ce/ nga tshwa pa yin/ g.yag gnyis bor song ba 'tshol mkhan yin ’’zhes yang gom gang mdun du spos/ bud med des skad cha gang yang ma bshad par mig ce rer dbang chen la blta bzhin du yang gom gang phyir bshol byas/‘‘da nyin mang po ja kham gang yang rag med pas nga la ja zhig bster dang /’’bud med des lan ma sbyin/‘‘a ce/ khyod nga la skrag dgos don med/ ja phor pa gang bster dang / de nas nga bud 'gro chog’ribud med des da dung lan ma sbyin/ ‘‘ja med kyang chu phor pa gang bster na'ang 'grig’’bud med des kha nas skad cha gang yang ma bshad par kho'i mgo nas mjug bar bskyar blta lan 'ga' byas nas sbra'i sgo phyes te kho nang du 'dzul rung ba'i brda byas/sbra'i nang du rno ngar mtshon chas sne len byed mkhan skyes pa gcig gis gra sgrig ang gsar gyis sgug nas med dam snyams pa'i dogs 'char dang bcas sbra sgo las yar blta dus ci yang mi 'dug pas da gzod kho blo bde bar gyur nas tsham tshom med par nang du 'dzul/zhim dkyil du sog thab rkang gsum gcig gi steng du rtsam thug gar po zhig bskol bzhin 'dug kho rang khyim du slebs pa ltar khyim sbug gi lpags gdan hrul po zhig 'dug pa de'i steng du bsdad de ‘‘khyod kyi khyo bo gang du phyin song ’’zhes dris/bud med des gang yang ma bshad/‘‘sa cha 'dir khyod tshang las gzhan gyi dud tshang med pa red dam/’’54

bud med des da dung gang yang ma lab par khyim mdor langs nas bsdad/ā/ ya mtshan/ bud med 'di lkugs ma yin pa 'dra snyam nas sna ru blangs te sna tha sen mo gang blugs te gang yang ma bshad par kha rog tu bsdad/de nas khos sna tha sen mo gang po de 'then nas bltas pas na bud med de'i ngo gdong gcig thog gnyis brtsegs su byug pa'i zhag rtsi'i nag dreg gis thog ma'i rang mdangs dkar dmar mi mthong yang ngo bzo dod pa'i bud med 'dra chags shig red 'dugabud med de'i ngo gdong las dga' sdug gi rnam 'gyur gang yang med par rang sar langs nas 'dug gcig gis skad cha shod pa'am yang na dris kyang gcig shos kyis lan gang yang mi bster ba ni ci bya gtol med kyi dus tshod ring po zhig red/dbang chen gyis khyim gyi g.yon phyogs su blta dus snod chas thabs chag 'ga' go rim gyi dang dod med par thar thor du bzhag yod pa dang / rtsam khug chen po gcig dang mar dkrog gnyis gsum zhig mal gzan dkar po snum dreg gis zin te thog ma'i tshos mdog mi mngon pa gcig gi zur du bzhag 'dug khos glo bur du rtsam pa rtsam khug gang po de dang / mar dkrog de dag 'phrog nas bud 'gro bsam/ de mtshams nas rtsam thug 'khol te 'phyur byung bas khos lam seng rtsam thug de thab las phabs/skabs der kho'i sems su bud med der snying rje zhig skyed de bud med gcig gi lag nas 'phrog bcom byas na skyes pa pho ga la yin/ de ltar byas na phyis 'byung bya ba lam lhong yong rgyu lta ci bar chad ngan pa yang 'phrad yong snyam nas 'gro bar brtsams pa na bud med des sgo bkag nas ‘‘ja med/thug pa 'thung ’’zer/55

dbang chen de mar hang sang nas ‘‘yā/ khyod lkugs ma red mi 'dugangs khyod lkugs ma red bsam byung ’’zer/bud med des rtsam thug phor pa gang blugs te kho la sbyin/ khos thug pa 'thung bzhin du ‘‘khyod kyi ming la ci zer ’’zhes dris/ bud med des ‘‘nga'i ming la 'o ma skyid zer ’’zhes lan btab/ dbang chen gyis thug pa phor pa gang btung rjes da dung 'thung 'dod nas phor pa phar sbyin/'o ma skyid kyis yang thug pa phor pa gang blugs te sbyin zhor du ‘‘'o na/khyod kyi ming la ci zer mi’zhes dris/‘‘nga'i ming la/ um/ nga'i ming la tshe ring zer ’’zhes rang ming gsang nas lan btab/‘‘khyod g.yag bor nas ga tshod phyin song ’’zhes dris/‘‘g.yag bor nas nyin gsum phyin song ’’zhes bshad zhor du phor pa gtsang mar ldag nas ‘‘'dir khyod rang gcig pu red dam/ 'di'i rgyud la da dung mi tshang gzhan yod dam ’rizhes dris/ bud med des mgo bo 'phred du g.yug bzhin dbugs ring zhig 'byin te thab 'gram du bsdad nas thab nang du lci ba 'ga' blugs te rang gi sngar song gi gnas tshul dag ji ma ji bzhin kho la bshad pa ste/'o ma skyid lo na nyi shur son dus lung pa'i phyi nang la skad grags yod pa'i bu mo gzugs mdzes shig red/ mo'i pha ma gnyis la phru gu mo rang las med la khyim tshang gi 'byor pa yang gzhan smon rang skyid cig red/ pha 'brug grags chung dus rang gi mes po dang mnyam du lo mang byang mthar 'khyam nas rngon rgyag gi las la byang chub pa zhig red/ 'on kyang kho lo sum cu so lnga'i dus yul der slebs te 'o ma skyid kyi ma g.yu mtsho dang ngo shes te mthar khyo shug gi 'tsho ba bskyal ba nas bzung byang mthar 'khyams te ri dwags rngon myong med/56

de ltar dus yun ring po phyin rjes byang mthar 'khyams nas ri dwags rngon 'dod kyi sems pa'i 'char sgo 'gog med rba rlabs 'phyur ba ltar skyed de skabs re mtshan mo'i gnyid lam du yang ri dwags rngon pa kho na rmis pas mi tshad sgo zog gi sha la bro ba med pa dang rkyang 'brog gi sha las bsam rgyu med par gyur nas dgun bshas bsha' ba'i dus la slebs dus rang khyim gyi sha bzan 'ga' shas la gzhu 'phangs nas bsod kyi yod pas nye 'khor grong rogs tshang mas yo ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ rang gi sgo zog la mda' rgyag pa ni bdud kyi byed stangs red ces dmod tshig bor bas mi tshad mi mang pos kho dang phor pa gcig nang ja mnyam 'thung dang gdan gcig steng mnyam sdod byas na rang gi bsod nams longs spyod nyams kyi red zer ba sogs mang po bshad nas mthar kho tshang la bdud tshang zhes 'bod nas kun gyis kha ya mi byed par de snga'i grong rogs tsho yang gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis bar thag ring ba'i sar gnas spos te kho tshang kher rkyang du bzhag don de'i dbang gis ma g.yu mtsho sems sdug gis ma bzod par tshe las 'das/'o ma skyid lo na nyi shur son te mag pa len pa'i dus la slebs kyang sde nang gi pho gzhon tsho mo'i byad bzhin la sems chags kyang bdud tshang gi bu mo'i mag pa byas na mthar rang nyid kyang bdud mag gi ming thogs te gzhan gyi mdun du mgo 'gyog thabs med snyam nas mo'i mdun du 'dod glu len nus mkhan gcig kyang med la de bas mag pa byed 'dod mkhan gcig kyang med/nyin zhig pha 'brug grags kyis yul gang nas yong ba mi shes pa'i tshe skyabs zhes pa'i 'khyams po zhig khrid yong nas mo'i mag pa byed dgos zhes gnyen ston stabs bde zhig bshams nas gnyen sgrig byed du bcugs/tshe skyabs spyir btang las kar mi dman pa yod kyang kho yang gyos po 'brug grags ltar ri dwags rngon rgyur shin tu dga' mkhan zhig red/57

tshe skyabs dang 'o ma skyid gnyis sngas gdan gcig gi steng du lo mang ‘‘'bad 'thab ’’byas kyang 'o ma skyid kyi lus la phru gu 'khor myong med pas sde ba'i nang gi mi kha bde 'gas/ bdud tshang la bdud mag gcig blangs kyang bdud mag de la skyes pa pho'i cha rkyen gcig tshang mi 'dug ces zer ba dang /bdud rgan 'brug grags khos rang gi sgo zog la'ang mda' brgyab nas bkum pa'i mtha' 'bras la bu mo gcig rang yod pa de'ang rabs chad red 'dug zer ba sogs rna ba sun pa'i 'phya smod de dag 'brug grags kyi rna bar thos skabs kho pa zhe sdang gis bzod ma thub par sked gri g.yu byur gyi khra can zhig yod pa de dgung la 'phyar nas ‘‘bdud las ma las par bdud kyi ming thogs na de ring ltad mo ltos ’’zhes ngar skad rgyag bzhin rgyug nas sbra gur la lar gri g.yug ste dbral/ la la'i gur thag rgyu ma gcod gcod byas/ byis pa dang bud med rnams mgo la sbar mo bkab nas ‘‘a ma ma/ mi gsod pa 'dug ’’ces 'o dod 'bod kyin bros/tsheskyabs kyis kyang gyos po'i rjes su 'brangs nas ‘‘kha phred la 'byar tshad de ring gsod/ sbra gur sa la brdab tshad de ring dbral dgos ri’zhes ngar skad sgrog bzhin rgyug kyang 'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘de 'dra ma byed/ kho tshos ci zer yang nyan 'jog ma byed ’rices shod kyin tshe skyabs kyi rkang pa las 'jus te bkag kyang ‘‘khyod kha rkub 'dra ma btsum na nga'i gri 'di la snying rje med ’’ces dmod zhor du rdog rgyag gcig gis 'o ma skyid ltag 'gyel sloga'abrug grags kyis sde ba'i nang nam rgyun kha bde shos yin pa'i skye bo rnam rgyal bya ba zhig yod pa de'i brang steng du pus mos gnan te ‘‘kha lce bde ba'i las 'bras 'di red ’’ces lce rtse gcod grabs byas/sde ba'i mi kun gyis spyi bo'i rtse ru bkur ba'i pho hreng bgres song ban rgan skya lo zhes pa chos kho na ma gtogs bsam rgyu med pa gcig yod pa des ‘‘de 58

'dra ma byed/ sde ba'i zhabs 'dren red/ nang dme las sdug pa'i spyod ngan ga la yod ’’ces bkag pas rnam rgyal gyi lce rtse gri 'og tu ma shor tsam byung /de nas gyos po dang mag pa gnyis kyis gri ring klad la bskor bzhin du ‘‘nga rgad po 'brug grags kyis 'brug skad grags na char ma babs pa'i dus med/ de ring khyod tsho ltad mo mthong e byung / ngas rang zog rang gis ji ltar bsad kyang khyod tsho jus gtogs mi dgos/ go e byung / de ring ngas ban rgan skya lo'i khar nyan pa ma gtogs khyod tsho thams cad gom gsum spo dbang dang tshig gsum shod dbang med pa bzo dgos bsam byung ’’zhes skad brgyab/yul lung de'i mi tshang ma nyin mang po mgo bo 'phred du g.yug bzhin dbugs ring gtong ba las rgyun ldan gyi skad cha'ang shod mi nus par gyur/mi sems chung sdug gi 'khor lo bskor/ rta sems chung 'gros kyi 'khor lo bskor zhes pa ltar mi sems chung kha shas nyin gyi zas la bro ba med pa dang mtshan gyi gnyid la bde ba med par gyur te mgo bo 'bras bu'i khur gyis lci ba'i 'bras shing gi yal ga ltar gug cing lag pas 'gram pa skyor nas gza' nad phog pa ltar gyur pa dang / gcin gtong skabs kyang 'brug grags tshang gi phyogs su kha gtad nas gtong mi nus par gyur/brtse dung gi rgya mtsho'i nang du bde skyid kyi phugs bsam la rol bzhin 'dod glu yi lcags kyus nya mo 'dzin pa'i gzhon nu pho gsar mo gsar rnams re zhig mdza' glu'i 'brel thag chad cing 'gro 'ong gi lam bu'ang 'gagade nas nyin gsum ma 'gor bar gyos po dang mag pa gnyis kyis ‘‘'dre lung 'di'i nang mi tshe 'khyol thabs mi 'dug de bas da lta rang byang du 'gro ’’zer/'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘nga 'chi yang rang yul du 'chi rgyu yin ’’zhes 'gro 'dod 59

ma byas kyang 'brug grags kyis bu mo'i mgo la byil byil byed bzhin ‘‘bu mo/nga'i snying / khyod de 'dra ma zer/ khyod kyis rtsam pa bzas pa las ngas tshwa bzas pa mang / nga'i khar nyon/ 'dir bsdad kyang sdod thabs med/ nga dang tshe skyabs gnyis khong khro ma bzod par kho tsho phu dkrug mda' dkrug byas pas kho tsho mi mang lag mang red/ nga tsho mi gsum gyis kha gtad gcog thub kyi ma red/’’ces bshad pas 'o ma skyid kyi sems su skad cha de gnas lugs tsed pa ma red/ sde ba'i mi tsho yang byis pa lo gsum ma red/ kho tsho tshang ma kha mthun te mda' gri mdung gsum gyi rtsed mo rtse bar yong na nged tshang me btang rjeyokyi thal ba'ang med pa bzo gi red snyams nas mig chu khrum khrum du gtong bzhin mgu ba'i brda la mgo bo lcog lcog byas/'brug grags tshang gis sbra dang stabs bde'i snod chas/ mchig gu sogs 'bri g.yag la bskal nas lug khyu ded de byang du 'ong ba red/sde ba las bral skabs mi tshang ma sbra'i sgo subs las bltas te ‘‘bdud tshang bud song / slar phyir log mi yong bar shog ’’ces shod pa las kho tshor skyel ma byed mkhan gcig kyang med/sde nang gi ban rgan skya los kho tsho mda' rgyang gang tsam gyi sar skyel ma byas/ bral khar khos ‘‘khyod tsho yul lung gang du slebs kyang yul khrims srung dgos/ yul chu btung ste yul khrims ma srung na mthar rang nyid pham rgyu red/de nges par du ma brjed yid la bzung ri’zhes kha ta byas/'brug grags kyis ‘‘lags so/ ngas ma brjed yid la bzung chogam gzhi khong khro slong mkhan med na/ bzod pa su la sgom ’’zer/ban rgan gyis ‘‘da dung don chen zhig khyod kyis ma brjed pa byed dgos/khyod tsho'i lug khyu'i nang lug rwa med dkar rkyang la sug bzhi ser po byas pa gcig yod pa de bsod mi nyan/ de bsad na khyod tshang la bkra mi shis pa'i 60

rkyen ngan zhig 'phrad rgyu red ’’ces bshad de phyir sde nang du log song /'brug grags kyis bsam blo ga tshod btang yang rang gi lug khyu'i nang lug de 'dra med pas/ kho lo na mtho bas 'chol gtam smras pa yin gyi red bsam yang sems nang du ma brjed par byas/dus tshod rim gyis 'das pas ban rgan skya lo'i mngags bcol de yang kha seng gi rkang rjes de ring mi gsal ba ltar rim gyis brjed song /zla phyed tsam song rjes kho tshos stag ru zhes pa'i mtshe'u zhig gi 'gram du slebs nas der rtswa kha bzang bas nyin shas sdod rgyu byas/ skabs de dus hor zla lnga pa yin pas yul lung yongs ljang thing thing du gnas shing / dbyar sos kyi tsha drod 'phel bas rgyang ring gi ri thang la mig rgyang gcod dus smig sgyu'i khrod du pha bong che chung mang po yang skya mi mang po gral star sgrig pa ltar phra la ring zhing 'gul skyod byed pa'i 'phrul snang shar/de nyin nyin dgung ma mo'i 'o ma bzhos rjes 'brug grags kyis mda' gzhu brgyab tu khur nas mtshe'u yi 'gram du lug 'tsho bar song / tshe skyabs dang 'o ma skyid gnyis nyin dgung gi tsha gdug kyis mnar te sbra'i nang du gnyid de bsdad/'o ma skyid kyi rna lam du ‘‘a ru/ a ru ’’zhes smre sngags 'don pa'i sgra zhig thos pas ya mtshan skyed de 'phral mar yar langs te bltas pa na pha 'brug grags kha nas khrag dmar don bzhin sgo 'gram nas gog drud byed kyin yong gi 'duga'o ma skyid dngangs 'tshab skyed nas ‘‘a pha ’’zhes skad rgyag bzhin 'brug grags skyor te ‘‘a pha/ khyod ci byas song ’’zhes dris/‘‘nga nga nga ’’zhes lan 'debs ma thub/ de mar tshe skyabs kyang gnyid sad de kho gnyis kyis khog stod smad las btegs te nang du 61

khyer/ gdan steng du bzhag kha ru chu blugs pas na zug cung zad drag nas 'dren byed zung gis bu mo'i gdong la blta bzhin ‘‘nga nga da res mtshe'u 'gram du gnyid gnyid shor 'dug de'i skabs tub tub kyi sgra 'ga' thos thos pas nga nga gnyid las sad dus ’’ na zug gis ma bzod par 'dren byed gnyis zim zim du gyur zhing skad cha mu mthud shod ma thub/ 'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘ a pha de nas de nas ’’zhes ngu ngag gis 'bod kyin chu phor pa gang ga ler kha nang du blugs pas yang dran pa sos te ‘‘ngas mtsho lug mang po zhig don yong ba mthong byung bas gzhu bkug ste 'phang pas mda' de mtsho lug gcig la phog song /’’yang chu cung zad blugs pas dran pa sos te ‘‘de dang dus mnyam gzhu dum bu gnyis su chag chag nas nga'i snying khar brgyab byung mtsho lug de ni kha seng ban ban rgan skya los los los ’’skad cha yongs rdzogs bshad ma tshar gong kha nas skad cha mi thon par gyur/tshe skyabs kyis lam seng slog pa kha phyes te blta dus snying khar dmar thig chen po zhig las rma ni mi 'dug kha nas da dung khrag dmar 'dzad med don pas sman bcos kyi thabs shes ni med stabs gan rkyal du bsnyal nas bzhaganyin de'i mtshan mo'i skar gral sgrig rjes 'brug grags tshe las 'das/'o ma skyid sdug bsngal drag po skyed de ‘‘a pha/ nga'i a pha ’’zhes 'brug grags kyi phung por 'tham nas yun ring po ngus/tshe skyabs kyis ‘‘da ma ngu / thabs shes yod ma red/ 'jig rten thog skyes pa'i mtha' ma rgas rgyu/ rgas pa'i mtha' ma shi rgyu red/ ma ngu ’’62

zhes 'o ma skyid la sems gso byed kyin mig chu phyis te 'brug grags kyi phung po rgyab tu khur nas ri ru bskyur/gnas der zla phyed tsam bsdad rjes da dung byang du nyin zhag bzhi song /byang du ji tsam song ba de tsam gyis 'o ma skyid rang yul dran par gyur nas mthar tshe skyabs la phyir rang yul du log rgyu'i re ba bton/tshe skyabs kyi ‘‘hung rna bar mi 'gro ba'i skad cha/ log na khyod rang logang mi 'gro thag chod yin ’’zer/'o ma skyid kyis tshe skyabs kyi mdun du pus mo btsugs te ‘‘byang thang mi med lung stong du song na nga rang gnyis 'tsho ba 'khyol gyi ma red/ de las phyir rang yul du log na shi yang blo bde ba 'dug sku mkhyen/ rang yul du log 'gro ’’zhes zhu ba 'then/tshe skyabs kyis ‘‘nag mo rabs chad khyod med na 'gro stabs bde/ log na khyod rang log ’’ces tshig tsub kyis dmod de phyi nyin 'bri g.yag tshang ma ded de snying rje spu tsam med par 'o ma skyid byi'u phrug thang du g.yug pa bzhin bskyur nas bud song / 'o ma skyid phyir rang yul du log bsam yang gcig nas 'bri g.yag med pas sbra dang snod sogs 'gel sa med pa dang /ri gnyis nas phyir log pa'i lam yang mi shes pas mi yul gyi dmyal ba myong bzhin du gnas der mi sdod ka med byung ba sogs rjes dran yongs sba gsang spu tsam med par dbang chen la bshad rjes 'o ma skyid ngo gdong yongs mchi mas brlan par gyur te dbugs ring shor/dbang chen yang 'o ma skyid kyi ya nga ba'i las bskal la snying rje skyed de cung trem ma gtogs mig chu shor/ 'o ma skyid kyis dbugs ring zhig btang nas ‘‘nga nag mo kher bu nad kyis mnar na chu kha gang yang bster mkhan med/shi rjes phung po sbra hrul 'di'i nang du lu sa te rnam shes 'gro thub pa mi 'dug ’’63

ces sems sdug byas/ dbang chen gyis ‘‘khyod 'dir slebs nas dus tshod ji tsam phyin song ’’zhes dris/'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘lo gcig dang phyed ka phyin song ’’zer/ dbang chen gyis ‘‘da gin ngas nga tshwa pa yin zhes pa ni rdzun bshad pa yin/ nga yang pha gzhis mnga' 'bangs mi lag tu shor nas bros 'ong ba'i 'khyam po zhig yin/nga dang bu gnyis kyis khyod kyi sbra mthong bas de ring 'dir yong ba yin ’’zer/‘‘rdzun ma shod ’’ces 'o ma skyid kyis dbang chen gyi mgo nas mjug bar bskyar lta zhig byas nas phyir nud tsam byas/‘‘rdzun min’’zhes khos mdun du nud tsam byas/‘‘'o na khyod yul las bral nas lo ga tshod song ngam’’‘‘yul las bral nas zla gcig zin grabs 'dug’’‘‘khyod kyis mna' skyel dang /’’‘‘gnam sngon po tshad btsugs/’’‘‘skyes pa pho lus blangs pa zhig gis mna' za gi ma red ’’zer nas rtsam phyur dang mar kho'i mdun du bzhag nas ‘‘spags zori’zer nas kho'i 'khris su bsdad de ‘‘nga lo gcig dang phyed ka'i ring de ring ma gtogs mi gzhan la skad cha shod rgyu lta ci/ mi gzhan gyi gzugs brnyan yang mthong ba thengs dang po yin/ khyod 'dir sdod/ nga nag mo gcig 'dir sdod dgos dus bshas bsha' mkhan med par lus kyi 'dug spyang kis rmug ste bsad pa'i lug dang spyang ki'i bzas 'phro las sha gtsang ma zhig za rgyu rnyed ma byung ’’zhes shod kyin ngo tsha ba'i dbang gis mgo bo sgur zhing ngo gdong sbar mos bkab/mo'i nyam thag gi las bskal dang 'u thug gi re ba des kho'i blo yid rbad de bkug pas ‘‘nga la da dung bu gcig yod ’’ces bshad/'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘ngas shes byung / da gin khyod kyis bshad byung ’’zer/64

‘‘'o/ red red/ da gin ngas nga la bu gcig yod ces bshad pa yin ’’zer/‘‘bu da lta ga par yod/’’‘‘bu da lta nub kyi ri de'i steng nga sgug nas yod ’’ces bshad/‘‘da khrid shog bu'i ming la ci zer ’rizhes dris/‘‘bu'i ming la dgra 'dul zer/ da lo lo bco lnga red ’’ces bshad rjes kho sgor don nas song /'o ma skyid kyis nang gi gad snyigs phyags shing gdan gtsang mar brdab/de nas go thal gtsang mar bshos te ngo gdong gtsang mar bkrus rjes 'dzum mdangs kyis khengs nas sbra sgor don nas kho gnyis yong rgyur sgugadabang chen bu'i 'gram du slebs dus dgra 'dul sgug yun ring drags pas rdo leb steng du rdo yi nor/ lug mi/ khyi sogs ri mo 'dra min sna tshogs 'bri bzhin bsdad 'dugadabang chen gyis ‘‘sgug yun ring ma song ngam/ grang e byung ’’zer/‘‘sgug yun ring ma byung / dud tshang des ci zer gyi 'dug ’’ces dris/‘‘der nag mo gcig las mi 'dug mo rang yul 'dir slebs nas um/ pha shi rjes khyo gas bskyur nas mo hreng ma red 'dug mo'i las bskal yang ha cang ya nga ba zhig red 'dug um um/ mos nga tsho zla sgril gtong rgyu'i re ba 'don gyi 'dug khyod kyis byas na ga 'dra 'dug’’ces dris/bus ‘‘o’’zer ba las mos mthun yod med kyi rnam 'gyur ma bstan/‘‘mo la sbra yod pas mi tshad/ snod thab chas dang lug kyang mang po 'dug lug bsha' mkhan gcig kyang med pas mo ngo ma ya nga 'os pa zhig red 'dug ’’ces bshad/65

bus mgo lcog lcog byas/‘‘'gro/ rjes ma ga 'dra byed min rjes su lta rgyu red/ gnas skabs mo'i re ba ltar zla sgril btang na phan tshun gnyis kar phan thogs chen po 'dug ’’zer nas kho gnyis ri las babs te song /dbang chen gyis ‘‘'di bu dgra 'dul red’’ces bshad/‘‘ya/ ya/ ngas khyod rang gi ma ltar gces skyong byed chog ri’zer/dgra 'dul gyis sems su nga la a ma yod bzhin mos ma tshab byed dgos don mi 'dug snyam nas ‘‘min/ ma ltar gces skyong byed dgos don med/nga la a ma yod ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘nga tsho gsum ka gcig phan gcig rogs byas na 'grigapha dang ma zer dgos don med ’’zer/dgong mo kho tsho phyi po ma chags bar skad cha sna tshogs shod kyin bsdad/'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘tshe ring / khyod gnyis ga 'dra byas nas yul dang bral ba red ’’ces dris/dbang chen gyis ‘‘o/ ngas da gin ming yang rdzun lab pa yin/ nga'i ming la dbang chen zer gyi yod ’’ces gsal bshad byas rjes sngar song gi 'das don yid la 'khor te phyir dran byas pa gsham gsal/yul g.yang phyug ces pa de ni kho gnyis pha bu gnyis kyi pha yul red/ de ni lung pa gnyis kyi nang du thar thor du gnas pa'i grong pa bcu bdun las grub pa'i byang rigs kyi tsho pa chung chung zhig red/yul g.yang phyug gi dbul phyug 'phel rim ltar kho'i yab mes kyi skabs kyang dbul phyug gi 'phel grib mang po byung myong ba ste/ khyim dud nyung zhing rtswa kha bzang bas dbyar char chu mang zhing dgun kha ba med pa'i dus/ phyugs rigs 'o ma kha lud pa ltar 'phel ba dang / dbyar char chu nyung zhing dgun 66

kha ba mang ba'i dus/ phyugs rigs tshang ma shi ste lhas ra stong par lus pa'i khyim dud kyang mang po byung myong / bya shing rtse la skyid/ mi rang yul na skyid ces pa ltar rang yul rgyab tu bskyur nas gzhan yul du mi tshe 'khyol thabs byed myong mkhan med/dbang chen gyis khyim gzhis bzung ba nas ha lam 'phel ba las 'grib pa'i dus byung myong med/ sgos su kho tshang gi sgo zog 'phel rgyas chen po byung nas yul g.yang phyug gi nang grags pa khyab pa'i phyug por gyur/de lo'i dbyar zla ra ba'i dus su yul g.yang phyug la sngar byung myong med pa'i char chu byung ste ma mo gnyis re'i 'o mas zo ba gcig khengs pa dang /'bri re'i 'o mas zo ba gnyis re khengs pa'i lo legs shig byung /lo de'i dbyar ka shar ma thag bod dmag rta pa bcu gnyis de ru slebs/de snga g.yang phyug la bod dmag gi sa srung sgar sa byed myong med kyang 'di lo dmag mi rnams byang skyod skor g.yeng byed skabs stes dbang gis 'brog sa skyid po der slebs pas mu mthud byang skyod ma byas par der bsdad pa red/sa srung dmag de dag la me'i 'phrul mda' zhes pa de khul gyi 'brog pas sngar mig gis mthong rgyu lta ci rna bas thos ma myong ba'i mtshon cha rwa gnyis ldan lcags dang shing las grub pa zhig 'dug pa de'i nang rdzas dang zha ril blugs te rgyab na rna ba'i bar du bkang nas 'phangs pa'i gzhu rgyang gsum bzhi'i sar gnas pa'i srog chags kyi srog bkum nus pa re khur nas 'dugs srung dmag de dag thog mar g.yang phyug tu slebs skabs gcig re gnyis re byas te 'brog pa'i dud khyim du gnas tshang g.yar nas tshul mthun gyis sdod pa las bud med la brnyas bcos dang / nyam chung la 'jigs skul/rgyu dngos 'phrog bcom mi byed par ha cang tshul dang ldan pa'i zol gyis yul mi yongs dang yug gcig tu 'brel nas skyes pa rnams la bo'u rgyag stangs 67

bslabs pa dang skabs skabs yul gyi skyes pa rnams dang mnyam du thang bde mo'i steng du g.yag gi sog rus kyi steng du rdzas kyi nag thig bris te 'ben rtsed rtse ba dang / skabs re mi 'gar me mda' dang rdzas mdel bskur te ri ru ri dwags rngon par mngags te rngon rdzas dgo ba dang gtsod sogs gang byung ba rnams mnyam du longs su spyod kyi yod/sde ba'i skye bo rnams kyis kyang khong tsho'i bka' bkod dang du len pa dang sha mar gyi sne len gzab rgyas byed kyi yod/kho rang ste/ dbang chen tshang du gnas tshang g.yar nas bsdad pa'i ru dpon tshe mgon dang / kho'i zhabs phyi skar ma 'gyur med/ dmag mi spen pa gsum yang bag yod tshul ldan yin khul gyis phyis su lha sar slebs na kho tshang du nges par du yong dgos lugs bshad pa dang / bla ma rtsa chen zhig gi ljags mdud red ces srung ba 'ga' yang sprad/dbang chen gyis kyang lhag bsam zol med kyis nyin gsum re'i nang lug shed bzang re dang nyin bco lnga'i nang 'bri g.yag shed bzang re bshas te kho tshor sne len gang legs byas/skabs der khyim tshang gi 'byor pa phyug pa'i dbang gis dbang chen gyis sde dmangs la las ka gang ci'i thad sne khrid cing sde dmangs kyis kyang brtsi bkur che/ 'on kyang yul chags kyi lo rgyus ha cang thung zhing phyi phyogs kyi 'jig rten dang 'brel ba med pa'i sa khug lung khug gi tsho chung 'dir sngar nas da bar sde dpon zhes ming 'dogs myong ba'i skye bo gcig kyang med/ them dud bcu bdun las med pa'i yul g.yang phyug gi pho gzhon tshos nye 'khor gyi sde tsho'i nang gi bu mo mdzes shos dang mdzangs shos rnams mna' mar bsu thub pa dang / bu mo tshos kyang pho gzhon gzugs bzang stobs rtsal can rnams mag par bsu thub pa'i rgyu mtshan yang yul g.yang phyug yul lung gzhan las 'byor 68

pa che ba'i dbang gis red/yul gzhan gyi pho gzhon mo gzhon tsho yang g.yang phyug tu mag pa'am mna' mar 'gro rgyu de phugs bsam du brtsi gi yod/ g.yang phyug gi yul mi tshor sngar mes po'i dus nas dar ba'i srol zhig yod pa ste rang gi sde tsho rgya skyed gtong ched rang sde'i pho mo rnams yul tsho gzhan du mag pa'am mna' mar song na khrel med kyi las la brtsis te kun gyis 'phya zhing phor pa'ang sbyin mi chog pa'i gtan 'beb ched du ma bzos kyang rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i lugs srol de 'dra zhig chags yod/ don du yang g.yang phyug gi pho mo gzhon nu tsho rang yul skyid po de dor te gzhan yul du 'gro 'dod can gcig kyang med la/tshang ma gnyen sgrig gi lo tshad zin dus pha ma dang gnyen nye grong rogs khyim mtshes kyis jus bkod ltar g.yas g.yon sde tsho gzhan las stobs rtsal can gyi mag pa'am mdzangs ma'i yon tan 'dzoms pa'i mna' ma tshur khrid yong gi yod/g.yang phyug gi yul mi tshos rang re'i yul 'di ni ming don mtshungs pa'i bsod nams lhun gyis grub pa'i sde ba zhig red ces bsngags brjod yang yang byed kyi yod/ them dud bcu bdun de dag phal che ba rus rgyud gcig las mched pa'i gnyen nye sha stag red/ g.yang phyug thog mar yul sde chags nas khyim dud gcig las da lta khyim dud bcu bdun bar 'phel rgyas 'gro bar dus yun ring shos su'ang mi lo brgya tsam las song med/ dbang chen gyis pha gzhis bzung ba nas dar ba'i srol bzang zhig yod pa ste/ dbyar mtsher dgun mtsher mnyam 'gro mnyam sdod dang / khyim tshang gi 'byor phyug thad phan tshun kha gsab byed res byed pa/ g.yog pho mo yang nga khyim kho khyim gyi dbye ba cher ma mchis par su tshang la las brel yod pa de tshang la las ka byed par 'gro gi yod/69

res rta re bzhon te ri ru ri dwags rgyag par song / dbang chen gyis skar ma 'gyur med kyi bo'u de rgyab tu khur/ g.yu gzhong lta bu'i char shul gyi spang ljongs steng du dbang chen gyis ka ci dkar po'i rngul len gyon pa'i lag g.yas pas lcag tshan cung zad 'phyar nas bya thang dkar gyi gshog pa brkyang pa ltar byas nas a re o/mgo'i wa zhwa ser chen me tog red/tshe gcig la dbu 'phang mtho bar shogasked gri khra nor bu'i bang mdzod red/tshe gcig la dgra mgo non par shogarkang bzhi phra sbu la'i 'ja' can red/tshe gcig la yob dkar non par shogaces glu gtong gin mdun du rgyugatshe mgon gyis rta pho lcag gis skul nas dbang chen gyi rjes su 'brang /re zhig rna bar lhag par snyan pa'i rta pho'i rmig sgra thag thag dang rta yi mgul gyi dril bu'i ting sgras dbang chen gyi glu la ram 'degs byed pa dang mtshungs /spang ljongs kyi steng du khra chil chil du bzhad pa'i me tog dkar dmar ser gsum mig lam du spang gdan gyi 'ja' ris ltar khra thar thar zhig las mi mngon/ de nas chu phran lhung lhung du 'bab pa'i chu 'gram gyi ne'u gseng zhig gi steng du dbang chen rta las babs te ru dpon lags ’’zhes phyag 'bul zhig zhus rjes ‘‘nged dpon g.yog gnyis 'dir tog tsam ngal gsos na ga 'dra 'dug ’’ces tshe mgon spro po yong ched de ltar bshad/tshe mgon ha cang dga' po byung nas rta las babs te ‘‘red/ red/tag tag red/ sa cha 'dir skyid po zhe drag 'dug nga byang gi sa cha mang 71

por 'gro myong yang 'di rgyud las skyid pa'i sa char slebs myong med ’’ces phyogs bzhi'i ri lung gi mdzes ljongs la myong rol byed bzhin dbang chen gyi gam du bsdad/ dbang chen gyis rta gro blangs te de'i nang nas lug sha btsos ma dang /mar gzan/ 'bag gi rjobaton te tshe mgon la sngar byung myong med pa'i rtswa thang steng gi nyin dgung gi gsol tshigs phul/ tshe mgon gyis sma rar byil bzhin du ‘‘'brog pa'i dbyar kha nga tsho'i lung pa las skyid pa 'dug ’mizer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘de ring nga la grogs bzang po khyod lta bu mnyam du yod pas ngas ched mngags 'di ltar gra sgrig byas pa yin/ nga tsho'i kha dper rma bya nags kyi rgyan/ mgron po khyim gyi rgyan/ grogs bzang mi yi rgyan zer srol yod/ de min rgyun par nga tsho ched mngags ri dwags rngon par 'gro srol med la gal srid dus brgyar lan gcig lta bu song ba'i dbang du btang yang za 'thung mang po khyer gyi med ’’ces shod bzhin sha tig re re bzhin btubs nas tshe mgon la sprod pa dang mar zan 'chang bu re re bzhin blangs te mdun du bzhag nas zho dang mnyam du za ru bcugatshe mgon gyis ‘‘mi tshos 'brog pa blun po'i dper len pa ni shin tu mi 'os pa red/ ngo ma blo thub kyi grogs po ni 'brog pa red/ nga lo mang byang du skor g.yeng 'gro myong bas 'brog pa las gshis rgyud 'jam pa dang gzhung drang pa mi 'dug ri’ces shod kyin za 'thung la rol/kho gnyis der nyin dgung tsha thog la ngal gso brgyab rjes rta gnyis chu 'gram der btags/ me mda' rgyab tu khur te ri 'dzegs nas ri dwags 'tshol bar phyin/ kho gnyis brag tsham tshom gyis brgyan pa'i spang ri'i ldebs dhi lug gi grod pa'am yang na pags pas bzos pa'i zho blugs snod/72

su slebs/ der gang sar lhung lhung du 'bab pa'i chu phran gyi 'gram du ser chen/ dril shang / a gar do gar/ bya rgod spos/ sum cu tig ta/hong len sngon mo/ gur gum/ lug mig khur mang sogs ri skyes me tog gi lhun gyis grub pa'i rang byung skyed tshal gyi khrod du dar dir bung bas dbyangs snyan sgrog cing me tog gi ze'u 'bru 'thu ba dang / lha bya gong mos mgrin pa'i rdza rnga brdung bzhin mon 'bru zhes bya ba'i spang skyes gro ma'i ro bcud la rol nas 'dugakho gnyis ri rtser slebs te ga ler bltas pas na/ g.yu yi sder ma'i steng du dngul dkar gyi khra btab pa lta bu'i pha bong dkar po che chung 'dra min sna tshogs kyi khrod du dgo ba khyu gcig bag phebs ngang gnas nas 'dug de mar gnyis kas me lcags brdab nas sbi sdi'i sne mor me sgron te gzugs po 'khar bar brten pa'i bgres song ltar sgur te pha bong gi phag nas dgo ba'i phyogs su rkang 'jab lag 'jab kyis song ste bar thag gom pa nyis brgya tsam gyi sar slebs/ dbang chen gyis tshe mgon gyi rna bar kha sbyar nas ‘‘khyed me mda' tsha bas khyed kyis rgyob ’’ces bshad de pha bong gi steng nas mig gi mtshams don nas bltas/tshe mgon pha bong gi phag tu 'dug ma tsog gis me mda'i mchu pha bong g.yag ro tsam zhig gi steng du bzhag nas ‘‘twa ’’zhes brgyab/'di phyogs nas me mda'i skad grags pa dang dus mnyam phar phyogs kyi dgo khyu de 'drogs te khyu gnyis su gyur nas phyogs so sor bros pa'i dbus su dgo ba gcig sar 'gyel te 'phag 'tshag rgyag bzhin 'dug de mar tshe mgon gyi me mda'i mchu bskal sa'i pha bong de'i mdun logs nas dred mong gcig me mda'i skad kyis 'drogs nas phar tsam mchongs pa dang de 'phral kha tshur bskor nas sbar mo gnyis brang 'og tu bskum tsam byas pa dang dus 73

mtshungs tshe mgon gyi steng du mchongs byung /tshe mgon rang srog shor song snyams pa'i 'jigs skrag gis ‘‘dkon mchog mkhyen ’’zhes skad shor ba dang chabs cig ltag 'gyel log nas dran pa thor/dbang chen gyi lag gi me mda'i sbi sdi thog mar nas me mda'i skam pa'i steng du bzhag yod stabs dred mong mchongs nas bar snang du yod pa'i skad cig ma'i dus thung de'i nang me mda'i mchu dred mong gi phyogs su gtad de brgyab pas dred mong de ‘‘ā 'ong ’’zhes skad ngan shor te da gin phyogs so sor brkyang pa'i rkang lag khum ste tshe mgon gyi steng du lhung nas slar yang rkang lag bzhi ka'i sen mo 'od cabs se glog brnyan nang gi ri mo dal por 'gul ba'i par gzhi bzhin phyogs so sor brkyang nas dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad/dbang chen gyis da gin me mda'i mchu de phyogs su gtad de brgyab pa las dred mong de gsod thub yong bsam pa yid la med kyang bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la dred mong de bsad pas kho re zhig hon thor te me mda' da dung bar snang du btegs nas langs 'dug dbugs ring zhig shor ba dang gzhi nas bsam rgyu dran rgyu yod par gyur te phar song nas blta dus dred mong gi g.yon phyogs kyi rtsib gseng gi mdel khung las zung khrag gar po zhig sa ru thigs bzhin 'dugs ru 'khyil ba'i dred mong gi zung khrag gar po de g.yu ltar sngo ba'i spang gi steng du lhag par mngon gsal dod/ de'i dbus nas gzengs su thon pa'i me tog sngon po de shin tu mdzes/ 'on kyang rkang pa khrag gi nang du 'byar zhing lag zung gis me tog gi sdong rkang steng du 'dzegs thabs byed bzhin pa'i sdom de ni spang dang zung khrag me tog gsum gyi mdzes chos dang cha mi mtshungs pa'i ldog phyogs kyi ches nyam thag pa'i dpe mtshon zhig tu gyur 74

nas 'dugade nas dred mong gi mdel khung las zung khrag gi thigs pa lug gi ril ma tsam zhig ga ler sdom de'i steng du lhung nas me tog gi sdong rkang phyed tsam dmar por gyur ba dang / sdom de khrag dmar gyi khrod du 'phag 'tshag rgyag gin 'dug dbang chen gyis rtswa rkang gcig bcad nas sdom de khrag gi dkyil nas blangs te rdo leb gcig gi steng du bzhag sdom des thugs rje che zhu ba'i zol tsam med par rang gi mthu rtsal la brten nas khrag dmar gyi dkyil nas don thub pa'i tshul gyis nus shugs gang yod kyis phyogs gzhan zhig tu phyin pa'i rjes su ras skud las phra ba'i dmar mdog gi thig ris nar mo 'ga' gya ma gyu ru lhag nas 'dugadabang chen gyis nus shugs yod dgu rtsal sprugs kyis dred mong gi ro de tshe mgon gyi steng nas g.yon phyogs su 'bud thub tsam byung nas tshe mgon gyi mgo lag pas skyor nas ‘‘ru dpon tshe mgon/ ru dpon tshe mgon ’’zhes lan gsum bos pas tshe mgon gzhi nas dran pa sos te ‘‘a a ma dbang dbang chen lags/ nga nga ’’zhes dab dib 'ga' bzla bzhin mig ga ler gdang pa dang rang gi gam du lhag pa'i dred mong gi ro de mthong bas ‘‘a ma ’’zhes skad shor nas dbang chen gyi pang du 'khyud cing ngo gdong dbang chen gyi brang steng du sbyar/dbang chen gyis ‘‘ru dpon lags/ dred mong bsad tshar ’’ zhes bshad/‘‘bsad tshar ad/’ri‘‘um/ ngas me mda' rgyag thengs gcig gis kho 'gyel song /’’‘‘de de shi yod kyi ma red/’’‘‘shi tshar 'dug khyod kyis ltos dang /’’75

‘‘da lta shi shi yod kyi ma red/ri’‘‘ngo ma shi tshar 'dug’’‘‘da dung me me mda' gcig rgyob/’’‘‘me mda' rgyag dgos mi 'dug ngo ma shi tshar 'dug’’tshe mgon gyi ngo gdong dbang chen gyi brang las bral te mgrin pa kyog nas bltas pas dred mong de ngo ma shi tshar 'dug kyang da dung 'jigs skrag gis ma bzod par phyir nud tsam byas/dbang chen gyis ‘‘ltos dang / da gin nas shi tshar ba red ri’zer bzhin dred mong gi am lcog las bzung nas mgo yar bkyags pas ngo ma shi zin pa shes te tshe mgon zhe sdang langs nas me mdar rdzas mdel blugs te dred mong gi dpral bar me mda'i mchu sbyar nas ‘‘twa ’’zhes brgyab rjes mgrin pa gzengs su gtod de ‘‘hwa/ hwa/ hwa ’’zhes gad mo dgod bzhin dred mong gi mgor rdog rgyag ༷byeg ༷nis/ de nas dbang chen gyis gri shubs las bton te rdo leb gcig gi steng du brdar bzhin du ‘‘da nged gnyis dred lpags bshu yā ’’zer/tshe mgon gyis ‘‘de bshus nas ci phan/ sha za rung ngam ’’zhes dris/dbang chen gyis ‘‘dred sha za mi rung / 'on kyang dred lpags bshus te yag po mnyed thub na de las yag pa'i gdan med/ ngas yag po mnyed de khyed rang la 'bul gyi yin/ khyed rang gis bed spyod ma byas na dpon po gzhan la phul na ngo bzo thon po yod/ btsong na'ang gong yag po thob kyi red/um/ da dung dred mong gi mkhris pa ni dom mkhris dang khyad par med pas khyed rang lha sar slebs rjes btsong na gong mthon po khug gi red ’’ces bshad/tshe dgon dga' thag chod nas ‘‘dngos 'brel red pas/ 'o tsi/ da byas na yag po byung song / khyed las yag pa'i grogs po yul phyogs gzhan na 76

med/ lhag par du khyed ni nga'i srog skyob kyi drin can yin/ ngas khyed kyi drin lan 'jal ma thub na shi dur khung du slebs kyang rnam shes 'gro thub sa ma red ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘de 'dra zer mi dgos/ phyin 'byung nga dang nag mo phru gu gsum lha sar slebs pa'i dus shig shar na/ khyed las skyabs bcol sa med do ’’zer/tshe mgon gyis ‘‘khyed tsho nges par du lha sar slebs pa byed dgos/ngas khyed gsum snang rtse shag dhitu gnas tshang g.yar thabs byas chog ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘snang rtse shag ces pa de ci red/ khang pa gcig gi ming red dam ’’zhes dris/ tshe mgon gyis ‘‘a tsi/ ga re'i khang pa/ snang rtse shag zer dus pho brang ster bzo can zhig yod/ spyir btang gi mi der sdod thub kyi ma red/'on kyang ngas gong gi dmag spyi la dred lpags 'di dang dred mkhris 'di 'bul tshan du phul na khong tshos phal cher khyed tsho gsum gnas gla mi dgos par der sdod bcug gi red/’’ces shod bzhin khog nang du 'brog pa 'di dag ni ci yang mi shes pa'i mi'i ri dwags rang red snyam nas khong dgod shor yang ha cang gzab brling yin pa'i tshul bstan/de nas kho gnyis ha rub sbar rub kyis dred lpags bshus shing tshe mgon gyis dred mkhris khyer/ dgo ba'i ro de khur/ dbang chen gyis dred lpags khur nas spang ri de las babs/tshe mgon gyis ‘‘khyod la re ba zhig zhu rgyur/ da res sde nang 'byor rjes grogs po khyed kyis dred mong de ngas bsad pa red ces bshad na 'grig e rjo snang rtse shag bar skor byang du yod pa'i bod rnying pa'i btson khang zhig gi ming /77

yong ’’zhes ha cang nyam thag pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/dbang chen gyis 6‘rgyu mtshan ci red ’’ces dris/tshe mgon gyis ‘‘de ltar ma bshad na um/ khyod kyis dred mong de bsad nas nga'i srog skyob pa red ces bshad na nga'i ab phrug de tshos rjes ma nga la 'phya smod byed kyi red/ lhag par du lha sar slebs rjes dred lpags dang dred mkhris dpon po gzhan la 'bul tshan 'bul skabs ri’dbang chen gyis tshe mgon gyi tshig mjug 'phrog ste/ ‘‘o/ ngas shes/grogs po khyed rang sems khral mi dgos/ ngas khyod kyis bsad pa red ces bshad chog khyod kyi re ba chung chung de 'dra zhig ngas khas len ma byas na grogs po ma red/ grogs po khyed sems khral mi dgos/ sems khral mi dgos ’’zhes shod kyin tshe mgon gyi phrag par bcag tsam byas/tshe mgon shin tu dga' bar gyur nas ‘‘nga'i mi tshe 'di'i nang khyed kyi drin lan 'jal ma thub na bu min/ che grogs chung grogs dang pho grogs mo grogs mang po yod kyang khyed las brtse ba gcig kyang med ’’ces 'ud gtam sna tshogs bshad/sde nang du slebs skabs mi tshang mas ma 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan bzhin mgo bo 'phred du g.yug nas ‘‘dred mong bsad nyan gyi ma red/ nga tsho'i yul gyi rgyab ri kha 'dzin can lha dge bsnyen gyi bzhon pa dred mong rag dkar gcig yod ’’zer/la las/ ‘‘dred mong de'i kha dog rag dkar min pas skyon yod kyi ma red ’’zer/dbang chen gyis kyang mi de dag gi skad cha'i rjes 'brang nas ‘‘dred mong de nag po yin pas skyon yod kyi ma red/ ma gzhi nas de ring ru dpon khong gis me mda' brgyab ste dred mong 'di ma bsad na nga de ring dred mong gis 78

bzas tshar ba yod ’’ces bshad/tshe mgon gyis ‘‘jo bo rin po/ dred mong de zhed snang 'dug stabs legs pa zhig la/ ngas me mdar rdzas mdel blugs te sbi sdir me sgron nas rgyag chog chog byas yod pas ma gtogs/ nga gnyis gnyis ka tshar song ’’zhes ngo tsha rgyab tu bskyur nas de ltar bshad/dbang chen gyis ‘‘dngos 'brel red/ khyod ni nga'i srog skyob drin can yin ’rizhes khong dgod shor bzhin du phyag 'bul zhig zhus/tshe mgon gyis 'gying nyams chen po'i sgo nas ‘‘ga pā/ ga pā/ ngas ma bsad na nga yang za gi red/ ma gzhi nas nged gnyis grogs po blos thub ma red pas ’rizhes mthe bong ker nas kun gyi 'dren byed kyi lam du bstan tsam dra/sa/kho'i lag 'og gi dmag mi tshos ‘‘a tsi/ dred mong de che ba la/’’‘‘dred mong de'i sru gra bkrag mdangs che ba la/’’‘‘dred mong de'i sbar mo che ba la’’‘‘ngas de ring ma gtogs dred mong mthong myong med/ dred mong la mjug ma thung thung gcig las mi 'dug’’‘‘ru dpon khyed dngos gnas gyong po 'dugang yin na 'di 'dra mthong ba tsam gyis dran med du brgyal rgyu gtan 'khel red/’’‘‘dngos 'brel red/ nga yin na mthong ba trem gyis skyag gcin gos thung nang du shor rgyu red ’’ces lab gleng sna tshogs byed kyin dred lpags steng gi mdel khung la mdzub mo btsugs/‘‘hwa hwa hwa ’’der yod mi tshang ma gad mo shor/dbang chen dang tshe mgon gnyis gcig ngo gcig la bltas te gad mo shor/de nas dred mong gi mkhris pa de sbra'i mchon thag gi steng du btags nas skam/ dred spags de lhas ra'i steng du bkal nas ‘‘sang nyin mnyed dgos ’’79

zer/dbang chen gyi bza' zla g.yang mo dang bcas pa'i bud med 'gas ‘‘dbang chen/ dred lpags de phar khyer dang / de lhas ra'i steng du bkal na nga tsho do dgong 'bri bzho bar 'gro nus sa ma red/’’zer/byis pa 'gas dred mong gi pags pa rkang lag 'byar ma de mthong bas ‘‘a tsi ’’zhes skad shor te phyogs gzhan zhig tu bros song /ma rabs kyi spyod par byang pa'i skye bo de dag re zhig ya rabs kyi tshul 'dzin yang rang gshis ngan pa bsgyur thub rgyu dka' mo red/nyin zhig bod dmag gcig nas chang gis rab tu myos te gom pa 'khyar 'khyor spo bzhin lhas ra'i nang 'bri bzho bzhin pa'i bud med rnams kyi phyogs su kha gtad de gcin pa gtong bzhin du/pags tshag rgon khra gon pa'i/ dman chung 'brog mo ngo mdzes/o o o lo chang gis bzi yang / chang gis bzi med/pags tshag drod mo'i nang du/nga la byams po byos dang / zhes 'chal glu btang bas bud med yongs ngo tsha la hang yang sang nas ‘‘a ma ma/ ltas ngan 'di tshor ngo tsha yang mi 'dug ’’ces skad chung ngus dmod kyin de phyogs su blta yang ma nus/yang nyin zhig dmag mi gcig gis nyin mo kha dkar ngo dkar la ngo tsha khrel dang bral nas chu 'gram na chu len bzhin pa'i g.yog mo gcig gan rkyal du brdab nas brla sha'i 'khri shing gi bar du btsan gyis 'dzul te btsan g.yem byed rtsis byas/ g.yog mo des skad rgyag bzhin rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab byed kyin phar rgol byas pas khrel zad de'i bsam don ma 'grub par khu ba dkar po 80

brla bar 'dzaga.a khyung tshang du gnas tshang g.yar ba'i dmag mi gcig gis nyin zhig a khyung la me mda' bskur nas ri ru ri dwags rngon par btang rjes a khyung gi chung mar chang ldud de bzi ru bcug nas log g.yem byas/gnas tshul de dag shes rjes dbang chen khong khro rab tu langs nas dmag mi ma rabs khrel med de dag sked gri rnon pos srog bkum nas sdug ro khyi la bster 'dod kyang re zhig ru dpon tshe mgon gyi ngo la bltas te khong khro'i sems gnan te ‘‘ru dpon lags/ deng skabs dmag mi 'ga' shas chang gis bzi nas bud med ’’tshe mgon gyis dbang chen gyi tshig mjug 'phrog nas ‘‘ga re/ kho tshos nga tsho g.yang phyug gi bud med la brnyas bcos byed kyi 'dug gam/ hung /mi ngan de tsho rgya yan du btang na de 'dra byed kyi red bsam byung ’’zhes gdan las langs te phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed bzhin khong khro rab tu langs pa'i zol gyis lag g.yon ma rked par gzer nas zhabs phyi skar ma 'gyur med skad btang nas ‘‘khyod rang song nas khong tsho khrid shog ngas de ring mi rer rta lcag rgya re ma gzhus na/ nga tshe mgon gyi ming ma 'bod/ de nas kho tsho da dung 'bor shob byed nus min blta dgos ’’zhes bka' phab/dbang chen brel 'tshab langs nas ‘‘de 'dra ma gnang / de 'dra ma gnang / khyed kyis kho tshor kha ta yag po byas te phyin chad gnas tshul de 'dra ma yong ba byas na 'grig gi red mi’ces bkagatshe mgon gyis rma rar byil tsam byas nas ‘‘'o na de ring ngas grogs po dbang chen gyi ngo la bltas te gzugs po'i nyes chad mi gcod/ 'on kyang nga rang gi dmag mi nga rang gis ma bcun na ga la 'grig phyir lha sar slebs rjes ngas dmag spyi khang la zhu thag chod yin ’’ zhes khu tshur sar brdab/81

stabs ma legs pa zhig la khu tshur rdo zhig gi steng du brdab pas na zug ma bzod par ‘‘a ru ru/ a ma'i ro ’’zhes skad ngan shor te khu tshur kha ru bcagade nas dmag mi de dag kho rang gi mdun du pus mo btsugs te bsdad/khos lag pa gnyis rked par gzer nas ‘‘khyod tsho sdug lcog nyon a/ yul g.yang phyug gi lung par ā/ khyod tshos khrims med lugs med byas na/ ā/lhag par du bud med dang byis par brnyas bcos byas na/ nga'i rta lcag la snying rje mi 'dug ma zer ā/ yul chu btung na yul khrims khur dgos pa shes kyi med pas/ hung mi’zhes yang khu tshur sa ru brdab/ da res khos ga ler spang 'jam po zhig gi steng du brdab pas na zug ma byung /denas mu mthud ‘‘ngas de ring grogs po dbang chen gyi khar nyan te ma gzhus pa ma gtogs/ hin/ de ring khyod tsho rkub khrag khyis ldag kyang ldag tshar gyi ma red ’’ces dmangs kyi rna ba'i thos sar dmag mi de dag la skyon brjod byed kyin lag g.yas pa'i nus shugs yod tshad bton te rta lcag nam mkhar 'phyar nas sa yi steng du lan gnyis gzhus te khong khro tshad med langs khul byas/de nyin dbang chen gyis dred lpags de mnyed rjes pags pa'i mthar 'byar ba'i sbar mo dang rkang pa bcad de dgun dus rta la bster na yag po yod snyam nas thag pa gcig gis bsdams nas mchon thag steng du btags/de'i skabs sbra'i nang du bza' zla g.yang mos ‘‘sku mkhyen/ sku mkhyen/de 'dra ma byed dang ’’zhes skad rgyag pa go bas ci yin nam snyam nas nang du 'dzul dus tshe mgon gyis g.yang mo'i lag par 'jus nas 'dugatshe mgon gyis lam seng g.yang mo'i lag pa glod de ‘‘un hwa hwa ngas rtsed mo um ’’zhes ngag dab dib cig las shod rgyu ma rnyed/dbang chen khong khro chen po langs kyang kha nas skad cha ma bshad par ngo 82

gdong nag rog ger thab 'gram du bsdad de sna tha sen mo gang blugs nas 'then gyin bsdad/bu dgra 'dul gyis gung zi gcig 'bud kyin yong nas ‘‘a pha ltos dang a khu skar ma 'gyur med kyis bzos pa red ri’zer/de nyin tshe mgon gyis dmag mi gsum po der skyon brjod byas pa nas bzung gnas tshul de rigs nyung du 'gro rgyu med pa ma zad mang du 'gro gi 'dugadamag mi kha shas kyis ri dwags rngon par kha g.yar te dzi bo bu mo mang por log g.yem byas pa'i gnas tshul yang mang po byung bas dbang chen gyis tshe mgon la ‘‘dmag mi 'di dag da lta zas kyis grod pa rgyags drags nas nga tsho'i rdzi bo 'gar btsan g.yem byas 'dug khyod kyis de dag gcun pa'i thabs yod na gcun tshod red 'dug de min na nga tsho'i mi rnams bzod sgom thub pa mi 'dug ’’ces 'u thug nas bshad/tshe mgon gyis ‘‘grogs po de 'dra ma zer/ thog mar ngas kho tsho mi rer rta lcag brgya re gzhu rtsis byas kyang / khyod kyis gzhu ru ma bcug skabs de dus mi rer rta lcag brgya re gzhus na ra bsad de lug 'dar du bcug pa'i dpe nang ltar red/ nga'i dmag mi 'di rnams rang gi chung ma dang bral nas lo phyed tsam 'gro gi 'dug pas ngo ma kho tsho yang khag mi 'dug rjes ma khyed rang lha sar slebs na ngas de'i rin du khyod rang la dbus pa'i bu mo sha mdog dkar la 'jam pa/ a tsi/ lha yi bu mo lta bu/ mthong ba tsam gyis khyod rang bzi nas 'gyel 'gro gi red/ hwa hwa ’’dbang chen khong khro'i me lce 'bar yang re zhig sems pa mnan te ‘‘nga tshos khyod tshor za 'thung gang ci'i thad 'dod blo ma skong ba med pas khyed nas bsam shes thub pa byed rogs ’’zhes bshad zhor du ru dpon tshe mgon la chang phor pa gang bster/83

tshe mgon gyis chang gtsang dag btung nas ‘‘dmag mi 'bangs kyi don du rang srog phangs med byed kyi yod pas/ 'bangs kyis kyang nga tshor bsam shes ma byas na ’’dbang chen tshe mgon gyi skad char nyan ma 'dod par sgor bud nas bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis btang /dgong mo nor 'dogs pa'i skabs dbang chen gyis g.yang phyug gi mi rgan gras rnams la deng skabs dmag mi 'di dag gis ja lan chu yis 'jal te nga tsho'i bu mo tshor brnyas bcos kho na byed kyin 'dug pas/ da thabs shes ma byas na nga tsho sdod bzod bde po mi 'dug ’’zer/gzhan rnams kyis ‘‘da nga tsho bzod thabs bral song bas kho tsho dang 'thab rgyu red ’’zer/mthar kho tsho gleng mol mang po byas mthar thabs shes 'di 'dra zhig rnyed pa ste phyi nyin sde stod smad bar gyi grong 'dabs kyi ne'u gsing gi steng du gur gcig phub/ de'i nang du gdan gang drag drag bting zhing sha chang gi gsol ston bshams/ gur dang bar thag gom pa brgya phrag gis chod pa'i sa na 'bri g.yag gi sog rus 'ga' 'ben la btsugs/ sde ba'i nang nas bdam bdam dkrug dkrug byas pa'i skyes pa bcu gnyis dang dmag mi bcu gnyis me mda' tsha kha 'gran rgyu byas/ sha chang la dga' ba'i dmag mi rnams dga' thag chod nas gur gyi nang du 'dus te spyang ltogs pa'i kha la sha thob pa ltar sha chang la hab thob brgyab/ru dpon tshe mgon gur gyi sbug tu bting pa'i dred lpags kyi gdan steng du bsdad de sma ra byil byil byed kyin gur nang gi mi tshang mar mig 'grim zhig byas te ‘‘nga tsho ma song ba'i sa cha med kyang / g.yang phyug las skyid pa'i sa char 'gro myong med la/ g.yang phyug gi mi rnams las 'dris gzhung bzang 84

pa'i mi thug myong med pas/ khrel med kyi las ka 'ga' byas na rkub la 'o brgyal bzos yong ngo / de dus 'gyod pa skyed kyang phyi drags pa red dā/sdug lag thung tsam dang sdug lcog ring tsam ma byas na nyo cha gzed yong ngo ’’zhes bshad kyin spos shel gyi sna ru gser gyi kha gcod can zhig bton te sna tha sen mo gang blugs rjes sna ru dbang chen la g.yar nas 'gying nyams bton/sde ba'i nang bdams pa'i skyes pa bcu gnyis kyis khong tshor chang drangs shing sha tig btubs te sbyin/ khong tsho'i am phrag tu rno dbal gyi ngar chu ldud pa'i rum gri re bcug nas yod pa dmag mi tshos ga la shes/ dmag mi rnams nas chang gis cung myos rjes nges par du chang zhu mkhan bu mo dgos zhes bshad/dbang chen gyis kho tshos de ltar shod nges red snyam ste snga sa nas bu mo na chung rgyan bzang gis spud pa 'ga' gra sgrig byas yod pas de dag skad btang nas chang zhu ru bcugadamag mi rnams nas chang gis myos shing 'dod sred kyis bzir te/na chung tshos chang phor 'degs skabs mig hrig hrig gis blta ba dang / chang phor len pa'i skabs dang bstun nas na chung tsho'i sor mor byil byil byas/dbangachen gyis ‘‘da sngon la nga tshos me mda' tsha kha 'gran na ji 'dra 'dug ’’ces ru dpon tshe mgon la gros 'dri ba'i tshul gyis brjod/tshe mgon gyis ‘‘de rang red/ de ring skyid po zhe drag 'dug khyod tshos sdug lcog yag po nyon ā/ rjes su g.yang phyug gi mi su 'dra zhig yin rung lha sar slebs na nges par du snang rtse shag tu gnas tshang g.yar thabs byed dgos red/ ma red pas hwa hwa hwa mi’zhes bshad/dmag mi tshos ‘‘de rang red/ hwa hwa hwa’’zhes 'ur brgyab/de nas dmag mi rnams kyis me mda' thogs nas gur las don te ru sa la btsugs shing sbi sdi'i du ba sngo 'phyur rer 'ben la gzes/85

bud med dang byis pa tshos sor mo'i yal 'dab kyis rna ba'i bu ga bkag ste phyogs der blta ba'i spobs pa med par phyogs gzhan zhig tu bros nas yib/‘‘twa/ twa/ twa/ ’’dmag mi tshos me mda' brgyab rjes khong tshos ‘‘dpe red/ dpe red/'o tsi/ nga tshos 'gran nus pa mi 'dug lhan rgyas yar phebs yar phebs ’’zhes slar gur nang du bsus te sha chang drangs/da gzod kho tsho'i me mda'i nang du rdzas mdel med pas go skabs yag po 'di shor mi rung snyam nas mdang nub gros 'cham pa'i gsang brda ste/dbang chen gyis ‘‘lhan rgyas spro po yong ched ngas skad snyan po med kyang rten 'brel mtshon byed du glu zhig blangs na rung ngam ’mizer bas tshang mas ‘‘de yag po 'dug khyod kyis glu yag po zhig thongs dang / nga tshos nyan ’’zer ba ༵nga / dbang chen gyis mgrin pa gzengs su gtod de glu blangs par/a wa loge.e ma rong da nga dang po byis pa yin dus su/skar g.yo sgyu che ba ma shes pas/skar khra khra de la sems pa shor/gsal nyi ma mkha' la 'char ba'i dus/dgung a sngon gyis nga la mgo skor btang /nga dang po byis pa yin dus su/spang g.yo sgyu che ba ma shes pas/spang me tog gnyis la sems pa shor/dgun grang ngar yul la slebs pa'i dus/86

sa dog mos nga la mgo bskor btang /zhes glu mjug rdzogs pa dang dus mnyam sde ba'i nang nas bdam pa'i skyes pa tshos rno ngar gyi rum gri bton te dmag mi re'i steng du mi re mchong nas thong ga las dam par bzung zhing mig 'bur tshugs su bltas te ‘‘khyod tshos khrims med lugs med kyis ja lan chu yis 'jal ba'i lan pa 'di yin ’rizhes ngar skad bsgrags/bud med dang byis pa rnams ‘‘a ma ma ’’zhes phyi ru bros/ dmag mi de dag da gzod nas chang gis myos pa las dwangs te ‘‘sku mkhyen/ sku mkhyen/tshe thar gtong rogs ’’zhes zhu ba yang yang 'then pa las 'phag 'tshag rgyag pa'i spobs pa dang bral/de nas snga sa nas gra sgrig byas pa'i skyes pa gzhan rnams kyis rtsid thag ring po 'ga' khyer 'ong nas ma rungs sdug pa can gyi dmag mi de dag gi dpung pa'i 'khri shing dang bgrod byed kyi rkang pa phyin ci log par byas te ril ril gru gu 'dra bar dam por bcings shing lus la btags pa'i 'dogs rgyan dang am phrag nang gi dngos po yongs 'phrogaril ril gru gu ltar bcings pa'i dmag mi de dag na zug gi sdug bsngal myong bzhin 'o dod 'byin/ la la'i kha nas lbu ba dkar po 'phyur/ la la'i ngo gdong phu btab pa ji bzhin skrangs/ la la'i 'doms dang rkub las phyi sa dang dri chu dbang med du shor nas brlan par bzos shing dri ngan gang sar khyab/skyug bro ba'i tshul de dag mthong bas kun gyis 'phya smod kyi gad mo lhang lhang shor zhing phu dung gis sna bkab/—de ni spyir btang gi dgod sgra zhig min par/ de ni ma rungs sdug pa can gyi mi spyang rdul du brlag pa'i dgod sgra red/ de ni rgyal kha thob pa'i dgod sgra red/ de ni dgod sgra ma yin glu dbyangs te/ ma rungs khrel zad 87

cham la phabs pa'i glu dbyangs red/ de ni rgyal kha thob pa'i glu dbyangs red/dgod sgra dang glu sgra nam mkha'i dbyings su khyab/ lung pa'i phu mdar khyab ste phyogs bzhi'i sa 'dzin gyi phreng ba las brag ca lhang lhang 'khor/g.ya' dag pa'i nam mkha' sngar bas dwangs par gyur/ mkha' dbyings su bya thang dkar re zung gis gshog rtsal ngom bzhin lding bskor rgyag gi 'dug de'ang phal cher khong tsho'i rgyal kha'i dga' ston gyi byed sgor ltad mo lta ba yin la ma rungs mi spyang de dag gi sha khrag longs su spyod 'dod pa'ang yin shas che/tsha zer can gyi khri gdugs kyi nyi ma de nub phyogs chu lha'i phang bar bgrod pa'i sta gon byas/ mtha' yas pa'i sngo ljang gi rtswa thang yangs por 'jam rlung bsil bu ldang zhing rdzi bo'i glu dbyangs sde ba dang bar thag je nye dang je nye/ri byi'u rnams kyang rang gnas su log pa'i dus la slebs nas gshog zung brkyangs te 'phur lding gi gar stabs bsgyur/der 'dus dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi las la dpa' ba'i skye bo rnams sha chang gi ston mo dang glu gar gyi rgyun da dung ma chad par rgan rabs rnams nas chang gi nying khur rol te gtam gleng byed/ gzhon nu pho mo yongs dga' spro'i rnam pa'i khrod du dga' ba'i dga' bro brdung / skyid pa'i skyid glu blangs/dmag mi de dag na zug gis dmyal ba myong bzhin 'o dod 'byin gyin ngo gdong mchin pa skam po'i mdog tu gyur/ tshe mgon gyis mig gyen du cer nas ‘‘nga nga tshe thar gtong rogs/ nga rang gis byung ma song da nas bzung yag yag po gcun gyi yin/khyod khyod tshor khag mi 'dug nga rang gis byung byung ma song / sku mkhyen sku mkhyen nga nga tshe thar gtong rogs/ grogs grogs grogs po dbang chen 88

sku mkhyen nga gnyis kyi mdza' bshes ma dor bar nga glod dang ’’zhes ngu ngag gis bshad/dbang chen gyis gtsos pa'i rgan pa rnams kyis ‘‘nga tshos khyod tshor nyin gsum rer lug re dang zla phyed rer 'bri g.yag re bshas te gces phrug ltar bskyangs/ bla ma ltar bskur yang khyod tsho'i 'dod blo ma khengs par chang med pa'i 'khang ra byas/ nga tshor nas de tsam gyis mang po med kyang khyod tsho'i 'dod blo bskong ched chang 'dzad med bsnyal te drangs kyang da dung 'dod blo ma khengs par mthar bud med la brnyas bcos byas pa sogs las ngan sha stag brtsams pa'i las 'bras 'khor ba red/’’tshe mgon gyis mgo bo yar bkyag ste ‘‘khyod tshos gsungs pa de de rang red/ khyed rnams la thugs khag med mi mi bzo dgu bzo byed mkhan nga'i ab phrug khyi'i khyi'i bzo 'dra 'di tsho yin/ a ma'i ro lha sar slebs rjes ngas ngas kho tsho tshang ma dmag dmag spyi khang la rtsis sprad de dmar gsod gtong gi yin ’’zhes kho rang glod bkrol thob thabs kyis de ltar bshad/dbang chen gyis 'gying nyams chen po'i sgo nas tshe mgon gyi 'gram du phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed kyin du ‘‘dmag spyi khang zhes pa nga la rgyus med/ khyod tsho dmar gsod gtong mkhan nga tsho g.yang phyug gi mi las su yod/ khyod tsho'i bsam par 'brog pa zhes pa de rnams nyam chung nus med cig red/ der brnyas bcos ga tshod byas kyang khe bzang rag gi red bsam pa ni rbad de nor ba red ri’ces bshad pa dang mjug tu ‘‘hwa hwa hwa ’’zhes gad mo chen po zhig bgad/de 'phral dmag mi tshang mas 'u thug thabs zad ngang /‘‘sku mkhyen/ nga ma gsod rogs/ ngas gang yang byas med/’’89

‘‘nga bsad na nga'i bza' zla dang phru gu tshang ma brten sa med/’’‘‘khyod tshos sdig pa de 'dra bsags na las rgyu 'bras la 'gro gi ma red/’’‘‘nga'i khyim du da dung pha rgad po gcig yod/ nga bsad na pha rgan gso mkhan med/ri’‘‘nga tshe thar gtong rogs/’’‘‘tshe thar gtong rogs ’rizhes ngu ngag gis 'bod/g.yang phyug gi skyes pa tsho khong khro sngar bas che bar langs te ‘‘hung / nga tshor thabs shes mi 'dug nga tsho sdig las kho nar bsam mkhan min yang nga tsho bzod sgom thub pa mi 'dug ma gzhi mi 'dre khyod tshos sa cha gang du slebs kyang spyod ngan kho na spel gyi yod pa gtan 'khel red/ khyod tsho'i srog bcad na 'jig rten yongs la phan pa'i las bzang red/ mi ngan khyod tsho da nas bzung gshog pa ldan yang 'phur sa med/ sder mo rno yang 'dzul sa med/da res khyed tshos nga tshor rta dang me'i 'phrul mda' mang po 'di 'dra gnang bar thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin hwa hwa hwa ririzhes bzhad dgad long long du gnas/dbang chen gyis lo na bgres pa rnams phyogs gzhan zhig tu bsdus nas ‘‘tshe mgon kho'i zhabs phyi skar ma 'gyur med ces pa de mi tshul ldan zhig 'dug pas de gcig pu glod bkrol btang na ga 'dra 'dug ’’ces gros dris par gzhan rnams kyis ‘‘gcig btang na tshar ba red/ khos rjes su dmag mi de las mang ba khrid de dgra sha len par yong gi red/ da res mi gcig kyang tshe thar gtong mi rung ’’zer/'dod tshul der gnas lugs 'dug bsam nas dbang chen mgu ba'i brda la mgo bo lcog lcog byas/dgong mo rdzi bo rnams phyugs lhas su bcug zin pa dang der yong nas blta rub brgyab/90

‘‘thu/ skyag dri bro gi 'dug’’‘‘rna ring de'i kha nas khrag don gyi 'dug’’‘‘rgya bo de'i mig ril g.yas pa phyi la don 'dug’’twetwesna nyag’ sdo shi grabs 'dug’’dgong zas bzas rjes sde ba'i nang gi skye bo che chung pho mo tshang ma ne'u gsing gi gzhir 'dus te lci ba'i me spung chen po zhig spar/ 'ur 'ur du 'bar ba'i me lce dgung son du 'phyar zhing me 'od kyis phyogs bzhi mtshams ching ༄༄ brgyad dmar lhang lhang du 'phros/ yul gyi rgyab ri dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo zhes bya ba shel dkar gyi mchod rten la co 'dri ba'i gangs dkar gyi lhun po de'ang me 'od kyi mdangs 'phros te gangs ri dmar po zhig tu gyur/me spungs kyi mtha' nas gzhon nu pho mo yis bskor te lag gdang sbrel te sgor sgor mo'i bro gar 'khrab/khong tshos 'khrab pa'i bro gar gyi gzhas tshig ni 'dri 'dra ste/steng phyogs lha la lha 'khrug mi yong le/lha chen tshangs pa dkar po grogs la byon/bar phyogs mi la mi 'khrug mi yong le/mi bo ge sar rgyal po grogs la byon/'og phyogs klu la klu 'khrug mi yong le/klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen grogs la byon/rgan 'khogs rnams zhim mngar ja chang gi bro ba myong bzhin gtam gleng gi rgyun ma chad/dmag mi bcu gnyis sdug bsngal gyi 'o dod 'bod kyin tshe thar gtong rogs zhes ngu 'bod byas/91

dgung sngon g.ya' dag pa'i me long ji bzhin dwangs/ rgyu skar gyi tshogs khra tshom tshom du gnas/ phyogs bzhi'i ri las skabs re 'ug pa'i skad dang skyi g.ya' ba'i wa mo'i skad re gnyis grags 'ong /de nas dbang chen gyis ja phor pa gang mthon por btegs te ‘‘tshang mas mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis rgyab ri kha 'dzin can/ srung ma myur mgyogs can/ dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mor ja mchod 'bul dgos ’’zhes kun gyi thos 'dzin dbang po'i lam du bsgrags/ de'i tshe skye bo pho mo rgan gzhosatshang mas rang rang gi ja phor lag tu blangs shing mthon por btegs te rgyab ri dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mor kha phyogs te mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis/bso bso/ rgyab ri kha 'dzin can/srung ma myur mgyogs can/dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo'i zhal la mchod/mi pho 'dra 'dra'i nang la/mgo rmog dkar gang gis mtho bar shogarta pho 'dra 'dra'i nang las/lag srab mda' gang gis mgyogs par shogabaso bso/grogs mi kha la yod tshad rang kha/dgra rang yul la yod tshad gzhan yul/phar 'gro skyabs kyi skyel ma/tshur yong skyabs kyi bsu ma/mchod/ mchod/ mchod/ dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo'i zhal la mchod/92

ces phor ba'i nang gi ja dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo'i phyogs su mchod par byas/mi rnams kyi skad gsang mthon po'i gyer dbyangs kyi sgra de dag yul gyi mdun phyogs su drag tu rgyug pa'i dal 'bab g.yang chu'i sgra dang 'dres te yun ring bar phyogs bzhir grags/'jam rlung bsil bu zhig gis mi rnams kyi sna lam du bzod dka' ba'i khrag dri zhig gang sar khyab pas tshang ma ya mtshan skyed de ‘‘ci red/ ci red/khrag dri zhig bro gi 'dug ’’ces sna phu dung gis bkab/de'i dus ma rungs mi spyang de dag dal 'bab g.yang chur bskyur te nam yang gsal nyi ma'i 'od mthong rgyu med pa zhig bzo dgos bsam nas de dag gi phyogs su song bas na/ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la ma rungs mi spyang de dag tshang ma'i kha nas zung khrag dmar chil chil du 'phyur gyin lnga pa'i lam du song zin 'dugadabang chen gyis gtsos pa'i mi mang pos da res rgyab ri dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo'i gzhi bdag lha dge bsnyen gyis mgo'i gser rmog la dar 'phru'i gtsug phud kyis rgyan zhing mdung ring phyag tu thogs te bzhon pa dred rag dkar gra lo nyil ba gcig la bcibs nas mi tshogs kyi dkyil du phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas rjes ma rungs mi srin de dag gi phyogs su phebs pa mngon gsum mjal byung zhes thal mo sbyar te dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo'i phyogs su phyag yang yang btsal/de nas skyes pa tshos mi 'dre de dag gi ro drag tu rgyug pa'i dal 'bab g.yang chur bskyur rjes lag pa gtsang mar bkrus te slar dgong tshogs kyi spro skyid la rol/de'i skabs mi mang pos rang khyim las mar dkrog mang po blangs te me 93

spungs kyi nang du g.yug pas me spungs de 'bar shugs sngar bas che ru song nas me lce dgung du 'phyur/phyi nyin dbang chen gyi thabs dang jus bkod kyis ma rungs pa de dag tshar bcad pa'i dpa' ba'i dpa' rtags la mi tshang mas kho'i mthe bong gnyis ka mar dkar gyis yang yang byug ①ste kun gyis bsngags brjod byas shing dbang chen yul gyi sde dpon la bdams nas dred lpags kyi steng du mnga' gsol te 'bangs kyis kho'i mgul la dar dkar yang yang bsgron/dkar zhing gtsang ba'i dar dkar nar mo re re ni lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sems pa re re mtshon pa las bkra shis pa'i mtshon tshul tsam ga la yin/sde dpon dbang chen gyis ja phor gang btung nas sma ra byil tsam byas te rang re g.yang phyug ste g.yang sde phyug mo 'di sngar bas g.yang chags cing phyug po yong ched/ mes po'i dus nas dar ba'i srol bzang rgyun 'dzin gyis rgan rabs la bkur zhing chung bar gces skyong gis las la brtson pa byas te rang re'i sde ba 'di kun gyis 'gran zla med pa zhig yong bar byed dgos bsgrags/de'i tshe sde ba'i nang yul phyogs mang por 'gro myong zhing blta rgya mthong rgya che shos kyi bgres song nyi ma 'bum zhes pa mgo skyes thor lcog tu bcings pa sde ba'i nang yi ge shes mkhan gcig rang yod pa des bkra shis mtshon byed du kho rang gis shes pa'i bod yig gsal byed sum cu ka nas a bar skad gsang mthon po'i sgo nas thengs gcig bklags/dman chung bu mo rgyan bzang gis spud pa khag gcig gis chang phor lag tu bzung nas sde dpon dbang chen gyis gtsos pa'i bgres song nyi ma 'bum ze rjo ོbyadwasags rnyi yul 'dir gna' dus su byas rjes che ba'i mi la mthe bong mar dkar gyis brgyan te ga /)dī bstad da la da/

sogs bzhugs gral gyi steng du 'khod pa'i mi rnams la glu blangs par/nga'i lag gi kha btags dkar gtsang 'di/dus de ring 'go 'dren khyed la 'bul/'dis khyod la bkra shis bde legs zhu/nga'i lag gi bdud rtsi sil ma 'di/dus de ring 'go 'dren khyed la 'bul/'dis khyod la brtse dung zab mo mtshon/nga'i ngag gi 'gyur khug glu dbyangs 'di/dus de ring 'go 'dren khyed la 'bul/'dis khyod la tshe ring lo brgya zhu/de nas bo'u bcu gnyis yod pa de dag nang du pho gzhon dang / sgo ru 'do ba rta mchog yod pa'i dud khyim bcu gnyis la bgos/ rgyab ri dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo'i gzhi bdag dge bsnyen gyi phyag mtshan mdung ring de'i mdung dar dmar po yin pas khyim tshang so sor bgo bsha' thob pa'i bo'u yi rwa la ru dar dmar po brgyab/nyin zhig sde dpon dbang chen gyis yun ring ma bkrus pa'i mgo skyes snum dreg gis ral par gyur pa dag bkrol te gtsang mar bkrus rjes khyim sbug tu dred gdan de'i steng du dkyil krung du bsdad de bo'u khra ring gnam lcags lag tu blangs te nyams 'gyur ldan pa'i sgo nas phyis tsam byas nas ‘‘byang rigs kyi yul 'dir nga tsho las stobs 'byor che ba yod mi srid ri’ces chig lab shor/'o ma skyid dus yun ring po zhig mtshan mo re re bzhin skyi g.ya' ba'i wa mo'i ngu skad dang 'jigs su rung ba'i 'ug pa'i skad kyi khrod du gnyid sos bde ba thengs gcig kyang khug myong med mod/ do dgong 'jigs skrag gi rgyab rtsa 95

dbang chen pha bu gnyis yod pas skad cha bshad 'dod dang nyan 'dod kyi spro ba rab tu 'phel zhing lus kyi khrag dron rgyas te ‘‘de nas ga re byas pa ras/ mu mthud shod dang ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘rjes ma bshad chog da nam phyed zin grabs 'dug pas nga gnyid kyis gzir gyi 'dug ’’zer nas nyal gos yar 'then te mgo btum/‘‘tog tsam shod dang / ngas khyod kyi gnas tshul de tsho nyan 'dod chen po 'dug ’’zer bzhin tsha drod kyis ma bzod par sked pa yan chad mal chas las don te lag zung ltag rgyab tu bzhag nas nyal/‘‘sang nyin bshad na mi 'grig gam ’’zhes dbang chen gyis nyal gos kyi mgo btum phyes nas blta dus dgung kheb dhilas 'phros pa'i dkar gsal zla ba'i 'od 'o ma skyid kyi gzugs po'i steng du 'phros nas yod pas dkar zlum gyi 'o 'dzin zung gangs ri'i mu khyud kyi steng du 'bur du thon pa'i gtor gzugs kyi gangs ri'i rtse mo dang mtshungs/khos ga ler rang gi mal chas las don te rkang 'jab lag 'jab kyis song ste 'o ma skyid kyi rum du 'dzul nas skad chung ngus ‘‘khyod do dgong gnyid mi khug pa ci red ’’ces 'o ma skyid kyi brla sha'i 'khri shing la byil byil byas/‘‘nga do dgong nyal rogs yod pas skrag gi mi 'dug’’‘‘zla 'od 'di gsal ba la āng /’’‘‘tog tsam sgug zla 'od gsal drags pas ’ri‘‘ma phur dang nga nga ’’‘‘um/ um/ um/’’du dgung kheb ces pa ni sbra'i steng du yod pa'i du ba 'gro sa'i dkar khung la zer/96

dkar gsal gyi zla ba de yang ngo tsha nas blta ba'i spobs pa dang bral nas sprin nag gi yol ba'i phag tu yib nas sbra'i nang du mig gi mdun du mdzub mo lnga yang mi mthong bar gyur/'o ma skyid kyis dbang chen kyi mjing par 'khyud de 'o zhig bskyal/dbang chen gyis 'o ma skyid kyi nu mar phur gyin du 'o ma skyid kyis dbang chen la yang 'o zhig sbyar nas ‘‘um um ga ler byos dang ’’de nas dbang chen gyis lag myul byed kyin ga ler song nas rang gi mal chas su 'dzul te gnyid khugaphyi nyin zhogs zas bzas rjes dgra 'dul kha seng kho gnyis kyi sdod gnas su mkho byed rnams len par song /dbang chen gyis 'o ma skyid la ‘‘de ring ngas sha bzan gcig bsha' dgos/ khyod yun ring po de 'dra spyang kis rmug pa'i zas 'phro las za ma myong bas za 'dod yod kyi red ’’zer nas zhags pa gcig khyer te song nas lug khyu'i nang bdam bdam dkrug dkrug byas pa'i sha bzan gcig bzung nas sbra'i chon thag gi phur par btags/ sha bzan des rang nyid de ring bsha' rgyu yin pa shes te ‘‘sba sba ’’zhes skad rgyag gin lug khyu'i phyogs su bltas te dus yun skar cha tsam yang mi sdod par phur par bskor gyin de las thar thabs byas/dbang chen gyis rang gi ske la btags pa'i ga'u chung chung de'i nang nas byin rlabs cung zad cig phor pa'i nang du chu yis sbang rjes kha nas ma ṇi 'don gyin lug de'i kha nang du blugs/ lug despo re zhig bdud rtsi kha la rag pa ltar kha ldag lce ldag byed kyin rang sar langs nas dbang chen la bltas nas 'dug pas dbang chen gyis sems su snying rje drag po zhig skyed de ‘‘a tsi/lug 'dis ci bsam gyi yod dam ’’zhes chig lab cig brgyab rjes rang dbang 97

med par khong 'dar shor/khos ga ler lug de'i 'khris su song nas 'gram par byil byil byas kyang lug de da gin ltar gyong po med par mi la 'dris te mgo yar btegs te kho'i ngo gdong la blta bzhin gzugs po'i gang sar snom pa dang lag pa'i steng du ldag tsam byas pas dbang chen gyis bsha' ma nus par ‘‘we/ 'o ma skyid/'o ma skyid ’’ces thengs gnyis bos/'o ma skyid kyis mgo sbra sgo las phyir don te ‘‘ā ’’zer/‘‘lug 'di ngas bsha' nus pa mi 'dug’’‘‘ci red/ri’‘‘khyod kyis ltos dang da gin byin rlabs de blud dus zhim snang byed pa ma zad de nas bzung mi la rbad de 'dris 'dug ’’ces bshad kyin lug de'i og mar byil byil byas pas lug de da gzod 'drogs rgyu lta ci ha cang zhi dul gyis mig gnyis kyang zim zim du gyur nas ldad rgyag bzhin 'dug pas 'o ma skyid kyang snying rje skyed de ‘‘'o na ma bsha' glod gtong ’’zer/‘‘yā yā/ lug de ya nga po 'dug ri’ces dbang chen gyis thag pa bkrol te glod grabs byed dus 'o ma skyid kyis sbra'i nang nas ‘‘tog tsam ma glod dang ’’zhes skad brgyab byung /dbang chen gyis ‘‘'dre mo 'dis ci zer ba yin nam ’’zhes kher lab rgyag bzhin lug de'i sker btags pa'i thag sne rang gi lag pas bzung nas sbra'i nang du yar bltas te ‘‘ci zer ba yin ’’zhes dris/'o ma skyid kyis skud pa dkar dmar khra gsum gyi sne sbrel bzhin du ‘‘lug de ya nga po 'dug de tshe thar gtong zhes ’’zer/de nas dbang chen gyis lug de'i mgo las bzung zhing 'o ma skyid kyis lug de'i am lcog gnyis por skud pa dkar dmar dang ras 'dzar dkar 98

dmar gyi rna cha brgyab/ de nas rwa co gnyis dang ngo gdong la mar gyis rgyan rjes dbang chen gyis rdo log gcig gi steng du mchil ma btab ste btsag rdo dmar po zhig brdar te lug de'i gnya' nas mjug ma'i bar dang dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi bal gyi steng btsag dmar gyis rgyan te ‘‘thar thar thar tshe thar/ tshe thar ’’zhes kha g.yang sgrog nas lug de'i ske yi thag pa bkrol nas lug khyu'i phyogs su btang /nyi ma phyed yol tsam la dgra 'dul phyir slebs/ rngon khyi lnga sbra'i sgo 'dabs su nyal nas 'dugadabang chen gyis ja khug de las ja sbar mo gang blangs te ‘‘de ring mdong mo yang yod pas ja zhim po zhig 'thung dgos ’’zhes bshad de ja bskol/khyim gyi g.yon phyogs kyi sbug gi pags gdan gyi steng du dbang chen bsdad/ de'i 'og tu bu dgra 'dul bsdad/ g.yas phyogs kyi sbug tu 'o ma skyid bsdad de ja blugs pa dang thab nang du lci ba rgyag pa bal skud 'khel ba bcas kyis bkra shis mtshon pa'i shis tshig gang yang med kyang khyim tshang gsar pa zhig chags pa mtshon gyi yod/dbang chen gyis bo'u de pang du bzhag nas phyi nang yongs gtsang mar phyis te sbra'i phub kar gyi steng du bcings nas sna tha sen mo gang blugs/ de'i skabs 'o ma skyid kyis khor ja phor yang yang btegs pas kho'i sems su dga' skyo zung du 'brel ba'i rjes dran zhig dran shes kyi me long ngor rang dbang med par ngang gis shar/dbang chen yul g.yang phyug gi sde dpon la bkod rjes bgres song nyi ma 'bum gyis ‘‘yul g.yang phyug g.yang gi gzhong pa red/ dpon dbang chen dbu 'phang dgung las mtho/ thog ngar ma 'dra ba'i bo'u zhig khur/ bya thang dkar 'dra ba'i rta zhig bzhon/ 'brug pho stong ma gtogs skrag sa med/99

yul g.yang phyug mi sde gang skyid red/ chu thur du rgyug tshad nged tsho'i red/rtswa gyen la 'tshar tshad nged tsho'i red/ rtswa pho thur bcag na gser gyis 'jal/rtswa mo thur bcag na dngul gyis 'jal ’’zhes gzhas shig brtsams/ gzhas de rim gyis khyim mtshes kyi sde tsho yongs la khyab pas khyim mtshes sde tsho de dag gi mi la la yul g.yang phyug la yid smon skyed/ la la phrag dog gis nyi ma 'khyol dka' bar gyur/g.yang phyug tsho pa'i shar phyogs su gnas pa'i zla thang tsho pa'i btsan rgod kha sho zhes bya ba sgo zog dang khyim chas gang thad nas kyang khyim tshang 'bring ba'i tshad las brgal te tsho pa'i nang 'byor pa ang dang po gnyis par slebs pa'i pho hreng zhig yod/ kho rang kha sho nas ya so gnyis phyir don pas ming yang btsan rgod kha sho zer/ lus khams kyi skyon cha de'i dbang gis nye 'khor gyi bu mo gcig gis kyang kho la ya byed kyi med stabs kho'i pha ma gnyis kyi sems su rang gi bu gcig pu 'di lus khams kyi skyon cha de'i dbang gis mi tshe gcig pho hreng la lus nyen 'dug snyam nas de sngon yul lung gzhan nas sprang mo gcig khrid yong nas sde ba'i nang ma slebs gong chu 'gram du mgo nas mjug bar gtsang mar bkrus rjes khyim mtshes kyis ma shes par byas te chu 'gram de rang du tshar slog sram shan dang spang gdan 'ja' ris can gyis rgyan cha spras shing mgo skyes kyi lan bur g.yu byur dang spos shel gyis mdzes par rgyan nas khrid yong yang btsan rgod kha sho'i ngo gdong 'jigs su rung ba de mthong bas bu mo rang nyid ji ltar rgyu nor gyis dbul yang khyo bo kha chag sna ral can zhig dang mnyam du 'tsho ba skyel 'dod med pas nyin gnyis pa'i mtshan mo mgo skyes kyi lan bu'i steng gi g.yu byur dang spos shel blangs te nyal sar bzhag nas bros phyin pa red/sprang mo zhig khrid yong yang ya ma byas par bros phyin par brten da ni bya thabs mi 'dug snyam nas pha ma gnyis yid thang chad/ sprang mo de btsan rgod 100

kha sho'i sa nas bros te g.yang phyug tu slebs nas dbang chen tshang gi g.yog mo byas te bsdad/ mo gzugs bzang zhing ngo gdong mdzes pa dang las ka hur zhing gshis rgyud 'jam pa sbyin bdag la lhag bsam rnam par dag pas dbang chen gyi pha ma gnyis nas bu la mna' ma len ran yod pas yul gzhan zhig nas rgyu 'gro btang ste bu mo gcig khrid yong ba las g.yog mo 'di mna' ma byas na bzang zer nas g.yog mo de dbang chen gyi mna' ma byas/ don du dbang chen gyi sems su yang de rang yod pas ngo ma ‘‘mi'i bsam sar rta rgyug ’’ces pa'i dpe rang byung /g.yog mo de'i ming thog mar nag bdag zer/ mo dbang chen gyi mna' ma byas rjes ming de snyan po mi 'dug snyam nas bgres song nyi ma 'bum gyis g.yang phyug la slebs pa'i sprang mo yin pa'i don dang ldan par g.yang mo zhes ming btags/phyi lor g.yang mo la khye'u yid du 'ong ba gcig skyes pa ni da lta pho lo lnga gsum bco lngar song ba'i bu dgra 'dul zhes pa de red/don de'i dbang gis zla thang gi btsan rgod kha sho thog mar mna' ma ma rnyed pa'i sems sdug de mthar mna' ma gzhan yul du bros pa'i khong khror gyur te mo nang zas mi rnyed rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ dgong zas mi rnyed ri bo'i rtser 'khyam yang nged tshang gis lus tsha ru pags tshag gis rgyan/ mgo shig dang sro ma las med pa la g.yu dang byu ru spos shel gyis rgyan yang skyid mi 'dod sde mthar 'khyam nas 'gro 'dod nas song yang song / lus gos med gcer bur shi ste ro de yang khyis za ba shog ces dmod tshig bor/ 'on kyang sprang mo de yul g.yang phyug gi bu dbang chen gyi mna' mar gyur te khye'u yid du 'ong ba gcig kyang btsas pa'i ‘‘gtam ngan ’’de go nas tshig pa 'brong la za yang mgo lcag rta la gzhus zhes pa'i dpe ltar thog mar sprang mo der bcangs pa'i khong khro 101

de dbang chen la 'khon lan slog rgyu'i zhe sdang la 'gyur te nyin mang po gri brdar nas dbang chen dang dmar 'dzing byed 'dod kyang sde ba'i nang kho la gdung sems mnyam skyed kyis rogs pa byed mkhan med pas da bar lus/mi lo bcu lhag phyin rjes zhe sdang de da dung 'jags med la kho la mna' ma'i ming tsam med par pha ma gnyis kyang rim gyis grongs te kho rang gcig pur lus/mtshan mo kha shas khos kha sho'i steng du spags kyis lhan te lug gi lhas mthar nyal ba'i bu mo 'ga'i rum du 'dzul te 'dod pa spyod rgyu byung yang gzig lpags bkab pa'i bong bu de/ lo tog bzas mthar gzhan gyis bsad ces pa'i dpe ltar ring min lhas mtha'i bu mo tshos btsan rgod kha shos spags lhan brgyab nas rum nang du 'dzul yong ba shes te khor ya byed mkhan ma byung /de yang nyin zhig gi mtshan mo kho rang gcig pu dgong zas bzas rjes spags rdog cig g.yos te khar lhan rjes khyim mtshes kyi g.yog mo gcig lug lhas kyi mthar nyal yod pa de'i sar song nas slog pa'i gong ba las 'then/bu mo des ‘‘de 'dra ma byed dang / khyod rang su yin/ nga nga nyal ’’zhes gnyid sad la ma sad kyis de ltar bshad/btsan rgod kha shos ‘‘nga nga don bzang yin/’’ (don bzang ni g.yog mo de'i dga' rogs yin ) zhes rdzun bshad pas bu mo des de mar rum kha phyes te kho rum nang du bsus/ kho 'dod chags kyis rab tu myos te bu mo der kha yang bskyal bas bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la spags kyi lhan pa lhung ste rdzun rkub brdol bas bu mo de zhed nas ‘‘a ma ’’zhes skad shor/ ‘‘pha ro za rgyu de su red ’’ces don bzang gis rked gri 'phyar te gsod rtsis byas/ btsan rgod ngo tsha dang 'jigs skrag gis ma bzod par bu mo de'i rum las don te gcer bu mar bros/ de nas bzung kho'i rdzun mthil brdol pas kho la ya byed mkhan ma byung bas g.yang phyug sde ba'i dbang chen la bcangs 102

pa'i zhe sdang de sngar bas che bar gyur te dbang chen dmar gsod btang nas g.yang mo 'phrog rgyu'i bsam ngan bcangs kyang re zhig 'di 'o snyam pa'i thabs bzang po zhig ma rnyed pas yid thang chad de gnas skor la song /kho yul las gīs khar byis pa rdzi bo gcig brgyud de dbang chen la ‘‘yul g.yang phyug gi dbang chen dang sprang mo nag bdag (g.yang mo ) gnyis la dgra btsan rgod kha sho yod pas skyid nyi ma gcig kyang mthong yong ma bsam zhig ’’ces kha lan bskur bas g.yang mo nyin mang po blo ma bde bar gyur nas ‘‘bsod skam ngas khyed pha bu gnyis dgra lag tu shor nyen 'dug ngas skabs de dus batren rgod kha sho kho'i mna' ma rang byas te bsdad na da lta nga tsho su la'ang dgra yod pa ma red ’’ces mig chu gtong bzhin dbang chen gyi mjing par 'khyud nas bshad/dbang chen gyis ‘‘a tsi/ khyod de 'dra sems khral byed mi dgos/ blo bde mo byos/ kho khyod shor ba'i sems pham skyed de bshad pa tsam las don du kho la de lta bu'i dpa' yod pa ma red/ gal srid kho de 'dra'i dpa' blo khog can zhig yin na byis pa rdzi bo gcig la ngag 'phrin bskur dgos don med ’’ces bshad/‘‘a pha/ a pha/ khyed ri’dbang chen 'das don de dag la bsam blo gtong gin lag tu bzung ba'i ja phor shor grabs kyis ja pus mo'i steng du bshos pa dgra 'dul gyis mthong nas bos pas da gzod gzhi nas rjes dran gyi rgya las 'grol te ‘‘o/ o/’’zhes bshad kyin phar blta tshur blta byas/khong tsho sa cha der zla gcig tsam bsdad rjes mkho byed yongs rgyab tu khur nas brag 'phrang dog po de rgyud de ja gar rong du spos/'o ma skyid la nas sgye mo bzhi yod kyang da thengs khyer thabs med pas nub ri'i brag phug cig tu sbas nas bzhag103

ja gar rong ni rtswa chu 'dzoms shing gcan gzan gyi 'tshe ba med pa phyogs bzhi sa 'dzin gyi phreng bas bskor ba ra ba'i nang du 'dzul ba ltar drod che ba lung pa phyi nang gnyis kyi gnam gshis ha lam dbyar dgun gyi khyad par yod pas 'o ma skyid hang sang nas ‘‘a tsi/ lung pa skyid po 'di 'dra zhig khyed gnyis kyis ga 'dra byas nas rnyed pa red ’’ces dbang chen la dris/ dbang chen gyis ‘‘a ru ya ’’zhes rgyab tu khur ba'i khur po sar phabs nas gad pa'i steng du bsdad de ‘‘lung pa 'di nga tsho'i bsod nams kyi mthu las rnyed pa ma gtogs gzhan mi su yin yang rnyed mi srid/ ga 'dra 'dug nga gnyis kyis rdzun bshad mi 'dug ga ’’zer nas dpral ba'i steng gi rngul chu phyis tsam byas/‘‘skyid po 'dug byang gi sa char yang lung pa skyid po 'di 'dra yod pa ngo ma ya mtshan red ’’ces shod zhor du phyogs bzhir rgyang mig gcod dus lung pa'i phu na yod pa'i 'brong khyu de mthong nas ‘‘lung pa 'di'i nang ’’dgra 'dul gyis 'o ma skyid kyi tshig mjug 'phrog nas ‘‘lung pa 'di'i nang da dung mi khyim gcig yod/ ya gi ni mi khyim de'i nor khyu red ’’ces ku re bshad/'o ma skyid hang sang nas ‘‘a/ ga re/ 'dir da dung mi khyim gzhan zhig yod red ad/ 'o na kha sngon khyod gnyis kyis mi khyim gzhan gcig kyang med zer byung ’’zhes mig kyang cher gdangs nas dris/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘yod red mi’ces lan btab/'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘su tshang zer ba red mi’ces dris/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘dbang chen tshang zer gyi 'dug ’’ces ku re bshad/‘‘hwa hwa hwa/ bu 'di bstan bshig tsha ba la/ ngas ngo ma da dung mi tshang gzhanatshozhig yod red snyam byung ’’zhes bshad rjes dbang chen la/‘‘'o na nor khyu de ci red mimices dris/104
