dbang chen gyis ‘‘de nged tshang gi nor red ’’zer/‘‘a/ 'o na khyed gnyis kyis nor khyu gcig ded yong ba yin nam/’’‘‘ma red/’’‘‘'o na ’’ ‘‘dkon mchog gis nga tshor sbyin pa red/’ri‘‘dkon mchog gis sbyin pa red ad/’’‘‘um/ red dkon mchog gis sbyin pa red/ da 'gro ’’zhes dbang chen gyis khur po khur te ‘‘khyod kyis 'dir lug tog tsam 'tsho nas nyi ma ma bzhud tsam la ded nas shog ’’ces dgra 'dul gyi phrag par bcag tsam byas/‘‘mtsher rnying ’’du slebs dus sha rlon phung po de'i phyi skog cung zad skam pa las kha nyin de ga rang bsdad 'dug dbang chen gyis sha rdog kha shas bcad de rngon khyi lnga por sbyin te ‘‘'di nga gnyis ma song gong bshas pa'i nor sha red ’’zer/'o ma skyid kyis da gin gyi nor khyu de dran te blta dus nor de dag ni khyim nor las gzugs stobs che ba 'dug pas ‘‘de tsho 'brong ma red pas ’rizer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘red/ da gin khyod kyis ngo ma nor red bsam byung ngam ’’zer/'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘lung pa 'di'i nang 'brong khyu gcig ga 'dra byas nas slebs pa yin nam ’’zhes da dung 'brong khyur bltas te de ltar bshad/dbang chen gyis ‘‘byas tsang dkon mchog gis gnang ba red zer ba yin ’’zhes rgyab tu khur ba'i khur po sar phabs rjes khur por bsnyes nas ngal gathesabasdo/'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘a ru ’’zhes mo rang las che ba'i khur po sar phabs rjes slog pa'i phu dung gnyis phud de ngal gsos/ nang 'jam gyon rgyu med pas 105

khog stod dmar hreng nger rtsib ma rkang re re bzhin phyir mngon pas ma tshad rab tu rgyas pa'i 'o 'dzin zung yang cung zad thur du dpyang nas 'dug dpral ba'i steng nas bzhur 'ong ba'i rngul chu rkang gnyis ma le'i steng slebs dus sran rdog las che ba'i rngul chu rdog gnyis su gyur te cung tsam song rjes gzugs po'i 'gul skyod kyi g.yo 'gul thebs te 'o 'dzin zung gi steng du lhung nas su mgyogs kyi bang rtsal 'gran pa ltar thur du rgyug pas slog pa'i dreg pas sha mdog mi mngon pa'i 'o 'dzin zung gi steng du rngul chu bzhur ba'i rjes gsal po gnyis mngon/dbang chen gyis ga ler mig zur gyis blta dus myos bum zung gis kho la 'dod sred drag po zhig bster yang lam bar du ngal dub che bas lus po 'gul skyod byed mi sgyid par gyur te rkang pa brkyang nas gnyid du yur/ja gar rong gi nyi ma'i tsha gdug ni dbyar gzhung gi tsha gdug dang ha lam khyad par mi 'dug 'o ma skyid da dung gnyid khug med kyang de ring lam bar gyi ngal dub dang nyi ma'i tsha drod kyis mgo nas mjug bar lus kyi rus sgrom zhig pa ltar gyur te mgo bo gzhu ltar gug dpral pa'i steng nas yang sran rdog las che tsam gyi rngul chu rdog gnyis 'o 'dzin gyi steng du lhung nas grang thig thig gi tshor snang zhig byung ba dang za 'khrug kyang langs byung bas ngo tsha drag po zhig skyed de de mar phu dung gnyis ka gyon te ga ler dbang chen gyi phyogs su blta dus dbang chen rbad de gnyid khug nas sdur ba 'then gyin 'dugadagra 'dul dang lug khyu smin sgyu'i khrod du rab rib tu mngon pa dang mi phyugs tshang ma sngar bas ring zhing phra bar mngon/mos yang ga ler dbang chen gyi phyogs su blta dus dbang chen da dung gnyid khug nas mjing rtsa 'khyug 'khyug tu 'phar ba dang dbugs yar rngub skabs sna khung nas rngub ste har sgra grags pa dang dbugs mar gtong skabs kha 106

nas gtong bas sil sgra grags kyi 'dug dbang chen gyi ngo gdong ni ngo ma skyes pho rab kyi ngo gdong 'khrul med cig ste dpral mtshams mtho ba/ smin ma nag la stug pa/ sna mtho la 'gram zheng che ba dang mkhur tshos mtho ba/ sha rtsi nag pa/ so gral 'grig cing dkar ba/ 'gram pa g.yas g.yon dang yas mchu/ ma le'i steng gi sma ra stug cing nag pa bcas kyis mo la 'dod sred drag po zhig skyed de 'doms gsher khu zhig gis brlan par gyur bas ngo tsha bar gyur te ngo gdong sbar mos bkab nas bsdad/ de'i skabs lte ba'i 'og gi nags tshal gyi khrod du za 'phrug cig langs byung bas lag pa brkyangs te myul bas shig rgan bgres song gcig mthe bong dang ldag mdzub gnyis kyi bar du shi ba'i dus su slebs kyang gson thabs kyis rwa co gnyis 'gul gyin 'dugamos shig rgan bgres song de sbar mthil du bzhag nas bltas pas na shig rgan bgres song de dmus long gcig mya ngam gyi thang chen du 'khyams pa ltar skor ba bskor gyin 'dug pas mos sngar ma mthong ba'i ltad mo zhig mthong ba ltar mig hrig hrig gis bltas nas bsdad pa'i tshe rlung 'tshub chung chung gcig gis shig rgan bgres song de sbar mthil las mi mngon par gyur bas gang du song ba yin nam snyam nas 'tshol dus shig rgan bgres song de dbang chen gyi 'gram pa'i steng du slebs te nus shugs yod tshad bton nas yar 'dzegs kyin 'dug pas mos lam seng mthe bong dang ldag mdzub kyis tshur bzung skabs btson las bros pa'i btson pa zhig slar khrims mun du tshud pa ltar mdzub mo gnyis kyi bar du 'phag 'tshag rgyag gin 'dug 'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘khyod 'jon po de 'dra yod na g.ya' ’’zhes bshad de mthe bong gnyis kyi sen mo'i bar du bzhag nas bsad/de nas dbang chen gnyid las sad de ‘‘de 'dra'i nyi ma tsha ba la ’’zer bzhin mig phur phur byas te a stong zhig brgyab rjes 'gram par bred tsam byas 107

nas sma ra'i dkyil nas shig phrug skya bo gcig bzung 'dug khos lam seng mthe bong gi sen mo'i steng du bzhag nas bsad rjes ‘‘nga la shig gcig kyang med/ shig de khyod kyi gzugs po'i steng nas 'byar yong ba ma red dam ’’zer/'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘hi hi ’zhes gad mo zhig bgad de ‘‘shig la skrag gi yod na khyod nga'i rum nang du 'dzul nas ci byed pa yin ’mizer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘shig la ma skrag tsang nga yong ba red/ skug na 'dzul gyi ma red ’rices shod kyin 'o ma skyid kyi mjing par 'khyud de 'o chen po zhig bskyal/ 'o ma skyid kyis slog pa'i thu gsham yar brdzes te dbang chen gyi brang 'og tu nud de yud tsam song rjes 'o ma skyid yar langs te kha phar bskor nas sked rags bcings skyor zhig byas te phar tsam song nas gcin pa zhig btang rjes chu 'gram du gog nas chu btung /dbang chen gyis sbra chag bshigs te sbra phub rtsis byas/ 'o ma skyid kyis phu dung gis ngo gdong phyis tsam byas te sbra'i chon thag 'then nas sbra phub/ de nas kho gnyis kyis mkho byed yongs nang du khyer/ dbang chen gyis sog thab rkang gsum de sbra'i dbus su btsugs rjes chu 'gram du song nas ngo gdong dang lag pa gtsang mar bkrus rjes chu blangs/'o ma skyid kyis lci ba 'thu bar song / cung 'gor rjes mos gos kyi thu gsham yar brdzes pa'i nang du lci ba mang po blugs nas slebs/ gos kyi thu gsham yar brdzes drags pas brla sha'i 'khri shing gnyis ka phyir mngon zhing pus mo'i lha nga'i steng du rwa ltar chags pa'i dreg nag gis lhan pa nag po zhig brgyab pa dang mtshungs/108

tshul de mthong bas dbang chen gad mo shor/ mo rang yang ngo tsha nas lus kyi tshugs ka mi zin par de mar rang sar bsdad de rlu ba sa ru gtor nas ‘‘ci bgad rgyu gda' ’’zer nas khong khro langs pa'i zol gyis dbang chen la mig mthog cig bltas/de nas kha sngon kho gnyis pha bu gnyis thog mar ja gar rong du slebs pa ltar sbra de'i gnam sgo las du ba skya 'phyur 'phyur du langs/ sbra de lung pa de'i nang gson nyams dod shos dang che shos kyi dngos po zhig tu mngon/dbang chen gyis sha spung las sha rdog kha shas bcad de sha btsos/ 'o ma skyid kyis thab nang du lci ba blugs bzhin yun ring gtan sdod gzhis chags kyi 'go tshugs/zla phyed lhag tsam song rjes dbang chen gyis lham mthil brdol ba'i steng du ko ba gsar pa zhig gis lhan pa brgyab rjes ‘‘sang nyin nga song nas nas sgye mo gcig khur yong ’’zer/'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘khyed rang gcig pu song yang mang po khur mi thub pas nga gnyis gnyis ka 'gro ’’zer/‘‘de 'dra byas na bu dgra 'dul gcig pu sdod thub kyi ma red/ nga zhag ma gcig las 'gor mi yong mi’‘‘'o na khyed pha bu gnyis song / ngas nang srung nas sdod ’’ces 'o ma skyid kyis pha bu gnyis kyi ngo gdong la bltas/dbang chen gyis ‘‘de 'dra byas na mi 'grig khyed rang gcig pu 'dir bsdad na nyi ma 'khyol dka' bas nga rang gcig pu 'gro yong ’’zer/'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘nga rang gcig pu sa ngan der yun ring po de 'dra bsdad kyang nyi ma 'khyol song bas zhag re gnyis nyi ma mi 'khyol ba ci yod ’’zer/phyi nyin nyi ma shar ri'i rtse nas ma shar tsam la dbang chen mal las langs 109

te sha rdog gcig dang spags thang khug gang am phrag tu bcug nas 'gro rtsis byas/'o ma skyid dang dgra 'dul gnyis kyang lam seng mal las langs te ‘‘zhogs ja btung rjes song ’’zer bzhin thab nang du lci ba blugs te me gtong rtsis byas kyang dbang chen gyis ‘‘zhogs ja 'thung dgos mi 'dug snga tsam song na yag gi red ’’zer nas sgor don/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘a pha me mda' khur song ri’zer bzhin bo'u de sbra'i phub kar las bkrol te dbang chen gyi lag tu sprad/dgra 'dul dang 'o ma skyid gnyis sgo khar langs te dbang chen la thag ring po'i bar du skyel ma byas/dbang chen gyis phu dung g.yug gin me mda'i ru dar dmar po rlung gis lhab lhub tu g.yo bzhin gom zheng chen pos mdun du bskyod/dbang chen ri 'dabs su slebs rjes kha phyir bskor nas blta dus nub ri'i rtse mo yongs gser gyi khu ba'i nang nas blangs pa ltar nyi gzhon gyi gser 'od 'phros nas 'dug bu dgra 'dul dang 'o ma skyid gnyis kyi zhogs ja bskol ba'i du ba sngo lhog lhog tu 'phyur gyin 'dug de nas khos thog mar kho gnyis ja gar rong du slebs nyin rngon khyi lnga po'i rjes su 'brang nas 'bab yong sa'i rdza g.ya' ma 'dres pa'i ri der blta dus ri de ni srid na 'gran zla bral ba'i ral gri chen po zhig gis phyed bshag btang pa ltar shin tu gzar bas kho hang sang nas ‘‘a tsi/ skabs de dus nga gnyis ga 'dra byas nas babs yong ba yin nam ririzhes chig lab brgyab/kho brag 'phrang las bgrod de thur du 'bab skabs ri gsham gyi spang ljongs steng na g.yag khyu gcig bag phebs su gnas pa'i mthar mi gcig me btang nas ja bskol bzhin 'dug de ni tshwa pa'i khal khyu yin gyi red snyam/110

gang lags zhe na/ tshwa mtsho'i khar chu tshang ma tshwa shas che bas tshwa pa tshugs babs rjes 'gel khal yongs der sdod mi rung bas 'dzo ba zhes ched mngags bkod sgrig byas pa'i khal rdzi des ded de tshwa mtsho dang bar thag 'gyang ba'i sar gnas spos byas nas tshwa las yongs su grub rjes 'gel khal rnams tshwa mtsho'i khar 'ded dgos kyi yod/dbang chen gyis rdzi bo des ma mthong ba byas te de'u 'bur zhig gi rgyab nas 'jab ste bltas pas na rdzi bo der da dung rta rkyang po bya 'dra ba gcig kyang 'dug da lta rdzi bo de dang kho gnyis kyi bar mda' rgyang gang tsam las mi 'dug tshwa khal 'di dag drin pha mas ma sbyin sgo zog red/ de ring go skabs 'di shor mi rung snyam nas sked gri de rum du bcug me mda' der bzhag nas ‘‘ya la la mo la la red ’’ces glu gtong bzhin rdzi bo de'i phyogs su song /rdzi bo des kho mthong rjes blta tsam byas nas dogs 'char spu tsam med par ja 'thung bzhin bsdad/gam du slebs rjes dbang chen gyis ‘‘zog 'tsho yag ’’ces khams 'dri byas par rdzi bo des ‘‘lam nye mi’zhes khams 'dri byas/khoyang snang dogs med par rdzi bo de'i gam du bsdad de ‘‘khyod tsho yul gang gi yin ’’zhes dris/rdzi bo des rang gi ja phor gyi nang du ja thang zhig blugs pa de'i steng mar rdog ril ma las che tsam zhig brgyab nas kho la bster zhor du ‘‘ja 'thung dang kha skom yod kyi red/ nga tsho rdo dkar tsho pa nas yin ’’zer/khos ja phor phar bster zhor du ‘‘rdo dkar nas 'di bar khal tshugs ga tshod yod ’’ces dris/‘‘khal tshugs shar mar song na sum cu so gnyis yod ’rizer/111

‘‘khyed mi tshang phyug po zhig yin pa 'dra/’ri‘‘khyed kyis ci shes kyi 'dug’ ‘‘khyim tshang phyug po zhig min na khal mang po 'di 'dra yod srid dam/mi’‘‘khal 'di dag sbyin bdag gi red/ nga g.yog po yin/’’‘‘sa thag ring po 'di 'dra 'gro dgos dus khyed kyi chung mas khyo yan gzhan 'tshol gyi ma red dam ’’zhes ku re'i khul gyis rdzi bo de'i khyim tshang gi grub cha shes rtogs byas/‘‘hwa hwa/ khyed ni mi ku re rtsed rgyur dga' ba zhig yin pa 'dra/ nga la chung ma'i grib ma tsam yang med pas khyo yan 'tshol ba'i sems khral med/khyed yul lung pa ga nas yin ’’zhes dris/‘‘ nga 'di nas rang yin/’’‘‘o/ 'di rgyud la yang mi tshang yod dam/’ri‘‘yod red/ mang po rang med ’’ces lan btab/rdzi bos kho la ja phor bster zhor du ‘‘khyed de ring gang du 'gro ba yin ’’zhes dris/dbang chen gyis ja btung rjes phor pa phar sprad de ‘‘kha seng nor gnyis bor song bas de 'tshol bar 'gro mkhan yin/ khyed kyis mthong ma byung ngam ’’zhes dris rjes rum las sna ru blangs te sna tha sen mo gang blugs te sna ru rdzi bo der g.yar/rdzi bo des ‘‘ngas sna tha 'then mi shes ’ zhes shod zhor du gal ta las sha lhu chung chung gcig blangs te khor sprad/khos sha tshur blangs rjes rdzi bo der mtshon cha gang yod shes par byed ched ‘‘nga la gri med/ gri gcig g.yor dang ’’zer/rdzi bo des gal ta las gri chung ko shubs can gcig blangs te khor g.yar/112

khos ‘‘gri 'di las che tsam med dam ’’zhes dris/rdzi bo des ‘‘med ’’zer/de ltar kho gnyis za 'thung la rol bzhin yun ring kha brda glod de bsdad/rdzi bo des ja phor khor ster zhor du ‘‘khyed kyi ming la ci zer ’rizhes dris/dbang chen gyis ja phor phar ster zhor du rdzi bo de'i steng du mchongs nas thong ga las bzung ste ‘‘nga ri 'go'i jag pa kher 'dug la ming med ri’ces mig 'bur tshugs su bltas te rum gri gnam la 'phyar nas ‘‘pho las zad jag pa'i lag 'og tshud/ gsal nyi ma mthong ba da lta tsam ’zhes ngar skad sgrog gin 'jigs skul byas/rdzi bo des am gtsigs bsdams nas 'phag 'tshag rgyag gin ‘‘nga mi nyes med rang gar sdod pa la khyed kyis 'di ltar byed dgos don ci yin/ ngas khyed kyi pha rgyu grags pa can ma rgyu grangs ka can ci zhig la gnod pa bskyal byung ’’zhes bshad zhor du dbang chen gyi ngo gdong la mchil ma btab/dbang chen gyis sked gri sngar bas mtho bar 'phyar nas ha lam g.yug la khad byas nas ‘‘khyod mgo sgur ram ro 'jog ’’ces skad shugs sngar bas che bar btang nas 'jigs skul byas/‘‘nga ji ltar sdug kyang mgo mi sgur/ nga la pha ma gnyen nye dang bza' zla bu phrug la sems chags sa ni med/ da sod/ nga ji ltar sdug kyang skyes pa pho lus shig blangs pas gshin rje'i dmag dpon slebs kyang ro 'jog pa las mgo sgur srol med ’’ces mig 'bur tshugs kyis dbang chen la bltas/dbang chen gyis sngar bas dam par bzung nas ‘‘skyag zan khyod sdug tshod sna 'go'i rtse la ma bzung na mtshon sngon mo 'di la snying rje mi 'dug ma zer ā ’’zhes gri rtse sna la gtad de 'jigs skul byas/rdzi bo des ‘‘da sod dang / da sod dang / gsod ma nus na khyod pho khyo 113

ga min/ gdong kha sprod kyis 'dzing mi nus pa 'jab rgol byed mkhan sdar ma wa 'dra ba khyod kyis de ring gsod ma nus na pho khyo ga min mi’zhes bshad/rdzi bo de phar bltas na mi nyam chung gang yang mi 'jon mkhan zhig dang 'dra bas dbang chen gyis 'jigs skul byas nas mgo sgur thabs byed dgos snyam yang don du mi de ni dpa' blo khog shin tu che ba 'chi rgyur mi skrag mkhan zhig 'dug pas dbang chen re zhig bya dka' byed gtad du gyur te sked gri gnam la 'phyar zhing thong ga las bzung nas sdod rgyu las ma 'das/rdzi bo des slog pa'i rum kha phyes te brang dmar po bton nas ‘‘da sod dang / de ring gsod ma nus na khyod bu ma red bu mo red ’’ces shod kyi 'dugardzi bo de bsad de nor khyu ja gar rong du 'ded song na mi 'grig pa med kyang de 'dra byas na las rgyu 'bras la 'gro gi ma red/ nor khyu ni sbyin bdag gi yin pa dang rdzi bo ni g.yog po yin pas kho bsad kyang de'i gzugs po'i steng nas rgya khab phra mo tsam gyi rin thang can gyi dngos po med pas/ de bas kho dang gdong dang gdong gtugs nas 'dzing dgos snyam nas rdzi bo glod de ‘‘yar longs ’’zhes bshad/rdzi bo des snang dogs tsam med par yar langs te lus la 'gos pa'i thal ba sprug sprug byas te ya mtshan pa'i mig mdangs kyis dbang chen la bltas nas bsdad/ 7‘‘dbang chen gyis sked gri rdzi bo de'i mdun du g.yug nas 'o na khyod kyis nga sod ’’ces bshad/rdzi bo des ‘‘nga don dag khab rtse tsam rtsod rgyu med par mtshon sngon mo'i rtse mo rtsed 'dod med/ shi 'dod na khyod rang gis rang sod ’rices bshad zhor du mdun gyi bye ma'i steng du lhag pa'i sked gri der rdog rgyag gzhus te dbang chen gyi phyogs su g.yug114

dbang chen gyis sked gri de yar sgrug nas de'i steng gi thal rdul dang bye ma gtsang mar phyis rjes shubs su bcug nas ‘‘bu dpa' bo red 'dug nga gnyis mna' bzhag gi shag po zhig byas na 'grig gam ’’zhes bshad/rdzi bo des ‘‘khyed ni byang sa skya mor sdod pa'i jag pa red/ nga ni gnas skabs kyi 'grul pa red/ nged gnyis mna' bzhag kyang ci phan ’’zer/dbang chen rdzi bo de'i mdun du dkyil krung du bsdad de sna tha sen mo gang blugs nas ‘‘ngo ma bshad na nga jag pa min/ pha gzhis khra mo mi lag tu shor te 'dir bros 'ong ba yin/ khyed yid ches na ngas da dung khyed la nag mo gcig kyang sbyin chog ’’ces bshad/rdzi bo de da gzod dbang chen gyi gam du bsdad de ‘‘'o na khyod yul gang gi mi yin ’’zhes dris/dbang chen gyis ‘‘de ngas rjes su bshad chog khyed mna' bzhag gi shag po byed 'dod na dus de ring phan chad khyod sbyin bdag gi ched du g.yog rgyug dgos med par nor khyu 'di dang rta 'di nga gnyis kyi red/ khyed kyi rgyu mtshan ha go e song ri’zer/rdzi bos ‘‘khyed kyis byas na nga gnyis nor khyu 'di 'ded de phyogs gzhan zhig tu bros 'gro zer ba yin nam ’’zer/dbang chen gyis mgo ldem tsam byas nas sna tha gtsang mar 'then rjes goms gshis chasas pa ltar mthe bong gi sen mo slog pa'i thu gsham gyi steng du phyis tsam byas nas lag g.yas pa'i srin mdzub gug gug byas te rdzi bo de'i phyogs su brkyang /rdzi bo des lam seng srin mdzub gug gug byas te dbang chen gyi srin mdzub la 'khyud par byas te ‘‘yā/ shag po'i ming la ci zer ’’zhes 'dri bzhin mdzub mo gnyis sngar bas dam par 'khyud/115

‘‘nga'i ming la dbang chen zer/ shag po'i ming la ci zer ’’zhes phar dris/‘‘nga'i ming la khyi gu nyi shar zer/ nga'i a mar phru gu mang po skyes kyang nga ma gtogs gson ma thub/ nga skye skabs zhogs pa nyi ma shar ba dang dus mnyam yin pas ming de 'dra zhig btags te mi shi ba'i smon lam btab pa red ’’ces drang por bshad/ de nas kho gnyis kyis gnam a sngon la tshad btsugs/ sa dog mo pang du blangs te shi na mnyam shi dang gson na mnyam gson/ lus grib ma ji bzhin 'grogs te byams dang snying rjes skyong res byed rgyu las mna' zan khrel med kyi nang dme mi byed rgyu dbus lha sa'i jo bo rnam gnyis tshad btsugs nas mdzub mo dmar 'gug gi shag po byas/kho gnyis kyis yang bskyar me btang ste ja bskol/dbang chen gyis ‘‘nga la da dung me mda' gcig yod ’rices bshad de de'u 'bur gyi rgyab tu song nas me mda' tshur blangs/dbang chen gyis ‘‘shag po/ nga sdod sa ri 'di'i phar logs mi ma dgos gdon 'dres mi rnyed pa'i lung pa skyid po zhig yod/ nga tsho'i nas do po bzhi brag phug tu sbas nas yod/ nga de len par yong ba yin/ nga gnyis sang nyin shar skya rengs skya mda' ma btang gong nas nas do po bzhi po de khal la bskal te log 'gro ’’zer/‘‘yā yā ’zhes bshad rjes khyi gu nyi shar gyis mno bsam zhig btang ste ‘‘shag po nga tsho lung pa 'di'i phar logs rang la bsdad na nga tsho'i mis btsal te rnyed 'gro gi red/ thag ring tsam bros na ’’zhes bshad/‘‘rnyed thabs yod ma red/ ngas da lta mi shod sang nyin slebs song na shag po khyod kyis shes kyi red/ nang du slebs rjes ngas da dung khyed la nag 116

mo mdzes ma gcig ster ’’zer/‘‘hwa hwa hwa ’’zhes khyi gu nyi shar gyis shag pos ku re rtsed pa red snyam nas mgo bo 'phred du g.yugadabang chen gyis ‘‘shag po/ khyed kyis yul g.yang phyug ces pa go e myong ’’zhes dris/khyigu nyi shar gyis ‘‘go myong / kha sngon g.yang phyug la tsho pa phan tshun 'khrugs nas god chags chen po zhig byung ba ma red dam ’’zer/‘‘red/ de dus nga yul la yod/’’‘‘khyod g.yang phyug gi red dam/’’‘‘red/ g.yang phyug gi sde dpon yin/’’‘‘o ’’zhes khyi gu nyi shar gyis dbang chen gyi ngo gdong las gsang ba gang zhig 'tshol ba bzhin yang yang bltas/‘‘khyed g.yang phyug tu 'gro myong ngam/’’‘‘'gro myong / tshwa pa'i lam 'khel gyi red/ kha sngon g.yang phyug la sde phan tshun 'khrug ste god chags chen po byung pa'i skor la grags lung grags red 'dug pas nga tsho g.yang phyug las g.yol te 'ong ba yin ’’zer/‘‘g.yang phyug nas khyod tsho'i bar g.yag tshugs ga tshod yod dam/’’‘‘g.yag tshugs brgyad tsam yod/’’mun pa'i yol nag gis sa gzhi chen po yongs su btums shing bgrang yas skar tshogs kyi 'od lhang lhang du 'tsher/ phyogs bzhi'i lhun po'i rtse mo'i sgang gshong sog le'i kha ltar mtho ba nas dma' ba/ dma' ba nas mtho ba'i gnam sa'i thig mtshams lhag par gsal/ 'byams klas rtswa thang chen por rlung lhags kyi sil sgra dang rtswa 'jag ma'i skyo ba'i shu sgra dus gcig tu bar mtshams med par grags pas skye bo'i sems dang lus la bzod dka' ba'i skyo 117

shas dang grang zug tshad med sbyin 'ong gi 'dugaphyi nyin skya mda' ma btang tsam la mal las langs te myur stabs kyis song bas nyi ma shar tsam la la rtser slebs nas brag 'phrang gu dog de rgyud de song /gcong rong lta bu'i lung pa de gting zab pa dang / bgrod lam brag 'phrang gya ma gyu de gu dog pas ya mtshan skye ba dang / yang tshwa pa'i 'bangs kyis shes te ra mda' slebs mi yong ngam snyam pa'i dngangs skrag gis khyi gu nyi shar gyis phyi bltas yang yang blta gi 'dug pas dbang chen gyis kho'i sems rtogs nas ‘‘shag po/ sems khral byed dgos yod ma red/ lung pa btsan po 'di la brag 'phrang 'di las gzhan gyi bgrod lam med/ gal srid ra mda' yong mkhan yod na/ ngas mdel sngon mos bsu ba zhus chog ’’ces rgyab tu khur ba'i me mda'i gsham shing la lag pa 'chang tsam byas/khyi gu nyi shar gyis ‘‘brag 'phrang 'di las gzhan gyi bgrod lam gcig kyang med pa red dam ’’zhes dris/‘‘gshog gnyis kyi bya yin na ma gtogs brag 'phrang 'di las gzhan gyi lam bu gcig kyang med ’’zer/brag 'phrang bgrod de gzhung du slebs rjes dbang chen gyis phyi bltas 'ga' bltas nas glu btang bar/sa byang gi lam 'grul a rogs tsho/nor bdag med ma zhog pha bzang bu/bu khram pa'i lam la thug zer na/bu khram pas snying rje shes le min/khyi gu nyi shar gyis dbang chen la bltas te ‘‘nor bdag yod yin yang khram pas 'ded nas 'gro gi mi 'dug gam ’mizhes ku re bshad pas kho gnyis 118

gnyis ka ‘‘hwa hwa hwa ’’zhes gad mo shor/dgra 'dul dang 'o ma skyid gnyis kyis 'grul dum zhig yong rba —mthong bas ya mtshan skyed de gnyis ka'i mgo sbra'i sgo las phyir don te blta bzhin sems nang du'ang 'jigs skrag cung zad skyes/de'i skabs thab steng du btso bzhin pa'i sha nas ‘‘tshir ’’zhes sha khu 'phyur ba'i sgra grags byung bas 'o ma skyid de mar nang du 'dzul nas sha rnams a slog brgyab/ da lta btso bzhin pa'i sha de dag ni dbang chen de ring phyir slebs mkhan yin pas ched du btsos pa'i sgug sha dhired/de nas 'grul pa rnams thag je nyer slebs dus rgyab tu me mda' 'khur ba'i mi gcig 'dug pa de'i ru dar dmar po lhab lhub tu g.yo bzhin 'dug pas dgra 'dul gyis rang gi pha yin pa shes kyang rogs pa gcig dang nor mang po 'di 'dra 'ded rgyu yod pa ci yin snyam pa'i dogs 'char skyed de ga ler de phyogs su song nas zhib par blta dus rang gi pha dbang chen ni 'khrul med red 'dug pas rgyug nas song /rngon khyi lnga yang zug skad rgyag bzhin dgra 'dul gyi rjes su 'brang nas zla1ga'o ma skyid kyis thab nang du lci ba blugs zhor du ‘‘'grul pa de ga par slebs 'dug ’’ces dris kyang lan ster mkhan med pas ci yin nam snyam nas kha phyir bskor ba na dgra 'dul mthong rgyu mi 'dug pas gang du song ba yin nam bsam ste mgo sbra sgo las don te 'grul pa'i phyogs su blta dus dgra 'dul rgyug ma 'dur gyis de phyogs su rgyug 'gro ba dang / 'grul pa me mda' 'khur ba de dbang chen yin pa mo rang gis kyang shes te ‘‘gcig de su yin nam ’’zhes shal sdom/ sgug sha zhes pa ni khyim mi gcig yul gzhan zhig tu song nas phyir slebs rgyur sgug nas ched du btsos pa'i 119

chig lab rgyag gin nang du 'dzul nas btsos zin pa'i sgug sha de dag snod las blangs te sder ma zhig gi nang du bzhag rjes mgo skyes kyi lan bur byil byil btang / de nas sked rags kyi sne mos ngo gdong phyis phyis 'ga' byas rjes mar rdog gcig nas mar ril ma tsam zhig blangs te ngo gdong la byug de nas thab 'gram gyi go thal phyags te phyogs gcig tu spungs/ las ka de dag tshar rjes ga ler sbra srubs las bltas pas na da dung thag 'gyang tsam 'dugad gzod rang gi khyo bo slebs stabs sems nang du 'tshab sha langs te ngo tsha ba dang snying brdeb pa'i tshor snang 'dug pa ni dga' spro'i sems 'tshab dang brjod mi shes pa'i ngo tsha zhig kyang red/ de nas yang gos kyi thu gsham yar brdzes te lham sgrog dam por bcings/ de'i skabs 'doms las za 'khrug cig langs byung bas lag pa brkyangs nas bred skabs de'i rgyud du gsher khu zhig gis brlan par byas yod pas sor mo'i yal 'dabs kyi rtse yang gsher khu de 'gos yod pas blta tsam byas nas skyug bro pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig bstan te 'brong rwa yi a ru'i nang du chu blugs nas brla bar du bcangs nas sgur sgur byas te lag pa gtsang mar bkrus nas thab nang du lci rdog 'ga' blugs rjes sbra'i sgo srubs las blta dus kho tsho sgo 'gram du slebs 'dug pas de mar sgor don te ‘‘dka' e byung ’’zhes khams 'dri byas/ dbang chen gyis ‘‘dka' ma byung mi’zhes lan btab rjes ngo gdong las bcos ma min pa'i 'dzum zhig bstan te ‘‘'di shag po khyi gu nyi shar red ’’ces 'go mjug med pa'i skad cha de bshad pas dbang chen dang mnyam du yod pa'i mi gsar pa des 'o ma skyid la blta tsam byas rjes ngo gdong dmar por gyur te mgo bo smad de langs nas 'dugadabang chen gyis ‘‘yā/ khyed gnyis lag do byos/ nga gnyis pha bu gnyis lag do byed ’’ces bshad de dgra 'dul dang kho rang gnyis lag do byas/120

'o ma skyid dang rgyus med kyi mi de lag do byas te nor gyi steng nas nas do po bzhi po 'beb 'go tshugs/da lta dbang chen dang mnyam du yod pa'i mi rgyus med des 'o ma skyid la blta mi nus par mgo bo smad de sdod pa dang 'o ma skyid kyis mi 'di su yin nam snyam nas mi de'i gdong la bltas nas bsdad/ tshul de mthong bas dbang chen gyi sems nang du gad mo shor yang phyi tshul ha cang sgam brling gi tshul 'dzin te ‘‘wa ye/ lag do khyed gnyis da dung langs nas ci byed/ da nas phobs dang / mgyogs tsam ma byas na nor des sgal pa na gi 'dug zer gyi 'dug go ’’zhes ku re bshad/de mar 'o ma skyid dang khyi gu nyi shar gnyis g.yag de'i gzhogs g.yas g.yon du song ste nas skye blangs/ nas skye'i steng gi thag pa bkrol skabs mi des lag pa 'o ma skyid kyi lag par reg tshe tsher ma zug pa ltar 'drogs pa dang ngo tsha nas rna ba gnyis kyang khrag ltar dmar por gyur/de nas tshang ma nang du 'dzul te gdan la 'khod/'o ma skyid kyis kho tshor ja blugs shing rtsam pa dang mar phyur sha bcas dbang chen dang khyi gu nyi shar gnyis kyi mdun du bzhag nas ‘‘lto zo dang ’’zer/‘‘da rang zhogs ja med pas ltogs yod kyi red/ da zo dang shag po ’’zer gyin dbang chen gyis lug gi rtsib ma chen po gcig blangs te khyi gu nyi shar la sprad/ de nas yang gcig blangs te kho rang gis bzas/'o ma skyid kyis kho gnyis la ja yang yang blugs/khyi gu nyi shar gyis za 'thung kho na byed pa las skad cha tshig gcig kyang ma lab/'o ma skyid kyis mi rgyus med de su yin snyam yang su red ces skad cha 'dri ma nus/121

dbang chen gyis sha za bzhin du ‘‘shag po khyi gu nyi shar nga tsho'i nang mi red/nga tsho yang mi gcig gis mang du song ba red ’’zer/khyi gu nyi shar gyis ‘6um ’’zhes dgod tsam byas/sha bzas rjes dbang chen gyis lag pa'i steng gi zhag tshil slog pa'i steng du phyis/ de nas lag pa rum nang du brkyang ste sna ru bton nas sna tha sen mo gang blugs te sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i 'gying nyams kyis rkang mgo dkrab dkrab byed kyin du ‘‘shag po/ nged tsho'i nor khyu'i nang 'bri ga tshod 'dug ’’ces khyi gu nyi shar la dris/‘‘'bri brgyad yod red ’’ces lan btab/dbang chen gyis mgo lcog tsam byas rjes sir sgra dang bcas sna tha 'then pa dang sna khung las phyir don pa'i rdul dkar po de smug rlangs stug po zhig ltar gang sar khyab ste ngo gdong mi mthong ba byas/ de nas dbang chen gyi 'dren byed zung las sdug bsngal med pa'i mig chu'i phreng thag chad pas mig chu phyis tsam byas nas ‘‘snang ba skyid po'i sna tha 'then/ sdug bsngal med pa'i mig chu shor zhes pa 'di 'dra zhig yod red ’’ces bshad/'o ma skyid kyi sems su khyi gu nyi shar zer ba'i mi 'di gang 'dra zhig yin nam/ nor mang po 'di gang nas 'ded yong ba yin nam/ nas sgye mo bzhi 'di dbor ched g.yar ba yin nam/ yin gyi ma red/ nas sgye mo bzhi las med par nor mang po 'di 'dra dgos don ci yod/ dbang chen gyis kyang da gin shag po khyi gu nyi shar nga tsho'i nang mi red zer bas phal cher kho yang yul gyar ba zhig yin nges red snyam pa'i bsam blo sna tshogs 'khor ba dang rgyu mtshan de shes 'dod blo la skyed kyang don gyi snying po 'dri ba'i spobs pa med pas ga shod 'di shod med par khyi gu nyi shar la bltas nas bsdad/dbang chen gyis 'o ma skyid kyi bsam blo rtogs nas ‘‘shag po khyi gu nyi shar 122

ni rdo dkar tsho pa'i 'byor ldan pa zhig gi g.yog po red/ gzhis pha yul lung par pha ma gnyen nye dang bza' ma bu phrug kyang med/ kha seng kho khong tsho'i tshwa pa'i mdzo rdzi byas te bsdad 'dug mi'i grib ma tsam mthong rgyu med pa'i sa cha der ngas kho mthong nas kha brda glod par song nas nga gnyis shag po sgrig ste tshwa pa'i mdzo yongs 'ded de 'dir yong ba red/ da nga tsho nang gcig gi mi red/nga tsho mi phyugs mang du 'gro ba 'di ni bkra shis yar 'gro'i bzang rtags shig red ’’ces rgyu mtshan mdor bsdus shig brjod pa las kho rang gis sked gri 'phyar nas kho la rdzig rdzig btang tshul skor gtan nas ma bshad pa dang dgra 'dul la ‘‘rjes su khong la a khu nyi shar zhes 'bod dgos ’’zhes khyi gu zhes pa'i yig 'bru gnyis po dor dgos pa'i nan bskul byas/ dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘ya ya ’’zer nas de 'phral thab 'gram gyi khog ltir blangs nas ‘‘a khu nyi shar ja thungs ’’zer nas nyi shar gyi phor pa'i nang ja gang blugs pa'i tshul de ni nyi shar kho tsho'i bza' mir gyur par dga' bsu zhu bar mtshon/ nyi shar gyi rna bar ‘‘a khu nyi shar ’’zer ba thos pa dang sems nang du dga' lhang lhang gi tshor snang zhig byung /nyi shar gcin gtong bar 'gro skabs dbang chen gyis ‘‘'o ma skyid khyod rang song nas khyi khog dang / shag po nyi shar khyis rmug gi red ’’ces 'o ma skyid khyi bkag par btang /'o ma skyid lam sang sgor don te rngon khyi lnga po la la'i ske las bzung la la'i gnya' rdog brdzis btang ste khyi bkagakhos gcin btang zin te tshur yong skabs 'o ma skyid kyis khyi bkag bzhin kho'i ngo gdong la bltas nas 'dug pas kho rang ngo tsha nas 'o ma skyid kyi ngo gdong las g.yol te phyogs bzhi'i ri la blta ba'i zol gyis phar blta tshur blta 'ga' byas te nang du 'dzul/123

dgong mo nyi ma ma nub tsam la 'o ma skyid lug lhas rar bskong bar song /dgra 'dul 'bri g.yag bskong bar song / de'i skabs dbang chen gyis nyi shar la ‘‘nag mo de gang 'dra 'dug khyod kyi yid la 'gro gi 'dug gam ri’zer/nyi shar ngo tsha ste mgo bo smad de ‘‘de de de shag po khyod rang gi nag mo red pā/ ngas de 'phrog na ga la 'grig ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘nga yul la nag mo yod ces kha seng nas bshad pa yin pā/ der brten ngas de 'dra byas na bu dgra 'dul gyi sems nang du'ang ngas rbad de g.yang mo brjed pa red bsam gyi red/ shag po khyed kyis byas na nag mo de'i rnam pa ga 'dra 'dug khyod yid la 'gro gi 'dug gam ’’zhes yang yang dris/nyi shar gyis ‘‘shag po khyod kyi bka' drin gyis ma gtogs nga la yid 'gro dang mi 'gro lta zhog nag mo'i ming 'dogs rgyu yod pa zhig rnyed rgyu dka' mo red ’’zer/sa ma rub tsam la 'o ma skyid kyis lug khyu sbra'i 'dabs su bskong /dgra 'dul gyis 'bri g.yag gdang du bskong byung bas dbang chen dang nyi shar gnyis nor gdang du song nas ‘‘cho le cho le ’’zhes nor 'dogs kyi glu dbyangs gyer bzhin 'bri g.yag rnams gzugs stobs che chung gi go rim bzhin gdang la btags/dgong mo dkar zhing gsal ba'i zla 'od kyi 'og tu sbra'i g.yas 'dabs su lug khyu ga mer re nyal nas yod pa dang spra'i g.yon 'dabs su nor khyu nag mer re nyal nas yod/ nor 'ga' shas kyis 'khun sgra grags 'ong ba dang rta rkyang po'i ske la btags pa'i dril bu chung chung des ‘‘ti ting ting ’’zhes rna bar snyan pa'i sgra grags 'ong bas dbang chen gyi sems su yul las gyar te da bar 124

byung ma myong ba'i dga' tshor chen po zhig skyed pa dang sbrags kha nas ‘‘da ni mi tshang phyug po zhig tu 'gyur song ’’zhes bshad/nyin gnyis pa'i dgong mo nas bzung nyi shar dang 'o ma skyid rngakanyis sngas gcig gdan gcig gi steng du khyo shug gi 'tsho bar rol/ 'on kyang skabs re dbang chen la ‘‘dmigs gsal gyi dka' ngal ’’'phrad tshe kho tsho bza' gsum gyi 'tsho ba yang bskyal/ de nyin dbang chen gyis me mda'i nang du rdzas mdel blugs te de ring 'bri skam shed bzang gcig bsha' dgos pa 'dug nga tsho yun ring nor sha ma bzas pas sha za 'dod 'dug ’’zer/nyi shar gyis 'brong 'bri skam gcig gsod rgyu yin pa'i don rtogs nas ‘‘ya ya/ ngas de snga ri dwags dgo ba tsam las 'brong gsod pa mthong ma myong /de ring ngas ltad mo yag po blta gi yin no ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘de ring ltad mo blta mkhan nga yin ’’zer nas dmag dpon zhig gis 'thab 'dzing pa zhig la shi gson chags 'jig gi dus su las 'gan rlabs po che zhig sprod pa ltar me mda' de lag gnyis kyis btegs te nyi shar gyi lag tu bzhaganyi shar gyis me mda' de'i mgo nas mjug bar myong rol byed kyin lag pa'ang cung zad 'dar nas ‘‘gal srid 'brong la ma thebs na mdel 'phro brlag red mi’ces dgra 'dul dang dbang chen gnyis kyi ngo gdong la blta bzhin de sngon me mda' rgyag myong med pas 'brong la thebs pa'i gdeng tshod med stabs bya dka' byed gtad kyi rnam 'gyur bstan/dbang chen gyis me mda' tshur blangs te ‘‘khyod kyis ltos ang / 'di me mda'i so snying red/ 'di gzes khung red/ gzes khung dang so snying 'brong gsum thig gcig gi steng du gzes te lag pa ma 'dar bar dbugs 125

sgom nas rgyag dgos/ gal srid gzes khung dang so snying 'brong gsum thig gcig gi steng du med par cung zad yo 'khyog byung na thebs kyi ma red ’’ces re re bzhin bslabs/dbang chen dang dgra 'dul gnyis ni me mda' rgyag gyur shin tu byang pa zhig yin yang rang gi khyo bos da res 'brong la ma thebs na kho'i sems nang bzod dka' ba'i ngo tsha skyed te kha skyengs po yong gi red bsam nas 'o ma skyid kyis slog pa'i gong ba'i phyi nang slog ste shig 'thu bzhin du ‘‘ma thebs na ngo ma rdzas mdel 'phro brlag red/ de bas khyod rang pha bu gnyis kyis rgyob ’’ces bshad zhor du ‘‘a tsha tsha ’’zhes yang mgor bred tsam byas nas skra gseb las shig gcig bzung nas bsad/ dgra 'dul gyis gang yang ma bshad par 'o ma skyid kyi gong ba'i phyi las phyir don pa'i nu ma la bltas te khong dgod shor/'o ma skyid kyis tshul de mthong bas khong dgod cig shor te dgra 'dul la mig log cig bltas/de'i skabs nyi shar gyis kyang ‘‘a tsha tsha/ shig de'i gzan pa la ’’zhes lag pa brkyang ste mjing pa las shig rgan rgyags pa gcig bzung nas me mda'i mchu ru blugs te ‘‘da 'o na ngas shig rgan de yang 'brong dang mnyam du gsod dgos ’’zer bas tshang ma gad mo shor/dbang chen gyis ‘‘khyod kyis 'brong gi dpung pa'i thad du gzes nas rgyob dang phal cher thebs kyi red ’’ces bshad kyin kho gnyis sbra sgo las don te song /'o ma skyid kyis dgra 'dul la ‘‘khyod kyis da res nga'i nu mar bltas nas gad mo shor rgyu ci gda' mi’zer ‘‘khyod rang gi nu ma bstan pas nga gad mo shor byung /’’‘‘nu ma bstan mi nus pa ci yod ’’ces shod kyin phu dung gyon/126

‘‘bstan mi nus pa med na tshang ma ston dang /’’‘‘nyi hi hi ’’twetweha ha dzi’ ’’‘‘nyi shar gyis da res ma gtogs 'brong nye po de 'dra mthong myornga med/de snga mi gzhan gyis bshad pa ltar na 'brong gi rwa co gnyis kyi bar du mi gnyis dkyil krung du sdod thub pa'i zheng tshad yod pa dang / 'brong che ba 'ga' re'i gzugs po sbra yi che chung dang khyad par med pa go myong yang da lta rang gi mdun du lhags pa'i 'brong de dag ni yul nor las zhe drag che ba tsam las sbra'i che chung dang mtshungs pa med pas sems nang zhed snang de tsam ma byung / 'on kyang 'brong la ma thebs na rdzas mdel 'phro brlag red snyam nas ‘‘shag po khyod kyis rgyob dang / ngas rdzas mdel 'phro brlag ma gtogs gsod thub e yong ri’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘bya ba tshang ma lag len gyi nang du shes pa ma gtogs chung ma khog las don dus nas bya ba tshang ma shes mkhan ci yod/ 'brong der ma thebs kyang skyon ci yod ’’ces bshad kyin me lcags brdab ste sbi sdir me sgron nas ‘‘da ga ler 'jab ste ya gi'i 'bri skam de sod ’’ces mdzub ston byas/nyi shar gyis chu shur de las 'jab kyin song nas me mda'i ru gad pa'i steng du btsugs te da res dbang chen gyis mdzub ston byas pa'i 'brong de btsal/ 'brong 'bri skam des rkyen ngan zhig 'phrad rgyur sngon dpag thub pa ltar mgo bo sgur zhing sa la snom gyin 'dug pa ni rdzas dri tshor ba yin nges red/nyi shar gyis blo rtsa brtan po'i sgo nas 'brong de'i dpung pa g.yas par gzes te dbugs ring zhig btang rjes da res dbang chen gyis bslabs pa ltar dbugs sgom nas lag g.yas pa'i ldag mdzub kyis skam pa gnan te me mda'i skad grags pa dang 'brong 'bri skam de rang sar nyal ba ltar sa ru 'gyel/127

byings rnams rnga ma dgung la 'phyar nas shar gyi thang nas rlung 'tshub chen po zhig dang 'dra bar mda' ru bros/nyi shar gyis rang gis me mda' brgyab nas ri dwags bsad pa thengs dang po yin pas sems nang dga' ba 'bum gyis myos te khos thog mar ji ltar byas nas 'jab lugs/ de nas ji ltar byas te gzes tshul dang me mda'i skam pa ga 'dra byas nas gnan tshul yang yang shod kyin me mda' da dung 'brong der gzes te da dung gcig rgyag rgyu byung na ci 'dra ma red snyams/dbang chen gyis nyi shar da dung me mda' rgyag 'dod yod pa shes te kho'i 'dod blo bskong pa'i ched du me mdar rdzas mdel blugs te ‘‘khyod kyis da dung gcig rgyob dang / 'brong de da dung shi mi 'dug pas da res de'i mgo la gzes te rgyob ’’ces bshad/ kho me mda' rgyag 'dod kyi spro ba rab tu 'phel nas rdzas mdel 'phro brlag yin pa'ang brjed de 'brong de'i mgo la gzes te brgyab kyang bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la skam pa gnan skabs lag pa g.yon ma cung 'dar bas mde'u de 'brong dang bar thag cung ring ba'i gad pa gcig gi steng du babs nas 'brong de'i mig ril gnyis la ltogs sla byed mkhan pho rog nag chung gnyis yod pa'i gcig la thebs te bsad/ gcig shos de 'jigs skrag gi dbang gis gad pa'i steng nas 'og tu lhung rjes a slog cig brgyab ste 'phur nas bros song /dbang chen gyis gad mo bgod bzhin du ‘‘shag po khyod la shig rgan de'i rogs pa med na gzes pa'i 'ben la thebs kyi med pa 'dra/ 'brong chen po de la gzes kyang pho rog chung chung la thebs song ’’zer/nyi shar gyis da gin nang du yod skabs mjing pa'i steng nas shig rgan gcig bzung ste me mda'i mchur blugs pa gzhi nas dran te ‘‘ngas de ring srog 128

chags che 'bring chung gsum gyi srog bcad pa red/ 'on kyang me mda' khob gnyis las brgyab med do ’’zhes ku re rtsed/re zhig nas 'brong de rkang lag 'phag tsam 'phag tsam byas rjes mgo bo thur du lhung nas shi song /kho gnyis 'brong ro'i gam du slebs rjes dbang chen gyis 'brong 'bri skam de'i sgal zheng che tshul la bltas pa tsam gyis 'bri skam yin pa shes tshul dang ji ltar tshon po yod tshul bshad/kho gnyis kyis lam seng 'brong gi rnga ma bcad te rwa rtser bskon/ de nas grod pa gshag ste nang khrol phyir 'don skabs 'brong de 'bri skam zhig ga la yin/ de'i grod pa'i nang du be'u gcig kyang 'dug pas dbang chen gyis ‘‘mde'u gnyis kyis srog chags bzhi bsad thub mkhan khyod las a yod ’’ces ku re bshad/nyi shar gyis ‘‘rma ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ ’’zhes ma ṇi 'don bzhin be'u ro de rngon khyi de dag gi mdun du g.yug nas ‘‘khyod kyis de ring 'bri skam dang sbrum nor nor 'dug pas ma gtogs ngas de ring srog chags gsum las gsod rtsis med ’’ces bgad mo dgod/dbang chen gyis 'brong ko bshu bzhin ‘‘'bri skam min yang khyod gnyis la ko gdan yag po zhig byung ba red ’’zer/da ni snga dgong lug lhas kyi nang du lu gu'i 'ba' skad ldir zhing rtsed 'khrab byed pas lung pa chung chung der dpyid kyi dpal yon rgyas/ lung pa'i mda' yi 'khyags ri chen po de nyin re las nyin re chung du phyin nas mthar lung mdo der brlan gsher shin tu che ba'i na thang gi steng du na ning 'khyag pa'i 'og tu gnan pa'i rtswa sngon dang gsar du skyes pa'i rtswa sngon 'dres te dar yug ljang khu gcig gi lhan pa brgyab pa dang mtshungs/129

snga dro dang dgong mo 'o ma skyid kyis 'brong rwa'i a ru khyer nas ma mo'i 'o ma 'jo gi yod pas nyi ma gnyis re'i nang zho thengs re dkrog nas blangs pa'i mar phud las mar ril phug ron gyi sgo nga'i che chung dang mnyam pa gsum bzos te skyes pa gsum por sbyin pa dang de nas mar rdog gcig sbra'i phub dkar gyi steng du sbyar ba dang rdog tsam zhig thab nang du blugs te sbra lha dang thab lha gso gi yod/mar ril byung rim bzhin dbang chen gyis de nas rdog tsam re blangs te lci leb kyi me gong steng du bzhag nas sbra'i nub kyi pha bong gcig gi steng du bzhag ste de'i steng du rtsam skya phran tsam gtor nas dkar sur gtong gi yod/dkar sur gtong ba dang sbrags khos ‘‘swo swo sgo/rgyab ri kha 'dzin can/srung ma myur mgyogs can/dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo swe swo ’’zhes yul gyi rgyab ri'ang gso gi yod/hor zla gsum pa shar te lung pa'i phu mda' yongs ljang mdog gis lhag par mdzes/ bya byi'u yis gsung snyan sgrog bzhin 'phur lding la rtsen/ me tog chung chung sna tshogs kyis chu phran gyi g.yas g.yon ne'u gsing yongs mdzes par rgyan zhing dri bsung phyogs bcur 'thul gyin 'duganam zla nyin re las nyin re dro ru 'gro ba dang gsar skyes rtswa sngon dang tshos mdog 'dra min sna tshogs kyi me tog bzhad de dpyid kyi dpal yon rgyas pa'i dus/ 'bri mo'i ngur ldir dang ma mo'i 'ba' skad kyis mi tshang ma pha yul dran pa'i 'dun pa 'gog thabs med par gyur te de nyin dbang chen dang nyi shar gnyis lung pa'i mda' las don te song /lung pa'i phyi nang gnyis bar ha lam dbyar dgun gyi khyad par 'dug pa ste de phyogs su sgur sgur byas nas btsal mthar gsar skyes rtswa sngon thar thor 130

las me tog gi ming tsam yang mi 'dug thag ring gi ri rab smig sgyu'i khrod du rab rib las mi mngon pa dang ri rab kyi cod pan du bcings pa'i gangs dkar gyi rtse mo rab dkar chu 'dzin gyi phung po dang 'dres te yid mug gi tshor snang dbang med du skyed/ nyi shar gyis sgur sgur byas nas gsar skyes rtswa sngon rkang gcig bcad de sna la snoms bzhin du ‘‘shag po dbang chen/ nga tsho'i ja gar rong de ngo ma ya mtshan can gyi sa cha khyad du 'phags pa zhig rang red/'on kyang nga tsho lung pa de'i phyi nang kho na phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas te bsdad pas phan thogs ci yod/ de bas nga tsho lho ru song na yag gi ma red dam ri’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘red/ ngas kyang de 'dra bsam gyi 'dug nga tsho lung pa de kho na'i nang du bsdad na dgra sha len ga la thub ’’ces bshad zhor du kha phyir bskor nas lho phyogs su rgyang mig gcod kyin dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo'i ri rtse tsam zhig mthong mi yong ngam snyam yang chu 'dzin gyi phung po'i phang ba ru zug pa'i ri tshogs rtse mo grangs las 'das pa mtho dman mi mtshungs pa sor mo'i yal 'dab kyi bang rim bzhin yug gcig tu 'brel ba las gang yang ma mthong yang ja gar rong zhes pa'i sa cha 'di ni yun ring sdod pa'i gnas shig ma red snyam nas kho rang lo na phra ba'i skabs rang gi yab mes dang yul mi tsho dang mnyam du 'grogs te rgyab ri dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mor ri gso bar song ba'i 'das don dum bu zhig dran shes kyi me long ngos su dbang med du 'char ba ste/ de yang kho rang lo bcu gsum la son skabs bro 'tshal nad kyis mnar nas nyal sar lus/ kho rang gi yab dam pa dang mes po tsho sems 'tshab chen po byung yang thag ring lung khug der lha rje sman pa'i ming tsam yang med pas nyin mtshan rtag tu za 'thung bcud che ba dang 'ju sla ba gang legs sbyin te gsol ba smon lam kho na 'debs pa las gzhan gyi thabs shes gang yang ma rnyed/131

'on kyang dbang chen gyi nad gzhi drag skyed yong rgyu lta ci nyin re las nyin re je sdug tu song nas skabs re mjing pa'i 'phar rtsa 'khyug 'khyug tu 'phar ba yis da dung dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad med par shes thub pa las lus kyi mdangs nyam zhing yid kyi tshor ba med par gyur nas lnga pa'i lam du song zin pa dang dbye ba cher ma mchis/ yab mes tsho nyin mtshan ltos med kyis rang rang gi shes pa'i ma ṇi yig drug kho na kha 'don gyis gdong mchi mas brlan zhing blo rdza ri smug po sdug bsngal gyi na bun 'khrigs nas slog pa'i nang du nyal te ngo gdong skya thal du gyur ba'i dbang chen la bltas nas sdod rgyu las bya thabs gzhan ma rnyed/dbang chen ni yab mes tsho'i lce thog gi bdud rtsi dang mgo thog gi cod pan du brtsi gi yod pas gal srid bar chad de las phyir ldog ma thub par rkyen lam du song na kho'i pha mar phru gu de gcig pu las med stabs sdug bsngal bzod bsran mi thub par smyo rgyu las med pas grong rogs tshos kyang gdung sems mnyam skyed kyis kha nas ma ṇi yig drug bar med du 'don gyin mtshan mo re re bzhin dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba snying nas 'debs pa dang zhogs pa re re bzhin shi tshar med dam snyam pa'i blo dogs dang sdug bsngal mnyam 'dres kyis kho tshang du song nas blta bar byed kyi yod/skabs de dus g.yang phyug la mi tshang bdun las med pa de dag lung pa gnyis kyi nang du thar thor gnas/ khyim dud bdun po'i nang nas phal che ba yul phyogs gzhan nas rang byung gi gnod 'tshe dang yul sde'i nang dme sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis yul byol slebs pa yin la sa cha der gnas sdod byas nas lo ring shos la lnga bcu drug cu dang thung shos la lo nyi shu tsam las song med pas yul gyi rgyab ri zer ba med la srung ba zer ba de bas med/grong tsho'i nang gi skye bo tshang mas spyi bo'i gtsug rgyan du gyur ba'i bgres song lu gu grub chen zhes bya ba gcig yod pa des ral pa khyi nag gi ro ltar che ba 132

dag thor cog tu bcings te sngags pa'i tshul 'dzin yang gsang sngags kyi gzhung lugs la sbyang pa nyin gcig kyang byed myong med pas kha nas ma ṇi yig drug las gzhan gyi gzungs sngags tshig gcig kyang mi shes la de bas cho ga sgrub stangs mi shes kyang cha byad sngags pa'i tshul 'dzin pas thabs drag shos ni khong gdan 'dren zhu rgyu red snyam nas lu gu grub chen khyim du gdan drangs te skyabs bcol/ bgres song lu gu grub chen gyis lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas ma ṇi yig drug kha nas bar med du 'don bzhin ‘‘bu dbang chen la stabs mi legs pa'i bar chad mi yong ba shog ri’ces dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs kyin nyin gyis mtshan mthud mtshan gyis nyin mthud de nyin mang po gnyid med par thabs shes ci drag byas kyang bu dbang chen gyi nad gzhi la phan 'bras rta rnga til 'bru tsam yang ma byung /bu dbang chen gyi mig gnyis kyang zim zim du gyur te rdo brgyab pa'i byi'u rmas ma ltar dbugs lhom stem du gtong gin sang shi gnangs shi las gson thub pa'i re ba bral te nang mi dang khyim mtshes kyi mi yongs ngo gdong mchi mas brlan par gyur nas sdod pa'i nyin zhig gi snga dro shar ri'i phag las gsal chen nyi ma 'char ba dang chabs cig shar phyogs nas khur rtsa khur ba'i mi gcig gom pa'i 'degs 'jog ljid po zhig spo bzhin sde ba'i phyogs su yong gi 'dug pas de ni yul 'khyams sprang po zhig yin nges snyam nas do snang byed mkhan ma byung /'on kyang bgres song lu gu grub chen gyis yul 'khyams kyi sprang po zer ba de gang sar 'khyams myong bas mthong rgya dang thos rgya che bas de la thabs shes 'dra med dam snyam nas de'i phyogs su song / gam du slebs dus mi de ni mgo'i ral pa thor cog tu bcings pa/ lag tu kha ṭam thogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'khrul med cig 'dug pas de mar gus phyag lan gsum 'tshal te sde ba'i nang du gdan drangs nas ja phor gang ma blugs gong 'brug grags tshang du khrid nas 133

shi gson bye ma'i la khar nyam thag par gnas pa'i dbang chen la sman dpyad rim 'gro'am thugs smon skyabs 'jug zhus/'brug grags bza' tshang gnyis kyis kha btags gcig gi sner dngul srang kha shas shig btums te rnal 'byor pa der phul nas ‘‘rnal 'byor pa rin po che/ nged gnyis la bu 'di las med pa 'di tshe sngon sdig bsag gang gis ma nyes mi shes par nad 'dis bzung nas da ni zla phyed 'gor song ’’zhes sems nang gi skad cha cha tshang brjod ma thub par mgrin pa brnangs/rnal 'byor pa de'i skya phyed sngo phyed du gyur pa'i ral pa'i thor cog dang kha dog dmar ser dang dmar smug gi gyon pa snum dreg can de dag gang sar rtsab hral du song ba dang / mig byu ru las dmar ba sogs gang thad nas bltas kyang bgres song myong pa can zhig yin par gdon mi za/ khos kha ṭam de gzhogs zhig tu bzhag ste slog pa'i nang du nyal nas yod pa'i dbang chen la blta tsam byas rjes mig dam por btsums nas sgra mi gsal ba'i chos shig 'don gin du langs nas bsdad/ cung zad song rjes mig gdang nas lag gi phreng ba de dbang chen gyi mgo steng du bzhag nas yang mig dam por btsums shing yas mchu dang mas mchu bar med du brdebs pa las tshig 'bru gcig kyang mi gsal ba'i chos shig 'don gyin yun ring 'jim sku ji bzhin langs nas bsdad/ de nas kho rang gi mgul la btags pa'i ga'u de kha phyes te nas 'bru bdun blangs te dbang chen gyi kha ru blugs rjes ga'u de dbang chen gyi spyi gtsug tu 'jog tsam byas/ de nas yang gzan gyi gong ba las sen mo'i sgor rgya tsam zhig dbral te me mdag gi steng du bzhag pa'i du ba dbang chen la bdugs te ‘‘da drag yong / da drag yong ’’zer nas sgor don/ngo ma ya mtshan pa zhig la dbang chen gyi mig cung zad grung du phyin nas phar blta tshur blta byed thub par gyur bas 'brug grags khyo shug zung dad pa'i 134

spu long rab tu rgyas te rnal 'byor pa der phyag yang yang 'tshal/lu gu grub chen gyis rnal 'byor pa de spyir btang min pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig 'dug snyam nas phyag gsum 'tshal rjes kho rang gi nang du bsus te sne len gya nom pa byas te ‘‘khyed yul gang nas phebs pa yin/ da lta gang du phebs mkhan yin ’’zhes dris/rnal 'byor pa des ‘‘nga mdo smad nas yin ri’zhes bshad de ja hub gang btung rjes ‘‘nga ni yul nges med du 'gro ba'i rnal 'byor pa yin/ da res dbus lha sar 'gro ba yin/ khyod dbus lha sar 'gro e myong ’’zer/‘‘'gro ma myong ’’zhes lu gu grub chen gyis ha cang gus pa'i ngang mgo bo g.yug tsam byas/ ‘‘um/ mi lus rin chen thengs gcig thob par dbus lha sar ma slebs na skyo ba la ang ’mizhes mig btsums nas ma ṇi bton gyin bsdad/de nas rnal 'byor pas ras ser po'i nang du bsgril pa'i dpe cha gcig kha phyes te bklags/ dpe cha de rnying drags nas thog ma'i kha dog mi mngon pa dang de'i steng gi yig 'bru yang ha cang mthong dka' bas mtshon byed rang bzhin gyis mdun gyi cog tse'i steng du kha phyes te blta khul byas pa las don du dpe cha de khong gi blo la yod/dpe cha de bklags tshar ba dang ga'u de'i nang nas byin rlabs yin nam yang na bod sman yin mi shes par ril bu mdog dmar smug can gsum bton te ‘‘'di nad pa de'i kha nang du blugs dang ’rizhes ril bu gsum lu gu grub chen gyi lag nang du bzhagalu gu grub chen lam seng 'brug grags tshang du song nas ril bu gsum po phor pa gcig gi nang du chu khol gyis sbangs te dbang chen la ldud/de nas bzung dbang chen gyi nad gzhi zhag khyad nyin khyad kyis drag skyed 135

song bas yul mi kun gyis rnal 'byor par dad pa'i spu long rab tu rgyas te phyag mang po 'tshal nas gnas gzhan du ma phebs par yul g.yang phyug tu bzhugs rogs/ khyed kyi thugs 'dod ci yod nga tshos sgrub rgyu yin zhes zhus kyang rnal 'byor bas ‘‘nga 'dir sdod rgyu med/ nga yul dbus su 'gro dgos/dbus lha ldan zhing du ma slebs na nga'i mi tshe stong zad red ’’ces shod kyin lag zung gi snyim pa brang khar sbyar/yul mi tshos lu gu grub chen gyi sne khrid 'og ma gros gcig mthun gyis ‘‘'o na bla ma khyed rab byung na lo gsum dang / de ltar ma byung na zla gsum/ de ltar ma byung na zhag gsum 'dir bzhugs rogs ’rizhes zhu ba 'then gyin gus phyag 'tshal/rnal 'byor bas snga 'dang phyi 'dang zhig brgyab rjes ‘‘lo gsum zer na khyod tsho ham pa che/ zhag gsum zer na nga ham pa che/ da 'o na nga zla gsum bsdad na 'thus sam ’’zer/tshang mas ‘‘thugs rje che/ thugs rje che ’’zhes gus phyag yang yang 'tshal/lu gu grub chen gyis rang gi bu nyi ma 'bum gyi lag pa nas bzung ste khrid yong nas rnal 'byor par gus phyag yang yang 'tshal te ‘‘rin po che/ da ni bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum khyod la 'bul rgyu yin/ khyod gang du phebs pa'i sar nga yang 'gro rgyu yin/ khyed 'dir bzhugs ring nga la bu gcig rang yod pa 'dir yon tan zhig slob rogs zhu ’’zhes bshad/nyi ma 'bum skabs de dus lo bzhi bcu lhag slebs zin yang bza' zla bu phrugagang yang med par chos kho na bsam mkhan zhig yin yang lung khug der yon tan sbyangs pa'i mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pas chos byed pa'i tshul 'dzin yang kho rang gi pha lu gu grub chen ltar rgyun par chad med 'don pa'i ma ṇi yig drug las ka bong bu tsam yang shes kyi med/136

lu gu grub chen gyi re ba ltar rnal 'byor pa des zla gsum gyi ring nyi ma 'bum la ka mad sum cu mthar phyin par bslabs/de nas zla gcig las ma 'gor bar dbang chen nad gzhi rbad de drag skyed byung bas 'brug grags kyis bu nad kyis mnar ba'i rgyu mtshan dris pa na/rnal 'byor pa des mig btsums nas yun ring bsam blo btang rjes ‘‘khyod tshang gi sdod gnas 'di btsan lam du 'khel 'dug pas nges par du yang na shar dang yang na nub tu spo dgos 'dug rab byung na nub kyi spang ljongs gzhong pa lta bu der spos na yag shos red/ spang ljongs gzhong pa lta bu de ni rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i nor gzhong red ’’zer/'brug grags tshang de ma nyid du grong rogs khyim mtshes kyis rogs pa byas te spang ljongs gzhong pa lta bu der spos/yang rnal 'byor pa des phreng ba de phar bshug tshur bshug 'ga' byas nas ‘‘khyod tsho yul 'dir slebs nas lo mang po de tsam song yang kha 'dzin can gyi rgyab ri yod kyang ma gsos/ rgyab ri de la khyad du 'phags pa'i srung ma myur mgyogs can zhig yod kyang rgyab rten ma bcol pas srung ma khros 'dug pas lo re'i zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin nges par du rgyab ri de gso dgos/lo re'i zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga chad med rgyab ri de gsos na gegs bar chad dang gdon gnod pa tshang ma las rnam par rgyal thub ’’zer/tshang mas rgyab ri kha 'dzin can de gang yin ma shes par ‘‘rin po che rgyab ri kha 'dzin de gang red ’’ces dris/rnal 'byor bas byang nub yod pa'i mchong gi mchod rten 'dra ba la rtse mo gangs gyi cod pan can der mdzub ston byas te ‘‘khyod tsho'i rgyab ri ni pha gi red/de'i ming la dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo zer/ rgyab ri kha 'dzin can der srung ma myur mgyogs can zhig yod pa de'i mtshan la lha dge bsnyen zhes bya ba dred 137

rag dkar la bcibs pa/ phyag mtshan du mdung ring thogs pa zhig yod/'di lta bu'i rgyab ri lta na sdug cing kha 'dzin can dang / de'i srung ma ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa myur mgyogs can bod khams la shin tu dkon pas khyod tsho'i bsod nams kyi mthu las byung ba red ’’ces brjod/rnal 'byor pa de g.yang phyug tu zla gsum bsdad rjes ‘‘da ni nga 'gro rgyu yin/ bgres song nga lta bu nub kha'i nyi ma dang 'dra ba'i mi gcig dus tshod nar 'gyang byas drags na dbus lha ldan zhing gi jo bo rin po che mjal mi thub par lam bar du shi nyen yod mi’ces bshad pa dang dngos su g.yang phyug las bral khar ‘‘khyed tshos 'di nas g.yas skor gyis dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo'i byang shar gyi ngos su slebs rjes/ ri rtse'i gangs ri'i ldebs su srung ma myur mgyogs can de'i mdung ring gis bshag pa'i bgrod lam zhig yod pa de rgyud nas ri rtser song ste dar lcog 'dzugs dgos/ nges par du lo re'i zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin ma brjed par gyis shig ri’ces nan bskul byas/yul mi kun gyis phyag yang yang 'tshal/ rnal 'byor pas khur po rgyab tu khur zhing kha ṭam lag tu bzung nas g.yang phyug las bral te lho phyogs su phebs/lu gu grub chen gyis nyal chas dang rgyags phye nyung ngu zhig khur te pha yul la zhen chags kyi sems pa spu tsam med par rnal 'byor pa de'i rjes su 'brang nas song /nyi ma 'bum gyis kyang rang gi pha bral ba'i skyo sems spu tsam med par ‘‘a pha/ khyed gnyis dbus lha sa'i jo bo'i sku mdun du slebs rjes nga tsho gzhis sdod pa rnams kyi tshab byas te gsol ba smon lam yag po 'debs rogs ’’zhes mngags rjes 'ur rgyang gang tsam gyi sar phebs skyel zhus/nam zla nyin re las nyin re dro ru phyin nas dpyid 'go tshugs te sa phyogs 138

gang sar dpyid rlung ldang zhing 'khyags rom bzhur te rtswa sngon gsar pa skyes/ri lung yongs ljang thing thing du gyur pa dang chu phran gyi 'gram ngogs gang sar me tog dkar dmar ser gsum gyis mdzes par rgyan/ mtshan mo rtag par char pa rgyun chad med par 'bab pa dang / nyin mo nam mkha' sngo la dwangs shing mdzes pa ngo ma rang byung gi khams chen po yang byams dang snying rje'i 'du shes yod pa ltar skye bo'i bsam don mthun pa byung bas g.yang phyug la sngar byung ma myong ba'i dbyar ka zhig shar te ma mo dang ra ma mang por ril lug mtshe ma re skyes/ 'bri thul ma yan chad la 'bri skam gcig kyang med par be'u re skyes/rgod bzhi mo mang po la rkyang gseb dhikyi rgyud pa'i rte'u yid du 'ong ba re skyes/sde ba'i pho gzhon dang mo gzhon mang pos g.yas g.yon gyi sde tsho las mna' ma dang mag pa blangs te de snga'i grong pa bdun las med pa de grong pa bcu gcig tu gyur zhing mi grangs sum cu so lnga nas bzhi bcu zhe lnga bar 'phel rgyas song /khyim grangs dang mi 'bor gyi kha grangs mang du 'gro ba ni mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i ldog med kyi chos nyid cig yin pa dang / rang byung khams kyi 'gyur ldog sna tshogs kyang rang byung khams kyi chos nyid cig yin yang de khul gyi 'brog pas de dag tshang ma ni rnal 'byor pa de'i bka' drin yin zhes lag zung gi snyim pa brang khar sbyar nas dad sems skyed bzhin hor zla bzhi pa de mgyogs tsam slebs na ci ma rung snyam bzhin sgug ste dar lcog dang bsang gra sgrig byed bzhin 'dugadus kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong can de skad cig tsam yang ngal gso mi byed par mdun nas mdun du 'khor nas da gzod hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco lngar slebs/dhi gseb ni rta'i pha phyugs la zer zhing 'dir rkyang gseb ni rgyud rkyang las byas pa'i rta'i pha phyugs la zer/139

nyin de'i zhogs pa ni g.yang phyug sde bar sngar byung ma myong ba'i 'du 'dzi che shos kyi dus shig red/ grong pa so so'i nyin de'i phyugs rdzi phud pa'i byings rnams yongs/ sngar zhogs pa ngo gdong dang lag pa mi bkru ba'i goms gshis kyi 'ching rgya gtor nas tshang mas ngo gdong dang lag pa gtsang mar bkrus pa dang / gyon pa gang legs rgyan te gzab mchor spras nas smra mi shes pa'i dga' spro rab tu 'phel bzhin shar skya rengs skya mda' ma btang gong zhogs ja btung ste snga sa nas gra sgrig byas pa'i dar lcog phrag pa'i steng du bzhagabasang khug lag par khyer te rgyab ri kha 'dzin can de gso bar song /khong tshos rnal 'byor pa des gsungs pa ltar skor ba g.yas bskor gyis song nas thog mar mchod rten gyi bang rim lta bu'i spang ri chen po zhig gi skas rim steng du slebs/ der sa khod snyom la spang rtswa shin tu stug pa/ dwangs zhing gtsang ba'i chu phran mang po thur du 'bab pa/ chu 'gram g.yas g.yon du 'jib ru dkar mar khra chil chil du bzhad pa/ lha bya gong mo'i gsung snyan lhang lhang du grags pa ha cang nyams dga' ba zhig 'dug de yi steng du spang ri de las cung chung ba'i rdza ri gcig 'dug pa der dung dkar g.yas 'khyil lta bu'i rdza lam bgrod bde ba zhig 'dug pa de rgyud nas song bas skor ba gsum thog nas rdza ri'i steng du slebs/ de yang gsham gyi spang ri de dang mtshungs par sa khod snyom zhing rdza gseb las rdza chu shang shang du rgyug pa/ nag sag thal mgo dang brag byi'u khra mo sogs bya byi'u 'phur lding rtsen pa rang byung skyed tshal lta bu de'i steng du bong gzugs rdza ri las chung ba'i gangs ri de phye mar spungs pa ltar skya tsog ger gangs rtse las nyi ma'i ldog 'od 'phro bzhin gnas 'dugadage bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo zhes bya ba'i ri de'i rtsa ba nas rtse mo'i bar gyi chags tshul ni mchod rten gyi bang rim ltar spang ri'i steng du rdza ri dang rdza ri'i 140

steng du gangs rim pa ltar che ba'i steng du chung ba maṇ+ḍal gyi dbyibs dang mtshungs pa zhig 'dug pas 'jig rten byed pos ma bskrun ci yang med ces pa ni cis ma bden/ri de'i chags tshul ha cang thun mong ma yin pa des g.yang phyug gi skye bo tsho'i yid dbang 'phrog nas dad sems dbang med du shor nas gus phyag yang yang 'tshal/de nas yang skor ba g.yas bskor gyis song nas gangs ri'i byang shar gyi ngos su slebs mtshams ngo ma rnal 'byor pa des gsungs pa ltar gangs ri'i gsham nas rtse mo'i bar rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i rdo skas kyi lam 'drong po zhig 'dug g.yas g.yon du lo ngo khri phrag mang po bsags pa'i gangs gsog dang 'khyags rom ha cang mthug pa'i dkyil gyi rdo skas las 'dzegs nas gangs ri'i rtse mor slebs/ gangs ri'i rtse mo de rgyang nas blta skabs mdung gi rtse mo ltar phra yang don du gangs ri'i rtse mor rgya khyon 'brog pa'i lhas ra chung chung tsam gyi mtshe'u dwangs shing gtsang pa dbyibs sgor mo bco lnga'i dung zla la co 'dri ba zhig 'dugadabyibs maṇ+ḍal ltar ngo mtshar shin tu che ba/ gang sar rang byung gi skyed tshal ltar mdzes ljongs lta na sdug pa'i ri bo de'i khyad du 'phags pa'i yon tan gyis skye bo tshang ma'i yid kyi brtan pa cig car tu 'phrog nas re zhig mi tshang ma steng phyogs lha yul zhes pa 'di min nam/ dbus kyi ri rgyal lhun po zhes pa 'di min nam zhes lab gleng sna tshogs byed kyin mdzes ljongs la myong rol gyi dbyings zhugs/der yod mi rnams kyis da lta shod bzhin pa'i skad cha de dag gis nyi ma 'bum la bsam pa'i 'char sgo phun sum tshogs pa zhig sbyin byung bas khos ‘‘e ma 'di 'dra'i ngo mtshar che ba la/ nga tsho'i rgyab ri kha 'dzin can lha dge 141

bsnyen gyi chags tshul ni ngo ma srid gsum 'gran zla med pa zhig red/ rtse mo gangs dkar gyi cod pan la rgya mtsho (mtshe'u ) sngo mer re yod pa 'di steng phyogs lha yi mtshon byed red/ de 'og rdza ri mchong gi mdog dang 'dra ba de bar phyogs gnyen gyi mtshon byed red/ de 'og spang ri g.yu ltar sngo ba la rtsi tog gi gur khang phub pa de 'og phyogs mi yul gyi mtshon byed red ’’ces kho rang gi klad pa'i nang du yod pa'i tshig snyan pa yod tshad bkol te kha sngon rnal 'byor pa des dpe cha klog skabs thos pa'i lha yul dang gnyan yul mi yul gsum yid la shar te de ltar bshad/de nas mi tshang mas mtshe'u yi chu lag g.yas pa'i srin mdzub kyis mchod pa dang kha la btung ste spyi bor byug pa sogs byas rjes mtshe'u yi 'gram gang sar dar shing btsugs te tshon mdog sna lnga'i dar lcog btsugs pa dang /dar shing phreng ba rgyus pa ltar dar gdang gis 'brel ba byas nas mis bzos rdzing bu lta bu'i dwangs gsal gyi mtshe'u chung chung de'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad sngo/ ser/ dkar/ dmar/ ljang lnga'i tshos mdog las grub pa'i dar lcog gis mdzes par rgyan rjes de'i nye 'khor gang sar bsang btang ste bsang dud kyis nam mkha'i bya lam yang dog par byas nas mi tshang mas rtsam skya sbar mo gang re bzung ste mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis/bso bso bso/rgyab ri kha 'dzin can/srung ma myur mgyogs can/ki bso bso/g.yas kyi stag la khra mo swo lo/g.yon gyi gzig la khra mo sro lo/phar 'gro skyabs kyi skyel ma/142

tshur yong skyabs kyi bsu ma/rta pho 'dra 'dra'i nang la/lag srab mda' gang gis mgyogs par shogami bo 'dra 'dra'i nang la/mgo rmog dkar gang gis mtho bar shogaki bso bso/zhes 'brug stong dus gcig tu ldir ba lta bu'i lha 'bod glu gyer byas te sbar mo'i nang gi rtsam skya dgung la gtor nas ri gso'i cho ga yongs su grub/rgyun par ri mthon po de 'dra'i steng du 'gro ba ha cang nyung nyung yin pa dang / mi 'ga' shas de las dma' ba'i rdza ri dang / spang ri/ brag ri sogs kyi steng du slebs dus tshabs che chung 'dra min gyi rdza dug phog nas mgo bo na ba dachong mgo yu 'khor ba/ zhe mer langs pa/ skyug pa shor ba'i gnas tshul yong gi yod kyang de ring ri mthon po de 'dra'i steng du slebs kyang tshang ma rdza dug phog rgyu lta ci lus khams sngar bas bde ba'i tshor snang byung /skabs der/ kha sngon rnal 'byor pa des kho la bshad myong ba yin nam yang na kho rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig par brten nas gsar rtsom byas pa yin mi shes mod a khu nyi ma 'bum gyis 'dren byed zim bu'i sgo nas phyogs bzhir blta bzhin du ‘‘'di nas smad rgya nag gi ri bo rtse lnga dang stod rgya gar gyi bya rgod phung po'i ri yang mthong thub ’’ces brjod/gal srid tshan rig gi rgyun shes phran tsam shes mkhan zhig yin na kho'i lag tu srid na 'gran zla bral ba'i rgyang mthong che shel ji 'dra zhig yod kyang sa bzhi ni dbyibs ril lhang bu lta bu zhig yin pas rgyang mthong che shel de'i 'then shugs ga tshod che yang stod rgya gar gyi bya rgod phung po'i ri dang smad rgya nag gi ri bo rtse lnga mthong mi thub ces kha tshon gcod rgyur gor ma chag kyang 'jig rten 143

chos nyid thams cad dkon mchog gis bzos pa dang / sa gzhi 'di dbyibs leb mor ngos 'dzin zhing bar snang stong pa thogs reg bkag gsum med pa de sa gzhi'i thog khebs la ngos 'dzin byed mkhan sa mtha'i 'brog pa de tshos mig gi dga' ston de da lta rang longs su spyod rgyu byung na ci ma rung snyam nas phyogs bzhir rgyang mig gcod kyin bya rgod phung po'i ri dang ri bo rtse lnga btsal/mi 'ga' shas kyis ‘‘a khu nyi ma 'bum/ stod rgya gar gyi bya rgod phung po'i ri dang smad rgya nag gi ri bo rtse lnga zhes pa de gnyis kyi dbyibs ga 'dra zhig yod ’rices dris/nyi ma 'bum gyis sma ra byil tsam byil tsam byas te ‘‘khyed tshos ltos dang stod rgya gar gyi bya rgod phung po'i ri zhes pa de'i dbyibs 'di 'dra zhig yod ’’ces sked pa sgur zhing lag pa gnyis ther ther byas nas bya rgod kyi bzo ston pa dang / yang de nas sor mo'i yal 'dab lnga cung zad rub par byas te ‘‘smad rgya nag gi ri bo rtse lnga de 'di 'dra ba zhig yod mi’ces bshad/der yod mi tshang ma ha las hang sang nas a khu nyi ma 'bum lta bu'i yon tan can bod khams la e yod snyam nas la las ‘‘mkhas pas shes kyang mi shes khul/ blun pos ma shes shes pa'i khul zhes pa cis mi bden/ a khu khyed kyis rgyun par gang yang mi shes pa'i tshul kho na 'dzin yang don du mkhyen rgya chen po 'di 'dra 'dug ’zer/laglus ‘‘a khu nyi ma 'bum gyi klad pa spyang pa la ang / rnal 'byor bka' drin can de'i drung du zhag ma dgu bcu bsdad pa tsam gyis bod yig shes pas mi tshad (don du ka mad sum cu las mi shes/) stod rgya gar dang smad rgya nag gi chags tshul yang shes 'dug ’’ces bstod ra gtong gin ‘‘bla ma mdun du bzhugs kyang ngos ma zin par byin rlabs gzhan las slong mkhan nga tsho ni 144

dud 'gro rang red mi’ces bshad nas nyin de nas bzung nyi ma 'bum g.yang phyug sde ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gtsug gi nor bur gyur to/nye 'gyang gi ri tshogs rnams sngo mdangs bkra bzhin mtho dman gyi 'gran rtsod byed pa ltar smig sgyu'i khrod du rba rlabs kyi bang rim ltar g.yo 'gul byed pa dang kha ba'i rdul brtsegs kyi lhun po'i mu khyud dag grangs 'das khrung khrung gis lag gdang sbrel nas gar stabs ling ling bsgyur ba ltar smig sgyu'i khrod du g.yo 'gul shig shig byed kyin 'dug pas dge bsnyen lhun po'i rtse nas mi yul gyi dpyid kyi dpal yon ci yang mthong gi 'dugadabang chen gyi byis blo'i rang shed kyis a khu nyi ma 'bum gyi gos gsham 'then te ‘‘a khu nyi ma 'bum/ ga gi stod rgya gar gyi bya rgod phung po'i ri zer ba de red/ ga gi smad rgya nag gi ri bo rtse lnga zer ba de red/ nga la ston dang ri’zhes rtogs 'dod kyi blo skyed de dris pa na a khu nyi ma 'bum gyis ‘‘stod smad kyi yul 'di nas bar thag 'gyang drags pas chu bur mig gis mthong mi thub ’’zer/ chu bur gyi mig ces pa de'i don ma rtogs par ‘‘a khu nyi ma 'bum/ chu bur gyi mig yin nam de gang red ’ces dris/ ‘‘um ’’zhes nyi ma 'bum gyis mno bsam gtong bzhin dbang chen gyi mgo'i ral pa srug shig shig der byil tsam byas nas ‘‘rgod thang dkar min gyi srog chags yongs kyi mig de chu bur gyi mig red/ khyod kyis ltos dang mthong gi 'dug gam ’’zhes lho phyogs thag ring gi ri gseb cig tu da dung bzhu ma thub pa'i chu mig gi 'khyags spungs gcig la mdzub mo gtad de ston/dbang chen gyis ‘‘mthong gi 'dug de mi mthong mkhan su yod ’’zer/nyi ma 'bum gyis ‘‘red red/ de nga tsho tshang mas mthong thub/ 'on kyang ri pha gi'i ldebs su sha rdog gcig yod na nga tshos mthong thub kyi ma red/145

rgod thang dkar yin na chu mig gi 'khyags spungs de mthong mi thub kyang der sha rdog gcig yod na mthong thub ’’ces bshad/dbang chen gyi pha 'brug grags kyis ‘‘tag tag red/ de 'dra sgrung gtam zhig kyang yod ang ’ zer/dbang chen gyis gtsos pa'i byis pa mang po zhig gis sgrung de nyan 'dod skyed de ‘‘sgrung de shod dang nga tsho nyan 'dod 'dug shod dang shod dang ’’zhes 'ur rgyag gin lu gu 'khrab 'khrab byas/'brug grags kyis ‘‘ya ya/ ngas khyod tshor bshad chog khyod tshos yag po nyon ang ’’zhes der yod byis pa tshang ma mdun du bsdus nas ‘‘yag po nyon ang ’’zhes sgrung bshad par/‘‘gna' snga mo bya thang dkar gcig dang pho rog nag chung gcig nam 'phangs bcad de mar sa ngos su bltas te rang gis mthong pa'i dngos po len par 'gro rgyu gros 'cham/ bya thang dkar gyis stod rgya gar yul gyi sa cha zhig tu drel mo gcig shi ba'i ro mthong / pho rog nag chung des bod yul gyi sa na 'o ma zo ba gang dang mar rdog gcig mthong / de nas kho gnyis rang rang gi mthong ba'i dngos po'i phyogs su song bas na/ bya thang dkar gyis mthong ba ni ngo ma drel mo gcig gi ro red/ 'on kyang pho rog nag chung gis mthong ba'i 'o ma zo ba gang de ni gnam mtsho phyug mo yin pa dang / mar rdog de ni gnyan chen thang la red/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni thang dkar gyi mig de sha mig dang / pho rog gi mig de chu bur gyi mig yin pas red ’’ces bshad/de'i skabs bgres song smon lam thar gyis lho phyogs ri rab kyi phreng ba'i khrod las gzengs su thon pa'i gangs ri phye mar spungs pa dang mtshungs pa zhig la 'khar rgyug gtad de ‘‘ltos dang / ngo ma chu bur gyi mig ces pa cis mi bden/ ngas kyang thag ring gi sa cha nas gangs ri skya tsog cig mthong gi 146

'dug ’mizer/tshang mas nyi 'od lag pas bkag gin de phyogs su bltas/a khu nyi ma 'bum gyis ‘‘gangs ri de ngas shes kyi 'dug de ni bsam gtan gang ba bzang po red/ kha rgyun du bsam gtan gang bzang dgo bo mgo/ sa ga nas bltas kyang dgo bo mgo zer gyi yod ’’ces bshad/khong tsho sa bltas ri bltas kyi 'dod blo yongs su tshims nas da gzod rgan skyor byis khrid kyis rdo skas las babs te song nas bang rim 'og ma spang ljongs nyams dga' ba der slebs nas rang gi rgyab tu khur ba'i sgye mo las sha dang / thud/ mar gzan bcas blangs te ngal gsos te za 'thung la rol bzhin gtam gleng sna tshogs kyis dus 'da' bar byas/‘‘kwa kwa ’’zhes pho rog nag chung gnyis klad nas 'phur te brag dmar gcan gzan gyi mche ba dang gnyis su med pa zhig gi ldebs su babs pas da gzod dbang chen gzhi nas rjes dran gyi rgya rnyi las thar te dbugs ring zhig kyang shor/nyi shar gyis ‘‘ci zhig bsam blo gtong gi yod/ nag mo dran pa ma red dam/ nag mo dran gyi 'dug na do dgong nga'i nag mo ’’dbang chen gyis ‘‘hwa hwa ri’zhes u tshugs kyi gad mo bgod de nyi shar gyi tshig mtshams bcad nas ‘‘nga tsho da dung zla gcig tsam ngang sgug ma byas na 'di phyogs ni da dung dgun kha dang khyad zhe drag mi 'dug pas lu gu 'khyag shi thebs mi yong ngam ’’zhes bshad/nyi shar gyis ‘‘de rang red/ ngas bltas na nga tsho 'di nas ru spos rjes gtso bo lho phyogs su 'gro rgyu de yag shos red bsam gyi 'dug ’’zer/yang de nas ‘‘g.yang phyug tu log thub a yong ’’zhes bshad/dbang chen gyis ‘‘nga tsho lam seng g.yang phyug la log thabs med/147

btsan rgod kha shos nga gnyis pha bu bros phyin pa shes pas ga dus yin yang gsod rgyu'i gra sgrig byas nas yod pas thabs shes nges can zhig med par skyag pa yin par shes bzhin du mdzub mo btsugs na 'grig gi ma red ’’ces bshad/nyi shar gyis ‘‘ngas bltas na nga tsho 'di nas ru spos rjes shag po khyod g.yang phyug tu gnas tshul rtogs par phyin na ga 'dra 'dug da lta nga tshor rta ṭ+wāṃ tram̐/da/ btsan rgod ces pa de las rgyu 'bras 'khor rgyu med pa zhig a yin ’’dbang chen gyis mgo bo lcog lcog byed kyin mno bsam btang /ja gar rong nas sa phyogs gzhan du ru ba spo rgyu zla gcig tsam las med stabs deng skabs 'o ma skyid kyis khom pa cung zad byung ba dang nas bsngos te rtsam pa 'thag gi yod/ mos lag g.yas pas mchig yu nas bzung ste bskor dus mchig gi ya khod dang ma khod 'byar ba'i mtshams nas dgun dus kyi kha ba bu yug 'tshab pa ltar rtsam pa skya chil chil du 'bab nas mchig gi mtha' 'khor ༷༷dro shājerdo'ajug /ce) ——— )sgo ༷(1 /chenadu rtsam pa' gangs —'a mu khyud ga mtho ru ma ru 'a— ba dang / ma ga bskor ba'i sgra ‘‘sir/ sir/ ’zhes grags kyi 'duga'o ma skyid kyis slog pa'i phu dung gnyis ka phud de mchig bskor dus brang skyes myos bum zung yang 'phag tsam 'phag tsam byed pa mthong bas dgra 'dul gyi sems su brjod mi shes pa'i ngo tsha dang dus mnyam de phyogs su lkog blta byed 'dod pa'i blo zhig ngo tsha'i sems pa las rnam par rgyas te mig zur gyis yang yang bltas/'o ma skyid kyis da dung snang dogs med par blo rtse gcig sgrim gyis rtsam pa 'thag gin 'dugade nyin dbang chen dang nyi shar gnyis kyis ‘‘de ring wa dang sbre 'dra thug na gsod dgos mi’zhes shod kyin me mda' khur zhing rngon khyi lnga po khrid de nor 148

lug gi phyogs su song /dgra 'dul pags gdan steng du bsdad de ja btung / de'i skabs 'o ma skyid kyis yos sgye mo gang brngos te rtsam pa 'thag 'go brtsam/ da gzod mo'i phu dung gnyis ka gyon te rtsam pa 'thag gin ‘‘a la la mo la la red/ tha la la mo la la red ’’ces skad dma' bo'i sgo nas glu chung gtong gi 'dug la/yang skabs re 'khris su bzhag pa'i yos blugs pa'i sgye mo'i nang nas yos sbar mo gang re blangs te gcig re gnyis re byas te kha nang du blugs/yud tsam song rjes 'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘a ru/ de 'dra'i tsha gdug che ba la ’’zhes bshad de lag g.yas pa'i phu dung phud nas sngar bzhin rtsam pa 'thag gin bsdad/dgra 'dul gyis yun ring 'bud ma myong ba'i gung zi de btsal te de'i steng du chags pa'i thal rdul gtsang mar phyis nas 'dod glu'i dbyangs snyan po zhig btang /'o ma skyid hob ste kha tshur phyogs nas ‘‘dgra 'dul/ de ci red/ nga la ston tsam byos dang ’’zer/ skabs de dus mos phu dung gnyis ka phud de 'bur du don pa'i brang skyes gnyis kyi rtse ru'ang rtsam skya 'gos nas 'dugadagra 'dul gyis ‘‘'di gung zi red/ khyod kyis gung zi'ang rig ma myong pa red dam/ 'di'i nang nas gzhas gtong thub la skad cha'ang shod thub ’rizer/‘‘a tsi/ ngas 'bud tsam byas na chog gam ’zhes gung zi cha tshang kha nang du bcug ste 'bud khul byas pas sgra ci yang ma don/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘ma red ma red/ de 'dra ma red ’’zer/'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘'o na ga 'dra red ’’ces gung zi de kha nang nas bton dus cha tshang brlan par gyur zhing / de'i steng du da dung da res mos yos 149

bzas pa'i ldad lud kyang 'gos 'dug pas dgra 'dul skyug bro nas ‘‘brlan par 'gyur na 'bud rgyu med/ ngas tog tsam phyi logs su skam chog ririces kha g.yar te phyi ru phyin nas gtsang mar phyis/ a pha dang a khu nyi shar gnyis gang du yod snyam nas rgyang blta byed dus kho gnyis lug khyu'i 'gram du 'gro bzhin 'dugadagra 'dul gyis gung zi de kha'i yal 'dab dang mas 'dab gnyis kyi bar du bzhag nas gtong tsam byas nas ‘‘'di 'dra byas nas gtong dgos ’’zer/‘‘da ngas gtong shes song ’mizhes 'o ma skyid kyis dgra 'dul gyi kha'i yal 'dab kyi bar nas gung zi de tshur 'then pa dang dgra 'dul gyis mos yang brlan par bzos pas mi tshad ldad lud byug gi red bsam nas lam seng yas so dang mas sos gung zi de bcangs pas gung zi de dum bu gnyis su gyur nas phyed ka da dung dgra 'dul gyi kha nang du yod pa dang / phyed ka 'o ma skyid kyi lag tu bzung nas 'dug mo phangs sems skyed de ‘‘khyod kyis sos bcangs nas ci byed/ ltos dang / da chag nas dum bu gnyis su gyur song ’’zer/dgra 'dul gyis chag pa'i phyed ka lag nang du bzhag nas ‘‘ngas 'bud stangs yag po zhig slob bsam yang / khyod kyis 'phrog pas byas pa red ’’ces 'o ma skyid kyi lag par bzung pa'i phyed ka de tshur blangs nas dum bur gyur pa'i sne gnyis sbyar tsam byas nas ‘‘da 'bud rgyu yod ma red ’’ces gung zi chag krum de me nang du 'phangs/'o ma skyid kyi ngo gdong las phangs sems dang / 'gyod pa'i rnam 'gyur ston bzhin ‘‘a tsi/ ngas ma 'phrog na ci 'dra ma red ’’ces mdzub mos sa la ri mo 'bri bzhin bsdad/ dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘de chag par phangs rgyu ci yod ’’ces bshad zhor du rang 150

gi mdun du tsog nas bsdad pa'i 'o ma skyid kyi nu ma'i steng du mdzub mo zhig btsugs te ‘‘bye ri de'i steng du 'brong rgan gcig 'gro bzhin 'dug ’’zer/mos de mar mgo bo gug ste bltas pas na nu ma'i steng du shig rgan nag ril gcig 'gro bzhin 'dug pas cung zad ngo tsha bar gyur nas ‘‘'brong red na sod cig ’’ces shig rgan de blangs nas dgra 'dul gyi mdun du bzhag pa'i rdo yi cog tse nar mo snum dreg gis zin nas thog ma'i kha dog mi mngon pa de'i steng du bzhag ste rtsam pa 'thag par song /‘‘dgra 'dul khyod a pha yin/ nga a ma yin/ ngas rtsam pa 'thag ’’ces dbang skyid kyis rdo leb sgor mo gcig gi steng du bye ma spung pa de'i steng du yang rdo leb sgor sgor gcig bzhag nas yang yang brdar rjes ‘‘a pha khyod spags zo dang mimizhes rdo leb gcig gi steng du bye ma spungs te dgra 'dul la sprad/khos ‘‘spags bzas rjes ’’rdo dkar po pho rog gi che chung tsam zhig gi sne gcig 'ur rdos bsdam nas ‘‘lug bshas/’’dbang skyid kyis khor rogasbu pa byas te rgyu ma dang grod pa'i nang gi btso bkrus rjes rgyu ma rgyangs te btsos nas ‘‘bzas/mi’ de nas gnyis ka sked rags bkrol te mnyam du nyal/ tog tsam song rjes dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘a a a ’’zhes phru gu ngu khul byas/ dbang skyid kyis lam seng rdo gcig spang du bzung nas phru gur 'o ma bster khul gyis brang du sbyar nas ‘‘ma ngu ma ngu a ma'i bu ’’zhes g.yug g.yug byas/ dbang skyid kyi brang steng las 'bur du ma don pa'i nu ma des kho la thun mong ma yin pa'i tshor snang gang yang ma sbyin/de dus kho gnyis lo brgyad red/de rjes kho gnyis nar son te gnyis ka lo bcu bzhi'i skabs mnyam du rdzi bor 'gro gi yod kyang sngon ma lta bu'i rtsed mo rtsed myong med la sngon ma lta bu'i dwangs gtsang gi byis blo dgun rtswa rlung gis khyer ba ltar med par gyur te de 151

snga'i 'brel ba de dus rim gsar pa zhig tu slebs nas gcig ngo gcig gis lta mi bzod pa dang / phan tshun ma 'phrad tshe 'phrad 'dod kyi blo skyed pa dang 'phrad tshe ga shod 'di shod med par bcos min gyi ngo tsha'i yol ras kyi srubs las phan tshun 'dren byed kyi lkog mda' 'phen res byed kyi yod/g.yang phyug gi bu dang bu mo ga 'dra zhig yin rung gnyen sgrig gi lo tshad zin na nges par du yul sde gzhan gyi khyim tshang dang gnyen 'brel 'dzugs pa las/ rang sde'i nang gnyen 'brel 'dzugs mi rung pa'i srol zhig yod kyang kho gnyis kyis ga la rtogs/ gang lags zhe na/ kho gnyis nar son te gnyis ka lo bcu bzhir slebs kyang da dung byis pa'i gras las mi rgan gyi gras su 'jog rin med pas red/nyin zhig dgra 'dul gyis rang khyim gyi nor khyu ded de spang ri gcig gi steng du bkram/ dbang skyid kyi lug khyu yang dal gyis rgyu ba'i chu 'dzin gyi phung po zhig dang 'dra bar kho'i nor khyu'i phyogs su ded byung /dgra 'dul gyi bsam par de ring mo ma mthong ba byas nas lkog blta blo yid tshims pa zhig byed dgos snyam nas 'jab ste mdun gyi brag tshom chen po zhig gi dkyil du 'dzul nas gab ste dbang skyid yong rgyur sgugadabang skyid kyis bal 'khel bzhin dal bu'i sgo nas spang ljongs su slebs te pha bong rdog tsam gcig gi steng du tsog nas sngar bzhin bal 'khel bzhin bsdad/khos mig hrig hrig gis blta dus/ mo'i mgo skyes kyi lan bu phra la ring ba de dag gi steng du g.yu dang byu ru'i rgyan gyis mdzes par byas shing / ngo gdong de sngon ma dang mi 'dra bar dkar la mkhur tshos dmar mdangs bkra ba dang / smin ma bde la mig 'bras dkar nag gsal ba/ 'gram pa g.yas g.yon gyi mdzes kong zung lhag par mngon gsal dod pa/ mchu 'dab srab 152

la bzo bde ba/ mo'i ngo gdong de lta bu'i mdzes ma yin pa de ring ma gtogs ma shes/dbyar gzhung gi nyi ma'i tsha gdug gis rdzi bo'i lus yongs rngul chus brlan par bzos shing / skom pa'i gdung pa'ang bster/ dbang skyid yar langs te phar blta tshur blta 'ga' byas rjes chu phran zhig gi 'gram du song nas ngo gdong kho'i phyogs su gtad de slog pa'i phu dung gnyis ka phud cing mdun du mdud pa brgyab nas chu khyor pa gang bcus te ngo gdong gtsang mar bkrus shing spyi gtsug tu'ang chu gtor/ mo'i dkar la mdzes pa'i brang steng nas 'bur du thon pa'i 'o 'dzin chung chung gnyis lhag par mngon gsal dod pas kho an tsam ma gtogs skad shor grabs byas/ khos lag pas kha bkab ste mig hrig ger dbang skyid kyi brang steng du bltas nas bsdad/ mos ngo gdong bkrus rjes yid tshims pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis ngo gdong gnam la gtad de ‘‘a da ’zhes dbugs ring zhig btang / de nas mgrin pa gzhu ltar gug nas rang gi myos bum zung la myong rol byas shing mdzub mos btsir tsam 'ga' byas/kho'i sems su sngon ma byis pa'i skabs yid dbang 'phrog mi nus pa'i brang steng gi nag thig de gnyis las da lta yid dbang 'phrog pa'i brang skyes 'bur du don don ci yin nam/ da mo dman shar ma'i gras su tshud pa yin gyi red snyam nas rang dbang med par lus kyi cha shas 'ga' re rengs por gyur yang dbang skyid kyi phyogs su 'gro ba'i spobs pa med par sngar bzhin 'gul skyod kyi dbang rtsa nyams pa ltar sngar bas lhag pa'i ltad mo zhig mthong rgyu'i re ba bcangs te bltas nas bsdad/dbang skyid chu 'gram du gog nas nyin bcu grangs chu 'thung rgyu ma rnyed pa'i sha ba yu mo ltar chu btung /'jib ru dkar dmar ser gsum dang / dril shad/ tig ta/ a 153

gar do gar/ hong len sngon mo sogs skyed mos tshal gyi me tog gi ra ba ltar me tog khra chil chil du bzhad pa'i chu phran gyi 'gram du mdzes ma zhig gi gzugs po'i phyed ka 'dzems bag med par bton te ngo gdong bkru ba dang chu 'thung pa'i tshul ni 'jig rten na gnyis su ma grags pa'i mig gi longs spyod cig red/ de'i skabs mo'i dkar la zlum pa'i brang skyes zung gi phyed ka dwangs shing gtsang ba'i chu phran gyi nang du zug chu btung zin nas yar tsog tsog byed dus brang skyes zung gi steng du me tog gi 'dab ma ser po re 'byar 'dug pa ni ngo ma lkog gyur gyi bsam pa'i 'char sgo phyug pa'i ri mo mkhas can gyis bris pa'i lha mo dang gnyis su ma mchis/de'i skabs dgra 'dul gyi sems su dbang skyid kyi lus kyi cha shas de da lta rang longs su spyod rgyu byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i 'dod sred kyi gdung bas mnar te kha lce tshang ma skam por gyur yang / de phyogs su 'gro ba'i spobs pa dang bral te sngar las lhag pa'i ltad mo zhig mthong rgyu'i re ba bcangs shing /ri dwags rngon mkhan gyis rtsa che'i ri dwags shig la me mda' gzes pa ltar/mig gi longs spyod de 'drogs dogs kyis lus kyi ba spu tsam yang 'gul ma nus par gab bsdad/ 'on kyang dbang skyid kyi phu dung gnyis ka gyon pa dang /da res chu 'thung skabs mdun du lhung pa'i mgo skyes lan bu rgyab tu g.yug nas lug khyu'i phyogs su bud song bas kho rang me mda'i skam pa gnan ma thub gong ri dwags 'drogs te yid pham pa'i rngon pa ltar mgrin pa gzengs su btegs te rgyang ring du song ba'i dbang skyid la bltas nas kha ru mdzub mo btsugs te bsdad/‘‘dgra 'dul ja 'thung /’’'o ma skyid kyi skad cha des kho rjes dran gyi 'ob dong las thar te mgo yar 154
