btegs te blta dus 'o ma skyid kyi brang skyes ni dbang skyid kyi brang skyes las zhe drag gis che ba dang cung zad thur du lhung 'dug pa de'i steng du rtsam phye 'gos te bye ma'i de'u 'bur zhig gi steng du ba mo srab po zhig babs pa dang 'dra/khos ja phor tshur blangs te hub gang gis gtsang mar btung ste 'o ma skyid kyi lag tu bzhaga'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘khyod ci zhig la bsam blo gtong gi yod ’’ces dris byung /dgra 'dul ngo gdong dmar por 'gyur nas ‘‘nga nga ci ngas bsam blo gang yang gtong gi med/ khyod kyis ci zer ba yin ’’zer/'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘hi hi mi’zhes hab cha shor ba dang sbrags ‘‘ngo gdong dmar por gyur don ci red mirices bshad zhor du kho'i 'gram par byil tsam byas pas kho'i 'gram pa'i steng du rtsam pa'i ‘‘phyag rjes ’’gsal po zhig bzhagarngon khyi tshang ma lce bsnar te sgo 'gram du slebs pa dang mda' mo nag rkang sgo las yar 'dzul te thab 'gram gang sar snom bzhin phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas pa dang / thab 'gram du spungs pa'i lci ba'i khrod nas rus gog gcig rnyed pa de kha ru bzung nas sgor don song /da gzod dbang chen dang nyi shar gnyis log slebs pa red snyam nas de mar 'o ma skyid mchig gi 'khris su song nas rtsam pa 'thag gin bsdad/dgra 'dul rtab rtab por yar langs te sgor don nas blta dusani dbang chen dang nyi shar gnyis da dung lug khyu'i 'gram du bsdad nas 'dug dgra 'dul thad kar pha dbang chen dang a khu nyi shar gnyis kyi sar bud song /rngon khyi lnga po'ang gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis dgra 'dul gyi rjes su 'brangs pa ni lhag bsam zol med kyi 'thab 'dzing pa lnga ru dpon gyi rjes su 'brangs pa dang gnyis su ma mchis/dbang chen dang nyi shar gnyis kyis sbre lpags gcig sar skam nas slad 155

phyin sa phyogs gang du phyin nas bya thabs gang zhig rgyud de dbang chen gyi bza' zla g.yang mo tshur khrid thabs dang btsan rgod kha sho'i dgra sha ji ltar len rgyu'i skor lab kyin bsdad 'dugadagra 'dul der slebs nas ‘‘khyod gnyis kyis sbre gcig bsad 'dug ’’zer nas sbre lpags lag tu blangs nas ‘‘spu gra yag po 'dug ’’zer/rngon khyi lnga pos da res bzas 'phror lhag pa'i sbre sha cung zad yod pa de dag la hab thob rgyag gin 'ded res 'phrog res kyi rtsed mo rtse gi 'duganyi shar gyis snang med kyi sgo nas sbre lpags kyi spu grar lag pas byil tsam byil tsam byas nas ‘‘sbre lpags kyi slog pa zhig bzo gi yin na drod chen po med dam ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘sbre lpags kyi slog pa la sbre tshag zer/ de drod che la yang po yod/ da dung de'i gong ba dang mtha' gsham wa lpags yod na ngo ma gzab mchor ang gnyis pa yin gyi red ’’zer/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘'o na gzab mchor ang dang po de gang red ’mices dris/dbang chen gyis ‘‘g.yi tshar la wa lpags kyi gong ba can de las legs pa'i gzab mchor gang na yod ’’zer/de'i skabs shar gyi ri gsham gyi na thang de'i steng du wa mo spu gra dmar ser cacha/ gcig 'gro ba nyi shar gyis mthong nas ‘‘ltos dang wa gcig 'dug’’zer/ dbang chen pha bu gnyis lam seng skad cha mtshams bzhag nas nyi shar gyis mdzub mo gtad sa'i phyogs su blta dus wa gcig phar rgyug tshur rgyug byed kyin a bra 'dzin pa dang yang skabs re sar nyal nas kho tsho'i phyogs su phyi bltas blta gi 'dugarngonakhyi lnga po ni da dung 'ded res 'phrog res kyi rtsed mor mgo 'khor 156

nas 'dugadagra 'dul gyis lam seng khyi mo mda' mo nag rkang gi gnya' las bzung ste gad pa mtho ba zhig gi steng du khrid nas wa mo'i phyogs su mdzub mo gtad de ‘‘cho ’’zhes skad brgyab pa dang dus mnyam mda' mo nag rkang gis mgo bo mthon por btegs te mig gnyis kyang sngar bas grung bar gyur nas bltas te wa mo mthong 'phral dgra 'dul gyis 'phang pa'i mda' mo zhig dang 'dra bar wa yi phyogs su shor/ rngon khyi gzhan bzhi po'ang dus gcig tu 'phang pa'i mda' mo bzhi ltar de yi rjes su rgyug de mar wa des rngon khyi lnga rgyug yong ba mthong nas mjug ma rlung gis skyod kyin byang phyogs su bros/rngon khyi lnga po wa mo dang bar thag je nyer song nas mthar mda' mo nag rkang gis wa mo'i mjug ma kha yis ma bzung tsam la wa mo des pha bong chung chung gcig gi g.yas phyogs nas bskor te yang kha lho ru gtad de bros pas rngon khyi lnga dang wa mo'i bar thag cung zad ring du song /dbang chen dang / nyi shar/ dgra 'dul gsum gad pa'i steng du langs nas bltas/rngon khyi lnga pos sngar bzhin mgyogs tshad cung zad kyang dal du ma btang bar rjes 'ded btang nas wa mo dang bar thag nye ru nye ru song nas mthar mda' mo nag rkang dang wa gnyis kyi bar thag ring shos la'ang mi'i gom pa gang tsam las med pa'i dus dbang chen dang / nyi shar/ dgra 'dul gsum mgo bo sngar bas mtho bar btegs te ‘‘ltos dang / ltos dang / da ha lam rjes zin song / da bzung ran song ’’zhes sems 'tshab langs te rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab byed kyin 'dugamada' mo nag rkang gis wa mo'i mjug ma kha yis 'dzin grabs byed pa dang wa des sngar bas mgyogs par bros te yang bar thag cung zad ring du song 157

ba dang / mda' mo nag rkang gi gom rlabs kyang sngar bas mgyogs par gyur nas wa mo'i mjug mar btags pa ltar rjes 'ded btang nas wa mo'i mjug ma nas zin grabs yod pa'i skabs der/ wa mo de sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma'i sprul pa ston pa ltar khung bu zhig gi nang du 'dzul nas mthong rgyu med par gyur/khyi mo mda' mo nag rkang phangs sems drag po skyed de khung bu'i sgor nyal te sbar mos sa 'bru gin mjug ma sa ru brdab/ rngon khyi gzhan bzhi yang rim gyis khung sgor slebs te 'ga' re rdzi snom byed/ 'ga' res mda' mo nag rkang dang mnyam du sbar mos khung sgo'i sa drus/kho tsho gsum lam seng de las bral te wa khung yod sar song /dbang chen gyis ‘‘wa de de 'dra'i mgyogs pa la/ sngar yin na mda' mo nag rkang gis gsod ma thub pa'i wa gcig kyang thug ma myong ’rizer/kho tshos lam seng lci ba sgrug nas du ba rgyag rgyu'i gra sgrig byas/ nyi shar gyis rdo chen po gcig khyer 'ong nas khung sgo'i yan tsam bkag de nas lci ba yongs khung sgor spungs te me tshang bcas/ dbang chen gyis glo la btags pa'i me lcags kyi nang nas me rdo mchin pa'i mdog dang 'dra ba dbyibs zur gsum can gcig gi steng du pa rdog ril ma las che tsam gcig bzhag nas mthe bong dang ldag mdzub gnyis kyi bar du bcangs te me lcags kyi kha brdar tsam byas pa'i me stag las me son blangs te lci ba'i dkyil du bzhag nas phu btab pas du ba sngo lhog tu 'phyur byung /me tshang bcas pa'i lci ba phal che ba mes zin rjes khung nang du blugs/de'i steng du da dung lci ba mang po blugs te khung sgo rdo dang bye mas bkag nas du ba phyir mi don pa byas/kho tshos lug khyu dang nor khyu sbra yi phyogs su yar tsam 'ded nas log song /158

phyi nyin nyin dgung ma zin tsam la dgra 'dul dang nyi shar gnyis nor lug gi phyogs su 'gro ba'i zhor du kha seng du ba brgyab pa'i wa khung der song nas khung sgo bkag byed rdo dang bye ma tshang ma phyir bton/ de nas lci ba'i thal ba dang sna rdo phyir blangs rjes me mda'i su ma rjowa de'i steng du btsugs nas spu gcus brgyab ste phyir bton/ kha seng nyi shar gyis bzhag pa'i sna rdo de cung chung drags pa'i rkyen gyis wa yi rna ba gnyis dang spyi gtsug gi spu cung zad mes 'tshig pa las gzhan gyi cha ni skyon gang yang mi 'dug‘‘hwa hwa hwa/ri’dben 'jags kyi lung chung de'i nang mi yul gyi 'tsho bas ma dor ba'i sbra nag rnying song de'i nang rtag par dgod sgra lhang lhang du grags kyi 'dugadagod sgra de ni skabs nges med kyi yid dga' spro'i 'phel phyogs shig gam yang na sdug po gcig thog gnyis brtsegs myong ste rang yul rgyab tu bskyur te mi yul 'grim dgos byung yang 'tsho gnas yong phyir 'bad pa byas par 'bras bu mi dman pa thob nas/ gang zag mi la ma mthar 'dzoms dgos pa'i 'tsho gnas kyi cha rkyen te zas gos thad sems khral med pa'i dga' spro las don du khong tsho tshang ma'i lus thog tu brjod mi shes pa'i sdug bsngal gyi khur po chen po re khur yod/dbang chen pha bu gnyis kyi sems gting du nam yang zub thabs bral ba'i 'khon 'dzin gyi rma shul re yod pa ste dbang chen gyi ngos nas bshad na rang yul dag zhing 'dra ba de dang / mdza' gcugs gser thag gi mdud brgyas dam du bcings pa'i bza' mo dgra lag tu shor te/ de sngar nyal ba'i gnyid lam du yang shar ma myong ba'i yul gyar ba'i 'tsho ba 'di 'dra zhig skyel rjo su ma/ bod mda'i mdel rdzong rgyag byed dang me mda'i khog nang gtsang sbra byed ched kyi lcags rgyug gcig159

dgos pa 'di ngas tshe sngon mar las ngan pa gang zhig byas pa'i rnam smin yin snyam pa dang / bu dgra 'dul gyi ngos nas bshad na'ang drin can gyi a ma dgra lag tu shor te gson bral byung nas sdug po 'di 'dra myong dgos don ci yin snyam bzhin mtshan mo mang po nyal khung gi nang du mig chu khrum khrum du shor myong /nyi shar dang 'o ma skyid gnyis kyi las skal 'dra bas sems nang gi sdug bsngal yang gcig mtshungs te/ rang yul du gnyen nye ba'i brtse dung bcangs sa mdang skyes byis pa gcig kyang med mod/ byang thang mi med lung stong 'dir 'tsho ba skyel rgyu ni ha cang yid mug pa zhig red/ 'dir zas gos kyi thad sngon ma las lhag tsam longs su spyod rgyu yod pa dang gzhan gyi brnyas bcos dang 'phya smod byed mkhan med pa ni dbang chen gyi drin red snyam nas nyi shar gyi sems su shi dur khung du ma 'dzul bar khong gi zhabs phyi sgrub dgos snyam pa'i dam bca' mi 'gyur rdo rje'i brag lta bu zhig snying khong du bzhaga'on kyang rang yul gyi ri chu dran pa'i gdung ba drag po'i dbang gis dpyid ka'i gnam gshis ltar re zhig sems nang du dga' spro 'phel ba'i dus shig shar yang / glo bur du yid gdung ba'i sprin nag 'khrigs te snying khong mchi mas brlan par gyur/de'i skabs nyi shar gyi blo ngor rang yul dran pa'i gdung ba'i dbang gis rjes dran dum bu zhig yid la 'char ba ste/kho rang ma bu gnyis sbra gog 'brong gi sna khung tsam zhig gi nang du bsdad de/ snga dro rgyags kyang phyi dro ltogs/ de ring rgyags kyang sang nyin ltogs/de ring drod kyang sang nyin grang pa'i ha cang nyam thag pa'i 'tsho ba skyel bzhin sde dpon tsha zhang nyi grags tshang gi thal spungs kyi 'khris su bsdad yod/khong ma bu gnyis kyi las ka gtso bo ni snga dro sde dpon tshang gi khyi de dag 160

'dogs dgos pa dang / srod rub rjes khyi de dag glod rgyu/ rgyun pa khyi lto bster rgyu dang / khyi phrug bsnyor skyong byed rgyu bcas red/sde dpon tshang nas nyin ltar khong gnyis la zas lhag 'thung lhag dang rtsam pa za ru do re sbyin gyi yod/ sde dpon tshang la phyi nas yong mkhan gyi mgron po med pa'i dus nyung nyung red/ mgron po slebs tshe khong ma bu gnyis kyis 'dogs khyi ngar ma de dag bkag dgos kyi yod/ gal srid 'dogs khyi shor te mgron por rmug pa'i gnas tshul byung na rta lcag bcu re'i ‘‘bya dga' ri’rag rgyu gtan 'khel red/ der brten khong ma bu gnyis kyi sems khral che shos ni dpon sde dpon tshang la mgron po slebs rgyu de red/ sems khral ni sems khral rang las khong gnyis la mgron po mi yong pa'i thabs ga la yod/a ma'i ming la g.yang zer ba dang kho rang gi ming la khyi gu nyi shar zer yang / kho gnyis kyi ming ngo ma las 'bod mkhan gcig kyang med par khyi rdzi ma bu gnyis zhes 'bod pa dang / dmigs su bkar nas 'bod dgos tshe khyi rdzi rgan mo dang khyi rdzi'i bu zhes 'bod kyi yod/sbra hrul der lo mang char chus sbang zhing mtho sgang nyi ma'i 'od kyis sregs pa dang / lhags rlung gis brdab pas i khung mang po yod kyang lhags pa bkag ched sbar mthil tsam yang ma rnyed stabs dgun lhags pa'i gzigs skyong dang dbyar char chu'i mgron po rgyun chad med pas sde dpon tshang gi gces phrug dang khyim tshang 'byor pa can gyi byis pa tshos/sbra chung chung 'brong gi sna khung /phyi skar ma brgya shar stong shar/dgun rlung po mda' mo rgyag rgyagadabyar char chu 'o ma bzho bzho/zhes mi rgan gyi ngag las thos pa'i 'phya smod kyi glu gtong bzhin ‘‘o o ’’161

zhes zhim mngar gyi zas rigs ngom bzhin phar rgyug tshur rgyug byed pa dang /sbra la gtad de gcin pa gtong ba/ rdo bzhu ba sogs brnyas bcos sna tshogs byed kyi yod pas kho'i ya chung sems nang sdug gi smug pa 'khrig cing zhe sdang gi me lce 'bar yang bzod sgom byed rgyu las phru gu de tsho'i ba spu'i sne gcig la yang reg ga la nus/kho yang spyang grung can zhig yin pas nyin zhig lhas ra'i nang rtsed mo rtse bzhin pa'i phru gu de tsho'i khrod du song nas ‘‘kho tsho/ nga tsho mnyam du rtsed mo rtse/nga rta byed/ khyod tsho mi byas nas nga la bzhon dang ’’zer bas phru gu de tsho dga' nas ‘‘ya ya/ de rang yin ’rizer nas phru gu de tshos res mos kyis kho'i sgal par bzhon/ khos rkang lag bzhi ka sa ru btsugs nas phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas/phru gu tshang mas bzhon rjes khos ‘‘rta la rta chag ma bster na rta shi gi red ’’ces shi ba'i khul gyis sa ru 'gyel te kho tshor bzhon ma bcug phru gu de tshos kho'i sgal par bzhon rgyu'i ched du ‘‘rta chag bster dgos ’’zer nas sha skam dang / phyur ba/ mar gzan sogs kho la bster bas khos de dag rum nang du blugs te yang kho tsho res mos kyis sgal par khur nas rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab byed kyi yod/ rtsed mo rtses zin rjes khos dga' dga' spro spro'i ngang nang du log nas rum nang gi sha skam dang phyur ba/ mar gzan de dag bton te a mar sbyin/a ma hang sang nas ‘‘'di dag gang nas khyer yong ba yin/ 'dre phrug khyod kyis rku ma yang byed shes ’’zhes dbugs hal hal byed kyin mig 'bur tshugs kyis khor bltas/khos rgyu mtshan yongs ma gsang drang bshad byas pas a ma lhag par khros nas ‘‘hung / nged ma bu gnyis ma shi tshe ring byung na de bas yag pa med/ nga 162

la phru gu mang po skyes kyang tshe sngon sdig las byas pa'i rnam smin gyis gson por lhag pa khyod las med/ 'on kyang ltas phrug khyod kyis mi tshang chen po'i phru gu'i rngan pa 'phrog hung / kho tsho'i pha mas shes na khyod kyi pags pa bshus yong /phyin chad de 'dra byed kyi yin nam min ’rizhes sgo 'gram las me skyog blangs te kho'i rkub la gzhus/‘‘a ma/ a ra/ ngas 'phrog pa min/ in/ ngas ngas de 'dra byed kyi min ’’zhes ngus te sbra gog 'brong rgan gyi sna khung tsam de'i nang phar bros tshur bros byas/sha rid cing mdog ngan pa'i kho'i ngo gdong chung chung de mchi mas brlan par gyur pa mthong bas da gzod a ma yang sems pham skyed nas kho brang khar bzung ste ‘‘a mas lag pa thal drags song / phyin chad de 'dra ma byed ang ’’zer bzhin mig chu rang dbang med par shor/kho yang a ma'i brang la dam por sbyar nas ‘‘ngas ngas rjes ma de 'dra byed mi yong ’’zhes ngu skad che ru btang /de nas bzung phru gu de tshos ‘‘khyi rdzi'i bu/ khyi rdzi'i bu/ 'dir shog dang nga tsho mnyam du rtsed mo rtse/ de ring yang khyod rta dang nga tsho mi yin no ’’zhes bos byung bas khos kho tsho'i 'dod blo yongs su bskang ba las ‘‘rta chag ’’gang yang ma bzas/nyin zhig grong 'dabs kyi rtswa thang steng du rta drel drug cu slo/ra 'ded pa'i dar mdo nas yong ba'i ja pa'i tshong pa rgya chen zhig slebs te ja sgam ri las mtho ba brtsigs shing rta drel rtswa thang du bkram/yul phyogs gzhan nas yong pa'i tshong dpon chen po dang / bla dpon che rigs mthong na sde dpon tsha zhang nyi grags rgyu rngam che ba dang / rang gi mtshan snyan grags kyi ched du thabs brgya jus stong gis de dang grogs 'grig 163

thabs byed kyi yod/de nyin ja pa tshugs babs ma thag khos g.yog po gnyis ja pa'i 'bangs la lci ba skyel bar btang / de nas g.yog mo gnyis mdun du bos te gcig gi lag tu mar ja bsrubs ma khog lter gang dang / gcig gi lag tu 'bri'i brang sha btsos ma ka to ra gang bzhag nas ‘‘tshong dpon lags cung zad ngal gsos rjes khyim du phebs zer gyi 'dug ces lobs ’’zer nas btang /ja pa'i tshong dpon des tsha zhang nyi grags la lag rtags su ja bag chung gnyis bskur ba las kho rang ma song /mthar kho rang sde dpon ngo ma mi 'gro ka med thug ste g.yi lpags kyi tshar slog sram shan wa lpags kyi gong ba can zhig gyon/ mgo la rgya gar yang zhwa rdza mdog cig gyon te g.yog po gnyis khrid pa gcig gi lag tu lug sha mgo 'byar ma khog gcig dang / gcig gi lag tu tsha ru mnyed ma lnga bcu khyer te ja pa'i 'bangs su song /ja pa'i tshong dpon khams pa lo na bzhi bcu lhag tsam byas pa sma ra lcags kyu ltar 'khyil ba de gur sbug gi grum tse'i gdan steng du ngal gsos nas bsdad 'dugasde dpon tsha zhang nyi grags kyis gur sgo las yar bltas te zhwa phud cing lce mnar te ‘‘tshong dpon lags ’’zhes phyag 'bul zhus nas kha btags mdun du bzhagatshong dpon bag gro des ‘‘ya/ a rogs sdod dang ’’zhes gam du sdod bcug rjes zhabs phyis ja blugs/tshong dpon des sde dpon la mthong 'dod zhe drag med par skad cha gang yang ma bshad/g.yog po gnyis pos lag rtags sha khog dang / tsha ru mdun du bzhag164

sde dpon gyis ‘‘tshong dpon lags/ lag rtags chung chung red ma dgongs par bzhes rogs gnang ’’zhes gus gus zhum zhum gyis bshad/tshong dpon gyis ca lag de dag la mig blta tsam yang ma byas par ‘‘yag byung / yag byung ’’zer/sde dpon tsha zhang nyi grags kyi sems su sa thag ring dar mdo nas yong ba'i ja pa'i tshong dpon chen po 'di 'dra rang gi khyim du mgron por yong na rta khyu'i nang du gyi ling slebs pa dang / bya khyu'i nang du khyung chen slebs pa ltar khyim gyi mdzes rgyan zhig dang / sde ba phan tshun gnya' gnan byed kyi snyan grags dang gzi brjid yin pas mi tshad rang nyid la'ang ja yi lag rtags gya nom pa gnang nges red snyam nas ‘‘tshong dpon lags/ nga tsho'i nang du phebs dang ’’zer/tshong dpon des sma ra byil bzhin du ‘‘nga mi 'gro ’’zer/kho'i bsam par da res mgron po khrid rgyu med la lag rtags yang med par lag stong du log na ngo tsha snyam nas ‘‘de 'dra ma gsung / tshong dpon lags/ zhabs phyi gang dgos nga tshos zhus chog nang du phebs tsam gnang dang ’’zer/ tshongadapon gyis ‘‘khyed kyi lag rtags mang po de 'dra khyer bas bka' drin che zhu rgyu yin/ nga khyod kyi nang du song ba'am khyod tshur yong gcig pa red a rogs ’’zer nas 'gro 'dod ma byas/nyi grags kyis ‘‘tshong dpon lags de 'dra ma gsung / phebs tsam gnang dang / 'jig rten gyi kha dper ‘nye ba brgya las ngo shes gcig yag mizer/ nga rgad po 'jon thang mi che yang ngo shes kyi grogs po yin phyin la chu brgya yi bar chod kyang mi brjed mkhan zhig yin/ da nga'i khyim du phebs tsam gnang dang mi’zhes bshad/165

tshong dpon des skra gzhug nag po de dkris skyor byas/ sog lham nag po shur ma'i phyi skogs can de'i lham sgrog bcings/ gri mgu bzi khra ring gcig sked par gzer nas 'gro 'dod la ma 'dod kyis gdan las langs te lag g.yog khams pa stobs chen gri ring sked par gzer pa gnyis khrid de lag rtags su ja sgam chung ba gcig khyer nas sde dpon tshang du song /de'i skabs 'dogs khyi ngar ma de dag smyo ba ltar sa mchongs gnam mchongs byed kyin zug skad kyis nam mkha' dbral ba ltar byed kyin 'dugakho gnyis ma bu gnyis kyis khyi'i ske las bzung ste nus shugs gang yod kyis bkag thabs byas/ 'dogs khyi ngar ma de dag gi sder mos sa bred kyin 'then/ de'i skabs khyi gu nyi shar gyis bkag pa'i khyi des lcags thag bcad de shor/ khos lcags thag gi sne las bzung nas phyir 'then yang khyi de kho las shugs che bas kho sa la drud de tshong dpon gyi steng du shor/ g.yog po gcig bde lcag 'khyug po'i ngang khyi'i gnya' las bzung thub tsam byung bas mi la rmug ma thub kyang / sde dpon gyis tshong dpon gyi mdun du 'gying nyams ston ched du ‘‘hung / za 'dre/ khyi gcig kyang 'gog mi thub/ thu/’’zhes khyi gu nyi shar gyi ngo gdong la mchil ma btab pa dang sbrags lag pa 'phyar te 'gram lcag zhu rtsis byas/tshong dpon gyis ‘‘a rogs/ kho rdung nas ci phan/ khyi brdung na drin ma che/ mi brdung na sdig pa che ’’zhes sde dpon dang khyi gu nyi shar gnyis kyi bar 'dzul te sde dpon la 'bud rgyag brgyab/sde dpon phyir bshol byed skabs rkang pa rdo gcig gi steng du 'dred de ltag dgye log nas sa ru brdab ste rgya gar yang zhwa rdza mdog de yang 'khor lo 'khor ba ltar rlung gis 'ded de song /khyi gu nyi shar gyis rjes bsnyegs te rgyug pas zhwa mo de thal spungs kyi 'og 166

tu lhung nas 'dug pas khos lam seng yar bsgrugs dus de'i 'og tu dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gyi dbyibs dang mtshungs pa'i skyag pa skam po gcig 'duga'on kyang stabs legs pa zhig la zhwa mo'i steng du thal rdul las skyag pa 'gos mi 'dug pas khos lam seng yar bsgrugs nas lag gnyis kyis btegs te sde dpon la sprad/sde dpon gyis khyi gu nyi shar la mig log cig bltas nas zhwa mo shugs kyis tshur 'phrog ste brdab tsam byas nas mgor gyon te ngo gdong las ngu ba dang khyad med pa'i bgod 'dzum skyug bro po zhig ston te ‘‘tshong dpon lags phebs dang ’’zer/ja pa'i tshong dpon de phyir 'gro khar khyi rdzi ma bu'i sbra chung chung de'i sgo las yar bltas ‘‘a nyog rjo'adi na shog dang ri’zer/sde dpon nyi grags tshong dpon gyi rgyab tu langs nas phu dung gis sna bkab nas ‘‘tshong dpon lags/ der ma 'dzul/ skyug bro ba la ’’zer nas tshong dpon gyi phu dung las bzung nas phyir 'then byas/tshong dpon gyis ‘‘ci skyon le ma red/ yag na sdug na mi tshang gcig red/ nga yang dang po sprang phrug gcig yin/ da lta khyod sde dpon dang /nga tshong dpon/ khong gnyis sprang po yin yang shi tshar na 'byor phyug drag zhan gyi khyad par med pa 'gro sa gcig red/ 'dzam bu gling ’’zer/khyi gu nyi shar gyis dus rgyun sde dpon tshang gi dar shing ring po de'i rtser babs pa'i pho rog la ltad mo blta ba ltar kha gdang nas tshong dpon la bltas 'dugatshong dpon gyis khyi gu nyi shar gyi phrag par bcag tsam byas nas ‘‘a nyog() a nyog ni khams skad du byis par go/167

khyod nga'i rta drel 'tsho mkhan byas nas nga dang mnyam du e 'gro ’’zer/khyi gu nyi shar gyis tshong dpon gyi skad cha'i don ma rtogs par sngar bzhin kha gdang nas rang sar langs nas 'dug ma rgan gyis tshong dpon la phyag 'tshal bzhin du ‘‘tshong dpon bka' drin can/ nga la phru gu 'di las med pas gtong nus pa mi 'dug ’’zer/tshong dpon gyis ma rgan yar bskyor te ‘‘a ye/ khyod kyis gtong nus na ngas kho la brnyas bcos byed mi srid/ lo re'i nang thengs re thug gi red/da nas bzung nga ston 'khor dhidang yang na skye dgu mdo rjolas de phan chad 'gro dgos med par tshong pa gzhan gyis dbor yong gi red/ kho nga dang mnyam du song nas shid po (skyid po )yod med thug dus skad cha dris na 'grig gi red ’’ces bshad/ma rgan gyis tshong dpon gyi lag pa bzung nas ‘‘tshong dpon bka' drin can khyerd ni me sems bzang can zhig yin pa ngas shes kyi 'dug kho khyod dang mnyam du phyin na skyid po yong nges red/ nga la phru gu 'di las med pas rgan mo nga ni snum zad kyi mar me ltar shi rgyur nye bas gtong nus pa mi 'dugatshong dpon dgongs pa ma tshoms/ khyed ni mi sems bzang can zhig yin pa ngas shes kyi 'dug ’’zer/tshong dpon gyis ‘‘yā/ a ye rgan mo khyed kyis gtong ma nus na ngas u tshugs mi rgyag ’’zer nas rum las dā yang dkar po gnyis bton te rgan mo'i lag nang du bzhaga'agrol hā baṇ+ḍaṃkau k+to r+sha spya sna shā a+yaushā sdo d+nghahā t+na ngamash+laudu kār+sha ṭī sbriṭ+wā sni rdot+na zhi t+na ste rgya skad du ṣ+ṭham zer/ bcings dhi skye dgu sasdu ni mtsho sngoshā zhing cherī yul nāl gād rirnyisari rang skyong pa 'i~X gyi sridra 'ardzun lte glunasayulats+tshal sdo rtashā shaṃn+dha kāsnru ༵ ljo n+d+rasngu sh+lau sa/ cha zhir+sha/ go/hu / ga gas gas mang 'a nga pa' 'gra lam na stabs nga 168

rgan mos lag pa 'dar gyin du ‘‘tshong dpon lags/ bka' drin che/khyed kyi ming la ci zer shod dang rgan mo ngas ngas ma shi ma shi bar khyod khyod tshe ring nad med/ bsam bsam don 'grub pa'i gsol gsol ba gsol ba smon lam 'debs ’’ces shod kyin mgrin pa brnangs/tshong dpon gyis ‘‘nga'i ming la thub bstan bzang po zer/ khams phrug thub bzang zer na'ang 'grigs ’’zer/phyi nyin ja pa song rjes sde dpon tsha zhang nyi grags smyo ba ltar rgyug yong nas ‘‘za 'dre/ khyi rgan gcig kyang 'gog thub kyi mi 'dug nga sde dpon tsha zhang nyi grags zer dus rta yod kyi rta sga bshu sa/ rta med kyi khur po 'beb sa/ja chang gi rgyun ma chad/ bla dpon gyi mgron po mang sa/ gtam kha mchu tshig thag gcod mkhan skad grags can zhig yin/ mgron po'i mdun du kha seng ma gtogs zhabs 'dren zhu ma myong / g.ya' khyod/ g.ya' khyod ’’ces snying rje med par khyi gu nyi shar la rdog rgyag gzhus/ ma rgan gyis tshul de mthong bas rang gi gzugs pos bu bkab nas ‘‘sde dpon sku mkhyen/ nga gnyis za 'dre rang red/ phyag 'jug gang yod nga la gnang dang ’’zhes zhu ba 'then/khos da dung gdug rtsub kyis ‘‘g.ya' khyod ’’ces rdog rgyag gzhus te ma rgan gyi rtsib ma bcag de nas kha seng ja pa'i tshong dpon gyis sprad pa'i dā yang gnyis po de 'phrog nas ‘‘sdug tshod ma zin na nyo cha gzed rgyu red ’’ces khyi gu nyi shar gyi sna rtser mdzub mo btsugs/ma rgan gyi rtsib ma bcag pas nad gzhi ljid pos mnar te nyal sar lus kyang sman pa bstan par dngul dang rgyu nor med stabs nad gzhi nyin re bzhin je sdug tu song nas mthar rang sha las chad pa'i bu chung khyi gu nyi shar la sems chags te ‘‘nga'i nga'i nga'ibu khyi gu khyi gu nyi shar 169

a a mas khyod khyod tshong dpon thub thub bstan bzang po dang mnyam du btang na ci 'dra ma red/ nga'i bu ’’zhes 'bod kyin khyi gu nyi shar pang du bzung nas 'jig rten phyi ma'i lam du gshegs song /khos ‘‘nga'i a ma/ nga'i a ma/ khyod dran pa sos dang ’’zhes 'bod kyin ma rgan gyi phung por 'tham nas nyi ma mang po ngus/de nas bzung sbra hrul de'i nang kho rang gcig pu lus/sbra hrul de sngar bas hrul bar gyur nas rlung bu'i khrod du lhab lhub tu g.yo ba ni ri 'go'i dar lcog dang gnyis su ma mchis bsam blo gtong mtshams der slebs dus nyi shar gyi ngo gdong las dga' skyo zung gi rnam 'gyur zhig bton te ‘‘dā yang gnyis am phrag tu blugs kyang da gzod 'bri g.yag mang po 'di 'dra gar song cha med lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul ltar gyur pas sde dpon nyi grags kho ci bsam gyi yod dam/ kho phal cher smyo yod kyi red ri’ces chig lab brgyab/da ni ja gar rong las bral rgyu'i dus tshod mi ring bas sha yang ldeng nges zhig dgos pas de ring 'brong gcig gsod rgyu byas te kho tsho lto chas stabs bde zhig bzas rjes me mda' khyer nas 'brong khyu'i phyogs su song /kho tsho der slebs pa nas bzung 'brong khyu der brdab gsig dang /dngangs skrag chen po bzos pas mi tshad rang rigs kyi spun zla mang po'i srog kyang bcad stabs da thengs thag ring po nas mi mthong ba dang rnga ma dgung du 'phyar nas mgo g.yug gin 'drog rgyu'i gra sgrig byed kyin 'duga'on kyang las dbang rlung shugs btsan pos 'ded pa'i kho tsho mi yul gyi 'tsho ba skyel dgos pas 'tsho gnas kyi thabs shes btsal te re zhig sdig pa zhes pa'i tha snyad de rgyang ring du mi dor ka med red/ dbang chen gyi me mda'i 170

nang du rnam kun gyi khob tshad las brgal ba'i rdzas blugs te sbi sdi'i sne mor me sgron nas nyi shar la sprad de ‘‘da ma 'chug rab byung na mdel gcig gis 'brong gnyis gsod dgos ’’zer/nyi shar gyis me mda' lag tu len skabs me mda' de sngon ma las ldab gcig gis lci ba'i 'phrul snang zhig byung ba ni sems nang du 'gan ljid po zhig yod pa'i dbang gis red/ de ring me mda'i rtsed mo rtse ba ga la yin/dbang chen gyis 'brong la ma thebs kyang skyon med/ mde'u re gnyis 'phro brlag song bar ha las rgyu ci yang med ces bshad pa las nges par du gsod thub pa byed dgos pa dang / rdzas mdel 'phro brlag gtong mi rung zhes shod myong med mod kho'i sems su 'brong la ma thebs na rdzas mdel 'phro brlag yin pas nges par du thebs pa byed dgos snyams pa dang / yang ma thebs na 'brong yang 'drogs shing rdzas mdel yang 'phro brlag btang ste bya gnam la 'phur zhing sgo nga sa ru lhung pa'i dpe zlar gyur rgyu red snyam nas ‘‘de ring khyed kyis rgyob dang / ngas gsod pa mi 'dug ’’ces me mda' dbang chen gyi lag tu bzhagadabang chen gyis ‘‘'o na khyod kyis rgyob ’’ces me mda' dgra 'dul la sprad/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘ngas sod thub e yong ’’zhes sems nang du the tshom skye bzhin du mig 'brong khyur bltas te dbang chen gyi lag nas me mda' tshur blangs pa na gzab gzab ma byas pa'i rkyen gyis me mda'i skam par lag pa 'khon pas mig mdun du me stag 'phyur ba dang dus mnyam ‘‘twa ’’zhes me mda'i kha grags pa dang chabs cig 'brong khyu'i nang gi 'brong gcig 'degs byed rgya rdo'i lung thag chad pa ltar mgo rting log nas sa ru 'gyel/gzab gzab ma byas par me mda' kha shor bas nyi shar gyi sems su 'jigs skrag chen po skyed de dran pa thor grabs byas pa dang / mgo bo smad 171

de dbang chen nam yang na dgra 'dul gcig bsad yod nges red snyams nas re zhig mgo bo btegs te blta ba'i spobs pa dang bral/dgra 'dul gyis me mda' de sus brgyab pa yin snyam nas hon thor/dbang chen gyis ‘‘me mda' tsha ba la dpe red/ gzes dgos yas mi 'dug hwa hwa ’’zhes ku re shod kyin bgad byung bas da gzod nyi shar mgo yar bkyags te blta dus me mda'i lcags hreng yod sar dbang chen gyis bzung pa dang me mda'i skam pa yod sar dgra 'dul gyis bzung nas 'dugadagra 'dul hon thor nas da dung kha gdang mig bgrad kyis 'gul skyod kyi dbang rtsa rbad de nyams pa ltar rang sar langs nas 'dugadabang chen gyis ‘‘kho re/ kho re ’’zhes dkrug dkrug btang bas da gzod dgra 'dul dran pa sos pa ltar lag nang gi me mda' glod de ‘‘me mda' ga 'dra byas nas kha grags pa red/ sus brgyab pa red ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘ngas gzes te khyod kyis brgyab pa red mi’ces kha mtshar bshad/khos de'i don ma rtogs par ‘‘a/ ga re/ ngas brgyab pa red ad/me mda' nga'i lag nang du slebs ma thag kha grags byung ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘red/ khyod rang gis mig 'brong la blta bzhin du me mda' lag tu blangs skabs skam par lag pas bcangs nas me mda' kha shor ba red/ 'brong de khyod rang dang srog lag 'bre la yod pas kha shor ba'i me mda'i mde'u yis 'brong bsad pa red/ 'brong de khyod rang gcig pus bsad pa yin ma bsam ang ’’zhes ku re rtses/da gzod gzhi nas rgyu mtshan shes nas ‘‘dpe la/ ngas 'brong gsod rgyu phar zhog sdug mig 'brong la bltas nas mi gsod grabs byas 'dug ’’ces sems nang sngar bas lhag pa'i 'jigs skrag skyed de mde'u de a phar thebs 172

med dam snyam nas dbang chen gyi mgo nas mjug bar thengs kha shas bltas/de'i skabs 'brong khyu byings 'drogs te lung pa'i mdo las don te mi snang bar gyur/de nas kho tsho 'brong ro de'i sar song nas bltas pas na/ da res me mda' kha shor nas bsad pa'i 'brong de'i gzugs po'i steng du mdel khung khab mig tsam zhig kyang mi 'dug pas kho tsho ya mtshan chen po skyed de ‘‘de ci yin nam/ 'di shi a yod/ khyad mtshar ’’zhes gleng mol long long byed kyin re zhig bsha' ma nus/dbang chen gyis 'brong de'i mig gi rgyal mo'i steng du mdzub mo btsugs te blta dus 'brong de'i dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad nas yun ring song zin 'dugadagra 'dul gyis ‘‘khyad mtshar 'di ga 'dra byas nas shi ba yin nam ’’zhes mgo g.yug byas/nyi shar gyis ‘‘khyod la dgra lha 'khor ba yin gyi red ’’zer/dbang chen gyis 'brong de'i mjug ma'i sne mor rtsid pa dkar po tshom bu zhig 'dug pa mthong nas ‘‘ltos dang / 'brong 'di spu log red 'dug ’’zer/dgra 'dul gyis 'brong spu log ces pa de'i don ma rtogs par ‘‘a pha/spu log zer na ci red ’’ces dris/dbang chen gyis ‘‘'brong gi gzugs po'i steng du kha dog nag po min pa'i rtsid pa med/ ri dwags tshang ma de 'dra red/ rigs gcig pa yin pa la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos yod na spu log zer/ dper na ri dwags pha ma bu dgur dhicha bzhag na/ gna' gnyen 'brong gsum pho rwa mo rwa/ gla rjo 3 dwags rnyi ma bu dgu ces pa sdi ri dwags gna' ba/ gnyen/ 'brong / gla ba/ ri bong / rkyang /sha ba/ dag ba/ ga da bcas dgu la ra/ 173

ri (ri bong )rkyang gsum pho yu mo yu/me sha dgo gtsod gsum pho rwa mo yu zer/gal srid gna' ba dang / gnyen/ 'brong gsum rwa co med pa/ gla ba/ri bong / rkyang gsum la rwa co yod pa/ sha ba/ dgo ba/ gtsod gsum pho la rwa co med pa dang / yang na mo la rwa co yod pa lta bu dang / spu mdog gzhan dang mi 'dra ba yod tshad la spu log zer/ de 'dra bsad na yang na yag rtags shig dang / yang na sdug rtags shig red ’’zer/nyi shar gyis de ni sdug rtags shig yin nges red/ me mda' kha shor nas bsad pa la mdel khung khab mig tsam med pa ma zad de'ang spu log gcig yin pas da ni bkra mi shis pa'i than ltas shig yin gyi red snyam pa'i 'jigs skrag byung nas ‘‘da de ma bshas na mi bzang ngam ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘skyon med/ de la ldog thabs yod/ ri dwags gsod mkhan la de 'dra ya mtshan can thug gi yod/ 'on kyang nyung nyung red ’’ces shod bzhin glo gri bton te bsha' 'go tshugs/dgra 'dul dang / nyi shar gnyis kyi sems su dngos gnas ldog thabs yod na ma gtogs ldog ma thub na chags sgo chen po bzo gi med dam snyam pa'i blo dogs sna tshogs skyes/kho tshos ha rub sbar rub kyis bshas pas yud tsam zhig la 'brong de'i ko ba bshus/de nas dbang chen gyis de'i ldog thabs su sug mthil bzhi bcad de lag sug rkang sug gi go rim bzhin 'brong gson po langs pa'i sug rjes ltar bzhag de'i lag sug gnyis kyi mdun du 'brong mgo bzhag ste ‘‘'di ltar byas na dngos med gdon 'dres 'brong gi mgo dang / sug mthil bzhi dhi yu ni rwa co med pa mgo ril gyi rigs la zer/174

mthong pa tsam gyis 'brong de shi mi 'dug snyam nas nga tshor gnod pa skyel gyi ma red ’’ces bshad/de nas nang khrol bton nas khyi la sbyin/ snying dang glo mchin mkhal ma sogs nyar/de nas zla gcig dang phyed ka song rjes kho tshos rtsam sgye dang / thab/snod sogs ca dngos ma lus par g.yag la bskal te ja gar rong las don te song /de nyin zhogs pa snga po zhogs ja btung rjes dbang chen dang / nyi shar gnyis kyis dol khal 'ded de sngon la thon song /'o ma skyid kyis lug khyu 'ded pa dang / dgra 'dul gyis nor khyu 'ded de rjes su thon/ ja gar rong du dus yun lo phyed tsam bsdad de rtsa ba'i cha nas bsam don ji bzhin 'grub kyang da res gnas de las bral dus mtsher rnying der zhen chags skyed de 'gro mi nus pa'i rnam 'gyur ston mkhan gcig kyang med pa ma zad tha na mi tshang mas mun nag btson ra las don pa lta bu'i dga' spro'i rnam 'gyur zol med cig mngon gyi 'dugalung pa'i phyi rol de ja gar rong ltar tsha drod che ba zhig min yang da lta hor zla bzhi pa slebs zin stabs brlan bsher che sa yongs rtswa sngon skyes te sngo thing thing du 'gyur pa dang / kha sngon 'khyags pa'i dar dkar dpyang pa'i chu mig de dag kyang dwangs shing gtsang ba'i chu phran du gyur nas thur du 'bab pa'i 'gram ngogs gang sar rtswa sngon gyi khrod du me tog gi 'dab lo thar thor skyes pa ma zad kha ma 'bus pa'i me tog gi the'u yang re zung mthong rgyu 'dug rgyang ring gi ri bo de dag kha dog sngon por snang zhing smig sgyu'i khrod du bzo dbyibs rnam pa sna tshogs su 'gyur te 'dar yom yom byed kyin 'dug175

kho gnyis kyi mdun nas rgyang ring du 'gro bzhin pa'i dbang chen dang / nyi shar/ dol khel sogs kyang smig sgyu'i khrod du gnam 'degs ka ba ltar phra la ring pa sha stag tu mngon/na thang chen po zhig tu slebs dus nor de dag gsar skyes na rtswar za 'dod che bar gyur te mi 'gro bar rtswa bza' bzhin mjug ma g.yug tsam g.yug tsam byed kyi 'dug kho rang ne'u gsing gi gzhi ru gan rkyal du nyal te ngal gsos/ dgung sngon gyi dbyings su gshog rtsal ngom bzhin pa'i bya thang dkar re zung lding skor rgyag pa dang / sprin dkar gyi tshom bu de dag bzo dbyibs sna tshogs su 'gyur bzhin byang nas lho ru 'gro ba ni kho tsho ltar byang sa skya mo bskyur te lho ru 'gro ba dang mtshungs pas kho'i sems su yun ring bral ba'i a ma dang 'brel ba'i rjes dran du ma yid la shar/kho'i a ma ni yul la skad du grags pa'i mdzes ma zhig red la lag las ka'i thad la'ang kun gyi 'gran zla bral ba'i mdzangs ma zhig kyang red/ kho tshang gi gyon pa dang / cha ra/① skye mo/ gan zla sogs yol go tshang ma khyim tshang gzhan gyi yol go las spus dag pa dang kha dog mdzes pa/ bzo dbyibs legs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni dgra 'dul gyi a ma'i thag las dang bzo las bud med gzhan las yag pas red/nyin zhig kho'i a mas tsha ru mnyed ma mang po blangs nas thig skud kyis thig rgyag gin 'dug kho nor rdzir 'gro zhor du a ma'i gam du song nas ‘‘a ma tsha ru mang po 'di 'dra blangs nas su la tshar tshag bzo rtsis yin ’’zhes dris/a mas dgod tsam byas nas kho'i mgor byil tsam byas/de nas kho nor khyu 'ded de kha sngon gyi spang ri de'i steng du slebs rjes dhi cha ra ni yul thon sgye char te dbus skad du sle'u zer/176

dbang skyid kyis mu tig gi tshom bu lta bu'i lug khyu 'ded de der slebs/kha sngon mo rang chu 'gram du ngo gdong bkru skabs yid du 'ong ba'i brang skyes zung gis kho'i yid dbang 'phrog pa nas bzung / mo la sngar las lhag pa'i 'dod sems shig chags kyang / mnyam du med tshe 'dod pa'i dbang gis rgyang blta byed dgos pa dang gam du slebs tshe skad cha shod pa'i spobs pa med pas dbang skyid kyis bal 'khel gyin sdod pa dang / khos lag pas lag par phur gyin bsdad/smra shes don go'i mi gnyis mnyam du bsdad kyang lkugs pa'i tshul 'dzin te skad cha tshig gcig kyang med pa'i rnam pa de ni ha cang 'khyol dka' ba'i dus tshod ring po zhig red/ phan tshun 'dren byed kyi lkog mda' 'phen pa las bsam tshul brje res kyi smra ba tshig 'bru phyed ka tsam med/ yun ring song rjes dbang skyid kyis ‘‘dgra 'dul ’’zer/‘‘65’’‘‘skad cha shod dang /’’‘‘skad cha ci zhig shod dgos red/rimi‘‘ci bshad kyang chogami ‘‘um/ skad cha shod rgyu mi gda'/’’‘‘skad cha med pa ci red/’’‘‘'o na khyed kyis shod dang /’’‘‘sngon la khyed kyis shod dang /’mi‘‘sngon la skad cha shod zer mkhan khyed rang yin pa/ ’‘‘ci zhig nyan 'dod 'dug’ ‘‘ci bshad kyang chog’mi‘‘nga la'ang skad cha mi gda'/’’177

‘‘'o na gtam dpe ①shod dang /’’‘‘gtam dpe ngas mi shes/’’‘‘khyod kyis glu thongs dang /’’‘‘khyod kyis gtam dpe bshad na ngas glu gtong chog’mi‘‘ngas gtam dpe ci shod dgos/’’‘‘ci bshad kyang chogaspre’yang re zhig smra ba med par lus kyang gnyis ka'i sems da res ltar 'tshab snang mi 'dug pas dbang skyid kyis ‘‘khyod kyi mdzub rgyus de mdzes pa la ang ’’zhes dgra 'dul gyi lag pa g.yon ma'i dkyil mdzub la btags pa'i dngul gyi sor gdub byu ru'i khra can der blta ba'i khul gyis kho'i lag par phur phur byas byung bas kho'i ngo gdong la tsha shur zhig brgyab pa dang sbrags lus kyi cha shas 'ga' rengs por gyur/‘‘ya/ ci red/ khyod kyi lag pa 'dar gyin 'dug ngas za gi red bsam gyi 'dug gam ’’zhes dbang skyid kyis kho'i lag mgo dam par bcangs/‘‘ma red/ ma red/ dza nga ngas gtam dpe snyan po zhig shod ’’ces dgra 'dul ngo tsha drags pas smra lce dab dib kyis lag mgo phar bskums/‘‘ya/ da shod dang / ’‘‘um/ ngas gtam dpe snyan la ring mo zhes pa de bshad na 'grigs gam ’’zhes kho da gin dang mi 'dra bar spobs pa cung zad che ru phyin/‘‘ya ya/ de snyan po yod kyi red ’’ces dbang skyid nyan 'dod chen po yod khul byas/‘‘snyan po yod pas mi tshad ring po'ang yod ’’zer/() gtam dpe/ byang rigs kyi kha skad du gtam dpe ni sgrung la zer/178

‘‘ya/ da shod dang ’’zhes dbang skyid dgra 'dul gyi phyogs su nud tsam byas/ ‘‘da 'o na ngas bshad/ khyod kyis nyon ang ’’zer nas dgra 'dul gyis sgrung bshad don/‘‘dang po tsa na byi'u skad snyan po zhig yod/’’‘‘khri/’’‘‘byi'u de lcang ma ring po zhig gi steng du babs pa red/’ ‘‘75mi’‘‘de'i ming la snyan la ring mo zer/’’‘‘ya/ de nas/’mi‘‘de nas rdzogs pa red/’’ ‘‘ya/ ga re/ rdzogs pa red ad/’’ sgrung de shin tu thung bas dbang skyid hang sang nas de ltar bshad/ ‘‘um/ ngas cha tshang bshad tshar/’’‘‘'o na da res khyed kyis snyan la ring pa zhig shod rgyu yod zer ba min nam/da lta bshad pa de snyan po mi 'dug la ring po'am mi 'dug ’’ces dbang skyid kyis phangs sems skyed de bshad/dgra 'dul gyis rtswa rkang gcig bcad de so bar du 'dzugs kyin du ‘‘byi'u de ni skad snyan pa dang lcang ma de ni ring po yod pas snyan la ring mo min na ci zhig red/ ha ha ’mizhes bshad/‘‘hung / khyod kyis nga la mgo skor gtong gi 'dug ’’ces khong khro langs khul gyis kha phyir bskor nas bsdad/ ‘‘ngas mgo skor btang med/ ngas snyan la ring mo bshad tshar bas da khyod kyis glu thongs dang ’’zhes bshad zhor du dgra 'dul gyi lag pa rang dbang med par dbang skyid kyi phrag steng du bzhag nas bcag tsam byas/179

‘‘dbang skyid kyis rang gi phrag steng du bzhag pa'i dgra 'dul gyi lag pa phar 'bud tsam byas nas dgra 'dul la zur mig cig bltas te sdug lag phar ma bskum na ngas glu gtong gi min ’’zer/dgra 'dul gyis lag pa phar bskums nas yang rtswa rkang gcig gis rna sbug bsang bzhin du ‘‘ya/ da glu thongs dang ’’zer/‘‘ya ya/ ngas btang pa'i glu la khyod kyis glu lan 'jal dgos yod/glu lan ma 'jal bar mi rkyang glu len byas pas ci phan ’’zer/‘‘75 75’’de nas dbang skyid kyis gre gsang zhig byas te mgo bo smad de glu blangs par ‘‘khyod rta med rkang thang yin zer na/rta rkyang po'i 'phyi 'phongs nga yis gzhogakhyod gos med gcer bu yin zer na/tshar dkar thu sne nga yis 'geb/mi’ de'i lan du dgra 'dul gyis glu'i dbyangs med par tshig shod byas par/‘‘nga rta med rkang thang ma yin yang /rta rkyang po'i phyi 'phongs gzhog rogs byos/nga gos med gcer bu ma yin yang /tshar dkar thu sne 'geb rogs byos/’mide nas dbang skyid kyis yang bskyar glu len 'jal par/‘‘rta rkyang po dung gi pha spor can/'gros gom pa zad mtha' ma byung na/nga'i glo rta mchor rta gnyis ka byed/tshar dkar po chu sram mtha' rgyan can/180

gos mtha' chu yis ma gyong na/nga'i tshes gos mchor gos gnyis ka byed/mimices glu mjug rdzogs ma thag ‘‘hi hi ’’zhes dngul dkar gyi dril chung bkrol ba lta bu'i gad mo bgad de 'dug gnas las hob langs kyis mo rang gi lug khyu'i phyogs su song nas pha bong g.yag ro tsam zhig gi steng du langs nas 'ur lcag tshag sgra grags pa zhig brdab/de dgong tshes bco lnga'i dung zla dkar po de shar ri'i phag nas dal gyis 'char zhing dben pa'i rtswa thang gi snod bcud yongs khu sim/ zhi bde/lhing 'jags su gnas shing ri lung gang sar zla 'od skya thing nger 'dugakhyim dud so so'i lhas ra'i nang gi nor lug yongs nyin gang rtswa mchog ro bcad ༄kyis tshims te bag phebs ngang nyal zhing skyug ldad byed pa'i sgra cung zad thos/de'i skabs sde stod kyi gzhon nu pho mo tshos/'dzoms shog 'dzoms shog zer na/a sngon sngo khra'i dkyil la 'dzoms shogaser chen nyi ma de dang /dkar gsal zla ba de gnyis 'dzoms shogaser chen nyi ma de ni/'dzam gling drod skyid bster la 'dzoms shogadakar gsal zla ba de ni/ma rig mun pa sel la 'dzoms shogazhes 'dzoms bro'i glu dbyangs lhang lhang du grags byung bas de mar sde smad kyi pho gzhon mo gzhon tsho yang brel ba langs nas la las dgong zas bzas 'phro yang bzhag ste grog tshang brdol ba ltar khyu dang khyu byas te sde stod smad 181

gnyis kyi bar du yod pa'i bro gdan g.yu gzhong zhes bya ba rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i bro ra ste spang ljongs gzhong pa kha sbug tu bzhag pa 'dra ba'i steng du 'dzoms te thog mar phan tshun khams 'dri byed res byas/ la las rum las sna ru blangs te g.yar res byas/mo gzhon rnams kyang logs shig tu rub nas phan tshun sked rags bcings rogs sogs byed kyin da dung ma slebs pa'i pho gzhon mo gzhon 'ga' sgug gin 'dugadagra 'dul gyis kyang dgong zas bzas 'phro bzhag nas song ste sde stod smad kyi pho mo gzhon nu tsho'i ‘‘dpung khag ’’tu bzhugs/'gro khar pha dbang chen gyis ‘‘grod pa rgyags song ngam ’zer/a mas ‘‘bu grang yong ngo ’ zer bzhin dgra 'dul gyi 'gram par byil tsam zhig byas nas wa zhwa de phyi nang slog ste brdab brdab 'ga' byas te bu'i mgo la g.yogasde stod smad kyi pho mo gzhon nu yongs rdzogs 'dzoms rjes pho gzhon rnams phyogs gcig tu 'dus te lag gdang sbrel/ mo gzhon rnams phyogs gcig tu 'dus te lag gdang sbrel/ pho gzhon dang mo gzhon star pa gnyis po'i sne gnyis kyi pho gzhon dang mo gzhon lag gdang sbrel bas bro ra de yang bco lnga'i dung zla ltar sgor mo mi yi a long du gyur/dgra 'dul dang dbang skyid gnyis so so'i gral star gyi sne ru yod stabs kho gnyis lag gdang sbrel/ khos dbang skyid kyi lag pa 'jus ma thag dbang skyid kyis kho'i lag mgo mo rang gi phu dung gi nang du yar 'then nas dam par bcangs pa ni gzhan lag tu shor dogs ma yin par brtse dung gi mtshon byed los yin/zla ba ji ltar dkar mod mtshan mo yin pas da lta kho gnyis phu dung gi 182

nang du bya spyod gang spel yang gzhan gyis shes mi srid pas sems la 'tshab snang gang yang ma byung /de nas pho gzhon dang mo gzhon tshos mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis yul sde mi phyugs dang / ri lung rtswa chur gegs bar dang god chags mi yong ched sngar rgyun bzhin bro mchod phul bar/steng phyogs lha la lha 'khrug mi yong ched/lha chen tshangs pa dkar po grogs la byon/bar phyogs gnyan la gnyan 'khrug mi yong ched/gnyan chen sku lha ger mdzo grogs la byon/bar phyogs mi la mi 'khrug mi yong ched/mi bo ge sar rgyal po grogs la byon/'og phyogs klu la klu 'khrug mi yong ched/klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen grogs la byon/zhes bro mchod kyi glu blangs te pho gzhon rnams ling ling sgam sgam/ mo gzhon rnams ldem ldem 'khyug 'khyug gi bro gar 'khrab/bro gcig 'khrab rjes dgra 'dul gyis dbang skyid kyi phu dung gi nang du mo'i lag mgo shugs kyis btsir bas dbang skyid na zug gis ma bzod par an tsam ma gtogs skad shor/sde ba'i nang gi bu dang bu mo su 'dra zhig yin yang gnyen sgrig lo tshad la slebs na nges par du sde ba gzhan las mna' ma'am mag pa len pa las rang sde'i pho mo gzhon nu gnyen sgrig mi byed pa ni mes po'i dus nas dar ba'i srol zhig yin stabs dgra 'dul dang / dbang skyid gnyis da res bro ra'i nang gnyis ka so so'i gral star gyi mjug tu yod pas stes dbang gis lag gdang sbrel ba red snyam pa las phu dung gi nang du ‘‘tshul min gyi ’’bya spyod spel bzhin 183

yod pa su'i yid la shar srid/skabs 'di'i spyi tshogs kyi 'khor yug nang ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi rig gnas 'tsho ba zhes 'bod rung ba'i byed sgo ni lo re'i dus re'i rta rgyug dang dus chen/ ri gso dang / rgyun ldan zla 'od 'og gi sgor gzhas 'khrab rgyu las gzhan gang yang med/lhag par du thag ring lung khug gi 'brog sde de lta bu'i ngos nas bshad na gzhon nu pho mo rnams nyin gang dud 'gro'i rjes su 'brang nas rlung lhags pa dang / gangs char chu'i khrod nyin mo'i mi dang / mtshan mo'i khyi byas te 'tshar longs byung zhing de'i nang mi tshe'i mjug rdzogs par byed kyi yod pa las gzhan gyi 'du 'dzoms kyi byed sgo che ba med pas dkar gsal zla 'od kyi 'og tu sgor mo'i bro gar 'khrab cing snyan 'jebs kyi glu dbyangs len rgyu de rang la dbang ba'i spro skyid dpag tu med par brtsi gi yod/tshes bco lnga'i zla ba de skar phreng gur khang phub pa'i dbus su dkar mdangs ngom bzhin dgung sngon gyi dkyil du slebs/ da gzod khong tshos/a sngon dgung gi dbyings la/gsal chen nyi ma shar dus/khra chung skar ma'i me togagazhan gyi yul la phebs kyang /a sngon dgung gi dkyil la/yang yang 'dzoms pa'i bkra shis/bro ra khra mo'i las sgo/'di ga tsam la bzhag nas/na chung bu dang bu mo/rang rang khyim la log 'gro/184

sang dgong bro ra khra mor/yang yang 'dzoms pa'i bkra shis/zhes gyes bro'i glu dbyangs rtswa thang gi dgung sngon du khyab par byas te sde stod smad kyi gzhon nu pho mo rnams khyu dang khyu byas te rang gnas su log song /dgra 'dul yang na chung rtsed rogs gzhan dang 'dra bar nyin gcig gi ngal dub yongs ling ling gi gar stabs dang / snyan lhang lhang gi glu dbyangs kyis bkrus te rang nang du logasgo khar slebs dus sgo 'gram la rdo phur ring po zhig yod pa der sga srab kyis rgyan pa'i rta bo g.yu 'brug 'dra ba zhig btags nas 'dugathab nang gi me 'od dmar lham lham du 'phro bzhin a pha dang mi gzhan zhig skad cha shod bzhin 'dug pas nam phyed rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la mgron po gsar pa su 'dra zhig slebs pa yin snyam nas kho tsho'i lab gleng la lkog nyan byas/dbang chen gyis ‘‘bu 'di da lo lo bco lnga yin/ nga gnyis la bu 'di las med pas da mna' ma gcig len ran yod/ khyod kyi bu mo de ngas kyang mthong myong / lag las ka dang / mchor kha dog gang nas bltas kyang yid la 'gro po zhig 'dug sang lo'i lo gsar gyi snga nub gza' skar bzang dus shig la len gyi yin ’’zhes bshad/skad cha de go bas kho'i sems su dngangs 'tshab skyed de su tshang gi bu mo zer ba yin nam snyams nas rna ba sbra sgor sbyar nas gzab nan gyis nyan/kho'i a mas ‘‘nga'i bu 'di snying gi nor bu zhig yin/ nga gnyis la phyi yi lcags ri zer na'ang 'dra/ nang gi nor bu zer na'ang 'dra/ gang ltar ma shi lag gi brten sa dang / shi na pha gzhis sprod sa 'di las med/ nga tsho'i sde bas mna' ma mag pa gang yin yang gzhan sde las len pa ma gtogs rang 185

sde las len srol med pas khyod tshang gi mi rgyud de bzang bas slong ba yin ’’zer/gsar du slebs pa'i mgron po des ‘‘nga'i bu mo de lce thog gi bdud rtsi dang mgo thog gi bla ma min yang / bya thang dkar ma gtogs gshog grib med/ma a ma ma gtogs lag grib med/ khyim tshang bzang po khyod tshang la bster thub pa de ni ngo ma bla ma'i blo dang dpe cha'i gzhung zhes pa ltar nga rgad po'i bsam thog tu song ba zhig red/ kha sngon a khu dbang chen gyis de'i skor lab dus nga'i sems su bden pa yin nam snyam pa'i the tshom skyed byung bas de ring ched mngags yong ba yin/ khyed gnyis kyi skad cha tshang ma gser phye sil ma yin pas nga rgad po blo bde song ’’zhes brjod pa go bas dgra 'dul dug ma bzas mgo na/ chang ma btung ra bzi ste sems gong dkar sdug gi mtsho mo 'khyil yang mes po'i dus nas dar ba'i srol der gyen ldog byed ga la nus/khong tshos nyi ma re la tshigs re byas te tshigs mal lnga song rjes na thang chen po zhig yod sar slebs te der zla shas sdod rgyu byas/sa cha de ni ja gar rong ltar btsan po zhig min pas mtshan mo spyang ki yong nas lug kha shas bsad pa'i gnas tshul byung bas khong tshos dgong mo rtag par phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du lci ba'i me spungs spar ba ma zad khong tsho bzhi ka nor lug gi mtha' ru nyal nas srung ba byed kyi yod/nyi shar khyo shug gnyis sngas gdan gcig gi steng du nyal te dgong mo rtag par pags tshag gi nang du gcig la gcig 'khyud kyis 'dod sred kyi skad gdangs phra mos gtam gleng sna tshogs byed kyi yod/de dgong yang kho tshos dgong zas bzas rjes rang rang gi nyal chas dang sngas gdan khyer nas nyal bar song / kho gnyis nyal ma thag nyi shar 'o ma skyid kyi rum du 'dzul/nyi shar gyis 'o ma skyid kyi grod par phur gyin du ‘‘zla bzhi lhag tsam song ba 186

ma red dam ’’zhes 'dri zhor 'o gcig bskyal/‘‘red/ da zla lnga zin grabs yod red/ um ’’nyi shar gyi 'gram par 'o gcig bskyal nas ‘‘khyod yul la yod dus nag mo'i rum nang 'dzul e myong ri’zhes dris/‘‘ngas ngas gcig myong ’’zhes nyi shar gyis skad cha dab dib cig bshad pa dang de mar kho'i dran shes yid kyi me long gi ngos su sngar song 'das don gyi bar bcug ri mo chung chung zhig shar ba 'di lta ste/sde dpon tsha zhang nyi grags kyi bu mo che ba gser mtsho 'bum skyid ces pa de dang / chu bo'i pha rol gyi sde pa'i pho gzhon bsod nams nor dga' zhes pa de gnyis kha thug nas bsod nams nor dga' dgong mo rtag par gser mtsho 'bum skyid kyi sar yong ba dang / yong ba'i dus tshod khos gsal po shes kyi yod/nyin zhig gi dgong dro kho chu'i pha rol gyi sde bar sde dpon tsha zhang nyi grags kyi bka' ltar 'phrin zhig skyel bar song / de'i dus bsod nams nor dgas rta bo rkyang rgod la sga srab spras shing rnga mar dar tshon sna lnga'i rnga mdud brgyab nas sde ba las thon te phyin pa dang 'phrad pas nyi shar gyis de mar slog hrul gyi phu dung g.yas pa phrag steng nas blangs/ mgo'i zhwa phud de sprang pos zas slong pa ltar lag g.yas kyis bzung nas phyag 'bul zhus te ‘‘jo lags/ khyed brel ba che mdog de 'dra gang du phebs rgyu yin ’’zhes sked pa sgur zhing lce yang mnar/bsod nams nor dgas ‘‘sang nyin nga'i a zhang tshang gi bu bco lnga tshe ring la mna' ma bsu ba'i bag ston yin/ nga khong tsho'i ston mor yong dgos pa'i mgron brda 'byor byung ri’zhes bshad de rta la bzhon nas gom gang phyin rjes rta kha phyir bskor nas ‘‘kho re/ khyi gu nyi shar/ rjes ma nga yong dus khyi 187

yag po 'gog rogs/ mdang dgong nga'i nywa khyi'i kha la shor grabs byas byung ’’zhes bshad de ‘6hwa hwa hwa ’’zhes gad mo chen po zhig bgad de rta kha phyir bskor nas lcag gis brabs te bud song /de'i dgong mo nor lhas su nor 'dog skabs gser mtsho 'bum skyid kyis goms gshis chags pa ltar chu'i phar kha'i sde ba'i phyogs su yang yang blta gi yod pa nyi shar gyis mthong bas khong dgod shor nas ‘‘a che gser mtsho 'bum skyid/ be'u de ’’zhes bshad/ da gzod gser mtsho 'bum skyid kha phyir bskor nas blta dus be'u bre se gcig gis 'bri mo'i 'o ma 'jib kyin 'dug pa mthong nas ‘‘ya ltos dang / be'u 'di 'o ma ma gtogs bsam rgyu med ’’ces be'u de gdang la 'dogs rgyu brjed pa da gzod dran nas be'u de'i ske lung las bzung ste 'then nas gdang la btags/nyi shar gyi sems su be'u de 'o ma ma gtogs bsam rgyu mi 'dug mo rang bsod nams nor dga' ma gtogs bsam rgyu mi 'dug kyang do dgong nam ma langs bar sgug kyang re ba stong zad yin pa khyod kyis shes sam snyam/nub der zla ba sprin nag gis sgrib ste sa gzhi chen por khebs gcod nag po chen po zhig bkab pa ltar rang gi mdzub mo lnga yang mi mthong bar gyur/kho'i gnyid kyi byed po stong bsam sna tshogs kyis 'phrog song bas mthar rgyun par bsod nams nor dga' yong ba'i dus tshod kyi skabs der bgrod byed rkang pa zung rang dbang med par sbra hrul las don te/ gser mtsho 'bum skyid nyal sa'i phyogs su song ste stong bsam de mngon 'gyur byed rgyu'i sems thag bcad de sems shugs ldab 'gyur gyis bsod nams nor dga'i rdzun 'bag gyon te mo'i rum du 'dzul nas bskal brgyar lan gcig 'phrad pa'i go skabs 'dir rnga rang lag tu yod dus ma brdung na 'gyod kyang phyis drags pa red snyam nas tho rengs skar 188

chen ma shar bar mo'i rum du nyal nas bral khar mo'i mchu la 'o yang yang bster te mo'i rum las don te sbra hrul gyi nang du logade nas bzung kho'i sems su sde dpon gyi bu mo sbo shob ga tshod che yang nga'i brang 'og tu nyal myong bas mi tshad nga'i mchu dang lce 'jib myong bas sbo shob byed rin ci yod snyam nas sems nang du dga' tshor chen po byung nas spobs pa chen po skyed kyang de'i skor tshig zur tsam yang brjod ma myong / gal srid bshad na de ni ske 'khyer nas zhags pa nyos pa rang red/tag tag dgong mo de nas rtsis pa'i zla dgu zhag dgu phyin rjes gser mtsho 'bum skyid la khye'u yid du 'ong ba gcig btsas pas kho'i sems su phru gu de nga'i phru gu yin nam bsod nam nor dga'i phru gu yin snyam nas sbra hrul gyi nang du gzhan gyis ma mthong ba byas nas shel gyi me long chag krum gcig la blta dus/ phru gu de'i ngo gdong kho rang gi ngo gdong dang 'dra po yod pa'i tshor snang zhig byung ba ni mngon sum yin nam 'phrul snang yin mi shes mod/gang ltar go skabs byung tshe gser mtsho 'bum skyid kyi pang du nyar ba'i phru gu de'i ngo gdong la blta bas mi tshad der brtse dung chags nas pang du nyar te 'o byed 'dod skyed pa de ni nam yang 'grub thabs bral ba'i stong bsam zhig rang red/phru gu de dgod 'dzum shes pa nas bzung kho mthong ba dang 'dzum chung bstan bzhin ma yi pang du rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab byed kyin nyi shar la dga' snang gi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs ston gyi yod pas ‘‘nga'i bu 'di nga'i ma rgan gyi skye ba 'khrul med red ’’ces chig lab rgyag gi yod/phru gu de nar son te gom pa spo shes pa nas bzung / kho mthong ma thag kho'i phyogs su rgyug yong gi yod pas ‘‘nga'i bu ’’zhes 'bod kyin pang du bzung 'dod kyang / sde dpon tshang gi mi che chung su 'dra zhig gis mthong yang de 189

mar ‘‘bu tshur ma log na khyi gu nyi shar gyis am lcog za gi red ’’ces lag chung nas bzung ste khrid 'gro gi yod/phru gu des ‘‘min/ nga 'gro gi min/ am lcog za gi ma red ri’ces ngu bzhin 'gro 'dod mi byed pa mthong bas kho'i sems su sdug bsngal tshad med skyed kyang ‘‘rang gi ma rgan drin can gyi skye ba rang gi bu'i lus la blangs te sa phyed gdan bting / gnam phyed gos gyon mkhan sde dpon tshang la dbang nas kha la za rgyu 'bras dang bu ram/ lus la gyon rgyu dar dang gos chen/'dog rgyu gser dngul rin chen yod pa ni ma rgan drin can mo rang tshe sngon bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin pas slar yang nyam thag sprang po'i 'tsho ba skyel dgos med pas blo bde song ’’zhes chig lab rgyag gin/ sbra hrul gyi gseb las phru gu der lkog blta byed kyin tshe ring nad med dang / bsam don 'grub pa'i gsol ba smon lam yang yang btabs/de nas 'o ma skyid dang nyi shar gnyis rkub dang rkub gtugs nas gnyid lam gyi zhing khams su gshegs/rngon khyi lnga pos ‘‘'u 'u ri’zhes zug skad rgyag bzhin lhas dang sbra bskor gyin srog chags shig 'ded kyin 'dug pas de mar dbang chen gnyid las sad de spyang ki slebs 'dug ces slog pa lhob gyon byas te rgyug nas nyi shar gyi nyal chas las 'then pa na slog pa stong pa zhig las gang yang mi 'dug pas kho rang ngo tsha nas ci bya gtol med du gyur/da gzod nyi shar dang 'o ma skyid gnyis gnyid las sad kyang kho gnyis rum gcig gi nang du nyal yod pas ngo tsha kha skyengs kyis da dung gnyid ma sad khul gyis nyal nas bsdad/de'i skabs spyang ki de yang mi'i skad go bas rgyang ring du bros zin pas dbang chen rang gnas su log ste nyal yang gnyid kyi byed po da res spyang ki 190

des brkus pa ltar gnyid ma khug par bsam blo sna tshogs 'khor/nam zla nyin re las nyin re dro ru phyin te ri lung yongs sngo ljang du gyur te dbyar gyi dga' ston rol/ 'tsho bas ma dor ba'i yul gyar ba khong tsho dkar chu 'o ma rgyun ma chad par 'thung rgyu yod pas mi tshad nyin ltar zho dkrog nas mar phyur yang mang rab bsags/nyin shas phyin rjes kho tsho yang gnas de las bral te tshigs mal lnga tsam phyin te mdun du na thang rgya che zhing g.yas g.yon spang ri nyams dga' ba'i lung pa zhig tu slebs nas ston kha ma shar bar gnas der sdod rgyu gtan 'khel byas nas gzhis chags/'o ma skyid kyi grod pa nyin re las nyin re che ru phyin nas phru gu skye ran pa dang mtshungs kyang zla rtsis rgyag dus da dung zla gcig lhag tsam yod pas kho tshos 'o ma skyid la zas gang drag bster te gces phrug bzhin skyong ba dang snga dgong 'bri dang ma mo'i 'o ma 'jo rgyu las ljid las las mi bcug par pho las mo las tshang ma khong tsho'i phrag steng du babs te lci ba sgrug rgyu/ zho dkrog rgyu sogs las ka tsag tsig tshang ma dbang chen dang / nyi shar/ dgra 'dul gsum gyis las kyin yod/de nyin dbang chen gyis zhags pa ring po zhig khyer nas lug khyu'i 'gram du song nas shed 'dams byas/ lug tshang ma'i mig gis blta stangs rgyun ldan dang mi 'dra bar bdag po'i phyogs su dogs zon gyis blta bzhin bros 'gro bas kho'i sems nang ya mtshan dang snying rje zhig rang shugs kyis slebs kyang spyir na 'o ma skyid la 'tsho bcud yag po zhig dgos pa dang / mi tshang ma yang sha gsar zhig za 'dod pas snying rje'i bsam blo rgyab tu bskyur nas sha bzan mgo nag gzugs chen gcig 'dug pas der dmigs nas glog 'khyug pa ltar zhags pa g.yug pas lug tshang ma 'ur sgra dang bcas phyogs gzhan du 191

bros kyang sha bzan mgo nag de'i mgo zhags pa'i a long du tshud de bros thabs bral nas 'phag 'tshag rgyan gyin lug khyu'i phyogs su phyi bltas blta bzhin ‘‘rba/rba/ rba ’’zhes skad rgyag gin 'dug kyang dbang chen gyis kha nas ma ṇi 'don bzhin sems nang snying rje spu tsam med pa'i sgo nas zhags thag gi sne las yar 'then bzhin de'i rkang pa las bzung ste sbra'i chon thag gi sner btags te rdo leb g.yag lce dang 'dra ba zhig gi steng du gri brdar bzhin nang du 'dzul dus 'o ma skyid ‘‘a ru/ a ra ’’zhes skad rgyag bzhin nyi shar gyis skyor nas 'dug pas dbang chen lag nang gi brdar rdo g.yag lce 'dra ba de yang rang dbang med par sa ru lhung ste da res nad med bde thang yin yang glo bur du na zug chen po de 'dra rgyag pa ci yin nam snyam nas glo gri shubs su bcug ste ‘‘'o ma skyid/ga par na zug rgyag gi 'dug ’’ces dris/'o ma skyid na zug gis mi bzod par mig gnyis kyang dam par btsums nas ‘‘a ra/ a ru ’’zhes skad rgyag bzhin grod par mdzub mo btsugs pas skye zug langs pa shes nas dbang chen gyis ‘‘skye grabs red/ skye grabs red ’’ces skad rgyag bzhin 'o ma skyid bskyor te nyi shar la ‘‘mgyogs po/ kong dong zhig gi nang du ril ma'i gdan 'ding dgos/mi’zhes bshad/ gong gi skad cha de shod skabs dbang chen sems 'tshab langs pas dmag spyi chen po zhig gis 'thab 'dzing par sdig gtam gtong ba ltar skad shugs lhag par che/nyi shar rgyug ma 'dur gyis sbra'i 'dabs kyi kong dong zhig gi nang du ril ma bting rjes slar nang du 'ong nas nyal chas khyer te nyal sa bcal/de nas dbang chen dang nyi shar gnyis kyis bskyor nas 'o ma skyid der bsnyal/ dgra 'dul gyis de snga bud med phru gu skye ba mthong myong med pas 'o ma skyid kyi na zug drag po der zhed thag chod nas 'jim sku ji bzhin rang sar langs nas sdod pa las 'gul skyod kyi dbang rtsa rbad de nyams pa dang mtshungs/192

'o ma skyid bsnyal rjes dbang chen gyis sha bzan mgo nag cig chon thag la btags pa da gzod dran te rgyug ma 'dur gyis nang du song nas mar rdog khu tshur tsam zhig khyer 'ong nas lug de'i rwa co dang rna bar mar gyis byug tsam byas/ de 'phro'i mar tshang ma lug de'i kha nang du bcug ste tshe thar gtong ba'i cho ga ches stabs bde zhig gis 'o ma skyid ma bur bar chad mi yong ba'i smon lam btab ste lug de'i ske thag bkrol te btang / lug des kha nang gi mar rdog la zhen pa log pa'i tshul gyis mgo g.yug gi rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab byed kyin rgyugs te lug khyu'i nang du 'dres/'o ma skyid na zug gis bzod mi thub par ngo gdong las rngul chu khrum khrum du bzhur/ nyi shar mo rang gi sngas 'gor bsdad de rngul chu phyis rogs byas/dbang chen gyis sbra'i nang du mar khu bzhu dhibazhin snga sa nas gra sgrig byas pa'i phru gu'i gyon pa dang / gcin gdan blangs te brdab brdab sprug sprug dang / me thog tu g.yug g.yug byas nas tshe srog gsar pa de mi yul du slebs rgyur sgugad gzod dgra 'dul yang bsam rgyu yod par gyur nas me gtong ba dang /gro ma btso ba/ za rigs sna 'dzoms kyi thug pa bskol ba dhisogs skabs don las rnams hur thag byed kyin 'duganyi shar gyi ngo mdog 'o ma skyid kyi ngo mdog las kyang skyi g.ya' bar gyur nas 'o ma skyid kyi lag pa bzung ste ‘‘na na zug ga ga 'dra 'dug skye thub pa 'dug gam ’’zhes sems gso byas/'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘a da ru/ a ru/ a da ru ’’zhes skad rgyag pa las srol yohā/ byang rigs kyi srol du sbrum pa'i gzugs gzhi bskyar gso yong ched du phru gu btsas ma thag mar khu 'thung 'thung sdogosasbru/ma ma phru gu btsas rjes 'ju lam bskyar gso yong ched thog mar zas rigs kun 'dzoms kyi thug pa 193

nyi shar gyi skad char lan 'debs thub kyi mi 'duga'o ma skyid kyi lus la phru gu 'khor ba nas bzung nyi shar gyi sems su nga la nag mo yod pas mi tshad rang gi sha las chad pa'i dum du gcig kyang 'jig rten mi yul du slebs ran yod snyams nas dga' ba 'bum gyis myos kyang /da lta nag mo'i ngo gdong rngul chus brlan par gyur te skabs re am gtsigs bsdam pa dang / skabs re ‘‘a da ru ’’zhes smre sngags 'don pa/ yang skabs re na zug cung zad chung du phyin nas mig gnyis zum zhing kha nas dbugs hal ba'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs mthong tshe de snga phru gu yod pa'i dga' snang de 'ja' yal ba ltar yal nas ‘‘nga'i nag mo 'di'i tshe la bar chad mi yong ba shog ’’ces sems nang gsol ba 'debs pa dang / 'o ma skyid na zug che ru gyur te ‘‘a ru ’’zhes smre sngags 'don bzhin btsir skabs kho rang yang rang dbang med par dbugs sgom nas btsir ba dang / yang 'o ma skyid na zug chung du song nas dbugs lhom lhom byed skabs kho rang yang ri dwags rmas ma zhig dben pa'i brag phug tu yib nas na zug gis ma bzod par dbugs hal pa ltar dbugs lhom lhom byed kyin 'dugagal srid skabs der 'o ma skyid kyi tshab tu nyi shar gyis skye rung na khos som nyi the tshom med par bzod glags bral ba'i na zug de dag la ji mi snyam par 'o ma skyid kyi tshab tu skye nges red/dbang chen gyi sems su 'o ma skyid lo so brgyad la slebs skabs gzhi nas phru gu dang po skye dgos pas nyen kha chen po red snyam nas sems khral chen po byung ste dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs kyin dmigs brtse ma yang yang bton/'o ma skyid kyi na zug cung zad chung du phyin nas rdo phog pa'i byi'u bzhin dbugs lhom lhom du gtong bzhin 'dren byed zung rang 'gul gyis zum pa 194

dang ngo gdong gi rngul chu'i thigs sding dag kyang than pa'i tsha gdug khrod kyi chu phran ltar nyung du phyin pas nyi shar gyi sems su 'di ltar na tsha med par drag song na ci ma rung snyam pa las phru gu'i pha byed rgyu'i blo de med par gyur te re zhig kho rang yang sos dal du song /‘‘a da ru ’’zhes skad rgyag bzhin 'o ma skyid slar na zug langs te nyi shar gyi lag pa dam par btsir/ zug zer da res las ldab 'gyur gyis che bas ngo gdong dang / mgo/ sbar mo/ mgrin pa yongs rngul chus brlan par gyur te rlangs pa'ang 'phyur yong gi 'dugadabang chen gyis kha nas ma ṇi 'don bzhin gam du song nas ‘‘da dung skye thub kyi mi 'dug gam ’’zhes dris/nyi shar gyis ‘‘mi 'dug ’rices nyam thag pa'i mig gis dbang chen la bltas pa ni khyod la thabs shes bzang po 'dra med dam zhes 'dri ba dang mtshungs/dbang chen gyis ‘‘'o na mgo chu don 'dug gam ’’zhes dris/nyi shar gyis ‘‘mi shes ’’zer/bud med phru gu skye skabs skye bsu byed mkhan gso rig la sbyang pa che ba'i bud med cig dgos/ mthun rkyen de ma 'dzoms kyang cung zad nyams myong yod pa'i bud med cig dgos pa las skyes pas skye bsu byed rgyu ni mi 'os pa yin yang / yul der sgo phyugs phud pa'i mo rigs 'o ma skyid las med stabs ga 'dra byas na drag snyam nas dbang chen me mdag gi thang chen zhig tu rkang rjen mar 'gro ba ltar brel ba 'tshub 'tshub kyis phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed kyin smin ma'i mdud pa dam du bcings nas bsam blo btang yang thabs shes ma rnyed pas ngo tsha'i 'bag kho na gyon te sgug sdod rgyu ni thabs shes ma red bsam nas 'o ma skyid kyi gos gsham yar brdzes te blta dus/ skye sgo 'bur du don 195

pa dang cung zad kha gdang pa las da dung mgo chu don mi 'dug pas thabs shes ma byung /yang cung tsam phyin rjes 'o ma skyid kyi na zug cung 'jags te dbugs hal bzhin nyi shar gyi pus mo'i steng du mgo bzhag nas mig btsum bzhin par ‘‘nga la nga la chu chu gang ster dang ’’zhes skad dma' pos bshad/nyi shar gyis ‘‘a khu dbang chen/ ja phor pa gang khyer shog ’’ces skad brgyab/dbang chen gyis 'o ja drod 'jam phor pa gang dgra 'dul gyi lag tu bzhag nas ‘‘'di sprod dang ’’zer/ bud med phru gu skye ba mthong myong med stabs 'o ma skyid kyi na zug drag po des kho la 'jigs skrag chen po byung nas nang du las ka byed pa las sgor don te de phyogs su 'gro myong med kyang da lta mi 'gro ka med red/ khos 'o ja phor pa gang lag tu bzung nas sems chung gis der song nas ja phor nyi shar gyi lag tu bzhag de'i skabs 'o ma skyid kyis ja hub chung re btung ste ngal re gsos/ ja rbad de btung rjes nyi shar gyis ja phor dgra 'dul gyi lag tu bzhag nas 'o ma skyid kyi ngo gdong la bltas nas bsdad/dgra 'dul gyis lag nang gi phor par bltas te ‘‘da dung ja bster dgos sam ’’zhes dris/'o ma skyid kyis mgo bo 'phred du g.yug nas mi dgos pa'i tshul bstan/de nas mos dbugs ring zhig btang ste nyi shar gyi lag par dam por 'jus/dgra 'dul nang du slebs rjes dbang chen gyis ‘‘na zug 'jags pa red pas ’’zhes dris/dgra 'dul gyis mgo lcog tsam byas/196

na zug 'jags pa ni skye mi thub pa'i 'gog rkyen yin stabs na zug langs te mgyogs po skye thabs shig ci drag snyam nas dbang chen 'dug bzod mi bde bar sgor don zhor du lug khyur blta dus skyid po gcig kyang med par sdug po gcig thog gnyis brtsegs zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la lug khyu dum bu mang por gyur te phyogs gang sar bros pa'i dkyil du ri spyang sngon mo gnyis rgyug bzhin pa mthong nas ‘‘kho re/ dgra 'dul/ dgra 'dul/ lug spyang kis bzas song rgyugs ’’zhes skad brgyab/kho gnyis gnyis ka lug khyu'i phyogs su song na nyi shar la rogs pa med pa dang / gnyis ka ma song na dgra 'dul gcig pus spyang ki gnyis la kha gtad gcog dka' bas/ bzung na lag pa tsha/ glod na rdza ma chag ces pa'i dpe bzhin dbang chen re zhig ga byed 'di byed med par phar rgyug tshur rgyug byas/skabs der spyang kis mi yong ba mthong nas kha bkram nas lug dum bu re'i phyogs su spyang ki re rgyug ste lug gi steng du mchongs nas lug mang po sa ru brdab ste mnan/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘ki hi hi ’’zhes skad rgyag gin 'ur rdo klad la bskor nas spyang ki gcig gi phyogs su 'ur rdo 'phangs/ spyang ki des lug ro bzas 'phro bzhag nas yang bskyar lug dum gyi phyogs su rgyugs/yang spyang ki gcig shos des lug gcig sa ru brdab nas za ba mthong nas dgra 'dul gyis 'ur rdo 'phang rjes phar bltas pas na yang spyang ki gcig shos des lug gcig sa ru brdab nas bzas/de'i skabs 'o ma skyid sngar bas che ba'i na zug langs nas ‘‘a a a ru ’rizhes smre sngags 'don pa dang / na zug gis ma bzod par khog stod slog pa'i nang las don te gcus ril rgyag gi 'dugadza drag gi gnas tshul tshang ma dus gcig tu slebs pas dbang chen brel 197

'tshab kyis phar gom pa bcu grangs shig rgyug rjes tshur gom pa bcu grangs shig rgyug pa'i tshul ni 'brog khyim gyi bud med mdzangs mas thags bran pa dang mtshungs/de'i skabs kho tshur rgyug nas 'o ma skyid kyi gos gsham yar brdzes nas blta dus da dung mgo chu don med pas ‘‘cung zad sdug rus byos ang ’’zhes bshad zhor rtab rtab por sbra'i nang du rgyug dus gom mgyogs che bas thab 'gram gyi khog lter rdog rgyag bzhus te mgo rting slog nas 'o ja tshang ma me mdag gi nang du rgyug ste thal rdul 'phyur/ khos myur stabs kyis khog ltir 'jog skyor byas pa dang chabs cig ka bar bcings pa'i bod mda' lag tu blangs nas mgyogs myur ngang rdzas mdel blugs/ de mar kho'i sems su 'o ma skyid kyi na zug dang da dung skye mi thub par bltas na phal cher stabs mi legs pa'i rkyen ngan 'phrad nyen 'dug pas da lta sems can gsod pa'i sdig pa bsags na mi 'os snyam nas me mda' mgo rting slog nas mde'u len thabs byas kyang mde'u phyir ma don pas me mda'i mgo mjug slog ste sna rdzas blugs shing sbi sdir me sbar nas sgor don/de'i skabs nyi ma'i tsha gdug gi 'og tu dbugs hal bzhin nyal nas yod pa'i rngon khyi lnga po gzhi nas dran te me mda' sa ru bzhag nas khyi lnga po'i 'dogs thag dkrol te dgra 'dul gyi rogs par btang /rngon khyi lnga po bya 'phur ba'am glog 'khyug pa ltar spyang ki'i phyogs su rgyugs/spyang ki de gnyis kyis lam du lug ro mang po bzhag nas da dung lug khyu'i phyogs su rgyug gi 'dug de'i bar dgra 'dul nus shugs gang yod kyis rgyug gin 'ur rdo 'phangs kyang lag gi mtshon cha zhan pas phan nus cher ma thon/dbang chen gyis me mda'i kha gnam la gtad te ‘‘twa ’zhes brgyab/198

spyang ki gnyis pos me mda'i skad go ba dang rgyug mtshams bzhag nas kha tshur bskor pa'i mur mda' mo 'dra ba'i rngon khyi lnga rgyug yong ba mthong bas da gzod gzhi nas lug khyu las bral te phyogs gzhan du bros/rngon khyi lnga pos mjug ma bdud kyi zhags pa smyug lcag las drang par bsnar/ rna ba rlung gi gshog pa bya gshog ltar brkyang nas sder bzhi sa la mi reg pa 'phur ba'i tshul gyis spyang ki gnyis po'i rjes bsnyegs/ spyang ki gnyis pos da res lug mang po bzas te rgyags drags pas mgyogs po rgyug mi thub pas rngon khyi lnga pos spyang ki gnyis po'i rjes zin te the tshom spu tsam med par spyang ki'i steng du mchongs nas phan tshun dmar 'dzing gi las la bzhugs pas re zhig thal rdul gyi phung po zhig las ci yang mi mthong bar gyur/dgra 'dul gyis slog pa'i thu gsham brdzes te rgyugs/ gam du slebs dus spyang ki gnyis dang khyi lnga phan tshun rmug res 'dzing res kyis skabs re spyang ki 'og tu mnan/ skabs re khyi 'og tu mnan/ dgra 'dul gyis snga sa nas mthon por 'phyar ba'i gri de spyang ki'i steng du 'dzugs par thengs mang brtsams kyang spyang ki dang khyi rnams sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma'i sprul ba bton pa ltar steng 'og brje res kho na byed pas 'dzugs pa'i go skabs ma ldan/mda' mo nag rkang gis gtsos pa'i khyi gsum gyis spyang ki gcig la rmug gin khyi'i 'og tu spyang ki'i rnga ma las mi mthong ba dang / khyi gzhan gnyis kyis spyang ki gcig shos dang dmar 'dzing gis steng 'og brje res kyis 'gre ldog rgyag gi 'dug spyang kis da res lug mang po bzas te grod pa rgyags drags pa dang / da lta gzugs po'i 'gul skyod shugs tshad che bas da res bzas pa yongs da lta phyir skyug gin 'dug spyang ki des lu gu gcig gson por khyur mid btang pa de da lta phyir skyug skabs mgrin par 'gag nas brnangs par gyur nas khyi la rmug pa'i nus pa med par gzhan dbang du song 199

nas khyis phar 'drud tshur 'drud byed pa'i skabs dgra 'dul gyis spyang ki de'i mkhal mar shugs kyis gri zhig btsugs pas spyang ki de na zug gis ma bzod par dbugs rngub gtong chen po gcig gis lu gu'i ro de phyir skyug pa dang sbrags lus kyi rus sgrom zhig pa ltar nar mor 'gyel te shi/dgra 'dul dang khyi gnyis po mnyam du spyang ki gcig shos yod sar slebs dus rngon khyi gsum pos spyang ki de'i lus gang sar rmug nas shi bar nye yang lug gnyis rgya 'u (khyi de 'dzam pa zhig gi lag nas lug gnyis sprad de nyos pas lug gnyis rgya 'u zhes btags pa red ) yi lag pa kha ru bcangs te rmug gi 'dug dgra 'dul gyis tshul de mthong bas khong khro me ltar 'bar nas spyang ki de'i grod pa g.yas par gri btsugs te dkrug dkrug cig byas pas spyang ki de kha chen po zhig gdang nas lug gnyis rgya 'u yi lag pa glod cing grod pa'i rma khung las da res bzas pa'i lug sha dzar dzor khrag dang 'dres te phyir 'phyur nas khrag dri skyur mo zhig gang sar khyab pas dgra 'dul zhe mer langs nas skyug pa dang / mig gnyis mchi mas khengs te rab rib tu gyur/'o ma skyid kyi gos gsham 'og gi sa brlan par gyur 'dug pas mgo chu don zin pas skye ran yod nges snyam nas dbang chen gyis phru gur g.yog byed tsha ru dang lte bcings skud pa rum du blugs nas 'o ma skyid kyi gos gsham yar brdzes nas skye rgyur sgugazug gzer langs nas btsir dus skye sgo nas phru gu'i spyi gtsug mthong tsam mthong tsam byed kyi 'dug pas dbang chen gyis ‘‘'o ma skyid/ sdug rus byos skye ran 'dug sdug rus byos/ sdug rus byos skye ran 'dug ’’ces shod kyin brel ba 'tshub 'tshub kyis lag pa gnyis skye sgo'i 'og tu bzhag nas skye bsu'i gra sgrig byas/'o ma skyid kyis nyi shar gyi lag par dam por bzung nas ‘‘a/ a/200

a da ru ’mizhes shugs kyis btsir ba dang dus mnyam nyi shar gyis kyang rang dbang med par dbugs sgom nas btsir rogs byas/'o ma skyid kyis am btsigs bsdams nas ‘‘a da ’’zhes shugs kyis btsir ba dang dus mnyam phru gu de dmar 'khyug 'khyug ngang skye sgo las don te dbang chen gyi lag nang du lhung / de mar khos mgyogs myur ngang lte bcings skud pa blangs te lte thag dam par bcings nas bcad de phru gu tsha ru'i nang btum nas rum nang blugs rjes bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la yang phru gu gcig don byung bas ‘‘da dung gcig 'dug ’’ces skad shor ba dang ga byed 'di byed med par lte bcings de'i sne mo bcad de lte thag dam par bsdams nas bcad de yang tsha ru zhig gi nang du btum nas pang du bzung ste da dung gcig med dam snyam nas sgug kyang da lta bu rogs las gzhan gang yang mi 'dug pas kho rtab rtab por nang du log nas phru gu dmar 'byar gnyis mnyam du slog pa yi nang du bsnyal te ya rkan la ma mo'i mar gsar rdog tsam re sbyar/de nas snga sa nas gra sgrig byas pa'i mar khu de khyer nas 'o ma skyid la bster/'o ma skyid phru gu skyes zin te na zug 'jags shing lus stobs zad de nyal ba dang / nyi shar yang na zug 'jags pa ltar dbugs lhom lhem gyis 'o ma skyid kyi gam du 'gyel nas 'dug pa ni skam sar bzhag pa'i nya ro zhig dang 'dra/dbang chen dgod 'dzum zhig shor nas ‘‘hwa hwa/ khyed kyis kyang phru gu skyes zin pa ma red dam/ wa ye/ da yar longs ’’zhes skad brgyab pas kho gnyid las sad pa ltar dbang chen gyi ngo gdong la bltas te ‘‘phru gu skyes tshar ba red dam ’rizer/dbang chen gad mo shor nas ‘‘hwa hwa hwa/ bstan bshig ma slong dang phru gu skyes zin pa da dung ma tshor ram/ dpe mi srid ririces mgo bo 'phred du 201

g.yug gin nang du song nas thab nang du lci ba blugs te da gin bskol ba'i zas rigs sna 'dzoms kyi thug pa de tsha po bzos/nyi shar gyis bu rogs gdan hrul gyi nang du btums nas thag ring tsam gyi sar gnam mi mthong ba'i kong dong zhig gi nang du bskyur/'o ma skyid kyi gzugs stobs zhan po rang med stabs dbang chen dang /nyi shar gnyis kyis g.yas g.yon nas bskyor te nang du khrid nas bsnyal/brel zing dang / dza drag gi gnas tshul tshang ma bde blag ngang mjug 'gril zhing sems nang gi rdog khres dor bas nyi shar bde lcag dod par gyur nas 'o ma skyid la ja dang / thug pa bster ba/ me gtong ba/ chu len pa/'o ma skyid kyi ngo gdong la blta bzhin ngo gdong las sngar med kyi 'dzum mdangs phyung bzhin du ‘‘da blo bde song / blo bde song ’’zhes chig lab rgyag pa dang /‘‘na gi mi 'dug gam/ gang za 'dod 'dug ’’ces 'o ma skyid la skad cha 'dri ba dang / ngo gdong las bzhur ba'i rngul chu phyi rogs dang / thur du dpyangs pa'i skra byil bzhin ‘‘de ring shi rgyu red bsam nas nga tshor ba med par gyur song / ngas de ring ma gtogs nag mo phru gu skye ba mthong myong med/ da blo bde song / sang nyin sha bzan gcig bsha' dgos ’’zhes shod kyin phu dung g.yas pa phud de nang du sku mgron zhig phebs pa ltar nang las la brel/dbang chen yang blo bde bar gyur nas dkyil krung du bsdad de ‘‘de ring lug kha shas spyang kis bzas song / thog mar brel 'tshab che bas sha khyi gtong rgyu'ang brjed song / de ma gtogs lug mang po de tsam gsod thub kyi ma red ’’zer/skabs de dus nyi shar gyis 'o ma skyid kyi bde thang kho nar bsam blo gtong ba las gzhan la bsam blo gtong khom ma byung bas lug khyu'i nang du spyang ki slebs pa dang / dbang chen gyis me mda' brgyab pa/ rngon khyi mngags pa 202

bcas tshor mi 'dug pas ‘‘a/ spyang kis lug bsad song zer ram ’’zhes rang gi rna bar yid ma ches par de ltar dris/dbang chen gyis ‘‘khyod kyis ngas me mda' brgyab pa'ang tshor ma byung zer ram ’rizhes mig hur rer nyi k+ṣ-ishar la bltas/‘‘ngas gcig kyang tshor ma byung ’’zhes nyi shar gyis mgo bo 'phred du g.yug gin ‘‘nga tshor ba med par gyur pa 'dra ’’zhes brjod/‘‘red/ thog mar brel 'tshab che bas sha khyi gtong rgyu brjed zhag ’’ces brjod bzhin mgrin pa kyog ste sbra'i sgo srubs las dgra 'dul gyi phyogs su blta tsam byas/de'i skabs phru gu gcig gnyid sad de ngu skad brgyab byung bas 'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘phru gu de nga la sprod dang / ngas 'o ma bster ri’zer/nyi shar phru gu'i phyogs su song dus der phru gu gnyis 'dug pas rang gi mig 'khrul 'dug snyam nas mig phur phur byas te bltas kyang de ni 'khrul shes min par mngon sum red 'dug pas kho rbad de hang sang nas ‘‘'di 'di 'di ci red phru gu gnyis 'dug ri’ces gdong gshis kyang rbad de 'gyur nas mig kyang ches cher gdang /dbang chen gad mo shor bzhin du ‘‘phru gu gnyis skyes pa red ’’zer/'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘da gin khyod gang byas pa red/ ra bzi ba ltar tshor ba med par gyur 'dug ri’ces dgod tsam byas nas mgo rum du bcug‘‘a ma ma/ phru gu gnyis 'dug ’’ces sems nang du sngar med kyi dga' spro skyed de kha thal nas ‘‘da byas na mi rer phru gu re 'dug ri’ces skad brgyab nas rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab byas/dbang chen gyis ‘‘de 'dra zer mi rung / de gnyis ka khyed rang gi phru gu red/ mda' gcig gis bya glag gnyis gsod zer ba'i dpe ltar ’’203

mjug gi skad cha de ma bshad par ‘‘khyod 'di red ’’ces nyi shar gyi phyogs su mthe bong ker nas bstod ra 'then/nyi shar gyis 'jig rten na gnyis su med pa'i be+eḍūr+ya'i bum pa zhig lag tu blangs pa ltar sems chung gis phru gu de yar blangs te ga ler 'o ma skyid kyi lag tu bzhag 'o ma skyid kyis phru gu tshur blangs te brang khar bzung nas 'o 'dzin gyi mgo phru gu'i kha nang du bcug ste 'o ma bster zhor du spyi bor byil byil byas/dbang chen gyis 'o ja phor pa kha shas btung rjes sgor don te dgra 'dul gyi rogs par song /nyi shar gyis 'o ma skyid kyi ngo gdong la byil tsam byas te ‘‘phru gu gnyis skyes pa ya mtshan/ de nga tsho mi phyugs 'phel ba'i bzang rtags shig yin gyi red ’rices brjod/e ma/ byang thang gi dbyar dus ni de 'dra'i thung ba la ang / ri lung yongs sngo ljang gi gos gsar bklubs cing khra chil chil du bzhad pa'i ri skyes me tog gi dri zhim phyogs bcur 'thul ba'i khrod du dar dir bung ba'i sgra snyan gyis phye leb sgeg mo'i gar stabs la ram 'degs byed pa'i dbyar gyi dga' ma'i bzhin la ston gyi gser mdangs mngon bzhin 'dugad ni ston zla 'bring por slebs te phyugs rigs kyi thon rdzas bsdu ba'i dus la babs pas lug la la'i mgrin pa'i rgyud kyi bal rnying sa ru lhung pa'i shul nas bal gsar dkar zhing gtsang ba sor gang ma zin tsam 'tshar te bal gyi shubs nang nas lug gi mgrin pa bsring pa dang 'dra/ dpyid dus su skyes pa'i lu gu rnams kyi spyi gtsug tu rwa co sor lnga tsam 'tshar te rang rang gi ma yi rjes su 'brang nas rtsed 'khrab brdung /de nyin nas bzung bal 'breg 'go tshugs/ khong tshos lug khyu chu khug 204

tu bkag nas bal gri rdo la brdar te lug re re bzhin bzung nas sug lag mnyam du bsdams/rgyun par ha cang lhing 'jags pa'i byang thang gi lung khug chung chung der de ring bal breg gi las yul de ni ha cang 'khrug cha dod pa zhig yin pas 'byams klas kyi 'jig rten der 'khrug cha dod pa'i gson shugs shig sbyin/dbang chen gyi phu dung gnyis ka phud de zangs dmar g.ya' can gyi mdog dang 'dra ba'i stod kyi sha nag rdog re re bzhin 'jim gzugs ltar 'bur du thon zhing khrag rtsa rab tu rgyas pa ni de'i steng du gya ma gyu ru rgyu ba'i sbrul dang 'dra/ khos lug shed bzang gcig bzung nas sug lag bsdams rjes rdar rdo lag tu bzung nas/gri leb chen g.yas brdar g.yon brdar red/yang min na brdar yun ring tsam byed/yang min na brdar shugs che tsam byed/da brdar yun ring tsam byed long med/brdar shugs che tsam byed rgyu yin/zhes bal glu gtong bzhin mtshon byed rang bzhin gyis bal gri rdo la lan gsum brdar nas gzugs po gzhu ltar gug nas bal bregade'i skabs nyi shar gyis kyang phu dung gnyis ka phud de mdun du bsdams nas dbang chen gyi phyogs su 'gran rtsod rang bzhin gyis blta tsam byas nas/gri kham sder ma'i ya gcod tsam/gri kham sder ma'i ma gcod tsam/rgod po bu de'i lag rjes red/nga dam pa'i chos la ma sbyang yang /skya ril ril shog skya sgyur sgyur red/205

lug lag pa gnyis kyi kha bar la/mtshon sngon mo chu bya 'khyug 'khyug red/lug khyod ni khyod ni brel po red/lug g.yang mo spang dkar rtswa la brel/mi nga ni nga ni brel po red/mi nga ni 'khor ba'i las la brel/khyod nga rang gnyis po brel mnyam red/ces glu gtong mtshams bzhag pa dang lug gcig gi bal breg zin te glod rjes yang lug khyu'i nang nas gcig bzung nas sar brdab ste sug lag bkyig nas breg 'go tshugs/'o ma skyid kyis phru gu gnyis por 'o ma bster te gnyid bsnyal rjes khyim nang gtsang mar phyags pa dang / chu blangs rjes ja bzos te khong tshor ja phor pa gang re blugs rjes khog ltir khyer nas nang du nyin dgung gi zas g.yos sbyor byed 'go brtsams/khong tsho mi re'i gam du rang rang gi phor pa'i nang ja blugs nas yod kyang ja 'thung gin ngal gso rgyag mkhan gcig kyang med pas ja phor gyi nang du thal rdul mthug po zhig chags nas ja yi ('o ja ) thog ma'i rang mdog mi mngon par gyur/ dgra 'dul gyi ja phor lug gis rdog dzis thebs nas mgo rting log kyang don der jus gtogs byed khom ga la yod/khong tshor tshad ldan gyi bal gri med par glo gris bal 'breg dgos stabs shin tu gcod mi bde ba dang las chod kyang chung yang las mi gsum ka hur sems che bas dus yun ring po ma 'gor bar lug khyu phyed ka'i bal breg zin/cung zad phyin rjes yang 'o ma skyid kyis byis pa dmar 'byar la nu zho bster ba ltar rdza ma'i khog lter tsha po de lag pa gnyis kyi phu dung gis zin te 206
