brang steng du sbyar nas khong tshor ja blugs par brtsams pa na nyi shar dang /dbang chen gnyis kyi ja phor thal bas khengs nas yod pas/ mos kho gnyis kyi phor pa'i nang gi ja grang mo rdul gyis khengs pa de dag bshos te bal rdog cig gis phyis tsam byas nas phor pa re'i nang ja gang re blugs te ‘‘ja 'thung /ja tsha po gang re thungs ’’zhes bshad kyang bal 'breg rgyur mgo 'khor ba las a lan sbyin mkhan mi 'dug khong tsho gsum ga rngul chus tshos te skra las kyang blangs pa 'phyur gyi 'dug kyang phyis tsam mi byed par phu dung gnyis ka phud de bal chun po re re bzhin lag g.yon mas bzung ste lag g.yas pas bal gsar rnying gnyis kyi 'dres mtshams nas gcod pa'i nyams 'gyur phra mo re re yang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos mi ldan par gcig mtshungs su snang /nyi shar gyis sha bzan shed chen gcig gi bal breg zin nas sug lag gi dkyig thag bkrol pa dang lug de rang dbang gi bde skyid thob pa'i tshor snang mtshon pa'i mchong lding rgyag gin lug khyu'i nang du 'dres/de mar yang rgyug shar gcig gis lug sha bzan mgo nag gcig gi rkang pa nas bzung ste khrid yong nas sug lag dam par dkyig ste/rgyab 'di na gangs ri spungs 'dra 'di/pha bzang bu yis breg le red/ rimadun 'di na ser ba 'gril 'dra 'di/bu bsod nams can gyis bsags le red/da ban bla ma min yang sgom re rgyob/bya ngang pa min yang ske re rkyongs/da ma 'gul ma 'gul g.yang mo luga'agul che na g.yang mo jus ngan red/ces glu sang sang dgung sngon la grags pa gtong bzhin ‘‘sag sag sag ’’207

ces bal 'breg pa las ja phor gyi phyogs su mig blta tsam yang ma byas/ kho'i mjing pa nas ma le'i bar rngul chu khrum khrum du bzhur te sa ru thigs kyin 'dugade'i skabs nyi shar gyis glo bur du ‘‘oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ ’’zhes skad brgyab byung bas phal cher kho'i lag par rma bzos pa yin gyi red bsam nas 'o ma skyid myur stabs kyis gam du song nas blta dus te le ①gcig gi sked pa bal gris bcad nas 'dug pas mo blo bde bar gyur/‘‘a/ a/ a mi’phru gu'i ngu skad grags byung bas 'o ma skyid gzhi nas tshor ba dwangs pa ltar sgur sgur byas te mdun du bzhag pa'i khog lter gyi lung nas bzung dus da dung tsha po yod pas ‘‘a tsha tsha ’’zhes skad shor pa dang sbrags khog ltir gyi lung glod de mdzub mo lngas rna gshog la phur phur byas/ de nas phu dung gis khog lter yar blangs te 'gro 'dod la ma 'dod kyis bud song /ma gzhi 'o ma skyid kyi ngos nas bshad na lug gi bal 'breg rgyu ni cha rgyus med pa'i las ka zhig ma yin yang / lo shas byang stong mi med kyi sar rang gcig po bzod bsran dka' ba'i 'tsho ba ya nga po bskyal te lug bal 'breg pa'i las ka ma las par yun ring song tsang de ring lug bal 'breg pa mthong dus las yul de ni spro snang ldan zhing 'khrug cha dod pa/ 'gran rtsod kyi rang bzhin ldan pa zhig yin pa'i tshor snang skyes/dbang chen gyis rang gi mdun du yod pa'i lug de'i bal 'breg bzhin mgrin pa dgra 'dul gyi phyogs su gtad de ‘‘bu/ da bal glu gtong res khyod yin no/ kha 'ug ge ma sdod/ nyams dga' byos/ nyams dga' les la la gnod le min mizer/de mar dgra 'dul gyis khengs skyung spu tsam med pa'i sgo nas/dhi te le/ dbyar dus lug gi lus su yod pa'i gzhan brten 'tsho 'bu zhig gi ming /208

phyugs nag med (nyes med )bkyig yun ma ring ang /rtswa dbyar rtswa zhag gsum mgron po red/chu dbyar chu (yang )de dang 'dra 'dra red/ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang lug de'i bal breg zin nas glod de rgyug thengs gcig gis lug gcig gi rkang pa las bzung nas khrid byung bas/dbang chen gyi sems su bu dgra 'dul cher longs nas skyes pho rab kyi gral du tshud 'dug snyam pa'i dga' tshor chen po byung nas bu'i phyogs su blta tsam byas/dgra 'dul ma khog las don nas de ring bar dka' tshegs che ba'i las ka 'di lta bu las myong med stabs sked pa dang / gru tshigs/ dpung tshigs/mkhrig tshigs/ tha na mdzub mo re re bzhin gzer zug bzod dka' ba yod kyang / bu zhe sdang med na bu mo dang / mtshon rno ngar med na me dkrug red snyam nas ngal gso rgyag sems rtsa ba nas med par lug gi bal breganyin gcig dang phyed ka'i dus yun nang khong tshos dka' tshegs chen pos 'bad mthar lug yongs kyi bal breg zin nas lug khyu'i nang gi pha phyugs shed bzang rwa gzugs bde shos gcig yod pa de'i rwa cor bal 'dzar gyis rgyan/ gzugs po'i steng du btsag dmar po'i g.yung drung gis rgyan te lug khyu dang bar thag nges can zhig btang ste der dar ba bshos/ khong tsho'i bal grir bal 'dzar dkris te dgung du 'phyar nas g.yug g.yug byed kyin skad gsang mthon po'i mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis ‘‘dgra kha las thar ro/nad kha las thar ro/ lug g.yang mo brgya 'phel stong 'phel shog ’rices mdzad sgo'i kha g.yang de bsgrags/dus bzhi'i mtshams tshigs ches mi gsal ba'i byang thang gi ston mjug de mi yul du byon nas ri thang yongs ser thing thing du bsgyur/ ston rlung yang yang g.yo ba dang / nam mkha' sngo la g.ya' dag pa'i me long dang 'dra/209

rab dkar chu 'dzin gyi phung po tsham tshom ston rlung gis ded de phyogs dang phyogs su bskyod/ mtshan mo zla 'od sngar bas dkar zhing rgyu skar 'od mdangs 'tsher/ mtsho dang mtshe'u yi kha ru dar srab po chags pa de dag zhogs pa'i nyi gzhon gyi zer brgya'i khrod du 'od lham lham 'phro/ ngang pa dang ngur pa/ khrung khrung / chu skyar/ thing ril sogs skam chu gnyis 'tsho'i 'dab chags kyi tshogs dag rang rang gi khyim tshang re grub nas pha sngon ma rjes phru gu dkyil du khrid de gshog zung rdeb nas lho phyogs su 'phur bzhin 'duganor lug yongs rdzogs sha shed bzang pa tshil rdog dang 'dra ba/ rwa co la snum gyis byug pa ltar 'od mdangs bkra/ g.yag gis rkang pa sa la 'drud kyin rwa 'dzing 'gran pa sogs ha cang nyams dga' yang gnas de kho tsho dgun sdod bya yul zhig min stabs ring min de las bral rgyu red/ 'o na gnas gang du 'gro zhe na/ grang reg gi gnod 'tshe chung zhing rtswa chu gnyis 'dzoms kyi ja gar rong du log rgyu red dam zhe na ma yin te kho tsho yang bya rigs de dag dang 'dra bar lho phyogs su gnas spos bya rgyu red/ sa cha de'i rgyud kyi gnam gshis nyen re las nyin re grang du 'gro ba/mtshan mo rtag par rtswa thang gi gang sar ba mo srab pos g.yog pa/ mtsho dang mtshe'u yi mtha' ru nyin gung yang bzhu mi thub pa'i 'khyag pa chags pa yi dbyar dus ches nyams dga' ba'i sa cha der da gzod skyi g.ya' ba'i dus tshigs shig shar 'go tshugs pas kho tsho tshang ma lho ru gnas spos byed rgyu'i sems pa 'gog med skyes/nyin shas de'i ring kho tshos dbyar dus kyi yong 'bab mar phyur dang bal khul rtsid gsum bsdu gsog rgyag pa dang / ma mo'i 'o ma snga sa nas 'jo thag bcad de lu gu ma mo dang mnyam du btang yod/dbang chen dang nyi shar/ 'o ma skyid gsum gyis phru gu gnyis rta la 210

bskal te dol khal ded de sngon la song /dgra 'dul gyis nor khyu dang lug khyu ded nas rjes nas song /khong tshos zhogs pa nyi ma shar tsam la zhogs ja btung ste song nas nyin gung ma zin tsam la tshugs babs te zhag sdod byas/ rtswa chu gnyis 'dzoms kyi sa cha kha shas su zhag gnyis gsum bsdad/ de ltar nyin lnga phyin rjes nub phyogs su sprug po mchong gi mdog dang 'dra ba'i rdza ri dang / lho byang shar gsum du spang ri nyams dga' ba'i sa cha zhig tu slebs/ sa cha der 'brog ra skya spos byed skabs kyi mtsher shul yang re zung mthong rgyu 'dug pas da gzod sde tsho zhig gi sner zin pa rtogs/mtsher shul de dag gi nye 'khor la phyugs rigs shi ba'i rus pa dang pags 'dzar phan med/ nor gdang chad dum/ rdza ma chag krum/ lham hrul phan med/ phying zhwa rnying hrul/ sha bzas pa'i rus pa/ bal gri rnying song g.ya' can/ gri chag dum/ 'bri g.yag 'dog byed cha ru chag dum/ras dras hrug dang skud pa dkar dmar sna tshogs sogs byang rigs 'brog pas spyod myong ba'i phan med ca dngos mang po gang sar mthong rgyu 'dugaras dras hrug 'ga' shas kyi tshos mdog kyang ma 'gyur bar bltas na de nas spos te yun ring ma song ba rtogs thub/mtsher shul gyi nye 'khor du da dung dbyar kha'i lci ba skam rlon 'dres ma mang po spungs yod pa/ ra ba med pa'i lug lhas kyi ril ma'i khrod du bal 'dzar skya thor thor du yod pa dang / mtha' skor du ched mngags spyang ki 'gog byed du brtsigs pa'i rdo dang spo tho'i tho yor rjoyang mang po yod pa da zo du'i—thoyosnyezhernyipanirgyayurnyizhingarjis zhingathang du byi'u'agog byed ‘chak+ṣiṃrki’skesagrabagh+ridamasprirtswalak+ṣiṃ byā bltaṅgishā m+bi t+yā — ldaṭī bash+lau t+na sdospra 'ad+ngha dro zhi / lha/ 'dra bar 'asbog pas lhas mtha' ru spyang — 'gog —da dī rdo ༵nga

dung ma bshig par skyug bro ba'i ngang ‘‘las gnas brtan srung gis langs nas 'dug’’ da dung spo tho'i tho yor ring po gcig gi steng du spyang grung ldan pa'i 'brog pa zhig gis lci ba leb mo'i zhwa mo bzo bde po zhig g.yog pa dang phrag pa g.yon ma'i ldebs su gtsod kyi rwa co gnyis kha bkram nas btsugs 'dug pas rgyang nas bltas na mi nag gzugs ring rgya gar yang zhwa gyon pa gcig gi me mda' 'khur nas langs pa 'dra po 'dug dbang chen gyis 'ur rdo'i nang rdo bya sgong tsam zhig blugs te skor bzhin du ‘‘ltos a/ ngas kho bsad ma song na ’’zhes 'ur rdo zhig brgyab pas de'i grod par thebs kyang gnod skyon spu tsam ma byung bar sngar bzhin langs nas 'dug pas/ ‘‘gsod thub ma song ri’zhes kho tsho tshang ma gad mo shor/phan med dngos po hrul po/ mtsher shul/ ra ba med pa'i lug lhas bcas ni rang nyid la cha rgyus shin tu che ba sha stag yin pas kho tsho tshang ma'i sems su rang yul du slebs pa lta bu'i dga' tshor chen po skyed la/ yang de dag tshang ma ni rang la cha rgyus gtan nas med pa'i dngos po gsar pa 'ga' rnyed pa ltar ‘‘ltos dang 'dir lham hrul cha gcig ’‘‘'dir rdza chag ro gcig’’twetwe'adir ༈nga zhwa hrul po gcig’’re zhig khong tsho g.yag gi khal 'be+eb rgyu'ang brjed de rang rang gi mthong ba'i phan med dngos hrul de dag la mdzub mo 'dzugs pa dang rdog rgyag bzhus nas phan tshun shod res byas/de'i skabs nyi shar gyis mtsher shul de'i shar phyogs kyi thal spungs gtor gzugs de'i gad snyigs kyi khrod nas shel gyi me long chag krum mthe bong gi sen mo'i sgor rgya las che tsam zhig rnyed nas ‘‘nga la shel sgo gcig rnyed byung ’’212

zhes dga' tshor chen pos skad rgyag gin shel gyi me long chag krum de gnam la 'phyar nas ‘‘ltos dang ’zhes brjod/dbang chen dang 'o ma skyid gnyis mgo bo btegs te ma gros gcig mthun gyis de phyogs su blta dus nyi shar lag nang gi shel gyi me long chag krum de las nyi ma'i ldog 'od bzod dka' ba zhig mig la 'phro gi 'dug 'o ma skyid phar rgyug nas ‘‘de nga la dgos ’’zhes nyi shar lag nang gi me long de mthe bong dang ldag mdzub gnyis kyi bar du bzung nas lo du ma mthong ma myong ba'i rang gi ngo gdong la myong rol byas/shel gyi me long chag krum de chung drags pas ngo gdong cha tshang mthong mi thub pas/ mos thog mar mthong ba'i 'dren byed zung sngar dang mi 'dra bar cung zad kong du lhung ba dang / de nas dpral bar blta dus dpral ba'i steng du sngar med gsar slebs kyi gnyer ris phra mo mang po 'phred du 'then pa dang zang zing du gyur ba'i mgo skyes kyi4khrod du skra dkar po'ang re zung mthong rgyu 'dug de nas sna la blta dus sna khug g.yas g.yon gang sar sbrum ma'i bu dreg gi sprin nag thar thor da dung ma yal bar mtshon byed rang bzhin du grub nas 'dug la sna rtse ru sran rdog las che tsam gyi sna chu rdog gcig lhung la khad 'dug pas ‘‘sir mi’zhes shugs kyis yar 'jib kyang sna chu rdog de sa ru lhung /de nas ngo smad la blta dus mchu sgros sngar ltar gyi dmar mdangs med par thal mdog tu gyur pa dang yal 'dab kyi ba spu phra mo'i khrod du snum dreg dang thal rdul yang chags 'dug mchu zur g.yas g.yon du gzhu mo kha sprod du bzhag pa'i ngang tshul 'dzin pa'i gnyer ris re'ang 'dugasngar ru ba khyim mtshes bu mo'i gtsug phud du brtsi ba'i na chung mdzes ma de lta bu yun ring lo zla'i rlung lhags dang / shin tu bzod par dka' ba'i shi gson chags 'jig gi yo lang mang po'i rjes shul rab dang rim pa da gzod 213

mngon sum dbang po'i spyod yul du gyur bas snying khong rus pa'i gting nas sdug bsngal tshad med skyed kyang / bsam blo zhib cing phra ba gtong dus de ni btsan pos bkag thabs med pa dang / grung pos bcos thabs med pa'i 'jig rten gyi chos nyid ldog tu med pa zhig ste skyes nas ma rgas pa dang /rgas nas ma shi ba dus nam yang gzhon nu'i lang tsho'i dpal yon rgyas pa'i mi ni med/sgos su rang nyid da lta mi lo bzhi bcur nye zhing pang du bu skyes pa'i ma la sngar gyi lang tsho'i dpal yon ldan mi srid pas gzugs gzhu ltar gug cing mgo skyes gangs ri'i mdog ltar dkar por gyur yang ha las rgyu ci/ lhag par du phru gu mtshe ma skyes te 'jig rten mo rigs kyi 'os 'gan rlabs po che legs sgrub byas yod snyams pa'i dga' tshor chen po'ang skyed/‘‘ā/ ā/ ā ’’rta'i rgyab tu bskal ba'i byis pa gnyis po gnyid las sad de ngus byung bas kho tshos gzhi nas phru gu gnyis rta rgyab nas blangs pa dang de nas g.yag gi do po 'beb 'go brtsams/ do po tshang ma phabs rjes sa khod cung snyom pa zhig gi steng du sbra hrul de phub ste me btang nas re zhig gnas der 'tsho sdod byed par mtshon pa'i du ba phra mo zhig gyen du 'phyur/dgra 'dul gyis nor lug khyu gnyis rtswa chu gang bzang gi sa ru 'tsho gin du yong nas shar gyi spang ri rta sga'i dbyibs dang 'dra ba de'i steng du slebs nas rang khyim gyi sbra dang / dol khal mthong byung bas da lta nyi ma phyi po min stabs re zhig rang nyid lus ngal gso ba'i ched nor lug khyu gnyis bzas la bkrams nas spang ljongs kyi steng du ngal gsos/sa cha de'i phyogs bzhi'i sa 'dzin gyi mu khyud dang / na thang spang ljongs/de bzhin sa rgyu gang gi thad nas bltas kyang rang yul g.yang phyug dang 'dra ba'i cha mi nyung ba yod pas yid la sngar med kyi dga' tshor chen po skyed/214

dgong dro nyi ma nub ri'i phag tu ma yib tsam la nor lug khyu gnyis rim gyis sbra 'dabs su bskongs/ nub phyogs kyi gnam sa 'dres mtshams su mig la bzod par dka' ba'i nyi 'od kyi rgyab ljongs kyi mdun du rta'am g.yag gam yang na 'brong ngam rkyang gang yin cha mi 'tshal ba'i sems can mang po nyi ma dang su mgyogs kyi bang rtsal 'gran pa ltar nub ri'i phag tu yib pa mthong /mig gi lta phyogs su mthong lam du shar ba de dag la ya mtshan ma skyed la do snang yang ma byas/mtsher shul de dag gi nye 'khor du slebs dus dgra 'dul yang khong tsho dang 'dra bar yun ring mngon sum dbang po'i spyod yul du ma gyur ba'i phan med dngos po de dag mthong bas do snang chen po'i sgo nas myong rol byed pa dang rdog rgyag gzhus te phar g.yug tshur g.yug byed kyi 'dugaphyi nyin nyin gung ma zin tsam gyi dus su lho nub kyi spang ri de'i steng nas rta mchog bzang po la bzhon pa'i skya mi gsum yong gi 'dug byang sa mi med lung stong la rta mi mang po 'di 'dra mnyam du 'gro ba ni jag pa yin nges snyam nas dbang chen gyis me mdar rdzas mdel blugs te sbra'i shar phyogs kyi kong dong zhig tu yib/nyi shar dang dgra 'dul gnyis kyis lag tu rang rang gi gri thogs te mig ma g.yeng bar sbra'i tshem srub las bltas te bya ra byas/rngon khyi de dag thang chad de gnyid kyis bzi nas de tsam snang ba ma byung /'o ma skyid 'jigs skrag gis ngo gdong skyi g.ya' bar gyur nas phru gu gnyis brang g.yas g.yon tu bzung te kha nas smra ba mi gsal ba'i ma ṇi 'don gyin bsam yul las 'das pa'i don rkyen ngan pa mi yong ba'i gsol ba smon lam btab/da lta skya mi gsum pos rta las babs te ri thur 'bab yong gi 'dug215

gyen la ma bzhon rta min/ thur la ma babs mi min zhes pa'i dpe ltar skya mi gsum pos spyir btang mi phal pa'i tshul mthun spyod pa des dbang chen gyi sems su jag pa min pa'i re ba shar/ 'on kyang sngar bzhin dogs zon lhod med kyis mig ma g.yeng bar skya mi gsum po'i 'gul skyod la bltas te me ma sgron pa'i sbi sdi me mda'i steng du bzhag nas me lcags las me rdo dang pa blangs te lag g.yon ma'i mthe bong dang ldag mdzub kyi bar du bzung nas me lcags rdeb chog chog byas/'o ma skyid kyis phru gu gnyis por 'o ma bster te bsnyal rjes gzugs po 'jag rtswa rlung gis g.yo ba ltar 'dar gyin 'o ma rdza ma gang thab steng du btsugs nas ‘‘gang thub thub kyis kha yag ngo bstod byas na mi legs sam ’’zhes bshad zhor du sbra'i sgo srub las dbang chen la blta dus gad pa'i steng nas don pa'i me mda'i mchu las dbang chen kong dong du nar mor yib pas mthong rgyu mi 'dug mo rang 'jigs skrag gis skya mi gsum po'i phyogs su lta ma bzod par thab nang du lce ba blugs zhor du ‘‘de gsum da lta gang du slebs 'dug ’’ces dris/nyi shar gyis ‘‘da lta ri sked la'ang slebs mi 'dug ’’zer/de'i skabs dbang chen myur mo nang du rgyug yong nas ‘‘stabs legs nas jag pa min pa 'dra/ jag pa ya med yin na ri thang med par rta bzhon te smyo ba ltar rgyug pa las tshul mthun de 'dra nyung nyung red/ lhag par du da lta nga tsho bcom mkhan yin na thog mar nas 'jigs skul ston ched ri thur du'ang rta bzhon te smyo ba ltar rgyug nas dgra ki 'debs nas ya med tshad nges red/yin na'ang dogs zon lhod med byos ang ’’zhes bshad nas kha phyir bskor te sgor dom/ zhor 'o ma skyid la bltas nas ‘‘skrag snang ma byed/ skrag snang ma byed/gcig byas na lam 'gro'am ri dwags rgyag mkhan yin yang srid ’’ces bshad 216

de myur stabs kyis da gin gyi kong dong der song nas sngar bzhin skya mi gsum por sdig nas bltas/de'i skabs dgra 'dul gyis kha seng dgong mo nyi ma ma bzhud tsam la nub ri'i steng nas mthong ba'i sems can de dag yid la dran nas ‘‘o/ ngas dran byung / kha seng dgong mo nga log yong skabs nub ri'i steng nas 'bri g.yag gam rkyang 'brong gang yin mi shes pa mang po ri'i phar logs su phyin pa mthong byung / phal cher ri 'di'i phar phyogs su mi tshang yod pa min nam ’’zhes bshad/nyi shar gyis mgo bo lcog lcog byed pa las lan ma sbyin par sked gri lag tu bzung nas sngar bzhin skya mi gsum por bltas nas bsdad/de'i skabs dbang chen slar yang nang du rgyug yong nas ‘‘gal srid jag pa yin bzo yod na khyed gnyis sbra las ma don par sbra sgo las yar 'dzul rgyur sgug sdod/ sngon la ngas me mda' brgyab nas phar rgol byed/ phar bltas na mi de tshor me mda' khur rgyu med pa 'dra ’’zhes bshad de slar rgyug shar gcig gis kong dong du song nas me lcags brdab ste sbi sdi'i sne mor me sgron pa dang kho'i sna lam du yun ring bral ba'i rdzas dri mngar sang zhig khyab byung /da lta skya mi gsum po ri gsham du slebs te slar rtar bzhon te dal mor yong ba las 'jigs skul byed pa'i bzo lta ston gyi mi 'dugadagra 'dul gyis sbra'itshotshem srub che ba gcig las gzab nan gyis blta dus mi gsum gyi rgyab tu me mda' zhes pa mdzub mo tsam zhig kyang khur rgyu med pa mthong nas ‘‘kho tshor me mda' mi 'dug me mda' mi 'dug me mda' gcig kyang mi 'dug ’’ces dga' tshor chen po'i sgo nas yang lan bskyar lan du bshad/skya mi gsum po kho tsho'i sbra dang bar thag mda' rkyang gang tsam gyi sar 217

slebs rjes tshang ma rta las babs te rta kha khrid nas yong byung /kho tsho gsum ga'i rta bo mgo 'phang mtho ba/ shed bzang ba/ rkang lag ring ba ngo ma 'do ba'i khyu mchog ces brjod rung ba 'dug kyang steng du gtad pa'i sga dang sga gdan srab bcas ni rin thang shin tu chung ba sha stag red 'dugaskya mi gsum pos/ ‘‘wa ye/ mi yod dam ’mizhes bos byung /sbra'i nang du thad kar mi 'dzul bar phyi rol nas 'bod pa dang / wa ye zhes 'bod skabs skad gdangs chen po de tsam med pa sogs ga nas bltas kyang tshul dang mthun pa zhig 'dug pas nyi shar gyis phu dung gyon nas 'gro grabs byas pas 'o ma skyid kyis phu dung nas 'jus te 'then nas ‘‘ma 'gro/kho tshos g.yo sgyu gang zhig bsam blo btang yod mi shes ’’zhes 'gro ru ma bcuganyi shar rang gi sems su'ang mos bshad pa de'ang mi bden rgyu mi 'dug snyam nas gom mtshams bzhagadabang chen gyis lag g.yas pa'i ldag mdzub snga sa nas me mda'i skam par 'chang ste skabs re me mda'i so khung las skya mi gsum po re re'i snying khar gzes pa dang / skabs re mgo ga ler btegs te bltas pa na ngo gdong smug nag mchin pa'i mdog lta bu sma ra thar thor skyes pa'i pho gzhon gcig dang /gzugs ring ngo gdong gi sha rtsi sngon por gyur ba/ mgo la rgya gar yang zhwa rnying hrul zhig gon pa'i 'og nas skra gzhug dmar po'i 'dzar sne rna ba g.yon ma'i mdun du dpyangs pa'i pho gzhon zhig dang / lo lnga bcu'i g.yas g.yon tsam gyi dar ma zhig 'dug pa de'i gdong dbyibs shin tu sgor ba zhi mi dang 'dra ba za 'gram g.yas g.yon du tsher ma ltar zing pa'i sma ra yod pa/ mig rtsa byu ru ltar dmar ba/ phrag pa g.yas g.yon nas thur du dpyangs pa'i lan bu de gnyis slas pa nas da bar bkru ma myong ba ltar phying par gyur pa'i sne mor 218

ma bcings kyang chog mod bal skud dkar gtsang zhig gis bcings nas 'dug pa de phal cher da res khyim nas thon khar ched mngags bcings pa min nam snyam/‘‘wa ye/ mi yod dam/’’‘‘wa ye’’‘‘'u/ 'u/ 'u/’’ da gzod sbra 'dabs su btags pa'i rngon khyi tshang ma gnyid las sad de lag pa gnyis bar snang du mchong gin skor thag 'then nas zug skad brgyab/skya mi gsum po sngar bzhin rang sar langs te khyi'i phyogs su bltas te sbra'i nang nas mi zhig don rgyur sgug nas 'dug pas phar bltas nas ngan pa ya med de 'dra min pa 'dra snyam nas dbang chen kong dong las yar langs nas me mda' khyer nas phar song ba na skya mi gsum po phyir bshol gom pa re zung byas nas gsum ga rub rub kyis ‘‘wa ye/ wa ye/ me mda' de mar zhog nga tshos khyed la gnod pa'i las ka byed mi srid/ don dag zhig yod pa khyod la skad cha byed dgos ’’zer/dbang chen gyis me mda' sar bzhag sbi sdi'i sne mo rdog brdzis btang nas me bsad de mgrin pa kyog nas kho tshor bltas te ‘‘khyod tsho skrag dgos don med/ ltos dang sbi sdi'i me bsad yod/ nga tsho de ring ma gtogs mthong ma myong bar skad cha ci zhig shod rgyu yin/ khyod tsho gang nas 'ong ba yin/ da lta gang du 'gro ba yin ’’zhes dris/nyi shar dang dgra 'dul gnyis sngar bzhin sbra'i nang du yib nas lkog blta byed kyin yod/de'i skabs phar phyogs kyi mi ngo gdong sprug la sma ra thar thor skyes pa des gom gang mdun du spos nas ‘‘ngo ma byas na skad cha de 'bri mkhan nga tsho yin 219

yang / da lta sngon la khyod kyis bris byung bas ngas lan 'debs dgos byung /mdang dgong nga tsho'i rdzi bo 'gas 'dir khyim dud nor lug mi nyung ba yod pa gcig gsar du slebs 'dug zer bas nga tsho de ring ched du de don yong ba yin/ sa cha 'di ni nga tsho'i sde dpon tshang gi dbyar mtsher yin/ de sngon rtswa sa'i don du 'khrug rtsod thengs mang shor te phan tshun mi shi rmas kyi chags sgo mang po byung myong bas nga tsho de ring sde dpon gyi bka' ltar mtshon cha khab rtse tsam ma thogs par yong nas khyod tsho rab byung na sa cha gzhan du spo skyod byed rogs zhu rgyu dang / de ltar ma byung na ’rizhes go rgyu yod pa'i sgo nas rkang btsugs nas tshig mjug bkum/sa cha de sde dpon tshang gi yin pa shes pas gus gus zhum zhum gyis ‘‘nga tsho sa mtha'i 'khyam po stes dbang gis 'dir slebs pa las ched mngags sde dpon ༈nga la mtho dman 'gran bsam nas shes bzhin du bsdad pa min pas mig rtsa dmar por gyur pa'i mi gcig des dbang chen gyi tshig mjug 'phrog nas ‘‘byas tsang khyod kyis ma shes par 'dir bsdad pas sa cha gzhan du spo skyod byed rogs zer ba yin/ de ma gtogs hung ’’zhes skad cha'i mjug tu sna shu rgyag pa dang skad cha shod skabs mgrin pa gzengs su gtod de phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed pa mthong dus dbang chen zhe sdang gis da lta rang mi de'i steng du mchongs nas khyod shi nga gson 'gran rgyu byung na bsam yang da lta rang tshod ma bzung na mi 'os snyam nas ngo gdong las 'dzum mdangs skyug bro po zhig u tshags kyis bton nas phyag 'bul dang sbrags ‘‘nga tsho khyed tsho'i tsho bar mgo ri riX ///ske ///(btags zhus na 'thus sam ’’ sa ba da/‘‘khyod kyi skad cha de sems gting gi skad cha ngo ma yin nam ’’zhes rgya gar yang zhwa rnying hrul gyon pa des rta lcag gis zhwa mo yar 'bud tsam byas nas 220

‘‘sems gting gi skad cha yin na ma 'grig pa a yod ’’ces brjod/de'i skabs dbang chen gyis ‘‘khyod tsho nang du phebs nas bzhugs tsam gnang dang ’’zhes bshad pa dang chabs cig ‘‘kho gnyis mar don shog ’’ces skad brgyab pa dang nyi shar dang / dgra 'dul gnyis kyis sbra sgo g.yas g.yon tshurmis/‘‘'o tsi/ mi gcig gis mi tshad pa 'dug gari’‘‘dgongs 'gal med pa zhu rgyur da res nga tshos jag pa yin shag byas nas ’’ ‘‘nga tsho nang du mi 'gro ri’zhes bshad zhor gzugs ring des ske bsring nas nang du blta tsam byas nas ‘‘da dung nag mo gcig kyang 'dug ’’zer/‘‘khyed kyi skad cha kha zhe gnyis med yin na nga tshos sde dpon la bshad chog ’’zhes bshad de sga steng du mchongs nas rta kha bskor te 'gro rtsis byas/‘‘khyed rang nga tsho'i tsho bar mgo btags pa bden pa yin na sang nyin shog ’’ces bshad de rta bo lcag gis brab nas rgyugs song /rgyang thag gang tsam gyi sar slebs rjes rgya gar yang zhwa gyon pa des rta kha tshur bskor nas skad shugs chen pos ‘‘nges par du da sang nyin yong dgos da thad kar da la 'di don nas shog da ’’ces skad brgyab byung /phyi nyin nyi gzhon gyi gser mdangs phyogs bzhi'i lhun po'i rtse mor 'phros pa dang dbang chen gyis wa lpags gnyis khur/ nyi shar gyis g.yi lpags gcig khur nas kha seng skya mi gsum po yong ba'i lam bu ded de phyin/la rtser slebs te pha bong gcig gi steng du bsdad de ngal gsos/ la de'i phar phyogs su lung pa chung chung kha byang la gtad pa zhig gi phu/ mda'/bar gsum du khyim dud gsum 'dug rgyang nas bltas na khyim dud dkyil ma ste lung pa'i bar du yod pa de tshang gi sbra dang lhas ra khyim dud gzhan gnyis 221

las che ba 'dug pas phal cher sde dpon tshang de yin rgyu red snyam/ ri ma mgul der lug rdzi rgan po gcig 'dug pa der song nas skad cha dris/lug rdzi rgan po de lug g.yang dkar gyi pha ma 'dra ba'i rdzi bo phul du byung ba zhig yin par gdon mi za ste kho'i mgo skyes sked pa'i bar slebs pa de rang byung gi ral par gyur nas g.yag rnga las kyang 'dzing che ba 'dug kho'i ngo gdong du bgrang bya'i smyug rtses bris pa'i 'das don gyi gnyer ris gya ma gyu grangs las 'das pa'i khrod du ser ka las che tsam gyi mig de gnyis zhib phras ma btsal na gnyer ris kyi khrod du rnyed dka' po red/ kha ru phan thogs pa'i so mu tig tsam med kyang mdun so ser po gcig gi rtsa ba 'gul bzhin da dung ma lhung ba ni gzhon nu'i dus kho'i kha ru yang skye bo gzhan dang 'dra bar so skyes myong ba'i mtshon byed tsam du zad/kho gnyis ngal gso zhor du rgan po de'i drung du bsdad de ‘‘a mye/ khyod tsho'i sde dpon tshang ga gi red/ khyim dud dkyil ma de e red ’’ces dris/rgan pos mig ser ka las ha lam mi che ba de ches cher gdang khul gyis kem kem du g.yo bzhin kho gnyis la bltas te ‘‘khyed gnyis nga tsho'i dbyar mtsher sar sdod mkhan de yin nam ’’zhes tshur dris byung /‘‘yin/ nga gnyis sde dpon mjal bar 'gro ba yin/mi’‘‘sde dpon gyis de ring snga mo nas khyed gnyis sgug 'dug sde dpon tshang dkyil ma de red ’’ces bshad/kho gnyis gus gus zhum zhum gyis sde dpon tshang gi nye 'gram du slebs dus g.yog mo 'ga' yong nas 'dogs khyi de dag gi gnya' las bzung ste bkag de nas kha seng za 'gram g.yas g.yon du tsher ma ltar zing ba'i sma ra yod pa/ mig rtsa byu ru ltar dmar ba'i mi des khong gnyis bsu bar yong /kho gnyis kyis lam seng thor lcog tu bcings pa'i mgo skyes lhug par 222

bkrol/ phu dung g.yas pa phrag pa'i steng nas blangs te sked pa sgur sgur byas nas lce bsnar/mi des 'gying nyams ston bzhin du ‘‘o/ khyod gnyis yong ngam mi’zhes mig gis kho gnyis la mi blta bar rgyang mig gcod de dpung pa'i yal 'dab gnyis rgyab tu bzhag nas nga tsho'i sde dpon btsan lha zer dus gnam phyed gos su gyon/ sa phyed gdan du gting ba'i dbang thang can gyi mnga' 'og tu khyod tsho sbra 'brong gi sna khung tsam zhig dang / mi keng rus lta bu bzhi'ang mi shong ba'i sems khral byed dgos don ga la yod/ 'on kyang ’’zhes skad cha shod 'phro bzhag nas sma rar byil bzhin wa lpags dang g.yi lpags la bltas te mno bsam gtong khul byas/mi de'i byed stangs dang skad cha shod stangs mi sems su bzod dka' ba zhig 'dug pas/ dbang chen dang nyi shar gnyis snying khong rus pa'i gting nas khong khro me ltar 'bar yang da lta rang gis mi gzhan la re ba'i dus yin stabs gnas skabs 'gro zhi mi las mkhas pa dang / 'dug ri bong las tsog pa ma byas na rang nyid la gyong 'khel rgyu red bsam nas sems kyis sems bsnan te shod 'phror lus pa'i skad cha'i mjug sgugami des ‘‘khyod tshor me mda' ga tshod yod/ o/ kha seng gi de min pa da dung me mda' yod dam/mi’‘‘med/ me mda' gcig las med/’’‘‘ngo ma med dam/’ri ‘‘ngo ma med/’ri‘‘skad cha de rdzun yin gyi ma red/’’‘‘ska cha drang po yin/ nga tshor me mda' de min pa ’’um/ 'grig song / 'grig song / khyed tshor me mda' gcig yod 223

pas nga tsho'i sde bar/ ma red/ nga tsho'i sde dpon la rogs pa zhig byed dgos/ de khas blangs na nga tsho'i sde khongs su sdod chog khas ma blangs na ri’zhes skad cha mtshams bzhag nas phar 'gro dgos pa'i lag brda byas/dbang chen gyis ‘‘rogs pa ci byed dgos sam ’’zhes dris/‘‘nga tsho'i sde ba dang 'dre sde lung skyid gnyis bar rtsod mi tshar ba'i yab mes kyi sha 'khon dang bshad mi tshar ba'i gyod dang kha mchu yod stabs ’’zhes ldag mdzub kyis me mda'i skam pa gnan pa'i phyag rgya byas nas mig hu rer dbang chen la bltas nas bsdad/dbang chen gyi sems su sde dpon de da dung sgor mi don pa ci yin nam/da gin lug rdzi bgres song des de ring snga po nas sgug 'dug zer yang da dung sgor mi don ba ci yin nam snyams nas phrag par khur ba'i wa lpags mdun du blangs nas ‘‘nga tsho sngon la sde dpon mjal bcug rogs ’’zhes re ba bton/mi des ‘‘ngas dris pa'i skad char khyod kyis lan ji ltar 'debs/ de nas ga ler skad cha byed chog ’’zer/mi de'i skad cha'i don cha tshang gsal por rtogs kyang ma shes khul gyis ‘‘khyed kyis ci zer ba yin/ khyod kyi skad cha kha gsal por bshad na ma gtogs ngas lan 'debs mi shes ’’zer/‘‘red red/ ngas bshad chog nga tsho'i tsho pa ri’de'i skabs lo na nyi shu lhag tsam gyi pho gzhon gzugs tshad 'bring tsam byas pa lus la tshar slog gsar min rnying min zhig dang rkang par sog lham gsar min rnying min gyon pa zhig sbra sgo las don te tshur yong nas ‘‘ha/ hu/hu/’’zhes glo bsang zhig byas pa dang de mur mchil ma dang snabs cung zad cig sar 'phangs nas ‘‘a khu/ a khu/ a khu zla ba/ ka re ko re mang po byed dgos don med ’’ces mi de'i tshig mtshams bcad de slar dbang chen dang nyi 224

shar la bltas te ‘‘drang po bshad na/ nga'i tsho pa 'di ni tsho chung nus med skyo po zhig yin stabs mi rabs mang po'i ring tsho pa gzhan gyis rgan mo'i tsho pa zhes ngan ming btags te brnyas bcos kho na myangs pa red/ um/ thad kar bshad na khyod gnyis kyis rogs pa zhig byas na mi tshe 'dir khyod gnyis dpon byas te nga g.yog po byed dgos byung na'ang 'gyod pa med ’’ces bshad/dbang chen dang nyi shar gnyis kyis lam seng phyag 'bul dang bcas ‘‘de 'dra gsung pa'i srol ga la yod/ de 'dra dpe mi srid ’’ces shod zhor wa lpags dang g.yi lpags lag gnyis kyis btegs te phul nas ‘‘sde dpon mchogame tog chung yang 'bum pa'i kha rgyan zhes pa'i dpe bzhin lag rtags chung yang bsam pa'i mtshon byed yin ’’zhes bshad/sde dpon gyis g.yi lpags kyi gra la lag pas reg tsam byas nas ‘‘da ka re ko re ma byed/ khyod gnyis kyis rogs pa byed thub na thub pa dang / mi thub na mi thub pa kha gsal po shod ’’zer/dbang chen gyis mno bsam cung zad btang nas ‘‘'o na sde dpon lags/khyod kyis gnas tshul byung rkyen dang rgyu mtshan cha tshang zhig nga gnyis la bshad na chog gam/ de ma gtogs ’rizhes shod mtshams bzhag nas yang lce bsnar te 'gram pa lag pas bred/sde dpon gyis ‘‘red red red/ kha gsal na go sla/ nam gsal na 'gro bde/ rgyu mtshan mdor bsdus shig bshad na 'grig ’’ces khong tsho sbra'i g.yon phyogs kyi spang ljongs kyi steng du bsdad de bshad pa gsham gsal/‘‘nga tsho rong pa sde gsar zhes pa 'di ni nyam chung nus med kyi tsho pa chung chung zhig yin stabs sde tsho gzhan gyis rgan mo'i tsho pa zhes ngan ming btags te rtswa sa dang / chu/ phyugs rigs 'dres mtshams gang thad nas gyod kha mchu byung tshe nga tshor gyong kho na rag nas sdod dgos kyi yod/225

kho tsho ni lung skyid sde tsho'i ya med spun brgyad ces sa phyogs 'di'i sde tsho gang sar skad grags yod pa'i ya med lang shor bu spun brgyad yod pa de dag red/ kho tshos ga dus yin yang rtswa thang steng du phyugs rigs rgya yan du btang nas rtswa za chu 'thung gi brnyas bcos thengs mang byed myong yang ya med spun brgyad la kha ya byed nus mkhan gcig kyang med stabs lkog tu dmod tshig kho na bor te sdod pa las thabs gzhan ma rnyed/’’ces bshad rjes skyi g.ya' ba'i 'das don dum bu zhig rang dbang med par yid kyi dran shes su shar/thengs shig sde dpon lha rgyal dus rgyun dang mi 'dra ba'i dpa' ngar zhig skyed de ‘‘hung / kho tsho gzhan rgyu'i don du shi nus na/ nga rang rgyu'i don du shi mi nus pa med ’’ces khu tshur lcog tse'i steng du gzhus te gdan las hob langs kyis 'gro grabs byas par rdor dpal gyis bkag nas ‘‘khyod rang da lta ma phebs/ thugs lhod tsam gnang / sngon la nga song nas skad cha yag po byed/de ltar byas kyang 'bras bu ma thon na nga tsho mi mang la ro mang dang kho tsho mi nyung la ro nyung red/’’ces brjod de thad kar ya med spun brgyad kyi sar song nas sbra dang bar thag mi ring ba'i sa nas ‘‘wa ye/ wa ye ’’zhes lan 'ga' bos kyang ya med spun brgyad kyis ma go ba'i zol gyis kha ya mi byed pas mi tshad tha na mthong yang ma mthong ba'i khul gyis ya ma byas pas rdor dpal khong khro chen po langs nas ‘‘khyed tsho ham pa che mdog ma byed/ 'dir nga tsho che yang mi che sde ba'i dpon/ chung yang mi chung sde ba'i dpon lha rgyal tshang gi rtswa sa yin/ rtswa pho thur bcad na gser thur gyis 'jal dgos/ rtswa mo thur bcad na dngul thur gyis 'jal dgos/ chab chu mo btung na 'o mas 'jal dgos ’’zhes sdig gtam gtong bzhin 'ur rdo klad la bskor nas ya med spun brgyad kyi nor khyu rtswa thang las ded/ya med bu spun brgyad po gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis sbra sgo las don 226

nas la las skra gzhug mgo la dkris skyor byas/ la las phu dung rdzes te dpung pa 'phyar nas kho'i phyogs su 'ong / ya med spun brgyad kyi che ba a dar gyis sked gri'i gri mgo phur gyin ‘‘hung /mi ham chen khyod a ma'i bu dang ma thug pa 'dra/ gnam sngon po nga'i gos dang kho'i gos/ sa dog mo la nga'i gdan dang kho'i gdan yod pa shes le med/rtswa pho thur mo thur yang shes le med/ 'jal dgos na sngon mo mtshon gyis 'jal chog ’’ces kha chu gang sar 'thor gyin de ltar brjod/rdor dpal ngar langs nas ‘‘hung / rdza ri rtse rtse gnam 'og la ma 'dus le dang / chu mo shang shang zam 'og la ma 'dus le/ dpa' dpung pa ngoms nas song song nga rgad po'i mdun la 'gro sa med/ khyod tshos gzhan sa'i don du rang srog rta rnga phra mo la phangs sems med na/ nga rang sa'i don du shi mi nus pa med/’’ces bshad de khu tshur g.yug nas a dar ltag dgye slog pas gzhan rnams kyis sked gri shubs las bton te ‘‘rgan 'khogs shi 'dod langs na nga tshos snying rje shes le min/ da dung sdug tshod sna mgo'i rtse la ma bzung na dus de ring phan chad gsal nyi ma'i 'od mi mthong le zhig bzo ’’zer nas sked gri 'phyar tsam 'phyar tsam byas/rdor dpal gyis ‘‘nga tsho rong pa sde gsar dang khyod tsho lung skyid tsho pa zer dus sngar nas da bar bu phar 'gro dang mna' ma tshur yong byas nas pho phyed pha dang a khu/ mo phyed ma dang sru mo yin yang khyod tsho ya med spun brgyad skyag gcin gyi nang nas 'tshar nas bzung gyod kha mchu rgyun ma chad ’’zer nas khu tshur gang byung g.yugaya med spun brgyad kyis gri ltag gis rdor dpal gyi lus la gzhus te ‘‘rgad po ra rgan 'dra ba zhig bsad na dri ma che rogs red/ da lta sdug tshod 227

bzung na phyi mi 'dug ’’ces bshad de ma le'i steng gi og tshom ra'i og tshom lta bu de nas bzung ste phar 'drud tshur 'drud byas/ma gi na zing langs pa mthong nas sde dpon lha rgyal gyis mda' mdung lag tu thogs te rang gi bu dang g.yog 'ga' khrid de rgyugade nyin bu chung ba btsan lha ri dwags rngon par song nas nang du bsdad med/ya med spun brgyad kyis mtshon cha thogs pa'i mi mang po yong ba mthong bas mda' mdung dang gri klad la 'phyar nas ‘‘shog dang / shog dang /khyod tsho me btang rjes kyi thal ba'ang med pa zhig bzo dgos na shog dang /nged spun zla brgyad po dpa' dpung pas za ma bzas te 'tshar yong ba yin/skyag 'dzar khyod tsho bag ril khab rtse btsugs pa ltar bzos ma song na nga tsho'i ming nas ma 'bod ’’ces shod kyin shor nas rgod dar gyis lha rgyal la gri zhig g.yug lha rgyal gyis de'i gri kha bkag nas ‘‘khyod gzhan rgyu'i don du shi nus na/ nga rang rgyu'i don du shi mi nus pa med ’’zer nas phar gri zhig g.yugargod dar gyis gri kha shugs kyis bkag nas ‘‘khyod de ring rtswa rkang re gnyis kyi don du shi 'dod na g.ya' ri’zhes gri zhig g.yug lha rgyal gyis gri kha shugs kyis bkagardor dpal gyis mdung ring zhig gang byung bskor bas btsan dar dang lha dar gnyis ga byed 'di byed med par gyur te phar bros tshur bros byas/ go skabs de dang bstun nas sha za byed kyi glo gri shubs las bton te rgyab phyogs nas 'jab ste rgod dar la shugs kyis btsugs pas rgod dar 'khyar re 'khyor re'i ngang rked gri 'khar bar brten nas kha phyir rdor dpal gyi phyogs su bskor 228

te am btsigs bsdams nas ‘‘thu thu/ pho tha/ dpa' med kyi sdar ma/gdong gdong gtad gdong gtad nas 'dzing mi nus pa lkog lkog gri 'dzugs mkhan khyod thu thu ’’zhes dmod rjes ‘‘a/ a ’’zhes kha nas khrag skyug rjes shing sdong 'gyel pa ltar ga ler 'gyel te lnga lam du song yang 'dren byed zung las khong khro'i me lce 'bar bzhin rdor dpal gyi phyogs su bltas nas 'dugardor dpal gyi mi tshe'i ring de ring ma gtogs dmar 'dzing drag po de 'drar bzhugs ma myong la de bas mi ga la gsod myong / kho re zhig hon thor nas lag nang gi gri lhung ste gri rtse sa ru zugs nas ke rer langs pa ni da lta shi ma thag pa'i rgod dar gyi dur byang dang mtshungs/lha rgyal yang dran pa thor pa ltar rdor dpal la mig hrig ger bltas nas 'dug pa de rdor dpal gyis rang la rogs byas par thugs rje che zhu ba yin nam yang na rgyab phyogs nas lkog gsod gtong ba'i pho tha'i byed tshul la khong khro skyed pa yin mi shes/cung zad song rjes kho gnyis gnyis ka dran pa gsos pa ltar dbugs ring zhig rngub nas phar blta tshur blta byed dus mtshon sngon mos 'dzing res kyi chag sgra dang phyogs gnyis kyi rkyen lam du song ba'i mi'i rma kha'i khrag dri/ rmas ma'i smre sngags 'don pa gzhi nas mthong thos byung /de'i skabs ya med spun brgyad kyi tha chung 'jigs dar gyis ‘‘ki hi hi ’’zhes ngar skad sgrog bzhin lha rgyal gyi phyogs su shor nas gri g.yug byung / lha rgyal gyis rtab rtab por gri phyir g.yug rtsis byas kyang de'i gri kha bkag ma thub pas gri dpung par thebs nas lag pa g.yon ma dpung pa'i mtshams nas 229

pags pa steb tsam zhig ma gtogs rbad de chad nas dpyangs 'phrul du g.yugade mar lha rgyal gyis gri g.yug thengs gcig gis 'jigs dar gyi rgyu ma bton/rdor dpal gyis sde dpon gyi lag ya dgra la shor ba mthong bas khog nang gi khong khro me ltar 'bar nas lag nang du gang yang med par 'jigs dar gyi phyogs su shor/ 'jigs dar gyis lag g.yon mas rgyu ma gos kyi thu ba'i nang blugs te kha phyir bskor nas gri g.yug thengs gcig gis rdor dpal gyi klad pa phyed bshag btang nas klad zho yang skya thor thor sa ru lhung / ‘‘sdar ma khyod g.ya' ’’zhes rdor dpal gyi dpung pa'i steng du da dung rdog rdzis btang / de nas khyar re khyor re'i ngang gom pa gsum tsam song rjes lag g.yon ma shugs med par gyur te gos kyi thu gsham shor nas rgyu ma dang nang khrol shwa 'od rgyugs pa ltar grod pa'i rma kha chen po de las don te sa ru lhung / khos da dung mu mthud gom pa spos pas kho rang gi rgyu ma kho rang gis rkang pas brdzis te khog nang gi nang khrol phal che ba sa ru lhung rjes gan rkyal du 'gyel nas shi song /de'i skabs ya med spun brgyad kyi bzhi rkyen lam du song / gnyis la rmas skyon tshabs chen phog gnyis la rmas skyon gang yang ma phog rong pa sde gsar gyi phyogs su mi gsum rkyen lam du song / sde dpon bcas pa'i mi bzhi la rmas skyon tshabs chen phogasde dpon gyi bu rgan pa ste da lta'i sde dpon btsan lha rogs pa lo mnyam 'ga' dang mnyam du rta 'do ba'i kha lo bsgyur gyin bzhad bgad ling ling ngang dgong mo nang du log dus bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la ma gi'i rtswa thang du bem ro mang po zhig bdag med du bskyur ba'i khrod du ngu ngag gi skad sgra skyi g.ya' ba gang sar grags pa dang / rang gi pha lha rgyal gyi dpung pa g.yon ma 230

bcad de zungs khrag gang sar bzhur ba'i khrod du sde ba'i mi gson por gnas pa rnams kyis thabs shes ci drag gis la las byin rlabs chu ru sbangs nas blud/la las ja ldur blud kyin 'dug ‘‘a pha da ’’zhes skad brgyab ste btsan lha rang gi pha'i gam du rgyug pa dang phas lag g.yas pa kho'i phyogs su brkyang nas ‘‘bu da wabu bu’’zhes skad cha dab dib cha ma tshang ba zhig bshad rjes dran med du brgyal bas bud med dang byis pa'i ngu skad long long grags/ lo na bgres pa rnams kyis kha ru chu grang mo blud pa dang yas mchu'i 'dab la sen mo btab pa sogs thabs gang drag byas pas slar dran pa gsos te ‘‘chu chu ’’zhes chu blud dgos pa'i bzo bstan pas btsan lhas chu grang mo phor pa gang blud/ lha rgyal gyis chu btung rjes mig kyang cher gdang nas dbugs ring zhig btang rjes ‘‘bu bu btsan lha khyod kyis sde ba 'di byis pa bzhin skyong nas nga'i ched du ma red nga dang de ring rkyen lam du song ba'i yul mi yongs kyi ched du dgra sha zhig len rogs ya med srun brgyad (don du da lta spun bzhi las lhag med ) tshar gcod ma thub na khyod skyes pa pho yi gral du sdod rin med nges par du dgra sha re len dgos/ nga'i dbugs rta rnga tsam 'di ma chad gong khyod khyod kyis khas len gyi yin nam min/ khas ma blangs na nga shi dur khung du song yang mig btsum mi thub da khyod kyis khas len gyi yin nam min ri’zhes bshad de lag pa g.yas pa bu btsan lha'i phyogs su brkyangs byung /btsan lhas am btsigs bsdams nas mig chu gtsang mar phyis te ‘‘a pha/ngas khas len gyi yin dgra sha de ma blangs na nga bu min ’’zhes bshad de 231

pha'i lag par 'jus/lha rgyal gyis kyang dbugs ring zhig btang nasaṃ ‘‘khyod gson lag tsha mos nga'i shi lag grang mo bcangs nas dgra sha de len rgyu khas blangs pa 'dir yod tshang mas thos yod pas da nga blo bde song ’’zhes bshad de mchu zur las 'dzum chung zhig mngon par byas te der yod tshang mar mig 'grim zhig byas rjes 'jig rten phyi ma'i gzigs mor gshegs/phyi nyin phyogs nges med du 'gro ba'i rnal 'byor pa bgres song zhig der slebs nas rkyen lam du song ba'i mi tshang mar pho ba brgyab cing dur 'jug gtsang ma byas/shod mtshams der slebs dus sde dpon btsan lha mgo bo 'bras shing gi yal ga ltar gug cing lag pas dpral bar bskyor te mgo nad kyi zug gzer bzod dka' ba'i nad pa ltar re zhig smra ba'ang med par lus/re zhig nas khos dbugs ring zhig btang ste mgo bo btegs nas gnam la bltas nas ‘‘rgyu mtshan de 'dra zhig red ’’ces brjod/nyi shar gyis gang yang mi shod par lag par rtswa rkang gcig bzung nas sa ru ri mo gang byung 'bri gin bsdad/dbang chen gyis yun ring bsam blo btang nas bsdad/ya med bu spun bzhi po de dang nga yi bar la khab rtse tsam gyi rtsod gleng med pas don med mi la gnod 'tshe gtong rgyu ni mi 'os pa red/ 'on kyang re ba de khas len ma byas na rang nyid mgo 'dogs sa 'di las lhag pa'i sde tsho zhig rnyed dka' po red/ mgo 'dogs sa med par 'khyam po'i 'tsho ba kho na skyel dgos na khag po red/ 'o na re ba de khas len byas na klan ka ji 'dra zhig 232

btsal te dmar 'dzing byed/ stabs legs na sde dpon gyi ched du dgra sha len thub/ stabs ma legs par rang nyid ya med spun bzhi'i gri 'og tu shi na bsam blo gtong mtshams der slebs dus kho khong 'dar zhig shor nas lag nang gi sna ru'ang sa ru shor grabs byas/ de'i skabs kha seng ngo smug nag mchin pa'i mdog 'dra ba'i pho gzhon de dang / rgya gar yang zhwa rnying hrul gyon pa de gnyis kyis ja dang / phor pa khyer yong nas kho tshor ja blugs/sde dpon gyis ‘‘'di ni g.yog po go chod cig yin/ ming la grags pa khri srong zer/ gzugs ring 'di ni da res ngas bshad pa'i rdor dpal oṃ ma ṇi pad+me kli/ dam pa de'i bu don grub red ’’ces bshad/de gnyis kyis kho dang nyi shar la bltas nas dgod tsam byas/dbang chen gyis ‘‘'o na/ kha sang gi mi gcig de su red/’’sdedapon gyis ‘‘kha spu mang po yod de nga'i a khu red/ khong tshang lung skyid du sdod kyi yod/’’de'i skabs sde dpon gyis dbang chen la bltas te ‘‘'o/ tag tag red/ya med spun brgyad po de da lta ya med spun gsum las med/ klu dar la rmas skyon chen po phog pas yun ring ma song bar shi ba red/ da lta a dar dang /'brug dar/ chos dar gsum las med la sngar dang 'dra ba'i ya med tsha po mi 'dug 'on kyang don de ni nga'i pha dam pa 'chi khar bzhag pa'i zhal chems don chen zhig yin stabs ngas khas len byas pas don de ma bsgrub na nga'i gson lag tsha mos pha dam pa'i 'chi lag grang mo bzung pas mna' bzas pa dang khyad par mi 'dug ’’ces rnam 'gyur sgam po'i sgo nas bshad/dbang chen gyi sems su rang nyid la gzhan la med pa'i mtshon cha ste bo'u 233

khra ring rgyab tu khur rgyu yod stabs ya med spun gsum gyi kha gtad gcog mi nus pa mi srid/ gtan nas mi srid snyam nas tshig thag chod po'i sgo nas ‘‘sde dpon lags/ 'jig rten gyi kha dper yang na hob ste bltas na shes/yang na lo gsum gshib na shes zhes pa ltar nga rgad pos phar bltas pa tsam gyis khyed ni kha dan tshig la gnas mkhan gyi pho rab gcig red 'dug pas nga rang gi 'byung 'gyur gyi ched du ngas khyed kyi re ba khas len rgyu yin/’’zhes bshad/sde dpon btsan lhas ‘‘spyir nga ni dmar 'dzing gi las la dga' ba zhig min yang ngas pha dam pa'i phyag nas 'jus te zhal chems de khas len byas stabs khyod la gzhan la med pa'i drag po'i mtshon cha zhig yod pas re ba de bcol pa yin/ khyod nas nga'i re ba de khas len byas pas slad phyin chad khyod kyi blo dang ma mthun pa'i las ka byas song na nga btsan lha'i ming nas ma 'bod ’rizer/de nas bzung dbang chen dang dgra 'dul/ nyi shar/ 'o ma skyid dang khye'u mtshe ma bcas pa rong pa sde gsar gyi sde gral du tshud de 'tsho ba gsar pa zhig gi 'go brtsams/ 234

‘ — tram̐/ ‘ trī sto—༷rdotsho—co — ༷ dzocidroji tsā ṭ+wāṃ mi—cisgyudze+e /rā — r+ṣa— ṭ+wāṃcho dusku du—༷ re citsho lkulhatrī me /sduci 7thirnyepa shā tso ridzo tsutsho snyo ༷/46rnya ci4 ṭā —tsho cidz+wapa3 —3 0 —— 4 riX/ga—— cicidi 7 7 rta ci rna k+ṣ-i dro rdo citre —spyocici ri ci rtso sta ci ho ci sna — ci — ṇa — rme spyojipruci ri dze+e waṃbyu rdzoX py-iXrdo 〉 tso〉 shā dzo/ chisnye rī —ri (༷ rmyu sko chosh+lau— du trīrici — cho 0peji/dīniri ne chi ju ci — cirīsgyurichicadzha4 ci — d+ngha —stsa——— —sgo—gyidzhaci—ci— ༷rī d+kuXtshokyi cidicho/sdudro —tshe3 tsātshosdukyico(sdisnesaci8juciṣe༄thoXchi ci4rdo3 hūṃ tsā ri wī chod+ngha rngu wa sna ——dre— — — 4 chi dici—ngh+rurīcirdo ne〉— — — sngu snadu9shārichi mi tsho4ri shādzidzi— sdu tshoci5/dzhaṣ+ka ciXcitredzohūṃ5dū/ rngoṇakyirtertopa‘dzeshāXci—yehūṃsgyutshoñcāstu spyachijiciX ru r+shariri ci dzo — —mi //—༷ ne+e ༷ wa ༷snye dzo mi shād+ngha — ci — skutsho 1ga ṣe jirubyu dhe tre —rnga — (tsā cicichocidu/ — snyechi cici ri dro ༷jiri cho — cid+ngha ciñca — ciX 5 —4— wadro zhe pa r+sha—sdu — tsho— 4 —spyacho —tsā5/ —/wawa wa — ju —ri ci‘— riru ci ri ci ༷ cho ༷—wa ci— —— wa wa ciri sku spyo tre ci rī — — — — wa— ne+e ༷bye/ ༵//ske gyispre citsho ne cigyu— —ri / ༷warwa ༷ ci ‘ridze cipyongh+ruwabyutsho ci ci wa wa ṇ+ḍaṃX wawaX/ dro— 9 ciwa tsho skeX waX gawa wa ci—ci rirngatshotsho ci wa rdzo spyo — na—chosdu — —ri

phyi lo sde dpon btsan lha dang don grub gnyis kyis jus bshams pa ltar don grub kyi nu mo bkra shis g.yang chags dbang chen gyi bu dgra 'dul la mna' mar sprod rgyu byas/ ya med spun gsum cham du phabs nas dgra sha len rgyu de don dngos thog sde dpon btsan lha'i pha dam pa'i sha 'khon kho na ga la yin/ lo shas sngon gyi don rkyen tshabs chen nang don grub dang bkra shis g.yang chags gnyis kyi pha ste rgan mo lha mo'i khyo bo rdor dpal yang rkyen lam du song / kho 'chi khar dgra sha len dgos rgyu'i kha chems med kyang / dus de nas bzung don grub kyi sems nang du dgra sha de ma blangs na bu skyes pa la skyes rin med la/ pha dam pa'i drin lan 'jal rgyu lta ci pha sha bzas pa dang khyad med snyam gyi yod/ rgyu mtshan der brten nas dbang chen tshang la mna' ma zhig dgos pa dang gcigabakra shis g.yang chags la'ang ming don mtshungs pa'i khyo bo rang 'dra zhig dgos pa dang gnyis/ gsum thad nas bshad na spyir dbang chen gyis dgra sha de len rogs byed rgyu'i khas len dam bca' yod kyang sngar bas lhag pa'i sgo nas de snga rkyen lam du song ba'i gshin po'i bdag po sde dpon btsan lha dang don grub sogs kyi ched lhag bsam rnam dag byed nges yin par brten/ da lan bu dang bu mo'i 'jig rten las 'phro'i zam pa der brten nas gnyen tshang gi 'brel ba de 'dzugs rgyu byas/ma gzhi de'ang rmang gzhi gtan nas med pa'i jus 'god ma yin te sbra'i chon thag gcig la gcig 'brel gyi khyim mtshes min yang sde ba gcig gi khongs su gtogs shing lung pa gcig gi chu mnyam 'thung byas nas mig khra chung gis bltas na mthong rgyu dang / dar lung rna bas nyan na go rgyu yod pas dus yun lo phyed tsam gyi ring gshib pa'i tshe dgra 'dul dang bkra shis g.yang chags gnyis dbar khra chung mig gis lkog mda' 'phen res dang / 'dzum so 237

dkar gyis bsu res byed pa sogs gzhon nu lo chung thun mong la yod pa'i 'char yan gyis phyug cing stong bsam gyis khyab pa'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs ston res byed pa kun gyis tshor nas gleng ba'i rgyu ru gyur yod/don de dbang chen gyi blo ru'ang 'bab po byung nas zla dus tshes grangs kyi dang dod med la/ bag ston gyi mdzad sgo'ang med par spros med bab chags kyi sgo nas nyi shar char 'bab spang la 'ja' tshon shar ba'i nyin zhig gi phyi dro bkra shis g.yang chags dbang chen tshang du bsus te bu dgra 'dul dang khyo shug gi 'tsho ba don snying ldan pa zhig skyel 'go tshugs/sde dpon tshang gis rdzong skal gyi dod du sbra chung chung gcig dang / ra lug sum cu lhag tsam sprad pa dang / kha sngon dbang chen dang nyi shar gnyis kyis 'bul tshan gyi dod du sbyin pa'i dmar yag wa mo'i pags pa dang / g.yi dkar gyi pags pas dgra 'dul dang bkra shis g.yang chags gnyis la zhwa mo re bzos te sprad/ don grub dang ma lha mo gnyis kyis bu mo'i rdzong skal du 'bri g.yag gsum sbyin/ dus de nas dbang chen tshang dang / nyi shar tshang /donagrub tshang grong pa gsum gyi phyugs zog mnyam du bzhag nas khyu gcig tu bzos te rdzi bor khyim tshang res nyi ma gsum re 'gro res byas/ ston ka shar te sa gzhi yongs ljang mdog gi gyon pa phud de gser mdog gi gyon pa bklubs nas ri klung yongs gser mdangs bkra zhing nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa'i me long ji bzhin dwangs pa/ tsham tshom dal bur rgyu ba'i sprin pa'i kha dog da lta 'jos ma thag gi 'bri'i 'o ma dang mtshungs/de'i tshe rong pa sde gsar gyi khyim tshang drag gras sde dpon btsan lha tshang dang / dbang chen tshang / nyi shar tshang / don grub tshang lung pa'i mda' yi rtswa kha bzang sa zhig tu spo skyod byas nas ston mjug skyel 'go brtsams/de sngon dang mi 'dra bar sde dpon btsan lhas 'di lo'i ston ka ched du 238

lung pa'i mda' yi rtswa thang du skyas spo ba'i gtso bo'i rgyu mtshan ni de nas lung skyid dbar thag cung nye bas yun ring mig nang gi ling tog dang / sems nang gi mdzer rur gyur ba'i a dar/ chos dar/ 'brug dar gsum skyid 'jig rten mi yul nas sdug dmyal ba'i khams su brdzang rgyu'i 'char bkod red/ 'on kyang / 'char bkod de kho'i sems nang du bsam pa las da lta kha nas mi su la'ang bshad ma myong bas dbang chen gyis ga la shes/a dar/ chos dar/ 'brug dar gsum bcas dbang chen gyi sems nang du'ang 'khon 'gras med pa'i mdzer ru zhig tu gyur yod/ gang lags she na/ kho tsho spun gsum dang dbang chen gyi bar sngar nas da bar pha rgyu grags pa can dang ma rgyu bsags pa can bal skud phra mo tsam gyi rtsod gleng med mod/ 'on kyang thog mar rong pa sde gsar la mgo 'dogs zhu skabs sde dpon gyi mdun du khas len dam bca' ni bzhag zin pas da lta rgyab tu bskyur na kha dan tshig thog tu mi gnas pa'i pho tha ma'i byed stangs shig red snyam/de nyin dbang chen sbra 'dabs su bsdad de ko ba rlon pa yug cig pus mo'i 'og tu mnan nas lham mthil brje rtsis byas/ skabs der sde dpon gyis khog stod kyi phu dung gnyis ka phud nas thog ma'i kha dog ji yin mngon dka' ba'i be'u ras kyi stod gos gcig gyon nas dbang chen gyi kha sprod du bsdad de rum las rgya glang gi rwa co la rgya dngul gyi shan pa la g.yu byur gyi phra brgyab pa'i sna ru gcig bton nas myong rol cung zad byas rjes dbang chen gyi phyogs su bsrings/dbang chen gyis de mar lag nang gi las 'phro bzhag nas lag par 'gos pa'i thal rdul gos mthar phyis te srid na 'gran zla ma mchis pa'i nor bu'i bum pa zhig lag tu len pa ltar lag gnyis kyis sems chung ngang sna ru tshur blangs nas myong rol byed kyin du ‘‘ya —'dzam pa brgya/ sna ru mdzes po 239

'di 'dra de ring ma gtogs mthong ma myong ’’zhes shod kyin sngar bzhin sems chung gis lag g.yon ma'i mthe bong gi sen mo'i steng du cung zad blugs pa dang de mar yar 'then nas ‘‘a da ’’zhes shin tu yid tshim pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ma gzhi nas los yin/ dbang chen gyi sna tha chad nas yun ring song bas de ring gi sna tha de ni shin tu zhim pas red/ khos de nas yang sna khung gi snabs gtsang mar 'bud rjes yang mthe bong gi sen mo'i steng du mang tsam blugs rjes sems chung gis sna ru de sde dpon la phar sprad/sde dpon gyis ‘‘sna ru de khyod la bster ba yin/’’‘‘min/ min/ nga dang bcas pa'i yul gyar rnams khyed kyi snying rjes sde khongs su bcug pas khyed kyi bka' drin 'jal thabs bral song / da dung ngas khyod kyi rtsa che'i sna ru 'di rang dgar blangs na ga la 'grig ’’ces dbang chen dngangs 'tshab langs nas de ltar bshad pas byur bur blugs pa'i sna tha tog tsam sa ru thor/sde dpon gyis ‘‘khyod de 'dra ma zer dang / khyod kyis nga la rogs byed rgyu khas blangs pa min nam ’mizer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘yin/ de ngas khas blangs pa yin/ mi ngas khas blangs zin pa de mi 'grub pa byed mi srid/ yin na'ang sna ru rtsa chen 'di 'dra ngas len ga la nus mi’zhes phar nud tsam byas nas sna ru de sde dpon gyi pang du bzhag pa dang de nas ‘‘sde dpon lags/ ya med spun gsum deng sang da dung 'bor shob chen po yod dam ’’zer/sde dpon gyis ‘‘kho tsho'i spun zla de dag bsad pa nas bzung rbad de gnya' chag pa red/ yin na'ang kho tsho dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bla mar gyur yang ngas pha rgad po 'chi kha'i kha chems ma sgrub na nga bu skyes pa la skyes rin med pa dang lte thag bcad pa la'ang bcad rin med ’’ces bshad zhor du sna ru de 240

dbang chen gyi pang du g.yug‘‘sna ru rtsa chen 'di ngas len mi nus/’’‘‘de 'dra ma zer dang /’’‘‘ngo ma len nus pa mi 'dug’’‘‘de 'dra ma zer dang / khyod sna tha chad nas rgyun ring phyin yod/’’dgin thog mar sna ru sprod len byed skabs rin thang bral ba'i nor bu zhig sprod len byed pa dang 'dra yang da lta sna ru de ni rin thang gang yang mi ldan pa'i spyir btang gi dngos po zhig ltar phan tshun pang du g.yug res byed kyi 'dug mthar sde dpon gyis u tshugs mtha' bskyal bas sna ru rtsa chen de dbang chen gyis mi len thabs med thugasde dpon gyis dbang chen la da lta rang dgra sha len rogs byed dgos zhes brjod med pas dbang chen gyis rang dang rgya khab phra mo tsam gyi rtsod gleng med pa'i mi gsum dang dmar 'dzing gi las lung 'gyed 'dod med stabs re zhig dus tshod nar 'gyangs gtong ba'i ched du ‘‘sde dpon lags/ nyin shas phyin rjes nga yul du thengs gcig 'gro dgos bsam gyi 'dug khyod kyi bka' drin gyis yul nges med 'khyam po nga lta bu da lta sde chen po mar khu 'dra ba'i nang dpon bzang po bla ma 'dra ba khyed kyi mnga' 'og tu 'tsho sdod byed thub pa ni tshe sngon tshogs bsags pa'i 'bras bu los yin/ da res yul du thengs gcig song nas ngas bza' zla nyi ma 'dra ba de'i bde 'tshams shig blta rgyu dang chabs cig rang sde'i nang spun mched lta bu'i yul mi ma 'chi gson gnas re gnyis 'dra yod med lta bar 'gro 'dod 'dug ri’zer/sde dpon gyis ‘‘'o na khyod kyi nag mo de bde mo yin na da res tshur khrid yong rgyu yin nam ’’zhes dris/dbang chen gyis mig cung btsumase pa dang mas mchu so yis dam par 241

bzung ste mno bsam gtong bzhin mgrin pa gzengs su gtod de dbugs ring nar mo zhig shor/ da gin gzengs su gtod pa'i mgrin pa da gzod gzhu mo ltar gug nas ‘‘da res khrid thabs byas kyang chog yin na'ang ngas da res mo'i bde 'tshams blta rgyu las mo dang thug 'phrad byed rtsis med/gal srid btsan rgod kha shos shes song na phyis su dgra sha len rgyu lta ci kho de bas dogs zon che ru 'gro nges red la/ nga rang gi srog kyang thar dka' mo red/de snga nged tsho pa'i me mda' yod tshad da lta kho tsho'i tsho pa'i lag tu yod pas/ring mi gcig gis kho tsho'i kha gtad 'jal ga la nus ’’zhes shod kyin 'dren byed zung las mig chu'ang rdog gnyis lhung byung /skyes pa pho yi mig chu ni rin chen gser ltar mthong dka' mo zhig red/'on kyang da lta dbang chen gyis skad cha shod kyin du 'dren byed zung las rtswa thang gi zhogs pa'i zil chu lta bu'i mig chu dwangs shing gtsang ba rdog gnyis ri gzar las rbab rdo 'gril pa ltar mkhur mgo g.yas g.yon las thur du lhung byung bas sde dpon gyi sems su'ang skyo snang skyed nas dbugs ring zhig shor ba dang / de nas mu mthud dbang chen gyi gdong la blta ma nus par phyogs gzhan zhig tu bltas te ‘‘'khor ba khab kyi rtse mo na/ bde ba nam yang yod ma yin zhes pa cis mi bden ’zhes sngon chad dam pa gang gi zhal las gsungs pa mi shes kyang go don shin tu gting zab la tshig 'bru shin tu nyung ba'i legs bshad lta bu'i skad cha de ngag las shor/ sde dpon gyis na ning thog mar mthong skabs dbang chen ni gzugs stobs che la gdong gi sha rtsi smug cing tsub dreg ldan pa/ mig rtsa cung zad dmar la spyang grung dang ldan pa/ ngo ma rtswa thang gi rlung lhags la mi 'jigs shing sdang dgra bo'i mdun du dpa' mi zhum pa/ lag pa gnam la 'phyar ba tsam gyis nyam chung srog rtsa 'dar 'os pa'i dpa' bo lta bu zhig tu mthong yang /24 2

de ring kho'i mdun du lhags pa'i dbang chen ni de las ldog ste mgo skyes g.yag rnga ltar zang zing du gyur ba/ ngo gdong thal mdog la sngo shas che ba/ 'dren byed zung yang 'od mdangs nyams pa/ mkhur mgo g.yas g.yon steng gi da gin lhung pa'i mchi ma'i rjes shul gsal po de ni shin tu nyams zhan pa'i mtshan rtags shig tu mngon pas chung ma khog las don nas da bar sde mthar myul pa'i sprang rgan lta bu 'di yis nga'i dpung rogs byed thub bam snyam pa'i bsam tshul ya mtshan pa zhig skyed/ 'on kyang brang zheng che la sha rgod 'bur du thon pa/lag pa che la mkhregs pa/ mdzub mo sbom la rtsub dreg ldan pa de dag mthong tshe de ni ngo gdong gi ldog phyogs su gyur zhing rang gi klad pa'i nang du yan ring spyod ri tsho rig /ste)/ tsho ring 11(( zir pa /ji//gnas pa' dpa' bo' snang brnyan du gyur tsho dpa' ba' dpung gas 'a lta bu zhig yod pas ya med spun gsum lta ci kham gsum dmag gis 'khor lo bskor te 'jig rten khrag gi mtsho mo 'khyil yang 'jigs dgos mi 'dug snyam pa'i tshor snang skyes/de'i skabs sde dpon gyis ‘‘rogs pa su khrid rtsis yod/ dgra 'dul byishā /nam ’’zhes dris/ dbang chen gyis ‘‘rogs pa su'ang khrid rtsis med ’’‘‘grogs po ’’zhes sde dpon gyis dbang chen gyi phrag par bcag tsam byas nas ‘‘rogs pa gcig khrid na mi bzang ngam/ sa thag ring po gcod pa'i dus/ yang min na zhim po'i zas shig dgos/ yang min na snyan po'i gtam zhig dgos zer srol yod pas/ lam rogs shig yod na nyi ma 'khyol sla gi red ’’zer/sde dpon gyis dbang chen la ‘‘grogs po ’’zhes shod pa thengs dang po yin pas dbang chen gyi sems su mi 'dis ngo ma rang mir brtsis nas sems khur byed kyi 'dug snyam nas ‘‘khyod sems khral mi dgos/ da res ngas yul du 243

thengs gcig song nas bza' mo'i bde 'tshams kyi gnas tshul zhig bltas te log yong rgyu yin/ da res phyin nas gnas tshul zhig rtogs thub na phyis su dgra sha len skabs kyang 'char bkod bzo bde bas nga rang mi rkyang rta rkyang las rogs pa khrid rtsis med ’’zer/de nas sde dpon yar langs te kho rang gi nang du log 'gro ba'i lam du don grub dang 'phrad/don grub kyis ‘‘khyed dbang chen tshang du phyin pa yin nam ’mizhes dris/sdedapon gyis ‘‘yin/ ngas da lan ya med spun gsum dang dgra sha len rgyu'i skor kho la shod grabs byas pa yin/ 'on kyang ’’don grub kyis sde dpon gyi tshig mjug 'phrog nas sems 'tshab dang bcas ‘‘ga re/ khos khas len mi byed pa red dam ’’zhes dris/sde dpon gyis ‘‘ma red/ da thengs kho yul du thengs gcig 'gro rtsis 'dug pas ngas da lta kho la bshad med/ khos khas len byed srid/ nga tshos kho tsho sde khongs su bcug pas mi tshad khyod kyi sring mo bkra shis g.yang chags kho'i bu dgra 'dul gyi mna' mar bster bas kho'i mna' tshig gyur mi srid/ma gzhi nas ngas bltas na mi de 'di 'dra zhig 'dug ’’ces mthe bong g.yas pa ker te don grub la ston tsam byas nas mu mthud bshad don ‘‘nga tshos da lta rang ya med spun gsum dang 'dzing nas dgra sha len dgos zhes bshad na dbang chen gyis khas len srid mod/ 'on kyang rang nyid la yang da lta 'char bkod zab mo zhig med par dbang chen la khyod song nas kho tsho sod ces brjod na nga tsho nyam chung nus med thabs rdugs kyi byed stangs shig red/ dgra sha len skabs kho la mtshon cha yag po yod pas dpung rogs su khrid rgyu las 'thab mkhan gtso bo nga gnyis red/ nga'i pha dam pa'i kha chems 'jog sa nga yin pa las dbang chen ma red/ mtshon 'og tu 'chi ba ni nga gnyis kyi pha rgan las 244

dbang chen gyi pha min pas dbang chen gyi ngos nas bshad na kho tsho'i bar rtsod gzhi rtsod gleng gang yang med pas nga tshos thabs bkod kyi jus gzhi bkod nas klan ka zhig 'tshol dgos nges red/ de ltar byung tshe dbang chen dpa' ba'i dpung rogs su khrid nas 'chi gson gang la thug kyang nga gnyis gdong mchong gis dmar 'dzing byed dgos pa las dbang chen kho nar 'gan bcol nas ya med spun gsum dmar gsod btang yang de nga gnyis pha dam pa'i ched du dgra sha blangs pa yin zer rgyu med la gzhan gyis kyang 'phya smod byed nges red ’’ces bshad/ skad cha de don grub kyi bsam stangs dang shin tu mthun pas ‘‘de rang red/ ngas kyang de 'dra bsam gyi 'dug ’’ces brjod/de nas dbang chen yul du 'gro rgyu'i gra sgrig gis lam rgyags la sha btsos/rtsam pa rtsam khug tu blugs/ bo'u khra ring gnam lcags kyi phyi nang yongs gtsang mar phyis te ‘‘sang dang gcig gnangs dang gnyis/ gzhes lha nyin dkar por thon rgyu yin ’’zhes bshad/don grub dang / dgra 'dul/ bkra shis g.yang chags/ nyi shar/rgan mo lha mo sogs kyis rogs pa mang tsam khrid na yag pa'i kha ta byas pa dang pho gzhon mang pos rogs par nga 'gro zhes dang blangs byas kyang dbang chen gyis de dag gi khar ma nyan par nyin gsum pa'i nyi ma rtse shar gyi dus su gnyen nye dang grong pa khyim mtshes tshang mar 'gram pa yang yang sbyar nas zhal gyes zhus te rta bo rkyang rgod la bzhon/ bo'u khra ring gnam lcags rgyab tu khur nas yul las thon te song / der yod tshang mas dbang chen lam bar du gegs bar mi yong ba/ bya ba lam lhong yong ba'i smon lam yang yang 'debs bzhin sgo 'gram du langs nas rgyang ring gi bar du kho la mig gis skyel ma byas/dbang chen lung mdo nas thon khar rta kha phyir bskor te blta dus mi mang po da dung sgo 'gram du langs nas kho la mig gis skyel ma byed kyin yod pa 245

mthong bas khos kyang gzhis sdod mi phyugs yongs god chags mi yong ba'i smon lam btab/lung mdo las don rjes rta las babs te rgyang ring gi lho phyogs su mig rgyang 'ga' bcad dus rgyang ring sa 'dzin gyi phreng ba dang / khug sna'i khrod du kha ba'i rdul brtsegs kyi lhun po'i gtsug tor thar thor yang mngon gyi 'dug kyang de dag gi khrod du rang yul gyi ri rtse red snyam pa ni gcig kyang mi 'dug pas gang ltar nyin shas lho phyogs kho nar kha gtad de 'gro rgyu red snyam nas rtar bzhon te rta bo lcag gis brab nas skyod/'byams klas mya ngam gyi thang chen du 'grul rogs med pa'i mi gcig kher 'gro byed rgyu ni ha cang yid mug pa zhig red/ lab rogs gleng rogs zer na'ang 'dra/ dga' grogs skyo grogs zer na'ang 'dra gang ltar 'og tu bzhon pa'i byol song las med pas yid mug gi sems sangs ched smra sgo phyes te glu chung zhig blangs par/shar phyogs sprin bzang dkar po/'gros chen rta bo yin na/rgya dang bod kyi lam thaganyi ma gcig gis bskyod chog‘‘'o/ shu shu ’’kho'i mdun gyi ri sna chang chang de'i 'dabs kyi na thang de the(1 da sna zi pa rwar rwazig ri misu pa zirab lhazig lag (1tho spyoranas gzhan stag rgad 'dra ba zhag gas nar khyu gcag mar 'dad nga ga 'dugan thang de'i gzhung gi rgyug chu'i 'gram du kho dang nor rdzi pho gzhon de 'phrad/ pho gzhon des ru dar dmar po can gyi me mda' rgyab tu khur pa'i skya mi kher rkyang 'di ci zhig yin snyam nas 'gro mtshams bzhag ste khor bltas nas 246

bsdad /dbang chen rta las babs nas ‘‘ya/ pho gsar/ zog 'tsho yag ’’cesakhams 'dri byas kyang pho gsar des lan ma sprad par mig hur rer khor bltas nas 'dug pho gzhon de ni gzugs stobs che la mig rtsa dmar ba/'gram pa g.yas par rma shul sor gsum tsam yod pa zhig 'dug sa cha de ni lung skyid 'tsho ba'i sa cha yin pa dbang chen gyis shes kyi yod pas pho gsar 'di phal cher ya med spun gsum gyi gcig min nam snyam nas ‘‘khyod kyi ming la ci zer ri’zhes dris/ rīpho gsar des ‘‘khyod kyi ming la ci zer ’’zhes tshur dris byung /dbang chen gyis bod mda' tshur blangs te ‘‘hwa hwa/ nga'i ming shes 'dod na ri mgo'i jag pa kher 'gro zer ’’zhes bshad/phogasar des phyir bshol gom gang byas nas ‘‘khyod kyis ci byed rtsis yod/ nga don med nor rdzi la khyod kyis brnyas bcos byed don ci red/ nga rang srog 'ben la btsugs nas 'thab 'dod can de 'dra min/ 'thab rgyur dga' drags pas chags sgo chen po rag myong ’’zhes phyir bshol byed kyin nor khyu 'phrog dogs kyis nor khyu'i phyogs su blta tsam blta tsam byed kyi 'dugadabang chen gyis gom gang mdun du spos te ‘‘nga'i ming bshad tshar/ da khyod kyi ming la ci zer/’’zhes skad shugs che ru btang nas dris/‘‘nga'i ming nga'i ming 'brug dar zer/ jag dpon lags ’’zhes mu mthud phyir bshol byas/dbang chen gyis bde lcag 'khyug po'i sgo nas sbi sdi'i me sgron nas gom pa re re bzhin 'brug dar gyi mdun du bcar nas ‘‘kho re 'brug dar/ khyod de ring nga'i mtshon 'og tu shi song ’’zhes 'jigs skul byas/'brug dar gyis ‘‘de 'dra ma byed dang / jag jag dpon/ nga 247

spun brgyad yod sa la da lta gsum las ma lhag mi’zhes shod kyin rkang pa gnyis kyang 'dar sig sig byed kyi 'dugadabang chen gyis ‘‘'o na/ khyod kyis nga'i me mda'i mchu lce yis ldogs dang de min na ngas gsod rgyu yin ’rizhes 'jigs skul byas/'brug dar gyi sems su sngar byung myong med pa'i 'jigs skrag skyed de/de ring rang nyid rlung rta nyams nas gdon 'dre gson po zhig thug 'dug pas rang srog skyel ba las me mda'i mchu ldag na dga' snyam nas dbang chen gyi mdun du phyin nas me mda'i mchu thengs gsum ldag‘‘hwa/ hwa/ hwa/’’dbang chen gyis gad mo chen po zhig bgad nas me mda' rgyab tu khur zhing rta bo lcag gis brab nas bya 'phur ba ltar rgyug song /'brug dar rang sar langs nas lce da dung phyi ru bton te da gin de rmi lam yin nam mngon sum yin cha ma 'tshal bar hon thor nas lus/nyi ma nub rir bzhud cing nub phyogs kyi gnam sa 'dres mtshams kyi sprin dkar yongs da gzod dar zab dmar ser gyi mdog tu gyur/ribyi'u rnams gshog gyur ngom bzhin la la thur du 'phur pa dang la la gyen du 'phur pa sogs skabs de'i 'jig rten snod bcud kyis dbang chen lta bu yun ring yul gyar 'tsho ba'i nyams sad theg nas 'jigs dang skrag ces pa'i tha snyad snga sa nas ming gi lhag mar gyur ba'i skye bo'i sems nang du'ang shin tu yid mug pa dang skyo shas kyi tshor snang sbyin gyi 'dugade nas kho dwangs gtsang chu mig ldan pa'i na sgor mo zhig tu slebs pas der rta sga blangs shing lci ba btus te ja bskol te ngal gso tog tsam brgyab rjes shar phyogs nas tshes bco lnga'i zla ba gsal gyi ler shar byung bas slar yang rta sga brgyab nas mdun du skyod/gnam gshis je grang du song ba dang byang rlung ldang byung bas me mda'i ru 248

dar lhab lhub tu g.yo ba dang / 'gram pa dang / rna rtsar grang shur shur byed kyi 'dug sa gzhi yongs zla 'od skya thing thing du khyab pa dang phyogs bzhi'i sa 'dzin gyi phreng ba dag gcan gzan gyi mche ba ltar ring thung mtho dman dang /sgang gshong gi dbye mtshams lhag par gsal/ g.ya' dag pa'i dgung sngon gyi dbyings su rgyu skar gyi tshom bu mang du mang du phyin nas khra thing nger gyur pa dang bco lnga'i dung zla yang mtho bar 'phags te dpa' rogs dpung rogs med pa'i dpa' rgod rkyang pa der skyo rogs byed pa bzhin rnam kun las sgor rgya che zhing dkar mdangs che ba'i snang ba shar/de'i skabs sprin nag tshom bu zhig gis zla ba'i zhal ras bkab nas re zhig 'jig rten yongs mun nag tu gyur te mdun gyi mdzub mo lnga yang mi mthong bar gyur bas dbang chen gyi yid du skyi g.ya' ba'i rjes dran dum bu zhig shar/btsan rgod kha sho yul las bral nas zla gnyis lhag phyin pa'i rjes kyi nyin zhig gi mtshan mo zhig mi rnams gnyid lam gyi zhing khams su rol zhing phyogs bzhi dben zhing lhing 'jags su gnas/ skabs re bgres song 'ga' shas kyi sdur pa 'then pa'i har sgra re 'ga' thos/ skabs re yid mug pa'i 'ug pa'i skad re zung thos/ glo bur du khyi'i zug skad lhang lhang du grags pa dang dus mnyam 'jigs su rung ba'i me mda'i skad dang / mi'i ki sgra sna tshogs byung bas sde nang gi mi tshang ma gnyid har sad dang slog pa lteb gyon byas/ mun nag lag snyob kyis me mda' dang / rdzas mdel btsal yang bzhu mar dang zla 'od gang yang med pa'i mun nag nang 'ga' shas kyis me mda' rnyed kyang rdzas khug ma rnyed par rtsam khug dang rdzas khug nor 'dzol byung nas me mda'i nang du rtsam pa blugs/ 'ga' shas kyis rdzas mdel rnyed kyang me mda' ma rnyed/ dza drag dang 'tshab 'tshub kyi dbang gis la las rang gi chung ma'i byu ru'i mgul rgyan mde'u la nor te me mda'i nang du blugs khul byas/249

'ga' shas kyis sked gri dang btags ma nor te btags ma 'phyar nas sgor don/'jigs su rung ba'i ki gsod rgyob gsod kyi skad sgra dang / me mda'i skad bar mtshams med par grags pa'i dza drag gi dus der sbrum ma 'ga' shas 'jigs skrag gis ma bzod par mngal yang shor ba dang khyi'i skad sgra dang /phru gu'i ngu skad mnyam du 'dres/ dbang chen gyis gri dang me mda' lag tu thogs te bu dgra 'dul dang bza' mo khrid de sgor don grabs byed pa'i skabs phyi logs nas sbra'i chon thag bcad pas de ma nyid la sbra de rim gyis 'gyel/gnas tshul shin tu stabs mi legs pa rtogs pas dbang chen gyis shugs kyis bu khrid de phyir don thub tsam byung yang g.yang mo phyir don ma thub par da dung sbra'i 'og tu yod pas dbang chen brel 'tshab kyis kha phyir bskor nas bza' zla skyob par brtsams pa'i tshe rgyab phyogs nas mi gcig gis dbyugs pa lta bu zhig rang gi mgor gzes te gzhu ba'i tshor snang zhig byung bas gzugs po g.yas phyogs su yo tsam byas pas dbyugs pa lta bu de dbang chen gyi rkang pa g.yon ma'i 'khris kyi sa ru gzhus te sne gcig chag pa'i shing phye mkha' ru thor te dum bu zhig kho'i mgo skyes zing zing du gyur ba de'i steng du zug yang de'i skabs g.yas phyogs nas mi gcig tshur rgyug byung bas de mar dbang chen gyis sked gri shubs las 'byin nas shugs kyis bsnun pas mi de'i grod par thebs te ‘‘a da ri’zhes skad ngan shor ba dang dus mnyam sa ru 'gyel pas dgra 'dul yang tog tsam ma gtogs mi de'i ro'i 'og tu gnan/‘‘dbang chen bu dgra nga ’’g.yang mo'i ngu ngag gi tshig mjug brjod dbang med par gyur bas dbang chen gyis gzhan gyis kha bkag nas btsan khrid byas pa shes te khog nang du khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar nas sked gri dgung la 'phyar te g.yang mo'i skad grags 'ong sa'i phyogs 250

sa shor yang rkang pa sbra'i chon thag gi phar par 'khon te kha bab logari brgya ri ring dmi byimi gsum gyis mnyam du ‘‘dbang chen kho ga par 'dug de ring kho thar par btang na mi 'grig da dung kho'i bu yod ’’ces skad rgyag gi 'dugami de gsum nang nas gcig gi skad cha sgra mi dag la gdangs kyang shin tu phra bas de btsan rgod kha sho'i skad yin pa dbang chen gyis gsal por shes/dbang chen gyi bsam par da lta mi mang nyung gi khyad par che bas rang nyid pham rgyu red snyam nas dgra 'dul gyi lag nas bzung ste sbra'i lho phyogs kyi grog rong zhig gi nang du bros nas yib/‘‘dbang chen thar par btang na bu min/’’‘‘rnyed kyi mi 'dug’’‘‘thar par gtong mi rung / da dung kho'i bu yod/’’twetwernyed kyi’ ḍi 'dug’’de'i skabs grong sde'i nang ki sgra dang khyi'i zug skad/ a tsha a ra'i 'o dod kyi sgra/ lug gi 'ba' skad/ nor gyi ngur ldir gyis skyi g.ya' ba'i mtshan mo der yid shin tu skyo ba'i mnyam dkrol rol mo zhig btang /mi skad sbom po zhig gis ‘‘ab phrug tsho/ jag brgyab pa la brgyab rin yod pa zhig dang / mi bsad pa'i sdig rin yod pa dgos/ 'do ba rta la sga srab sprad/ khra ring bo'u la rdzas rdzong brgyab nas yong ba'i yong go chod pa dgos ’’zer/btsan rgod kha shos sgra mi dag pa'i skad kyis ‘‘g.yang phyug sprang sde me btang rjes kyi thal ba tsam yang med par bzo dgos/ dbang chen kho shig la brgyab kyang gong ba'i phyi red ’’ces zer ba'i skad cha de dag go bas dbang chen khog nang gi khong khro mnan ma thub par kho tsho gzhan rgyu'i don du 'chi nus na/251

kho tsho mi mang na ro mang dang / nga mi nyung na ro nyung red snyam ste gri ring dgung la 'phyar nas thengs kha shas shor grabs byas kyang bsam blo zhib tu gtong dus de ring mi mang nyung gi khyad par dang / sprang gnam 'di yang sprin nag gis khengs te mthong gi mi 'dug pas bya gnam la 'phur/ sgo nga sa ru lhung pa'i dpe bzhin g.yang mo yang skyob mi thub par rang nyid kyang gson ma thub na phyis su dgra sha len rgyu lta ci g.yang phyug sde ba zhes pa gtam rgyud tsam du 'gyur rgyu red snyam nas bsdad/dbang chen gyi sems nang du khong khro'i me lce 'bar bzhin sked gri dang /me mda' lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis dam par bzung nas skad sgra grags 'ong sa'i phyogs gang der nyan bzhin mas mchu so yis dam par bzung nas khrag dmar yang ma ne+e'i steng nas thur du bzhur/ de snga phan chad gnyid lam du yang gtong myong med pa'i de ring gi 'jigs skrag des bu dgra 'dul rkang lag 'dar gyin kha yi rkan dang / lce yang skam por 'gyur yang kha nas ngu skad dang / sdug skad tshig 'bru gcig kyang ma don par rang gi pha dang kha bral dogs kyis pha dbang chen gyi slog pa'i thu sne las dam par bzung ste bsdad/jag pa de tshos sbi sdi klad du skor gyin me lce dmar 'phyur 'phyur gyis lug g.yang mo 'ba' skad di rer/ nor nag chung ngur skad long nger ded pas dbang chen khong khro bzod glags bral bar gyur nas sbi sdi'i me lce 'phyur ba'i phyogs der gzes te mug nag lkog mda' zhig 'phangs pas 'di phyogs nas ‘‘twa ’’zhes me mda'i skad grags pa dang dus mnyam phar phyogs nas sbi sdi gcig me lce dmar thor rer sa ru lhung ba mthong bas jag pa gcig 'jig rten phyi ma'i lam du brdzangs song snyam/ khoskode mar dbang chen pha bu gnyis myur stabs kyis gnas gzhananizhig tu spos te yib nas bsdad/252

‘‘dbang chen kho'i sdug ro phi na 'dug de ring kho'i sdug mgo la phug gshag gshag dang / sdug snying nyung ma gcod gcod ma byas na bu min/ab phrug tsho rgyugs ’’zhes skad brgyab pa dang mi kha shas kho gnyis kyi phyogs su rgyug yong ba'i rdog sgra gsal po thos/ dbang chen pha bu gnyis lam seng grog mo zhig gi nang du 'dzul te yib nas bsdad/ kho gnyis 'tshol mkhan jag pa de tshos lab gleng sna tshogs byed kyin gang sar 'tshol ba'i khul gyis 'gro gi 'dug de'i skabs mi gcig gis gcig la skad dma' po'i sgo nas ‘‘gzhan gyi don du rang srog dron mo dgra lag tu bzhag pas ci phan/ dbang chen ni rang sa rgyus yod yin pas gang du gab kyang las sla mo red/ nga tsho gzhan sa rgyus med yin pas nyen kha chen po red/ de bas ma btsal na dga' ’’zer/gcig shos kyis ‘‘de rang red/ 'gro 'gro ’’zer nas bud song /gzhan rnams kyang de gnyis kyi rjes su 'brang nas bud song /da gzod dgung sngon gyi sprin pa'i yol nag de sbar mthil gyi che chung tsam gyi i khung zhig rdol ba las zla ba'i zhal ras phyed tsam mngon/ jag pa tshos phyugs khyu ded de lho nub kyi phyogs su 'gro ba rab rib cig mthong bas dbang chen gyis bu khrid de mda' 'phangs pa ltar rgyug nas jag pa de tsho 'gro ba'i mdun phyogs su rdza 'phrang dog po zhig yod pa de'i g.yon phyogs kyi ri ldebs su rgyug ste sgug nas bsdad/jag pa de tsho yang spyang grung ldan pas da res mi gcig me mda' phog nas bsad pa nas bzung me sbar ba'i sbi sdi klad du bskor gyi mi 'dug la phan tshun skad shugs chen po'i skad cha'ang lab kyi mi 'dug kho tsho ji ltar spyang grung ldan yang dbang chen pha bu gnyis kyis mdun phyogs kyi rdza 'phrang dog po de nas sgug yod pa ga la shes/dbang chen pha bu gnyis der slebs nas cung zad song rjes jag pa tshos 253

phyugs khyu ded de 'phrang lam de rgyud nas slebs byung /gcigagis ‘‘shag po btsan rgod/ khyod la chung ma mdzes po de 'dra zhig thob pa nga'i bka' drin yin pa ma brjed ang ’’zer/smra lce dib cing gdang phra ba'i btsan rgod kyis ‘‘dbang chen pha bu gnyis gsod ma thub na nag mo 'dis nga la blo gtad mi srid la/ nga la'ang skyid kyi nyi ma rig gi ma red ’’zer/‘‘de las sla mo red/ kho da lta rang sa rgyus yod yin pas gab nas bsdad kyang shig la brgyab kyang gong ba'i phyi red ’rizer/de'i skabs dbang chen pha bu gnyis kyi khog nang du khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar nas g.yang mo dang / phyugs rigs gang la'ang bsam blo ma btang bar ri ldebs nas rbab rdo gang byung du g.yug pas jag pa de dag skad sgra long long gis gang byung du me mda' brgyab pa dang a ra dang a tsha'i skad kyang mang po grags byung /jag pa de dag rim gyis rdza 'phrang las bgrod pas mthar kho gnyis ri ldebs der brag tshom zhig yod pa der zhag nyal byas/dgong mo der pha bu gnyis gnyid bde po zhig ga la khug rgyun par stag gdan/ gzig gdan/ 'bol gdan sogs med mod pags gdan dang ko gdan yod kyang de dgong sa 'khyags gdan dang rdo 'khyags sngas byas nas nyal ba'i khar mal chas zhes pa sbar mthil tsam med pa dang / dbang chen gyi sems su 'jags thabs med pa'i khong khro dang sdug bsngal/ dgra 'dul gyi sems su 'jigs skrag gis gnyid skyid po zhig ga la khug srid/phyi nyin nam gsal la ma gsal skabs dbang chen mgo rum las don te yar blta dus brag tshom gyi steng du pho rog kha shas babs nas 'dug pa de dag la las ‘‘kwa/ kwa/mirizhes skad rgyag gin mchu rdo la brdar/ la las gshog pa 254

rdeb tsam rdeb tsam byed kyin kho gnyis kyi phyogs su bltas nas 'dug pas sems nang sngar bas lhag pa'i khong khro dang 'jigs skrag byung bas hob langs kyis sked rags bcings nas pha bong zhig gi rgyab nas ga ler rdza 'phrang gi phyogs su bltas pa na rjes ma zin par lus pa'i phyugs rigs skyo zhan 'ga' shas dang / mdang nub rbab rdo phog pa'i rmas ma gcig lus nas 'duganam rbad de ma gsal bar dbang chen pha bu gnyis thur du ma babs par brag tshom de'i khrod nas phyogs bzhir rgyang mig gcod kyin dogs zon byas nas bsdad/nam rbad de gsal nas nyi ma'ang 'char nye ba'i skabs kho gnyis rgyug ma 'dur gyis ri ldebs las rdza 'phrang du mar babs te mi rmas ma de'i phyogs su song / dbang chen lag nang gi me mda'i sbi sdi'i du ba sngo 'phyur 'phyur du yod pa mthong bas rkang gyol de'i ngo gdong las shin tu nyam thag pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis kho gnyis la bltas te ‘‘tshe thar gtong rogs/ sku mkhyen ’’zhes zhu ba 'then gyin lag pa gnyis kyis phyag rgya'ang byas/dbang chen gyi sems su rang nyid phung pa'i rnyi zas lta bu zhig min nam snyam nas nye 'khor la blta bzhin dogs zon chen po'i sgo nas ‘‘kho re/ khyod sdug sroge rta rnga phra mo la gces sems yod na/ g.yo sgyu ma byed/ de min na zha mdel sngon mo gcig bster ’’zhes me mda'i mchu phar gtad de rdzig nyams skul/mi rkang gyol des ‘‘ngas g.yo sgyu'i skad cha shod pa min/ nga mi gsod rogs ’’zhes zhu ba 'then gyin 'khris kyi me mda' dbang chen gyi phyogs su g.yug dbang chen sngar bzhin dogs zon chen po'i sgo nas mi de'i 'khris su bcar/mi des ‘‘mdang dgong khyed kyis rdza ri'i ldebs las rbab rdo g.yug pas 255

nga'i rkang par thebs byung / kho tshos nga la ya ma byas par 'dir g.yug ste phyin song ri’zhes bshad zhor du rkang pa g.yon ma'i pus mo'i mtshams skrangs nas 'dug pa de dbang chen la bstan nas lag pa 'dar gyin skrang 'bur gyi steng du mdzub mo btsugs te ‘‘'dir 'dir rdo brgyab byung a ra a ra phal cher phal cher chag yod pa 'dra ’’zer/dgra 'dul gyis mi de'i me mda' yar blangs te blta dus me mda'i gsham shing chag pa'i chag shul gsar pa de mthong bas dbang chen gyi sems su mdang dgong shing chag krum gyi zegs ma mkha' la 'thor te mgo skyes kyi steng du 'byar yod pa da gzod dran gsos te chag krum de mgo'i steng nas blangs te bltas pas de ni me mda' de'i gsham shing gi chag krum 'khrul med red 'dug pas dbang chen khong khro sngar bas che ba langs nas ‘‘pha ro za rgyu khyod kyis ma dang dgong nga'i mgo la me mda' bzhu ma thub pas ma gtogs nga gsod rtsis byas pa ma yin nam ’’zhes mig 'bur tshugs kyis sdigami des ‘‘lags yin/ stabs legs pa zhig la khyed ’’dbang chen gyis ‘‘mi de'i tshig mjug 'phrog nas nga tsho g.yang phyug mar khu 'khyil ba la khyod tsho ma rungs bas khrag ltar dkrug don ci red/’mices gom gang mdun du spos nas sked gri mthon por 'phyar te gzhu bar brtsams pa'i tshe mi des ‘‘nga nga ma gsod rogs nga nga sku mkhyen ’’zhes ngo mdog skya bor gyur zhing ngag 'dar gyis mthe bong ker nas tshe thar gtong ba'i zhu ba 'then byung /kho'i nyam thag pa'i rnam 'gyur mthong bas dbang chen gyi sems su'ang snying rje zhig skyed de mthon por 'phyar ba'i gri ring mar phabs te sngar bzhin am btsigs bsdam nas mi der bltas nas bsdad/mi des ‘‘ngas khyod la skad cha drang po zhig shod/ der yid ches min 256

khyod rang la rag las yod ’’ces gzugs po u tshugs kyis dbang chen gyi phyogs su nud tsam byas nas mu mthud bshad rgyur ‘‘ngas kha seng khong tsho'i rkub la lces ma ldag tsam gyis sri zhu sgrub pa dang / mdang dgong yang rang srog phangs med kyis khong tsho'i bka' ltar khyed tshor gnod pa'i spyod ngan spel/'on kyang mdang dgong nga'i rkang par rdo phog nas 'gro ma thub pa'i tshe khong tshos ya nga snying rje med par nga 'dir g.yugs pas da nas nga kho tshor zhen pa log cing rang gi byas nyes la 'gyod pa snying dbus nas skyed kyi 'dug da nas bzung nga gnyis mna' bzhag gi shag po zhig byed thub na phan tshun gnyis kar phan thogs 'dug ’’ces bshad/dbang chen sngar bzhin dogs zon gyis phyogs bzhir rgyang mig cig bcad pa dang / mi de'i gam gyi sa 'bur zhig gi steng du ong khri byas te bsdad nas ‘‘khyod kyi ming la ci zer/ btsan rgod kha sho kho la dpa' dpung rogs mang po de tsam dang me'i 'phrul 'khor yang mang po de 'dra ga 'dra red ’’ces dris/mi des ‘‘nga'i ming la dga' blo zer ’’zhes bshad zhor du sna ru bton te sna tha sen mo gang blugs te bshad pa'i skad cha bsdus 'bri byas pa gsham gsal/btsan rgod kha sho yul las song ste nyin bcu grangs song rjes yul nges med kyi jag pa rta pa bcu drug dang 'phrad/ kho jag pa dang 'phrad pas zhed nas rang srog thar pa'i ched du nag chu kha la mi gsum bsad pa tho lo bshags/shag chu kha la mi bzhi bsad pa tho lo bshags/ rdza chu kha la mi lnga bsad pa tho lo bshags zhes kho rang gis mi mang po bsad par thol bshags byed khul gyis de ltar kha nas 'don gyin phyin pa jag pa tshos thos pas kho dang nye bar bcar dus mi de ni kha sho 'jigs su rung ba zhig 'dug pas ngo ma mi gsod lag dmar bdud kyi bu dang 'dra bas jag pa tshos rta thog nas phan tshun rna bar ngo 257
