ma btsan gyi bu rang yin pa 'dra zhes shub shub lab res byas pa khos go nas brel 'tshub kyi khrod du blo gros rnyed pa'i dpe ltar khos de mar nga ni btsan gyi bu yin/ ming la btsan rgod zer/ sngar yang kher 'gro kher 'dug yin/deng yang kher 'gro kher 'dug yin zhes rang nyid gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad 'phags kyi nus mthu khyad par can zhig yod khul gyi skad cha mang po bshad pas jag pa tshos kyang spyir btang min pa'i mi ya mtshan po zhig 'dug snyam nas mnyam du khrid nas song / de nas bzung mi rta tshang mar god chags ma byung bar sde che chung mang po bcom thub pas 'di ni btsan gyi bu khrid yod pas nga tsho rgyal ba red ces btsan rgod kha sho la lhag par gyis gces bkur byas/ khos sngar las lhag pa'i rdzig nyams ston bzhin jag pa de dag gi sne khrid de dbang chen gtsos pa'i g.yang phyug tsho ba zho ltar chags de khrag ltar dkrug rgyu thabs bkod la bsam blo gtong bzhin da res ni 'thus shor gtong mi rung ba'i go skabs rtsa chen zhig red snyams/de'i skabs mdun nas ri bong gcig hob langs kyis phyogs gzhan zhig tu bros pas dbang chen gyi bzhon rta 'drogs tsam byas pas skyi g.ya' ba'i 'das don der mu mthud phyir dran byed pa'i go skabs ma byung /de'i tshe zla ba yang nam dkyil du slebs nas dkar mdangs sngar bas che bar gyur zhing sgor rgya yang sngar bas che ba'i 'phrul snang shar/ skabs der grang zug kyang lhag par che bas kho'i 'gram pa dang rna ba tsha sbir sbir du gyur/rkang pa gnyis ni khro lcags bzhun ma las grub pa'i yob la reg yod pas grang drags stabs rang lus kyi cha shas yin pa'i tshor snang med par gyur bas da gzod kho rta las 'bab skabs rkang pa gnyis sar thug pa dang tog tsam ma gtogs ltag dgye log rang gi gzugs po drod khug pa'i ched du de ltar rta khrid nas rgyang grags gcig tsam bskyod rjes mi rta gnyis ka'i gzugs por 258

yang drod khug ste tsha sob sob tu gyur/ de nas brag ri mthon po zhig gi 'dabs kyi na thang zhig tu slebs pas de dgong der zhag sdod byas/rta'i ske yi dril bu'i ting sgra las phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad lhing 'jags/ zhi bde/ khu sim du gnas kyang dbang chen gnyid ma khugamago rum du bcug nas gnyid khug thabs byas kyang gnyid ma khug la mig btsum yang gnyid ma khug lab rogs dang gleng rogs gang yang med pa'i mi rkyang gcig nam phyed zin grabs yod kyang da dung gnyid ma khug pa ni shin tu 'khyol dka' ba'i dus tshod cig red/ da lta rta'i ske yi dril bu'i ting sgra de'ang rna bar shin tu mi snyan pa tha na sun pa'i snang ba'ang bster/ gnyid kyi byed po kho dang bar thag je ring du song bas bsam pa mi 'khrug dgu 'khrug tu gyur/de ltar nyin mtshan bstud mar nyin bcu gcig song rjes cha rgyus yod pa'i g.yang phyug gi sa sne zin te sa 'dzin 'phreng ba'i gtsug phud du gyur ba gangs dkar po'i cod pan can dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo de bya brgya'i khrod kyi khyung chen ltar rtse mo sprin rum du zug ste 'gying nger gnas pa mjal byung bas dbang chen gom pa'i 'degs 'jog gi mtshams chad de byis par yun ring bral ba'i pha ma 'phrad pa ltar mig zhag 'khor/ khos zhwa mo phud de lag tu bzung nas dad pa'i spu long dbang med du g.yo bzhin gsol ba smon lam yang yang btab/lo gnyis tsam ring rang yul gyi rgyab ri kha 'dzin can/ srung ma myur mgyogs can de mjal ba'i go skabs ma byung bas de ring thengs dang po mjal skabs dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo ni sngar las mtho ba dang / brjid chags pa/gangs dkar gyi cod pan de'ang sngar las dkar ba dang / mdangs che ba'i 'khrul snang shar bas gza' nad phog pa'i nad pa ji bzhin re zhig 'dren byed 259

g.yo med kyis der bltas te 'gul med krong nger langs nas bsdad/de'i phyi nyin nyi ma ma nub bar rtswa chu gang bzang gi sar ngal gso bzhin dal gyis song ste mthar nyi ma nub rir bzhud cing sa yang ma rub tsam gyi dus rdza rong zhig tu slebs te der bsdad/ der rta sga blangs rjes sha rjen kha shas bzas rjes rta sga la bsnyes te gan rkyal du ngal gsos/nyin mang po mtshan 'grul nyin 'grul byas nas yong ba'i dka' sdug dang / rang yul du dngos su slebs pa'i blo bde bag phebs kyis bsam rgyu dran rgyu med par gnyid du yur/phyi nyin dbang chen gnyid las sad dus nyi ma shar nas yud tsam phyin pa ma zad ru sde'i phyugs rigs dkar nag yongs zas su bkram nas 'dugakhos ga ler rdza rong de'i kha las don te rgyang blta byed dus gnas de dang bar thag mi 'gyang ba'i spang ljongs kyi ldebs shig na phyugs rdzi byis pa zhig gis rang nyid kyi gzugs tshad las ring ba'i bo'u ru ring zhig khur/ bya rgod kyi deng rus las bzos pa'i gling bu snyan zhing 'jebs pa zhig btang byung /byis pa de'i spro snang dang / spang ljongs ldebs kyi bag phebs pa'i lug khyu'i nyams dga' ba'i mdzes ljongs la cung zad myong rol byas pa na/ byis pa des btang ba'i gling bu'i sgra ni ji ltar btang ba de ltar gyis skad che ba dang /gdangs snyan pa/ 'gyur khug ngo mtshar ba 'dug snyan dbang gso ba'i gling bu'i sgra gdangs der 'gran zla bral ba'i 'then shugs shig yod pa ltar kho'i sems pa las rkang pa dbang che bar gyur te rkang pa'i 'degs 'jog gling bu 'bud mkhan phyugs rdzi byis pa'i de'i phyogs su bsgyur/nye sar slebs dus byis pa des kho mthong nas gling bu 'bud mtshams bzhag ste mgrin pa kyog kyog gis kho la bltas nas bsdad 'dugakhobyis pa de'i gam du song nas ‘‘ya/ bu/ gling bu snyan po de 'dra 260

'bud shes kyang da lta 'bud mtshams bzhag nas ci byed ri’ces dris/byis pa des lag zung gis gling bu de phyis bdar byed pa las gang yang ma bshad par bag tsha ba'i zol gyis mgo bo smad de bsdad/dbang chen gyis byis pa de'i lag nang gi gling bu tshur blangs te myong rol byed kyin du ‘‘deng rus 'di gang nas sgrug pa yin ’’zhes dris/byis pa des ‘‘pha gi nas sgrug pa yin mi’ces g.yang phyug gi phyogs su mdzub mo gtad/skabs der khos g.yang phyug gi phyogs su rgyang blta byed dus 'gyang thag ring bas g.yang phyug gi phyi'i 'jig rten gyi bkod pa gsal por mthong yang nang bcud kyi bkod pa rab rib dang mag mog las mi mthong yang sems nang du sdug bsngal drag pos mnar te sngar g.yang phyug ces bya ba gzhanatshosmon rang skyid kyi yul de da lta skyo ba skye 'os pa'i mtsher rnying 'ga' las ci yang med ang snyam nas kho'i yid rba klong 'khrug 'khrug gis rang dbang med par dbugs ring shor te 'das don skyi g.ya' ba zhig yid la shar/dbang chen pha bu gnyis kyi khog nang du sems sdug dang / zhe 'khon gyi me lce drag tu 'bar bzhin dogs zon gyis phyogs bzhir rgyang mig gcod kyin myur stabs kyis phyir sde ba'i nang du log pa na/ sngar rang gi lte khrag bor sa skyid pa'i g.yang phyug ni/ da lta dmyal ba'i yul dang 'dra bar khams gsum skyo ba skye zhing 'chi bdag gshin rje yin yang re zhig snying rje skye 'os pa ste/ sbra kha shas kyi chon thag tshang ma gri bcad btang ste sa ru 'gyel ba dang / sbra la la'i chon thag kha shas bcad cing kha shas ma bcad par stod langs smad 'gyel khararlung lhags kyis lhab lhub tu g.yo/ sbra re re'i khug ltag tu mthon por bsgreng ba'i dar mdung yang gang sar 'gyel te dar lcog lhab lhub tu g.yo ba'i gson shugs dang rbad de bral/ gang sar 'khyil ba'i zungs khrag gi khrod du 261

'gyel ba'i bem ros khengs shing / khyi de dag kyang sngar byung myong med pa'i sems sdug drag pos mnar te/ rnga ma sgyid khug tu dpyang nas stod langs smad 'gyel gyi sbra gog dang / gang sar 'gyel ba'i bem ro'i khrod du 'gro 'ong byed pa dang / bem ro za rgyur rngam pa'i pho rog de dag 'ded kyin rang gi bdag po phyi ma'i lam du gshegs zin yang da dung srung nas 'dug skabs re sa ru tsog nas kha gnam la gtad de skyi g.ya' ba'i ngu skad dang zug skad res mos rgyag gi 'dugadabang chen gyis lag g.yas su sked gri bzung ste rang khyim gyi phyogs su song ba na/ rang khyim gyi sbra nag ling bzhi'i chon thag tshang ma gri bcad btang nas thang la 'gyel ba'i 'khris su rngon khyi gsum po la la sbar mo gnyis mdun du bzhag pa'i steng du sdug bsngal gyi mgo bo smad de nyal ba dang / la la kha gnam la gtad de ngu zug byed kyin 'duganam mkha' stong pa'ang mi yul g.yang phyug gi ya nga ba'i god chags chen po der skyo gdung drag po skyed pa bzhin sprin tshogs 'khrigs nas rta bdun dbang po'i zhal khyim logs su sbas nas 'dugagayang phyug gi mkha' dbyings su rgod thang dkar mi nyung ba zhig gis lding skor rgyag gi 'dugadabang chen gyi sdug bsngal dang / khong khro'i 'bar mdel de rang dbang med par 'bar gas byung ste/ ‘‘e ma/ lha dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo/khyed kyi spyan long song ba red dam/ nga la skyabs dang dpung rogs med pa 'di ci/ gtsan rgod kha sho kho'i snying dmar po 'don ma thub na nga'i ming nas ma 'bod/ chung ma brang 'og nas 'phrog mkhan 'chi bdag bdud po las med bsam yang / kho btsan rgod kha sho red/ ki hi hi ’’zhes phyogs bzhi'i ri klung brag ca 'khor zhing nam mkha' stong pa yang dbral ba lta bu'i ngar skad 262

bsgrags/ sked gri sa ru btsugs/ khu tshur gyis brang dang / mdun gyi sa la brdung /dgra 'dul gyis bem ro mthong ba thengs dang po yin pas 'jigs skrag dang / a ma dgra lag tu shor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis ngo gdong mchi mas brlan pa dang skad chung ngus ngu bzhin 'dugade nas dbang chen gyis sked gri shubs su bcug ngo gdong gi mchi ma gtsang mar phyis te rngam pa ring po zhig 'then nas ‘‘bu/ nga rang gnyis re zhig bros na ma gtogs srog thar gyi ma red ri’zer bzhin sgye mo gnyis kyi nang du rtsam pa dang / sha ja/ rdzas mdel sogs blugs/de'i skabs rdza 'phrang gi 'dabs nas ‘‘ki hi hi mi’zhes skya mi bcu grangs shig gis dgra ki rgyag gin thal rdul dgung la 'phyur nas rgyug byung bas dbang chen gyis ‘‘bros’mizhes phyir bshol byed zhor du me mda'i mchu de phyogs su gtad de brgyab pa na/ thal rdul gyi khrod du gang yang ma mthong mod skya mi de dag re zhig rgyug mtshams chad/de 'phral kho gnyis myur stabs kyis bros/ dbang chen gyis bros pa'i zhar du bde lcag 'khyug po'i sgo nas me mdar rdzas mdel blugs/ rngon khyi gsum gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis rjes su 'brang / khyim mtshes tshang gi rngon khyi gnyis kyang rjes su 'brang nas rgyug byung /de'i tshe/ nam mkha'i sprin nag je mthug je mthug tu gyur nas ja phor pa gang 'thung ba'i dus yun tsam ma 'gor bar kha ba lhab lhub tu babs/ kha ba 'bab shugs je cher je cher gyur nas da lta gangs khrod du bzhag ma thag pa'ikang rjes da lta rang gangs gsog gis bsnub ste mthong rgyu med par gyur/bu yug gi khrod du phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gom pa bcu grangs las mthong mi thub/263

‘‘ki hi hi/ ki hi hi ’’zhes rjes 'ded pa'i skad sgra bar med du thos kyi 'dugadabang chen gyis gling bu byis pa de'i lag tu bzhag nas ‘‘gling bu yag po zhig 'dug 'di sus bzos pa red ’’ces dris/byis pa des ‘‘'di nga'i a phas bzos te nga la bster ba red ’’zer/‘‘khyod kyi a pha'i ming la ci zer/’’‘‘nga'i a pha'i ming la dga' blo zer/mi’dbang chen gyis rgyu mtshan yongs shes te ga ler byis pa de'i rgyab tu khur ba'i me mda' de'i gsham shing la bltas pa na gsham shing chag pa'i shul de sngar ltar gsal po 'dug pas ‘‘bu/ khyod kyi me mda' nga la ston dang ’’zhes bshad/byis pa des me mda' mar phabs te kho'i lag tu bzhagakhos me mda'i gsham shing gi chag shul du mdzub mo btsugs te ‘‘me mda' yag po 'di yi gsham shing chag pa phangs pa la ang ’’zer/byis pa kha lce bde po des ‘‘de nga'i a phas kho rang gi shag po'i mgor gzhu skabs sa ru gzhus te chag pa red/ nga'i a pha'i rkang pa shag po des rbab rdo g.yug nas chag pa red ’’ces zhib cing phra ba bshad/dbang chen hang sang pa'i zol gyis ‘‘a tsi/ de 'dra'i shag po ga 'dra yin nam/ khyod kyis shag po dang dgra bo nor ba min nam ’’zhes dris/byis pa des sna rtse ru dpyang pa'i snabs phyis tsam byas nas ‘‘nor med/thog mar kho gnyis shag po ma red/ de rjes kho gnyis ngo shes te shag po byas pa red/ deng sang nga'i a phas rtag par shag po de sgug gin 'dug ’’ces bshad/dbang chen gyis ‘‘'o na shag po de gang du phyin pa red ri’ces dris/264

byis pa des ‘‘shag po de thag ring zhig tu bros pa red zer gyi 'dugami 'ga' shas kyis kho shi tshar ba red zer gyi 'dug ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘bu/ khyod kyi a phas rtag par sgug pa'i shag po de nga yin/ khyod kyis mi gzhan la ma shod ’’ces mngags/byis pa des kho'i mgo nas mjug bar lan 'ga' bltas nas ‘‘ya ya ’’zer/de nas kho gnyis kha gyes te rang rang gi gnas su song / lab rogs gleng rogs mdang skyes byis pa tsam med pa'i mi rkyang gcig lag las ka'ang med par nyi ma 'khyol thabs byed rgyu ni ha cang 'khyol dka' ba'i dus tshod cig red/ dbang chen slar rdza rong der slebs rjes zhog ja btung med kyang grod pa ltogs pa'i tshor snang mi 'dug la ga byed 'di byed kyang med pas gan rkyal du nyal te dgung sngon dbyings su blta dus sprin dkar gyi tshom bu thar thor 'ga' mkha' dbyings su 'phyo ba las sprin tshom zhig rim gyis mi'i bzo ltar 'gyur/ de nas cung tsam song rjes zhi mi'i bzo lta'am lug gi bzo ltar gyur/de nas rim gyis gangs ri'i bzo lta dang / khrung khrung gi bzo lta/ sbar mo'i bzo lta sogs bzo dbyibs rnam pa sna tshogs su gyur nas byang nas lho ru skyod kyin 'dugade ring snga dro dga' blo'i phru gu de'i ngag las dga' blo zhes pa de yid bcol rung ba'i khrel yod mi gcig yin pa shes pas nyi ma 'di mgyogs tsam nub ri'i logs su yib ste mgyogs tsam dga' blo dang 'phrad nas g.yang mo'i bde 'tshams kyi gnas tshul go 'dod kyi blo skyed/de ltar 'khyol dka' ba'i ngang rdza sbug der bsdad de nyi ma nub rir bzhud min blta gin blta gin byas nas sgug da gzod nyi ma nub ri'i phag tu yib nas phyogs bzhi'i lhun po'i rtse mor nyi ma'i 'od lhag gi phyi mdangs 265

'phros te gser gyi khu ba'i nang nas blangs pa'i pir gyi rtse mo dang mtshungs shing / nub phyogs kyi gnam sa'i 'dres mtshams nas dgong mo'i mtshams sprin mkha' ru 'phyur ba ni 'jig rten na gnyis su ma mchis pa'i snum tshon ri mo zhig dang 'dra/de nas dmar ser mdangs 'dzin gyi dgong mo'i mtshams sprin rim gyis yal te smag rum gyi yol nag gis 'jig rten mi yul mun pa'i btson rar bcug khung byi'u khung du 'dzul/ thang byi'u thang du nyal/ 'khor yug yongs dben zhing lhing 'jags par gyur/de'i skabs ri sked mtshams nas me lcags brdab pa'i me yi zegs ma dmar 'phyur 'phyur byed pa mthong byung bas dbang chen gyis kyang lam seng rang gi glo ru btags pa'i me lcags las me rdo mchin pa'i dbyibs dang 'dra ba gcig blangs te me lcags brdab ste brda bstan/ phan tshun gnyis kas me lcags brdab ste brda ston byed kyin rim gyis nye bar bcar nas dga' blo'i rkang pa gyol bzhin du ‘‘shag po dbang chen rimizhes khyu las bral ba'i lug chung zhig rang rigs kyi khyu dang 'phrad pa ltar tshur rgyug byung /dbang chen yang sems nang dga' spro dpag med skyed de ‘‘shag po dga' blo ’mizhes ming las bos te rgyug nas phan tshun dam por 'khyud/ de nas kho gnyis rdza rong du mar babs te me btang / chu zangs nang du dga' blos da dung ja sbar mo gang blugs/ ja ma khol gong yun ring ja dang kha bral ba'i dbang chen gyi sna lam du ja dri zhim po zhig 'thul bas khos lam seng da lta chu'i kha ru lding ba'i ja yi lo ma lhob tsam zhig yar blangs te kha ru bcug nas ldad pa tsam gyis ja yi skom gdung sel ba lta bu'i tshor snang zhig byung / dga' blos da dung mar zan dang / sha btsos pa bton te dbang chen la bster/skabs der dbang chen gyis dga' blo'i lag pa las bzung ste cung zad 266

nyam thag pa'i mig mdangs phyung nas ‘‘g.yang mo da lta bdetshomo red dam ’’zhes dris/dga' blos ‘‘bde mo red/ na na tsha tsha gang yang mi 'dug 'on kyang mo rang khyed pha bu gnyis dang ma shi gson bral byed dgos byung bas sems sdug chen po byed kyi 'dug ngas thengs mang po mo rang gcig pu'i sar song nas dbang chen dang nged gnyis mdzub mo dmar 'gug gi shag po yin lugs dang /ring min khyod btsan rgod kha sho'i lag 'og nas thar thub nges red ces sems gso byas kyang mos yid ches de tsam/ mi byed ’’zer/de nas dga' blos sna tha sen mo gang po de gtsang mar 'then nas ‘‘shag po dbang chen/ ngas byas na da res khyod kyis g.yang mo dang thug 'phrad byed rgyu phar zhog khyod phyir slebs pa'i gnas tshul ma shes pa byas na bzang gi red ’’zer/ dbang chen gyis ‘‘thog mar ngas kyang mo dang thug 'phrad bya rtsis med mod da lta bsam blo gtong dus thug 'dod pas sa thag ring po de nas yong ste da res ngas mo dang thug 'phrad ma byas na a yong ’’zer/dga' blos ‘‘ngas byas na shag po rang gis bya ma 'drogs par sgo nga len thabasakhyed rgyu gal chen po red/ spyir khyod kyis btsan rgod kyi dgra sha len rtsis yod na da res mo dang thug 'phrad ma byas na yag gi red/ gal srid g.yang mo skyobs rgyu kho na yin na las sla po red/ go thos la sang nyin btsan rgod phyogs su thon mkhan red zer gyi 'dug pas kho phyin rjes mtshan mo g.yang mo khrid de bros na las sla po red/ de min pa btsan rgod kyi dgra sha len rgyu yin na 'jig rten kha dper nyin mo 'gro 'gro ma mang ri mgo thams cad mig yin/ mtshan mo lab lab ma mang sbra 'dabs thams cad am lcog yin zer gyi yod pas da res shag po rang gis bsam blo yag po zhig gtong dgos ’’zhes 267

bshad/dbang chen gyis mno bsam zhib par btang rjes bya ma 'drogs par sgo nga len thub pa byed rgyu de shin tu gal che bsam nas ‘‘da res ngas mo khrid rgyu min/ ngas btsan rgod kha sho'i mgo lag ma blangs na nga pho gral du sdod rin med ri’zer/dga' blos ‘‘byas na 'grig song / a che g.yang mos khyod pha bu gnyis dran drags pas da res khyod dang thug na mnyam du 'gro rgyu las 'byung 'gyur gyi bsam blo rgya chen po gtong thub kyi ma red/ der brten khyod slebs pa'i gnas tshul tsam yang mos ma shes pa byed dgos ’’zer/dbang chen gyis dga' blo'i skad cha'i go don legs par rtogs nas da res g.yang mo dang thug 'phrad mi byed rgyu dang / rdza rong 'dir yang sdod yun ring mi rung bsam nas ‘‘shag pos bshad pa shin tu bden/ nga yang sang nyin phyir 'gro rgyu yin/ ngas dngos su dgra sha len pa'i dus la slebs dus kyang sngon la shag po khyod kyi sar gsang stabs kyis yong nas 'char 'god bzos te dgra btsan rgod kyi mgo lag len rgyu yin ’’zer/nyin gnyis pa'i skya rengs ma shar tsam nas gnas de las bral te slar byang du bskyod do/rang re'i gtam rgyud 'di'i mi sna gtso bo dbang chen da res rang yul du thengs gcig phyin te rang gis nyin mtshan dbyer med du gsol ba 'debs yul rgyab ri kha 'dzin can lha dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo mjal ba'i go skabs shar ba dang / mna' bzhag gi shag po dga' blo rgyud de tshe gang gi gtan grogs g.yang mo bde gnas yin pa'i gnas tshul shes te phyir log pa'i lam du yid mug dang skyo shas kyi tshor snang gang yang ma byung /dbang chen gyi me mda'i ru dar dang rta yi rnga ma 'jam rlung bsil bus 268

skyod kyin lho yi ri rtse nas don skabs rta las babs te rang sar langs nas blta dus sde dpon tshang dang / nyi shar tshang / don grub tshang / rang khyim bcas re ba'i sbra nag phub pa'i 'brog sde chung chung de mthong bas sems nang du smra mi shes pa'i skyo snang zhig shar ba ste kho'i sems su sngar yul g.yang phyug la gzhan na ma mchis pa'i me yi 'phrul 'khor mang po de lta bu yod pa ma zad dud khyim yang de tsam gyi nyung nyung min yang smag rum mun nag gi mtshan skor zhig gis me btang shul gyi thal ba'ang med par bzos/ a tsi/ skyid mi rtag rtswa 'go'i zil pa 'dra/ da lta yod bzhin da lta med zer ba cis mi bden snyams/khos gom gang mdun du spos te slar yang brag rdo mi gzugs 'dra ba zhig gi 'gram du rang sar langs nas sems nang sngar gyi g.yang phyug dang deng gi rong pa sde gsar gnyis bar mi rta dang / mtshon cha gang thad nas bsdur yang gnam sa'i he bag 'dug mod/ g.yang phyug da lta gtam rgyud tsam du gyur bas gal srid rong pa sde gsar zhes pa 'dir dgra jag gnyis gsum zhig slebs kyang kha gtad gcog rgyu dka' mo red/ mtshon cha drag shos nga'i rgyab kyi bo'u 'di las med/ sde dpon gyis da dung dgra sha len rgyu yin zer/ 'o/ya med spun gsum da lta gnya' chag 'dug nga'i me mda'i mchu yang kho'i lce dron mos ldag myong / me mda'i mchu ldogs zhes bshad pa de las brnyas bcos tsha ba ga la yod snyams te/ ‘‘hwa hwa hwa hwa ’’zhes rang dbang med par gad mo shor/de nas rta kha khrid de thur du babs/ dud khyim de dag gi sgo 'gram du mi thar thor langs nas 'dug kho'i sems la de dag gi khrod du nga'i bu dgra 'dul yod nges red/ dgra 'dul gyis kho rang gi a ma'i skor skad cha 'dri rgyu gtan 'khel yin pas ngas da res mo dang thug 'phrad byas med zer na dgra 'dul gyi yid du 'gro a yong / thug 'phrad byas pa yin zer na ga 'dra shod 269

bsam blo sna tshogs gtong bzhin song bas 'phral mar lung pa'i mthil du slebs pas/ da gzod gzhis pa rnams kyis ngo ma dbang chen yin pa shes te dgra 'dul dang / nyi shar/ don grub gsum kho bsu bar rgyug byung /kho tsho re re bzhin phan tshun 'gram pa sbyar te khams 'dri byas/‘‘dka' e byung /’’‘‘dka' ma thal’’‘‘khyod tsho sdod skyid che/’’‘‘che thal/ dka' e byung / ’twetwedaka' ༈ byung /’’dgra 'dul gyi mgrin pa cung brnangs bzhin a phar bltas te ‘‘a pha a a ma bde mo red dam mi’zhes dris byung /dbang chen gyi sems su da res thug 'phrad byed ma myong zhes bshad na dgra 'dul sems khral chen po byed nges red/ der brten nyes pa med pa'i rdzun zhig ma bshad na yong thabs mi 'dug snyams nas ‘‘bde mo red/ nga tsho sems khral byed dgos mi 'dug ’’zer/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘a pha khyod la a ma thug byung ngam mi’zhes cung zad yid ma ches pa'i sgo nas dris/dbang chen gyis sngar mus ltar rnam 'gyur sgam po'i sgo nas ‘‘thug byung /'on kyang btsan rgod kha shos ma shes par gsang stabs kyis thug 'phrad byed dgos pas skad cha mang po shod khom ma byung / khyod kyi a mas lham bzhi khra yag po zhig khyod la skur rtsis byed kyi 'dug 'on kyang de btsan rgod kha shos shes par dogs nas ngas ma khyer ba yin/ khyod la bkra shis g.yang chags zhes pa'i bu mo yag po zhig mna' mar bsus yod pa'i skor dang / ngas nga 270

tsho pha bu dang / mna' ma bcas pa mgyogs po mnyam 'dzoms byed thub rgyu yin pa'i skor sogs bshad pas a ma dga' tshor chen po byed kyi 'dug ’’ces bshad/nyi shar dang / don grub gnyis kyis da res thog mar 'phrad skabs khams 'dri byed pa'i skad cha tshig re gnyis bshad pa las da bar skad cha tshig gcig kyang med pa ma zad ngo gdong las kyang rgyun ldan dang mi 'dra ba'i rnam 'gyur ya mtshan po zhig kyang 'dug pas dbang chen gyis ‘‘khyod tsho tshang ma bde mo yin nam ’’zhes kha nyi shar la gtad de de ltar dris/nyi shar de mar stong 'dang gi rgya las grol ba ltar ‘‘a a nga tsho tshang ma bde mo yin/ hwa hwa ’’zhes dgod 'dzum bcos ma zhig ston nas de ltar bshad pas dbang chen gyi sems su dogs pa sngar bas che ba skyed de ‘‘shag po gtam drang po shod dang / khyod kyi skad cha shod stangs la bltas na gzhis pa rnams la rkyen ngan zhig 'phrad pa 'dra/ don dag gang yin yang rba gsang byas pas don gang yang mi 'grub/ don rkyen ci byung song / drang po shod dang ’’zhes 'gro mtshams kyang bzhag nas nan 'dri byas/de'i dus sde dpon yang dbang chen bsu bar yong nas ‘‘dka' e byung ’’zhes 'gram pa sbyar/sde dpon gyis kyang dbang chen la khams 'dri byas rjes kha nas skad cha gang yang mi shod par rtsa che'i ca dngos gang zhig gtor brlag btang pa'i byis pas rang gi pha ma la skrag pa ltar mgo bo cung zad smad de bsdad/mi 'di dag gi rnam 'gyur la bltas na don rkyen zhig byung ba kho thag red/kha sngon nga rang phar 'gro skabs 'brug dar la brnyas bcos kyis me mda'i mchu ldag tu bcug pas de rjes khos don rkyen zhig bslangs pa min nam/ o de yin mi srid/ khos nga ngo mi shes pas don rkyen slong don med/ 271

de ltar bsam blo gtong bzhin rang khyim gyi sgo ru 'byor/ rta sga blangs te nang du 'dzul/ sde dpon yang kho dang mnyam du nang du 'dzul byung / kho tshang gi cha rkyen shin tu zhan pas dbang chen gyis be'u yi ko ba'i gdan gcig yod pa de sde dpon gyi rkub 'og tu bting / sde dpon gyis ‘‘nga'i nang nas ja yag pa khog ltir gang khyer shog ’mices dgra 'dul mngags/ cung tsam phyin rjes dgra 'dul gyis ja srub ma rdza yi khog lter gang khyer 'dug pas sde dpon kho rang sku ngo mas dbang chen la ja blugs nas ‘‘thungs dang / da res khyod log yong pa mthong bas ched mngags bzos pa yin/ zhim po zhig yod/thungs dang / thungs dang ’’zer/‘‘zhim po 'dug mi’ces ja phor pa gang btung rjes ‘‘khyod tsho'i rnam 'gyur la bltas na bkra ma shis pa'i don rkyen zhig byung ba 'dra/ yang snying gang byas song ’’zhes dris/‘‘brel ba ma byed/ sngon la lto yag po zo dang / sa thag ring po gcod mkhan kha skom yod kyi red ’’ces sde dpon gyis thab 'gram gyi khog lter snum zhag tshir tshir de yar blangs nas dbang chen la ja gang blugs/sde dpon gyis da res ched mngags nga la ja zhim po'ang khog lter gang bzos/ des kyang mi tshad kho rang sku ngo mas nga mi phal par ja blugs stangs la bltas na don rkyen zhig byung yod thag chod red/ de snga ngas don dag khab rtse trem gyi rtsod gleng med pa'i ya med spun gsum gyi srog gcod sdig khur byed rgyu khas blangs pas mi tshad da res yang nga la ci zhig byos zer rtsis yod dam/a tsi/ min zer na dpon gyi bka' dang 'gal 'gro/ khas blangs na rang srog rta rnga las phra yang phangs sems med pa ga la yin/ lhag par du ya med spunagasum lta bu zhig tshar gcod gtong dgos na don med kyi sdig pa gcig thog gnyis brtsegs red/ khyad mtshar/ yang snying don rkyen gang zhig byung 272

ba yin snyam/dbang chen za 'thung grub rjes goms gshis chags pa ltar mchu to dang sna gtsang mar phyis rjes lag pa rum du brkyang ste sna ru blangs nas rkang 'gor lan gsum brdab rjes lag g.yon ma'i mthe bong gi sen mo'i steng du sna tha cung zad cig blugs rjes lag g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang ldag mdzub kyis sna tha cung zad cig bzung ste sna khung g.yas pa'i sgor sbyar nas sdod pa dang da dung yar mi 'then par sngar bzhin mno bsam gtong bzhin kho rang gi mdun du bsdad pa'i sde dpon la bltas nas bsdad/sde dpon gyis dbang chen la ja phor pa gang blugs rjes cung zad dogs mi bde ba'i sgo nas ‘‘kha nub jag pa skor zhig gis nga tsho'i nor khyu yongs ded song ’’zhes bshad de rang nyid sde dpon yin khul byas kyang bya ba tshang ma gzhan la skyabs bcol dgos pa'i gnong 'gyod kyis mgo bo thur du smad/dbang chen rbad de hang sang nas ‘‘nor tshang ma ded song ba red dam ’’zhes dris/sde dpon nor 'khrul shor ba'i byis pa zhig ltar skad dma' pos ‘‘red ’rizer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘sir mi zhes da res sna khung gi 'gram du sbyar ba'i sna tha yar 'then nas ‘‘jag pa ga tshod 'dug ’’ces dris/‘‘jag pa bzhi 'dug’’‘‘de tshor lag cha gang 'dug’’‘‘me mda' 'di 'dra bzhi 'dug ri’ces sde dpon gyis dbang chen gyi bo'u khra ring la lag pas reg tsam byas/‘‘rta 'dug gam/’mi‘‘'dug rta bzhi 'dug’’273

da lta dbang chen dang btsan lha gnyis go gnas 'pho 'gyur byung ste dbang chen sde dpon dang btsan lha mi ser la gyur ba ltar dbang chen gyis mu mthud dris par ‘‘ga 'dra byas nas slebs byung / ga 'dra byas nas ded song ’’zhes dris/spre‘‘ga 'dra byas nas slebs pa gsal po mi shes ’’sde dpon btsan lha smra lce dab dib tu gyur nas ‘‘tog tsam sgug ang ’’zhes dbang chen tshang las don te kho rang gi nang du bud song /dbang chen gyis ‘‘ga 'dra byas nas ded song ’’zhes bu dgra 'dul la dris/‘‘de dgong tog tsam ma gtogs dpe bsags song ’’zhes dgra 'dul gyis dbang chen la bshad par/de nyin nam mkha' yangs por sprin byi'u yi gshog rgya tsam med par dwangs shing g.ya' dag pa dang rgyu skar gyi gur khang rnam par bkra/ zla ba shar ri'i rtse nas 'phags te mthor bstegs/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i rtswa thang 'bri mo'i 'o ma bshos pa ltar gang sar skya thing thing du gyur/ phyogs bzhi dben zhing lhing 'jags zhi 'jam du gnas/ nyi shar tshang yang thag ring gi 'brog sde gzhan dang 'dra bar snum bzhu ril ma tsam med par thab nang gi me 'od la brten nas dgong thug btung rjes 'o ma skyid kyis phru gu gnyis la 'o ma yid tshims par bster rjes slog pa'i nang du bsnyal/ nyi shar thab kyi byang 'gram du bsdad de me 'od la brten nas slog pa rnying song zhig la lhan pa rgyag bzhin 'duga'o ma skyid gnyid lcog rgyag bzhin thab kyi lho 'gram du bsdad nas ‘‘da nyal lo/ sang nyin lhan pa rgyob ’’zer/nyi shar gyis me 'od la brten nas bal skud dkar po zhig khab kyi mig khung du rgyu bzhin ‘‘um/ tog tsam sgug dang / lhan pa brgyab tshar grabs 274

yod/ de min na khyod rang sngon la nyol dang ’’zer/‘‘'o na nga nyal gyi yin/ a ’’zhes a stong zhig brgyab pa dang dus mnyam bya rmyang zhig byas te sgor don nas gcin pa gtong bar phyin/mo rang sgor don dus lhags rlung grang bsil bsil zhig rgyag gi 'dug pas rig pa dwangs par gyur te phar blta tshur blta byed dus dbang chen tshang dang mi 'gyang ba'i sa na mi bzhi mthong / de dang dus mnyam dbang chen tshang gi sha khyi dang sde dpon tshang dang don grub tshang gi 'dogs khyi tshang ma de phyogs su shor/ mo gcin pa gtong mtshams bcad de nang du rgyug nas ‘‘nyi nyi shar/ jag jag pa slebs 'dug ’’zer/dgra jag dang spyang kis gnod pa med kyang 'brog sde'i khyi mtshan mo skabs 'gar mi sems su bzod dka' ba'i zug skad rgyag gi yod pa de gdon 'dre 'gog gi yod pa'i rtags red ces shod srol yod pas nyi shar gyis der do snang spu tsam med par sngar bzhin slog par lhan pa rgyag bzhin ‘‘a/ jag pa slebs 'dug zer ram/ rnam rtog ma slong / da nyol/ ngas lhan pa brgyab tshar grabs yod ’’zer/‘‘a tsi/ khyod khyod rang da dung bstan bshig slong rgyu dran nam/ khyod rang mar mar don nas ltos dang ’’ zhes sngar bzhin dbugs hal hal gyis rkang pa gcig sgo them gyi nang dang / gcig sgo them gyi phyi byas te langs nas 'dug pas mo'i skad cha'i gdangs dang / lus kyi stangs stabs la bltas na phal cher rtsed mo bshad pa mi 'dra bas ‘‘ngo ma red dam ’’zhes nyi shar gdan las hob langs kyis sgor don/ kho sgo nas don skabs brel 'tshab ha cang che bas 'o ma skyid la 'bud rgyag thebs nas tog tsam ma gtogs ltag dgye log‘‘a ma ma ’’zhes 'o ma skyid lag pa g.yas pa sa ru btsugs pas ma 'gyel 275

tsam du yar langs thub pa byung nas ‘‘ltos dang rimizhes de phyogs su mdzub mo btsugs/de mar nyi shar sde dpon tshang gi phyogs su rgyug nas ‘‘jag pa slebs 'dug jag pa slebs 'dug ’mices skad brgyab/'o ma skyid kyis lcags slang mthil rdol zhig brdung bzhin ‘‘jag pa slebs 'dug jag pa slebs 'dug ’’ces skad brgyab pas da lta gnyid khug ma thag pa'ibyis pa gnyis gnyid las sad de byis pa'i sgra gdangs gnyis ldan gyi ngu skad gang sar grags pa la lcags slang brdung ba'i sgras ram 'degs byas/‘‘twa ’’zhes me mda'i skad grags pa dang ‘‘si ’’zhes mde'u mo rang gi mgo'i steng nas rgyug pas zhed thag chod nas de mar nang du bros/jag pa slebs song zhes pa'i skad dang lcags slang brdung ba'i sgra grags pas da lta rum gcig gi nang du nyal ma thag pa'i dgra 'dul dang bkra shis g.yang chags gnyis slog pa lheb gyon gyis sgor don/ don grub tshang dang /sde dpon tshang gi mi rnams kyang brel zing 'tshub 'tshub kyis sgor don byung /‘‘twa/ twa/ twa ’’zhes me mda' brgyab nas khyi gsum bsad pas khyi byings rnams dpa' zhum nas phar tsam bros te rgyang nas zug pa las nye bar bcar ma nus/nyi shar gyis nus shugs gang yod bton te sde dpon tshang gi phyogs su rgyug pa'i skabs ‘‘twa ’’zhes me mda' gcig gi mde'u kho'i klad nas 'phur te tog tsam ma gtogs klad zho sa ru 'thor/— ‘‘gang drag ci drag mi ngan 'di tshor me mda' yang 'dug a khu dbang chen ni bsdad med/ da gang drag ci drag ’’ces tshang ma skad cor long long gis sde dpon tshang gi sgo 'gram du 'dzoms/da lta khyi gsum bsad pa dang gzhan rnams nye bar bcar ma nus pas 276

jag pa de tsho mngon sum 'dzems med kyis gsum gyis rta khrid cing me mda' kho tsho'i phyogs su gtad de ‘‘sdug tshod ma zin na gsod rgyu yin/ ngo ma gsod rgyu yin/ sdug lcog gis go e byung ’’zhes skad rgyag bzhin phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed pa dang / gcig shos kyis nor gdang tshang ma gris bcad de me sgron zin pa'i sbi sdi klad la bskor bzhin nor ded/sde dpon gyis ‘‘a khu dbang chen ni bsdad med/ bltas bltas rig rig la rang rgyu gzhan gyis 'phrog pa de ring ma gtogs mthong ma myong / kho tsho gzhan rgyu'i don du shi nus na nga rang rgyu'i don du shi mi nus pa ci yod ’’ces gri ring klad la 'phyar nas lag tu me mda' thogs pa'i jag pa de dag gi phyogs su shor/nyi shar dang bcas pas ‘‘kho tshor me mda' yod pas de ltar byed mi rung /nga tsho tshang ma shi rgyu red ’’ces bkag kyang sde dpon la the tshom mi 'dug pas gzhan noms kyang de rjes mi 'brang mthu med red/ jag pa de dag gis me sgron pa'i sbi sdi snga sa nas me mda'i skam pa'i steng du btsugs nas yod pas ‘‘twa ri’zhes me mda' brgyab byung bas sde dpon gyi zhwa mo shog bu rlung gis khyer ba ltar rgyab logs su 'phangs stabs sde dpon gom mtshams bzhag nas ‘‘pha ro za rgyu de'i me mda' tsha ba la ’’zer bzhin zhwa mo yar sgrug nas brdab tsam byas nas mgor gyon/nyi shar gyis ‘‘ngo ma red/ da res nga'i mgo yang i khung 'big grabs byas byung / ltas ngan de tsho mtshan mo yang me mda' gzes po 'dug pas nga tshos thabs shes 'dra bton na ma gtogs tshang ma kho tsho'i mtshon 'og tu shi rgyu red ’’zer/da gzod jag pa de dag gis sbi sdi'i me dmar 'tshub 'tshub kyis bskor bzhin nor khyu lho phyogs su ded nas song / jag pa gcig gis ‘‘rang srog rta 277

rnga phra mo la phangs sems med na shog dang ririzhes skad rgyag bzhin ‘‘twa ’’zhes yang me mda' zhig brgyab byung bas don grub tshang gi 'dogs khyi dom nag ces pa che chung ya ru tsam zhig yod pa der phog ste ‘‘a 'ung ’’zhes skad ngan dang chabs cig gnam du mchongs ba dang slar sa ru lhung nas shi/ khyi yi ming du nor srung zhes pa de 'brog khul du ming don mtshungs pa zhig yin pas khyi rtser son 'ga' shas nyo tshong byed par g.yag re'i rin gong dgos pa dang 'dogs khyi bsad pa ni shin tu mi 'os pa'i brnyas bcos yin yang dza drag gi dus der rkyen lam du song ba'i khyi de dag la do snang byed mkhan med par tshang ma ‘‘da ci drag gang drag ’’ces shod kyin bsdad/‘‘hung / do dgong sprang gnam 'di la sprin sbar mo tsam yang med pa ci red ’’ces sde dpon btsan lha khong khro ma bzod par khu tshur sa la brdab ste gnam la dmod/de nas tshang ma gros byas nas sde dpon tshang gi g.yog po gnyis dang dgra 'dul don grub bcas mi bzhi gsang stabs kyis jag pa de dag phyogs gang du 'gro min shes pa byed rgyu dang / rab byung na sde tsho gang nas yin rtsad gcod thub pa byed dgos zer/ de nas tshang ma rang gnas su log ste rgyags phye stabs bde khur nas dogs zon chen po'i sgo nas jag pas ded pa'i nor khyu'i rjes ded de myul dpyad byed par bskyod/jag pa de tshos thog mar lho phyogs su bskyod pa dang nyin gnyis par nub phyogs su bskyod/ kho tshos jag pas ma shes pa byas te rjes 'ded btang /nyin gnyis pa'i phyi dro spang ljongs shig gi steng du mu tig thang du bkram pa dang gnyis su med pa'i lug khyu zhig 'dug pa de'i rdzi bo bud med lo bzhi bcu'i g.yas g.yon byas pa zhig 'dug pa de'i sar skad cha dris pa na bud med des ‘‘o/ jag pa bzhi po de rgyun par nged tsho'i nang gi nub kyi ri pha gi'i logs 278

su sdod kyi yod/ rgyun par dgun kha shar ba dang byang du phyin nas ri dwags kho na rngon nas sdod pa las gzhan rgyu 'phrog bcom byed kyi med/ na ning nas bzung g.yas g.yon sde tsho 'ga' las nor lug 'phrog bcom byed rgyu goms 'dug go thos la kho tsho rdzas mdel rdzogs te ri dwags rngon dka' bas 'phrog bcom mi byed ka med byung ba red zer gyi 'dug’ridon grub kyis ‘‘khyod tsho'i nor lug 'phrog bcom byas ma byung ngam ’’zer/‘‘nga tsho'i nor lug 'phrog bcom byed ma myong / 'jig rten kha dper spyang tshang 'gram gyi lug khyu skyid zer ba cis mi bden/ nga tsho'i nor lug la spu rkang gcig gi gnod pa skyel ma myong ’’zer/ ‘‘mi 'di dag khyod tsho'i sde tsho'i red dam/’’‘‘ma red/ sa phyogs gzhan nas yong ba sha stag red/ 'di'i rgyud du slebs nas lo bdun brgyad phyin song / de snga dgun dus su byang du phyin nas ri dwags kho na rgyag pa dang dbyar kha lho ru tshur yong nas skabs 'gar nga tsho'i ru sde'i nang yong nas 'brong sha dang gtsod sha khyer 'ong nas 'o ma dang zho nyo gi 'dug na ning nas bzung gzhan rgyu 'phrog bcom byed rgyu'i bsam ngan zhig goms 'dug’’‘‘'o na kho tsho sa cha 'dir gtan sdod byed mkhan red dam/’’‘‘na ning nas bzung gtan sdod red/ khyod tsho song nas ltos dang gtan gtan ri pha gi'i logs su bsdad yod/ lung pa de nas thad kar nub tu 'gro sa med par gangs ri'i ri rgyud kyis bkag yod pas shar lho byang gsum las thad kar nub phyogs su 'gro sa med ’’zer/rdzi bo bud med des bshad pa ltar kho tsho bzhi pos rkang 'jab lag 'jab kyis song nas ri rtse nas mar blta dus nub ngos gangs ri'i yol bas bskor ba'i lung pa skyid po zhig gi na thang gi dbus su sbra nag chung chung zhig phub nas 279

'dug pa de'i steng nas du ba sngo lhog lhog tu 'phyur gyin 'dug pas de ring bu rta gnyis kyis dka' ba spyad pa la 'bras bu byung bas 'bri skam shed bzang zhig bshas te skyid po gtong gi yod pa gtan 'khel red/nor khyu rtswa thang gi gang sar gram nas 'dug pa las rdzi bo gcig kyang mthongargyu mi 'dug ‘‘me mda' zhig yod na mi ngan de tsho da lta rang tshar gcod gtong rgyu las sla po red ’’ces dgra 'dul gyis khu tshur sa la brdab nas ‘‘a pha tshur log slebs yod na jag pa bzhi lta ci bzhi bcu yod kyang tshang ma sbra'i nang du bsdad yod stabs tshang ma cham la 'beb rgyu ni ja phor gang 'thung ba'i dus tshod las dgos kyi ma red ’’zer/de nas khong tshos dbang chen phal cher slebs ran yod pas sde dpon tshang gi g.yog po gnyis pos jag pa'i 'gro lugs sdod stangs thad so bltas te sdod rgyu dang / don grub dang / dgra 'dul gnyis myur stabs kyis phyir log nas gnas tshul shod rgyu/ gal srid dbang chen da dung nyin shas phyir ma slebs na zhag shas kyi rjes su g.yog po gnyis por gro skyel bar yong rgyu byas nas don grub dang / dgra 'dul gnyis kyi rgyab tu khur ba'i rgyags phye yongs g.yog po gnyis por bzhag nas ‘‘nges par du rang gis jag pa mthong ba zhig dang jag pas rang phyogs ma mthong ba byed dgos ’’zhes nan skul yang yang byas te don grub dang / dgra 'dul gnyis nyin mtshan ltos med kyis phyir log ste de ring snga dro sde ba'i nang du slebs pa red/de'i skabs sde dpon gyis ‘‘ltos dang nga'i klad skogs i khung phig song /hwa hwa ’’zhes zha mdel gyis i khung phig pa'i wa zhwa rnying song zhig khyer te nang du 'dzul byung /dbang chen gyis ‘‘wa zhwa de lag tu blangs nas ’’‘‘um/ mi ngan de tsho zhwa mor 'khon 'gras de 'dra yod don ci yin nam ’’zhes ku re rtsed/280

‘‘hwa/ hwa/ hwa/’’twetwehwa/ kyā/ hwa/’midabang chen gyis mno bsam gtong bzhin du ‘‘me mda' bzhi/ kho tshor me mda' bzhi/ nga tshor me mda' gcig nga tsho sang nyin thon na ci 'dra 'dug ’’ces sde dpon la dris/‘‘red/ khe pham ci byung yang snga tsam 'gro rgyu red/ri’ces bshad rjes der yod don grub dang nyi shar gnyis la ‘‘khyod gnyis gra sgrig yag po byos ’’zhes bshad rjes kha dbang chen la phyogs te ‘‘nga tsho rta bzhon dgos sam ’’zhes gros dris/dbang chen gyis ‘‘nga tsho rkang thang du phyin na stabs bde/ gal te kho tsho gnas de las gzhan zhig tu spo skyod byas na'ang 'ded rgyu nor mang po de tsam yod pas nga tshos rjes mi zin dogs med ’’zer/sde dpon dang / nyi shar/ don grub tshang ma rang khyim du log nas gra sgrigakhyas/ sde dpon nang du slebs pa dang sbra'i phug gi phying gdan gru bzhi de'i steng du bsdad de grags pa khri srong dang tshe rab gnyis skad btang ste ‘‘nga tsho gsum ka 'gro dgos ’’zhes bshad rjes kho rang sdod sa'i 'gram gyi shing sgam ring pa du dreg gis zin te thog ma'i rang mdog mi mngon pa'i ko ba'i sgam 6〉dang 'dra ba zhig kha phyes te sked gri ko shubs can gnyis dang smyug ma leb mo gnyis kha sbyar te rgyus pa dang 'breng bas sne gnyis dam par bsdams nas shubs byas pa'i gri gcig bcas gri gsum kho gnyis kyi lag tu bzhag nas ‘‘gri de gsum kha spu bzhar thub pa zhig brdar dgos ’’zhes bshad/ lag zhor du kho rang mdun gyi lcog tse'i steng gi ja phor tshur blangs te hub gang btung nas slar phor pa lcog tse'i steng du 'jog pa dang dus mnyam ‘‘ha chi da ’mizhes hab 281

sbrid cig brgyab pas phor pa'i nang gi ja btung 'phro yongs lag pa'i steng du bshos/bza' mo dung mtshos ‘‘tshe ring / tshe ring ri’zhes kha g.yang sgrog gin sde dpon gyi phor pa'i nang ja blugs/grags pa khri srong gis ‘‘sde dpon/ ngas byas na khyed rang 'gro dgos don mi 'dug nga tsho mi mang po 'di 'dra yod pas ’’sde dpon gyis lag pa'i steng gi ja phyis kyin grags pa khri srong gi tshig mjug 'phrog nas ‘‘nga nges par 'gro dgos/ nga tsho ga dus yin yang dbang chen kho nar skyabs bcol na ngo tsha gi red mi’zer/bza' mo dung mtshos ‘‘dkon mchog mkhyen/ bar chad sdug po mi yong ba shog ’’ces gsol ba 'debs kyin spos rkang gsum la me sgron nas lha sku'i mdun du btsugs/tshe rab dang grags pa khri srong gnyis lhas ra'i nang du song nas brdar rdo lug grod tsam zhig dkyil du bzhag nas gri brdar 'go brtsams/bkra shis g.yang chags kyis sha lhu 'ga' blangs te khag cig sgye mo'i nang du blugs/ khag cig rdza ma'i nang du blugs nas btsos/dbang chen gyis me mda' pang du 'phred du bzhag nas gtsang mar phyis/dgra 'dul sgo 'gram du bsdad de sha sog pa zhig za bzhin du ‘‘nged tsho'i tsho par mi gson por bsdad pa gcig kyang mi 'dug gam ’’zer/dbang chen gyis me mda' phyis zhor du med pa'i tshul la mgo 'phred du g.yug g.yug byas/‘‘'o na sngon ma nged tsho'i mtsher shul du dud tshang gzhan bsdad 'dug gam/’’ dbang chen gyis sngar bzhin mgo bo 'phred du g.yug282

‘‘ ’’de'i tshe dbang chen gyi sems su da res dgra jag pa'i ra mdar song nas cham la 'beb thub pa zhig dang / nor nag khyu 'ded byas pa tshur 'phrog thub pa byed dgos/ de ltar byas na sde dpon gyis da dung ya med spun gsum tshar gcod gtong dgos zer a yong / phal cher zer gyi ma red/ o/ jag pa de dag la me mda' bzhi yod pas da res spyang grung ldan tsam ma byas na nyen kha chen po red/ mtshan mo 'jab rgol byas na ci 'dra red/ phal cher mtshan mo 'jab rgol byed rgyu de rang las gdong dang gdong gtug nas 'dzing rgyu de las sla po ma red/ ma gzhi kho tsho gzhan rgyu'i don du 'chi nus na nged tsho rang rgyu'i don du 'chi mi nus pa ci yod snyams/ yang bsam blo zhib tu gtong dus nga da res 'chi mi rung / ngas dgra btsan rgod kha sho'i dgra sha ma blangs gong gzhan gyi mtshon 'og tu shi ste snying gi bu chung gcig pu lus na ga la 'grig snyams te mgo yar btegs nas rang gi gam du sha za bzhin pa'i bu dgra 'dul la yang yang bltas te mig yud tsam la rang gi bu sbar mo gang las med pa de skyes pa pho gzhon zhig tu 'tshar 'dug ang snyam nas dgra 'dul gyi 'gram par byil tsam byas nas ‘‘nged tsho sang nyin ra mda' ru 'gro dgos par skrag gi e 'dug ’’ces dris/‘‘skrag gi mi 'dug ’’ces dgra 'dul gyis tshig thag chod po'i sgo nas de ltar bshad pa dang sha sog pa de'ang bzas zin te gri rtses sog rus kyi steng du i khung zhig phug nas thab 'gram gyi go thal gyi nang du g.yug dbang chen gyis yang bskyar dgra 'dul gyi 'gram par byil tsam byas nas ‘‘grod pa rgyags song ngam ’’zhes dris/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘rgyags song ri’zer/nyi shar gyis phyi ru las ka tsag tsig 'ga' byas te nang du 'dzul dus phru 283

gu mtshe ma de gnyis sgo 'gram du go thal gyi rtsed mo rtsed kyin 'dug che chung spu nyag gi khyad par med la/ byad bzhin dbye ba phran bu tsam med pa mgar bzo'i las la byang pa'i mgar bas lugs kong gcig las bton pa'i snang brnyan dang khyad par med pas phru gu che ba gang yin dang chung ba (mngal las donasnga ma de che ba dang phyi ma de chung ba'o ) gang yin ma shes pas ‘‘mo re/nga'i snying / he he/ rgad mo/ phru gu 'di gnyis ga gi che ba dang ga gi chung ba red/ ngas da dung dbye ba 'byed shes kyi mi 'dug te he ri’zhes mig gis sngar bzhin lugs kong gcig las bton pa'i snang brnyan chung chung de gnyis la bltas nas 'duga'o ma skyid kyis lag nang gi las ka bzhag nas ‘‘ltos dang / 'di 'dra'i pha yod dam/ hung / rang gi phru gu gnyis kyi che chung gi dbye ba'ang mi shes par/ hung ’’zhes khong khro langs ba'i zol gyis mchu zur g.yas g.yon las 'dzum re bstan zhing mig gis mig log bltas te ‘‘khyod rang ni/ a tsi/'di che ba red/ 'di chung ba red ’’ces mdzub mo btsugs/nyi shar gyis ga tshod zhib blta byas kyang de gnyis la mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos ma rnyed pas ‘‘khyod kyis 'di gnyis ga 'dra byas nas dbye ba 'byed shes kyi 'dug ’’ces dris/‘‘um de de ’’mo rang gis kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos ma rnyed pas ‘‘gang ltar 'di che ba red/ 'di chung ba red ’’ces tshig thag chod po'i sgo nas bshad rjes mo rang gi mgul las g.yu chung ril ma tsam zhig blangs nas phru gu gcig gi ral pa'i sne ru btags te ‘‘ltos dang che ba 'di red/ 'di chung dus nas zho 'thung rgyur dga' ba de red ’’‘‘o da ngas shes song / 'dzam pa brgya/ khyod kyis rtags de 'dra zhig ma brgyab na ngo ma shes kyi mi 'dug da ngas shes song ’’zhes 'o ma skyid kyi 284

tshig mjug 'phroga'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘rgad po/ phru gu 'di gnyis la da dung ming med pas de ring khyod kyis kho gnyis la ming re thogs dang / ban bla mas gnang ba'i chos ming zhig med kyang / drin pha mas btags pa'i gces ming zhig yod na de gas 'grig pa red ’’ces gog bgrod thub tsam gyi byis pa de gnyis nyi shar gyi pang du bzhaganyi shar gyis byis pa gnyis po pang du bzung nas ‘‘he he/ um/'di chung dus nas zho 'thung rgyur dga' bas zho dga' zer rgyu yin/ 'di 'o red/ kho chung dus lug mthong ba dang dga' snang byed kyi yod pas lug dga' zer rgyu yin ’’zhes che ba'i ming la zho dga' dang chung ba'i ming la lug dga' zhes btags rjes ‘‘um/ nga'i srog gnyis po tshe ring bar shogadon grub par shog lo brgya nad med yong bar shog ’’ces smon lam 'debs kyin phru gu rer 'o re sbyar/ kho'i ya mchu'i steng du phru gu'i snabs cung zad 'gos 'dug pas khos goms gshis chags pa ltar mthe bong gis phyis tsam byas/phyi nyin dbang chen pha bu gnyis/ sde dpon dpon g.yog gsum dang nyi shar don grub bcas kho tsho mi bdun nyi ma ma shar gong nas zhogs ja btung ste nub ri'i ri rtser zhogs pa'i nyi 'od kyi gser mdangs 'phro ba dang sde pa las don te phyin/ gzhis sdod bza' ma bud med dang de min gyi skyes pa tshos sbra'i mdun gyi sa khri'i steng du bsang btang nas khong tshor bkra mi shis pa'i don rkyen ngan pa mi yong ba'i gsol ba smon lam yang nas yang du btab/khong tsho kha phyir bskor nas sde ba'i phyogs su blta dus sde ba yongs zhogs pa'i dmar ser mtshams sprin gyi 'og tu zhogs ja skol ba'i du ba dang bsang dud khug sna bcas kyis yongs su btum pa'i khrod du da dung sgo 'gram du langs 285

nas khong tshor mig gis skyel ma byed mkhan gzhis sdod rnams rab rib las mi mngon/lug khyu 'ga' shas bag phebs ngang lhas ra las don te rim gyis rtswa thang du gram/ lug khyu 'ga' shas lhas rar zhen chags kyis bral mi phod pa ltar lhas mthar gram nas 'dugamada' mo 'dra ba'i skyes pa bdun gyi khrod du dbang chen gyi rgyab tu khur ba'i bo'u khra ring gnam lcags kyi ru dar dmar po de rlung gis lhab lhub tu bskyod pas tshang mar sngar med kyi spobs sems rgyas par byas/dbang chen gyis mgrin pa gzengs su gtod de glu blangs par/a re yo/stag shar pa khram pa ma red de/sems bsam pa khram pa 'gro 'gro red/rta 'do ba khram pa ma red de/rkang rwa bzhi khram pa 'gro 'gro red/bo'u khra ring khram pa ma red de/mde'u sngon mo khram pa 'gro 'gro red/dbang chen gyis glu ma blangs par yun ring phyin pa dang de ring slar yang khram glu snyan zhing 'jebs pa zhig blangs pas dgra 'dul gyi sems su pha dbang chen gyis glu btang na rkyen ngan bar chad yong mi srid/ de sngon rang dang pha gnyis gangs khrod du dka' tshegs shin tu che ba'i yul gyar du 'gro skabs khong gis spobs sems cher skyed kyis glu btang bas mthar ma shi gson gnas thub pa yin pas de ring yang tsho rjes ra mda'i don go chod de dgra jag pa'i klad zho sa ru gtor thub rgyu red snyam pa'i blo stobs ldab 'gyur 'phel/grags pa khri srong gis ‘‘a khu dbang chen/ khyod kyi glu de snyan po 'dug 286

kyang don 'tshams po mi 'dug go ’’zhes ku re rtsed/sde dpon gyis ‘‘don 'tshams po med pa ci red ’’ces dris/grags pa khri srong gis ‘‘nga tsho rta 'do ba med par khong gis rta 'do ba khram pa 'gro 'gro red zer ma byung ngam ’’zhes ku re rtsed/nyi shar gyis ‘‘tag tag red/ dngos gnas byas na rkang bzhi khra khram pa ma red de zer na 'tshams shos red ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘'o na ci zhig khram pa 'gro 'gro red zer dgos ’’zhes dris/sde dpon gyis ‘‘de las sla mo red/ rkang a krad khram pa 'gro 'gro red zer na 'grig gi red ’’ces ku re rtsed/‘‘hwa hwa hwa/’’twetwehwa hwa swā’/’’nyin gnyis pa'i dgong mo nyi ma ma bzhud tsam la khong tsho de sngon rjes 'ded pa tshor 'phrad pa'i lug rdzi bud med de tshang gi sar slebs te mda' rgyang gang tsam gyi sa nas lag g.yug brgyab nas bos pas bgres song mgo skyes skya phyed sngo phyed du gyur pa gdong snum zhag can bag dro po zhig tshur yong nas gus phyag cig phul te ‘‘khyod tsho jag pa de tsho'i ra mda' yin nam ’’zhes dris/sde dpon gyis ‘‘yin/ jag pa de tsho da dung la 'di'i phar logs su bsdad 'dum gam ’’zhes dris/bgres song gis ‘‘khong tsho gtan sdod red/ khyod tsho'i so pa de gnyis kyis mig ma g.yeng bar srung nas 'dug kha seng nga tsho'i nor rdzis kho gnyis la gro snon sha lhu kha shasnya bskyal yod pas rgyags phye 'dzad dogs med/ ngas khyod tshor gur zhig phab/ri d+ngha khyod tsho do dgong 'dir bzhugs ’’zer/ bgres ༄ 1phro 287

song gi skad cha de ni lhag bsam zol med yin yang kho tsho'i sems su sngar 'dris da rgyus med pa'i mi gcig gis sems rtsa 'khol po'i sne len byed rgyu de jag pa dang kha mthun pa'i lkog g.yo zhig min nam snyam nas ‘‘bka' drin che/'on kyang nga tsho do dgong sa ma rub gong so lta gnyis po'i sar slebs pa byed rgyu yin ’’zer/bgres song des ‘‘jag pa de tsho nga tsho'i sems nang gi mdzer ru zhig yin yang nga tshos khyed tshor rogs pa gtong nus pa mi 'dug gal srid jag pa de dag tshar gcod ma thub na nga tshos khyod tshor dpung rogs mngags pas slad phyin nga tsho sdod bzod bde po yong mi srid ’’zer/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘khyod tshos spyang tshang 'gram gyi lug khyu skyid zer ba ma red dam ’’zer/bgres song des ‘‘'jig rten kha dper de ltar zer srol yod mod/spyang ki'i khog tu byang sems skyed mi srid pas snga phyi ma gtogs nga tsho kho tshos za rgyu red/ lhag par du kha dgra sna dgra bsags na de bas smyo ham che bar 'gyur rgyu red/ deng sang kho tsho'i sdod gnas de sngon ma nged tshang gi dpyid dus phyugs phrug skye bsu byed yul rtswa thang yag po zhig yin/ ltas ngan de tsho 'dir slebs pa nas bzung nged tshang gi dpyid mtsher de ru spo ma nus/ nga tsho ni ab lung dud bcu nor dgu zhes pa'i tsho pa nyam chung nus med cig yin pas ltas ngan de tshor kha gtad 'jal ba'i nus pa med stabs kha rog sdod rgyu las ma byung ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘de tshor me mda' 'dug gam ’’zhes kho rang gi me mda'i gsham shing la lag pas reg tsam byas nas ‘‘me mda' 'di 'dra 'dug gam ’’zhes dris/ bgres song des dbang chen gyi rgyab tu khur bā'i me mda'i mgo nas 288

mjug bar blta yag cig byas nas ‘‘'dug kho tsho mi rer me'i 'phrul chas de 'dra re 'dug go thos la khong tsho'i rdzas mdel rdzogs grabs yod pas 'phrog bcom byed rgyur goms pa red zer gyi 'dug mod/ nga rang ni kho tsho dang 'dris rgyus rtsa ba nas med ’’zer/zhib tu nyan dus bgres song de'i skad cha'i nang du g.yo sgyu'i skad cha med pa rtogs kyang so lta nyi ma dang lha dga' gnyis chu tsha mo kha gang med par nyin mang po ri rtser sdod dgos byung bas mgyogs tsam kho gnyis kyi sar slebs pa byas te rgyal pham ci byung yang nar 'gyang byed mi rung snyam nas ‘‘a myes da nga tsho 'gro rgyu yin ri’zer/bgres song des ‘‘kho tsho mi bzhi dang khyod tsho mi dgu yod pas khyod tshor rgyal kha thob nges red/ 'on kyang nga tsho ni nyam chung nus med yin pas khyed tshor rogs pa gtong nus pa mi 'dug khyod tshor rgyal kha thob nges yin pas khyod tsho phyir phebs skabs nges par du nged tshang du phebs rogs ’’ zer/khos kha nas de ltar shod pa las sems nang du jag pa ltas ngan de tshor me'i 'phrul 'khor yod stabs kho tsho mi dgu yod kyang me'i 'phrul 'khor gcig las med pas rgyal kha thob rgyur yid ches de tsam med pas 'byung 'gyur jag pa de tshos rang nyid la brdab gsig mi yong ched rogs pa gtong mi nus pa red/gyes khar khos da dung pus mo sa ru btsugs nas ‘‘khyod tshos nga'i rtsar skad cha 'dri bar song ba yin zhes ma shod/ sku mkhyen ’’zhes zhu ba 'then/nyi ma nub rir ma bzhud tsam la khong tsho bdun po so pa gnyis po'i sar 'byor/ so pa gnyis po rdo ra chung chung zhig gi nang du bsdad nas 'dugari de'i rtse nas blta skabs jag pa de dag gi sbra dang nor khyu sbar mthil du bzhag pa ltar gsal po mthong ba ma zad bar thag kyang nye tsam 'dug pas dbang chen gyis nyi shar dang sde dpon gnyis la ‘‘do nub mtshan mo 'jab rgol 289

byas nas bya ma 'phur bar sgo nga len rgyu red/ khyod gnyis kyis byas na ’’zhes gros 'dri byas/so pa nyi mas ‘‘de 'dra yong ba mi 'dug ’’ces bshad byung bas rgyu mtshan ci yin ma shes pas sde dpon gyis ‘‘gang yin nam/ kho tshor 'dogs khyi 'dug gam ’’zhes dris/nyi mas ‘‘khyi mi 'dug jag pa 'di tsho mtshan mo gur nang du nyal gyi med pa 'dra/ nga gnyis kyis zhogs pa nam gsal ba dang so bltas pas snga dro kho tsho rtag par nor khyu'i mtha' nas mal las langs yong gi 'dug ’’zer/sde dpon dang dbang chen/ nyi shar gsum re zhig ngag nas smra ba med par kha rog tu bsdad de mno bsam btang / dbang chen gyis rum las sna ru blangs te goms gshis ltar rkang 'gor lan gsum brdab nas mthe bong g.yon ma'i sen mo'i steng sna tha cung zad cig blugs te 'then grabs byed pa dang rlung 'tshub cig gis mthe bong steng gi sna tha shul tsam las ma lhag pas ‘‘shi/sprang rlung ’’zhes dmod tshig cig bor nas yang mthe bong g.yon ma'i sen mo'i steng sna tha cung zad cig blugs rjes yang rlung 'tshub kyis khyer dogs kyis lag pa g.yas pa'i sbar mo lag pa g.yon ma'i steng du bkabs nas bsdad/sde dpon gyis rtswa rkang gcig so yis ldad kyin skabs re mgrin pa bsring nas jag pa'i phyogs su blta tsam byed pa dang skabs re mig zung dam par btsum nas mno bsam gtong gi 'duganyi shar gyis kho rang gi sgye mo las sha lhu gcig blangs te sha tig kha shas bcad nas sde dpon dang dbang chen gnyis kyi mdun gyi rdo leb gcig gi steng du bzhag nas ‘‘zo dngatsho/ sha zo dang ’’zer/sde dpon gyis sbrang 'bu zhig kha ru 'dzul ba ltar ‘‘thu ’’zhes rtswa rkang de g.yug nas rdo leb steng gi sha tig gcig sgrug nas za bzhin dbang chen la ‘‘da 290

ji ltar byas na legs sam ’’zhes dris/dbang chen gyis sna tha 'then rjes mgrin pa bsrings nas jag pa'i phyogs su ga ler blta dus mi gcig sgor don nas gcin pa gtong bzhin 'dug khos der sdig nas yud tsam bltas rjes kho rang gi gam du bsdad pa'i so pa lha dga' la ‘‘nyin mo kho tsho ga re byed kyi 'dug ’’ces dris/lha dgas ‘‘nyin mo rtag par sbra'i nang du sdod kyi 'dug kha seng g.yag gcig bshas song ’’zer/grags pa khri srong gis ‘‘phal cher 'bri skam zhig yin gyi red ’’zer/sdedapon gyis ‘‘kho tsho mtshan mo sbra'i nang ma nyal na nga tshos 'jab rgol byed thabs med pas sang zhogs gdong dang gdong gtug nas 'thab rgyu ma red pas/ kho tsho gzhan rgyu'i don du 'chi nus na nged tsho rang rgyu'i don du 'chi mi nus pa ci yod ’’ces tshig thag chod po'i sgo nas de ltar bshad/dbang chen mgu ba'i brda la mgo bo lcog lcog byas/de nas kho tsho tshang ma sgor mor bsdad de sha rtsam sogs rgyags phye mdun du bzhag nas dgong zas za ba las re zhig jag pa'i skor gyi skad cha shod mkhan mi 'dug pas zhe 'khon dang sdug bsngal gang yang med pa'i gnas skor ba tsho zhig dang mtshungs/rim gyis sa rub nas yangs pa'i sa gzhi chen po mun nag yol bas sgrib/byang thang gi dgun dus kyi grang ngar ni bzod glags bral ba zhig red/ lhag par du ras gur rnying song zhig kyang phub rgyu med par ri rtser zhag sdod byed rgyu ni ngo ma las sla po zhig ga la yin/ da gzod mi tshang ma'i mjing pa slog pa'i gong ba'i nang du bskum nas drod khug thabs kyis phan tshun gzugs po gcig la gcig 'brel gyis gong bu gcig tu gyur/ nyi ma dang / lha dga' gnyis zhag ma mang po yi mug gi ngang ri rtser bsdad stabs gnyid skyid po dgong mo 291

gcig kyang khug myong med pa dang de ring rogs pa khong tsho yang slebs stabs blo bde bar gyur nas lam seng gnyid lam gyi zhing khams su gshegs/ gzhan rnams da dung gnyid ma khug par ci gros mol gros kyi gtam gleng yang byed kyi 'dug pas sde dpon btsan lhas ‘‘bu tsho da skad cha mang po ma shod/ gna' mi rgad po'i kha dper/ nyin mo 'gro 'gro ma mang / ri 'go thams cad mig yin/ mtshan mo lab lab ma mang / nye 'khor thams cad rna yin zer srol yod/ sang nyin dpa' ma zhum nywa ma 'dar ’’zer/phyi nyin shar skya rengs skya mda' btang ba dang kho tsho mal las langs te ga ler jag pa yod sar bltas kyang da lta nam rbad de ma gsal bas gang yang ma mthong / de nas kho tsho'i g.yon phyogs su brag tshom zhig 'dug pa'i khrod du song nas yib ste mig ma g.yeng bar jag pa yod sar bltas nas bsdad/yud tsam song rjes nam rbad de gsal nas phyogs bzhi gsal lhang lhang du mthong / gur gyi mtha' gang sar nor nag khrig ger nyal nas yod pas mi de dag da dung langs med pa gtan 'khel red/ de nas shar phyogs kyi mkha' dbyings yongs su dmar ser mtshams sprin gyis khyab cing nub ri'i ri rtser nyi 'od 'phros te gangs ri'i ldog 'od 'tsher/ cung zad phyin rjes lung pa'i srib las gzhan tshang mar nyi ma shar te kho tsho'i lus la drod skyid kyi bde ba bster/ dbang chen gyis bo'u yi ru sa la btsugs nas 'dug kyang da lta sbi sdir me sgron mi 'dug gzhan rnams tshang ma dbang chen gyi g.yas g.yon du sar nyal te bsdad/ mig jag pa'i phyogs su bgrad/ nyi ma dang / lha dga' gnyis kyis 'ur rdo re bzung bas mi tshad 'ur rdo'i nang rdo yang blugs nas 'dug sde dpon dang bcas pa'i mi drug pos sked gri shubs las bton te lag g.yas pas dam par bzung ba'i tshul ni bkod 'dom pu'u yi bka' rgya sgug pa'i dpa' rgod 'chi nus pa'i dpung tshogs shig dang 'dra/292

dbang chen gyis skad dma' bo'i sgo nas sde dpon la ‘‘tha shal 'di tsho da dung gnyid sad med pa a yin ’’zer/sde dpon gyis kho rang gi gam du yod pa'i lha dga' la ‘‘kho tsho rtag par zhogs nyal rgyag gi 'dug gam ’’zhes dris/lha dgas ‘‘phyi tsam ma gtogs lang gi mi 'dug ’’zer/dbang chen gyis sna ru blangs te 'then grabs byed skabs tshang mas skad dma' po'i sgo nas ‘‘ltos dang ltos dang / da mi gcig langs byung ’’zer/dbang chen gyis de mar sna ru rum du bcug nas blta dus mi gcig mal las langs te kho tsho'i phyogs su gtad de gcin pa gtong bzhin 'dugade nas gzhan gsum yang phyogs mi 'dra ba nas mal las langs te sked rags kyang ma bcings par slog pa lheb gyon byas nas sbra yi nang du log song /dbang chen gyis glo las me lcags blangs te sbi sdir me sgron rtsis byas pa sde dpon gyis mthong nas cung zad ngang 'then byed dgos pa'i lag brda byas nas ‘‘tog trem sgug da lta kho tsho me gtong chu len byed rgyu yin pas mi 'ga' shas phyir don yong gi red/ tog tsam sgug ang ’’zer/ ngo ma sde dpon gyis bshad pa ltar de mar mi gcig chu 'gram du phyin nas 'khyags pa chen po zhig pang du bzung nas log song / de mtshams nas sbra'i steng nas zhogs ja bskol ba'i du ba skya lhog lhog tu 'phyur ba dang / sbra'i nye 'khor gyi nor khyu yang rim gyis rtswa thang du gram song /dbang chen gyis me lcags las me rdo zur gsum zhig dang / spa ba ril ma las che tsam zhig blangs te me lcags me rdo'i steng du shugs kyis brdab pas me yi zegs ma mkha' ru 'thor ba las me son blangs te sbi sdir me sgron/de'i skabs kho tsho'i sna lam du rdzas dri mngar bsil zhig khyab byung bas tshang mar sngar bas lhag pa'i blo stobs shig skyed de mig hrig hrig gis jag pa'i sbra de'i 293

phyogs su bltas nas bsdad/dbang chen gyis mig g.yon ma dam por btsums te gzes dus gzes khung las sbra yi nang gi mi'i 'gul bskyod kyang mthong ba'i snang ba shar/skabs der ‘‘twa ’’ces 'di phyogs nas me mda'i skad grags pa dang dus mnyam gur nang du 'gul long byed pa dang / slog pa lhob gyon byas pa'i mi gsum phyir thon nas me mda' phyogs gang nas brgyab yong ba ma shes stabs rang sar skor ba rgyag bzhin phyogs bzhir mig rgyang bcad/ de mar dbang chen gyis bde lcag 'khyug po'i sgo nas me mdar rdzas mdel blugs te gzes/nyi shar gyis ‘‘gcig bsad tshar 'dug ri’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘skad ma rgyag ngas yang bskyar mde'u gcig 'bul dgos ’’zer nas gzes/ de mar mi gcig rgyug ste sbra'i nang du 'dzul/‘‘twa ’’zhes me mda'i skad grags pa dang dus mnyam mi gcig rtsa ba bcad pa'i sdong po ltar kong dong zhig gi nang du 'gyel/ da gin gyi mi de slar sbra'i nang nas don te lag tu me mda' zhig thogs kyang ga byed 'di byed med par skor ba rgyag gin bsdad/nor khyu'ang me mda'i skad kyis 'drogs te rnga ma dgung du 'phyar nas kha thor ya thor du song / rta de dag kyang 'drogs te 'dog thag gi phur bar bskor gyin phar rgyug tshur rgyug byed kyin 'dugadabang chen gyis me mda' thengs gsum pa brgyab dus me mda' thogs pa'i mi de 'drog tsam byas nas 'di phyogs kyi me mda'i du ba mthong bas 'phral mar kong dong zhig gi nang du yib nas ‘‘twa ’’zhes me mda' zhig brgyab byung ba de kho tsho'i mdun gyi brag rdo zhig la thebs nas bcag pa'i rdo yi zegs ma chung chung zhig don grub kyi 'gram pa g.yas par thebs nas zungs khrag dmar chi 294

ler bzhur byung bas tshang mas ‘‘don grub ’’ces don grub la 'khyud de la las khrag phyis rogs byas/ la las slog pa'i steng kyi pags pa srab po 'ga' dbral nas rma khar sbyar/de'i skabs phar phyogs nas yang ‘‘twa ’’zhes me mda' zhig brgyab byung /de mar grags pa khri srong dal po'i ngang ltag dgye log song bas tshang mas ‘‘grags pa khri srong ’’zhes skad rgyag bzhin blta dus grags pa khri srong gi dpral bar me mda'i mde'u thebs nas zungs khrag dang / klad zho sa ru 'khyil nas 'dug pas tshang mas ‘‘grags pa khri srong ’’ zhes ming nas 'bod pa dang /gzugs po dkrug dkrug gtong ba sogs gang byas kyang dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad zin pas tshang ma yid gdung bas mnar bzhin kho rang gi zhwa mo ngo gdong du bkab/ dbangachen gyis ‘‘ltas ngan de me mda' tsha ba la re zhig tshang ma mgo btegs te ma blta/ gab dgos/ gab dgos ’’zer bzhin kho rang sa cha gzhan zhig tu spos te me mda' gzes kyang da gin gyi mi gcig de'ang kong dong gzhan zhig tu gab nas mthong rgyu mi 'dug sde dpon gyis zhwa mo gri rtser g.yog ste mtho tsam 'phyar ba gzhan rnams kyis mthong nas de spyang grung ldan pa'i thabs shes shig red snyam nas tshang mas rang rang gi zhwa mo gri rtser g.yog ste 'phyar/ yang phar phyogs nas ‘‘twa ’’zhes me mda'i skad grags pa dang dus mnyam lha dga'i zhwa mo rlung gis khyer ba ltar rgyab phyogs su 'phangs/ yang ‘‘twa ’’zhes me mda'i skad grags pa dang chabs cig dgra 'dul gyi zhwa mor phog song bas dbang chen rbad de hang sang nas ‘‘ltas ngan de'i me mda' tsha ba la ’’zhes chig lab brgyab/me mda'i mde'u thebs pa'i zhwa mo rnams sngar bzhin dgung du 'phyar ba dang phar g.yug tshur g.yug gis 'gul skyod byed khul byas pas yang ‘‘twa ’’zhes 295

me mda' zhig brgyab byung yang su'i zhwa mo la'ang ma thebs par mde'u de khong tsho'i klad nas 'phur song /re zhig me mda'i skad chad song bas gang yin snyam nas dbang chen gyis me mda'i gzes khung las g.yol te da gin rdzas dud 'phyur yong ba'i phyogs su blta dus me mda' thogs pa'i mi de sngar bzhin kong dong de rang du yib nas me mda'i kha kho tsho'i phyogs su gtad yod bzo 'dugade'i dus sde dpon gyis rang gi lus la gyon pa'i slog pa phud de gong ba'i steng du zhwa mo g.yog ste sked gris mtho tsam 'phyar bas ‘‘twa ’’zhes phar phyogs nas me mda'i skad grags pa dang 'di phyogs kyi slog pa'i rgyab mdun gnyis kar i khung re phigs song / sde dpon gyis ‘‘pha sha za rgyu de'i me mda' tsha ba la/ tshang mas 'di 'dra byed dgos ’’zhes bka' phab pas tshang mas lus kyi gyon pa slog pa phud de gong ba'i steng du zhwa mo re g.yog ste sked gris mtho tsam 'phyar nas phar 'gul tshur 'gul byas kyang me mda' rgyag mkhan mi 'dug‘‘ltas ngan de tshos slog pa stong pa yin pa shes pa yin nam/’’‘‘tog tsam sgug dang khos gzes nas yod shas che/’’‘‘me mda' khob gang rgyag par yun ring po 'di 'dra gzes dgos yod dam/’’‘‘ltas ngan de tsho spyang grung dod pas slog pa stong pa yin pa shes pa min nam/’’‘‘ ’ritshang ma gleng mol long long byed kyi 'dugadabang chen gyis lag tu me mda' thogs shing gzugs po gzhu ltar gug ste mgyogs po sde dpon gyi 'gram du rgyug nas ‘‘kho tsho phal cher mde'u rdzogs pa 'dra/ da gin me mda' mang po brgyab byung yang da lta me mda' rgyag rgyu mi 296

'dug ngas tshod dpag byas na kho tsho phal cher mde'u rdzogs pa 'dra ’’zer/sde dpon gyis ga ler mgo pha bong gi steng nas don te blta dus da gin me mda' thogs pa'i mi de sngar bzhin kong dong de nas mthong rgyu yod tsam byas nas gab 'dug pa dang / lag tu me mda' med pa de kong dong de las don te me mda' yod pa'i mi de'i sar rgyug nas song /dbang chen gyis de mar gzes pa'i go skabs ma rnyed kyang me mda'i mchu de phyogs su gtad de gcig brgyab kyang phan nus ma thon/gzhan rnams kyis slog pa stong pa sngar bzhin dge 'dun pa'i gser sbreng gi gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ji bzhin mthon por bsgrengs nas yod kyang phar phyogs nas me mda' gcig kyang rgyag gi mi 'dug yin na'ang sde dpon gyi sems su mde'u rdzogs kyang gcig nyar yod kyi red snyam nas ‘‘tshang ma slog pa gyon ’’zhes bka' phabs rjes dbang chen la gtad de ‘‘ngas byas na khos mtha' mjug gi mde'u de da dung nyar nas yod nges red/ nga tshos 'di nas dus gcig tu rgyug nas ma gi'i gad pa de'i 'og tu slebs pa byas na ci 'dra red ’’ces bshad/dbang chen gyi sbi sdi'i sne skra yi steng du brdar bzhin ‘‘red/ ngas 'di nas khyod tshor 'geb srung byed/ khyod tsho rub rub ma byas par kha gram nas shor dgos ’’zer nas kho rang gi me mda'i mchu mdun gyi pha bong de'i steng du bskal nas gzes/tshang ma slog pa gyon tshar ba dang sde dpon gyis ‘‘nga tshos ri gsham gyi gad pa de'i 'og tu slebs pa byed dgos/ tshang ma rub rub ma byed ’’ces bshad/kho rang gis sne khrid de la rtse nas don te dgra 'dul gyis dpa' bos me 'bar ral gri dgung la 'phyar nas pha rol bdud dpung bcom par gshegs pa ltar ‘‘ki hi hi ’’zhes dgra ki brgyab ste gri ring klad la 'phyar nas rgyug297

ri mthon po'i rtse nas rbab rdo mang po g.yug pa ltar kho tsho ri rtse nas thur du the tshom spu tsam med par rgyug nas la gsham gyi gad pa de'i 'gram du ma slebs tsam la ‘‘twa ’mizhes me mda' zhig brgyab byung ba de'i mde'u sde dpon gyi g.yon phyogs kyi sa steng du lhung ste thal rdul 'phyur/ tog tsam ma gtogs dgra 'dul gyi rkang par thebs/sde dpon gyis tshod dpag byas pa ltar da gzod jag par mde'u gcig las med pa de'ang brgyab zin pas 'phral mar gnyis ka kong dong las yar langs te sked gri klad la skor bzhin rta'i phyogs su rgyug ste sked gri g.yug thengs gcig gis rta'i 'dogs thag bcad de yang sha dod po'i sgo nas rta yi steng du mchong nas yob brdeb cig byas pas rta gnyis gzhu rgyun las shor ba'i mda' mo ji bzhin re zhig byang phyogs su rgyuga'on kyang sga srab gang yang med pa'i rta rjen la kha phyogs bsgyur thabs med pas rta gnyis phar tsam rgyug rjes slar tshur rgyug byung / ngo ma rkyang rgod kha lo med pa bzhon pa ltar rta gnyis tshur tsam rgyug rjes yang lho phyogs su rgyugajag pa gnyis pos rta yi rna ba gnyis las bzung ste kha phyogs bsgyur khul byas kyang bsgyur ga la thub/de'i skabs kho tsho ni rta rgyug la ltad mo lta mkhan ltar ra bar tshud pa'i ri dwags ltar smyo rgyug byed bzhin pa'i jag pa rta pa gnyis por blta bzhin phyin te jag pa'i sbra'i nye 'dabs su slebs/ dbang chen gyis sa ru nyal te me mda'i ru sa ru btsugs te gzes khung las rta pa gnyis mthong tsam mthong tsam byed pa'i skad cig ma'i dus thung de'i nang me mda'i skam pa mnan pas na mde'u de mi rta gang la'ang ma thebs kyang rta gnyis po me mda'i skad kyis 'drogs nas hob ste kha phyir bskor bas jag pa gnyis po dus gcig tu sa ru lhung /dbang chen gyis lam seng me mdar rdzas mdel blugs nas ‘‘sde dpon 298

lags kho gnyis bde ba can gyi zhing khams su skyol dang ’ zer te me mda' sde dpon gyi lag tu bzhaganyi shar gyis ‘‘mda' gcig gis bya gnyis sod dang / nga tsho'i sbra'i nang me yang shi grabs yod pas sgug yun ring na grod pas skad rgyag gi 'dug ’’zer/dbang chen gyi rna bar nyi shar gyis kha mtshar dgod bro po de 'dra shod pa de ring ma gtogs go ma myong bas ‘‘hwa hwa/ khyod kyis kyang kha mtshar snying rje po de 'dra shod shes kyi 'dug ang ’’zer/tshang ma jag pa de gnyis kyi phyogs su bltas nas sdod pa'i skabs dgra 'dul stes dbang gis kha phyir bskor nas kha lud cig 'phen skabs bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la jag pa gcig da gin me mda'i skad go ba dang dus mnyam sbra'i nang du gab nas shi khul byas pa las shi rgyu lta ci rmas skyon yang phog med pas da lta khos dbyar chu rgyug shul gyi grog rong nas 'jab ste tshur rgolda byed par yong ba red/jag pa de'i lag tu sked gri thogs te bar thag gom pa gsum bzhi las mi 'dug dgra 'dul gyis de mar ‘‘jag jag pa ’’skad brgyab pa dang dus mnyam jag pa des smyo ham chen po'i sgo nas mchong thengs gcig gis nyi shar gyi steng du mchong nas sog pa g.yas par gri btsugs/ dza drag gi dus thung de'i nang dbang chen gyi lag nas me mda' blangs ma thag pa'i sde dpon btsan lhas nus shugs gang yod kyis me mda'i gsham shing gis mi der brgyab pas nyi shar dang jag pa gnyis rtsa ba bcad pa'i sdong po ltar mnyam du ga ler 'gyel song /de mar dbang chen gyis ‘‘nyi shar ’’zhes skad brgyab nas nyi shar yar skyor dus nyi shar gyi kha nas khrag dmar 'phyur pa dang / dbugs nyem lhom 299

gyis mig gnyis gdang mi thub par gyur 'dug pas sde dpon btsan lhas lam seng nyi ma'i slog pa'i steng nas skyi lpags srab po steb tsam zhig dbral nas rma kha'i steng du sbyar te don grub dang dgra 'dul gnyis la ‘‘khyod gnyis kyis nyi shar yag po srung / nga tsho 'gro ’’zhes phar tsam phyin rjes ‘‘'o/ khyod gnyis kyis nyi shar khur nas kho tsho'i sbra'i nang du song / chu ldud dgos/ chu ma ldud na khrag zad nas shi rgyu red ’’zer nas song /dbang chen gyis nyi shar gyi mgo ga ler don grub kyi pang du bzhag nas 'gro grabs byed skabs nyi shar la gri rgyag mkhan jag pa de da gzod dran pa sos te rkang lag 'gul byung bas kho mchong thengs gcig gis jag pa de 'og tu mnan te ‘‘sde dpon sde dpon ’’zhes skad brgyab/sde dpon dang nyi ma/ lha dga'/ tshe rab bcas pa tshur rgyug byung /dbang chen gyis ‘‘kho'i sked rags de khrol dang ri’zer bas tshe rab dang lha dga' gnyis kyis de mar kho'i sked rags bkrol te jag pa de ril ril gru gu 'dra ba zhig bkyig da dung shor dogs kyis dbang chen gyis jag pa de'i lham sgrog yang bkrol nas dpung pa'i yal 'dab gnyis phyin ci log par byas te bkyig pa'i steng du da dung lham sgrog gis dam par bkyigs/nyi shar la rmas skyon tshabs chen phog pas re zhig tshang ma brel zing 'tshub 'tshub kyis nyi shar yod sar rub pas da gin gyi mi de gnyis mthong snang du mi 'dugare zhig bya thabs gzhan med stabs dbang chen gyis nyi shar skyor te nyi mas rgyab tu khur nas jag pa'i sbra'i phyogs su song / gzhan rnams kyis da gzod ril ril gru gu ltar bkyigs pa'i jag pa de'i rkang pa'i skyig thag bkrol nas ded de song /sbra'i nang du sog thab rkang gsum gcig 'dug pa de'i khrod du rdza yi khog 300

lter zhig btsugs nas 'dug pas chu tsha grang la ma ltos par dbang chen gyis lam seng khog lter gyi mchu nyi shar gyi kha la bcug ste chu blugs/nyi shar re zhig mig kyang cher gdang nas dbugs ring zhig bsnar nas kha nas skad cha med par dbang chen la bltas nas 'dug pas dbang chen sems sdug gis en tsam ma gtogs mig chu shor/ 'on kyang skyes pa pho rab kyis mig chu 'don mi rung snyam nas sdug rus kyis mig chu ma shor ba byas nas nyi shar gyi gam du bsdad de ‘‘shag po/ nga'i blo thub kyi shag po/ khyod shi mi rung / khyod shi mi srid ri’zer bzhin yang khog lter gyi lung las bzung ste nyi shar la chu blugs/sde dpon gyis thab na nga gi thal ba'i khrod du lag myul byas nas me yod med blta dus me shi nas yun ring phyin te thal ba'ang grang mo chags 'dug pas ‘‘kho tsho lam seng me thongs ’’zhes bshad pa dang la las thab nang gi thal ba phyir bton/ la las lci ba blugs/ la las me lcags brdab ste me son blangs nas 'phral mar thab las du ba sngo 'phyur 'phyur gyis langs byung bas tshang ma'i sems su gson shugs ldab 'gyur skyed pa ma zad/ nyi shar gyi na zug kyang re zhig chung du phyin nas ‘‘da da khyod tsho ngal gso byos dang / nga nga gson thub thub pa 'dug ’’ces bshad de tshang mar mig 'grim zhig byas/nyi ma dang / lha dga' gnyis thab 'gram du gog nas thab nang du phu 'deb kyin me mgyogs tsam 'bar thabs byas pas rim gyis du ba che ru phyin nas cung ma 'gor bar thab nang nas me dmar lham lham du 'bar byung /dbang chen gyis ‘‘chu tog tsam 'thung dang ’’zhes yang nyi shar gyi kha ru chu tog tsam blugs rjes khog lter de thab steng du btsugs/sde dpon gyis nyi ma dang lha dga' gnyis la ‘‘khyod gnyis kyis res mos byas te phyi ru phyin nas jag pa de gnyis mthong min so ltos ang / gzab 301

gzab ma byas par nga tsho tshang ma sbra'i nang du mgo 'khor bsdad na dpe bsags kyi red do ’’zer/don grub dang / dgra 'dul gnyis kyis jag pa'i gal ta'i nang du rtsam pa yod med blta dus rtsam pa shul tsam yang mi 'dug pas jag pa tshos bshas pa'i 'bri sha las brang dang rtsib ma bcas las sha lhu mang po blangs te sha btsos/nyi shar slar yang na zug che ru phyin nas mig gnyis dam par btsum nas mchu to gnyis kyang dkar por gyur/ dbugs lhom lhom gyis ‘‘shag po/dbang dbang chen/ khyod la dgra lha 'khor yod pas khyod kyis phyag mdas dbang dbang zhig gnang rogs ’’zer/ sde dpon btsan lhas lam seng bo'u khra ring gnam lcags dbang chen gyi lag tu bzhagadabang chen gyis me mda' tshur blangs te phu dung gis phyis tsam byas nas ngas me mdas kho la dbang gnang khul byas pas phan gnod mi shes kyang kho'i re ba ltar ma byas na ga la 'grig snyam nas me mda' de nyi shar gyi spyi bo'i steng du bzhag tsam bzhag tsam lan gsum byas nas dbang gnang khul byas/thun mong ma yin pa'i sems khams kyi nus mthu zhig yin nam yang na rgyu rkyen gzhan zhig yin mi shes mod nyi shar gyi tshor ba dwangs par gyur nas ‘‘nga gson por sdod pa'i re ba 'dug ’rices bshad zhor du sbra'i mdo ru bkyigs pa'i jag pa ste da gin khor gri rgyag mkhan de'i phyogs su blta tsam byas/nyi ma dang / lha dga' gnyis kyis sde dpon gyi bka' ltar res mos kyis phyi ru phyin nas phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du mig rgyang gcod kyin so bltas kyang gang yang ma mthong /thab nang gi me dmar lhab lhab tu 'bar ba dang khog lter gyi mchu to las rlangs pa skya 'phyur 'phyur byed kyin 'dug pas nyi shar gyis ‘‘nga la chu khol zhig 302

ldud dang ’’zer nas khog lhir gyi phyogs su'ang blta tsam byas/dgra 'dul gyis lam seng khog ltir thab las phobs te 'brong gi rmig pa yi phor pa zhig 'dug pa de'i nang chu khol gang blugs nas phu btabs te cung zad grang par byas nas sems chung gi sgo nas phor pa nyi shar gyi khar sbyar nas chu ldud/cung zad phyin rjes sha yang tshos song bas tshang ma thab kyi 'gram du skor nas za 'thung byas/ nyi shar gyi mgo dbang chen gyi pang du bzhag nas chu khol cung zad re 'thung ba dang yang dgra 'dul gyis bster ba'i sha tig re re ga ler ldad kyin za ba/ skabs re skad dma' bo'i sgo nas skad cha'ang tshig kha shas thogs pa med pa shod thub pa ma zad mig gnyis kyang grung ril ril 'dug pas mi tshang ma'i sems su da thengs ya nga shos ni grags pa khri srong red/phar bltas na nyi shar rmas skyon tshabs chen phog kyang gson thub pa 'dug snyam nas tshang ma skad cha'ang shod rgyu mang du phyin/‘‘da gin jag pa gnyis po de gang du bros pa yin nam/’’‘‘do dgong dogs zon ma byas na mi ngan de gnyis kyis tshur rgol byed rgyu gtan 'khel red/’’‘‘kho gnyis kyi lag tu gri ma gtogs me mda' med pas kho gnyis nga tsho dang nye bar bcar nus kyi a yod/mi’de'i skabs jag pa des ‘‘nga la chu zhig blud rogs ’’zer/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘pha ro za rgyu khyod/ skyag pa skam po zo ang ’’zer/don grub kyis ‘‘chu 'thung 'dod no ngas khyod la ldud/ nga'i chu ni khol yod pas zhim po yod ’’ces gos kyi thu gsham yar brdzes nas jag pa de'i ngo gdong la gcin pa gtong grabs byas pa sde dpon gyis mthong nas ‘‘ma byed/ma byed/ de 'dra byed rgyu ga la yod ’zer/303

dbang chen gyis ‘‘dgra rang lag tu yod dus bu las gces zer srol yod/ kho la chu khol zhig blud mi’zer/don grub kyis 'dod la ma 'dod pa'i ngang 'brong gi rmig pa zhig gi nang du chu khol blugs te jag pa der blud/dbang chen gyis jag pa de tshor mi rer me mda' re 'dug zer ba da gzod gzhi nas dran sos te jag pa der ‘‘khyod tsho mi rer me mda' re yod pa ma red dam ’’zhes dris/jag pa des dbang chen gyi phyogs su blta tsam byas nas ‘‘um ’mizhes mgo bo lcog tsam byas/me mda' zhes pa'i ming thos pa tsam gyis tshang ma'i sems nang du dga' spro 'phel nas ‘‘'o na gang du yod/ me mda' gang du bzhag yod/’’‘‘me mda' ga par bzhag yod/’’‘‘a tsi me mda' ad/’’‘‘me mda'/ me mda'/’’tshang mas jag pa de'i mtha' skor nas me mda' gar yod skad cha dris/don grub kyis skad cha 'dri zhor jag pa de'i rkub la rdog rgyag cig gzhus/jag pa des gang yang ma bshad par mgrin pa kyog nas bsdad/sde dpon gyis ‘‘me mda' gang du sbas yod/ a ’’zhes dris/ jag pa des sngar bzhin kha nas gang yang ma bshad/dbang chen gyis ‘‘rdzig mdog ma byed/ khyod da lta rang lus rang dbang med par nga tsho'i lag tu tshud pa red/ me mda' gang du sbas yod drang po shod ’mizer/jag pa des dbang chen la blta tsam byas nas yang mgrin pa g.yon phyogs su kyog nas gang yang ma bshad/304

de'i skabs dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘'o me mda' gcig ’’ces da res kho tshor me mde' rgyag mkhan des rdzas mdel rdzogs rjes me mda' rang sar g.yug nas bros pa gzhi nas dran sos te sgor don nas rgyugadon grub dang / nyi ma lha dga' gsum gyis kyang me mda' rang sar g.yug nas yod pa dran sos te dgra 'dul gyi rjes su 'brang nas rgyugadagra 'dul sgor don snga bas sngon du me mda' yod sar slebs nas me mda' de mthon por bsgrengs te ‘‘'o 'o 'o ’mizhes rang nyid rgyal ba'i khul gyis skad yang yang brgyab/gzhan gsum po dgra 'dul gyi rjes su lus te me mda' de ma thob pas ‘‘a tsi ’’zhes sems skyo ba'i rnam 'gyur ston bzhin da lta dgra 'dul gyi lag tu yod pa'i me mda' der myong rol byed bzhin kha ru mdzub mo btsugs te langs nas bsdad/nyi ma da gin khong tshos me mda' brgyab nas bsad pa'i jag pa'i ro de'i gam nas me mda' zhig rnyed rgyu'i re ba bcangs te phar tsam song bas jag pa de na thang gi kong dong zhig gi nang du zungs khrag dmar chi ler 'khyil ba'i khrod du lag g.yas pas sked gri gcig bzung nas shi 'dug pas khos myur mor de'i lag nang gi sked gri dang / da dung sked par gzer ba'i gri shubs blangs te ‘‘kho gnyis ltos dang ’’zhes sked gri dang gri shubs lag g.yas g.yon du bzung nas rgyug byung /lha dga' dang / don grub gnyis sngar bzhin rang sar langs te ‘‘a tsi/ nga la gang yang thob ma byung ’’zhes phangs sems skyed/dgra 'dul nang du 'dzul ba dang ‘‘kho tsho ltos dang ’’zhes bod mda' de lag gnyis kyis btegs te bstan/tshang mas res mos kyis myong rol byed kyin ‘‘me mda' yag po zhig 305

'dug ’’ces bsngags brjod byas/nyi shar gyis ‘‘nga la ston dang mi’zhes lag pa dgra 'dul gyi phyogs su ga ler brkyang byung bas dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘a khu nyi shar ltos dang ’ zhes me mda' de ga ler nyi shar gyi lag tu bzhaganyi shar gyis me mda' der byil byil 'ga' byas nas ‘‘me mda' yag po zhig 'dug shag po dbang chen/ khyed kyis me mda' de ga 'dra 'dug tshod lta zhig byos dang ’’zer/‘‘ya ya ’’zhes dbang chen gyis me mda'i nang du rdzas mdel blugs nas ‘‘don grub/ sog rus de 'be+en la btsugs dang ’’zer/don grub kyis lam seng jag pa'i sgo 'gram du me khyem gyi dod du bzhag pa'i 'bri'i sog rus de'i dkyil du dkre nag gi sgor thig cig bris te 'ben du btsugs/skabs der nyi ma nub rir bzhud de sa rub grabs 'dug pas sog rus de gsal po rang mi mthong yang dbang chen gyis me mda'i mchu sbra sgo las bton te brgyab rjes ‘‘don grub/ sog rus de yar khyer shog ’’ces bshad/sog rus de skya tsog ger 'dug pas don grub kyi sems su mde'u sog rus la thebs a yod snyam nas yar blangs te blta dus mde'u ni g.yas g.yon gyi phyogs lhung med par dkre nag gi sgor thig gi dkyil du thebs nas i khung chung chung zhig bton 'dug pas don grub hang sang nas ‘‘a ma ma/ de 'dra tsha ba la ’’zhes sog rus de dbang chen gyi lag tu bzhagadabang chen gyis ‘‘shag po/ khyed kyis ltos dang ’’zhes sog rus de nyi shar la bstan/ nyi shar gyis nus shugs gang yod bton te sog rus de lag tu blangs nas de'i steng gi i khung la mdzub mo btsugs te ‘‘sog rus gtor na srog la nyen kha yod dam ’’zhes sngar go ma myong pa'i dri ba zhig bton byung bas 306

kho 'khrul ba min nam snyam nas ‘‘shag po khyed kyis ci zer ba yin/ sog rus dang srog rtsa la 'brel ba med ’’zer/‘‘a ru/’’nyi shar la na zug langs byung bas dbang chen gyis kho la sems gso byed ched ‘‘shag po/ shag po/ sog rus dang srog rtsa la 'brel ba med/dngos gnas med ’’ces shod kyin nyi shar gyi khog stod las skyor te thabs ci drag gis kho la chu blud/ kha nas ma ṇi bar med bgrang / 'on kyang nyi shar la bzod glags bral ba'i na zug langs te da gin btung pa'i chu dang bzas pa'i sha tshang ma chu klong brdol ba bzhin skyug byung bas shi nyen 'dug snyams/tshang ma dngangs skrag skyed nas kha nas ma ṇi bar med bgrang bzhin gang drag ci drag zer nas der rub/ ‘‘phyir skyug kyang 'thung thub na drag gi red ’’zer bzhin sde dpon btsan lhas chu 'khyer 'ong nas blud kyang da lta btung ba da lta phyir skyug pa las phan nus ma thon pas mthar mtshan gung tsam la dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad de 'jig rten phyi ma'i yul du gshegs/tshang ma sems sdug chen po'i sgo nas nga'i shag po/ a khu nyi shar/ nyi shar zhes 'bod kyin ngus te da dung phung por 'khyud de dkrug dkrug btang yang shi ba las phyir ldog pa ni lha sgrung tsam las mngon sum dbang po'i spyod yul du 'gyur mi srid/da lta 'chi ma thag pa'i nyi shar gyi ngo gdong la dga' skyo dang / zhe sdang /'khon 'gras kyi rnam 'gyur gang yang med par mig gnyis zum nas 'dug pas dbang chen gyis der yun ring bltas rjes dbugs ring zhig 'then nas mal gzan gyi gong ba yar 'then te nyi shar gyi ngo gdong bkab nas ‘‘oṃ ma ṇi pad+me kli/’’zer nas mig gnyis las rang dbang med par mig chu shor/cung tsam phyin rjes/ dbang chen gom zheng chen po'i sgo nas mdun du song nas gri rtse jag pa de'i sna rtser sbyar nas ‘‘sdug shi rgyag rgyu khyod kyis nga'i 307
