shag po bsad song bas ngas dgra sha len rgyu yin mimizhes ngar skad sgrogajag pa des dbang chen gyi phyogs su mig blta tsam yang ma byas par ‘‘nga'i shag po'ang khyod tshos bsad pa ma red pas ’’zer/‘‘hung / nga tsho rang sa rang yul la bsdad pa la khyod tsho ma gtogs da bar brnyas bcos byed mkhan yong ma myong / khyod tsho'i ham pa dang btsan shed de sa cha gzhan la 'gro 'gro nga tsho rong pa sde gsar la 'gro gi ma red mi’ces dbang chen zhe sdang drag po langs nas sked gri 'phyar te bzhu bar brtsams pa dang / sde dpon gyis bkag nas jag pa de'i ma le'i 'og tu mdzub mo btsugs te ‘‘pho gsar sbo shob ma byed/ da lta ci byed nga tsho'i lag tu yod ’ zer/jag pa des sngar bzhin mgrin pa kyog nas skad cha tshig 'bru gcig kyang ma bshad/‘‘sde dpon/ mi ngan khor gtam rnyog bshad pas ci phan ’’zhes dbang chen gyis lam seng gsod rtsis byas/sde dpon gyis dbang chen gyi phu dung las 'then te sbra'i phyi ru khrid nas ‘‘kho tsho'i me mda' gsum da dung rnyed med pas sngon la kho blo 'gug khul ma byas par da lta rang bsad pa yin na me mda' gsum po de rnyed kyi ma red ’’zer/dbang chen gyis gri shubs su bcug nas mgu ba'i brda la mgo bo lcog tā/ga byas/nang du slebs rjes sde dpon gyis sha tig kha shas bcad de jag pa der bster nas ‘‘pho gsar rang shed ma byed rgyags tshad ma bzas na do dgong gnyid khug gi ma red ’’ces mu mthud sha tig bcad de bster/da gin sde dpon gyis dbang chen phyi ru khrid de skad cha gang bshad rna thos ma byung yang da lta dbang chen gyi gri shubs su bcug pa las gsod rtsis byed kyi 308

mi 'dug pas mi 'di tsho ya nga snying rje shes mkhan rkyang rkyang min nam/ da res mgo bde tsam ma byas na srog mgo thon pa mi 'dug snyam nas sha za bzhin tshang ma'i ngo gdong la bltas te ‘‘sku mkhyen nga'i bkyigs thag bkrol tsam gnang dang / nga gcin pa gtong dgos 'dug ’’zer/sde dpon gyis lam seng bkyigs thag bkrol nas nyi ma dang dgra 'dul gnyis kho dang mnyam du btang / gcin pa btang nas slar nang du slebs rjes sde dpon gyis kho'i yan lag bkyigs bsdams ma byas par sog thab rkang gsum de'i mtha' ru kho tsho dang mnyam du sdod bcug nas ‘‘khyod tsho ga nas yin drang po shod dang / khyod kyi shi gson gyi dbang cha nga tsho'i lag 'og tu yod pas klad rnying mkhregs bzung byas na rang nyid pham rgyu red ’’ces drang gtam bshad na mi gsod rgyu'i bzo bstan/mi ci 'dra zhig yin yang dka' ngal dang / sdug bsngal ji 'dra 'phrad kyang 'jig rten thog nyin gcig las sdod rgyu med kyang sdod 'dod pa las shi 'dod mkhan ni sems khams la skyon yod pa re zung las ga la yod/ mi lus thengs gcig thob pa ni las sla po min pas gsal nyi zla gnyis kyi 'og tu sdod rgyu byung na bde skyid yin pa dang / de las ldog par phyi ma'i lam du gshegs te bar do'i 'phrang lam dog po rgyud de lus gzhan zhig brje rgyu ni shin tu sdug bsngal ba dang / dka' tshegs che ba zhig yin pa kun shes red/ der brten jag pa de gson pa'i re ba skyed de ‘‘nga tsho tshang ma phyogs nges med yin mi’zer/‘‘phyogs nges med zer na ci la zer ba red/’ ‘‘kho tsho gsum ni bod dmag red/mi’‘‘a/ bod dmag red ad ’’ces dbang chen hang sang nas jag pa de'i skad cha'i tshig mjug 'phrog ste gdan las hob langs byas/ da lta thab 309

'gram du za 'thung la rol bzhin pa'i jag pa de 'drog tsam byas nas dbang chen la bltas nas bsdad/ ‘‘ya/ de nas mu mthud shod dang ’’zhes sde dpon gyis jag pa de'i phrag par bcag tsam byas nas ‘‘bod dmag de tsho ga 'dra byas nas 'dir slobs pa red ’’ces dris pa dang chabs cig dbang chen mar sdod dgos pa'i lag brda byas/dbang chen gdan du bsdad pa dang de ring nyin gang ring sna tha ma 'then pa dran nas sna tha 'then dgos snyam nas sna ru blangs te mthe bong g.yon ma'i steng cung zad cig blugs nas 'then pas rkan sbug tu mngar sang sang zhig byung ba dang dus mnyam sna khung gi sbug tu za 'khrugs shig langs te ‘‘ha chi ’’zhes hab sbrid chen po zhig brgyab pas kha chu dang sna chu'i zegs ma phyogs bzhir thor/jag pa des ‘‘nga la'ang sna tha cung zad cig bster dang ’’zhes mthe bong g.yon ma'i sen mo ldag mdzub kyis mtha' nas bskor te dbang chen gyi phyogs su brkyang / dbang chen gyis 'dod la ma 'dod kyis de'i sen mo'i steng du sna tha tog tsam zhig blugs/ jag pa des da gzod snang dogs dang /'jigs skrag gi rnam 'gyur gang yang med par ha lam kho tsho tshang ma mnyam du yong ba'i ra mda' las phan tshun dgra zla min pa ltar khos lag g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang ldag mdzub kyi steng du 'gos pa'i zhag tshi dag slog pa'i steng du gtsang mar phyis rjes mthe bong g.yon ma'i sen mo'i steng nas sna tha cung zad cig blangs te sna khung g.yas pa'i sgor sbyar nas ‘‘sir ’’zhes yar 'then pa dang mig gnyis nas mig chu don te mig gnyis zim zim du gyur nas dbugs gtong ba'i rnam 'gyur la bltas pa tsam gyis kho sna tha 'then rgyu med par gyur nas yun ring phyin pa rtogs thub/310

‘‘ya de nas ga 'dra red/ shod dang / shod dang ’’zhes sde dpon gyis kho'i pus mo'i steng du bcag tsam byas/‘‘ya ya/ ya ya/’’zhes kho da dung sna thas yid ma tshims par ldag mdzub dang / mthe bong gis da gin las cung zad mang ba'i sna tha blangs te yar 'then pa dang dus mnyam kha dang sna las thal rdul dkar po zhig 'phyur ba de yis re zhig kho'i ngo gdong mi mthong bar gyur/‘‘bod dmag red/ kho tshos bshad pa ltar na lo 'ga'i sngon kho tsho gtsang gi phyogs su mi rgya'u skra dang kha spu tshang ma dmar po dang / ser por byas pa'i gdon 'dre dang dmag rgyag skabs kho tsho pham pas bya thabs ma byung par tshur bros te srog thar yang gzhan gyis 'phya smod byed par dogs nas byang du ri dwags rngon te 'tsho ba skyel ba red/ thog mar kho tsho g.yul sar 'gro skabs dmag mi tshang mas ‘wa rnga ma sha rer bros pa las stag 'dzum drug rgyas nas shi na dga' ’zhes shi gson chags 'jig ga tshod thug kyang der shi rgyu las mi bros rgyu'i dam bca' bzhag yod pas g.yul sa las bros rjes byang sa 'di las sa cha gzhan dang / lhag par du lho phyogs su 'gro ma nus pa red/ de ni khong tshos nga la bshad pa red/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ ’’zer/‘‘a/ ga re mi rgya'u/’’‘‘skra dang kha spu dmar po dang ser po/’’‘‘gdon 'dre dang dmag brgyab pa red zer ram/’’‘‘gdon 'dre dang mi ga 'dra byas nas dmag rgyag gi yod dam/’’‘‘rna bar mi 'gro ba'i skad cha gdon 'dre dang mi dmag rgyag zer ba go ma myong /’’ kho tsho tshang ma ha las pa dang yid ma ches pa'i sgo nas kho la de ltar dris/dbang chen rbad de yid ma ches pa'i sgo nas ‘‘hung / mi 'dis rdzun bshad pa red/ khyod tsho da dung yid ches sam/ gdon 'dre dang mi dmag 311

rgyag zer ba go ma myong / skyag rdzun ma shod ’’ces jag pa de'i sna rtser mdzub mo zhig btsugs te ‘‘khyod kyis da dung nga tshor mgo skor gtong snyam gyi 'dug gam ’’zhes bshad pa dang gdan las hob langs kyis phyi ru don te skor g.yengs byed par song /lha dga' phyi ru grang reg ma bzod par lag pa gcig gis gcig phur gyin mjing pa slog pa'i gong ba'i nang du bskum nas skor g.yeng byed kyin 'dug pas dbang chen gyis ‘‘khyod nang du log tog tsam ngas so blta chogaskyag 'dzar des sgrung snyan po zhig shod kyi 'dug ’’zer/ sde dpon gyis ‘‘ya/ mu mthud shod dang khyod kyis bshad pa'i gdon 'dre kha sru dang skra dmar po dang ser po byas pa de ngo ma red dam ’’zer/‘‘kho tshos nga la bshad pa red/ ngas rdzun til 'bru tsam yang min ’’zhes rdzun min par khungs skyel pa'i tshul du lag g.yas pa'i mtheb chung gi rtser mchil ma bskus te ston tsam byas/‘‘khong tsho'i gras kyi mi gcig lam bar du nad kyis mnar te shi ba dang /kho tsho gsum po 'a chad 'u thug nas byang du bros te ri dwags rngon nas bsdad pa dang nga yang der slebs te nga tsho mnyam du bsdad pa yin ’’zhes bshad rjes mgo smad de dbugs ring zhig btang nas ‘‘de rjes nga rang gi chung ma dran drags nas 'tshol bar song yang sngar gyi sa ru med pas mo ma rnyed ’’zer/sde dpon gyis ‘‘khyed kyi chung ma sngar yod sar med kyang gzhan la skad cha 'dri sa med pa red dam ’’zer/‘‘skad cha 'dri sa ga la yod/ nga tsho yul nas bral te byang du gnas spos byas te yong skabs glo bur du mo'i pha rgan shi ba dang / mo mu mthud 'gro ma 'dod pas nga gnyis kha rtsod shor nas ngas mo der bskyur ba yin/ 'on kyang lo shas phyin rjes nga rang mo dran pa dang rang gi byed stangs la blo pham skyed nas 312

mo 'tshol bar song yang bya 'phur rjes med kyi dpe ltar mo sngar gyi gnas de ru mi 'dug ’’zer/skad cha de go ba dang dgra 'dul jag pa de dang nye bar bcar nas ‘‘khyod kyi chung ma'i ming la ci zer ’’zhes dris/jag pa des dgra 'dul la blta tsam byas nas ‘‘'o ma skyid ’’zer/‘‘a/ 'o ma skyid ’’ces kho tsho tshang ma gcig ngo gcig gis bltas pa dang / dgra 'dul lam seng phyi ru rgyug nas dbang chen la ‘‘a pha/ a pha/mi 'di 'o ma skyid kyi khyo ga red 'dug ’’ces bshad/dbang chen yid ma ches par ‘‘a ’’zhes mig sngar bas che bar gdang nas dgra 'dul la bltas nas bsdad/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘'di ’’zhes sbra yi phyogs su mdzub mo gtad de ‘‘'o ma skyid kyi khyo ga red 'dug ’’zer bas dbang chen hang sang nas khyod 'dir tog tsam sdod ang zhes dgra 'dul so bar bzhag nas kho rang rtab rtab por sbra'i nang du 'dzul nas ‘‘kho re/ khyod kyi ming la ci zer ’’zhes dris/‘‘nga'i ming la tshe skyabs zer ’’zhes bshad/dbang chen sngar bas hang sang nas ‘‘'o na 'o na 'o na ’’zhes rgyu mtshan med pa'i skad cha dab dib 'ga' bshad rjes sde dpon khrid de phyi ru don nas ‘‘mi 'di nged tsho'i 'o ma skyid kyi khyo ga red ’’zer/sde dpon gyis ‘‘khyod ci zer ba yin/ 'o ma skyid kyi khyo ga da res 'das po de red/ 'o ma skyid ces pa'i ming mang po yod/ nga'i a ye 'das mo de'i ming la'ang 'o ma skyid zer gyi yod ri’zer/dbang chen 'tshub cha langs nas ‘‘ma red ma red ’’ces lag pa gnyis pus mo'i steng du brdeb kyin ‘‘khos zer ba'i 'o ma skyid de nged tsho'i 'o ma skyid de rang red/ 'das po de dang 'o ma skyid kyi lo rgyus ngas khyod la shod myong ’’313

zer/ da gzod sde dpon gyis dran gsos te ‘‘'o tag tag red/ 'o na 'o ma skyid kyi khyo ga'i ming la tshe skyabs zer ram ’’zhes dris/‘‘tshe skyabs zer gyi yod/ de mo rang gis nga la bshad myong ’’zer/sde dpon gyis ‘‘'o na mi de ma bsad na mi legs sam ’’zhes dbang chen la gros 'dri ba'i ngag gis de ltar bshad/dbang chen gyi sems su nga'i shag po bsod mkhan lag dmar ni kho yin pas ngas shag po'i dgra sha ma blangs na shag po bar do'i 'phrang lam las nga la khrel mi 'dug snyam gyi med dam/ khos de snga ya nga snying rje med pa'i sgo nas 'o ma skyid gcig pu g.yug nas song bas 'o ma skyid kyis kho mthong na dga' snang byed rgyu lta zhog rang gi phru gu gnyis kyi pha bsod mkhan lag dmar kho yin pas kho dang dmar 'dzing byed rgyu yin zhes zing bslang na ji ltar byed/ gal srid mo'i sems su sngar gyi 'khon 'gras med na mo rang dang / phru gu gnyis la yang 'tsho sdod spyod gsum gang thad nas 'go 'dren byed mkhan yod pas yag po red snyam pa las 'di legs snyam pa'i 'dod tshul 'gran zla bral ba zhig ma rnyed stabs sde dpon la ‘‘khyod kyis byas na kho dang / 'o ma skyid mnyam du 'tsho ba skyel thabs byed rgyu yin nam ri’zhes dris/‘‘ngas byas na 'o ma skyid kyis khas ma blangs na khyod kyis shag po'i dgra sha len rgyu yin zhes kho bsad na ma 'grig pa mi 'dug ’’ces sde dpon gyis tshig thag chod po'i sgo nas bshad/de nas kho gnyis sbra'i nang du 'dzul nas thab 'gram du tsog ste sbar mo gnyis thab kyi phyogs su gtad de me lde bzhin re zhig smra ba med par lus pa dang / cung tsam phyin rjes sde dpon gyis ‘‘kho re/ tshe skyabs/ khyod da gzod khyod rang gi nag mo 'o ma skyid dran gyi 'dug zer ba kha khog pa gnyis kyi 314

drang gtam yin nam ’’zhes khrims dpon gyis nyes can la skad cha 'dri ba ltar dris/tshe skyabs kyi 'dren byed zung las re ba'i 'od mdangs 'phro bzhin sde dpon la bltas te ‘‘yin/ ngo ma yin/ sngar ya med byas nas ngas mo rang g.yug kyang phyis su 'gyod pa chen po skyed de slar mo dang mnyam du sdod rgyu byung na zas kyis grod pa ma rgyags pa dang gos kyis lus ma dros kyang tshul ldan red bsam gyi 'dug 'on kyang mo rang sngar gyi gnas de ru med pas ngas mo ma rnyed stabs thabs shes bral song / nga mo rang dran drags nas skabs re gnyid lam du'ang mo dang 'phrad pa rmis kyi 'dug ngas rdzun min/ ngas mna' skyel chog ’’zer nas ‘‘'dzam bu gling ’’zhes mna' bskyal/sde dpon gyis ‘‘khyod gal srid sngar gyi gshis ngan de dag dor te sdod ri bong las tsog pa dang / 'gro zhi mi las mkhas pa/ yin lugs tshul ldan byas na nga tshos khyod gsod rgyu min/ khyod kyi nag mo nga tsho'i sde nang du yod ’’tshe skyabs kyis sde dpon gyi tshig mjug 'phrog ste sde dpon gyi lag par 'jus nas ‘‘sku mkhyen/ de ngo ma red dam/ khyed kyis nga la mgo skor btang ba min nam/ mo da lta bde bde thang thang red dam ’’zer/sde dpon gyis ‘‘red/ khyod kyis zer ba'i 'o ma skyid de rang red/mo bde bde thang thang red ’’zer/tshe skyabs kyis sde dpon gyi rkang par dpral pa sbyar gyin phyag btsal te ‘‘khrel med nga'i tshe smad 'di khyed la skyabs bcol rgyu yin/ mos nga la dmod ngan tshig tsub ga tshod bshad kyang ngas khur nas sngar byas kyi sdig pa dag par byas te mo la byams snying rjes ma bskyang na nga mi min khyi yin ’’zer/sde dpon gyis ‘‘'on kyang mo la phru gu gnyis yod mi’ces bshad/tshe skyabs kyis ‘‘'o na nga khong tshang gi tshe g.yog byed rgyu yin/ sngar ngas 315

ya nga med par mo g.yug pas da lta mo rang la khyo bo yod na ngas de gnyis kyi bar du 'dzul nas gtor gshig gtong ga la rung / nga khong tshang gi tshe g.yog byed rgyu yin ’’zhes kha zhe gnyis med kyis de ltar bshad/dbang chen gyis dbugs ring zhig btang nas ‘‘mo'i khyo bo 'di red ’’ces sbra'i phug tu yoṅka pa'i nyi shar gyi phung por mdzub brda byas/ tshe skyabs rbad de hang sang nas ‘‘a kha de ngas ga la shes ’’zhes 'gyod sems drag po skyed nas mgo bo smad de bsdad/re 'is der yod tshang ma kha nas smra ba med par kha rog tu bsdad/tog tsam song rjes tshe skyabs kyis ‘‘mo rang gis nga la sdig pa dag pa'i go skabs shig sprad na ngas ma shi bar khong ma bu gsum la gtam ngan tshig rtsub med par byams dang snying rjes skyong rgyu yin/ lhag par du pha med kyi phru gu gnyis po de nga rang gi sha las chad pa'i phru gu dang dbyer med kyis gces skyong byed rgyu yin ’’zhes khas blangs shing dam bca' yang bzhagade nas tshe skyabs kyis khong tsho me mda' gsum po de len par khrid/ kho tsho re zhig rdzas mdel rdzogs stabs me mda' gsum po de chu phran rgyug shul gyi gad pa zhig gi 'og tu sbas nas 'dugad gzod nam dkyil zin nas zla ba sgo nga'i dbyibs dang 'dra ba zhig nub ri dang bar thag shin tu nye ba dang / nam mkha' ru sprin mthe bong gi sgor rgya tsam yang med par sngo zhing dwangs pa'i dbus su dgu tshigs skya mo de thag ring 'grul bzhud kyi shul lam dang 'dra bar lhag par mngon gsal dod/rtswa thang gi gzhi ru sbra de las che ba'i dngos po med pa dang sbra'i mtha' gang sar nyal ba'i nor khyu ni bag phebs ngang gnas pa sogs 'jig rten gyi snod bcud la bltas na 'dir mi gsod dmar 'dzing gi yo lang lta zhog kha rtsod tsam yang med par dus bde lhing 'jags dang 'dra yang kho tsho tshang ma'i sems su 'das 316

po gnyis kyi bzhin ras dang / rgyun ldan gyi rang gshis spyod tshul khra lham mer shar te gdung ba drag pos mnar/ lhag par du sbra'i nang du yod pa'i nyi shar gyi phung po mthong dus sngar bas lhag pa'i sdug bsngal dang / zhe 'khon skyed kyang phyogs lhung med pa'i 'jig rten mi yi las bskal gyis rang phyogs kyi spun zla gsod mkhan lag dmar ba yang rang phyogs kyi gras su 'dzul bas dgra sha len thabs bral ba dang / 'o ma skyid la gdung sems mnyam skyed byas/phyi nyin kho tsho snga po nas mal las langs te zhogs ja stabs bde zhig bskol te btung rjes nyi shar gyi phung po rta gcig la bkal nas sbra dang /bcas pa'i ca dngos gcig kyang ma lus par g.yag la bkal te song nas la rtser slebs/der grags pa khri srong gi phung po la khyi spyang gang gi gnod pa med par kha sa ltar zhwa mo ngo gdong la bkabs nas gan rkyal du 'gyel nas 'dug pa de'ang rta gzhan zhig la bkal nas song /kho tsho ra mdar song ba go chod de nor khyu nag khyur re 'ded yong ba mthong bas kha sa'i bgres song de kho tsho'i mdun bsu bar yong nas ma mthar yang kho tshang du nyin gsum bzhugs rogs zhus kyang kho tsho phung po gnyis rta la bkal nas da dung gzhan gyi sne len dang len byed mi srid pas bgres song gis kho tshor dpa' ba'i dpa' dar la mthe bong 'bri mar gyis byug cing rgyan nas ‘‘nga yang mgo 'bul lus 'bul yin ’’zhes kho tshang rong pa sde gsar gyi sde khongs su 'dzul/rang sde dang bar thag je nyer je nyer song ba dang / kho tsho tshang ma'i sems nang du 'tshub cha che ru song /grags pa khri srong ni dwa phrug 'khyam po yin pas lo na chung chung skabs pha ma 'jig rten phyi ma'i yul du gshegs pas shin tu snying rje ba las gnyen nye ba 317

yang med pas sdug bsngal 'khur mkhan med kyang / gson po'i skabs ga btang go chod kha nyan zhig yod pas sde dpon tshang gis 'das mchod kyi bya ba sgrub na 'grig mod/ 'o ma skyid zer ba'i las ngan ma de thog mar tshe skyabs kyis mi med sa stong du khyi lud bzhin dor te gson po'i dmyal ba myang pa dang /de nas re zhig nyi shar dang khyo shug gi 'tsho ba bskyal nas pang du bu yang yod pas gzhan smon rang skyid kyi 'tsho ba skyel 'go tshugs kyang da gzod khyo bo dgra lag tu shor bas sdug bsngal chen po yod pa smros med red/tshe skyabs kyi sems su de snga ngas ya nga snying rje spu tsam med pa'i sgo nas mo rang gcig pu byang sa skya mor g.yug da res mo'i khyo bo yang ngas bsad pas mos nga dang 'tsho ba mnyam du skyel rgyu lta ci/ nga ni mo'i mig nang gi gra ma dang sems nang gi mdzer rur gyur nas mthong na 'dre dang / thos na bdud du brtsi ba las ngas 'gyod bshags ga tshod byas kyang khas len mi srid snyam nas gom mtshams bzhag nas sde dpon la ‘‘mos nga ma mthong na sdug bsngal chung rgyu red/ nga mthong na sdug bsngal dang / zhe sdang / 'khon 'gras kyis mo rang smyo 'gro gi red/ de bas da khyod tshos nga sod cig ’’ces tshig thag chod po'i sgo nas bshad de lag pa gnyis kyis slog pa'i brang kha phyes te nges par du mda' yis brang la brgyab nas gsod dgos pa'i tshul bstan nas ‘‘mo la khyo bo gsod mkhan de nga red ces ma shod/ khyo bo'i dgra sha blangs yod ces shod ’’zer/tshe skyabs kyi skad cha go ba dang / byed stangs mthong bas dbang chen gyi sems su sngar lhag gi sdug bsngal skyed de sked gri sa ru btsugs/ khu tshur zung gnam la 'phyar nas ‘‘rgyab ri kha 'dzin can/ srung ma myur mgyogs can khyed gang du byon nam/ khyed kyi spyan long ba yin nam/ nga sdug po 'di 'dra myong don ci red/ lha dge bsnyen lhun po/ nga phar 'gro dus bsu ma mi 318

gda'/ nga tshur yong dus skyel ma mi gda'/ sdug mgo thog tu slebs kyang mgon skyabs med don ci red ’’ces nam mkha' dbral ba lta bu'i ngar skad sgrogs te tshe skyabs kyi mgo'i spyi btsugs nas rkang mthil drug bar sked gri g.yug thengs gcig gis dum bu gnyis su btang nas shag po'i dgra sha len rgyu byung na ci ma rung snyam yang sde dpon gyi khar nyan nas sdod rgyu las ma 'das/tshe skyabs kyis sngar bzhin slog pa'i brang kha phyes te ‘‘da nga sod dang /nga sod dang ’’zhes skad brgyab byung bas sde dpon kho'i mdun du song nas brang dmar rjen ma'i steng du khu tshur zhig gzhus te ‘‘bsam blo rgya che tsam thongs/ma gzhi nas khyod 'o ma skyid kyi khyo ga ma red dam/ bza' ma bud med gcig gis dgra sha len rgyu'i 'khon 'dzin bcang srid dam/ phru gu'i pha bsod mkhan khyod yin pa mos ga 'dra byas nas shes kyi red ’mices bshad/tshe skyabs kyis sde dpon gyi skad cha'i go don gsal por rtogs nas mgo bo lcog lcog byas nas mu mthud mdun du skyod/la steng du slebs dus sde ba'i nang gi mi tshang mas bltas nas 'dugatshe skyabs kyang kha sngon der ‘‘zhabs sor bkod ’’myong bas sde ba de ni shin tu 'dris rgyus che bar snang ba dang / sde ba dang bar thag je nyer song ba dang khong tsho'i sems nang dngangs skrag je cher song / sde dpon btsan lha dang /dbang chen gnyis kyi sems su thog mar 'o ma skyid la skad cha ga 'dra shod/sprin byi'u mgo tsam med par thog sta re tsam lhung pa'i dpe ltar bsam yul las 'das pa'i don rkyen bkra mi shis pa des mo'i sems su bzod glags bral ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mo rang yang bsam yul las 'das pa'i rkyen ngan dang 'phrad mi yong ngam/ ji ltar re zhig kho gnyis dbar rgyu rkyen sna tshogs shig gi bar chad byung 'dug mod gang ltar tshe skyabs ni mo rang gi khyo bo 'khrul med cig yin pa dang / byis pa gnyis pos rnyog 'dzing che ba'i bya ba'i rgyud rim de 319

dag shes mi srid pas 'o ma skyid la sems sdug ga tshod che yang mi tsher brjed med rdo la ri mo brkos pa lta bu'i sems sdug yong don med snyam/khong tsho nor khyu dang bcas pa phyir log yong ba mthong bas khyim tshang yong brel ba 'tshub 'tshub kyis ja bskol ba dang / zas rigs g.yos sbyor byed kyi yod pas sbra'i steng nas gyen 'phur g.yu 'brug lta bu'i du ba sngo lhog lhog gis 'phyur gyin 'dug 'on kyang 'o ma skyid kyis lam seng me gtong ma thub pa yin nam/ yang na gang ltar rgyu mtshan ci yin mi shes par sbra yi steng nas du ba rta rnga tsam zhig las mthong rgyu mi 'duga'o ma skyid kyis phru gu gnyis lag pa g.yas g.yon gyis bzung ste khrid nas gzhis sdod gzhan dang lhan du kho tsho'i mdun bsu bar yong yang rang gi khyo bo nyi shar gyi grib ma tsam yang mthong rgyu med par rta gnyis kyi steng du phung po bkal yod pa mthong bas rang dbang med par mig gnyis las mig chu rdog kha shas lhung yang ngu skad ma brgyab par ‘‘da res khyed khyed tsho song song ba nas nas bzung nga la gnyid lam sdug pa sha stag btang byung bas ltas ngan pa zhig red bsam byung / 'di ngas tshe sngon mar las ngan pa ci zhig byas pa'i rnam smin yin nam ’’zer bzhin byis pa gnyis mchan khung 'og tu dam par bzung /'o ma skyid ni sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyi nyams sad theg pa'i bud med gcig yin pas blo rgya chen po yod stabs ngu skad rgyag bzhin zing cha ma bslangs bas kho tsho'i sems nang gi dngangs skrag kyang rim gyis 'jags/ tshe skyabs shin tu ngo gnong par gyur nas mgo rbad de smad de zur zhig tu langs nas 'dug pas sde dpon gyis tshe skyabs kyi phyogs su lag brda byas nas 'o ma skyid la ‘‘khos yun ring khyod 'tshol myong 'dug da khyod tsho log song ’’zer bas 'o ma skyid kyis tshe skyabs kyi mgo nas mjug bar thengs mang bltas 320

rjes mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur gang yang med par ‘‘'gro ’’zhes byis pa gnyis khrid de tshe skyabs dang lhan du nang du log song /yul na grwa btsun zhes pa gcig kyang med mod rang yul du yod pa'i chos phyogs kyi shes bya phran bu ldan pa 'ga' bskongs nas 'das po gnyis kyi ched du chos phyogs kyi byed sgo stabs bde spel rjes phung po dur 'jug byas pa dang sde dpon tshang / dbang chen tshang / don grub tshang / tshe skyabs tshang tshang mas zhag bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i ring nyin mtshan dbyer med kyis mchod me spar nas 'das po gnyis bar do'i 'phrang las bde grol yong ba'i smon lam btab/tshe skyabs kyis zho dga' dang / lug dga' gnyis rang sha las chad pa'i dum bu min yang rang sha las chad pa ltar gces skyong byed pa dang /sngar byas kyi las la 'gyod bshag gis 'o ma skyid la gos drag tshad g.yogazas drag tshad sbyin nas gces skyong byed pa ma zad khyim don gyi thad mo dang kha rtsod tsam yang shor myong med/ma gzhi kho nyi shar gsod mkhan lag dmar yin yang da lta kha bshad don du 'khyol ba zhig byas pas sde dpon btsan lha dang / dbang chen gnyis mgu po byung nas sngar kho rang gi me mda' de kho rang la sbyin/ 'on kyang rdzas khyem sne gang dang / mde'u rdog gcig kyang ma sprad pas khos rgyun par me mda' de sbra'i phub kar la bcings nas bzhagame mda' gsum po'i nang gi legs shos de sde dpon gyis byas/ de byings gnyis gcig don grub dang / gcig dgra 'dul la sbyin/rta 'do ba la bya gshog skyes kyang ya mi nga mkhan gyi gzhon nu pho gsar la da dung rgyab tu thogs 'dra ba'i bo'u zhig khur rgyu yod pas spobs sems rab tu rgyas te don grub dang / dgra 'dul gnyis gcin gtong chu len ma gtogs bo'u rgyab dang bral med khur bas mi tshad rtag tu me mdar rdzas mdel blugs te 321

me mda'i khog nang du thal rdul sogs 'dzul bar dogs nas me mda'i mchu ru g.yag gi rtsid pa dkar po'i kha dil brgyab nas g.yul sar chas ran pa'i dpa' rgod ltar kho gnyis gar yod kyi sar ru dar dmar lhab lhab byed pa mthong rgyu yod/‘‘'od shu shu’’don grub dang dgra 'dul gnyis kyis me mda'i ru dar dmar lhab lhab kyis nor khyu sde ba'i phyogs su bskong byung /ri byi'u ri ru 'phur/ khung byi'u khung du 'dzul/ ‘‘kwa kwa ’’zhes nyin gang zas kyi don du gang sar 'phur ba'i pho rog nag chung rnams kyang gnyis re/gsum re/ bzhi re grogs sgrigs nas gshog zung brkyang nas brag dmar gyi mkhar rdzong du log dmar ser gyi mtshams sprin ni srid na 'gran zla bral ba'i snum tshon ri mo zhig dang 'dra bar nub phyogs kyi gnam mtha' 'dres mtshams la zil shugs sbyin/ gcan gzan gyi mche ba dang 'dra ba'i g.yang gzar gyi rtse mor da dung nyi 'od ser lham lham 'phros nas 'dug nyin mo dben zhing 'jags pa'i byang rigs kyi 'brog sde chung chung de da gzod 'du 'dzi'i dpal la rol/ bud med rnams kyis zo ba dang / a ru khyer nas 'bri'i 'o ma bzho 'go tshugs/ skyes pa rnams kyis ‘‘cho le/ cho le ’’zhes 'bri g.yag rnams rgyun ldan gyi go rim bzhin gdang la btags/ lug rdzi rnams kyis sprin dkar gyi tshom bu dang gnyis su med pa'i lug khyu dal gyis sde ba'i phyogs su ded/shin tu nyam thag gi sdug bsngal ga 'dra zhig byung yang dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'gros dang bstun nas rim gyis sangs 'gro ba ni ldog tu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi chos nyid cig yin pas da gzod snga dgong lhas ra'i nang du hwa hwa ho ho'i dgod sgra'ang thos rgyu 'dug322

tshe skyabs kyis rang khyim gyi 'bri g.yag gdang la btags zin nas zho dga' dang / lug dga' gnyis lag g.yas g.yon gyis khrid de nang du logabakra shis g.yang chags kyis ‘‘a che 'o ma skyid khyed kyis ltos dang / phru gu de gnyis kyi gzugs byad a khu tshe skyabs dang 'dra ba la ’’zer/'o ma skyid kyis ‘‘'dra po mi 'dug 'dra po ga la yong srid/ ngas bltas na 'das po de dang a na ma na red ’’zer/de'i skabs nyi ma der slebs nas bkra shis g.yang chags la ‘‘rjes ma khyed rang grod khog nang gi phru gu de dgra 'dul dang mi 'dra bar nga dang 'dra na hwa hwa ri’‘‘ci zer/ kha tshums/ ngo tsha rgyu med le/’’‘‘hwa hwa hwa/’’‘‘ ’’rong pa sde gsar gyis yul lung bde ru mi bcug mkhan gyi jag tshogs thal ba'i rdul du brlags pa ma zad me'i 'phrul 'khor bzhi yang thob pa'i snyan grags nye 'khor sde tsho gzhan du khyab pas sde tsho gzhan rnams rong pa sde gsar la yid smon skyed de rong pa sde gsar zer dus sngar sde chung nus med rgan mo ru ba zhes kun gyis 'phya ba dang / brnyas bcos byed yul zhig yin mod da ni bu rta'i mdangs thon song zhes bsngags brjod byed kyi yod/ ya med spun gsum gyi rna lam du skad cha de thos skabs shin tu mi dga' ba dang /'jigs skrag kyang tshad med skyed/de sngon dbang chen yul du 'gro skabs stes dbang gis 'brug dar 'phrad nas kho ni ya med spun gsum gyi ya gyal zhig yin par shes nas 'jigs skul gyis me mda'i mchu lce yis ldag bcug pa de sha dang rus pa'i steng du mi bzod pa'i na tsha'i sdug bsngal med kyang de ni shin tu mi 'os pa'i mthong chung 323

dma' 'beb yin pas kho'i phu bo a dar dang / chos dar gnyis kyis ‘‘mi rgan nang du bsdad dus kha mchu gnam las lhung zhes pa ltar don med mi la brnyas bcos byed mkhan gte po de su yin nam/ rong pa sde gsar gyis tshar bcad pa'i jag tshogs de'i nang gi mi gcig yin nam/ rong pa sde gsar gyi btsan lha dang nged tsho'i bar rgyal pham gyi dbye ba med pa bre srang la 'degs dgos kyang yang lci yod mi srid pas kho tsho'i mis de ltar byed mi srid la me'i 'phrul 'khor yod pa'i mi yang med ’’ces dbang chen dang nyi shar zhes rbe'i yul gyar grong pa gnyis der slebs pa kho tshos da dung shes med/‘‘hung / mthong chung dang brnyas bcos de lta bu byed mkhan de su yin/gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po yin yang som nyi the tshom med par de dang dmar 'dzing byed rgyu byung na mi lo lnga brgya skye ba ma blangs kyang 'gyod pa med ’’ces a dar gyis nyin mang po gri brdar gyin 'brug dar la ‘‘tha shal/ khyod lta bu'i tha shal yod dam/ ngo ma gnyid lam du'ang gtong mi srid pa'i brnyas bcos de 'dra khur nas me mda'i mchu ldag mkhan pho tha khyod de ring nas bzung nga dang chos dar gnyis kyi sring mo las spun mched du ngos 'dzin mi byed thag chod yin/slog pa'i thu gsham ring du thongs la mo las kho na ma gtogs pho las las mi dgos ’’zhes kha rdung drag po btang nas sdang mig gis bltas/chos dar gyis kyang phu bo'i lad zlos byas nas ‘‘bu zhe sdang med na bu mo red/ mtshon rno ngar med na 'u lu red/ da dung mi des khyod la rkub ldogs zhes ma bshad pas ma gtogs khyod kyis zhim snang byed kyin ldag nges red ’’ces kha rdung btang /'brug dar tsi gus zhi mi mthong ba ltar sgo 'gram du bsdad nas phu bo gnyis kyi kha rdung gzed nas smra ba med par mgo rnga dbyug ltar gug nas bsdad/phu bo gnyis kyi dmod tshig dang kha rdung ni sgrung pa phul byung zhig gis lha 324

sgrung shod pa ltar rdzogs mtha' mi 'dug‘‘hung / 'jig rten kha dper pho rab brgya yi khrod na pho tha gcigapho tha brgya yi khrod na pho rab gcig ces pa cis mi bden/ nga tsho 'chi gson spun brgyad kyi nang gi pho tha khyod red/ pho shi skyag zan/ bzang byed mkhan la bzang lan med na bzang byed mkhan nyung du nyung du red/ dgra byed mkhan la dgra lan med na dgra byed mkhan mang du mang du red ’’ces mdzub mo 'brug dar gyi sna rtser gtad de ‘‘go byung ngam/ tha shal/ a ri’zhes skad shugs sngar bas che ba'i sgo nas sdig pas 'brug dar 'drog tsam byas pa dang /ngo gdong las bya dka' byed gtad kyi rnam 'gyur nyam thag pa'i mig gis phu bo gnyis kyi gdong la thad kar blta ma nus par sa ru bltas nas ‘‘brnyas bcos yin pa ngas shes kyi 'dug 'on kyang nga tsho sngar bu spun stag phrug 'dra ba brgyad gzhan smon rang skyid cig yin yang rang shed rang btsan che drags pas da lta gsum las ma lhag pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin da dung ma rtogs pa red dam/rang srog rta rnga phra mo la phangs sems med par nga btsan nga rgod kho nar bsam nas ’’khos sngar gyi spun zla 'das pa de dag zungs khrag dmar chi ler khrag dmar gyi lbu ba'i khrod du re re bzhin dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad pa de rnams dran nas tshig mjug ma 'khyol bar rngam pa ring po zhig 'then nas slar sgo 'gram du bsdad nas smra ba med par lus/‘‘hung / de de ’’zhes phu bo a dar la 'os shing 'tshams pa'i tshig lan zhig ma rnyed par rkub la khab btsugs pa ltar sdod bzod mi bde bar gdan las hob langs kyis sbra'i nang du phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed kyin lag pa gnyis sked par gzer/chos dar yang gdan las hob langs kyis ‘‘rang srog rta rnga phra mo la gces 'dzin med pa min yang brnyas bcos de lta bu khur mkhan pho tha khyod las 325

thabs rdugs pa a yod/ nged tsho 'chi gson spun brgyad kyi zhabs 'dren pa/khyod kyis zhus pa'i zhabs 'dren de 'dra ni mi tshe las gtam tshe ring rgyu red ri’ces kha rdung gtong bzhin khong khro'i sems pa gnon ma thub pa'i khul gyis go skyor gyi steng du khu tshur brdab pas bzod glags bral ba'i na zug btang yang ma na pa'i zol gyis am btsigs bsdams nas bsdad/a dar dang / chos dar gnyis kyis 'brug dar la me mda'i mchu ldag bcug mkhan de rong pa sde gsar gyi mi min shag byas pa dang / lhag par du deng skabs rong pa sde gsar gyis jag tshogs shig pham nyes btang ba'i 'bras bur me mda' bzhi yod pa go thos byung bas phyis 'byung rong pa sde gsar la 'gran zla med pa shes te rang chu btung ste rang sar sdod ri bong las tsog pa dang 'gro zhi mi las mkhas pa byed dgos snyam/de mtshams nas tshang ma grags 'gul med par ril ma gcig rlung gis ded pa'i sgra yang thos thub par gyur/sde dpon btsan lhar me mda' bzhi yi nang gi mdzes shos bdag tu bzung rgyu byung bas da ni ya med spun gsum lta ci ya med spun bcu yod kyang 'jigs dgos don mi 'dug pas de ring ngas kho tshor nyams tshod cig len dgos snyam nas bo'u khra ring rgyab tu khur/ rta 'do ba nag po pho rog dang 'dra ba zhig la bzhon te ri dwags rngon par kha g.yar te thad la/ra ya med spun gsum tshang gi mdun gyi na thang wa dmar gyi sgal gzhung dang 'dra ba der tshugs babs te ched mngags gal ta'i kha las sha lhu gcig mthong bar byas nas me mda' rgyab tu khur nas lci ba 'thu bar song /ya med spun gsum gyis ma gi'i na thang du me mda'i ru'i rtse na ras dmar po'i dar lcog rlung gis skyod bzhin pa khur pa'i skya mi gcig tshugs babs pa mthong pas tshang ma ya mtshan dang / 'jigs skrag skyed de sbra'i sgo srub las 326

lkog blta byed kyin bsdad/de'i tshe pho rog gcig gis gal ta'i kha nas sha lhu de mthong nas ‘‘kwa kwa ’’zhes skad rgyag bzhin lding skor re gnyis byas nas thad kar gal ta'i 'khris su babs te sha bzas/sde dpon btsan lhas snga sa nas gra sgrig yod pa'i sgo nas me mda' mar phab ste blo rtsa brtan po'i sgo nas gzes te me mda' brgyab/ 'di phyogs nas ‘‘twa ’’zhes me mda'i skad grags pa dang pho rog de nag lhob be bsad song pas ya med spun gsum gyi rna lam du sngar 'brug skad las che ba'i sgra thos myong med pas da res de ni 'brug skad las kyang che bar snang ba dang / bar thag pho 'dom brgya tsam gyi sa nas pho rog bsod thub pa'i mthu rtsal la kho tsho rbad de hang sang nas kha gdang mig bgrad kyis re zhig rengs por lus/dgra mthong yul du med dus 'brug dar la kha rdung drag po gtong bzhin zhe sdang 'brong rgod 'khrab 'khrab dang / dpa' gtam chu rgyug rgyug tu bshad kyang da res sngar rna ba'i yul du thos pa tsam las mig gis mthong ma myong ba'i me'i 'phrul 'khor zhes bya ba de de ring mngon sum dbang po'i spyod yul du gyur bas sngar mtshon cha'i dbye ba cher med kyang rang re'i spun zla mang po'i srog kyang shor ba red/ skad sgra 'brug stong ldir ba dang 'dra ba/ kha nas du zhag 'phyur ba/ bar thag ring po'i sa nas sems can gyi srog bkum nus pa'i khyad 'phags kyi mtshon cha 'di 'drar 'gran zla byas na rdza mas rdo la brdung ba dang mtshungs so snyams nas dpa' zhum ste sgor don ma nus par gcin pa khyim nang du btang nas bsdad/sde dpon btsan lhas ya med spun gsum la nyams tshod len ched du du ba sngo lhog lhog gis ja bskol nas za 'thung byed kyin sa cha der nyi ma phyed yol gyi bar du bsdad kyang ya med spun gsum tshang ni mi shi khyim stong du gyur ba ltar sbra 327

gog de las mi'i grib gzugs tsam yang mthong rgyu med pas khos rta la sga srab spras nas mchong thengs gcig gis sga yi steng du mchongs/ rta bo lcag gis brab nas khram glu gtong bzhin phyir loga.a dar chos dar 'brug dar gsum da gzod gzhi nas grags 'gul yod par gyur te tshang ma dbugs ring 'byin kyin lus kyi rus sgrom zhig pa ltar gdan steng du 'gyel nas bsdad/'brug dar gyis ‘‘me mda' zhes pa de 'jigs su rung ba zhig mi 'dug gam/ ngas me mda'i mchu ma ldag par phar rgol byed rtsis byas na nga'i srog de'i kha nas thar thub bam ’’zhes skabs de dus rang nyid bya thabs med par gzhan gyi brnyas bcos khur dgos byung ba'i tshul gyis dag 'bud byas/phu bo gnyis bla 'khyer ba ltar kha nas smra ba tshig gcig kyang med par mig cher gdangs nas da gin 'jigs su rung ba'i me mda'i skad da dung rna lam du grags kyin 'duganyi ma de yi phyi nyin sde dpon btsan lhas g.yi lpags kyi slog pa la gos chen nag po'i steng du 'brug tshang nyal gyi ri mo ser po yod pa'i phyi skogs la gzig lpags kyi mtha' rgyan can/ gong ba wa mo'i pags pa byas pa zhig gyon/mgo ru rgya gar yang zhwa thal skya mdog rnying song zhig gyon/ rkang la sog lham rnying par g.yag ko'i lham krad brgyab pa zhig gyon nas dbang chen tshang du slebs/khos rgyun ldan gzab mchor de lta bu gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ston dang / yang na rta rgyug sogs 'du 'dzoms kyi skabs ma gtogs gyon srol med/ de ring gyon pa yag rigs tshang ma gyon pas mi tshad dgun dus su'ang rgya gar yang zhwa gyon lugs la bltas na de ring don dag chen po zhig yod pa 'dra snyams nas dbang chen rtab rtab por gdan las langs te sde dpon nang 328

du bsus/bkra shis g.yang chags kyis ko gdan gcig sgo phyi la brdab brdab byas nas sbra'i sbug tu gting nas sde dpon btsan lha sdod du bcugade ring gzab mchor de lta bu spras te sbra'i sbug tu ngo gdong 'dzum bag dang bcas bsdad dus ngo ma dbang thang bsod nams can gyi sde dpon zhig rang red 'dugabakra shis g.yang chags kyis lam seng thab nang du lce rdog 'ga' blugs pa dang de nas sha lhu 'ga' btsos te sde dpon la sne len zhu rgyu'i gra sgrig byas/gung dkar te sbra'i gnam sgo las 'phros pa'i gru bzhi nar gzugs kyi nyi 'od tsha po zhig dbang chen gyi steng du 'phros nas 'dug dbang chen slog pa'i phu dung gnyis ka phud de khog stod dmar hreng nger bsdad yod pas thab nang gi me dang nyi 'od tsha drags pas ngo gdong snum zhag tshil tshil du gyur ba ma zad dmar la nag dreg che ba dang / sha rgod 'bur du thon pa'i brang steng du mjing pa las bzhur ba'i jul chu rkang gnyis su mgyogs kyi bang rtsal 'gran pa ltar shar mar rgyugasde dpon gyis sma ra med pa'i ma ne byil tsam byas nas ‘‘dgra 'dul bsdad med dam ’’zhes dris/bkra shis g.yang chags kyis ‘‘nor chu blud par phyin song / da phal cher slebs ran yod mi’zer bzhin sbra'i sgo srub las rgyang blta zhig byas/dbang chen gyis sna tha sen mo gang blugs te lag g.yas pas sna ru bzung ste myong rol byed kyin du ‘‘sde dpon kha sang ri dwags rngon par phyin pa yin nam/ri’zhes dris/sde dpon gyis yang sma ra med pa'i ma ne byil tsam byas nas ‘‘yin/tog tsam ma gtogs 'brong rgod gsum bsad song /’’zhes bshad rjes ‘‘hwa hwa 329

hwa ngas rtsed mo zer ba yin/ nga kha seng ya med spun gsum la nyams tshod len par song nas kho tshang gi mdun gyi na thang der ja bskol nas bsdad kyang kho tshos ya byed nus kyi mi 'dug ngas da dung ched mngags gal ta'i kha nas sha lhu gcig mthong bar byas nas de'i steng du babs pa'i pho rog gcig la me mda' brgyab nas bsad pas kho tsho zhed thag chod nas skyag gcin gos thung gi nang du shor ba 'dra ’’zhes bshad rjes yang ‘‘hwa hwa hwa ’’zhes gad mo chen po bgad/dbang chen gyis sna ru mdun du bzhag nas mthe bong dang ldag mdzub gnyis kyis sna tha cung zad cig bzung ste sna khung g.yas pa'i sgor sbyar nas sir sgra dang bcas yar 'then pa dang / de nas thal rdul dkar po zhig dgun dus bye thang gi thal rlung dang 'dra bar kha sna gnyis las bton te re zhig ngo gdong yang mi mthong bar byas nas ‘‘ri dwags rgyag par song ba min zer ram/ri dwags rgyag par song nas pho rog gcig bsad 'dug ga hwa hwa hwa ’’zhes ku re bshad/dbang chen gyi bsam par ya med spun gsum gnya' chag cing dpa' zhum nas yod pas da nas khos phal cher dgra sha len rgyu'i bsam blo med pa 'dra/ ma gzhi thog 'dra ba'i me mda' khur rgyu yod pas mtshon cha skyed gri tsam las med pa'i dgra yar skrag dgos don ci yod snyam yang rang gis sde dpon gyi bde 'jags thad sems khur chen po yod khul gyis ‘‘a tsi/ khyod kyis nga mi khrid pa ci yin/ ngas snga sa nas khyod la dgra sha len rogs byed rgyu'i dam bca' bzhag pa khyod kyis brjed song ba ma red dam/ ngas ngo ma khyod ri dwags rngon par 'gro ba yin gyi red bsam byung ’’zhes bshad kyang don du phan tshun 'khon 'gras med pa'i ya med spun gsum dang dmar 'dzing byed 'dod med/330

sdedapon gyis ‘‘kha seng ngas kho tshor nyams tshod lta ba las kho tsho dang 'thab rgyu'i gra sgrig med pas rogs pa ma khrid pa yin/ kho tshos nga ngo ma shes pa yin yang srid/ gang ltar kho tsho nga'i mthong yul du yong ma byung / sang nyin don grub nga gnyis kyis khyod rogs par khrid de dgra sha len par 'gro bsam gyi 'dug da yun ring po sgug nas ci phan/ khyod la khom pa yod na ’’zhes bshad byung bas dbang chen re zhig ga byed 'di byed med par gyur/gal srid sang nyin khom pa med ces don gzhan zhig la kha g.yar yang nam yang khom pa med ces kha g.yar sa'i don zhig rnyed pa'i dbang du btang yang gzhan gyis yid ga la ches/ dang thog sde tsho 'dir mgo 'dogs skabs kyang khas len dam bca' bzhag zin pas rkyen pa mda' shor gyis mda' mo shor bas mda' de la log shog zer sa med/ kha ba tshig shor gyis tshig shor bas tshig de la log shog zer sa med snyam nas ‘‘khom pa yod/ khyod kyis ga dus 'gro zer ba de dus 'gro mirizer ba dang yang dgra sha len par 'gro dus dpa' ba'i dpung rogs med na ga la 'grig de dus rang gis gzhan la re dgos stabs kha dan tshig la gnas pa byed dgos snyam nas shin tu 'thad pa'i tshul gyis ‘‘nga tsho tshang mar me mda' yod pas skyag zan gsum la skrag rgyu ci yod ’’zer/‘‘da yag byung / da yag byung ri’zhes sde dpon shin tu dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ston bzhin 'a chad 'u thug gi gnas su gyar na ma gtogs gdong gtug nas dmar 'dzing byed mkhan don grub nga gnyis red snyams nas bkra shis g.yang chags don grub skad gtong bar btang /sde dpon gyis ‘‘khyod kyis bltas na nga tshos 'jab rgol byed dam mngon sum 'dzem med kyis gdong gtug nas 'dzing ’’zhes dbang chen la dris/‘‘um da ’’zhes dbang chen gyis de mar lan 'debs ma thub par bsam 331

blo btang / de spun gsum sngar ya med ces skad du grags kyang dus deng sang dpa' zhum nas nyam thag par 'dug kha sngon rang nyid yul du 'gro skabs stes dbang gis 'brug dar zhes pa de dang 'phrad de me mda'i mchu ldogs zhes brnyas bcos bshad par khos 'dzem bag med par ldag gi 'dug skyes pho dang skyes pho thug dus de lta bu'i brnyas bcos khur mkhan nyung nyung red/sang nyin gal srid 'jab rgol byas te dgra sha len rtsis byas na me mda' gsum gyis ya med spun gsum tshang ma gsod rgyur gor ma chag de bas gdong gtug nas 'dzing rtsis byas na kho tshos mgo sgur nges red/ des na kho tsho tshe thar gtong thabs shig byas te don med mi yang gsod mi dgos la/ sde dpon dang don grub gnyis la'ang lhag bsam zol med kyis rogs pa byas pa ngo ma mda' gcig gis bya gnyis bsad pa'i dpe bzhin rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don 'grub thub/ lhag par du ya med spun gsum dang 'khon 'gras med pas kho tsho gsod thub par spobs pa skye rgyu ci yod snyam nas ‘‘ngas bltas na gdong gtug nas 'dzing rgyu red/ me mda' yod pa'i mi gsum gyis 'jab rgol byas na ngo tsha mi’zhes brjod/de mtshams rdza ma'i nang gi sha khu lhog lhog tu khol bzhin chu yi zegs ma thab 'gram gyi me mdag gi nang du lhung nas ‘‘tshir/ tshir ’’zhes grags pa dang gser gyi khu ba dang 'dra ba'i sha yi zhag rdza ma'i kha nas lud tsam lud tsam gyis ma gzhi nas snum zhing nag dreg che ba'i rdza ma de sngar bas bkrag mdangs che bar gyur/ dbang chen gyis lam seng phu dung gnyis kyis 'jus nas rdza ma thab las phab/ glo gri bton nas gri sne yis sha lhu re re bzhin sde dpon gyi mdun du len bzhin ‘‘sha tshos la ma tshos de bro ba che/ rogs 'dris la ma 'dris de brtse dung che/’’ngo ma sha lhu de dag tshang ma phyi tshos kyang nang ma tshos pa rkyang rkyang red 'dug pas sde dpon mdun gyi rdza ma'i sder ma kha chag de las sha 332

khu dmar po chu rgyun bzhur ba ltar 'gram du rgyugadabang chen gyis ‘‘sha yag po rang mi 'dug 'on kyang khyed kyis 'dzem ma gnang par yag po za rogs ’’zhes de'i khrod nas tshi lu che ba'i sha lhu gcig blangs te sde dpon gyi lag tu 'jog gin du ‘‘ja grang na dga' yang rang gis mi 'jog sha tsha na dga' yang gzhan gyis mi bster zer yang da res sha tsha mo bster yod do ’’zhes ku re bshad/da lta rang rdza ma'i nang nas blangs ma thag pa'i sha tsha po dang de'i sha khu tsha pos sde dpon gyi lag pa 'tshigs nas ma bzod par ‘‘tog tsam sgug dang /a tsha tsha ’’zhes sha lhu tshil chen detshomar bzhag nas sbar mo'i steng du 'gos pa 'i zhag tshil dang sha khu gyon pa spus legs de'i steng du 'gos dogs kyis sbar mo gnyis ther ther byas nas mig gnyis sha lhu de'i steng gi tshi lur bltas nas sgra mi gsal ba'i ma ṇi bgrangs/da gzod bkra shis g.yang chags dang / don grub ming sring gnyis kyang tshur slebs/ don grub kyang lus dang grib ma ji bzhin mi bral ba'i me mda' de rgyab tu khur nas 'dug kho gdan steng du sdod khom med par ‘‘sde dpon lags/ sang nyin rang 'gro rgyu yin zer ba bden nam ’’zhes spro ba rab tu 'phel nas mchu zum mi thub par gyur/sde dpon gyis ‘‘yin yin/ da sdod/ ya de zo dang / tshi lu che drags pas ngas za thub pa mi 'dug ’’ ces da gin dbang chen gyis ched mngags khor bster pa'i sha lhu de don grub la sprad pa dang / de nas tshi lu chung ba zhig blangs te bzas/don grub kyis ‘‘sha tshil chen za bar bu snying chen dgos ’’zhes ku re bshad kyin glo gri bton te bzas/sde dpon gyis ‘‘ya ya/ bu snying chen yin na sang nyin ma 'phyug ’’ces 333

ku re bshad zhor du kho rang gis za bzhin pa'i sha lhu de'i steng nas tshi lu ti ka gcig bcad de ‘‘ya/ bu snying chen/ de zo dang mi’zer/sde dpon dang / don grub gnyis kyis dbang chen rogs par 'khrid de nyi ma sang nyin rang dgra sha len par 'gro rgyu yin pa'i skor gyi gtam gshog pa skyes pa ltar de ma nyid du grong tsho chung chung der khyab pas tshe skyabs dang /dgra 'dul gnyis 'tshang kha shig shig gis dbang chen tshang du slebs nas ‘‘nga yang 'gro rgyu yin/’’‘‘nga khrid dang / ngas zhabs 'dren zhu mi srid/’’‘‘nga nges par du khrid dgos/’’‘‘nga 'gro thag chod yin/’’‘‘grogs brgya yod kyang nyung skyon dang / dgra gcig yin yang mang skyon zer srol yod pas nga nges par du khrid dgos ri’zer/tshe skyabs kyis ‘‘khyed tshos nga la yid ches dang / blos 'khel na nga khrid dang / ngas rang srog rta rnga phra mor phangs pa med pa ma yin yang / khyed tshos nga tshe thar btang bas mi tshad rang mir brtsis te me mda' yang sprad pa ma zad nga'i bza' zla 'o ma skyid sdug dmyal ba'i yul nas bskyabs pas ngas da res khyed tshor drin lan gsab ched nga nges par du khyed tsho'i rogs par 'gro rgyu ma zad da res shi yang 'gyod pa rta rnga til 'bru tsam yang med ’’zer/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘nges par du khyed tsho'i rogs par 'gro rgyu yin/ 'og la bzhon rgyu'i rta pho yod la rgyab tu khur rgyu'i me mda' yod pas bu rta gnyis kyi mdangs 'don rgyu'i dus la slebs song ’rizhes kho rang khrid rgyu'i yid ches kyis khengs/sde dpon gyis ‘‘khyod gnyis kyi skad cha tshang ma sems nang gi skad cha yin pa ngas shes kyi 'dug khyod gnyis la yid mi ches pa dang / zhabs 'dren 334

zhu ba'i dogs pa min yang shig gsod par sta re 'phyar ba'i dpe bzhin gri 'ur rdo las mtshon cha med pa'i mi gsum gyi steng du mi lnga rgyug song na sde ba gzhan gyis 'phya nges red/ de bas rjes ma dbang chen pha bu gnyis kyi dpung rogs su 'gro dus nga tsho tshang ma dpa' zhum mi rung / nywa 'dar mi rung ’’zer bas tshe skyabs bya thabs zad de zur zhig tu bsdad/dgra 'dul da gin gyi yid ches de chu yi lbu ba ltar yal nas ‘‘nga yang khrid kyi min zer ram ’’zhes hang sang nas kha cher gdang ste bsdad/sde dpon gyi skad cha de dbang chen gyis sems su shin tu 'thad pa ma zad ‘‘rjes ma dbang chen pha bu gnyis kyi dpung rogs su 'gro dus dpa' ma zhum/nywa ma 'dar ’’zhes pa'i skad cha des khor sems 'gul tshad med thebs te da res sdig pa'i khur po ri rab las che ba zhig khur te dmyal ba chu rgyun las ring ba zhig myong dgos kyang som nyi the tshom rang lus kyi ba spu phra mo tsam yang med par mchong zer na dmar yag stag dang 'dra ba zhig dang gsod zer na byis pa lo brgyad yin yang ya mi nga ba byed dgos snyams nas ‘‘red/ shig gsod par sta re 'phyar dgos med/ khyed gnyis blo bde po byos ’’zer/tshe skyabs dang / dgra 'dul gnyis 'gro 'dod kyi sems da dung ma 'jags par lag pas lag pa phur gyin dbang chen dang / sde dpon gnyis la bltas nas bsdad/ dbang chen gyis kho gnyis kyi sems rtogs nas ‘‘ngo ma red/ shig gsod par sta re 'phyar na sde ba gzhan gyis 'phya gi red ’’ces nan bshad byas/dgra 'dul gyis skad dma' po'i sgo nas ‘‘'o na nga gnyis la rogs pa zhig btang ste song na mi 'grig gam ’’zhes bshad/‘‘hwa hwa hwa ’’zhes sde dpon gyis gad mo chen po zhig bgad de ‘‘de ga la 'grig da res dgra sha len rgyu de nga dang don grub gnyis kyi bya ba red/335

der rang gi tshab tu mi gzhan btang na mi tshe las gtam tshe ring bar gyur nas 'jig rten kha dper 'gyur nges red/ grogs dbang chen ni thabs bkod pa can zhig yin pas ma khrid na mi 'grig mi’zer/dbang chen gyi ming gi mdun du ‘‘grogs mi’zhes pa'i tshig cig sbyar bas dbang chen sngar bas lhag pa'i sems 'gul thebs nas lus yongs su 'dzad mtha' med pa'i stobs shugs 'phel te kha nas skad cha'ang ma thon par ngo gdong las yid ches dang spobs pa/ dga' spro/ sems shugs kyi rnam 'gyur gyis khengs te sde dpon la bltas nas bsdad/de nas kho tsho ci gros mol gros kyi gtam gleng sna tshogs shod kyin yun ring bsdad rjes sde dpon dang / don grub gnyis sang nyin phyogs thon gyi gra sgrig byed dgos stabs dbang chen tshang las don te rang gnas su logatshe skyabs kho tsho dang mnyam du 'gro rgyu'i re ba ma 'grub pas sgyid lug gi gom pa spo bzhin logatshe skyabs dbang chen tshang las don te cung ma song bar dbang chen gyis sbra'i nang nas ‘‘kho tshe skyabs/ 'dir shog dang ’’zhes bos pas da res kho khrid rgyu min nam snyams pa'i dga' spro 'phel te ‘‘a ’’zhes kha phyir bskor te rgyug ma 'dur gyis dbang chen tshang du 'dzul/dbang chen gyis ‘‘nga tshor rdzas mdel mang po rang med pas gron chung byed dgos 'dug ’’zer bzhin tshe skyabs la mde'u lnga dang rdzas mgyogs rwa gang sbyin/dbang chen gyi ngos nas bshad na rdzas mdel de dag ni tshe skyabs la rbad de yid ches pa'i mtshon tshul zhig yin pa dang / tshe skyabs kyi ngos nas bshad na de ni da res kho tsho dang lhan du 'gro ba'i go skabs ma byung ba'i sems gso dang / dbang chen gyis rang la yid ches pa'i mtshon tshul yin pas sems 336

'gul tshad med thebs te gus zhabs ldan pa'i sgo nas rdzas mdel de dag lag gnyis kyis len pa'i tshul la bltas na mgyogs rwa de ni 'jig rten na gnyis su ma mchis pa'i g.yang ṭi nag po'i bum pa zhig dang / mde'u lnga ni rnyed par dka' zhing shin tu rtsa che ba'i 'chi med lha'i ril bu lnga dang mtshungs/mgron po rnams rang gnas su log rjes dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘a pha/ khyod tshos tshe skyabs ma khrid kyang nga nges par du khrid dgos ’’zhes zhu ba 'then/bkra shis g.yang chags kyis ‘‘da res sde dpon gyis shig gsod par sta re 'phyar mi rung zer ba khyod kyis ma thos sam ’’zhes bshad zhor du sha tig gcig bcad de dgra 'dul la sbyin/dgra 'dul sun snang skyed de ‘‘a tsi/ khyod tsho bud med kyis ci shes kyi yod ’mices bkra shis g.yang chags kyis sprad pa'i sha tig de'ang ma blangs par dbang chen gyi phyogs su nud tsam byas nas ‘‘a pha/ 'o na khyod sdod/ khyod kyi tshab tu nga 'gro ’’zhes u tshugs brgyab/dbang chen gyis mgo bo 'phred du g.yug gin ‘‘ngas snga sa nas sde dpon la dgra sha len rogs byed rgyu'i dam bca' bzhag yod pas nga ma song na ga la 'grig ’’zer/dgra 'dul gyis a na u tshugs kyi sgo nas ‘‘pha bu gnyis su song yang gcig pa red pā/ ngas bltas na khyad par yod kyi ma red ’’ces rang gis rgyu mtshan mang po shes khul byas kyang dbang chen gyis ‘‘da khyod rang rnyog gra ma shod/de bas nga'i me mda' de gtsang mar phyis dang ’’zhes sbra'i phub kar la bcings pa'i me mda' de tshur blangs te mgo nas mjug bar myong rol lan 'ga' byas rjes dgra 'dul gyi lag tu bzhag nas ‘‘phyi nang gnyis ka gtsang mar phyis dang ’mizer/dbang chen gyis sna ru blangs te lag g.yon ma'i mthe bong gi sen mo'i 337

steng du sna tha blugs/ lag g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang ldag mdzub gnyis kyis sna tha cung zad cig blangs te rna ba'i bar du 'phyar zhing lag g.yon ma'i sor mo gcig thog gcig brtsegs nang du 'khyil ba bang rim lta bu de brang kha'i thang du sbyar ba'i tshul ni nyon mongs dug gsum gyi dgra bo las rnam par rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan zhig dang mtshungs/khos de ltar dgra 'dul gyis me mda'i phyi nang gang sar phyis pa'i tshul la yud tsam bltas rjes ‘‘sir ’’zhes lag g.yas pa'i ldag mdzub dang mthe bong sna khung g.yas pa'i sgor sbyar nas 'then/bkra shis g.yang chags kyis ‘‘sang nyin 'gro bar gro dug tshod dgos sam ’’zhes dris par dbang chen gyis ‘‘gro dgos kyi ma red ’’zer/bkra shis g.yang chags kyis ‘‘gro med na ga 'dra ’’dgra 'dul gyis de'i tshig mjug 'phrog ste ‘‘kho tshos ya med spun gsum gyi sa nas za gi yin zer gyi yod red ’’ces bshad/dbang chen gyis ‘‘kho tsho mi gsum tshe gcig ldeng ba'i zas gos yod na nga tsho gsum nyin gcig ldeng ba'i zas gos los yod ’mices bshad rjes chang phor zhabs dag rgyag pa ltar lag g.yon ma'i sen mo'i steng gi sna tha yongs sna khung g.yas par blugs te gtsang mar 'then rjes mgrin pa gzengs su gtod de ‘‘a ha ci ’’zhes sbrid pa 'brug stong grags pa lta bu zhig brgyab pas kha chu'i zegs ma thab nang du 'thor te ‘‘tshir tshir tshir ’’zhes grags pa dang bkra shis g.yang chags 'drogs tsam byas/ nyi ma de yi phyi nyin shar skya rengs skya mda' ma btang gong sde dpon tshang gi pho g.yog mo g.yog dang / tshe skyabs/ dbang chen gyi bu dgra 'dul () gro ni byang rigs kyi yul skad du rgyags phye yi don/338

bcas kyi bzhon rta gsum sde dpon dang don grub dbang chen gsum gyi sgor btags te sga srab legs par spras/ rnga mar rnga mdud brgyab/ me mda'i nang du rdzas mdel dang rna rdzas blugs te rna khebs brgyab nas thon chog chog gi gra sgrig byas/sde dpon dang / dbang chen don grub gsum zhogs zas legs par grub rjes khri gdugs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbang phyogs lhun po'i spo nas 'char te ri lung gang sar ser thing thing du gyur/ kho tsho gsum me mda' rgyab tu khur rta bo 'og tu bzhon nas sde ba las thon/sde ba'i nang gi khyim tshang so so'i sbra 'dabs su bsang btang ste du ba sngo lhog lhog tu 'phyur ba dang / gzhis sdod tshang mas g.yul 'gyed la rgyal kha thob rgyu'i bkra shis smon lam btab/dgra 'dul dang / tshe skyabs gnyis 'gro 'dod kyi 'dun pa 'gog thabs med par gyur te lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i pho brang gi srung dmag ltar rang rang gi sgo 'gram du me mda' bzung nas krong nger langs nas ring du gshegs pa'i skya mi gsum por mig gi skyel ma yun ring byas/sngar ya med spun brgyad kyi dus nas bzung sde ba phyi nang gi mi tshang mar dpa' dpung pa kho na ngom srol yod pas sde ba'i mi su 'dra zhig yin yang kho tsho grogs sgrig 'gro 'ong med pa dang dbyar dgun ston dpyid sa cha gang du phyin yang kho tsho dang grong rogs byed mkhan med pas deng skabs kyang nye 'khor du grong rogs khyim mtshes gcig kyang med par kher 'dug byas nas 'dugad lta bu spun gsum ga nang du bsdad de za 'thung dang / lab gleng gis dus bskyal gyin yod pa 'dra ste/ mdun gyi na thang du phyugs rigs dkar nag phra gsum bkrams nas 'dug mod de khrod du rdzi bo gcig kyang mi 'dugasbra yi steng nas du ba sngo lhog lhog tu 'phyur gyin 'dug pas mo rigs kyis 339

dben pa'i khyim tshang de 'byor phyug ldan pa zhig yin pa nges gtan red/kho tsho la nyag der rta las 'bab ste rta sga yi glo smed bsdam skyor byas/de nas tshang ma'i slog pa'i sked rags bcings skyor byas pa dang me mda'i mchu yi kha dil blangs shing me lcags brdab nas sbi sdir me spar te skra yi steng du brdar tsam byas rjes tshang ma rta yi steng du bzhon/ lag g.yon mas rta yi srab dang me mda' bzung / lag g.yas kyis lcag tshan 'phyar te dus gcig tu 'phangs pa'i mda' mo gsum dang 'dra bar yid gnyis the tshom med par ya med spun gsum tshang gi phyogs su shor/dbang chen sngon dang / de rjes sde dpon dang de rjes don grub byas te shor nas sbra dang thag nyer slebs kyang ya med spun gsum da dung za 'thung dang gtam gleng la mgo 'khor nas yod stabs mi gcig kyang mthong rgyu mi 'dugade mar tshang mas lcag tshan sked par gzer nas lag gnyis kyis me mda' bzung nas ‘‘ki hi hi/’’‘‘ki hi hi/’’‘‘ki hi hi/’’dgra ki rgyag bzhin sbra yi mtha' bskor nas rgyugasprinabyi'u mgo tsam med par thog sta re tsam lhung zhes pa'i dpe ltar glo bur gyi dgra ki des bu spun gsum ka hon thor bar bzos nas tshang ma kha gdang mig bgrad kyis re zhig 'gul skyod kyi dbang rtsa nyams pa ltar rengs por lus/da dung mi mthong rgyu med pas dbang chen gyis yang bskyar ‘‘ki hi hi ’mizhes dgra ki brgyab/sde dpon gyis ‘‘kho re ya med spun gsum shi ba'i ro min na don shog ’’ces skad brgyab/340

tshang mas de ni rong pa sde gsar gyi btsan lha yin par shes te sked gri bzung nas sgor don dus smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa zhig la me mda' ru ring lag tu thogs pa'i rta pa gsum gyis sbra'i mtha' las skor ba skor gin 'dug pas ya med spun gsum rang sar langs te skor ba bskor gyin kho tsho gsum po rgyug sa'i phyogs su bltas nas sdod pa las ya lan sprod pa'i spobs pa dang bral/kho tshos da dung ‘‘ki hi hi/ ki hi hi ’’zhes dgra ki rgyag gin sbra yi mtha' bskor nas rgyug gin 'dugade ltar dgra ki rgyag gin sbra'i mtha' bskor nas lan mang rgyug rjes da gzod kho tsho gsum rta las babs te me mda'i mchu ya med spun gsum la gtad de ‘‘shog dang / bu dpa' bo yin na shog dang / khyod tshos rtag tu 'phya smod dang / brnyas bcos byed pa'i rgan mo ru ba la bu 'tshar yod/ da shog dang ’’ces sde dpon gom gang mdun du spos/'jigs su rung ba'i me mda'i kha dang / du ba sngo lhog lhog tu 'phyur ba'i sbi sdi mthong bas ya med spun gsum dpa' zhum nas lag nang gi sked gri kho tsho gsum gyi mdun du g.yug nas ‘‘sku mkhyen tshe thar gtong rogs/ sngar byas kyi spyod ngan thams cad thol bshag byas nas slad khyod tsho'i tshe g.yog byas kyang chog ’’ces a dar dang / chos dar gnyis kyis mthe bong ra rnga ltar ker te zhu ba 'then byung / 'brug dar gyis gang yang mi shod par dbang chen la bltas nas 'dugasde dpon btsan lha dang / don grub gnyis kyis gom gang mdun du spos nas ‘‘he he/ gnyen nye ba'i sha 'khon brjed na skyes pa pho yi gras su sdod rin ci yod/ sngon ma gzhan rgyu'i don du rang srog shor ba'i spun mched tsho'i dgra sha len rtsis med pa red dam ri’zhes 'phya smod byas/341

a dar dang / chos dar gnyis kyis pus mo'i lha nga sa ru btsugs te ‘‘tshe thar gtong rogs/ tshe thar gtong rogs ’’zhes zhu ba 'then byung /'brug dar da dung 'jim sku ji bzhin 'gul skyod med par langs nas 'dug pas sde dpon gyis me mda'i mchu 'brug dar la gtad de ‘‘pho khyo ga zhig yin bzo 'dug 'on kyang khyod kyi dbang rtsa nyams nas 'gul skyod byed bde po med pa 'dra/ ngas sngon la khyod rang 'gul skyod byed rgyu yod pa zhig bzo dgos ’ zhes me mda' gzes te 'jigs skul byas pas ‘‘kho re/ sdug pus sa ru tshugs ’’zhes 'brug dar gyi gnya' ba las gnan te pus mo sa ru 'dzugs bcug de nas dpral ba yang sa ru sbyar gyin ‘‘rong pa rong pa sde gsar gyi dpon dpon btsan lha khyed thugs khag med mi byed rgu byed byed mkhan nga tsho rang yin/ dus de ring tshe tshe thar gtong rogs/ sku mkhyen mi’zhes ngu ngag gis zhu ba 'then byung /dbang chen gyis sde dpon gyi rna bar kha sbyar nas ‘‘kho tshos 'di ltar zhu ba byed dus pho dpa' bo la'ang snying rje zhig dgos pas da kho tshor me mda'i mchu ldag chugs/ de nas tshe thar btang na ga 'dra 'dug mi’ces gros 'dri ba'i tshul gyis de ltar brjod/sde dpon gyis re zhig gang yang ma bshad par mno bsam gtong bzhin dbugs ring 'then/ dbang chen gyis sde dpon la ci zhig bshad yod pa ya med spun gsum gyis ma shes kyang rang nyid tshe thar gtong ba'i re ba chen po'i sgo nas tsi tsis byi la mthong ba ltar grags 'gul med par kho tsho gsum la bltas nas 'dugasde dpon gyis me mda' mar phab nas ‘‘khyod tsho da dung 'jig rten mi yul du bsdad de/ gsal nyi zla gnyis mthong 'dod na nga tsho'i brla bar nas phar gcig dang tshur gcig song ’’zhes bshad de rkang pa gnyis grad grad byas/342

‘‘lags so/ lags so ’’zhes ya med spun gsum gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis sde dpon btsan lha'i rkang pa gnyis kyi bar nas gog bgrod byed kyin phar thengs gcig dang tshur thengs gcig nud de song /shin tu mi 'os pa'i brnyas bcos de myong rjes ya med spun gsum da dung pus mo sa ru btsugs nas 'dug mod gdong gshis da gin las cung zad yag tu phyin 'dugade nas sde dpon gyis yang skad shugs chen po'i sgo nas ‘‘hung /gdon 'dre gsum tshe thar gtong bar las sla po de 'dra ga la yod/ khyod tsho ngo ma gson 'jig rten du sdod 'dod na nga tsho'i me mda'i mchu ldag dgos ’’zhes bshad de me mda'i mchu a dar la gtad/ don grub kyis me mda'i mchu chos dar la gtad/ dbang chen gyis me mda'i mchu 'brug dar la gtad/kho tsho gsum pos pus mo sa ru btsugs te 'dzem bag med pa'i sgo nas rang rang gi phyogs su gtad pa'i me mda'i mchu lce yis ldagasde dpon gyi klad pa'i nang glo bur du ‘‘bu bu btsan lha khyed kyis sde ba 'di byis pa bzhin skyong nas nga'i ched du ma red nga dang de ring rkyen lam du song ba'i yul mi yongs kyi ched du dgra sha len rogs ya med spun brgyad (don du da lta spun gsum las med ) tshar gcod ma thub na khyod skyes pa pho yi gral du sdod rin med nges par du dgra sha de len dgos/ nga'i dbugs rta rnga tsam 'di ma chad gong khyod khyod kyis khas len gyi yin nam min/khas ma blangs na nga shi dur khung du song yang mig btsum mi thub da khyod kyis khas len gyi yin nam min/ri’‘‘a pha/ ngas khas len gyi yin/ dgra sha de ma blangs na nga bu min ’’zhes pa'i skad cha de rna lam du yang yang 'khor/343

ya med spun gsum ni 'jig rten gyi khams su shin tu dkon pa'i bdud rtsi zhig rag pa ltar me mda'i mchu ldag gin 'dug‘‘twa/’’ ‘‘twa/’’me mda'i skad gnyis grags pa dang dus mnyam a dar dang chos dar gnyis klad zho skya chi ler thor te gan rkyal du shi song /dbang chen ha las hang sang gis mig hur re sde dpon la bltas nas 'dugasde dpon gyis dbang chen gyi phrag par bcag tsam byas nas ‘‘thabs shes mi 'dug ngas gson lag tsha mos pha dam pa'i 'chi lag grang mo 'jus te dgra sha de len rgyu yin zhes khas blangs pa yin/ pho dpa' bo la'ang snying rje dgos pa ngas shes kyi 'dug 'on kyang ngas pha dam pa 'chi khar khas blangs zin pas thabs shes mi 'dug ’’zer nas cung dogs mi bde ba'i ngang nas mgo bo thur du smad/'brug dar ni 'jim sku ji bzhin ngo gdong las dga' skyo dang /'jigs skrag zhe sdang / sdug bsngal la sogs kyi rnam 'gyur gang yang med pa ma zad tha na rang gi spun mched gnyis bsad pa'ang ma shes pa ltar sngar bzhin dbang chen gyi me mda'i mchu ldag gin 'dugasde dpon gyis ‘‘da gsod/ kho gcig pu tshe thar btang bas ci phan ’’zer/ dbang chen gyis ‘‘khyod gnyis kyi dgra sha ni blangs zin/ da 'di bsad pas ci phan/ de bas kho nged tsho'i rta brtod khyi 'dogs byed mkhan gyi g.yog por nyar na ci 'dra 'dug ’’ces bshad de me mda' mar phabs/‘‘spyang phrug gsos pas sgo khyi mi 'ong / da 'o na kho tshe thar thongs ’’zhes sde dpon gyis me mdar rdzas mdel blugs zhor du de ltar brjod/dbang chen gyis snying rje byas te kho ma bsad kyang 'brug dar gyi sems su 344

de ni snying rje skyed pa min par dma' 'bebs dang mthong chung gis gsod rin med par rkang btsugs nas ngo tsha nyo ru bcug pa red snyams nas phar tsam song ba dang yang kho'i sems su sngar stag phrug tshang las don 'dra'i bu spun brgyad yod pa las da ni nga ma gtogs 'jig rten mi yul du lhag pa gcig kyang med/nga gson por bsdad kyang mi kun gyi 'phya smod byed yul du gyur ba red/ khos nga mi gsod pa yang kun gyi 'phya smod byed yul du 'jog dgos snyams pa las snying rje skyed pa zhig ga la yin/ kho dang nga tsho'i bar la khab skud tsam gyi rtsod gzhi med kyang kha sngon don med nga la brnyas bcos kyis me mda'i mchu ldag bcug mi kho la snying rje yod mi srid/ da res nga mi gsod pa yang brnyas bcos kyis gsod rin med pa'i gras su bzhag nas kun gyi 'phya smod byed yul du bzhag pa red/ nga gcig pu gson por bsdad pas ci phan snyams nas glo bur du rdo phug ron tsam zhig sgrug nas brgyab pa dbang chen gyi rkang pa g.yas kyi rje ngar la thebs pas dbang chen na zug ma bzod par gan rkyal du 'gyel/‘‘a khu dbang chen ’’zhes don grub kyis de mar me mda' sa ru g.yug ste dbang chen skyor/sde dpon gyis ‘‘twa ’’zhes me mda' brgyab nas 'brug dar 'jig rten phyi ma'i gzigs mor brdzangs/‘‘a ru ru ’’zhes dbang chen don grub kyis skyor nas langs thabs byas kyang rkang pa g.yas pa sa ru 'dzugs thub kyi mi 'dug sde dpon dang don grub gnyis kyis lag pa g.yas g.yon nas bskyor te ga ler sbra de'i nang du song / sbra yi nang du khal sga dang / gyon chas/ sha blugs pa'i sgye mo sogs gral 'grig por brtsigs pa dang / sgo 'gram gyi rdo leb nar mo'i lcog tse'i steng du ja blugs pa'i phor pa dang / sha bzas 'phro yang mang po bzhag 'dugasde dpon dang / don grub gnyis kyis slog pa gcig rgyab bsnyes su 345

bzhag nas dbang chen ga ler gdan steng du rkang pa gnyis mdun du bsnar nas bzhag thab nang du me mdag dmar hur rer 'dug pas don grub kyis lam seng rang khyim du slebs pa ltar thab nang du lci ba blugs nas ja bskol/dbang chen gyi rkang mgo ga ler 'gul skyod byed thub kyi 'dug pas rus pa chag nas dum bu gnyis su gyur med pa shes/ 'on kyang rus gas btang pa gtan 'khel yin pas de mar sde dpon dang / don grub gnyis kyis shing gi phur pa kha shas leb mor bshag nas dbang chen la chag bcings byed rtsis kyis dbang chen gyi lham phud nas blta dus rje ngar gyi steng du sgor rgya ja phor gyi che chung dang 'dra ba'i sngo thig cig yod pa dang / rkang pa nas pus mo'i bar du skrangs nas 'dug pas sde dpon gyis rkang pa skrangs pa'i steng du ga ler mdzub mo 'dzugs kyin du ‘‘snying rje skyed che na zhe sdang gi rgyun mi chad ces pa cis mi bden/ spyang ki lta bu'i mi de dag la snying rje byed mi rung ’rizer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘de ngas skye ba sngon ma chad pa'i bu lon zhig yin gyi red/rkang pa chag mi 'dug pas skyon chen po yong mi srid mimizer/don grub kyi rogs pa'i 'og sde dpon gyis dbang chen gyi rje ngar gyi rgyab mdun g.yas g.yon gang sar shing thur leb mo gral 'grig por bsgrigs nas rtsid skud kyis yang skor bskyar skor dam por dkris te chag bcings byas/da lta rkang pa pus mo'i bar skrangs pas dbang chen la bzod glags bral ba'i na zug med kyang 'gro skyod byed thabs bral bas sde dpon gyis don grub la sha lhu gcig sprad de ‘‘khyed rang mgyogs po lto bzas te lam seng phar log nas dgra 'dul dang / tshe skyabs/ nyi ma/ lha dga' kho tsho khrid shog de ltar ma byas na da lta dbang chen gyi rkang par rmas skyon phog pas nga tsho phar log thub kyi ma red/ khyod kyis dbang chen gyi rkang par rdo zhig phog nas 'gro skyod 346

mi bde ba tsam las gnas tshul tshabs chen red ces brjod mi rung ’’zer/don grub kyis sha za bzhin mno bsam cung zad btang nas ‘‘nga da lta phar log na do dgong nam dkyil ma zin tsam las slebs mi thub/ da lta nyi ma nyin gung zin nyer yod pas de bas zla ba tshang du song na lam thag nye ba yod ’’ces bshad/‘‘tag tag red/ a khu zla ba tshang du song nas gnas tshul yongs shod/de nas mi gsum tsam zhig rogs par gtong rogs zhes shod dang / khong gis rogs pa byed nges red/ a tsi ngas rbad de brjed pa red ’’zer/don grub de mar me mda' rgyab tu khur nas rta pho lcag gis brab nas thad kar zla ba tshang gi phyogs su skyod/dbang chen gyis sde dpon la ‘‘zla ba zhes pa su red/ ming de ngas go myong 'dug ’’ces 'dri bzhin sna ru bton te mthe bong g.yon ma'i sen mo'i steng blugs/sde dpon btsan lha cung dogs mi bde ba'i sgo nas 'dzum tsam byas nas ‘‘de khyod kyis go los myong / khyod dang a tsi/ kho sde ba 'di'i sde dpon yin khul red/ 'on kyang ya med spun brgyad kyi 'og tu kho la bza' ba'i bza' dpon las sde tsho par jus bkod byed dbang med/ kho ni nga'i pha dam pa de'i sru mo'i phru gu chung shos de red/ khyod tsho nga tsho'i dbyar mtsher rtswa thang du slebs pa'i skabs de dus khong nga tsho'i nang du gnyen 'phrad du slebs yod/ khong gi ngo gdong de mi phal pas bltas na gdug tsub che zhing btsan grags can zhig yod pas de nyin don grub dang kha sngon 'das pa de (grags pa khri srong )gnyis kyi rogs par 'gro rogs zhes bshad pa yin/ a tsi/ da de'i skor mi lab/ ngo yang tsha ’’zhes sde dpon ngo gnong par gyur/dbang chen gyis skabs de'i gnas tshul dran sos te ‘‘da ngas dran song /347

ngo gdong sgor sgor zhi mi dang 'dra ba/ za 'gram g.yas g.yon gang sar sma ra skyes pa/ mig rtsa shin tu dmar ba de red pa ’’zhes dris/sde dpon gyis thab nang du lci ba blugs zhor du ‘‘tag tag red/ de red/ de ring ya med spun gsum tshar bcad pa shes dus kho dga' nas smyo grabs byed kyi red ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘de nyin khyod tsho'i skya mi gsum nged tsho'i sar yong dus jag pa gsum slebs 'dug snyams nas nga tsho sems khral chen po byung ’’zer/sde dpon gyis ‘‘dbyar mtsher gyi sar sngar med kyi grong pa gcig slebs 'dug ces nga tsho'i rdzi bos bshad dus/ yang ya med spun gsum lta bu'i btsan shed can zhig min nam snyams nas nga tsho yang sems khral chen po byung /'on kyang nga tsho sde ba gcig gi nang du mnyam du bsdad de phyi dgra ma lus kun bcom ste sde ba gzhan gyi mdun du snyan grags khyab pa 'di tshe sngon tshogs bsag gi dam tshig yin pa smros med red ’’zer/de nas ja 'khol song bas sde dpon gyis rtsam khug btsal te dbang chen la ja ldur dang sha bster/ ja ldud de gces phrug bzhin bskyangs/sa ma rub tsam la sde dpon gyis nor lug gi khyu lhas su bskong / rta gnyis por khebs bkabs shing brtod kha spos/sa ma rub tsam la don grub zla ba tshang du slebs te rta las babs te phan tshun bde 'tshams kyi khams 'dri yang byed khom med par ‘‘a khu zla ba/ ya med spun gsum nga tshos bsad tshar/ tshang ma bsad pa yin ’’zhes dga' spro rab tu 'khol te de ltar bshad/zla bas rang gis go nor thebs pa min nam snyam nas ‘‘a/ ga re/cig shod dang ’’zhes rna ba g.yas pa yang don grub kyi phyogs su gtad de nyan dus rang gis go 'dzol thebs med pa shes pas ‘‘pho rab/ pho rab/ gtam 348

bzang de 'dra zhig ngas de ring ma gtogs go ga la myong / nang du shoganang du shog ’’ces don grub kyi lag nang gi srab mda' kho rang gi bu rgod phrug gi lag tu bzhag nas rta sga blangs te rta chu ldud/ de nas rtswa yag sa zhig tu thod ’’ces bshad rjes don grub kyi lag pa nas bzung ste nang du khrid de ‘‘ya/ga 'dra byas nas bsad pa yin/ sde dpon khyed gnyis gcig pu yin nam/sde dpon gyis khyod nga'i sar gtam bzang shod par mngags byung ngam ’’zhes gna' sgrung nyan rgyur dga' ba'i byis pa zhig ltar don grub kyi 'gram du bsdad nas don grub kyi skad char nyan/don grub kyis ‘‘nga gnyis gcig pu min/ rogs par dbang chen yod/’’‘‘dbang chen zhes pa su red/’’‘‘gzhes ning nga tsho'i sde bar mgo btags zhu mkhan de red/’’‘‘'o/ me mda' yod pa'i mi de red dam/’’ ‘‘red/’’pho rab tsho da 'grigs song / mi ngan la dbang yod na bstan pa mer bsregs zhes pa ltar mi ngan de tsho tshar gcod ma thub na yul sde mi gsum skyid nyi ma gcig kyang rig sa ma red/’’ces bshad zhor don grub kyi me mda' der lag pas reg tsam byas nas ‘‘kha sngon khyed tshos jag tshogs shig rtsa med btang ste me mda' mang po thob pa'i gtam bzang go dus bkra shis bde legs zhu bar bcar bsam yang bstan dgra gsum pos (ya med spun gsum ) shes na rnyog gra slong gi red bsam nas 'gro nus ma byung ’’zer/ de nas don grub kyis kho tshos ji ltar byas nas ya med spun gsum bsad pa dang / dbang chen gyi rje ngar la rmas skyon byung stangs/ de bzhin da res rang nyid yong don sogs 'go nas mjug bar zla ba la bshad/349

phyi nyin nyin gung ma zin tsam la don grub dang / zla ba/ zla ba'i bu rgod phrug dang ldan ma bcas sde dpon dang / dbang chen gyi sar slebs/ya med spun gsum ji ltar tshar bcad pa'i skor don grub kyis mdang nub kho la mgo nas mjug bar bshad tshar yang zla ba da dung nyan 'dod kyi spro ba 'phel nas ‘‘ya/ a khu'i tsha bu/ pho rab tsho/ khyod tshos ga 'dra byas nas bsad pa yin/ khyod tshos me mda'i mchu ldog zer dus kho tshos ga 'dra byed kyi 'dug kho tsho skrag snang ga 'dra 'dug ’’ces yang yang dris pas sde dpon gyis mgo nas mjug bar kho la thengs gcig bshad/de nas kho tshos sbra dang sha mar rtsam phyur sogs zas kyi rigs su gyur ba dang de bzhin pags pa dang zas snod sogs ma lus pa g.yag la bkal/gyon pa'i rigs su gyur ba tshang ma bskyur/ dbang chen rta la bskyon nas zla bas rta kha khrid de kho tsho sngon du song / rgod phrug dang / ldan ma gnyis kyis nor lug ded de rjes nas song /kho tsho lho yi la nyag gi steng nas thon pa dang dgra 'dul dang / tshe skyabs gnyis byis pas yun ring bral ba'i rang gi pha mthong ba ltar mdun bsu bar rgyugagam du slebs dus rang gi pha dbang chen gyi rta mi gdong dbyibs sgor sgor byas pa'i steng du sma ra zang zing du skyes pa zhig gis khrid pa dang / rkang pa g.yas pa'i pus mo'i bar du bal phying gis btums te brla sha las sbom par 'dug pas rmas skyon phog pa shes te dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘a pha/ a pha/ gang gang byas pa red ’’ces ngu ngag gis 'bod kyin du dbang chen la 'khyud/dbang chen gyis dgra 'dul gyi phrag par bcag tsam byas nas ‘‘skyon mi 'dugaskyon mi 'dug sems khral ma byed ’’ces sems gso byas/sde dpon gyis dgra 'dul mchan 'og tu bzung nas ‘‘kho'i rje ngar gyi 350

steng du rdo phog nas gcog grabs byas 'dug gnas tshul tshabs chen ma red ’’ces gsal bshad byas/tshe skyabs kyis skad gdangs dma' bo'i sgo nas ‘‘kha seng nga gnyis khrid na tag tag red ang ’’zhes dgra 'dul gyi phyogs su blta tsam byas/dbang chen gyis ‘‘hwa hwa/ bskos pa'i las de bros pas mi thar/ rgas pa'i gnyer ma phyis pas mi dag zer srol yod pas khyod gnyis lta ci/ stong dmag cig khrid yod kyang ldog thabs med/ 'di ni ngas tshe sngon mar chad pa'i bu lon red ’’zer/‘‘gcog grabs byas 'dug ’rices par yid ma ches par dgra 'dul sems khral chen po'i sgo nas ‘‘chag yod pa gtan gtan red/ khyod tshos nga la gsang ba byas pa red ’’ces chag bcings byas pa'i dbang chen gyi rkang par byil byis byas/‘‘chag mi 'dug ’’ces don grub kyis gsal bshad byas kyang kho da dung yid ma ches par ‘‘chag med na chag bcings byed dgos don ci yod ’’zer/don grub kyis ‘‘ngo ma chag mi 'dug mag spun khyed sems khral ma byed/phal cher rus gas btang yod na'i chog ’’ces gsal bshad ga tshod byas kyang dgra 'dul yid ma ches par skad cha de dag ni kho la sems gso byas pa red/phying pa'i phyi sgril de gshig na a pha'i rkang pa de 'jigs su rung ba ga 'dra zhig yod/ chag nas dum bu gnyis su gyur pa kho thag red snyam bzhin phying pas btums pa'i rkang par blta dus phying pa'i phyi ru sim 'dzul byas pa'i khrag rjes ni sen mo'i sgor rgya tsam yang mthong rgyu med kyang da ni a pha'i rkang pa dgra lag tu shor nas mi tshe rkang gyol du chags pa red snyams pa las kho tsho'i skad char yid ches ma byas/ sde nang du 'byor dus mi rgan gzhon phal che ba gdong bsu bar yong nas 351

phan tshan khams 'dri byas pa dang / de nas tshang ma dbang chen gyi phyogs su raring ///sdi 1)nge/rub nas/‘‘rkang pa byas pa da/’’‘‘rmas pa red dam/’’‘‘chag pa yin gyi red/ chag bcings byas 'dug’’‘‘gri brgyab pa red dam/’ritwetwegri brgyaḍi pa yin gyi red/ kho tshor me mda' ni med pa ’’dbang chen gyis ‘‘khyed tshos zer na nga'i rkang pa chag pa red zer ram/chag med/ rmas skyon yang phog ma byung / phying lham 'di ster bzo mi 'dug gam ’’zhes ku re shod pa las rgyu mtshan ma bshad/sgo 'gram du slebs dus dgra 'dul dang / sde dpon/ don grub/tshe skyabs/ zla ba sogs kyis la las sked pa nas bzung / la las lag pa gnyis nas 'jus/ la las sems chung gis rkang pa g.yas pa yar 'degs kyin du dbang chen rta'i rgyab nas ga ler phabs te g.yas skyor g.yon skyor byas nas nang du khrid/tshul de mthong bas 'o ma skyid kyis dbang chen la rmas skyon tshabs chen phog pa 'dra snyams nas gos mtha' lag pas brdzes te rgyug nas dbang chen tshang du 'dzul te rkang pa g.yas pa ma gtogs skyon med pa shes pas sems cung lhod par gyur nas ‘‘a tsi/ rkang pa rkang pa ’’zhes 'go med mjug med kyi skad cha 'ga' dris/dbang chen gyis 'o ma skyid kyi skad char lad zlos byed kyin du ‘‘rkang pa rkang pa phying lham phying lham gyon yod ri’ces ku re bshad kyang gad mo dgod mkhan gcig kyang mi 'dug bkra shis g.yang chags dbang chen gyi rkang pa sbom po de mthong ba tsam 352

gyis 'jigs skrag skyed de de phyogs su blta ma nus par brel 'tshub 'tshub kyis thab las byed pa dang / de nas phor pa zhig gi nang du mar dang phyur ba blugs te spags zhim po zhig g.yos te 'chang bu re re bzhin bcangs nas ‘‘a pha/ de zo dang ’’zhes dbang chen gyi lag tu bzhag pa dang / de nas der yod tshang mar ja blugs/sde dpon dbang chen gyi gam du bsdad de thag pa'i sne las bkrol te rkang par dkris pa'i phying pa de'i sgril bshigs/ phying pas btums pa'i rkang pa'i chag kha nas khrag dmar bzhur gyi red snyams nas tshang ma rub rub byas te mig hrig ger bltas/sde dpon gyis yun ring nyar tshags byas pa'i mes po'i shul bzhag rtsa chen zhig kun gyi mig gi longs spyod du sbyin pa ltar rkang par dkris pa'i thag pa bkrol te phying pa'i sgril de ga ler bshigs dus rje ngar gyi steng du chag bcings stabs bde zhig byas pa las rma rjes khrag rjes gang yang mthong rgyu med pas dgra 'dul dga' thag chod de ‘‘ngo ma chag med pa 'dra/ nga da gin zhe drag skrag byung ’’zhes brjod/ dbang chen gyi rkang 'go 'gul tsam 'gul tsam byas nas ‘‘chag mi 'dug gal srid chag pa yin na 'gul thub kyi ma red ’’zer/dgra 'dul gyis lam seng rkang pa'i 'og tu slog pa rnying hrul las bcad pa'i pags gdan zhig bting / sde dpon gyis ‘‘do dgong lug lhas su bskong rjes chung por chag bcings yag po zhig byed rogs zer dgos/ ngas chag bcings yag po byed shes kyi med ’’ces bshad de gzhi nas zla ba dang lhan du rang khyim du logasde dpon gyi chung ma bcas pas snga sa nas sgo 'gram du langs te lag gnyis kyis phye mar dang chang phor bzung ste sgugs nas 'dug mod/ da gin 353

rang gi ched du dbang chen gyi rkang par rmas skyon phog pas sems khral gyis 'gro zhor du phye mar gyi rtsam skya mtshon byed tsam du zas tsam byas pa dang chang phor lag tu blangs te gtsang mar btung nas nang du 'dzul/de mar g.yog 'gas lag gnyis kyis btegs te kha sngon nas gra sgrig byas pa'i sgug sha dang sgug thud mdun du bzhag zla bas 'dzem bag med pa'i sgo nas glo gri dngul shan bton nas za bzhin ‘‘'brug dar de mar bsad na kho rang gi rkang par rmas skyon phog don yod ma red/ de ma bsad pa ni kho rang gis 'chug pa red ’’ces sngar ya med spun brgyad kyis brnyas bcos sha stag byas pa'i 'khon 'dzin da dung ma 'jags par shi ming 'bod de bshad/sde dpon gyis ‘‘dbang chen gyis snying rje byas drags song ’’zer/zla bas ‘‘snying rje byas drags na zhe sdang gi rgyun mi chad zer ba cis mi bden/ mi spyang de dag la snying rje byed rin ci yod ri’zer/dbang chen gyi rkang par bzod glags bral ba'i na zug mi 'dug la kho rang gi sems su'ang nga dang ya med spun gsum bar zhe 'khon gang yang med kyang brnyas bcos tshad med byas pa'i lan pa 'di red snyams pa dang tha na rang gi rje ngar la 'brug dar gyis rdo gzhus te rmas skyon phog pa de shin tu 'os shing 'tshams par bsam nas phar me mda'i mchu ldag tu bcug pa'i brnyas bcos dang / tshur rdo gzhus te rmas skyon phog pa de shin tu 'os shing 'tshams pa'i ngos 'dzin gyi thog nas de gnyis bre kha bcad kyang mtho dman dang rgya srang la gdeg kyang yang lci med snyams te sems lhod par gyur/ ngo ma lhag bsam zol med kyis de ltar bsam pa ma zad 'brug dar la khong khro mi langs pas mi tshad mtshon gyis bkum pa'i mi la skye ba lnga brgya ma song bar mi lus len rgyu med ang snyam pa'i snying rje'ang skyed/dgong mo rgod phrug dang / ldan ma gnyis kyis ded nas yong ba'i ya 354

med spun gsum gyi nor khyu dang / lug khyu sde bar slebs pas mi tshang ma nor lug gi khrod du phyin nas nor lug gi spu mdog dang / rwa dbyibs/ shed bzang ngan sogs gleng mol byed kyin 'dug de'i skabs sde dpon gyis lug rdzi chung po khrid nas dbang chen tshang du slebs/ de ring kho'i sked pa'i mtshams su slebs pa'i rang byung gi ral pa de bal skud sbom po zhig gis bsdams nas 'dug pa ni phyags ma rnying gog zhig dang 'dra/sde dpon gyis ‘‘a mye lug rdzi khyod nor lug rkang pa chag par chag bcings yag po byed shes kyi yod pas kho'i rkang par chag bcings yag po zhig byos dang ’’zer nas kho rang dbang chen gyi kha sprod du bsdad/lug rdzi chung pos ngo gdong gi gnyer ris gya ma gyu grangs las 'das pa'i khrod du ser ka las che tsam gyi 'dren byed kem kem du g.yo bzhin dbang chen gyi rkang pa'i steng gi skrangs 'bur la bltas nas ‘‘skrangs po che tsam 'dug ’’zer bzhin du rum las brdar rdo g.yag lce 'dra ba zhig blangs te skrangs po'i steng du brdar/ de nas rje ngar gyi steng du snam bu lheb tsam zhig dkris pa'i steng du kha seng sde dpon dang don grub gnyis kyis bzos pa'i chag bcings byed ched kyi shing leb nar mo de dag go rim ldan pa'i sgo nas dam lhod ran po zhig bsdams nas ‘‘'gul skyod ma byed/ rus gas shor 'dug pas rus khu mang tsam thungs dang lam seng drag yong / skyon chen po mi 'dug ’’zer/ya med spun gsum cham du phabs te thob pa'i rgyu dngos dang / phyugs rigs las tshe skyabs tshang la 'bri g.yag lnga dang / ra lug bcu sprad/ de byings tshang ma sde dpon tshang dang / dbang chen tshang / don grub tshang gsum por mang nyung med par bgos pa dang / sde dpon gyis ‘‘sbra de nga la dgos/ nga'i g.yog pho mo tsho nyal sa char chus sbang zhing rlung lhags kyis brdab ste rtsab hral du phyin 'dug pas kho tsho nyal sa brje dgos ’’zer/355

nyin bcu grangs phyin rjes dbang chen 'khar bar brten nas sgo phyi nang du 'gro thub kyi 'dug pas drag mgyogs po 'dug snyam nas tshang ma dga' spro skyed/lug rdzi chung pos nyin ltar dgong mo'am yang na zhogs pa dbang chen la lta bar thengs re yong gi yod/de nyin chung pos mig ser ka lta bu de kem kem du g.yo bzhin sbra'i sgo srub las yar bltas te ‘‘a khu dbang chen/ ga 'dra 'dug drag skyed 'dug gam ririzhes dris/de dus dbang chen da dung nyal nas yod pas de mar mgo mal chas las don te ‘‘drag tu phyin 'dug khyod yar nang du phebs ’’zer/chung po ga ler yar 'dzul te ‘‘ga 'dra 'dug ngas gcig lta ’’zer nas dbang chen gyi mal gos yar brdzes nas chag bcings bkrol nas blta dus skrangs zhom nas rgyun ldan gyi rkang pa dang mi 'dra ba med pa dang rje ngar steng gi rdo phog shul de yang mthong rgyu med pas ‘‘da chag bcings bkrol na yag pa 'dug 'on kyang 'gul skyod zhe drag ma byed ’rices bshad/bkra shis g.yang chags kyis chung por ja phor pa gang blugs pa dang dbang chen la ja phor pa gang dang / rus thang phor pa gang blugs/chung pos ‘‘rus thang da dung mu mthud thungs ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘khyed kyis chag bcings yag po de 'dra ga 'dra byas nas shes pa red ’’ces dris/chung pos ser ka las zhe drag mi che ba'i mig gis dbang chen la bltas nas chung byis pa lo brgyad nas bzung nor lug gi rdzi bo kho nar song bas skabs re ma bsam sa nas nor lug gi rkang lag la 'ur rdo'i rdo phog ste chag gi 'dug nor lug ni sbyin bdag gi yin pas rkang lag bcag na sbyin bdag 356
