gis mthong par dogs nas lam seng chag bcings byed kyi yod/ de ltar lo mang bsags pa'i nyams myong las gzhan gang yang shes kyi med ’’ces ha cang khengs skyung gis bshad de lag pas lag pa phur gyin bsdad/de ltar zla shas phyin pa na dbang chen gyi rkang pa gom pa spo skabs cung zad 'theng pa las rtsa ba'i cha nas drag yod kyang chung pos rbad de ma drag bar 'khar rgyug dor mi rung zhes bshad pas dbang chen gyis chung po'i khar nyan te gar song gar bsdad lus dang grib ma ji bzhin 'khar rgyug thogs te rkang pa g.yas pa sa ru 'dzugs skabs gzugs po'i ljid tshad 'khar rgyug la brten dgos byung /dpyid kyi drod rlung ldang ba'i tshe/ sa phyogs gang sar ljang mdog mngon zhes pa ltar nam zla nyin re bzhin dro ru phyin nas chu bo'i 'gram gang sar ljang thing thing gi rtswa gsar gyi khrod du me tog gi gang bu thar thor yang mthong rgyu 'dug pas dpyid tha ma'i dus tshigs de sngar rgyun bzhin rong pa rtswa thang du slebs pa mngon/ lhas ra'i nang du snga dgong lu gu'i 'ba' skad dang ma mo'i 'ba' skad lhang lhang du grags/ nyin dgung dang / dgong mo ma mo'i 'o ma 'jo ba dang / snga dro lu gu logs su phyes te 'tsho ba/ phyi dro lu gu dang ma mo mnyam du 'tsho ba/ dgong mo lu gu yongs khang bu zhes bya ba lci bas brtsigs pa'i 'jug khang du 'jug pa/ bud med rnams 'o ma skol ba/ zho dkrog pa sogs dkar chu 'o ma'i dbyar mtsho rgyas shing mi rnams las brel che ru phyin/sngar sde dpon btsan lha tshang gi sger bdag dbyar mtsher de 'di lo nas bzung khyim dud bzhi ka'i dbyar mtsher du gyur nas rim gyis dbyar mtsher rtswa thang du skyas spo byas te khyim dud bzhi po phan tshun bar thag nges can yod pa byas nas bsdad/ sde dpon tshang gi g.yog pho mo las khyim gyi mi gcig kyang 357

'gro srol med pas da res 'gro khar sde dpon gyis dbang chen la/ ‘‘dbyar mtsher du sdod pa'i ring pha gir don dag che chung gang byung yang khyod kyis 'go 'dren byos/’’zhes mngags bcol byas/dbyar mtsher gyi rtswa thang du khyim dud bzhi ka'i phyugs dkar nag tshang ma yod pas sngar bas 'khrug cha dod cing nyams dga' ba/ mdzes sdug ldan par gyur/ rong pa sde gsar gyi khyim dud gzhan kha shas kyang lung pa de'i lho byang shar gsum gyi spang ri'i phar phyogs su dbyar mtsher babs/ sngar rgan mo ru ba zhes kun gyis brnyas bcos bya yul gyi sde tsho des na ning nas bzung yul lung bde ru mi 'jug mkhan gyi phyi'i dgra jag dang / dpa' dpung pa kho na ngom mkhan tshang ma cham du phabs pas phyi nang sde ba'i mi tshang ma rang sa rang yul du sos dal bag phebs su 'tsho sdod las gnyer byed pa'i skal bzang shar/sngar rong pa sde gsar dang / lung skyid tsho pa gnyis sde 'dres yin pas bu phar 'gro mna' ma tshur len gyi gnyen 'brel rgyun ma chad par pho phyed pha dang a khu/ mo phyed ma dang sru mo'i mdza' bshes zab kyang bstan dgra ya med spun brgyad 'tshar longs byung ba nas bzung kho tshos dpung pa ngom nas sa mtshams su bsdad de rang sder gnya' gnon btsan shed dang / khrims 'gal lugs 'gal gyis rtswa chu gang legs kyi sa cha tshang ma sger bdag gis phyugs 'tsho skyong byed pa dang / khyim mtshes sde tsho'i rtswa thang du phyugs rigs rgya yan du btang nas rtswa za chu 'thung gis brnyas bcos tshad med byas pas sde tsho gnyis bar re zhig gnyen 'brel chad/da yang yul sde mi gsum bde sdod skyid 'tsho'i skal bzang shar bas khyim mtshes sde tsho'i gzhon nu pho mo mang po snyan grags kyi ba dan phyogs bcur g.yo ba'i rong pa sde gsar gyi gzhon nu la yid smon tshad med skyed de sha chang gi gnyen ston stabs bde las med pa'i sgo nas sde ba phan tshun bu dang bu mo 358

gtong len byed mkhan mang po byung /de'i tshe rong pa sde gsar gyi gzhon nu don grub kyang nyin rtag par ri ru phyugs rdzi'i skabs lung skyid tsho pa'i a khu blo ldan tshang gi bu mo 'brug mtsho dang ngo shes/ shes nas kyang gcig sems gcig la chags/lho phyogs kyi spang ri'i ldebs su lug khyu gnyis srad bu chad pa'i mu tig gi mgul rgyan ltar bag phebs su gnas 'dug de ni rong pa sde gsar gyi bu don grub dang lung skyid tsho pa'i dman chung 'brug mtsho gnyis kyi lug khyu red/don grub kyis lus dang grib ma ji bzhin mi bral ba'i bo'u rgyab tu khur nas pha bong gcig gi steng du bsdad/ 'jam rlung bsil bus dal por g.yo ba'i ru dar dmar po de ljang mdog spang ljongs kyi steng du mngon gsal lhag par che zhing gson nyams kyi mdzes chos ldan/'brug mtshos ‘‘a la la mo la la red ’’ces tshig don mi ldan pa'i glu chung len bzhin du 'ur lcag tshag sgra grags pa zhig brdab nas don grub la brda ston/don grub de mar 'brug mtsho'i gam du song nas ‘‘ya/ glu snyan po zhig btang song / da dung gcig thongs dang ’’zer bzhin 'brug mtsho'i gdong la gcer nas bltas/ 'brug mtshos na ma lcog chung rkang gcig bcad de rting pa kha ru bcug nas ldad kyin cang mi smra bar ngo tsha'i zol gyis mgo bo smad de bsdad/don grub kyis me mda' mar phab nas ru sa la btsugs nas bzhag ste ‘‘'brug mtsho ’’zhes skad cha zhig shod rgyu yod khul gyis 'brug mtsho'i gam du nud trem byas/‘‘dzin’’‘‘khyod kha mi grags pa ci yin/’’‘‘ci yang ma red/’’‘‘'o na glu zhig thongs dang /mi’359

'brog khul gyi pho mo'i dbar len pa'i glu ni 'dod glu las gzhan ci yang med/ sngar nas da bar 'brog khul gyi gzhon nu tshos 'dod glu'i 'brel thag rgyud de rang dbang dang bde skyid la brtson len byas nas bu tsha skyed bsring gis 'jig rten gsar skrun la rgya mtsho chu thigs tsam gyi byas rjes bzhag yod/ da res 'brug mtshos kyang cung zad bsam blo btang nas 'dod glu zhig blangs par/rta 'do ba na dmar dkyil nas 'tsher/sga gser sga khra mo nang du lus/sga gser sga'i blo gtad ma 'gyur na/rta 'do ba'i gom lag je mgyogs red/ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang ha cang bag tsha ba'i zol gyis rgyab don grub la phyogs nas bsdad/don grub kyis de don glu lan 'jal bar/bya khu byug rgya gar yul nas grags/ byi'u 'jol mo mon yul mthil nas grags/gsung grags bzhin grags bzhin thag nye red/shing tsan dan rtse ru mnyam 'dzoms byed/ces glu mjug rdzogs pa dang 'brug mtshor 'khyud de sked rags bkrol/mchu sbyar nas de ltar kho gnyis gcig sems gcig la chags nas 'chi bral las gson bral med pa'i snying grogs su gyur/phyugs rigs yongs dbyar mtsher du skyas spos nas zla gcig tsam song rjes kyi nyin zhig sde dpon btsan lhas rta nag pho rog 'dra ba zhig la bzhon/spu phrug gi phyu pa gsar min rnying min zhig gyon/ rkang par lham bzhi khra gsar 360

rkyang zhig gyon nas dbyar mtsher gyi sar song /de nyin nam mkha' sngo la dwangs pa'i khrod du kha ba'i rdul brtsegs kyi mu khyud dang 'dra ba'i rab dkar chu 'dzin gyi phung po tsham tshom re zung phyogs bzhi'i gnam sa'i 'dres mtshams kyi mtshams thig las mngon/ nyi 'od rnam par bkra bas spang ljongs steng du dar dir bung ba'i sgra snyan sgrog gin du rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i me tog gi skyed tshal du 'phur lding gar la rtsen/ thur nas thur du 'bab pa'i dwangs gtsang gi rdza chu'i 'gram du skye 'tshar byas pa'i ri skyes me tog ser chen dang / ser chung / a gar do gar/ 'jib ru dkar dmar ser gsum dang dril shang / bya rgod spos sogs sna mang me tog gi dri bsung phyogs bzhir 'thul zhing phye leb sgeg mos ri skyes me tog dang su mdzes 'gran pa ltar skabs re 'phur lding byed pa dang skabs re me tog gi ze'u 'bru'i bcud la rol nas gshog pa zung lheb lhob tu g.yo ba sogs rang byung khams kyi 'jo sgeg gis sde dpon btsan lha'i yid kyi dbang po cig car du 'phrog nas rang dbang med par rta las bshol te me tog gi skyed tshal khrod du gan rkyal du 'gyel nas dpung pa'i yal 'dab gnyis ltag rgyab tu bsnyes te re zhig lus sems yongs dga' bde'i dpal la rol/'do ba nag po yang shang shang rdza chu'i 'gram gyi rtswa dang rtsi tog longs su spyod kyin mgul gyi dril chung gi sgra thing thing du grags pa yis rang byung khams kyi mdzes sdug la sngar lhag gi gson shugs sbyin/de nas kho chu 'gram du bsdad de ngo gdong dang lag pa gtsang mar bkrus rjes chu phor pa gang bcus te btung pa dang nye rgyang ri lung gi mdzes ljongs la myong rol byas/ dbyar gyi dga' mas rang byung khams la mdzes sdug 'di lta bu sbyin nas skye bo'i lus sems la rdzogs mtha' bral ba'i bde skyid longs su spyod rgyu yod kyang rang nyid dpon yin tshul gyis dbyar mtsher dgun mtsher gyi 361

dbye ba med par rtag par gzhis sdod byed pa ni rang sdug rang gis nyos pa las skyid pa'i longs spyod cig ma red snyam nas za 'og thags su btags 'dra'i spang ljongs dang / sna mang me tog gi dri bsrung / ting ting dang tsi tsi/ko ko zhes mgrin pa'i rdza rnga brdung zhing 'phur lding gar la brtsen pa'i bya byi'u yi gsung snyan/ lha yi rdzing ring gi ngos su dal gyis rgyu ba'i rab dkar chu 'dzin gyi phung po dang / spang ljongs kyi ldebs su zhi lhod/ rang dbang /bag yangs su gnas pa'i phyugs rigs kyi khyu tshogs sogs gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod yon lnga las gcig kyang ma tshang ba med pa ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyar dus kyi mdzes ljongs kyis da dung yid ma tshim par skabs re gan rkyal du nyal te dgung sngon dbyings su blta ba dang / skabs re rna ba gtad de byi'u chung gi gre 'gyur la nyan par byed/ skabs re kha sbub tu nyal te sna sa la sbyar nas me tog gi dri zhim snom pa bcas byed kyin 'duganyi ma phyed yol tsam gyi dus su dgung sngon du sprin nag lang long du 'phyur ba dang / nub phyogs kyi gnam sa'i 'brel mtshams su glog zhags dmar 'khyug 'khyug tu 'khyug pa dang g.yag rgan gyi 'khun sgra sgrog pa ltar dal zhing ljid la lhod pa'i 'brug skad re zung yang grags byung bas sde dpon brel ba langs nas 'phral mar gnas de las bral te rta bo lcag gis brab nas shar mar bskyod/dbang chen tshang gi rngon khyi gnyis kyis 'u 'u 'u ’’zhes zug skad rgyag gin rgyug pa dang / gam du slebs dus sngar nas 'dris pa'i sde dpon yin pa shes nas mjug ma phar g.yo tshur g.yo byas nas mdza' bshes mtshon par byed/rgyang nas bltas pa tsam gyis sde dpon yin pa shes pas dbang chen kho bsu bar yong byung /a tsi/ 'di dbang chen red dam/ red/ tag tag kho red/362

rkang pa rbad de drag nas da lta 'khar bar brten dgos mi 'dug la gom pa'i 'degs 'jog la 'gog rkyen gang yang mi 'dug pas sde dpon dga' thag chod de pha dang bu 'phrad pa ltar dbang chen la 'khyud de 'gram pa yang yang sbyar nas ‘‘da yag po drag 'dug yag po drag 'dug mgyogs po de 'dra drag yong bsam bsam ma byung ’’zhes dbang chen gyi mgo nas mjug bar dang mjug nas mgo bar thengs gnyis bltas te ngo gdong las dga' ba'i 'dzum mdangs rgyas te lag pa gnyis kyis da dung dbang chen gyi dpung pa nas bzung 'dug dbang chen yang dga' tshor chen po skyed de ‘‘nga'i rkang pa rbad de drag 'dug ma gzhi nas rmas skyon tshabs chen ma red/ khyod yong gi red bsam byung / de ring zhogs pa nga nyal nas yod pa'i tshe nga tsho'i sbra'i chon thag gi steng du mgron byi'u gcig gis ting ting ting zhes skad bar med brgyab nas nga mal las langs dgos pa'i brda btang byung / ngas de ring mgron po su zhig yong gi yod dam snyam nas bsam blo btang yang sa 'dir nged tshang du yong mkhan khyed las gzhan su yod snyam byung ba de tag tag red 'dug ’’ces dga' spro 'khol ba'i gtam gleng byed kyin rta chon thag la btags te sga srab bshus te na kha'i nang du btang / de ring zhogs pa mgron byi'u de yi skad rgyun ldan gyi mgron byi'u gzhan gyi skad las snyan zhing 'jebs pa dang /gsangs ba/ skad rgyag yun ring ba ste kho mal las ma langs bar skad brgyab pas dbang chen gyis bkra shis g.yang chags la ‘‘de ring zho mngar tsam zhig snyol’’zhes mngags pa dang gtsod kyi gnya' lpags kyis bzos pa'i ja khug las ja sbar mo gang blugs te ja bskol yod/dbang chen gyis lam seng zho khebs phye ste sde dpon la zho phor pa gang blugs/ de nas 'bri mar gsar rkyang gis ja srub ma bzos/ mtshon byed 363

rang bzhin gyis lag pa stabs bde zhig bkrus te mar gzan nyung nyung zhim po zhig g.yos te 'chang bu re re bzhin bcangs te sde dpon gyi mdun du bzhagabakra shis g.yang chags lug rdzir song ba dang / dgra 'dul nor rdzir song bas khyim srung dbang chen las med pa'i dus der sde dpon slebs pas kho gnyis ci gros mol gros kyi gtam gleng sna tshogs byas/ dbang chen gyis sde dpon la sne len gyi las ka yongs sgrub rjes da gzod gzhi nas gdan steng du bsdad de sna tha sen mo gang blugs nas ‘‘deng sang bu don grub dang lung skyid tsho pa'i a khu blo ldan tshang gi bu mo de'i ming la gcig zer/ dbang 'brug 'brug lha ma red 'brug mtsho zhes pa dang ngo shes te deng sang khos lug 'tsho bar 'tsho rogs bu mo mdzes ma zhig yod red ’’ces bshad/sde dpon gyis ‘‘de yag po red/ don grub kyang lo chung chung ma red/pha rgan gyi dgra sha ni blangs/ lo yang chung chung min pas mna' ma bsu ran yod ’’zer/nub kha'i nyi mas phyi bltas slog nas mtho dman mi 'dra ba gcan gzan gyi mche ba dang 'dra ba'i sa 'dzin lhun po'i rtse mor bral mi phod pa'i tsum pa sbyar bas sa 'dzin lhun po'i rtse mo ngo tsha bzod mi thub pa'i khul gyis gser mdog dar zab kyi la thod bcings/ dmar ser mdangs 'dzin dgong mo'i mtshams sprin gyis mtha' yas rtswa thang yangs por 'char yan gyis phyug par byas/ dkar nag phyugs rigs khyu dang khyu phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas lhas su bskong byung / lug g.yang dkar gyi 'ba' skad long long / nor nag chung gi ngur skad ldir ldir/ rdzi bo'i glu dbyangs dang / khyi'i zug skad sogs kyis re zhig 'jig rten snod bcud bkod pa'i nang 'di las lhag pa'i 'du 'dzi dang / 'di las lhag pa'i mdzes ljongs shig sa mtha' ru btsal yang rnyed dka' ba'i snang ba shar/364

dgong mo phyugs rigs ra ba med pa'i lhas su bskong nas nor 'dogs pa dang / 'o ma 'jo ba sogs rgyun ldan dang mi 'dra ba med pa'i las ka yongs tshar rjes dgong zas bzas/ de nas dgra 'dul dang / mna' ma gnyis dgra dogs spyang 'gog dang / gnyis mos mthun 'jug gi ched du nyal chas phrag par khur nas lug lhas kyi mtha' ru nyal bar song /nyin shas de'i ring sde dpon snang ba rgya g.yeng dang / blo yid bag phebs kyis dbang chen tshang dang rang khyim gyi dbyar mtsher/ tshe skyabs tshang /don grub tshang bcas su phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed kyin bsdad/ su tshang du slebs pa de tshang gis sku mgron la brtsis te bsnyen bkur zhabs tog sgrub pa dang yang rang mir brtsis te gtam gleng sna tshogs kyis dus 'da' bar byas/kho thog mar nang nas yong skabs dbyar mtsher gyi sar nyin shas las sdod rtsis med mod dbyar dus rtswa thang gi 'jo sgeg gis yid kyi dbang po cig car du 'phrog ste der slebs nas nyin bzhi phyin yang da dung log rgyu'i gra sgrig mi 'dug da res sde dpon dbyar mtsher du slebs pa'i go skabs dang bstun nas rgan mo lha mos dbang chen lung skyid tsho pa'i a khu blo ldan tshang du btang nas bu mo 'brug mtsho don grub kyi mna' mar bsus/skabs de dus byang 'brog gi gnyen sgrig gsol ston dang mdzad sgo ni ha cang stabs bde yin/ sgos su dbyar mtsher gyi sar de bas stabs bde bas de'i sngon ma'i nyin mo tshe skyabs dang dgra 'dul gnyis kyis rogs byas te lug khyu'i nang nas brgya 'dams stong sgrug byas pa'i sha bzan shed bzang gcig bshas pas de ring sha gsar dang zho 'o mas sne len la rol te ru 'khor khyim mtshes kyi mi rnams mgron po'i tshul gyis don grub tshang du slebs nas dga' spro'i gtam gleng ci yang byed kyin 'dug gal srid de'i khrod du gsar 365

slebs kyi mgron po zhig gis bltas na gnyen ston gyi khyad chos dang / bro ba ldan pa ni sgye 'phyar gyi gdan la snam bu dmar po'i mtha' cun rnying song zhig gi steng du gzhon nu pho mo gnyis ngo tsha smin po'i sgo nas dpung pa mnyam gshib tu bsdad pa'i mdun du mgron po gzhan la med pa'i zas kyi bye brag gro ma mar khu phor pa gnyis bzhag pa las gzhan ci yang mi 'dugade ni ha cang stabs bde la rgyas spros longs spyod kyang med pa'i bab chags kyi gnyen ston zhig red/dus de nas bzung mdza' ba mi nyams rdo rje'i brag ri dang 'dra ba'i gzhon nu pho mo gnyis khyim tshang gcig gi nang du lhan 'dzoms kyis ma 'ongs 'tsho ba'i ro bcud la rol pa'i 'go brtsams pa red/de nyin ni hor zla drug pa'i tshes bco lnga red/ shel gyi me long ji bzhin rab dwangs lha lam gyi ngos su da lta char sprin gyi tshom bu sen mo'i sgor rgya tsam yang mi 'dug lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis chu gter lan brgya bsrubs pa las byung ba'i dkar gsal dung zla'i zhal khyim dbang phyogs ri bo'i rtse nas 'phags/ de ring gnyen sgrig byas ma thag pa'i gzhon nu zung lug lhas kyi mtha' ru 'dod sred kyi skad gdangs phra mo'i snying gtam ci yang smra bzhin 'dugaspyir 'bu srin yongs mtshan mo'i dus su rang rang gi gnas su log nas yib sdod kyi yod kyang da res phye leb phra chung gnyis dkar gsal zla 'od kyi khrod du 'phur lding gar la rtsen bzhin nam 'phang gcod pa ni mgo nag gzhon nu zung la phrag dog gis 'gran rtsod byed pa yin nam/ yang na ngo tshas skyengs te ring du 'phur ba yin mi shes/e ma rtswa thang gi dbyar dus ni de 'dra'i thung ba la ang / yud tsam zhig la ljang mdog gi rtswa sngon gyi rtse mor skya mdog gi ral pa chags 'go tshugs 366

pa dang phyi dro'i lhags bsil gyis sbra gur gyi 'dabs lhab lhub tu g.yo/phyugs rigs sha shed rgyas te dpyid dus kyi bzo lta dang rbad de tha dad du gyur nas tshang ma zlum gzugs su gyur/ 'bri g.yag gi rwa cor mar gyis byug pa ltar bkrag mdangs rgyas/ ston dus ni phyugs rigs rgyud spel gyi dus tshigs yin pas snga dgong nor gdang gi nang du pha phyugs gzugs chen 'brong rgod dang 'dra ba de dag gis 'brug skad dang 'dra ba'i ngar co ldir zhing lce bsnar te ‘‘snying sdug byams pa'i ’’don du khyod shi nga gson gyis rwa 'dzing 'gyed de gdang nang du 'bri'i 'o ma 'jo mkhan rnams la brdab zing slong ba dang tha na pha phyugs de dag gis brdzi nyen 'duganam zla ston mjug tu slebs te gnam gshis nyin re bzhin grang du phyin nas zhogs pa mtshe'u dang rgyug chu'i 'gram du dar srab po chags pa dang ri lung yongs ser thing thing du gyur zhing mtshan mo skabs 'gar rtswa thang gi ngos su ba mo srab po yang 'bab kyi 'dugadabyar dus mtsho dang mtshe'u ru gnas pa'i dus tshigs rang bzhin chu bya'i rigs rnams grang reg ma bzod par pha sngon ma rjes gshog rlabs bsgyur bzhin rim gyis lho phyogs su 'phur/dbyar mtsher du song ba'i 'brog sde rnams kyang rim gyis gtan sdod sdod gnas su log mar phyur bsag cing bal rtsid kyang bsdus zin pas ston dus ni 'brog pa rnams khom pa che shos kyi dus shig red/de nyin tshe skyabs kyis byis pa mtshe ma gnyis po lag khrid byas nas dbang chen tshang du slebs byung /dbang chen gyis sngar gyi 'khon 'dzin spu tsam med pa'i sgo nas tshe skyabs la ja blugs shing sna ru yang g.yar ba dang / de nas kho rang sdod sa'i gdan 367

zur nas ja khu'i nang du btsos te tshos srug po brgyab pa'i thi ge ①sbar mo gang blangs te byis pa gnyis la bgos nas ‘‘phru gu 'di gnyis khar nyan po yod/khyod gnyis rtsed mo rtses mizhes bshad pa dang byis pa gnyis po'i 'gram par byil tsam byas nas ‘‘snying rje mtshe ma zhes pa 'di mi mgo 'thom thag chod red/ngas da dung 'di gnyis rgan gzhon dbye ba 'byed shes kyi mi 'dug ’’ces brjod/tshe skyabs kyis sna ru de dbang chen la sprod zhor du ‘‘'di che ba red/'di chung ba red mimices mdzub ston byas/byis pa gnyis por da lta thi ge tshos can rag pas dga' thag chod nas 'di nga'i rta yin/ 'di khyod kyi lug yin zhes shod kyin rtsed mo rtses/tshe skyabs kyis thog mar skad cha gang nas 'go 'dzugs dgos min ma shes stabs ‘‘a khu dbang chen/ khyod kyi rkang pa rbad de drag 'dug gam ’zhes skad dma' pos dris/rbad de drag 'dug sngon ma dang gcig pa red mimices rmas skyon phog myong ba'i rkang pa de mdun du brkyangs nas rkang mgo dkrug tsam byas nas ‘‘na tsha gang yang mi 'dug sangs drag red ’mizer/tshe skyabs kyis ‘‘byas na deng sang las brel med la nam dus kyang de tsam gyi grang mo med pas mi’sngar rang gis dbang chen gyi shag po blo thub nyi shar bsad pa'i gnong 'gyod chen po yod pas de'i tshab tu khong rang dbang chen gyi dpung rogs su yid gnyis the tshom med par 'gro 'dod yod ces mu mthud shod ma spobs kyang skad cha lhag ma de'i don dbang chen gyis rtogs nas ‘‘red/ ngas kyang de rjo thi ge ni lug gi brla rkang dang rje ngar bar gyi rus pa zhig ste acug kyang zer/368

'dra bsam gyi 'dug da lta nged tshor go mtshon yang mi dman pa yod pas phyir 'gyangs byed dgos don mi 'dug ngas bltas na sde dpon btsan lha ni nga tshor bka' drin che bas khong nga tsho dang mnyam du dka' sdug myong dgos don mi 'dug pas khong gzhis su bsdad na yag shos red/ khong gis me mda' nga tshor g.yar na 'grig gi red ’’ces sbra'i phub kar la bcings pa'i kho rang gi me mdar blta trem zhig byas/tshe skyabs kyis shin tu 'thad pa'i tshul du mgo lcog lcog byed kyin ‘‘red/kho 'gro dgos don mi 'dug kha sngon a khu zla bas ya med spun gsum tshar bcad pa'i drin lan du kho'i bu ldan ma dang rgod phrug gnyis nga tsho'i rogs par gtong gi yin zhes mna' bskyal byung /’ dbang chen gyis ‘‘da byas na yag po red/ ma gzhi nas nga tshos kho'i bu gnyis khrid pa'i 'os bab yod/ da nga tshos dus tshod nar 'gyangs byed dgos don mi 'dug chu ma shor gong la rags dang / rkyen ma byung gong la zlog thabs zhes pa ltar gal srid nga tsho re zhig pham kha rag nas bros dgos byung na gangs babs na rjes 'ded kyis rtsad gcod byed sla bas da ni 'gro ba'i dus rang red/ nar 'gyangs byas na gangs 'bab nyen yod ’’ces bshad rjes da res dmag thon gyi dus tshod bkod sgrig dang / ji ltar 'gro lugs skor gtan 'khel bzo dgos stabs dbang chen gyis de mar mna' ma sde dpon skad gtong bar mngags/ ‘‘hwa hwa/ dman dpon chen po gnyis pos nga skad mi gtong ba ci yin ’’zhes sde dpon gyis ku re shod kyin gom zheng chen pos nang du 'dzul byung /dbang chen gyis ‘‘skad btang nas phebs pa ma red dam mi zhes kha mtshar bshad/sde dpon gyis ‘‘bkra shis g.yang chags kyis khyod gnyis kyis bkod sgrig 369

byas tshar song zer gyi 'dug ’mices kha mtshar bshad/bkra shis g.yang chags kyis ‘‘sde dpon gyis rdzun shod kyi 'dug ngas de 'dra zer ma myong ’’zhes dag 'bud byas pas tshang ma gad mo shor/de nas sde dpon gyis ‘‘sang dang gcig gnangs dang gnyis/gzhes lha nyin dkar por thon rgyu yin/ da ka re ko re byed dgos don med ’’ces da res ming don mtshangs pa'i sde dpon gyi bzo ston nas tshig thag chod ༄pos bshad/ de nas lag g.yas pa'i mdzub mo re re bzhin snon te ‘‘'gro mkhan nga dang dbang chen pha bu gnyis/ tshe skyabs/ don grub bcas lnga yi steng du nyi ma ja skol mkhan du khrid rgyu red ’’ces bshad pas dbang chen dang tshe skyabs gnyis cung zad ga shod 'di shod med par lus/ dbang chen gyis sna tha sen’ ’mo gang blugs nas ‘‘ngas bltas na sde dpon khyed 'gro dgos don sde dpon hang sang nas ‘‘a/ ga re nga 'gro don mi 'dug zer ram/ci'i phyir ’’zhes mig gnyis kyang cher gdang nas dris/dbang chen gyis ‘‘nga tshos byas na khyed rang gzhis su bzhugs te sde ba'i 'go 'dren byed/ khyed kyi me mda' nga tshor g.yar na lung skyid kyi a khu zla bas bu gnyis kyang rogs par gtong rgyu byas 'dug ’ces gsal bshad dang sbrags rgyun du zhe sa mi shes pa'i kha las da res ‘‘bzhugs mizhes pa'i zhe tshig gcig kyang thon/sde dpon gyis lag pa g.yas pas 'gram pa skyor te mno bsam cung zad btang rjes ‘‘nga gzhis su ma bsdad na rong pa sde gsar la nyi ma shar mi thub zer ram/ nga ma bsdad kyang nyi ma rgyun ldan bzhin shar nas shar te nub nas nub kyi red/ 'o na nga ma bsdad na rong pa sde gsar gyi mi rnams zas za mi shes zer ram/ gos gyon mi shes zer ram/ yun ring na zla ba gcig370

thung na zla phyed nang nga tsho tshur slebs rgyu red mi’ces tshig thag chod la cung zad khro ba'i gdangs kyis de ltar bshad pas dbang chen dang tshe skyabs gnyis de la lan rgyag ma nus par kha rog tu bsdad/ re zhig sbra chung chung de'i nang grags 'gul gang yang med par 'jam cag ger gnas pas ril ma rkang gcig rlung gis ded pa'i sgra yang thos srid par gyur/ ricung zad 'gor rjes dbang chen gyis skad dma' po'i sgo nas ‘‘khyod nga tsho dang mnyam du dka' sdug zhe drag myang na nga'i sems kyis bzod thub pa mi 'dug de ma gtogs ’’sde dpon gyis dbang chen gyi tshig mjug 'phrog nas ‘‘dka' sdug cung zad myong yang ha las rgyu ci yod/ nga tsho'i don du khyod kyi rkang par rmas skyon phog pa ma zad da dung ’’nyi shar rkyen lam du song ba'i skor shod grabs byas pa dang / tshe skyabs der yod pas shod mi rung ba dran te cung zad 'gor ba dang mu mthud bshad rgyur ‘‘'og la bzhon rgyu'i rta yod/ rgyab tu 'khur rgyu'i me mda' yod pas dka' sdug gang yang yong mi srid/ da res 'gro lugs 'thab lugs kyi jus bkod byed mkhan khyod rang yin/ de ring dang / sang nyin gra sgrig yag po byos/ gzhes nyin shar skya rengs skya mda' btang ba dang mal las langs te nangs ja btung rjes nyi ma 'char ba dang dus mnyam du thon dgos mi’zhes de ring sde dpon gyis sngon ma dang mi 'dra ba tshig thag chod po'i sgo nas don dag tshang ma gtan la phab pa dang / g.yog nyi ma skad btang nas lung skyid la a khu zla ba'i bu ldan ma dang /rgod phrug gnyis sang nyin 'dir 'dzom thub pa dang / rta dang / rgyags phye rang 'grig thog gri mdung sogs mtshon cha yag rigs khyer dgos rgyu'i brda sbyar bar brdzangs/nyin gnyis kyi ring tshang mas lham mthil ko lhan rdog pa/ slog pa lhan pa rgyag pa/ sked gri brdar ba/ me mda'i phyi nang gtsang phyis dang lam 371

rgyags sogs gra sgrig ma tshang ba med pa byas te nyin gsum pa'i skya rengs btang ba dang mal las langs te nangs ja btung / ‘‘mi dga' dga' mdog byed pa de/ pho gsar dmag la 'gro ba'i rtags ’’zhes pa cis mi bden/ dgra 'dul dang / don grub/ ldan ma/ rgod phrug rnams kyis rgyun ldan gyi goms gshis las 'gal te mal las langs pa dang mtshon byed rang bzhin gyis ngo gdong dang lag pa'ang bkrus/de nas shar ri'i spo nas a ti gzhon nu'i zhal 'dzum gyi zer brgya mkha' dbyings su khyab pa dang dus mnyam tshang mas rang rang gi bzhon rta blangs te sga srab legs par spras te dbang chen tshang gi sgo ru 'dzoms/ me mda' yod pa rnams kyi ru dar la zhogs pa'i 'od mdangs 'phros te sngar bas dmar mdangs che bar gyur/'jam rlung gis dal bur g.yo ba'i me mda'i ru dar dang / rta'i dar tshon gyis mdud pa'i rnga mdud khra nyig nyig mgo 'phangs mtho ba'i rta bo'i 'gro rngams sogs kyis dbang chen gyi sems la dga' spro dpag tu med pa sbyin te ngo gdong 'dzum gyis khengs shing 'thab na mi rgyal ba med pa'i spobs sems dang yid ches kyi lus sems yongs la 'dzad mtha' med pa'i stobs shugs gsar pa zhig 'phel nas ‘‘ya bu lu tsho/ da 'gro lo mimizhes mchongs thengs gcig gis rta yi steng du bzhon pa dang dus mnyam gzhan rnams kyang rtar bzhon/gzhis pa rnams kyis bsang btang nas du zhag gis nam mkha' sgrib pa byas nas tshe ring nad med dang / god chags skyon chags med pa g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i kha g.yang sgrogabakra shis g.yang chags dang 'brug mtsho gnyis rang rang gi khyo ga dang bral ba'i sems sdug dang sems khral gyis mig mchi mas sgrib ste rab rib tu 372

gyur yang bzod sgom byas te ngu skad ma don par byas/de nas dbang chen gyis sne khrid de ‘‘ki ki bso bso lha rgyal lo/ rta pho 'dra 'dra'i nang las lag srab mda' gang gis mgyogs par shog mi bo 'dra 'dra'i nang las mgo rmog dkar gang gis mtho bar shog ’’ces lha 'bod klu gyer byed bzhin du grong sde la skor ba lan gsum bskor nas gling dkar gyi dpa' thul dpung dmag dgra 'dul du chas pa ji bzhin lho phyogs su chas so/lho yi la nyag gi steng du slebs dus da gzod tshang ma rta las bshol te sde ba'i phyogs su phyir blta dus gzhis sdod pa rnams da dung sgo 'gram du langs te khong tshor mig gis skyel ma byed kyin 'dugabazhon rta'i shed shugs mi shor ched khong tshos zhogs pa nam gsal ba dang rdog thon byas te nyin gung ma zin tsam la rtswa chu gang yag gi sar sgar brgyab ste zhag sdod byed kyin phyin/ de nyin sdod gnas las rgyang blta byed dus ri tshogs kyi smug zhag khrod du dung gi thor cog bcings pa'i mi bo nyams bzang can zhig 'gyings pa lta bu'i gangs ri'i rtse mo zhig mthong byung ba ni yul g.yang phyug gi rgyab ri kha 'dzin can/ srung ma myur mgyogs can/ lha dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo yin pa gdon mi za bas dbang chen pha bu gnyis yun ring bral ba'i pha yul du slebs pa lta bu'i dga' tshor gyis dad pa'i spu long rnam par g.yos/ sa cha der rtswa chu gnyis 'dzoms yin pa ma zad dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo'ang mjal bas der zhag sdod byas/tshang mas rta sga blangs shing rta rtswa thang du brtod rjes gos kyi thu ba'i nang du lci ba btus te phyogs gcig tu spungs/ nyi ma dang / ldan ma/ rgod phrug gsum pos lam seng lci leb sgor mo'i me tshang bcas pa'i dbus su me lcags las blangs pa'i me son bzhag pa'i steng du lci zhib blugs pa dang sa ru 373

nyal te phu btab pas thog mar du ba rta rnga tsam las med pa de che ru che ru phyin nas du ba'i g.yu 'brug dgung du 'phur/ sngo lhog lhog gis gyen du 'phyur ba'i du zhag gis 'byams klas rtswa thang la gson shugs sbyin/ kho tsho gsum pos da dung mu mthud sa ru nyal te phu btab pas du ba nyung du phyin nas me 'ur 'ur du 'bar byung /khong tsho rang yul las thon nas de ring bar chu khol las ja 'thung myong med/ de ring rgyab ri kha 'dzin can mjal byung bas ja mang po med kyang nges par du ja bskol dgos snyam nas dbang chen gyis lang shor 'khyam pos mes po'i shul bzhag nor mdzod nyi ma gcig la brlag pa'i bzo ltar ja khug mgo rting slog nas lo ma rkang gcig kyang ma lhag par rdza ma'i nang du blugs te ja bskol/me 'ur 'ur du 'bar ba dang rdza ma'i nang ja dmar lhog lhog tu khol byung bas ma byan nyi mas ‘‘ja khol song ’’zhes phu dung gnyis kyis 'jus nas ja rdza thab las phabs pa dang tshang ma'i phor pa'i nang du ja blugs/ dbang chen pha bu gnyis pos lha dge bsnyen lhun por phyogs nas mgrin dbyangs gcig 'gyur gyis/bso bso/rgyab ri kha 'dzin can/srung ma myur mgyogs can/lha dge bsnyen gyi zhal la mchod/phar 'gro skyabs kyi skyel ma/tshur 'ong skyabs kyi bsu ma/gnyen phyogs nyi ma las dro ba/dgra mgor thog las tsha ba/374

bso bso/rta pho 'dra 'dra'i nang las/lag srab mda' gang gis mgyogs par shogami bo 'dra 'dra'i nang las/mgo rmog dkar gang gis mtho bar shogaces ja phud dang po lha dge bsnyen gyi phyogs su phul te g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i gsol ba smon lam yang yang btab/gzhan rnams tshang mas ja 'thung gin bsdad/de nas tshang mas rang rang gi phor pa'i nang du rtsam phyur blugs/ ma byan gyis brel ba 'tshub 'tshub kyis mi byings la ja blugs/ de nas sha zangs kyi nang du chu blugs te sha btsos/sha tshos rjes lhu re re bzhin rlangs pa 'thul bzhin blangs te che chung dbye ba med pa tshom bu brgyad du dbyes te rgyan rdo 'jog zhes pa mi gcig logs su gab pa dang / byings rnams kyis rdo'am lci ba/ ril ma/ rtswa sogs dngos po mi 'dra ba re sgrug pa (gcig gis dngos po gnyis sgrug ste dngos po gcig logs su gab pa de'i tshab byed dgos ) rnams rang gis ma brjed yid la bzung nas mnyam du bsres te gcig shos kyi lag tu bzhag pa de dag re re bzhin sha tshom bu re'i steng du 'jog pa'i dmangs khrod bgo 'grems bya thabs la brten nas bgos/nyin shas ring ja thigs pa gcig tsam yang 'thung rgyu ma byung bas de ring ja gar po de 'dra phor pa bzhi lnga btung pa tsam gyis tshang ma'i skom dad sel ba dang lus sems yongs su 'dzad mtha' med pa'i stobs shugs 'phel/dbang chen gyis tshod dpag byas na de nas g.yang phyug gi bar du rta pa'i nyin lam gnyis tsam las med stabs nyin gnyis pa'i sgar sar slebs te ja 375

rgyags me dros byung rjes ‘‘ngas bltas na 'di nas g.yang phyug gi bar thag ha cang nye bas nga tshos bya ma 'drog par sgo nga len thub pa byed dgos pas re zhig khyed tsho 'dir sgug nas sdod/ nga dang / don grub sngon la song nas gnas tshul zhib blta byed ’’ces bshad/sde dpon gyis ‘‘thag nye po a yod/ de sngon khyod g.yang phyug tu 'gro skabs yun ring 'gor song / khyod kyis sa nor pa ma red dam ’’zhes blo dogs skyed/ dbang chen gyis ‘‘sa nor med/ de dus sa rgyus med pas nga phar 'gro skabs lam kyog kyang phyin 'dug ’’zer/dbang chen gyi thabs shes de tshang ma'i blo la 'thad par byung nas de ltar byed rgyu gros 'cham/dbang chen dang / don grub gnyis kyis me mda' ldan ma dang /rgod phrug gnyis kyi lag tu bzhag nas rgyags phye phyed thig re khur nas sprang por brdzus te song /kho gnyis nam nyin mtshan phyed gnyis song rjes kyi dgong mo sa ma rub tsam la kha sngon dbang chen gab yul rdza rong der slebs te sha tig kha shas bzas rjes nyin mang po ngal dub kyis mnar bas gnyis ka gnyid lam gyi zhing du gshegs/ ri phyi nyin nam gsal tsam la dbang chen gnyid las sad kyang re zhig langs ma sgyid par mal las tsog ste sna tha sen mo gang blugs te zhim po zhig 'then dgos snyam nas ldag mdzub dang mthe bong gi bar du sna tha mang rab cig bzung nas sna khung g.yas par sbyar te shugs kyis 'then pas sna tha mang drags pas yin nam yang na 'then shugs che bas yin mi shes par hab sbrid chen po zhig brgyab nas kha chu'i zegs ma 'thor/ da lta brang khar bzung ba'i lag g.yon ma'i mthe bong steng gi sna tha thal rdul rlung gis phyags pa ltar shul rjes 376

tsam las ma lhag de mar don grub gnyid las sad de bya rmyang zhig byas nas ‘‘rdza rong 'di dro po zhig 'dug nga gnyid thun gcig gis nam langs song ’’zer bzhin ‘‘a ru ya ’’zhes yang bya rmyang zhig byas te mal las tsogadabang chen gyis ‘‘nga yang 'khyags ma byung ’’zer bzhin da lta hab sbrid brgyab nas sna rtse las thur du dpyang pa'i snabs chu phyis tsam byas nas yang bskyar mthe bong g.yon ma'i sen mo'i steng sna tha cung zad cig blugs nas 'then rtsis byas/de nas nyi ma yang shar byung bas kho gnyis mal las langs te rdza rong las don te blta dus zla thang tsho pa'i grong tsho de sngar mus bzhin gnas thog na thang du rta mang po zhig 'dug pas ci yin snyam/ shag po dga' blo tshang sngon ma'i mtsher sa de rang du yod cing sbra'i khug ltag gi dar lcog dal bur g.yo bzhin pa dang / khyim dud de dag gis zhogs ja bskol ba'i du ba sngo lhog lhog tu 'phyur gyin 'dug lung pa'i phu ru yod pa'i btsan rgod tshang gi phyogs su blta dus dga' blo tshang gi dar lcog las ldab mang pos che ba'i dar lcog rlung gis g.yo bzhin khyim dud gzhan dang 'dra bar zhogs ja bskol ba'i du ba sngo lhog lhog tu 'phyur gyin 'dug pas nga'i tshe gang gi gtan grogs g.yang mo ma shi gson bral byung nas sbra gog de yi nang du yod ang snyam pa'i sems sdug gis tog tsam ma gtogs mig chu shor/ skyes pho rab lus las khrag don yang mig chu mi don zhes pa'i shod srol yod pas am gtsigs bsdams nas mig chu ma don par byas/ de nas khos mdzub ston byed kyin du ‘‘ltos dang /pha gi nga'i shag po dga' blo tshang red/ pha gi btsan rgod tshang red ’’ces don grub la bshad/de nas kho gnyis zhogs ja yi tshul du sha lhu re bzas rjes ‘‘da khyod rang sprang por brdzus te song nas sngon la yas mas kyi khyim dud de dag gi sgo khar lto 377

slong khul gyis song / de nas dga' blo tshang la song / dga' blo ni mi rkang gyol zhig yod/ dga' blo kho rang la ma gtogs nga slebs yod ces ma shod ’’ces don grub sde nang du mngags te kho rang sngar bzhin rdza rong du yib nas bsdad/don grub thad kar grong pa gcig gi sgo ru song nas lto slong khul byas/der khyi stag 'dra ba gnyis kyis zug skad 'brug sgra ldir ba ltar grags bzhin kho'i phyogs su 'then gyin 'dug gal srid 'dogs thag chad de shor ba yin na dmar zos byed rgyu gtan 'khel red 'dug pas khos blo khog che tsam byas nas rum nang gi gri mgo lag pas 'jus te ‘‘wa ye/ sbyin bdag tshang /sprang zas shig ster rogs/ dge ba yod/ sku mkhyen zas lhag btung lhag tog tsam ster rogs ’’zhes rgyang 'bod lan mang byas kyang kho la ya byed mkhan ni khyi gnyis po de las mi 'dug yun ring der langs te rgyang 'bod byas na sprang zas rag rgyu phar zhog rang nyid khyis za rgyu gtan 'khel red snyam nas gnas de las bral te yang grong pa gzhan zhig gi sgor song nas da gin ltar rgyang 'bod byas pas da gzod ‘‘sprang zas ’’mang po byung /de nas dga' blo'i khyim gyi phyogs su song / thog mar kho la dga' bsu zhu mkhan yang che chung be'u dang 'dra ba'i 'brog khyi gnyis 'dug khyi'i zug skad brgyab nas cung ma 'gor bar bud med gcig gis lag tu rgyu ma bzas 'phro phor pa gang khyer nas 'ong ste kho la sprad/de mar khos skad shugs chung ngu'i sgo nas ‘‘nga dga' blo'i shag po yin/khong bzhugs yod na 'dir yong trem byed rogs zhes lab rogs ’’zhes bshad/bud med des kho'i mgo nas mjug bar blta yag cig byas nas ‘‘nga tsho'i rgad po la shag po sprang 'khyam zhig yod pa go ma myong / khyod su yin ’’zhes yid ma ches pa'i sgo nas dris/378

‘‘kho rang yong na ha go gi red ’’ces lan btab/‘‘ming lab rgyu med pa'i shag po yin nam ’’zhes ma 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis kho la bltas shing 'dren byed zung las dogs 'char gyi 'od mdangs 'tsher gyin 'dug ‘‘de khyod la jus gtogs med ’’ces don grub kyis gom gang mdun du shesas/‘‘nga kho'i nag mo yin/ jus gtogs med pa'i rgyu mtshan ci red ’’ces sngar bzhin 'dri rtsad gcod pa las da dung 'gro gi mi 'dug‘‘gang ltar ngas rdzun bshad med/ kho rang 'dir nga la thug tsam byed rogs ze lobs dang / gzhan khyod la jus gtogs med/ nga tsho skyes pa'i don la khyod nag mos the jus ma byas na dga' ’’zhes bshad/‘‘nga'i rgad po bsdad med/’’‘‘gang du phyin song ’’don grub brel 'tshab langs te mig cher gdangs/‘‘de'ang khyod la jus gtogs med/ nga tsho bza' tshang gi don la khyod tsho 'khyam pos the jus ma byas na dga' ’’zhes da lta don grub kyis bshad pa'i skad cha de dang 'dra ba'i dgag lan zhig sbyin te mchu zur nas 'dzum mdangs ya ma zung zhig bstan/‘‘nga khyod tshang du kho bsdad yod med blta bar 'gro gi yin ’’zhes don grub mdun du 'gro bar brtsams pa na bud med des kho'i mdun bkag nas ‘‘yong mi dgos/ sprang po ham pa che mdog ’’ces dmod/‘‘ngas kyang nag mo khyod lta bu'i jus gtogs can mthong ma myong /’’de'i skabs dga' blos rang gi nag mo dang / sprang po zhig 'khrug rtsod byed pa mthong nas sgor bud de ‘‘mi de ci red ’ ces mig gis don grub la bltas te tshur yong byung /379

don grub kyis mi de'i rkang pa gyol bzhin pa mthong ba dang dga' blo yin pa shes te ‘‘khyod 'dir shog dang / ngas khyod la skad cha zhig shod rgyu yod ’’zer/ dga' blos zhib blta dang dran gso ga tshod byas kyang gzhon nu de mthong myong mi 'dug pas ‘‘ngas khyod ngo mi shes/ khyod la don dag ci shod rgyu yod ’’zer/ don grub kyi 'dren byed las dogs 'char gyi mdangs 'phyung gin nag mo der blta tsam byas nas ‘‘khyod kyi rkang pa de ji ltar byas nas chag pa yin brjed song ngam ’’zhes gsang tshig cig bshad/dga' blo lam seng don grub kyi mdun du rgyug nas ‘‘khyod khyod shag po dbang chen gyi rogs pa yin nam ’’zhes skad dma' po'i sgo nas dris/don grub kyis yin pa'i brda la mgo bo lcog tsam byas nas ngo gdong las 'dzum mdangs shig ston/dga' blos kho rang gi nag mor ‘‘kha rkub 'dra ba zhig ma btsum na nyo cha gzed yong ngo ’’zhes sna rtser mdzub mo gcig btsugs te nang du btang nas ‘‘mgyogs po ja khol ’’zhes sdiganag mos ‘‘khyod kyi shag po yin na gsang ba byed dgos don ci red ’’ces ma 'dod pa'i 'khang ra byed kyin nang du song /dga' blos ‘‘kha tshums ’’zer bzhin mig log cig bltas rjes don grub kyi gam du song nas skad dma' po'i sgo nas ‘‘shag po dbang chen da lta rdza rong der gab yod dam ’’zhes dris/‘‘skyesgod/’’‘‘bde mo yin nam/’’‘‘bde mo yin/’’‘‘khyod tsho khyon sdom mi ga tshod yod/’’‘‘mi brgyad yod/’’380

dga' blos don grub kyi lag tu yod pa'i sprang zas de dag khyi la ster nas kho rang nang du song ste mar zan thang khuge chen po gang dang lug sha btsos ma sha lhu kha shas shig ster nas ‘‘da lta khyod rang log song / do dgong slebs yong ’’zer nas kho rang 'tshub nyi ler nang du log song /dbang chen dang don grub gnyis da res dga' blos bskur ba'i mar zan dang sha za bzhin rdza rong du sgug phyogs gang sar 'gro dbang med la btson pa ltar gab nas sdod pa dang / 'di dang de zhes pa'i bya ba yang med par sgug nas sdod rgyu ni ha cang yid mug pa dang / dus tshod 'gro dka' ba zhig red/shag po dga' blo ga dus slebs yong ngam/ khong la gtam bzang gang zhig shod rgyu yod snyam/ don du dga' blo sa rub rjes ma gtogs mi yong ba shes kyi yod kyang dus tshod 'gro dka' ba'i dbang gis rdza rong gi kha las don te mgrin pa bsring nas sde ba'i phyogs su yang yang bltas/don grub ni re zhig don chen zhig sgrub nas blo yid tshims pa ltar zas kyis grod pa rgyags rjes gan rkyal du nyal te dgung sngon la mig ce rer bltas nas gzhis la yod pa'i rang gi ma dang / gsar du bsus pa'i chung ma yid la dran/ da lta khong gnyis gang byed kyin yod dam/ phal cher nga dran te nga'i skor skad cha shod pa dang / a mas rtsub la gyong pa'i lag pas sbra sgo g.yas g.yon phyes te nga tsho 'gro ba'i phyogs su bltas te nga'i ched du sems khral byed bzhin nga tsho phyir yong rgyur sgug yod nges red/ de mtshams nas 'brug mtshos a ma'i gzhogs g.yas g.yon zhig nas sbra'i sgo srub las mig rgyang gcod kyin nga sgug nas yod shas che snyam nas ga ler mig btsums nas gnyid khug pa'i zol gyis rkang pa gnyis bskums te gzhogs g.yas pa sa la sbyar nas nyal/381

da gzod nyi ma nub ri'i rtser lhung ste gser gyi sgor mo zhig bye spungs kyi steng du bslangs ba ltar ser gyi ler 'dug ri chen gyi grib ma ring nas ring du 'gro ba dang chabs cig nyi ma rim gyis chu lha'i pang du gshegs te re zhig nub phyogs kyi mkha' dbyings dgong mo'i mtshams sprin dmar ser gyis yongs su bklubs nas mu mtha' bral ba'i dgung sngon de phyed ser phyed sngon gyi tshon mdog mi 'dra ba'i dum bu gnyis su gyur zhing mtho tshad gzhan las 'phags pa'i lhun po'i rtse mor da dung nyi ma'i 'od lhag gi sor mdangs shig mngon rgyu yod kyang ja phor pa gang 'thung ba'i dus thung nang de'ang mi mngon par gyur te sa gzhi chen po mun pa'i yol nag gis bsgribs shing rgyu skar gyi khra tshom dgung sngon dbyings su khyab/de'i skabs kho gnyis kyis snga sa nas gra sgrig byas pa'i lci ba rnams mnyam tu spungs te me tshang byi'u tshang 'dra ba zhig bcas nas me lcags brdab ste me son blangs nas me tshang gi dkyil du bzhag pa'i steng du lci zhib blugs/ de nas gnyis ka sa ru nyal nas phu btab pas cung ma 'gor bar me tshang gi nang nas me dmar lham mer 'bar byung /kho gnyis kha sprod du bsdad de mdun du rdza rdo leb mo re bzhag pa'i steng du sha btsos ma lhu re bzhag yod pa de da lta me yis dros te tshi lu bzhur ba'i zhag gis rdo leb de gnyis kyang snum gyis tshos nas 'dugadon grub kyis kho rang gi mdun du bzhag pa'i sha de yar blangs te za bzhin du ‘‘a khu/ da sha zo ’’zer/dbang chen gyis rang gi mdun du yod pa'i sha de a log cig brgyab nas ‘‘ngas sngon la sna tha zhig 'then ’’zer bzhin rum las sna ru blangs te pus mo'i steng du lan gsum brdab nas mthe bong g.yon ma'i sen mo'i steng du blugs/gcig gis sha bzas/382

gcig gis sna tha 'then/re zhig nas shar phyogs nas zla ba sgong gzugs shig shar te nag 'thib 'thib kyi 'jig rten de skya mog mog gi 'jig rten du gyur/ da gzod dbang chen gyis glo gri shubs las blangs te kho rang gi mdun du bzhag pa'i sha de yar blangs te bzas/don grub kyis lci ba rdog 'ga' me nang du blugs rjes sha bzas zin pa'i dpung pa'i rus pa bcag ste gri rtses rkang drus te bzas/‘‘si da si ’’zhes shu gnyis brgyab byung bas ‘‘shag po slebs pa red ’’ces kho gnyis ma gros gcig mthun gyis rdza rong las don te bltas pas shag po dga' blo rkang pa gyol bzhin du yong gi 'dug pas lam seng mdun du rgyug nas bsus/dga' blo dang / dbang chen gnyis phan tshun yun ring bral ba'i ma bu slar 'phrad pa ltar gcig la gcig 'khyud de gong bu gcig tu gyur/de nas dga' blos dbang chen gyi ngo gdong la lag pa reg bzhin du ‘‘khyod bde mo yin nam mi’zer/dbang chen dga' spro dang sems 'gul gyis mgrin pa brnang ste ‘‘nga bde mo yin/ shag shag po khyod bde mo yin nam ’’zer/‘‘nga bde bde thang thang yin/ da nga'i nang du 'gro ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘khyod kyi nang du stabs bde po yod dam ’’zer/dga' blos da lta kho gnyis kyis sa ru bkram pa'i ca dngos de dag bsdu gsog rgyag bzhin du ‘‘sems khral mi dgos/ mgyogs tsam 'gro ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ltogs pas zas dang skom pas 'thung 'dod ltar g.yang mo'i skor gyi gnas tshul shes 'dod nas ‘‘g.yang mo bde mo red dam ’ zhes dris/ dga' blos ‘‘g.yang mo bde mo red/ nang du slebs rjes skad cha 383

bshad chog nga tsho 'gro ’’zhes rdza rong nas don te phyin/nang du slebs dus dga' blo'i phru gu gnyis snga sa nas nyal zin pa dang /chung mas thab 'gram du bsdad de skud pa 'khel bzhin 'dug thab kyi steng du rdza ma chen po zhig gi nang du thug pa zhim po zhig lhog lhog tu khol bzhin yod pa de las sha tshil dang / la phug gi dri zhim kho gnyis kyi sna lam du 'thul/thab 'gram du ja khog lter gang bzhag 'dug pa de dag ni snga sa nas kho gnyis la gra sgrig byas pa los yin/chung mas lam seng ‘‘khyod gnyis la phor pa yod dam ’’zer/‘‘yod ’’ces kho gnyis kyis rum las phor pa bton te mdun du bzhagachung mas ‘‘ja tsha po thungs dang drod khug gi red ’’ces kho gnyis la ja blugs pa dang / de nas thug pa phor pa gang re blugs te sbyin/dbang chen gyis ‘‘shag po/ na thang du rta mang po 'di 'dra su tshang gi red ’’ces dris/dga' blos ‘‘sngon la lto yag po zo/ ja thungs/ nyin mang por ja ma rag pas kha skom yod kyi red/ de nas nga tsho skad cha bshad chog da nga la'ang thug pa gang blugs dang ’’zer/don grub dang dbang chen gnyis kha skom pa las grod pa ltogs pa min yang de lta bu'i thug pa zhim po de 'dra 'thung ma myong bas bstud mar thug pa phor pa do re btung /dga' blos rum las sna ru bton te kho rang gi mthe bong g.yon pa'i sen mo'i steng du sna tha cung zad cig blugs rjes sna ru dbang chen la g.yar te ‘‘khyod tsho tshang mar rta bzhon rgyu yod dam ’’zhes dris/dbang chen gyis ‘‘rta yod/ mi rer rta re yod ’’ces lan btab rjes ‘‘g.yang mo da lta bde bde thang thang red dam ’’zhes bskyar 'dri byas/384

dga' blos ‘‘bde bde thang thang red/ na ning mo la phru gu bu zhig skyes song ’’zhes 'das don thung ngu zhig dbang chen la bshad pa gsham gsal/g.yang mo rang nyid 'dre lag nas thar ba'i go skabs yod pa'i yid ches kyis btsan rgod kha sho'i blo dogs rbad de sel ched sngar bas kho la brtse dung che ba yod khul gyis btsan rgod kha sho phyir skyod byed skabs sems 'phreng ba'i tshul gyis mig chu gtong ba dang / phyi nas tshur log skabs thag ring po'i sa nas mdun bsu bar yong nas ‘‘khyod phyir skyod thengs rer nga'i sems su stong lhang lhang zhig 'dug ’’ces pa sogs kha yag ngo bstod sna tshogs shod kyi yod/don du btsan rgod kha sho phyir skyod thengs rer mo'i lus sems gnyis kar rang dbang dang bde skyid thengs re thob pa red/sngon ma btsan rgod kha sho phyir skyod byed dgos tshe kho rang gi blos thub pa 'ga' shas la mngon gsal dod po med pa'i sgo nas g.yang mo'i bya spyod la lkog blta byed dgos lugs mngags kyi yod pas mi de dag gis g.yang mor me gtong rogs dang chu len rogs byed khul gyis blta srung byed kyi yod/gnas tshul de g.yang mos shes te mo rang ha cang tshul ldan dang / btsan rgod la sems khur byed khul gyis btsan rgod phyir slebs nyer yod tshe sha btsos pa dang / thud brdzis te sgug gi yod pas btsan rgod rbad de yid ches te dogs zon byed kyi med/nyin zhig kho la lung pa gzhan gyi 'byor ldan pa'i khyim tshang zhig gi mna' ma bsu ba'i bag ston la yong dgos pa'i mgron brda 'byor bas kho rang sho sbag dang chang la shin tu dga' bas slog pa gzig shan dang wa zhwa gyon/ rta rkyang po zhig la bzhon te song / 'gro khar g.yang mos kho la sems khur chen po yod khul gyis ‘‘chang mang po ma 'thung ang / ra bzi na yag po med/'khrug pa'ang shor yong ’rizhes bshad/385

khos ‘‘ya ya/ ngas chang mang po 'thung mi yong / khyod sems khral ma byed ang ’’zhes bshad de ngo ma chang mang po 'thung mi rung / mos 'di lta bu'i sems khur byed dus ngas mo'i khar los nyan snyam/bag ston gyi bzhugs gral du ngo shes pa dang mi shes pa'i mi mang po 'dugakhos 'gying nyams chen po'i sgo nas de dag gi khrod du bsdad kyang byad bzhin mdog nyes de mthong bas mgron po tshang ma skyug bro ba dang / byis pa rnams 'jigs skrag skyed/ bud med rnams kyis shub shub lab ste kho la 'phya smod byas pas kho ngo tsha dang / khong khro mnyam skyed kyis bstud mar chang phor pa mang po btung ste ra bzi nas gam du yod pa'i mgron po 'byor ldan pa zhig gi gces phrug dang kha rtsod shor te ‘‘nga btsan rgod btsan gyi bu yin/ khyos nga la mthong chung de 'dra byed kyi yod na/ 'di'i ming la ci zer e shes ’’zhes sked gri bton te ‘‘de ring g.yag gus 'brong la rwa rtsed 'gran/ 'brong mi shi g.yag gu shi 'dod red ’’ces kha brdung btang nas gsod rtsis byas/ 'on kyang skabs der bzhugs gral la mi mang po yod pas ‘‘ra bzi'i kha dang gnyid shor gyi rkub la cha 'jog med/ de 'dra ma byed ’ces bkag 'gog byas/gces phrug lang shor de khong khro 'jags thabs med pa zhig langs nas ‘‘smug pa lang lang mtsho las langs/ mtsho med na smug pa langs don med/ma bcangs wa rnga sbom po 'di bcangs na ci 'dra blta rgyu yin ’’zhes btsan rgod kyi steng du mchongs nas sked gri bton/ der yod mi tshang mas ‘‘de 'dra ma byed de 'dra ma byed ’’ces phar 'then tshur 'then byas nas re zhig zing 'jags thub tsam byung /phyi nyin btsan rgod kha sho phyir log pa'i lam du gces phrug lang shor des ab phrug gnyis khrid nas sgug 'dug kho tsho mi res gri ring re bzung ste ‘‘kha seng kha pho che ba'i kha sho khyod kyis/ nga su yin shes kyi 'dug gam/ dpa' 386

dpung pa yod na shog dang ’’zer/btsan rgod kyis sked gri shubs dang mnyam du blangs te de ring mi lag mang nyung gi khyad par che bas stabs legs ma song bsam nas ‘‘ngas dgongs pa ma tshoms zhu rgyu yin/ kha seng ra bzi bas red ’’ces sked gri gces phrug lang shor de la rtsis 'bul zhus te tshe thar gtong re byas/gces phrug lang shor des btsan rgod kha sho'i skod gri phar g.yug nas ‘‘hwa hwa/ dpa' med na byed stangs de 'dra red/ dpa' med pa'i mi la chang gis phan thogs chen po 'dug ga hwa hwa/ da khyod rang gog bgrod byas te nga gnyis kyi brla 'og nas yar mar thengs gsum song dang / de nas nga tshos tshe thar gtong chog ’mices bshad de rkang pa bgrad bgrad byas te brla bar nas 'gro dgos pa'i tshul bstan/skyes pa pho lus blangs pa 'dra 'dra'i nang gcig gis gcig la pham kha khur te 'doms 'og nas yar mar 'gro rgyu ni sha dang rus pa'i steng du mi bzod pa'i na tsha med kyang / ngo ma sems nang du bzod thabs bral ba'i mthong chung dang brnyas bcos de las lhag pa med pas btsan rgod kyi ngo gdong sngar bas skyug bro ba'i rnam 'gyur gyi thog nas ‘‘dpon chung lags/ de 'dra ma zer dang / ngas pham kha khur bas da dung ma 'grig pa gang yod/ da nas nga tsho sha khag khag dang gri so so byas nas rang rang gi nang du sdod rgyu byung na kha mchu dang gyod gzhi med/ rjes su dpon chung lags nga tsho'i ru bar phebs na zhabs phyi gang dgos kho bos zhus pas chog ’’ces rang srog thar thabs kyis de ltar bshad/gces phrug lang shor des sngar bas lhag pa'i ngar ngar rdzig rdzig gis lag g.yon mas btsan rgod kyi brang las bzung zhing lag g.yas pas gri rtse sna la gtad de ‘‘kho re kha sho/ 'di'i ming la ci zer ma shes na 'di'i ming la gri rtse 387

zer/ nga pha phyug po'i gces phrug lus gyon rgyu dar dang gos chen/ kha za rgyu 'bras dang bu ram byas pa gcig gis sprang rgan kha sho gcig gsod rgyu ni sa steng gi 'bu srin gsod rgyu las kyang sla/ da khyod nga tsho'i 'doms 'og nas 'gro 'am mi 'gro/ sdug srog rta rnga phra mo de dgos sam mi dgos ’’zhes bshad zhor du gri rtse ya mchu'i steng du bzhag nas ‘‘kha 'di'i phyogs dbral na sngar bas nyams che ba mi 'dug gam ri’zhes gri rtse shugs kyis 'then pas btsan rgod kyi yas mchu g.yas phyogs de dbral nas zungs khrag dmar chi ler thon/btsan rgod gdug rtsub che ba'i mnar gcod ma bzod par ‘6a —’’zhes ri klung brag ca 'khor ba'i ngar skad dang chabs cig gces phrug de'i steng du mchongs nas mgo skyes kyi lcang lo las bzung ste shugs kyis tshur 'then pa dang dus mnyam rkang pa g.yas pas grod pa'i steng du rdog rgyag cig gzhus pas gces phrug lang shor de ltag dgye log nas mig mtha' skar ma khra chem chem shar/de mar ab phrug gnyis po stag dmar yag brag dmar gyi rtse nas mchongs pa ltar som nyi dang / the tshom spu tsam med par kho'i steng du mchongs pas khos lam seng am phrag las rum gri bton te phyir bshol gom gang byas/ ab phrug mdun ma des gri ring 'dom sgegang tsam zhig 'phyar te g.yug byung / de mar btsan rgod kyis rum gri khru gang tsam de 'phred du g.yug pas gri dang gri thug pa'i lcags rigs kyi sgra ‘‘thing ’’zhes pa dang bcas bkag de dang dus mnyam ab phrug gcig shos des kyang gri ring po zhig kho'i brang la gtad de snun byung bas khos bde lcag 'khyug po'i sgo nas phyir bshol byed zhor du rum gri g.yug pas bkag thub tsam byung /de'i skabs gces phrug lang shor de dran pa sos te am btsigs bsdams shing sked gri 'khar bar brten nas yar langs te btsan rgod kyi phyogs su sdang mig bgrad de sna khung gnyis las 'dzags pa'i zungs khrag phu 388

dung gis phyis trem byas/ rkang pa gnyis 'dar sig sig gis dbugs kyang hal bzhin du ‘‘de de ring khyi rgan 'di thar par btang na nga'i ming nas ma 'bod/ khyod gnyis khyod gnyis kyang bu gzhon pa'i gral la sdod rin med ’’ces bshad de yang khrag sbar mo gang phyis te btsan rgod la mdzub mo btsugs te ‘‘khyi rgan khyod/ nyi ma de ring nas bzung shi ming ma gtogs gson ming yod bsam pa ma byed ’’zer/btsan rgod kyi khog nang du khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar bzhin du de ring shi rgyu las gson pa'i re ba ni mi 'dug wa rnga ma shar re bros pa las stag 'dzum drug rgyas nas shi na dga' snyams te ngo smad yongs su khengs pa'i khrag dmar phyis tsam byas te ‘‘khyod tsho mi mang ro mang red/ nga mi nyung ro nyung yin/khyod tsho gsum de ring nas bzung drin pha ma'i zhal ras mjal yong bsam pa dang / gsal nyi ma'i dro skyid mthong yong bsam pa ma byed ’’zer bzhin da gin rang gis phar phyogs la rtsis 'bul zhus pa'i sked grir blta dus gri shubs rgya dngul la g.yu dang byu ru'i phra can de bye ma'i nang du nar rer yod cing gri yi phyed ka bye ma'i 'og tu mnan nas 'dug pas rang nyid dgra lag tu shor nas shi tshar ba'i rnam shes bar dor 'khyams pa'i skabs mthong ba'i skyo shas che ba'i snang tshul lta bu zhig byung ste da lta rang nyid kyi tshe srog ma dor bar gson 'jig rten du bsdad yod pas ma shi gong rang gi mtshon cha shubs dang lhan du bdag med du bor te bye ma'i 'og tu mnan na ha cang bkra mi shes pa'i ltas ngan pa zhig red snyam nas rang gi sked gri'i phyogs su mchongs/ de mar ab phrug gcig gis gri gcig g.yug byung pa de bkag thub na'ang rna ba g.yas nga pags pa lhob tsam zhig gis bzung ste dpung pa'i steng nas thur du dpyang / khos shi rtsis las gson rtsis med pa'i sgo nas rum gri de shugs kyis bsnun pas ab phrug de'i brang la thebs nas skad ngan shor te ga ler sa ru 'gyel/389

de'i skabs gces phrug lang shor des kho'i g.yon phyogs nas gri g.yug byung bas shi na mnyam shi byed rgyu las gzhan gyi bsam blo gang yang ma btang bar gri ma bkag par thad kar gces phrug lang shor de'i phyogs su shugs kyis bsnun pas kho rang gi lag pa g.yon ma dpung pa'i mtshams nas gces phrug lang shor des g.yug pa'i gris bcad pa dang chabs cig gces phrug lang shor de rgyu ma phyir don te gan rkyal du 'gyel/ de'i skabs kho rang yang lus kyi tshugs ka mi brtan par yam yom gyis mgo yu 'khor nas bsam rgyu dran rgyu med par gyur/re zhig song mtshams rlung 'tshub cig gis da gzod kho bsam rgyu dran rgyu yod par gyur te blta dus rang nyid ab phrug gcig gi ro'i 'og tu mnan nas 'dug nga da lta gang byas pa yin nam/ steng du yod pa'i mi ro 'di ci yin nam/ nga gnyid du shor ba yin nam snyam bzhin du dbugs ring zhig gtong dus rang gi gri da gin ab phrug gcig de'i brang steng du zug cing gri yu da dung rang gi lag g.yas pas dam por bzung nas 'dug pas rang nyid ma shi bar mi ro'i 'og tu nyal na ltas ngan red bsam nas shugs kyis 'phag ste steng du yod pa'i phung po de gzhogs g.yon phyogs su g.yugs/rang gi gzhogs g.yon phyogs de shin tu lci ba'i rdo pha bong zhig gis mnan pa ltar ljid tig ger 'dug pa de da gin phar phyogs mis gri g.yug ste bcad pa da dung brjed/khos ga ler phar blta tshur blta byed dus rang gi rta rkyang po de mi ro'i khrod du sdug bsngal gyis mnar te bla 'khyams pa ltar mgo bo smad de langs nas 'dug da gzod rang nyid gson por nang du slebs thub pa'i yid ches dang / rang nyid mi gcig gis dgra zla gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i spobs sems kyis lus kyi nus shugs rab tu 'phel te ba spu rkang gcig la'ang gnod 390

skyon med par bde bde thang thang ltar sa las hob langs kyis rta'i phyogs su song nas mchongs thengs gcig gis bya sa ru babs pa ltar rta sga'i steng du bzhon/ lag pa g.yon mas rta'i srab mda' 'dzin par brtsams tshe 'gul skyod byed rgyu med pa'i tshor snang zhig byung bas ci byas pa red snyam nas blta dus rang gi lag pa g.yon ma slog pa'i phu dung dang mnyam du dpung pa'i mtshams nas gar song cha med du gyur 'dug pas da gin gces phrug lang shor des bcad pa gzhi nas dran te lag pa chad dum de gang du yod pa lta skabs lag pa chad dum de lang shor de'i phung po'i sngas su byas nas 'dug pas sems sdug drag po zhig skyed de gzhi nas bzod thabs bral ba'i na zug gis lus yam yom du gyur nas rta yi steng nas lhung grabs byas/rang gi skod gri de ni phyed ka bye ma'i 'og tu mnan nas 'dug pas sems nang du sngar byung myong med pa'i gdung ba drag po skyed de 'dren byed zung las mig chu rkang gnyis su mgyogs kyi bang rtsal 'gran pa ltar thur du lhung nas ngo smad khrag dmar gyi nang du 'dres/ rta sga'i steng du khrag gi thigs pa gcig lhung bas da gzod yas mchu dbral ba dran te na zug btang / lag g.yas pa yar bkyag nas ngo smad kyi khrag dmar phyis skabs dpung pa'i steng du dngos po zhig thur du dpyang pa'i tshor snang zhig byung nas blta dus am lcog g.yas pa dmar sgor re dpung pa'i steng nas thur du dpyang 'dug pas kho khong khro chen po langs te mgrin pa gzengs su gtod de gnam la bltas nas ‘‘hwa hwa hwa ’’zhes ma 'dod pa'i gad mo chen po zhig bgad rjes am btsigs bsdams nas 'then thengs gcig gis dpung pa'i steng nas thur du dpyang pa'i am lcog de bcad de g.yug pas am lcog de bye rtswa sngo 'bob 'bob cig gi steng du lhung nas lo ma sngon po'i steng du bzhad pa'i me tog dmar po zhig dang yang dag mtshungs/ khos re zhig mig ce rer der bltas nas ‘‘hu ’’zhes dbugs ring 391

zhig btang ba dang / de nas yang gnam la bltas nas ‘‘hwa hwa hwa ’’zhes gad mo bgad/de'i skabs ‘‘kwa kwa ’’zhes pho rog nag chung gnyis 'phur yong ste kho'i steng du lding skor zhig brgyab rjes sa ru babs nas am lcog bdag med de mchu yis bzung ste 'phrog res byed kyin 'phur song /khos mgrin pa kyog ste ring du gshegs pa'i pho rog de gnyis la bltas te mchu zur nas 'dzum chung zhig ston te dar zhig ri mo'i gzugs su gyur ba'i tshul la bltas na sangs rgyas kyis stag mo lus sbyin gyi mdzad pa ltar kho rang gis kyang bkres ltogs kyis mnar ba'i pho rog zung la am lcog gi sbyin pa btang nas spobs pa skyed pa ltar snang /cung 'gor rjes kho rang yang dran pa gsos pa ltar mig gnyis grung hrig hrig tu gyur nas dbugs ring zhig btang rjes rang nyid ma shi gson po'i skabs rang sha pho rog gis bzas pa mthong bas sdug bsngal chen po byung nas da gin am lcog de 'phen mi 'os snyam pa'i 'gyod sems drag po skyed de ‘‘thu thu thu ’’zhes pho rog de gnyis kyi phyogs su mchil ma btab/de nas khos yob sdeb cig byas nas khyim gyi phyogs su song / kho'i rjes su zungs khrag gi thigs dmar po zhig 'then nas 'dug de'i skabs mig gnyis rab rib tu gyur ba dang / mgo yang rim bzhin smad de lag pa'i srab mda' yang shor/phyi nyin zhogs pa g.yang mo mal las langs te sgor don dus rta rkyang po de sgo ru langs nas sdug bsngal drag po zhig gis mgo 'gyogs mi thub pa ltar mgo bo smad de mo rang la bltas nas 'dug de mar mo'i sems su dngangs skrag chen po zhig skyed de steng du blta dus btsan rgod kyi phung po lag ya med pa de g.yas g.yon gyi phyogs lhung med par rta yi steng du bzhon zhing mgo bo rta'i rngog 392

ma'i khrod du lhung nas khrag gi thigs pa sa ru lhung gin 'dug mos da bar mi ro mthong myong med pas ‘‘a ma ma ri’zhes skad shor/ de mar yas mas khyim mtshes kyi phyogs su rgyug nas gnas tshul bshad/ khyim mtshes kyi mi rnams hang sang nas 'jigs skrag skyed/ bza' ma bud med gcig gis phung po thag gcod byed mi thub pas rogs ma byas na ga la 'grig snyam nas tshang mas ha rub sbar rub kyis rogs byas nas phung po dur 'jug byas/bsam yul las 'das pa'i don de g.yang mo'i ngos nas bshad na yun ring re sgug byas pa'i stong bsam mngon 'gyur byung ba zhig yin pas sems nang du sdug bsngal rta rnga tsam med kyang snying rje tshad med skyed de zhag ma bdun bdun bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i ring mchod me rgyun chad med par spar te 'das mchod byas/shod mtshams der slebs dus dbang chen khong khro dang 'gyod sems mnyam skyed kyis ‘‘mi ngan kho tshar bcad tshar ba red/ nga yong phyi drags song ’’zhes khu tshur sa ru brdab nas skad brgyab/dga' blos ‘‘skad ma rgyag skad ma rgyag ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘'o na da lta g.yang mo gcig pu e red ’’ces dris/dga' blos sna tha sen mo gang blugs nas ‘‘deng sang so srung dmag de dag phar phyin med/ nyin shas song rjes kho tsho phar log rgyu red/ de bar du shag po khyod rang 'dir sgug nas sdod/ da 'thab dgos 'dzing dgos med pa 'dra/ so srung dmag gis da lo nga tsho'i mtshon cha yongs rdzogs bsdus song /kho tshos zer na da lo gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i brgyud du spre'u srin po'i dmag slebs yod pas kho tsho sangs rgyas bstan pa'i ched du spre'u srin po'i dmag la phar rgol byed par 'gro dgos yod zer/ da dung sde ba'i nang nas dang blangs kyis dpung rogs 'gro mkhan yod na dngul srang brgya re'i bya dga' 393

ster rgyu yin zer ’’zhes bshad/‘‘'dir yang so srung dmag slebs yod dam ’mizhes dbang chen gyis dris/dga' blos ‘‘yod/ na ning nas 'dir slebs pa red/ de dag ni shag po khyod rang rtsad gcod byed mkhan red 'dug ’’ces bshad/khotshos ji ltar byas nas shes pa yin snyam nas ‘‘de dus nga tshos bod dmag de dag gcig kyang ma lhag par bsad pas kho tshos nga ga 'dra byas nas shes pa yin nam ’’zhes dbang chen hang sang nas chig lab brgyab/gnas tshul de yang 'di ltar te/de sngon g.yang phyug tsho pas tshar gcod btang pa'i bod dmag de dag ni byang rigs dmag khongs kyi rdo rag sha'i brgyud du sdod mkhan gyi so dmag red/de lo ru dpon tshe mgon gyis khrid pa'i so srung dmag de dag rdo rag shar ma song par g.yang phyug tu bsdad de phyir slebs rjes rdo rag sha'i brgyud bde 'jags yin lugs rdzun bshad na 'grig snyam yang g.yang phyug tsho bas tshang ma tshar bcad pas rgyun ldan gyi log tshod la phyir ma slebs pas phal cher gnas tshul tshabs chen zhig lhag pa red snyam nas byang rigs dmag gis dmag mi bcu shog gnyis rdo rag sha'i brgyud du btang / 'on kyang dmag mi de dag rdo rag sha'i rgyud du slebs nas yul mi tshor gnas tshul 'dri dus yul mi tshos nga tsho'i 'dir lo rtag par so srung dmag bcu shog re yong gi yod kyang 'di lo slebs ma byung zer bas byang rigs dmag khongs kyi ngos nas bshad na ru dpon tshe mgon gyis sne khrid byas pa'i bcu shog de bya 'phur rjes med lkog gyur gyi gsang ba de'i phugs rtsa rnyed thabs bral ba zhig red/de sngon btsan rgod kha sho dang ngan pa lag 'brel gyi jag pa de dag gis byang brgyud gang sar 'phrog bcom dang ri dwags rngon nas lo shas phyin rjes rdzas mdel rdzogs/ phyir log nas rdzas mdel nyo sgrub byas te bod zla bdun 394

par rgya mo nang du slebs/ skabs der byang rigs nang so'i dmag sgar gyis rtswa thang gi steng du sbra gur phub nas sha chang longs su spyod kyin dmag sbyong rtsal 'gran tsis len dang nyes can khrims gcod kyi byed sgo spel bzhin yod/dmag mi rnams kyis rta thog nas me mda'i tsha kha 'gran pa dang / sbe ga 'gran pa/ rta'i bang rtsal 'gran pa/ glu len gar rtsed sogs 'gran sdur dang / byed sgo sna tshogs spel/ gzhan yang rkun 'phrog dang / srog gcod byed mkhan nyes can khrims mun du tshud pa dag gcer bur phyung nas nyes pa khrims bsgrags byed pa dang / nyes pa che chung ltar rta lcag gis brab kyin 'dugamada' dpon grags pa 'bol gdan gyi khri thog tu bsdad de sha chang gi ro bcud la rol bzhin du mig log rdzig rdzig gis ab phrug de dag la ‘‘lcag tshan tsha zhu byed dgos ’’zhes bka' 'beb pa dang / yang skabs re gam du yod pa'i na chung mdzes ma de dag la ma rabs kyi rtsed mo sna tshogs rtsed kyin 'dugabakod sgrig byas pa'i 'gran bsdur gyi rnam grangs de dag mjug 'gril rjes 'byor ldan pa'i khyim tshang gi glu len gar rtsed dang / rta rgyug mda' rtsal la dga' ba'i skye bo de rnams kyis dmangs khrod kyi byed sgo sna tshogs spel/lam gyi g.yon phyogs su nor lug gi sog rus btsugs te rgyang 'phen 'gran bsdur byed skabs dmag mi dang / yul mi rta pa de dag gi khrod du 'ben la thebs mkhan gcig kyang mi 'dugade'i tshe jag pa de rnams kyis rta 'do ba'i steng du g.yo med bzhon te lag pas me mda' klad du bskor te rtsal sna tshogs ston bzhin 'ben de dag re re bzhin gtor bas mda' dpon grags pa ha las hang sang gis lag nang gi chang phor sa ru lhung / mig gnyis kyang gdang btsum gyi dbang rtsa nyams pa ltar ltad mor g.yeng nas rengs por lus/395

rta rgyug dga' ston gyi dus su'ang gzab mchor med par 'khyam po lta bu'i rta rtsal can 'di dag ga nas yin shes pa byed dgos snyam pa dang / de sngon rdo rag sha'i rgyud kyi so srung dmag de dag 'khyam po 'di dag gis tshar bcad pa min nam/ gnad don de rtsad gcod thub na dpe med kyi byas rjes yin bsam nas kho rang gi ab phrug gam du bos nas rna bar skad cha shub shub 'ga' bshad/ab phrug de jag pa tsho'i gam du song nas ‘‘wa ye/ mda' dpon sku ngo nas khyod tsho yar shog gsung gi 'dug ’’ces lag g.yug byas/jag pa tshos dogs zon chen po'i sgo nas me mda' bzung ste gom zheng chen po'i sgo nas ab phrug de'i rjes su 'brang ste mda' dpon gyi gam du slebs nas mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis/rdza rag dkar mgo sba (sbra )byas byas kyis/sbra re lu'i chon thag shes le min/dgung a sngon dpon po byas byas kyis/gong dpon por gus zhabs shes le min/zhes glu btang ba dang de nas ‘‘don dag ci yod shod dang / pho rtsed rtse 'dod na rtsed rgyu red/ de min na nga tsho 'gro rgyu yin ’’zhes bshad/mda' dpon gyis kho tsho'i glu tshig thos pa tsam gyis de tsho ni phyogs nges med 'khyams pa'i jag pa yin pa shes te sems 'tshab dang bcas ‘‘khyod khyod tsho dogs pa de 'dra mi dgos/ nga nga tsho grogs po sgrig na 'grig gam ’’zhes bshad/jag pa tshos gom gang mdun du spos nas spobs pa chen po'i ngang /bu khram pa nga la mgo sbra med/rdza rag dkar khram pa'i mgo sbra red/ 396

bu khram pa nga la dpung rogs med/bo'u khra ring khram pa'i dpung rogs red/bu khram pa nga la 'gro rogs med/rta 'do ba khram pa'i 'gro rogs red/bu khram pa nga la dpon po med/dgung a sngon khram pa'i dpon po red/ces glu blangs/nye 'khor du yod pa'i mi rnams kyis mi 'di tshos gong dpon por mjal dar 'bul rgyu lta ci/ da dung glu len pa dang me mda'i mchu dpon rgan la gtad pas mi tshad me mda'i sbi sdi'i du ba sngo lhog lhog tu 'phyur ba mthong bas ya med de dag gi nye 'khor du bcar mi nus par phyir bshol byas nas rgyang blta byed pa dang / 'ga' shas kyis de ring ltad mo chen po zhig mthong pa 'dug mda' dpon chen mo'ang 'jigs skrag gis skad cha'ang dab dib las mi khrol ba/ ya med 'di tsho yul gang nas yong ba yin nam snyam nas blta rub brgyab/de'i skabs mda' dpon gyi ngo gdong las btsan shugs kyis btsir ba'i 'dzum mdangs skyug bro po zhig bstan nas zhabs phyi tshor ‘‘za 'dre tsho/ khong rnams la chang zhus ’’zhes sdigade mar zhabs phyi tshos lag pa 'dar gyin du jag pa tshor chang phor pa gang re ster/jag pa rnams kyis lag g.yon mas me mda' bzung zhing lag g.yas pas chang phor blangs te mda' dpon dang bcas pa'i sku ngo tsho'i mdun du song nas ‘‘dug sbyar med dam ’’zhes chang phor cog tse'i steng du shugs kyis brdab ste chang gi zegs ma mkha' la thor nas dpon rigs de dag gi gos chen phyu pa 397

brlan pa bzos/mda' dpon gyi sems su ma rungs pa 'di dag da lta rang tshar gcod thub na ci ma rung / nga lta bu mda' dpon chen mo la gus zhabs byed rgyu lta ci/da dung chang phor cog tser brdab nas mthong chung byed kyi 'dug snyam nas khog nang du khong khro chen po langs kyang da dung khong khro langs med khul gyis ‘‘dug sbyar med/ de 'dra dpe srid dogs med/ khyod tsho yid ma ches na gzigs dang ’’zhes chang phor de dag gi mthil du lhag pa'i chang re re bzhin kho rang gis gtsang mar btung nas zhabs phyi tshor slar yang chang blugs dgos pa'i brda btang / da gzod jag pa tsho yid ches te chang phor tshur blangs te gtsang mar btung nas rnam 'gyur cung legs pa'i sgo nas ‘‘dpon po lags/ don dag ci yod shod dang ’’zer/mda' dpon yar langs nas ‘‘nga tsho shag po byas na 'grig gam/ khyed tsho'i rta rtsal ni ngo ma ha las dgos pa rkyang rkyang red ri’ces kha yag ngo bstod byed kyin kho tsho 'khris kyi 'bol khri'i steng du gdan drangs/jag pa tshos 'gying nyams chen po'i sgo nas 'bol khri'i steng du dkyil krung du bsdad nas ‘‘chang blugs dang ’’zhes skad brgyab/de mar mda' dpon gyi ab phrug des zhabs phyi de dag la 'gram lcag re gzhus te ‘‘khyod tsho tshang ma shi tshar ba red dam/ sku mgron la sne len byed mi shes mkhan gyi za 'dre ’’zhes gshe gshe btang / zhabs phyi tshos de mar phu dung phrag steng du bzhag cing lce bsnar te ‘‘lags so ’’zhes gus gus zhum zhum gyis tshang mar chang blugs te lag gnyis kyis mthon por btegs te phul/ de nas sha dang thud sogs kyi sder ma jag pa tsho'i mdun du bzhag nas ‘‘mchod dang mchod dang ’’zer/398

mda' dpon gyis srung dmag tsho me mda' yongs gzhogs gcig tu mnyam du 'jog dgos pa las rdzig nyams ston mi rung ba'i lag brda byas pas srung dmag tshos mtshon cha rnams gzhogs gcig tu spungs nas ne'u gsing gi gzhi ru gram song /da gzod jag pa tshos me mda'i sbi sdi'i me bsad rjes me mda' rang rang gi gam du bzhag nas sha za bzhin chang yang yang btung /mda' dpon gyis ‘‘nga tsho tshang ma da nas bzung grogs po red/ sha yag po zo/ 'dzem byed dgos don med ’’ces bshad/ don du sems nang du ya rabs kyi spyod pa dang bral ba'i 'khyam po de tsho'i spyod par zhen pa log kyang ngo bstod kyi tshul du kho rang gi gam du yod pa'i sku ngo gzhan dag la ‘‘khyod tshos gzigs dang / 'brog pa zhes pa de blo gshogs yangs po ga 'dra mi 'dug gam/ sems rgyud drang po kha ri kha thug rkyang rkyang red dā ’’ces ngo bstod kyi skad cha bshad/gzhan rnams kyis kyang ‘‘red red/ dpe red mi’ces ngo bstod byas/jag pa tshos sha chang kho na longs su spyod pa las kho tsho'i skad char do snang ma byas/sha chang gis rbad de tshims rjes sbar mo'i nang gi zhag rtsi de dag ngo gdong la byug pa dang da dung chang phor pa gang re btung nas mda' dpon la ‘‘don dag gzhan med na nga tsho 'gro rgyu yin ’’zer/mda' dpon dang bcas pas ‘‘brel ba ma byed/ nga tshos khyed rnams la skad cha zhig 'dri rgyu yod/ lo shas kyi sngon nga tsho'i 'di nas rdo rag shar btang ba'i so srung dmag bcu gnyis gar song cha med du gyur nas da bar gson pa'i gzugs dang shi ba'i ro ma rnyed/ gal srid khyed rnams kyis go rig thos gsum byung na nga tshor snyan zhu byed rogs/ nga tshos gzengs bstod 399

gya nom pa byed rgyu yin/ lhag par du khyod tshos so srung dmag de dag gi dgra shablangs na rgyu nor gya nom pa 'bul rgyu yin mimizhes bshad/ jag dpon tshe ringagi sems su de ni btsan rgod kyis gnod 'tshe btang nas yul gyar ba'i dbang chen zhes pa de yin pa shes te ‘‘o dbang chen mi’zhes kha thal ba dang lam seng tshig mtshams bcad de nga dang dbang chen bar la pha rgyu grags pa can dang ma rgyu bzos pa can gang yang rtsod rgyu med pas kho la gnod 'tshe gtong dgos don mi 'dug snyam nas ‘‘mi shes/ nga tshos go ma myong ’’zhes bshad/g.yo sgyu che ba'i mda' dpon grags pas khos skad cha cha tshang ba ma bshad pas ma gtogs shes kyi 'dug snyam nas ‘‘ya ya/ de ma shes kyang gang med/kho tsho shi tshar ba red/ shi med na nam zhig log yong gi red/ de bas de ring nged tsho mnyam du skyid po gtong nas sdod ’’ces shod kyin zhabs phyi tshor chang blugs dgos pa'i brda btang /zhabs phyi tsho 'gram lcag gzhu bar 'jigs nas kho tshor chang yang yang btegs/ jag pa de dag ni sha chang la chags zhen che ba'i mi sha stag yin pas mthar nyi ma phyed yol tsam la tshang ma ra bzi nas la la gnyid khug la la skyug pa shor/ ca co'i sgras khengs te zhabs phyi bud med tshor 'dod sred kyi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs ston bzhin rang gi mtshon cha bdag med du gyur/go skabs de dang bstun nas mda' dpon gyis jag pa de dag 'dzin dgos pa'i brda btang ma thag dmag mi tsho spyang ki lug khyur shor ba bzhin rgyug ste jag pa drug po'i yan lag thag pas bkyig nas ril ril gru gu 'dra bar bzos/de'i skabs mda' dpon grags pa 'bol khri'i steng nas mar babs/lag pa g.yon ma rgyab tu bzhag cing g.yas pas sma rar byil byil byed bzhin du 400

phar 'gro tshur 'grotshobyas te 'gying nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas ‘‘hwa hwa hwa/ sprang bu 'gro 'gro mang dus rkang lag thang chus 'dzin/ wa mo 'gro 'gro mang dus rkang lag rnyi la tshud/ hwa hwa hwa mimizhes bgad de jag pa tsho'i sna rtser mdzub mo gtad de ‘‘sha chang gis tshims song ngam/ da dung chang dgos sam/ a/ hwa hwa/dpa' bo g.yul las rnam par rgyal yang mdzes ma'i 'gag sgo las mi thar/ya med spyod pa tsub kyang rang srog chang gis bskyal zhes pa cis mi bden ’’zhes bshad/da gzod jag dpon tshe ring chang gis bzi ba las dwangs te sems nang du khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar bzhin khro mig gis mda' dpon la sdig nas ‘‘g.yo sgyu can gyi khyi rgan khyod tsho bu dpa' bo'i gral la sdod rin ci yod/ g.yo sgyu'i mgo skor gtong ba las ci yang mi shes mkhan khyod sdar ma wa dang khyad ci yod ’’ces dmod tshig yang yang bor/mda' dpon gyis ‘‘dpa' dang thabs shes gnyis zung du ma sbrel na dgra tshar gcod thub kyi ma red/ shes song ngam/ dpa' dang thabs shes gnyis/gnyis ’’zhes mdzub mo gnyis bton te bshad rjes kha gnam la gdang nas ‘‘hwa hwa hwa ’’zhes bgod rjes yang khro mig gis jag pa tshor bltas nas ‘‘ngo ma dpa' bo rang red/ rang srog rang gis bskyal ba snying rje/ thabs blo gros med pa ya re nga / mig yod bzhin du rnyi la 'dzul/ tshe phyi ma de las grung tsam gyis ang ’’zhes bshad rjes phu dung yar brdzis te chang phor pa gang btung nas ha cang yid tshims pa'i khul gyis ‘‘a/ de 'dra'i zhim pa la ’’zhes bshad/jag pa tshos nus shugs gang yod bton te 'phag 'tshag brgyab kyang ngal ba'i rgyu las ma 'das/ de nas nyi ma yang nub ri'i phag tu yib nas yangs pa'i sa gzhir mun pa'i yol nag gis rim bzhin sgrib ste grangs 'das skar tshogs kyis mkha' dbyings la mdzes rgyan spras/401

de nas mda' dpon gyis lag zung rgyab tu bzhag nas 'gying nyams bton te phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed kyin du ‘‘hung / snying rje/ da kha chems yod na khog tu nyor/ bla ma yod na sems nang sgoms/ skyag gcin yod na gos thung nang du thongs/ glen pa tsho do dgong gnyid skyid po nyol ’mizhes 'phya smod kyi skad cha sna tshogs bshad rjes dmag mi bcu shog gcig gis do dgong kho tsho yag po srung dgos pa'i bka' phab ste mi grags gzhan dang lhan du gur mo che 'ja' ris dang rgyan spros kyis mdzes pa de'i nang du sha chang longs su spyod kyin sho sbag rtsed kyin bsdad do/sbag khri'i steng du dngul srang gi bang rim sgrig ste rgyan btsugs nas 'dug sku ngo de tsho'i be'u ras kyi stod gos dkar zhing gtsang pa de dag gi phu dung 'dom pa gang tsam byas pa de lag pa gnam la 'phyar dus dpung pa'i bar du zhud pa dang rna ba g.yon mar btags pa'i sog byil dpyang dpyang du g.yug gi 'dugaphyi nyin zhogs zas grub rjes mda' dpon dang bcas pa'i sku ngo drag rigs tshang ma 'bol khri'i steng du bzhugs gral la 'khod rjes/ dmag mi tshos kha seng gi jag pa de dag gi dpung pa'i yal 'dab phyin ci log par bkyig cing bgrod byed rkang pa la'ang lcags thag gis bcings nas bzhugs gral gyi mdun du khrid 'ongs nas pus mo sa ru btsugs te gnya' ba las mnan/de nas khrims kyi bya ba byed mkhan sku ngo nyi ma stobs chen gyis ‘‘jag pa 'di tsho ni yul sde mi skyid pa'i rtsa ba dug gi sdong po yin pas da res kho tsho 'dir mi gsod khrag dkrug rgyu nor 'phrog bcom byed par yong yang bya ngan lam du ma song bar rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing gi 'og tu tshud pa red ’ces lag gnyis sked par gzer nas khrims bsgrags byas/dmag mi de dag gis jag pa tsho'i gyon pa bshus te gcer bur bton te 402

kha sbub tu bsnyal nas gnya' ba'i steng du bzhon/ de nas lag tu rta lcag thogs pa'i skye bo drug gis gos kyi phu dung brdzes kyin du yong nas jag pa de dig gi rkub steng rta lcag gzhus/'breng bu mang po mnyam du bslas pa'i rta lcag lo brgyad byis pa'i dpung pa las sbom pa de dag glog dmar 'khyug pa ltar dgung du 'phyar te re re bzhin nus shugs gang yod bton te gzhus pas 'phongs mtshos kyi steng du sbrul nag 'khyug pa lta bu'i mdog sngo nag gi rjes re re bzhin mang du phyin/gdan steng du bzhugs pa'i sku ngo de tsho'i mchu zur g.yas g.yon las 'dzum chung re mngon pa dang sma rar byil bzhin spro snang gi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs bstan/blta rub rgyag mkhan gyi yul mi la las ‘‘'khyam po las zad de tsho ya nga mi’zer nas 'jigs skrag dang ya nga'i rnam 'gyur ston/ la las ‘‘sde 'bangs skyid du mi bcug mkhan 'di tsho la dgos nges red/ ya med 'di tshos mi ga tshod bsad med dam/ da res las 'bras mdzub mo'i rtse nas‘ 'khor ba red ’’ces sdig mo byas/ mang po zhig gis rang rang gi 'khris su yod pa'i phru gu tshor ‘‘rjes su pha ma'i kha la yag po ma nyan na yong rgyu 'di red/ ltos dang ’’zhes mig mthong lag zin gyi slob gso dang / gson nyams ldan pa'i bslab bya dang kha ta byas/ phru gu tsho ha lam de phyogs su blta mi nus par rang rang gi pha ma'i gos sne las 'then te phyir bshol gyis gnas de las bral dgos pa'i tshul bstan/ mo gsar rnams rta lcag 'phyar ba tsam gyis 'jigs skrag dang gcer bur bton par ngo tsha nas phyogs gzhan du bros song / bgres song tshos lag gis phreng ba bar med du gtong gin ma ṇi bgrang /jag pa tshos am gtsigs bsdam nas sdod pa las a tsha dang a ra'i sdug skad rgyag mkhan gcig kyang med pas yul mi tsho hang sang nas ya med rang red/403

sdug rus che ba la ang zhes mgo bo 'phred du g.yug g.yug byas/mi rer rta lcag lnga bcu re gzhus rjes jag pa tsho'i rkub la mi sha'i mdog med par sngo nag lcags kyi mdog tu gyur zhing 'phongs mtshos g.yas g.yon gnyis skrangs te thog ma'i tshad las ldab gcig gis che bar song /mda' dpon dang / khrims dpon gnyis 'bol khri las mar babs te jag pa drug po'i mdun du song nas ‘‘kye/ nga tsho'i dmag mi gsod mkhan ga re dbang ga re/ de khyod tshos shes bzhin du ma bshad na yong rgyu de red ’’ces phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed kyin rta lcag gzhu ba'i phyag rgya byas nas 'jigs skul byas/ jag dpon tshe ring gis am gtsigs bsdam nas mda' dpon dang khrims dpon gnyis la mig log bltas nas ‘‘khyod tsho mi nyes med la nyes 'gel gyis gsod 'dod 'dug na sod cig nga la gang yang shod rgyu med/mi dkar dkar gangs dkar gyi ri bo 'dra ba la zhwa nag po pho rog gi mjug sgro 'dra ba zhig g.yog dgos don ci red ri ces gyen ldog byas/khrims dpon gyis ‘‘ya med ma byed/ nga rgyal ma byed/ da lta lo chung chung / mi tshe thung gi sdug bsngal dang / lha tshe ring gi sdug bsngal zer gyi yod/ ma gzhi mi tshe thung thung de da dung thung du gtong dgos don a yod/da lta bshad na phyis drags med/ da lta khyod rang gi tshe tshad ring thung de khyod rang gi lag tu yod/ bu glen rtags ma byed/ nga rgad po'i khar nyon ’’zhes g.yo sgyu'i tshig 'jam gyi mgo skor gtong thabs byas kyang jag pa de tsho'i kha las rin thang yod pa'i skad cha tshig 'bru gcig kyang ma don/de nas mda' dpon khong khro chen po langs te skad shugs chen po'i sgo nas ‘‘mi ngan 'di dag ni nga tsho'i so srung dmag gsod mkhan gyi lag dmar ba sha stag red/ lha ldan zhing du khrid nas dmag spyi khang la rtsis 'bul zhus te 404

khrims gcod nan po gtong dgos ’’zhes bshad/de mar dmag mi dag gis jag pa tsho'i mgo skyes las bzung ste drud nas song / de'i skabs ming la nya ga zhes pa'i jag pa lo nyi shu lhag byas pa zhig gis ‘‘nga ma gsod rogs/ ngas bshad bshad chog sku mkhyen nga ma gsod rogs mi’zhes zhu ba 'then/khrims dpon gyis don chen grub song snyam nas jag pa de khrid mi dgos pa'i brda btang /jag pa gzhan tshos u tshugs kyis phyir bshol byed kyin du ‘‘thu thu/sdar ma khyod kha nas khrag skyug ste shi bar shog ri’ces dmod/jag pa de kho rang gi byed stangs la skyo shas drag po skyed de dpral ba sa la sbyar nas skad shugs chen pos ngus/mda' dpon dang / khrims dpon gnyis da gzod don chen grub pas yid tshims pa'i sgo nas 'bol khri'i steng du dkyil krung du bsdad nas chang phor pa gang re btung rjes sma rar byil byil byed bzhin du ‘‘jag phrug snying rje po de lta skyong yag po byed dgos/ kho ni nga tsho'i nor bu red dā ’’zhes bshad/dmag mi de dag gis kho'i 'ching thag bkrol/ gyon chas g.yog ste gur gzhan zhig tu khrid nas za 'thung gya nom pa ster ba dang / 'phongs mtshos steng gi skrangs 'bur dang rma la gla rtsi dang sgo nga byug nas sman bcos byas/jag pa des blo rgyu mas ma gsang kha khog pas ma sbas bar rgyu mtshan tshang ma bayad pas lo gnyis sngon nas khos sne khrid de da bar dbyar dgun med par sde tsho 'dir bsdad nas g.yang mo ni dbang chen 'dzin byed kyi zhags pa red zer nas dbang chen phyir slebs rgyur sgug pa red/dga' blos ‘‘shag po khyod rang nyin shas 'dir sdod/ dmag mi de dag 405

phar phyin tshar na g.yang mo dang mnyam 'dzoms byed rgyu yod ’’ces bshad/dbang chen da dung yid ma ches par ‘‘kho tsho gtsang du dmag rgyag par 'gro rgyu zer ba de bden pa a yin mimizhes dris/dga'ablos de bden pa red/ kha sngon nyi ma lnga'i sngon la de don brda sbyar bar dmag mi gsum 'dir slebs song / da lan dmag mi gcig kyang ma lus par gtsang phyogs su spre'u srin po'i dmag dang 'dzing nas pho zad mo la thug kyang mgo mi sgur rgyu ni bka' shag gi bka' red ces bsgrags pa ngas kyang thos byung / ngo ma mi dga' dga' mdog byed pa de pho gsar dmag la 'gro ba'i rtags zhes pa bden pa red/ dmag mi tshang mas dmag mi byas pa la byed rin yod pa dang / pho lus blangs par blangs rin yod pa/ lte thag bcad par bcad rin yod pa byed dgos/ gangs can lha yul la 'dre lag rkyong mkhan yod na nga tsho mi 'gro su 'gro/ dbang chen zhes pa rtswa 'bu shing gcig gi don du 'dir sdod pa las phyi dgra dang 'thab rgyu byung na de bas dga' ba ci yod ces dpa' gtam kho na shod kyin 'dugadabangachen gyis ‘‘na thang nang gi rta 'di tsho dmag mi de dag gi red dam ’’zer/dga' blos ‘‘red/ kho tsho'i rta red rices bshad/dbang chen gyis ‘‘'o na khyod tsho'i sde ba'i nang kho tsho dang mnyam du dmag rgyag par 'gro mkhan 'dug gam ’mizhes dris/dga'ablos ‘‘'dug pho gsar stag 'dra ba drug gis 'gro rgyu'i khas blangs song / ngo ma sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo de 'dra yin na nga yang lo 'di las chung tsam yod na 'gro thag chod yin ’’zhes rkang pa dbang chen gyis bcag ste rkang gyol du gyur yang rkang pa'i skyon ma bshad par lo na bgres par kha g.yar/ kho'i skad cha'i don dbang chen gyis rtogs pas gang yang ma 406
