bshad par mgo bo lcog lcog byas/da lta gnyid lcog rgyag bzhin pa'i don grub kyis mig cher gdang nas ‘‘ngo ma de 'dra yin na nga yang 'gro dgos min nam ’’zhes dbang chen la gros 'dri ba'i tshul gyis de ltar bshad/dbang chen gyis ‘‘sde dpon la gros ma dris par song na ga la 'grig ’mizer/dga' blos ‘‘de 'dra byas na nga'i shag pos khyod tsho'i sde dpon la ga 'dra ze shod dgos red/ khyod 'gro mi rung ’’zer/dbang chen gyis ‘‘'o na/ nya ga zhes pa de deng sang 'dir so srung dmag mi dag dang mnyam du bsdad yod dam ’’zhes dris/nya ga zhes pa'i jag phrug des gnas tshul tshang ma bshad de so srung dmag 'dir khrid yong bas dbang chen khong khro ma bzod par de dang dmar 'dzing byas te zing slong pa ma zad rang phung gzhan brlag byed par dogs nas ‘‘kho rang la las rgyu 'bras mdzub mo'i rtse nas 'khor te 'dir slebs nas zla gcig lhag phyin rjes zas dug phog nas shi ba red ’’ces rdzun lab/‘‘jag pa de tshor dgos nges red/ nga dang don dag khab kyi rtse mo tsam gyi rtsod gzhi med par btsan rgod kha sho'i dpung rogs byas nas nga tsho g.yang phyug me btang shul gyi thal ba med par bzos byung ’’zhes dbang chen khong khro dang sdug bsngal mnyam skyed kyis chig lab brgyab/‘‘da shag po rang sems sdug ma byed/ nyi ma re gnyis song rjes khyod dang g.yang mo/ dgra 'dul pha ma bu gsum mnyam 'dzoms byed thub kyi red ’’ces dga' blos sems gso byas/dbang chen gyis ‘‘skyid mi rtag phyug po'i gces phrug sdug mi rtag sprang po'i dwa phrug ces pa'i 'jig rten kha dpe de las bden pa zhig mi 'dug ’’zer 407

nas mgo bo smad de bsdad/nyi ma de yi phyi nyin snga dro yul dmag drug pos sde ba'i nang nas bsdus pa'i me mda' rgyab tu 'khur/ la las da dung mdung ring 'khur zhing shang lang thogs te so srung dmag dang lhan du sde ba las bral nas lho phyogs su skyod/snga dro dug sbrul phra mos srog bcad dus phyi dro thag pa khra khrar yid mi ches zhes pa ltar srung dmag dang yul dmag sde ba'i lho yi spang ri de brgal nas yun ring phyin yang dbang chen dang / don grub gnyis da dung phyir don ma nus par sbra dang ra ba'i bar du gab ste ra ba'i rtsig srub las lho ri'i phyogs su bltas/dga'awā'i sems su kho tshos ca dngos gang zhig 'khyer rgyu brjed pa da gzod dran nas dmag mi gcig phyir sde bar yong gi med dam snyam pa'i tshor snang ya mtshan can zhig skyed/ dogs zon che drags pas sems su 'phrul snang gi bsam pa'i 'char sgo ya mtshan pa sna tshogs skyed pa las so srung dmag dang yul dmag gi nang nas phyir sde bar yong mkhan gcig kyang mi 'dug kyang /bsam pa'i 'char sgo de da dung ma yal bar dbang chen dang / don grub gnyis la ja khog ltir gang dang / spags thang khug gang bskyal/nyi ma phyed yol tsam du dga' blos ‘‘shag po dbang chen/ da ngas g.yang mo khrid yong ’rizer/ dbang chen gyis ‘‘khrid dgos mi 'dug da nga rang phar phyin na 'grig gi red ’’ces bshad de hob langs kyis 'gro rtsis byas par dga' blos bkag nas ‘‘khyod rang ma 'gro/ ngas khrid yong / ngas bltas na de ring mngon gsal dod po ma byas na bzang / 'jig rten rgad po'i kha dper nyin mo 'gro 'gro ma mang / ri mgo thams cad mig yin/ mtshan mo lab lab ma mang /nye 'khor thams cad rna yin mi zer ram ’’zhes da dung dogs zon byed dgos pa las snang chung spu tsam byed mi rung ba'i kha ta byas te kho rang rkang pa gyol 408

bzhin song /dga' blo'i skad cha de dag dbang chen gyi sems su shin tu 'thad par byung nas hol rgyug byas na rang gzhan gnyis ka 'phung pa'i nyen kha yod/gal srid 'dra ma 'dra'i gnas tshul glo bur ba byung na chags sgo slong rgyu red/nga'i snying dang 'dra ba'i mo gson bral gyis lo du ma de'i ring bzod bsran thub pa la da res ja dam bi gang 'thung ba'i dus thung de'i nang bzod bsran mi thub pa ci yod snyam nas kho rang gnyis kyi phor pa'i nang ja gang re blugs/de nas spags 'chang bu gcig kha ru brdzangs te ‘‘spags zo/ spags zhim po zhig 'dug ’’ces thang khug de don grub kyi mdun du bzhagadaga' blo g.yang mo'i sbra'i nye 'dabs su slebs skabs ‘‘'u 'u 'u ’’zhes thal spungs kyi 'gram du btags pa'i khyi rgya bo des kho'i phyogs su 'then gyin 'dug khyi de ni gzugs stobs ha cang che bas rgad po rkang gyol nga lta ci pho gsar stag 'dra ba zhig yin yang khyi des lcags thag bcad de shor na skra rkang gcig kyang mi lhag par za rgyu red snyam nas dga' blo 'gro ma nus par rdo gnyis sgrug ste rang sar langs/de'i skabs g.yang mo'i sbra dang bar thag mi 'gyang ba'i tshe ring tshang gi rgad po tshe ring sbra sgo las don te blta tsam byas te dga' blo'i gam du yong nas ‘‘ya/ dga' blo/ de ring za 'dre de tsho song bas khyod nyin mo mo'i rum nang du 'dzul 'dod pa yin nam/ ma gzhi nyin mo ma song na mtshan mo khyi 'dis za thag chod red ’mices ku re bshad/‘‘kho re/ kha mtshar skyug bro po de 'dra ma shod dang / kha yi so bud/rkub kyi sha shor ba'i rgad po zhig gis da dung nag mo gzhan gyi rum nang du 'dzul rtsis byas na skyid 'dod ma red shi 'dod red/ ma gzhi khyod rang mo'i rum nang du 'dzul 'dod yod na'i chog khyod kyis nga la mig ser ma byed 409

dang / nga mo tshang du skad cha zhig shod dgos yod ’’ces dga' blos kyang kha mtshar bshad/tshe ring gis ‘‘skad cha ci zhig shod rgyu yod/ 'o/ do dgong khyi ma glod zer rgyu yin nam ’’zhes mu mthud ku re bshad/‘‘rgad po kha btsog khyi'i kha dang 'dra ba khyod las bsam rgyu mang ba ci yod/’’ces dga' blos tshe ring gi brang steng du khu tshur yang po zhig gzhus/‘‘a ra ra/ khyod rang sdod ma tshugs na dbang chen yin nam des shes na nyo cha gzed yong ngo / hwa hwa hwa ’’tshe ring gis da dung ku re bshad/de mar dga' blos tshe ring la nyams tshod len ched du ‘‘dbang chen zhes pa zhig slebs rgyu yod med mi shes/ mo rang sdug po myang song / dmag mi de dag ga dus tshur yong gi yod dam ’’zer ba la bgres song tshe ring gis ‘‘phal cher tshur yong gi a yod/ kho tsho da res g.yul sar 'gro dgos pa'i brda 'byor bas tshang ma dga' snang byed kyi 'dug dpon gyi bka' dang g.yog gi ske zhes pa rang red/ gong gi bka' la zlog ma nus par 'dir nyi ma 'khyol thabs byas nas bsdad pa las bsam blo 'dir gnas kyi mi 'dugakha seng kho tshos nga'i lag nas lug sha bzan gnyis nyos song / de dus kho tsho da nas bzung bud med gcig srung nas sdod mi dgos par dgra dang 'thab pa'i go skabs shig shar song / bud med bsod skam de da nas bzung rang dbang thob pa red ces shod kyi 'dug dbang chen yin nam de shi med na da slebs na yag tshod red/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me kli/ nag mo des sdug po myang song ’’zhes da gzod kha mtshar min par drang gtam bshad byung bas dga' blo'i sems su da ni skug dgos don mi 'dug snyam nas ‘‘wa ye/ a che g.yang mo/'dir shog dang / dbang chen slebs yod ’’ces skad brgyab/ tshe ring gis go 'dzol byung ba min nam snyam nas ‘‘a/ dbang chen slebs 'dug e ’’zhes 410

dris kyang dga' blos der lan ma btab par mu mthud g.yang mo skad btang /g.yang mos kyang rang gis go nor thebs pa min nam snyam nas de mar sbra sgo las don te rna ba gtad de nyan/‘‘wa ye/ dbang chen slebs yod/ 'dir shog dang ’’zhes dga' blos thengs gsum pa bos/tshe ring gi dri bar lan 'debs mkhan med pas ‘‘dbang chen yin nam de dngos gnas slebs yod na yag po red/ nag mo des sdug po myang song ’’zhes chig lab brgyab nas kho rang gi nang du bud song /da gzod g.yang mos rang gis go nor thebs med pa shes kyang yid ches la ma ches kyis byis pa de pang du bzung nas kho'i gam du yong nas kha nas skad cha gang yang ma don par mig hu rer dga' blor bltas pa ni khyod kyi skad cha de bden pa yin nam zhes 'dri ba dang mtshungs/gdong gi rnam 'gyur la bltas na dga' blo'i skad cha de kha mtshar gyi skad cha dang mgo skor gyi rdzun gtam dang mi 'dra mod/ dbang chen slebs yod kyi ma red/ kho slebs na mi rta mang po'i dmag sne khrid de yong ba'am yang min na mun nag 'jab rgol byed pa las lkog lkog sud sud yong mi srid/ da res mi gcig slebs yod pa gtan 'khel red/ de yang khong pha bu gnyis dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin nges red snyams nas myur mo dga' blo tshang gi phyogs su song /dga' blos rkang pa gyol bzhin gang mgyogs song yang g.yang mo'i rjes ma zin par ‘‘g.yang mo/ sgug dang / mnyam du 'gro ’’zer/g.yang mos gom 'gros cung dal du btang nas dga' blo dang dpung gshib kyis 'gro bzhin du ‘‘mi de su red ’’ces dris/ dga' blos ‘‘mi su zer ba yin/’’411

g.yang mos dga' blo'i ngo gdong la blta tsam byas nas ‘‘mi su zer ram/mi zhig slebs 'dug zer mkhan khyod rang yin pa ’’zhes sngar ltar slebs pa'i mi de dbang chen yin mi srid snyams/dga' blo hang sang nas gom pa'i 'degs 'jog gi mtshams bzhag nas g.yang mor bltas te ‘‘ngas dbang chen slebs 'dug zer ba yin/ dbang chen/ dbang chen/ khyod rang gi khyo bo dbang chen ’mizhes nan bshad byas/‘‘khyod kyi skad cha de ngo ma yin nam ’’zhes g.yang mo'i sems su yid ches kyi me stag cung zad 'phros nas bskyar 'dri byas/‘‘a tsi/ da 'gro dang / ngas bshad kyang khyod rang yid ches kyi mi 'dug ’’ces dga' blos g.yang mo'i phu dung nas 'then tsam byas nas 'gro dgos pa'i tshul bstan/da gzod g.yang mo'i sems su dga' blos nga la mgo skor gtong ba'i rgyu mtshan med/ phal cher khong slebs pa yin shas che snyam pa dang chabs cig bu'i skor gyi skad cha mi shod pa dang / dbang chen lkog lkog sud sud du yong na nga'i bu la gnas tshul mi legs pa 'phrad pa min nam snyam pa'i sems khral langs te ‘‘'o na nga'i bu ’’zhes dris/‘‘khyod kyi bu dgra 'dul bde thang red/ da 'gro dang ’’zer/dga' blos bu dgra 'dul zhes ming 'bod kyi 'dug pas g.yang mo blo bde bar gyur nas yang gom 'gros mgyogs su btang nas phyin/da gzod dbang chen dang / don grub gnyis kyang sbra'i nang du bsdad yod pas dga' blos rkang pa gyol bzhin mdun du rgyug nas sbra sgo phyes pa dang dbang chen gdan las hob langs kyis ‘‘g.yang da mo da ’’zhes bos/g.yang mo rbad de bsam yul las 'das pa'i dga' spro dpag med du skyed nas brang du bzung ba'i byis pa'ang brjed de ‘‘dbang da chend ’’zhes 412

dbang chen gyi brang la 'khyud/da gin brang khar bzung ba'i byis pa de sgo 'gram du lhung bas rkub kyi na zug ma bzod par ‘‘in da ’’zhes ngus byung bas dga' blos de mar pang du bzung /dbang chen dang g.yang mo gnyis sgo them phyi nang byas te gcig la gcig 'khyud nas 'dugare zhig nas g.yang mos ‘‘bu bu nga'i bu gang du yod ’’ces ngo gdong dbang chen gyi brang las bral te sbra'i phyi nang gang sar dgra 'dul gyi gzugs brnyan btsal yang ma rnyed pas ‘‘nga'i bu ’’zhes ngu skad brgyab nas dbang chen gyi phrag pa gnyis las bzung ste dkrug dkrug btang /‘‘bu bde mo yin/ khyod rang ma ngu dang / ngas da dung khyod la gtam bzang zhig shod rgyu yod ’’ces dbang chen gyis g.yang mo'i lag pa nas 'then pas g.yang mo gzhi nas sgo them brgal te nang du 'dzul/dbang chen gyis g.yang mo'i ngo gdong gang sar blta bzhin du ‘‘nged gnyis kyi bu dgra 'dul la mna' ma zhig blangs nas yod/ kha nyin don grub nga gnyis sngon la 'di phyogs kyi gnas tshul shes rtogs byed par yong ba yin/bu dgra 'dul dang khong tsho lung pa gzhan zhig tu gab nas yod ’’ces bshad/byis pa de thab 'gram du gog nud byed kyin ‘‘a ma/ a ma ’’zer ba dang skabs re dbang chen la bltas te 'dzum chung ston gyi 'dug pas dbang chen gyis de'i 'gram par byil tsam byas/de dgong dbang chen dang g.yang mo gnyis nang du nyal/ phyugs rdzi pho g.yog mo g.yog rnams sbra gzhan zhig gi nang du bsdad/ don grub de dgong sngar bzhin dga' blo tshang du nyal/dbang chen dang g.yang mo gnyis ma shi gson bral gyi bar chad byung nas 413

lo mang ring phan tshun bltas na mig gis mi mthong / nyan na rna bas mi thos par gyur nas dus de ring gi bar sems sdug dang zhe 'khon/ re ba dang yid ches/ de bzhin stong bsam sna tshogs kyis dus 'da' ba yin mod/ de ring re ba dang yid ches mngon 'gyur byung nas sems sdug dang / zhe 'khon 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur nas da bar phan tshun gyi snying gtam brjod mi tshar ba yod pas byis pa de slog pa'i sbug tu bsnyal rjes g.yang mos sha khang las 'bri sha shed bzang thu ba gang blangs te btsos pa dang / ja dam bi gang re bsrubs par 'bri mar ser po khu tshur las che ba re blugs te ja zhim po bzos te dbang chen la ja yang yang blugs/dbang chen gyis bu dgra 'dul dang / kho gnyis yul las bral nas da lta'i bar dka' sdug gi rgyud rim dang / de nas rong pa sde gsar la mgo btags tshul bcas ma lus lhug brjod byas pas g.yang mo skabs re sems sdug gis mig chu khrum khrum du shor ba dang / skabs re dbugs ring shor/bu dgra 'dul la mna' ma bkra shis g.yang chags zhes pa zhig blangs tshul brjod pas sems su dga' tshor dpag tu med pa skyed pa dang / rang gi snying dang 'dra ba'i bu chung de da lta chen po ga 'dra 'tshar yod snyam nas dga' spro'i mig chu'ang shor/de ltar kho gnyis skad cha shod kyin mtshan dgung gi bar bsdad de ja yang dam bi lnga drug btung /phyi nyin don grub dbang chen tshang du yong nas zhogs ja rgyags tshad btung rjes rgyags phye phyed thig cig rgyab tu 'khur nas sde dpon dang bcas pa'i dmag mi tshang ma bsu bar song /nyi ma de dag gi ring g.yang mos rang gi bu chung dang sde dpon dang bcas pa dbang chen gyi dpung rogs rnams kyi ched du sgug thud rdzi ba/ sgug sha btso 414

ba dang lo mang gsog nyar byas pa'i tsha ru las nag thigs sen mo'i sgor rgya tsam med pa'i tsha ru mnyed ma nyis brgya lhag bdams te dbang chen pha bu gnyis dang / mna' ma bkra shis g.yang chags la tshar slog bzo 'go brtsams te dga' blo dang tshe ring dbang chen gsum mnyam rub kyis snga dro zhogs ja btung pa dang las 'go tshugs te dgong mo nyi ma ma nub bar dras gcod 'tshem gsum gyi las la brel/de'i ring g.yang mos bag tsha mar khu dang / sha btsos ma/ bag thugasha mog mar ja sogs kyis sne len rgyun ma chad par byas te nyi ma gsum gyi nang rgya nag yul las thon pa'i gos chen smug khra'i phyi skogs byas pa'i pho slog gnyis dang / rgya gar ther ma ljang khu'i phyi skogs byas pa'i mo slog gcig grub/g.yang mo chu len par song ba'i skabs dga' blos dbang chen la ‘‘btsan rgod kha shos khyod tshang la shul bzhag mi nyung ba zhig 'dug ang ’’zhes ku re bshad/bgres song tshe ring ni yul der skad du grags pa'i kha bde ku re shod rgyur mkhas pa zhig yin pas khos dga' blo'i tshig mjug mthud de ‘‘'dug gos chen dang ther ma mang po yod pas ma tshad byis pa snabs 'dzar zhig kyang shul du bzhag 'dug ’’ces bshad pas kho tsho gsum ka gad mo shor/dbang chen gyis byis pa der blta tsam byas nas ‘‘mi yi mi tshe zer ba de las ya mtshan pa zhig dang / de las ma drang pa zhig mi 'dug skabs re khyod shi nga gson gyi dgra zlar gyur/ skabs re dgra ya'i bu rgyud kyi pha tshab tu gyur nas de dang lhan du khyim tshang gcig gi nang du snod cig gi zas mnyam za dang thab gcig gi me mnyam lde byed pa'i dus kyang shar mirizhes chig lab brgyab pa dang / de nas tsha ru'i dras hrug nyeb tsam zhig gis byis pa de'i sna khung las 'dzar ba'i snabs phyis/415

de nas kho tshos tshar slog gsum po sbra'i chon thag gi steng du bkal nas de'i steng gi spu phyags skabs dbang chen gyis ‘‘kha sho de la gos chen dang ther ma mang po 'di 'dra yod 'gro bsam ma myong ri’zer/tshe ring gis ‘‘mang po zhig mdo khams ja pa dang tshong pa'i lag nas nyos pa red/ kha shas sde tsho gzhan nas 'phrog bcom byas pa yin gyi red mimizer/dga' blos ‘‘da lta g.yang mo'i mgul du btags pa'i byu ru de dag khams pa'i tshong dpon zhig gi lag nas byu ru rer lug gnyis re sprad de nyos song ’’zer/ gong gi skad cha de dag go dus dbang chen gyi sems su shin tu mi skyid pa'i tshor snang zhig gis rang sde mar khu 'dra ba de khrag dmar po'i rgya mtshor bsgyur mkhan btsan rgod kha sho'i rgyu dngos bal skud phra mo tsam zhig spyod 'dod med pa'i blo skyed de tshar slog gi mtha' gnyis nas dam por bcangs nas tog tsam ma gtogs da lta bzos ma thag pa'i tshar slog de ther tshal sbar tshal du btang / 'on kyang bsam blo zhib tu gtong dus rang gi snying dang 'dra ba'i gtan grogs g.yang mo'i bar las dbang rlung shugs btsan pos bar chad byung yang ma shi mnyam 'dzoms byung bas da res mo'i sems dang bstun dgos pa ma zad lhag par du lan chags byis pa snabs 'dzar de'i ngos nas bshad na pha shul bus 'dzin pa ni bod sgang pa'i lugs srol yin snyams pa dang byis pa 'di'i skal ba bcad na rgyu 'bras la mi 'gro bsam nas tshar dkar lnga drug cig bdams nas byis pa der yang tshar slog gsar pa zhig bzos/dbang chen gyis don grub song ba'i nyin nas mdzub rtsis rgyag dus tag tag nyi ma lnga phyin 'dug pas ‘‘g.yang mo/ tshe ring rgyu ma/ kho tsho sang nyin slebs kyi red/ de ring khyod rang skra gtsang mar khrus/ nga yang skra 'khru gi yin ’’zer nas yun ring ma bkrus par tshi dreg gis 'byar te ral bar gyur ba'i mgo skyes bsal te gtsang mar bkrus nas slas te stong skud dmar po zhig 416

dkris/g.yang mos lan bu bsal te skra gtsang mar bkrus nas dung gi me tog byu ru'i phra can gyi 'dan dung rjocha gcig dang g.yu dang byu ru/ mu tig gis rgyan pa'i lan shubs dang tsi lu bcas mgo rgyan cha tshang spras/phyi nyin khyo shug gnyis zhogs snga langs kyis sbra'i phyi nang gang sar gtsang mar phyags pa dang / zas rigs gra sgrig legs par byas rjes dbang chen gyis kha seng gsar du bzos pa'i tshar slog smug khra de gyon/ g.yang mos tshar slog sram shan gong ba dang gos mtha' g.yi dkar pags pa byas pa de gyon zhing rgya dngul gyi chab sked bcings/ gzhogs g.yon du rgya dngul gyi glo gri phra gsum btags/ gzhogs g.yas su rgya dngul gyi me lcags dang mdun du rag gi zho 'gel btags/'brog khul du rta rgyug rtsed 'jo'i dus dang lo gsar dga' ston/bag ma gtong len sogs kyi skabs ma gtogs de lta bu'i gzab mchor spros pa'i dus shin tu nyung yang de ring ni kho tsho lo mang bral ba'i pha ma bu gsum mnyam 'dzoms kyi dus yin pas rta rgyug dang lo gsar gyi dus las kyang lhag pa'i don snying ldan yod/g.yang mo dang dbang chen gnyis res mos kyis sgor don te byang gi phyogs su blta bzhin sgugagayang mos rang gi bu dang 'phrad 'dod kyi sems pa 'gog ched kyis ‘‘nga'i bu chen po ga 'dra 'tshar yod dam ’’zhes dris/dbang chen dang g.yang mo gnyis 'phrad pa nas bzung gong gi 'dri tshig de ni da res thengs dang po ma yin par ha lam nyi ma rer thengs bcu grangs re dhi 'dan dung zhes pa de ni gnyen sgrig zin pa'i mtshon byed do/417

dris myong yang dbang chen gyis sun snang gi rnam 'gyur med pa'i sgo nas ‘‘chen po 'tshar yod/ ha lam nga dang mgo mnyam yod ’’zer/nyin dgung phyed yol tsam la rong pa sde gsar gyi mi rnams byang ri'i steng nas don byung ba g.yang mos mthong nas dga' spro'i sems pa skad cig tsam yang 'jags thabs med par gyur nas nang du rgyug ste ‘‘dbang chen/ ltos dang / khong tsho slebs 'dug ’ces bshad pa dang / de 'phral yang sgo phyir don nas mig ma g.yengs par de phyogs su bltas te ‘‘nga'i bu/ nga'i bu ’’zhes chig lab rgyag bzhin 'dren byed zung dga' spro'i mchi zhag 'khor/dbang chen gyis rang gi lag pa g.yas pa g.yang mo'i phrag steng du bzhag nas ‘‘khyod kyis ltos dang ’’zhes lag pa g.yon ma'i ldag mdzub kyis mdzub ston byed kyin du ‘‘mdun nas rtsis pa'i rta pa ang gsum pa rta rkyang po bzhon pa zhig mthong gi 'dug gam ’’zer/‘‘mthong gi 'dug de nga'i bu red dam ’rizhes g.yang mo dga' spro'i rba rlabs 'phyur te byis pa ltar rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab byed kyin 'dugadabang chen gyis mdzub mo da dung phar phyogs su gtad de ‘‘mdun shos de sde dpon red/ gnyis pa de tshe skyabs red 'dug bzhi pa de don grub red mi’ces re re bzhin bshad kyang g.yang mos nyan 'jog mi byed par sngar bzhin rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab kyis ‘‘nga'i bu/ nga'i bu/ nga'i bu dgra 'dul ’’zhes chig lab rgyag gi 'dugadabang chen gyi rogs pa rnamaso da gzod rta las bshol te rta kha khrid nas yong ba dang / ri gsham du slebs rjes slar rtar bzhon te me mda'i ru dar dmar po rlung gis lhab lhub g.yo bzhin yong byung bas dbang chen khyo shug gnyis kho tsho'i mdun bsu bar rgyugad lta dus bde lhing 'jags yin pa'i gnas tshul don grub kyis kho tshor 418

bshad nas yod kyang / sngar yong ma myong ba'i sde tsho gzhan gyi mi rnams kyi mdun du khong tsho'i zil shugs ngom ched sde dpon btsan lhas sne khrid de ru star sgrig nas yong gi 'dug da gzod dgra 'dul gyis yun ring bral ba'i rang gi a mas mdun bsu bar yong bas dga' spro'i sems pa 'gog thabs med par rta pho lcag gis brab nas sngon du rgyug ste ‘‘a ma da ’’zhes 'bod kyin rta yi steng nas mchongs te srab mda' srab skyog dor te rgyug nas a mar 'khyud/‘‘bu/ nga'i bu/ nga'i snying ’’g.yang mo'i 'dren byed zung las dga' skyo zung gi mchi ma rang dbang med par shor te dgra 'dul gyi mjing pa brlan par gyur/ g.yang mos bu'i ngo gdong gang sar bltas te byil byil byed pa las skad cha gang yang ma thon par bu brang khar dam por bzung nas ngus/yang cung zad song rjes bu'i mgo nas rkang pa'i bar dang / rkang pa nas mgo'i bar zhib blta lan 'ga' byas nas yang bu brang khar bzung nas spyi bor byil byil byas/ dbang chen gyis ‘‘khyod tsho dka' las ’’zhes khams 'dri byed kyin sde dpon dang bcas pa'i mi tshang ma khyim gyi phyogs su khrid de rta tshang ma sbra'i chon thag gang sar btags te do po phabs shing rta sga blangs/dga' blo dang tshe ring tshang gi mi che chung mang po der 'dzoms nas la las rta sga len rogs byas/ la las do po 'bebs rogs byas/ bud med de rnams kyis sna phu dung gi nang du sbas te skye bo de dag la bltas te skabs re shub shub lab pa dang / skabs re phan tshun dpung shig rgyag gi 'dugagayang mo dang dgra 'dul ma bu gnyis phan tshun 'khyud de bsdad 'dugad gzod g.yang mos mig chu phyis te ‘‘bu/ a ma'i bu/ khyod na tsha ma byung ngam ’’zhes bu'i ngo gdong la byil byil byas/dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘a ma/ nga nga na tsha ma byung / a ma khyod bde thang yin yin nam ’’zhes mgrin pa brnang bzhin de ltar 419

dris/ g.yang mos ‘‘a ma bde bde thang thang yin/ a ma'i bu/ da log 'gro ’’zhes dgra 'dul gyi lag pa nas khrid de song nas nang du ma 'dzul gong ‘‘a mas khyod la tshar slog gsar pa 'di bzos pa yin/ da de gyon dang ’’zhes chon thag la bkal ba'i gos chen smug khra'i phyi skogs byas pa'i tshar slog de gyon du bcugadagra 'dul gyis slog pa skya bo de phud de tshar slog gsar pa de gyon pa dang / g.yang mos sked rags 'ching rogs byas/ de nas nang du 'dzul nas sgug sha dang sgug thud de dag mgron po tshang ma'i mdun gyi rdo nar mo'i cog tse'i steng du bzhag pa dang / snga sa nas gra sgrig byas pa'i mar ja de rag skyog gis dkrug dkrug byas nas mgron po rnams kyi phor pa'i nang du blugs/mo rang khom pa cung zad byung ba dang bu dgra 'dul gyi gam du bsdad de dgra 'dul la sha tig re re bzhin dang / spags 'chang bu re re ster nas ‘‘a ma'i bu/ ja thungs dang / sha zo dang ’’zer/dbang chen dang g.yang mo gnyis kyis brel ba 'tshub 'tshub kyis mgron po rnams la sne len byas/ dbang chen gyi rogs pa rnams nyin zhag mang po'i ring ri nyal thang nyal gyis dka' sdug mang po myang pa dang / za 'thung yang yid tshims pa ma byung bas da res tshang mas 'dzems med par dgod zhor za zhor gyi spro snang gi rnam pas khengs/za 'thung yid tshims par grub rjes ‘‘a da ’’zhes sde dpon gyis dbugs ring btang ba dang dpung pa'i yal 'dab gnyis ltag rgyab tu bzhag nas ‘‘grogs po dbang chen/ nged tsho nas 'di'i bar thag ring po zhe drag mi 'dug ga’’zer/‘‘thag ring po mi 'dug nga thengs dang po yong dus lam ma shes pas 420

lam kyog mang po phyin 'dug ’’ces dbang chen gyis de snga sde dpon gyis sprad pa'i rwa co'i sna ru dngul shan de bton te rkang mgor lan gsum brdab rjes mthe bong g.yon ma'i sen mo'i steng du cung zad cig blugs rjes sna ru de tshe skyabs la g.yar/sde dpon gyis ‘‘grogs po dbang chen/ khyed tshang 'dir sdod rgyu yin nam/ nged tsho rong pa sde gsar du spo rgyu yin ’’zhes dris/dbang chen gyis bya rgas na tshang dran/ mi rgas na yul dran zhes pa rang red/ deng sang lo na che ru 'gro dus pha yul dran te mtshan mo'i gnyid lam du yang rang yul gyi sa cha kho na rmis kyi 'dug g.yang phyug tu spos na rang tshang las mtsher shul rnying pa 'ba' zhig las med pa dang / zla thang du bsdad na kho tsho'i sde gral du 'jog srid mod de ni rang gis shes bzhin du pham kha khur ba rang red/ de bas rong pa sde gsar gyis rang la mthong yang chen po yod pas sngar mgo 'dogs sar mjug ma bsdu rgyu red snyam nas ‘‘sde dpon lags/rang yul mi skyid pa min mod/ nga la da dung dgra mang po 'dug pas nged tsho rong pa sde gsar las bral rgyu'i bsam blo med/ bkra shis g.yang chagasakyang rang gi lte khrag 'pho sa dang bral 'dod yod mi srid ’mices bshad de rang gi chung ma dang bu gnyis la blta tsam byas/dbang chen gyi skad cha de sde dpon gyi bsam thog tu song bas shin tu dga' bar gyur nas ‘‘tag tag red/ khyod kyis bsam blo btang par 'phyug mi srid/ yul 'dir khyod la bral mi thub pa'i gnyen nye rtsa chen ni med la nga tsho nyam chung nus med kyi rong pa sde gsar la'ang gang ci'i thad phan thogs chen po 'dug pas ngas khyod blon por nyar rgyu yin/ nga tsho 'dir nyin shas bsdad nas ru ba spos na bsam gyi 'dug mimices rbad de tshig thag kyang ma bcad par tshang mar mig 'grim zhig byas/421

dbang chen gyis mthe bong g.yon ma'i sen mo sna khung g.yas par sbyar nas ‘‘sir ’’zhes sna tha gtsang mar 'then nas ‘‘nged tsho 'dir nyin zhag bcu grangs shig skyid po byas nas sdod/ de nas ru ba spos na 'grig mi’ces bshad/de nas tshang ma ci gros mol gros kyi skad cha sna tshogs bshad kyang btsan rgod kha sho ni gna' snga mo snga mo'i dus su byung ba'i gtam rgyud du grags pa'i mi sna zhig ltar tshang ma'i klad pa'i nang du de'i don spyi tsam yang ma shar bas de'i skor shod 'dri byed mkhan gcig kyang mi 'duganyinasmobazhi pa'i nyin gung ma zin tsam la byang shar gyi thang chen de nas thal rdul nam mkhar 'phyur bzhin shin tu che la ring ba'i sbrul nag cig 'khyug pa ltar ru bstar bsgrigs pa'i rta pa stong phrag gcig lhag tsam zhig yong gi 'dug pas lung pa de'i skye bo pho mo rgan gzhon tshang ma sgor don te hang sang nas lag pas nyi 'od 'geb kyin du rgyang blta byas/ mig rgyang ring ba'i gzhon nu 'gas rtsis dus la las chig stong bzhi brgya nyi shu 'dug zer/ la las chig stong bzhi brgya nyi shu rtsa gnyis 'dug zer/ la las chig stong bzhi brgya sum cu 'dug zer/ skya mi mang po 'di 'dra ngo ma ya mtshan red/ mdo smad kyi gnas mjal ba dang / rgya sog hor gsum gyi tshong 'grul yar mar 'gro mkhan mang po yod mod/ gzhi rgya che ba'i bla dpon che gras kyi sgar yang mang po 'di 'dra med la ru star sgrig nas yong srol yang med/rgan rabs 'gas jun gar zhes pa'i bdud kyi dmag dpung stobs chen zhig yong nas bod khri skor bcu gsum la brdab gsig tshad med bzos pa dang dgon sde phal che ba gtor skyon btang ba'i go thos gtam rgyud dang 'dra ba thar thor 'ga' shod kyin rkang pa 'jag rtswa rlung gis g.yo ba ltar 'dar nas ‘‘da yang skal pa 'jig mkhan gyi bdud dpung zhig slebs 'dug ’mices gson pa'i re thag chad pa ltar ngo gdong skya thal du gyur/422

bud med rnams smra brjod kyi spobs pa dang bral nas 'jigs g.yer bar gyur/ byis pa mang pos rgyug pa rta yin khul gyis bzhon te ‘‘'o 'o ri’zhes 'ur rgyag gin sgar chen de ltar ru star bsgrig nas phar rgyug tshur rgyug byas/de nas thag nyer slebs dus skya mi de dag phal che bas bo'u dang mdung ring shang lang sogs go mtshon thogs yod pa mthong bas tshang ma sngar bas 'jigs par gyur nas bud med dang byis pa tshang ma skyes pa dang bgres song rnams kyi phag tu yib nas ‘‘da ci 'dra byas na legs sam/’’‘‘a pha nga khrid dang /mi’‘‘a ma nga ’’‘‘ mi’tshang ma skad cor long long du gyur/da ni 'chi gson gang la thug kyang khyod shi nga gson gyi dmar 'dzing byed rgyu las ma 'das snyams nas sde dpon dang dbang chen/ dgra 'dul/ don grub/ tshe skyabs lnga pos me mdar rdzas mdel blugs te sbi sdi'i me sgron nas khag so sor gyes te lhas ra dang / kong dong du gab nas de ring rang phyogs me btang shul gyi thal ba med par bzo rgyur gdon mi za yang ma 'chi bar 'thab rgyu'i blo thag bcad de bud med dang / byis pa rgan 'khogs rnams lhas ra'i nang du gab bcug me mda' med pa'i gzhon nu rnams kyis gri mdung lag tu thogs te 'thab rgyu'i gra sgrig byas/phreng ba star du rgyus pa dang 'dra ba'i skya mi rgya chen de dag da gzod na gzhung du slebs te tshang ma rta las bshol nas la las sbra gur phubs/ la la lci ba 'thu ru 'gro ba las 'phrog bcom byed rtsis mi 'dug pas tshang ma ya mtshan skyed/423

de'i tshe mi rkyang gcig lag tu mda' mdung sogs mtshon cha gang yang ma thogs par thad kar khong tsho'i phyogs su yong nas lag g.yug byed kyi 'dugakhong tshos sngar bas dogs zon cher skyed kyis me sgron zin pa'i sbi sdi'i sne mor phu btab ste me mda' rgyag chog chog byas/mi des dogs zon spu tsam med pa'i sgo nas lag pa gnyis rgyab tu bzhag nas ‘‘a la la mo la la red mices tshig 'bru med pa'i glu chung gyer bzhin thad kar khong tsho'i phyogs su yong /da gzod mi de dang khong tsho bar thag ha cang nye bas de'i gyon pa dang gzugs byad kyang gsal po mthong gi 'dug pa ste mtha' bzhi gyen du 'gyur ba'i rgya gar yang zhwa rnying song zhig gi 'og nas stong skud dmar po'i skra gzhug rna ba g.yon ma'i thad nas thur du dpyang nas 'dug lus la spu phrug nag po'i phyu pa'i 'og tu tshar slog gyon yod pa'i spu dkar po gos kyi mtha' dang gong ba/ phu dung gi kha nas mthong gi 'dugad gzod kho rtswa 'bur zhig gi steng du langs nas ‘‘wa ye/ a spin ①tsho/khyod tsho skrag snang byed dgos le ma red/ wa ye ’’zhes bos byung / khos da gin mi khag gcig kong dong du gab pa yang mthong 'dug pas sde dpon btsan lha dang / dbang chen kong dong las langs te ‘‘khyod 'dir ci byed par yong ba yin/ khyod la ci dgos/ lci ba dgos sam ’mizhes dris/mi des der yod tshang mar mig 'grim zhig byas te ngo gdong las 'dzum mdangs 'phyung ste ‘‘nga stong dpon gyi bka' ltar khyod tsho 'dir yod kyi me mda' de dag tshong min skad cha 'dri bar yong ba yin ’mizer/kho'i skad cha'i don ma rtogs stabs sde dpon gyis ‘‘a khyod kyis ci zer du de ni hor skad yin te spun zla zhes pa'i don/424

ba yin/ khyod tsho ga nas yin ’’zhes dris/mi des ‘‘nga tsho ni hor tsho so dgu'i dmag mi yin/ da res gtsang rgyud du skra ser gdon 'dre'i dmag la phar rgol byed par 'gro mkhan yin ’’zhes kha phyir bskor nas dmag sgar gyi phyogs su blta tsam byas te ‘‘ltos dang nga tsho'i dmag mi mang po 'di dag tshang ma ma skul dang blangs kyis sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ched dam bca' bzhag nas yong ba sha stag red/ nga tshor da dung me mda' mang po med pas lam brgyud nas nyo sgrub byed kyi yod/ nga tshos da gin khyod tsho'i lag tu me mda' yod pa mthong bas nga tsho'i stong dpon rdo dgas dung 'dir me mda' de dag tshong min skad cha 'dri bar btang byung / gal srid khyod tshos 'tshong rtsis med na u tshugs byed kyi min ’’zhes rang gi yong don bshad/da gzod gzhi nas mi de'i yong don shes te tshang mas mi de'i mgo nas mjug bar dang mjug nas mgo bar zhib blta lan mang byas te yid smon par gyur ba dang / gzhon nu de dag gi sems su rang nyid stong dmag 'di dang lhan du g.yul sar skyod pa'i go skabs byung na ci ma rung snyams/sde dpon gyis ‘‘'o na nang du phebs dang ’’zhes sbra'i phyogs su lag brda byasakhyang mi des mgo bo 'phred du g.yug nas ‘‘min/ yag byung / khyod tsho'i me mda' tshong gi yin nam min/ gal srid tshong 'dod med na u tshugs byed kyi min ’’zhes sde dpon dang dbang chen/ tshe skyabs/ dgra 'dul/don grub bcas bzhi po'i lag tu yod pa'i me mdar bltas te ‘‘sbi sdi'i me da dung mi gsod pa ci yin/ ngas khyod tsho gsod mi srid ’’ces ku re bshad byung /kho tshos me mda'i sbi sdi'i me gsod rgyu brjed pa gzhi nas dran te sbi sdi'i yi 'idhi stong dpon rdo dgasgru ni spyibyishā 'gog dmakyā'akhrurngi sbrengs gurdos pa'ingo skabs hos nā so dgu'i stong dpon na zhang / g.yul sar byas sa ma ra ba bzhag nga ba' rgyus kya sna ma na sum zhag na/ 425

me bsad rjes dbang chen gyis ‘‘'o na nga tsho khyod tsho'i stong dpon de mjal bar phyin na 'grig gam ’’zhes dris/‘‘'grig gi red/ 'gro/ nga tsho mnyam du 'gro ’’zhes mi des sne khrid nas kho tsho dmag sgar du phyin/ras gur dkar po'i steng du ras tshos mdog sna tshogs kyis rgyan spros byas pa'i gur sgor slebs pa dang mi des gur sgo phyes te ‘‘stong dpon lags/kho tsho phebs song ’’zhes bshad/gur de'i sbug tu lo na bzhi bcu'i yas mas byas pa'i mi bo ngo gdong smug la za 'gram g.yas g.yon dang ya mchu'i steng du sma ra thar thor skyes pa zhig gi mgor wa dmar gyi zhwa mo'i rgyab tu bya rgod kyi sgro rkang gsum sgar ba zhig gyon nas 'dug (phal cher ching rgyal rabs kyi dpon rigs kyi zhwa mo'i ltag rgyab rma bya'i mjug sgro yin pas der lad mo byas pa yin pa 'dra/)kho tsho slebs pa mthong bas khos ‘‘a spin tsho dka' las/ yar shogayar shog ’’zer/kho tshos gus gus zhum zhum gyis phu dung g.yas pa phrag pa'i steng nas mdun du blangs/ zhwa mo yod pa rnams kyis zhwa mo phud de lag tu bzung / zhwa mo med pa skra spyi bor bcings pa rnams kyis skra spyi gtsug las dkrol te mdun du blangs te gur nang yar 'dzul nas kha nas smra ba med par lce bsnar te gur mdor tsog nas bsdad/ da lta kho tsho shin tu nyam chung ba'i gus zhabs kyi mtshon tshul de ni rang gis sngar 'jig rten du ma grags pa'i sdig nyes tshabs chen zhig bsag ste da lta khrims dpon gyi mdun du tshe thar skyabs 'jug zhu ba dang mtshungs/stong dpon rdo dgas zhwa mo phud de gam du bzhag nas ‘‘de 'dra byed dgos med/ sdod dang sdod dang / byang sa skya mo la bu dpon g.yog yod le 426

ma red/ nga tsho tshang ma pha 'brog pa'i bu red/ me mda' yag po de 'dra 'khyer rgyu yod kyang byed stangs nyam chung de 'dra byas na dgra lha nyams yong /da sdod dang ’rizhes kho tsho sdod du bcug rjes ‘‘ja khol song ngam/ ja khol song na kho tshor ja blugs dang ’’zhes zhabs phyi skad btang /stong dpon rdo dgas sde dpon gyi me mda' de lag tu blangs nas zhib blta lan 'ga' byas te ‘‘bo'u yag po zhig 'dug khyod tshos tshong 'dod med na nga tshos u tshugs mi rgyag ma gzhi da res skra ser srin po'i dmag dang 'dzing nas sangs rgyas bstan pa srung rgyu ni nga tsho tshang ma'i 'os 'gan red/khyod tshos go yod shas che/ bstan dgra de dag da lta rgyal rtse'i rgyud du slebs nas dgon pa dang / mi ser gyi rgyu dngos 'phrog bcom byed pa dang bud med la btsan g.yem dang / byis pa dmar gsod gtong ba sogs sngar gnyid lam du'ang gtong mi srid pa'i gtum spyod spel bas da lta gzhung dmag lta ci dgon pa'i grwa btsun yang mtshon cha thogs te skra ser srin po'i dmag dang 'dzing gi yod/ dwags kong dang nag tshang gi dhidapung dmag kyang g.yul sar slebs nas yod/ kha ba can gyi bstan srid chags 'jig la thug pa'i dus nga tsho khong khros bzod thabs bral nas rang mos dang blangs kyis yong ba yin ’’zhes rgyas par bshad/sde dpon btsan lhas ‘‘nga tsho rong pa sde gsar ni nyam chung nus med kyi tsho chung thebs chag cig yin/ sngar rgan mo ru ba zhes sde tsho gzhan gyis brnyas bcos tshad med btang myong / da res stong dpon lags kyis gsungs pa'i skad cha de dag go dus mi sems la khong khro chen po langs kyi 'dug pas nga tsho'i 4 dhi+oskenag tshang ni snyeng skarngos nag chu sa khul nyi ma rdzong dbya sha1 tsa rdzoṣ+ṭṛ rgyud+ma la byer/ skat+nas de dus nag tshang gas rta sga' lha dmag sa pa' rta dmag lnga brgya g.yul sar skyad da byas sa na bzhag pa da/ 427

me mda' tshang ma rin med khyod tshor 'bul gyi yin ri’zhes thog mar kho rang gi me mda' de lag gnyis kyis btegs te stong dpon rdo dga'i mdun du bzhagade nas dbang chen dang / tshe skyabs/ don grub gsum gyis kyang snga ma ltar lag gnyis kyis mthon por btegs nas bla ma mjal ba'i mjal dar 'bul ba ltar me mda' tshang ma stong dpon gyi mdun du bzhagadagra 'dul gyis da dung me mda' bzung nas bsdad 'dug pas lam seng dbang chen gyis dgra 'dul gyi gos kyi thu sne nas 'then te me mda' sprod dgos pa'i brda btang /dgra 'dul gyis ‘‘nga khyod tsho dang mnyam du 'gro rgyu yin ’’zhes bshad byung bas kho tsho tshang ma hang sang nas mig hu rer dgra 'dul la bltas nas bsdad/dgra 'dul gyis da gin las skad shugs che ba'i sgo nas ‘‘nga khyed tsho dang mnyam du 'gro rgyu yin ’rizhes tshig thag chod po'i sgo nas yang bskyar thengs gcig bshad/de'i tshe stong dpon rdo dga' shin tu dga' bar gyur nas ‘‘pho rab/pho rab/ bu skyes pa la skyes rin 'dug ’’ces dgra 'dul gyi phyogs su mthe bong ker te bstod bsngags byas pa dang de nas ‘‘ya da khyed tsho yag byung yag byung nga tsho dmag brgyab tshar rjes tshur log pa'i lam du nga tsho 'dir mnyam du dga' dga' spro spro byas nas rta rgyug mda' 'phen dang glu len gar rtsed byed rgyu dang khyed tsho'i me mda' tshang ma phyir sprod byed rgyu yin ’’zhes bshad de me mda' rin med sprod mkhan rnams la thugs rje che zhus pa dang dgra 'dul la ‘‘khyed rang sang nyin nyi ma shar ba dang 'dir 'dzoms shog ’’ces bshad/de'i tshe/ don grub kyis kyang ‘‘nga yang 'gro rgyu yin ’’zer/sde dpon gyis ‘‘khyod rang 'gro mi rung / khyed kyi a mas mos mthun byed min mi shes pas ngas khyed gtong thabs mi 'dug dgra 'dul ni kho 428

rangagi pha 'dir yod pas gtong min kho rang gis shes kyi red/ gal srid ngas khyod dmag sar 'gro ru bcug kyang khyod kyi a mas mos mthun med na ngas khyod kyi a mar ga 'dra ze shod dgos red ’’zer nas don grub 'gro ru ma bcugakho tsho sde nang du slebs dus da res 'grul pa rgya chen de ni sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo skra ser gdon 'dre'i dmag cham la 'beb mkhan hor tsho so dgu'i stong dmag yin pa dang / dgra 'dul kho tsho mnyam du g.yul sar 'gro mkhan yin pa'i skor bshad dus pho gzhon tshang ma dgra 'dul la yid smon skyed de ‘‘nga yang 'gro rgyu byung na ci ma rung / nga yang 'gro 'dod 'dug ’’ces lag pas lag pa phur gyin rkang 'khrab lag 'khrab byed kyin 'dugagayang mo'i sems su rang gi khog nang gi snying dang 'dra ba'i bu dgra 'dul dang re zhig gson bral gyi sdug bsngal 'byung yang slar ma shi mnyam 'dzoms byung yang da res yang g.yul sar 'gro dgos byung bas sems sdug gi mig chu khrum khrum du shor mod de ni dgra 'dul rang gis rang mos dang blangs kyis phyin pa dang / lhag don du de ni mgo nag bod mi spyi yi don yin pa shes pas 'gro mi dgos zhes ma bshad pas mi tshad lam rgyags gra sgrig byed pa dang /chu mig yag sa zhig nas chu blangs te mgo skyes gtsang mar bkru rogs byas nas ‘‘bu/ a ma'i bu/ ltas ngan dgra bo'i mdun du zhabs 'dren ma zhu/ yin na'ang nga'i re bar khyod gson por log yong rogs/ a mas khyod sgug sdod kyi yin mi’zhes bshad/sde dpon gyis ‘‘khyod tsho 'gyang na lo gsum dang / nye na lo gcig nang phyir slebs thub kyi red/ de dus ngas khyod kyi mthe bong la 'bri mar dkar pos rgyan te nged rong pa sde gsar gyi dmag dpon byed du bcug gi yin ’’zhes gcig nas kha g.yang smon lam mtshon byed dang / gnyis nas g.yang mo'i sems gso ba'i ched du de ltar bshad pa ma zad kho'i sems nang du yang dgra 429

'dul ma shi gson por log thub pa'i yid ches skyed de ngo ma de dus kho dmag dpon byed du bcug dgos snyams/dbang chen gyis ‘‘bu/ pha ngas dgra bo'i mdun du dpa' zhum myong med la nyam chung la brnyas bcos byed myong med/ bu dpa' bo la dpa' dang spyang grung gnyis ka dgos ’’zhes go don gting zab pa'i skad cha de bshad/mi dga' dga' mdog byed pa de pho gsar dmag la 'gro ba'i rtags zhes pa de las bden pa gang na yod/ da gzod dgra 'dul sngar bas lhag pa'i spobs sems rgyas nas ‘‘sang gnangs da ma'i da tshod la bu dgra 'dul gyis bu rta gnyis kas mdangs don song zhes rgya grags bod grags byed rgyu yod pa zhig byas nas log yong / khyed tsho tshang ma blo bde sems bde byos ’’zhes bshad pa dang / de nas ‘‘a jo don grub/ nga'i me mda' de khyed kyis gtsang ma zhig phyis dang ’’zhes bshad/dgra 'dul skra gtsang mar bkrus rjes kho tsho pha ma bu gsum yul lha dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo mthong thub pa'i ri zhig gi steng du song nas bsang btang ste gangs dkar gyi cod pan bcings pa'i dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mor phyogs nas mgrin dbyangs gcig 'gyur gyis/bso bso/lha dge bsnyen lhun gyi rtse mo bso/phar 'gro skyabs kyi skyel ma/tshur yong skyabs kyi bsu ma/mi bo 'dra 'dra'i nang la/mgo rmog dkar gang gis mtho bar shogarta bo 'dra 'dra'i nang la/lag srab mda' gang gis mgyogs par shog430

rgyab ri kha 'dzin can/srung ma myur mgyogs can/bso bso/mi la na tsha mi yong le/sangs rgyas sman lha'i bkra shis shogaphyugs la god kha mi yong le/nor lha 'dzoms pa'i bkra shis shogaces gsol ba smon lam dang kha g.yang smon tshig nga/nga yang bsgrags/nyi ma de yi phyi nyin zhogs snga po tshang ma mal las langs te zhogs ja bskol/zhogs ja btung grub rjes dgra 'dul gyi lus la gos chen smug khra'i tshar slog gyon/ mgo la wa zhwa dang rkang la sde dpon gyi sog lham de gyon te bo'u khra ring rgyab tu khur/ gyes khar g.yang mos mo rang gi phreng ba de bu'i mgul du g.yog nas ‘‘a ma'i bu/ na na tsha tsha mi yong ba shog bde bde thang thang ngang log yong shog ’’ces 'gram pa yang yang sbyar/dgra 'dul gyis ma gcig gi spun zla chung chung de pang du blangs nas 'gram pa sbyar te ‘‘khyod kyis nga sgug sdod ang ri’zer/de nas dgra 'dul gyis yul mi tshang mar zhal gyes zhus te rta pho rkyang rgod la bzhon nas dmag sgar gyi phyogs su skyod/der yod tshang ma'i mig mchi mas bkangs te rab rib tu gyur yang da dung sgo 'gram du langs nas gsol ba smon lam 'debs kyin mig gi skyel ma byas/de'i tshe rta dmag stong shog de stong dpon rdo dgas sne khrid de ru star sgrig nas sbrul nag ring po zhig 'khyug pa ltar lho phyogs su bskyod/kho tsho lho yi spang ri de'i steng du slebs pa dang dgra 'dul gyis rta kha phyir 431

bskor nas mgo'i zhwa phud de lag tu bzung nas lha dge bsnyen gyi rtse mo'i phyogs su gtad de rang nyid da res bya ba lam lhong dang / g.yul la rgyal kha thob ste slar pha ma spun mched dang yul mi spun zla dang lhan du 'dzoms thub pa'i gsol ba smon lam dang / gzhis sdod pha ma spun mched tshang ma tshe ring nad med bsam don yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i smon lam btab rjes slar rta kha bcus nas me 'bar ral gri dgung du 'phyar ba'i brgya byin dmag gi dpung tshogs dang 'dra ba'i hor tsho so dgu'i dmag dang lhan du bod kyi lo rgyus thog snyan grags kyi ba dan phyogs bcur g.yo ba'i rgyal gces dbyin 'gog dmag 'khrug gi g.yul ngor chas so/ /1995lo'i zla bdun par mdo smad chab cha rtswa thang du 'go brtsams shing 1999lo'i zla 9par nag chur mjug 'gril/ 432

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ dpal 'dzoms/r+sā41rmar+sā 7 lkokha byang jus 'god pa/ karma rdo rje tshe ring /dz+ra1o 7snye/ 0 throthag ring gi sbra nagatshe bstan pa yar rgyas kyis brtsams/mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun zhing 'grems spel byas/(pe cin ho phing li byang lam ang 14pa/ sbrag ang 100013kha par ang grangs 64234411da 6511)mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi skul 'od par sgrig khang nas par bsgrigs/dbyi hu'e par 'debs bzo grwa nas par btab/2005lo'i zla dang por par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/ji 2005lo'i zla dang por pe cin du par thengs dang po brgyab/deb tshad/ 850pa7pa྾1168)snye 1mo32 par shog 13 75par grangs/ 0001—5000 deb rer sgor 18 00
